title: <UNUSED>
obj_text:
Kill 8 Dragonmaw Raiders,3 Dragonmaw Bonewarders,and a Dragonmaw Battlemaster.
 Dragonmaw Raider slain (8)
 Dragonmaw Bonewarder slain (3)
 Dragonmaw Battlemaster slain
desc_text: Throm-ka,<class>. There is no time to waste. Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have fortified themselves in the valley to the south of here.$BThey have denied the Warchief's mandate,leaving us only one course of action. We will eliminate them so that they will no longer dirty the name of the Horde.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Talk to Kelt Thomasin.
desc_text: Hello there,<name>. I've heard much about your exploits,and must say I'm honored to meet you. I don't suppose you've heard the story of Ol' Kelt? Ah,well,Ol' Kelt--Kelt Thomasin,that is--was once considered one of the finest hunters in all the realm. There wasn't much he hadn't done,but then,one day,he became obsessed with an ancient story... a myth,really. Well,as the stories go,a huge threshadon lives in the waters of the lake. Hogwash,if you ask me. If you're interested,you might talk to Kelt.

title: Clefthoof Remastery I
obj_text:
Hunt down 12 Clefthoof and return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary's Safari in Nagrand to prove yourself.
 Clefthoof (12)
desc_text: You want to earn a place in this safari?  You'll have to prove yourself.$BI don't care what you've hunted before, you haven't hunted until you hunt what we hunt here.  Start with the clefthoof if you're <man /tough> enough.$BI know that I've seen them in the immediate area around the safari and also close by to the south.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Collect 5 Threshadon Teeth and 5 Threshadon Claws, then bring them to Kelt Thomasin.
desc_text: Now, this will no doubt convince you that I am, as they say--and don't deny it, I know what they say--of an addled mind, obsessed with an impossible legend. An old dwarven legend, it is, of an enormous monster that lives in the depths of the Loch. I spent a good bit of my life trying to track it down, and I believe I got close, but alas, I fear old age has caught up to me. If you would like to try hunting down the monster of the Loch, bring me some treshadon teeth and claws.$B<He smiles mysteriously.>

title: <UNUSED>
desc_text: Great Mammoda. Enormous,she was,with claws and teeth like swords. Now,I was caught off my guard,but I don't think being ready would have helped my cause much. One swipe and poof! Darkness. They say I'm lucky to walk now...$BWell,not much enjoyment to be had in hearing that old story now,is there? Anyways,<name>,if you'd like to try yourself against her,the Lady of the Loch,

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text:
Kill Maruk Wyrmscale$BReport to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.
 Ma'ruk Wyrmscale slain
desc_text: Other than you,we sent two scouts through Algaz.  Only one returned.  Here's what he discovered:$BThe Dragonmaws sent one of their Lieutenants,Maruk Wyrmscale,to organize a crew of orcs in Algaz and cut off the land route to Menethil Harbor!$BWe have to stop this,now.  Take out Maruk,and then report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.$BMaruk is headquartered in a small cave,across a pond between the second and third tunnels of Algaz.  Menethil is through Algaz,then west along the road.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Shayla Nightbreeze outside of Darnassus wants you to bring her 20 Gnarlpine Fangs.
desc_text: y strict orders from the Council of Darnassus,I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine Tribe. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.$BAs decreed by the Council,you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Kalidar. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Go to Tarren Mill and find out the status of the party sent by Thrall.
desc_text: As a child,raised as a gladiator at Durnholde Keep,I was befriended by Taretha,the daughter of my wet nurse and mistress of the damned bastard Blackmoore.$BThe past is the past,<name>,but reports of human movements in Hillsbrad reminded me of that time. I dispatched a small party to the area to investigate and to retrieve an... item... given to me by Taretha,if they could.$BA fruitless task,no doubt,but perhaps...$BThey should have returned by now,I want you to go to Tarren Mill to investigate.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Return Catelyn's blade.
desc_text: It's a long shot,but perhaps you could try to convince Catelyn to part with her dagger? The heart of a collector,you know how it is?$BPerhaps if you mention that it's for me,she might be more well-disposed to sell it to me.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: ring 6 Small Scorpid Carapaces to Kor'ghan in Sen'jin Village.
desc_text: You would do well to learn how dangerous this land can be,<class>.$BThe wildlife here can teach us such things... if we are wise and observant.$BThe scorpids are a perfect example of survival in Durotar. If you are to survive,it would be wise to take on some of their characteristics as your own. Their hardened carapaces can protect you from the harshness of the sun,or even a deadly weapon.$BBring me 6 Small Scorpid Carapaces from the Clattering Scorpids,<name>,and I shall see about rewarding you justly.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: ring 5 Scorched Hearts to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
desc_text: My scouts report that some of the Durotar wildlife have become infected with a demonic taint.  They were seen to the north and west.$BThey wander among their brethren as normal beasts,but evil powers flow through them,and burning within each one is a heart scorched by black magic.$BThese beasts must be destroyed!$BIf you find such an animal while you explore Durotar,kill it and collect its Scorched Heart.  Bring the hearts to me and I will have them studied,then destroyed.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: ring 8 Large Scorpid Carapaces to Kor'ghan in Sen'jin Village.
desc_text: One of the other traits of the scorpids is their fierce loyalty. They will protect one another if they are in danger--you've probably already seen this behavior in your first scorpid hunt.$BYou would do well to heed that lesson and adapt it for yourself: we are stronger as one; we are weak when we are divided into many.$BBring me 8 Large Scorpid Carapaces from the Armored Scorpids and I shall reward you for learning this wisdom.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: ring 10 Chunks of Boar Meat to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.
desc_text: Cook and clean--that's all I do!$BYou want to eat,you get me some more meat! I don't have all day to hunt and prepare food for all these louses. You got to learn to pull your own weight around here if you wanna be treated equal.$BGet me some Chunks of Boar Meat if you want to make yourself useful... or you don't want to starve to death.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: ring 8 Shimmerweed to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
desc_text: Truly a spirit of strength resides in your body--or maybe it was only luck,yes?$BThat is what the young rely on these days: luck... and the generosity of those more powerful than they. Not many take the time to find their own path. It's always begging for help... always the reward,and never the quest. I'm sure you'll be the same.$BBut there is hope. I need one other thing for my potion,<name>: 8 shimmerweed herbs. They can be found in Thunder Ridge to the northwest of Razor Hill.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Continue down the road from Camp Taurajo.$BTurn left at the T intersection and continue North.$BFollow the path to the Ancestral Sage outside the Crossroads.
desc_text: Though you have reached the Barrens, your journey is not complete. You must continue on to the Crossroads, where you are needed most.$BFollow the road as you were, and turn left where the path gives you the choice. Follow it North until you see the walls of the Crossroads.$BJust before you enter, you should see the Ancestral Sage, he will have words of wisdom for you.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to Volcor.
desc_text: If we decide to fight our way out,the plan is simple: we'll make our way down to the road and kill any furbolgs that get in our way... or anything else that decides it wants to stop us.$BI wish there was another way,but sooner or later the furbolg threat would have to be dealt with. Better it be by our own hands,so we know the job is done.$BTake a moment to prepare any magic or weapons you have at your disposal,then speak to me again.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to Volcor.
desc_text: I noticed the cloak you are wearing,<name>. If you'd be willing to sacrifice it,I can renew its magics,and use it to escape. The problem with that,though,is you'll be left here in the cave alone.$BAre you able to make it out of here on your own if we choose that course?$BI can assure you that Terenthis will reward you for aiding me,if that is your concern.$BThe choice is yours,but I could really use your help.

title: Clefthoof Remastery II
obj_text:
Kill 12 Clefthoof Bulls and then speak to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary's Safari in Nagrand about your prowess.
 Clefthoof Bull (12)
desc_text: You've proved to me that you can find and take down a regular clefthoof, but far more dangerous are the clefthoof bulls.$BBag yourself twelve of those.  Then you can talk to me of your hunting prowess.$BLook for them all along the middle region of Nagrand to the west and south.

title: Clefthoof Remastery III
obj_text:
Acquire the Horn of Banthar and return it to Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Banthar
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: anthar is the fiercest and most elusive of all the clefthoof in Outland.  She's also the hairiest.$BIt is said that she roams with her clefthoof herd in the Field of Spirits near Oshu'gun.$BYou want to truly prove your hunting mastery?  Bring me her horn!

title: <NYI> The Gnome Pit Crew is Thirsty
Windroc Remastery I
obj_text:
Kill 12 Windrocs and then return to Fitz at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Windroc (12)
desc_text: Do you live for the hunt as I do, <class>?  Do you seek the quietude that comes as you stalk your prey?  Would you know what it is to honor the last heartbeats of your fallen quarry?  I will help you to achieve this.$BNagrand is a lush land, full of life in the midst of this broken world.  Bring down a handful of the windrocs and then we will speak more.$BYou can find them in many places nearby in all directions around our camp.

title: Windroc Remastery II
obj_text:
Hunt down 12 Ravenous Windrocs and then return to Fitz at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Ravenous Windroc (12)
desc_text: You must always push yourself if you are to one day stalk the mightiest of prey!  While you are not yet ready, I will point you in the right direction.$BThere is another breed of windroc even deadlier.  Seek out the ravenous windroc to test your mettle against.  You will find them in the heart of Nagrand to the west and southwest.

title: Windroc Remastery III
obj_text:
ring the Eye of Gutripper to Fitz at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Gutripper
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: You are ready, <class>.  Ready to face the mother of all windrocs, Gutripper!  Honor demands that after hunting so many of her children that you give her the chance to defeat you!  Seek her out amongst the greater windroc far to the west.$BShould you survive, bring her eye to me.

title: Talbuk Remastery I
obj_text:
Kill 12 Talbuk Stags and then return to Harold Lane at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Talbuk Stag (12)
desc_text: I don't think that I'm up to the hunt today.  Do you think that you might take my place?$BI told Hemet that I was going to see about bagging us some of those talbuk that seem to be all over the place.  The stags are especially nice to hunt.  You can find them congregated around the nearby trees.$BThink that you could take care of that for me?

title: Talbuk Remastery II
obj_text:
Hunt down 12 Talbuk Thorngrazers and then return to Harold Lane at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Talbuk Thorngrazer (12)
desc_text:
This darned scratch is getting the worst of me it would seem.  So, are you up to filling...... in for me again?$BThis time you're going to bag yourself some thorngrazers.  They're tougher and wilier than the stags, so keep your wits about you.  Look for them... ... sheltered under the trees in the middle of Nagrand to the west and south.$BGo on, get out there and...... show Hemet what you're made of.  I'll be fine.
                Completion
, ... <name>! You did it. There's only...... one thing left to...... do then.$B
Rewards
You will receive: 3 50 $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
12,650 experience$B

Related

title: Talbuk Remastery III
obj_text:
Obtain the Hoof of Bach'lor and return it to Harold Lane at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
 Bach'lor
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text:
<Wracking cough.>$BDon't worry about...... me.  I'll be fine.  It's just a...... scratch.$BJust the same, I think you'll... ... have to fill in for me one more... ... time.$BYou must seek out the great Bach'lor, king of...... the stags.  It's ok if you... ... take friends along.$BBring me one of his hooves..., ... as confirmation.$BLook for him...... leading his herd in the far west of Nagrand.
                Completion
Wow! You did it! That's really Bach'lor's hoof!$BUm, I'm starting to feel much better it would seem. Here, let me give you something in celebration of your proven hunting prowess!$B
Rewards
You will receive: 7 $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
15,800 experience$B

title: Seared Tome
obj_text: Seek out Apprentice Yahk Loregrain in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, you have completed your first hunt and proven yourself worthy. The path before you now diverges - you must choose your destiny.$BThis Seared Tome was left for you by Apprentice Yahk Loregrain. He sensed the fire burning within your spirit even before your birth. The way of the Pyromancer calls to those who would master flame itself.$BTake this tome to him in Camp Narache. He will guide you down the path of eternal fire.

title: REUSE
obj_text: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it,/cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.
desc_text: "Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!$BCluck... cluck... cluck."$BThe chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word,but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask,the chicken turns away and goes about its business.

title: Welcome!
obj_text: ring the Ebon Hold Gift Voucher to Siouxsie the Banshee in Ebon Hold.
desc_text: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Siouxsie the Banshee in Ebon Hold.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!

title: Celestial Chart
obj_text: Seek out Chume Dawnmoon in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, you have proven yourself as a hunter, but the greatest mysteries lie not on the plains, but in the heavens above.$BChume Dawnmoon left this Celestial Chart specifically for you. She has read the stars and seen your destiny written in constellations yet to be named. The way of the Starcaller is ancient, predating even our oldest traditions.$BTake this chart to her in Camp Narache when the stars are bright. She will teach you to command the very cosmos.

title: Void Manuscript
obj_text: Seek out Ultha Dreamharrow in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, your hunt is complete, but a darker path beckons. Few Tauren would dare what I am about to offer you.$BThis Void Manuscript was left by Ultha Dreamharrow, one who walks in shadows most fear to tread. She has seen something in you - a willingness to embrace forbidden knowledge for the greater good.$BIf you have the courage to hear whispers from beyond the veil, take this manuscript to her in Camp Narache. But know that some knowledge cannot be unlearned.

title: Sun Prayer
obj_text: Seek out Sunwalker Thunderhorn in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, your successful hunt has caught the attention of the sun itself. An'she's light grows brighter when you are near.$BSunwalker Thunderhorn left this Sun Prayer for you, blessed by An'she's own radiance. He has foreseen that you will become a beacon of hope in the darkness that threatens our world.$BCarry this prayer to him in Camp Narache. The path of the Sun Cleric awaits - you will wield light itself as both weapon and shield.

title: Tauren Rune Stone
obj_text: Seek out Go'hro in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, the ancient stones themselves whispered your name during your hunt. The old ways stir when you pass.$BGo'hro, keeper of the eldest traditions, left this Rune Stone for you. Each mark upon it was carved before the first shaman spoke to the elements, before the first druid sang to nature. The way of the Runemaster is the oldest path of power our people know.$BSeek him out in Camp Narache. He will teach you to inscribe reality itself.

title: Elemental Totem
obj_text: Seek out Amuwate Lifegiver in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, during your hunt, I watched the very elements respond to your presence. Earth shifted beneath your feet, fire danced at your approach.$BAmuwate Lifegiver has prepared this Elemental Totem for you. She commands the primal forces through will alone - no bargaining with spirits, no gentle requests. The elements will obey you, or be compelled to obey.$BTake this totem to her in Camp Narache. The path of absolute elemental dominion awaits you.

title: Earth Shield Tablet
obj_text: Seek out Mr. Hooves in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, throughout your hunt, you instinctively shielded others from danger. The Earthmother herself has marked you as a protector.$BMr. Hooves, our most stalwart defender, carved this Earth Shield Tablet for you personally. He sees in you the makings of an immovable guardian - one who will stand between evil and the innocent, no matter the cost.$BBring this tablet to him in Camp Narache. The way of the Guardian demands sacrifice, but offers the greatest honor.

title: Thunder Call
obj_text: Seek out Tooantuh Cloudtail in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, the very air crackled with energy during your hunt. Storm clouds gathered above you without rain falling. You have been chosen by the tempest itself.$BTooantuh Cloudtail left this Thunder Call for you, inscribed during a lightning storm. He has mastered the rage of the skies and seen that same fury sleeping within your spirit.$BTake this manuscript to him in Camp Narache. The path of the Stormbringer will teach you to become the storm incarnate.

title: Ancestral War Tablet
obj_text: Seek out Galak Twoclubs in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, I have never seen such controlled fury in one so young. Your hunt was methodical, precise, devastating. The ancestors' rage flows in your blood.$BGalak Twoclubs prepared this Ancestral War Tablet after witnessing your potential. He carries the fury of a thousand battles and recognizes a kindred spirit. The way of the Barbarian is not mindless rage, but focused wrath.$BCarry this tablet to him in Camp Narache. He will teach you to ride the storm of battle without being consumed by it.

title: Sacred Oath
obj_text: Seek out Jax Dawnsoar in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, your hunt was marked by righteousness - you took only what was needed, harmed none unnecessarily. Justice itself guides your steps.$BJax Dawnsoar left this Sacred Oath for you, written on hide blessed by the Earthmother. He serves as both warrior and judge, and has seen in you the makings of a true champion of justice.$BBring this oath to him in Camp Narache. The path of the Templar will forge you into justice incarnate.

title: Returning the Chalice
obj_text: Return to Khazno with the filled chalice.
desc_text: I should return the filled chalice back to Khazno.

obj_text: Helo I am dooby the big poopoo peepee man and I like the number 8 ALOT.$BHaha why is 7 afraid of 4? becaujse 8% lol

title: Plains Hunter Guide
obj_text: Seek out Nawat Windhorn in Camp Narache.
desc_text: <name>, during your hunt, I watched you read tracks others could not see, move through terrain others could not navigate. The wild itself has claimed you as its own.$BNawat Windhorn crafted this Plains Hunter Guide after observing your natural talents. He walks paths others cannot follow and has marked you as one who will surpass even his skills.$BTake this guide to him in Camp Narache. The eternal hunt calls to you - you will become our eyes in the wilderness.

title: Time Anomaly: Prevention
obj_text: Investigate the Time Anomaly.
desc_text: I foresaw your arrival, <name>.$BThe strands of time are in trouble, enemies of the Bronze Dragonflight are twisting the timeways and causing serious problems in their misguided attempts to change history.$BWe must stop them, and we must act quickly.$BMy timeline crystal is glowing bright red, there must be some kind of anomaly occurring around here. I'll mark the general area the crystal is pointing towards on your map.$BBe careful, <name>.

title: Secrets to Keep
obj_text:
Search for clues to Lealiena's present location
 Innkeeper Jovia
desc_text: The next step is to find Lealiena. I didn't exactly give much mind to Tarothae's friends, save to make sure they didn't keep her from her studies.$BBut you know she was a student here, so I suppose that's a start. Assuming she also survived, I'd assume she went back to Silvermoon, so I'd start with asking around there.$BTarothae always insisted on buying her clothes from Silvermoon Finery, something about "not trusting" Keelan. Never had a single probably with Keelan, but I suppose some people are impossible to please. In any case, if Lealiena had the same baseless mistrust, Andra from Silvermoon Finery might know something.$BQuithas took on a lot of the surviving Falthrien students as apprentices. It's possible Lealiena was one of them, so I suppose you could ask if she's training under him.$BAnd I doubt she was able to get more than an inn room to stay at, so I'd ask Jovia as well.$BFind Lealiena, and see what she knows about Tarothae. I'm certain she has to be involved somehow.

title: Dungeon Lock
obj_text: Dungeon Lock
desc_text: Dungeon Lock

title: Secrets to Keep
obj_text: Meet with Tarothae at Runestone Shan'do
desc_text: That's not enough, is it?$BI expected as much. If you've been determined enough to complete this job that you tracked me here, then I shouldn't expect you to give up easily.$BAlright. I'm meeting with Taro soon, so I'll let you come. We meet at Runestone Shan'dor, at the edge of Eversong Woods. You can come, if you're so insistent. It's not like you won't find them another way anyways.

title: Arcane Memories
obj_text: Activate memories of Tarothae's past
desc_text: You! You're going out to the island, no?$BWell, I've got a job for you, if you're interested, and I highly suspect you will be interested. In the coin if nothing else. My family can pay you quite well, should you succeed of course.$BYou see, my daughter is missing, and it's been hard to find a good investigator these days. I understand, of course, Silvermoon has much larger concerns than one missing girl. But for me, Tara is my largest concern. She was a student here, see, back when Falthrien Academy was a respected educational institution and not...this.$BI know what you're likely thinking, but her disappearance was after the Scourge's invasion. This island is the only starting point I have, however. She never had a habit of telling me much, if I knew of her personal life leading up to her disappearance I may be able to pinpoint where she might be.$BNo, I don't expect to find her diary just lying around, but what I do have is a crystal. Now, in simple terms, what you need to look for enchanted crystals that have survived within the grounds, and use this on them. If everything works as it should, it should draw out images of the past, specifically past events related to Tarothae. Focus on smaller ones, anything larger has too much energy to draw out anything coherent.

title: BLOOD ELF, QUEST POI TEST
obj_text:
Kill 8 Mana Wyrms; they are located close to the Burning Crystals that are adjacent to the tower and gazebo.
 Mana Wyrm slain (8)
desc_text: The sooner you begin your education, <name>, the better for us all.  There is little room for error, so listen closely.$BThe Burning Crystals - the green floating objects to the west of the Sunspire here - have long been used to power the isle's experimentations.  The mana wyrms were their guardians, but the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas has driven them errant from our lack of magical control over them.$BThere is little choice but to thin their numbers for reclamation.  Do this, then return to me.

title: Learn to Ride - Runemaster
obj_text:
Learn to ride a mount as a Runemaster.
 $BRequired money: 3 60

title: Dealer's Choice - Healer: Growing Light
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spells: Holy Light. Recommended Starter Spells: Life Tap, Blessing of Wisdom, Renew.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a support to tend their wounds and cleanse them of deadly ailments in their fight against the dangerous foes in Azeroth's Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to heal and support your allies, I can set you on the path to becoming a beacon of hope capable of sustaining your party through the most brutal attacks imaginable.$BRequired Starter Spells: Holy Light.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling: Life Tap, Blessing of Wisdom or Renew.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Growing Light. You can search for Growing Light at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Dealer's Choice - Healer: Blooming Growth
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Recommended Starter Spells: Life Tap, Rejuvenation, Healing Wave, Healing Touch.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a support to tend their wounds and cleanse them of deadly ailments in their fight against the dangerous foes in Azeroth's Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to heal and support your allies, I can set you on the path to becoming a beacon of hope capable of sustaining your party through the most brutal attacks imaginable.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling: Life Tap, Rejuvenation, Healing Wave, Healing Touch.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Blooming Growth and the Epic Mystic Enchant: Natural Synergy. You can search for Blooming Growth and Natural Synergy at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Guardian's Oath
obj_text: Read the Guardian's Oath and seek out Aspiring Gladiator Alistair in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: A noble calling awaits you, <name>. This oath was inscribed on the finest steel I have ever seen, and it practically radiates honor and duty. The words speak of protection, sacrifice, and standing firm against impossible odds. Few have the heart to take such a burden upon themselves. Do you possess such courage?

title: Dealer's Choice - Healer: Holy Radiance
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spells: Greater Heal. Recommended Starter Spells: Life Tap, Blessing of Wisdom, Renew.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a support to tend their wounds and cleanse them of deadly ailments in their fight against the dangerous foes in Azeroth's Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to heal and support your allies, I can set you on the path to becoming a beacon of hope capable of sustaining your party through the most brutal attacks imaginable.$BRequired Starter Spells: Greater Heal.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling: Life Tap, Blessing of Wisdom or Renew.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Holy Radiance. You can search for Holy Radiance at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Dealer's Choice - Tank: Blademaster
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spell: Defensive Stance. Recommended Starter Spells:  Thunderclap or Taunt.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a stalwart defender to shield them from the dangerous foes in Azeroths Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to aid in their effort, accept these skill cards and begin your journey as a 2handed Parry Tank!$BRequired Starter Spell: Defensive Stance.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling: Righteous Fury, Thunderclap or Taunt.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Blademaster. You can search for Blademaster at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Storm Codex
obj_text: Read the Storm Codex and seek out Nikolaus Thesela in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: y the Light! This tome nearly shocked me when I picked it up, <name>. The very air around it crackles with electrical energy, and I swear I can hear distant thunder rumbling from within its pages. Only those with the fortitude to channel the raw power of storms should even consider opening it. Are you prepared for such elemental fury?

title: Templar's Vow
obj_text: Read the Templar's Vow and seek out Brother Haeliye in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: The Light itself seems to have blessed this document, <name>. When I hold it, I feel a warmth spread through my chest and a sense of divine purpose fills my heart. This vow calls for absolute dedication to the Light's will and unwavering faith in the face of darkness. Such devotion is not given lightly.

title: Temporal Manuscript
obj_text: Read the Temporal Manuscript and seek out Soridormi in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: Most peculiar, <name>. I could have sworn this manuscript wasn't here a moment ago, yet here it is. The text seems to shimmer and shift before my eyes, as if existing in multiple moments simultaneously. Such temporal magic is beyond my understanding, but perhaps you have the mind to comprehend its mysteries.

title: Necromantic Journal
obj_text: Read the Necromantic Journal and seek out Halbert the Scoundrel in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: I'll be honest with you, <name> - this journal gives me the chills. Literally. The temperature drops whenever I get near it, and I keep hearing faint whispers that I can't quite make out. The binding appears to be made from... bone. This contains knowledge of death magic that most would consider forbidden. Are you certain you wish to pursue such a dark path?

title: Blood Grimoire
obj_text: Read the Blood Grimoire and seek out Whisp the Silent in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: I must confess, this grimoire makes me deeply uncomfortable, <name>. The leather binding appears to be... well, I'd rather not speculate. It pulses rhythmically, like a heartbeat, and I swear the pages are stained crimson. The magic within deals with life force itself - a power both terrible and alluring. Handle it with utmost care.

title: Ranger's Guide
obj_text: Read the Ranger's Guide and seek out Owen of Moonbrook in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: What a curious thing, <name>. This guide still has bits of forest debris clinging to it - pine needles, moss, even a small twig. When I opened it briefly, I heard what sounded like birdsong and rustling leaves. It speaks of tracking, wilderness survival, and becoming one with nature itself. The wild calls to you through these pages.

title: Keira's Quest
obj_text: This is a test quest. Do not use.
desc_text: This is a test quest. Do not use.

desc_text: Are you ready to make something of yourself Hero?$BPick a skill card and relish in power you are sure to achieve. You can only pick though... so choose wisely!

title: Dealer's Choice - Tank: Plague Bearer
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spell: Bear Form. Recommended Starter Spells:  Righteous Fury, Swipe (Bear), or Evasion.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a stalwart defender to shield them from the dangerous foes in Azeroths Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to aid in their effort, accept these skill cards and begin your journey as a Bear Tank!$BRequired Starter Spell: Bear Form.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling: Righteous Fury, Swipe (Bear), Evasion, Maul or Growl.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Plague Bearer. You can search for Plague Bearer at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Flame Codex
obj_text: Read the Flame Codex and seek out Spenny Hotz in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: Careful there, <name>! This codex is almost too hot to handle. Flames dance across its surface without burning the pages, and the air around it shimmers with heat. I can practically feel the fire magic contained within, begging to be unleashed. Only those with a passion for destruction should even consider such power.

title: Dealer's Choice - Tank: Manaforged Barrier
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spell: Manaforged Barrier. Recommended Starter Spells:  Hand of Reckoning, Brilliance Aura,  and either Fireball or Frostbolt.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a stalwart defender to shield them from the dangerous foes in Azeroths Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to aid in their effort, accept these skill cards and begin your journey as a Caster-Tank.$BRequired Starter Spell: Manaforged Barrier.$BRecommended Starter Spells:  Hand of Reckoning, Brilliance Aura,  and either Fireball or Frostbolt.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Blademaster. You can search for Blademaster at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Engineering Manual
obj_text: Read the Engineering Manual and seek out Norman Normative in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: Fascinating! This manual is filled with blueprints and schematics I've never seen before, <name>. Small gears, springs, and clockwork mechanisms seem to spill from its pages, and I can hear the faint ticking of unseen machinery. The combination of magic and engineering here is truly remarkable. Innovation awaits those clever enough to understand it.

title: Dealer's Choice - Tank: Bulwark
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spell: Defensive Stance. Recommended Starter Spells:  Thunderclap, Shield Block or Taunt.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a stalwart defender to shield them from the dangerous foes in Azeroths Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to aid in their effort, accept these skill cards and begin your journey as a Shield Tank!$BRequired Starter Spell: Defensive Stance.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling:  Righteous Fury, Thunderclap, Shield Block or Taunt.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Bulwark. You can search for Bulwark at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Dealer's Choice - Tank: Crimson Champion
obj_text: Collect your skill cards and activate them while you are level 1. Required Starter Spell: Defensive Stance. Recommended Starter Spells:  Thunderclap, Shield Block or Taunt.
desc_text: Heroes all across Azeroth are seeking a stalwart defender to shield them from the dangerous foes in Azeroths Dungeons and Raids.$BShould you wish to aid in their effort, accept these skill cards and begin your journey as a Shield Tank!$BRequired Starter Spell: Defensive Stance.$BRecommended Starter Spells or High Priority picks while leveling:  Righteous Fury, Thunderclap, Shield Block or Taunt.$BThis combination of spells synergizes well with the Legendary Mystic Enchant: Crimson Champion. You can search for Crimson Champion at the Auction House to obtain it, or reforge items at the the Mystic Enchanting Altar to obtain it.

title: Kobold Camp Cleanup
obj_text:
Kill 8 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
 Kobold Vermin slain (10)
 Murloc Forager slain (10)
desc_text: Your first task is one of cleansing, <name>.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.

title: Forbidden Treatise
obj_text: Read the Forbidden Treatise and seek out Patal the Mad in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: y all that's holy, <name>... I can barely look at this thing directly. The symbols seem to writhe and shift, and I keep hearing... whispers. Voices speaking words I don't understand but that fill me with dread. This knowledge comes from the Old Gods themselves, and only the truly mad or truly brave would dare to study it. Which are you?

title: Solar Scripture
obj_text: Read the Solar Scripture and seek out Chaplain Eleora in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: What a beautiful sight, <name>. This scripture glows with the warm light of dawn, and reading it fills me with hope and renewed vigor. The golden text speaks of healing through solar energy and channeling the sun's life-giving power. Such radiant magic brings only blessing and renewal to the world.

title: Runic Inscription
obj_text: Read the Runic Inscription and seek out Sixtus Fiske in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: Ancient power flows through this tablet, <name>. The runes carved into its surface glow with their own inner light, and I can feel the weight of centuries in every symbol. This is the oldest form of magic known to our kind - the art of binding power into permanent form. Such knowledge was old when the world was young.

title: Death Manual
obj_text: Read the Death Manual and seek out Troes the Remover in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: This manual chills me to the bone, <name>. Literally. The air grows cold around it, and I can smell the distinct scent of funeral preparations. The knowledge within deals with death itself - not as evil, but as a natural force to be guided and channeled. Only those who understand the balance between life and death should study such arts.

title: Ancient Tablet
obj_text: Seek out Tormund the Reaver in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from defeating those kobolds, <name>. It appears to be an ancient tablet bearing the crude markings of the barbarian warriors. The stone itself radiates primal fury, and I can sense the wild strength that courses through those who follow this path. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

title: Guardian's Oath
obj_text: Seek out Guardian's Oath and seek out Kharzon the Hammer in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: This oath rings with the strength of mountain stone, <name>. You showed courage facing those wolves - now the words speak of standing firm like the peaks themselves, unmovable in the face of any storm. Do you have the fortitude to be an immovable guardian?

title: Storm Codex
obj_text: Seek out Storm Codex and seek out Elund Stormbelch in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: The mountain air crackles with energy around this tome, <name>. Even after dealing with those tough wolves, I can feel the electrical power contained within. Mountain storms are fierce and unforgiving - perhaps you have the fortitude to master their fury?

title: Tribal Scroll
obj_text: Seek out Doctor Roscoe in Northshire Abbey.
desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from defeating those kobolds, <name>. It appears to be a tribal scroll marked with the mystical symbols of witch doctors. Strange herbs are bound to its edges, and I can almost hear the whispered incantations of ancient spirits. The art of healing through shadow and light is not to be taken lightly. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

title: Sacred Letter
obj_text: Seek out Elling Trias in Northshire Abbey.
desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from defeating those kobolds, <name>. It appears to be a sacred letter bearing the silver seal of the witch hunters. The parchment itself seems to repel darkness, blessed by those who dedicate their lives to purging evil from this world. Such righteous fury requires proper guidance. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

title: Templar's Vow
obj_text: Seek out Templar's Vow and seek out Thosha Firstpride in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: y my beard! The Light shines as bright as forge-fire from this document, <name>. You handled those wolves with honor - the mountain dwarves have always known that true faith burns like the eternal flames of our forges - steady, strong, and unquenchable.

title: Temporal Manuscript
obj_text: Seek out Temporal Manuscript and seek out Harudormu in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: Strange... this manuscript seems to exist at multiple altitudes simultaneously, <name>. After watching you deal with those wolves, I see the thin mountain air must make temporal magic more visible. Only those with the clearest minds should attempt such studies.

title: Ranger's Guide
obj_text: Seek out Ranger's Guide and seek out Baruhr Mightmane in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: Fascinating! This guide still carries the scent of high mountain air, <name>. You showed skill tracking those wolves - I can almost hear the cry of eagles and feel the bite of wind through stone passes. The mountain wilderness calls to those brave enough to answer.

title: Warrior's Fury
obj_text: Seek out Mu'kaka in the Valley of Trials.
desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention, young warrior. It appears to be a primal tablet carved with orcish war-runes that pulse with barely contained fury. The stone radiates wild strength, and it seems to be from Mu'kaka, who teaches the barbarian's way in the Valley of Trials. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

title: Engineering Manual
obj_text: Seek out Engineering Manual and seek out Imcog Pullbang in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: Now this is proper dwarven work! I can hear the gears clicking and steam hissing just by holding this manual, <name>. After seeing your practical approach to those wolves, our mountain engineering is the finest in all the land - if you're clever enough to learn it without blowing yourself up!

title: Necromantic Journal
obj_text: Seek out Necromantic Journal and seek out Grimnir Lifetaker in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: The very stone grows cold around this journal, <name>. These mountains hold many ancient secrets, and after seeing how you dealt with those wolves, some of them involve the restless dead. Tread carefully with such dangerous knowledge.

title: Death Manual
obj_text: Seek out Death Manual and seek out Zipak Cogweight in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: The very air grows colder when this manual is near, <name>. Death is a constant companion in these harsh mountains, and after watching you put those wolves out of their misery, perhaps that is why some learn to guide it rather than fear it. Handle this knowledge with the respect it deserves.

title: Primal Codex
obj_text: Seek out Primal Codex and seek out Aldus Hammerfist in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: Raw elemental power swirls around this codex, <name>! After seeing how you handled those wolves, the magic contained within is as untamed as a mountain storm and twice as dangerous. Only those with the strength to embrace chaos should dare to study such primal forces.

title: Forbidden Treatise
obj_text: Seek out Forbidden Treatise and seek out Clippo Doomwhistle in Coldridge Valley.
desc_text: y the mountain kings... the symbols on this treatise seem to shift and writhe when I'm not looking directly at them, <name>. After watching you face those wolves, the mountain echoes carry strange whispers when this thing is near. Handle it with extreme caution.

desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention, young one. It appears to be a tome reeking of exotic poisons, green vapors seeping between pages of treated flesh. desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention, young one. It appears to be a sealed letter bearing the burning wax seal of the Inquisition. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention, young one. The way of the Starcaller opens celestial mysteries, and it comes from Starlord Landralanis, who commands stellar forces in Deathknell. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

title: A Small Mistake
obj_text: Search the Frostmane Encampment for Clues.
desc_text: Oh blast it all! This is bad…this is really bad…hey, you! Yeah, you! You want a job? Good. I’ve got one. Okay, calm down Efry, calm down…$BSo I was making a bot and I tried to make it smart! I was going to make a bot slow down, sorry. I made a bot, Intelligent Automated Security Guardian, or Nylrisa. What, you think I’m gonna go around calling it Iasg? No way! Nylrisa is my pride and joy, why, she’ll shape our concept of technology as we know it! Why, she’s probably a better strategist than you or I! With Nylrisa guarding your home, even a team of coordinated adventurers wouldn’t stand a chance!$BAt least…that was the idea…$BNylrisa has gone rogue. She left, who knows where, but with everything she’s capable of…well, this really isn’t good. I mean, I sorta gave her the ability to control bots and…look, this wasn’t supposed to happen, okay? Look, she attacked the Frostmane trolls over nearby, seems like she didn’t finish the job, but maybe she left something behind.

title: The Scout's Favor
obj_text:
Slay 4 Rockjaw Raiders and meet with Mountaineer Tagnur on the other end of the tunnel.
 Rockjaw Raider slain (4)
desc_text: No idea if Nylrisa's actually targetting the Frostmanes, but I don't have any other leads right now, so let's try and find that exile and see if she knows anything we don't.$BAlright, now, if I were an exiled troll, where would I be? Well, anywhere that isn’t one of the main encampments probably. Oh that really doesn’t narrow it down, does it? Wait, I know, I overheard this from a scout, maybe he saw more! The scout went up through the tunnel, you might’ve passed by him earlier even. Go find him, ask him what he knows!$BI’m heading to Thelsamar, maybe see if any of the dwarves there saw anything. Meet me there after you’re done and let me know if you got anything out of that troll, kay? Oh, uh, clear some troggs out of that tunnel while you’re there, might make that dwarf more open to chatting. Also, so I can actually get through…

title: Old Mirsinth
obj_text: Find the exiled Frostmane troll.
desc_text: I saw a troll wanderin’ in the hills up between Brewnall and Kharanos, looked to be avodin’ the other trolls. Went near the cave of that yeti we’ve taken to callin’ Old Icebeard. Why? Well, he’s been there for a while, and his beard has ice in it.$BAnyways, your troll exile’s probably dead by now, Old Icebeard’s taken out some good dwarves in my time. I wouldn’t go near him personally, but if you’ve really gotta find that troll, just keep an eye out and stay clear of him. Got it? Rather not have your death on my conscience.

title: We Found Her!
obj_text: Search for Nylrisa to the south-west of Brewnall Village.
desc_text: Alright, I got it! She’s not even that far out, just in the south end of Coldridge Valley. You should hurry before she leaves, and…you might have to destroy her, but try not to damage the internal components more than you have to. I just need to figure out what happened, make a few adjustments, and everything will be good, I swear!$BBut she’s still a danger right now, so get moving and go shut her down! I’ll…figure the rest out later.

title: A Brother's Betrayal
obj_text: Get Mirsinth the Exile’s totem from Jun’Kon at Frostmane Hold.
desc_text: You wish to talk things Old Mirsinth has seen? A being of metal wages war upon my people and maybe yours as well? Yes, yes, Old Mirsinth has seen many things, but maybe your being of metal as well. You wish it stopped for the threat it poses to your people, though it attacks mine?$BYou have better foresight than Old Mirsinth’s people, perhaps. You have put aside old feuds, so Old Mirsinth will as well. Old Mirsinth’s people are no longer Old Mirsinth’s anyways, cast out, yes, “exiled” as you say? Why is that? And why does your metal being not do as told? For the same reasons Old Mirsinth does not, or perhaps the opposite.$BIf you want answers, you will do something Old Mirsinth cannot. Old Mirsinth hides here because yeti keeps our peoples away. Yeti easier to hide from than our peoples, see. Old Mirsinth can hide, avoid, wander, but Brother Jun’Kon took Old Mirsinth’s totem when cast her out, see. No family of Old Mirsinth if she is no family of his. Brother Jun’Kon is coward, hides deep, deep in cave. Bring totem back, we will talk about metal being, history, many things, yes?

title: A Dangerous Sample
obj_text: Collect demon blood from a strong demon.
desc_text: You have my gratitude. The truth is, this flower is the only lead I have. I’ve gathered plenty of cacti, there’s enough around I didn’t need to venture much off the main road, but the property I observed must have been in the flower. It’s more than most anyone else has found, but I have limited resources, and we don’t even know where the flower originated.$BWhat I need to understand is the properties of the demon blood. I’ve taken plenty of my own as samples, but I need something from the source. There’s demons in the cave at the north end of the valley, no? Find me the blood of one there, not any blood, the strongest you can find.$BIt will not compare to what the orcs drank of long ago, but perhaps it is at least a start.

title: To Find a Cure
obj_text: Find the strange flower.
desc_text: Hmm. You mix the peacebloom and…no, that isn’t quite right.$BThe new recruit, right? Maybe you could help with something. Consider it part of your trials, maybe. Fighting was never my strength. I underwent these trials a few years back, a scorpid almost killed me. I only survived by making a salve with the local cacti and a rare flower.$BNot that it did much good. Do you think I’d be cheered on for coming back a failure? I’m a weakling who failed and a coward who couldn’t finish her fight.$BBut I’m back here anyways, not because I plan to repeat that but because I found my own path in life, and I’m trying to find a cure to something that’s afflicted us for a while. So if you do better in your trials than I did, I’m looking for another one of those flowers I found. Not for a healing salve this time. Something else. In my trials I found it in the north-west, growing under a tree.

title: Knowledge of the Centaurs
obj_text: Search the centaur camp for clues to the flower’s properties.
desc_text: This isn’t enough…it’s a start, yes. But this task will require more. For a start, I need to understand this flower’s properties. I’ve yet to find anyone in the Horde who knows of it, they don’t seem to grow very frequently. But there is another group who may know of natural things.$BThe centaurs have lived in Durotar for many years, not that we can just ask them what they know. Still, it’s possible they have some record of this flower. See what you can learn from their camp. I’ll be in Orgrimmar when you’re done.$BBe safe. You are already a stronger and braver warrior than I, but with strength and bravery often come foolishness, as much as many orcs are loathe to admit it.

desc_text: You recognize the drawing as a creature you have heard threatens Durotar, a harpy. Perhaps some bits of shiny metal will appease one enough to talk with you.

title: The Queen's Decree
obj_text:

desc_text: Sisters plan rebellion, yes, yes, yes, ears listen, hear vile traitorous words! Want power, freedom, want to be queen, yes, yes, yes! Killed for this title fairly, sisters just jealous, yes yes yes, jealous traitors they are!$BShow sisters who true queen, yes, yes, yes, not all, many, enough! title: Dark Chivalry
obj_text: Seek out Aheravara in Shadowglen.
desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention, <name>. It appears to be a dark proclamation bearing the seal of Xoroth, wreathed in cold shadow flames. The document speaks of wielding darkness in service of light, and it seems to be from Aheravara, who walks this dangerous path in Shadowglen. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

title: Deathbound Codex
obj_text: Seek out Baarelam of the Auchenai in Shadowglen.
desc_text: I was asked to bring this to your attention, <name>. It appears to be a bone-bound codex that chills the air around it. I can hear faint whispers of the departed emanating from its pages, and it seems to be from Baarelam of the Auchenai, who practices necromancy in Shadowglen. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

The scent of autumn's end clings to its pages, and it seems to be from Canni the Shade, who walks between life and death in Shadowglen. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.

title: Coming into Demonhood
obj_text: Retrieve the skull of Lo'k.
desc_text: And so it begins.$BGreetings, <name>. I can already tell that you have begun to feel the residual fel power that burns within your veins. I envy you, there was once a time where I was not so used to it as I am now.$BYou are Felsworn, and as such, you are at the border of mortality and the likes of demons. However, unlike some, you and I will not fall to the traps of power that fel magic provides, and that so many other practitioners fall too, often unbeknownstly. Perhaps you will even become powerful enough to take on a demonic form someday, but for now, your Fel Empowerment will do you wonders at bringing out your true potential.$BLet me make myself clear, the Horde and Alliance are of no use to us, but they must believe we are their allies in order for our greater goals to become achievable. Do not forget this. When it all comes to a head, do not forget where your true allegiance lays.$BAnd now, a test. A skull of a powerful demon known as Lo'k has been placed in the surrounding area. Find it for me.

title: Champion of Elune
obj_text:
Find the toppled statue and praise Elune.
 Pay respects to Elune
desc_text: al'a dash, malanore, <name>. I see Elune has not forgotten you, good, I could use one so blessed.$BAs Starcallers, we are champions of Elune, and as such, we must carry out her will - wherever it takes us, and whatever it must be.$BBut, when the land is embroiled with peace, one must learn to still pay respects to Elune, so that she will be there to guide us when the land is yet again filled with war and despair.$BIn the mountains to the north is a old statue dedicated to the time when Tyrande herself landed her forces upon the Eastern Kingdoms - a direct assault against the scourge itself, and aided my people.$BSince the time that the statue was erected, it has fallen, and been forgotten. Yet it remains as a pilgrimage site for followers of Elune. Go there, meditate, and pay respects to the goddess, then return to me.

 Scorpid Stalker slain
desc_text: My brethren be out here tryin' to deal wit da scorpid situation. It be more dangerous than it look.$BI am not da first one to be injured. I can only pray to da Loa that I was not poisoned. But I did get hurt. Thank you for healing me, mon.$BOh, no! Look behind you, mon! One of da scorpids be comin' back to finish da job!

title: The Demon Inside
obj_text:
Kill the unfathomably lazy peon.
 Unfathomably Lazy Peon slain
desc_text: Aha, <name>, welcome, do you like your mortal visage? The time has come for us to unleash hell upon Azeroth, one step at a time.$BAs you well know, there are only so many of us, but our numbers will grow with time. I need not remind you, I assume, that the plight of the Horde is not your primary concern. They are but a tool, a shield, so that we may further our own goals.$BAt every step, at every moment, we must wreck havoc on this world, yet we must not give up our secret - that we are demons - and as such, I have a little task for you.$BThere is a peon, one of which is so unfathomably lazy that he could not be made to do work no matter how hard you tried.$BI have been tasked by my superiors here to deal with him. We could give him a pay raise, we could beat him with a stick until he listens, we could even try to simply convince him to work. But...$BKill him, we'll make up an excuse for how he died. Scorpid attack, probably.

obj_text:

desc_text: Greetings, <class>. Glad you could join me in the graveyard today.$BBeautiful day, isn't it?$BIt seems you've already been acquainted with undeath, I am impressed by your ability to raise the dead.$BPerhaps you could be used to my benefit, which I'm sure you would not mind. title: A Quiet Life
obj_text:
Visit the waterfall in Northshire Valley.
 Visit the waterfall in Northshire Valley.
desc_text: Welcome to the order, <name>. I have awaited your arrival.$BAs Templars, we have ascended to the highest order of the holy faith, and as such we have quite a lot of responsibility on our shoulders.$BPaladins and Priests work alongside us to maintain peace through the Holy Light in this world and each of us, though different in our own subtle ways, hope to bring the light to Azeroth once more. Despite it's perils.$BOur path may be different but some may argue that it is far more rigorous. To be a templar means to maintain extremely precise control of your emotions, your combat flow, and your mind.$BIn order to keep myself healthy I enjoy meditating under the waterfall here in Northshire Valley. There is a statue there to remember one of the fallen heroes of the Alliance, and it is there that I find the peace to meditate. You must use your agile movement to reach the statue.$BPlease, visit the area yourself. Tell me what you experience when you return.

title: Welcome to the Warband
obj_text:
Kill Gerald and return back to your trainer.
 Gerald slain
desc_text: Har! Har! Welcome, <name>. Glad you could join the Warband.$BWhat is the Warband, you might be wondering? Considering your arrival, I would have assumed you'd already know. Well, little <class>, this is about to be a rude awakening.$BThe Warband is where all barbarians, brutes, and strongmen alike come together to compete to see who is the strongest, most brutal, and most powerful individual of them all.$BThat's the only way we can TRULY test our mettle. THIS IS IT! You may be new to this, but absolutely nobody will go easy on you.$BYour first test will be the same as all the other rookies. There's an individual who has been mucking things up and spreading rumors just because they couldn't cut it and were denied access to the Warband.$BThey're known as Gerald. Kill him, hahaha! I will reward you with a weapon well-suited for a noob like yourself if you are capable of such a task.$BCome back to me alive, or die.

title: Peace Through Strength
obj_text: Find "Little Wa'zoo" in the Kobold mine.
desc_text: It is nice to meet you, <name>. We have much work to accomplish together and you, my friend, have much to learn!$BWe are Guardians, and as such we are tasked with, quite literally, guarding Azeroth. From the occasional ne'er-do-well that robs a man, to far more threatening monsters who pose a threat to our people. We are the ones who heed the call.$BAnd, as my example preludes, I have such a task for you today. If you can do this, you are more than ready to proceed further into your training.$BThere is an individual nearby in the Kobold mine who goes by the name of "Little Wa'zoo", and I believe he could use my help.$BVisit him and see what he needs.

title: Runes of Power
obj_text: Figure out the riddle etched on the runestone.
desc_text: Greetings, <name>. I'm glad you could finally join me, I have awaited your arrival.$BToday, a simple lesson in problem solving for an aspiring Runemaster such as yourself. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will not.$BHere, I have a rune. Etched on the rune is a riddle. Figure the riddle out and return to me.$BA hint? The best I can do is tell you that the answer to this riddle lays within this abbey. Not without.$BI will know when you return if you have figured it out or not, do not worry. Succeed, and I will reward you.

I've been studying them. They have a particular sword that would be perfect for me. If you could acquire one for me in tip-top shape, that would be perfect!

title: The Way of the Pyromancer
obj_text: Defeat Scorch and acquire his heart.
desc_text: I've seen you around, <name>.$BYou've been reckless with your magics and careless with your studies.$BPyromancy is a dangerous art, and if you lose control you could end up burning both yourself and the world around you.$BThis is why I have decided to take you under my wing and show you the way of the Pyromancer. Your first mission to defeat a rogue fire elemental that has been summoned by a group of outlaw Pyromancers and left to wreak havoc on the surrounding area.$BThey bound it to a campfire in the hills near the Defias encampment, many innocents could be harmed if they peer into the flame.$BDefeat it, and bring me back it's heart.

I want it. The highest quality one you can find. No matter how many must die for you to get it.

I noticed you use one and I gave it to your trainer. Perhaps the one I found may be of some use to you.$BHe should have it ready for you when you return to him.$B... and <name>, thank you.

desc_text: Thank you for coming to my aid, <name>. I am happy to know that I am very looked after here in Camp Narache.$BTimes are getting... perilous. The local quilboar, as you may know, are quite a dangerous bunch. I seek a weapon that I could use to protect myself if things got tough.$BNot any weapon, however, for I would like a weapon carried by one of the quilboar themselves. Perhaps if they see me with it, they will think twice before attacking me.$BCan you get me one of their weapons?

title: Prioritizing Defense
obj_text: Kill Scarlet Converts until you find a suitable weapon for Cadmus Emberblaze.
desc_text: Ahhh, <class>. I knew help would arrive soon. I could use some protection today, or the means of protecting myself, perhaps?$BI am a master of all things fire and flame. Alas, my prowess in melee combat is lacking. I would like to be able to defend myself if the situation demands it without simply incinerating my opponent alive.$BNearby there are members of the Scarlet Crusade. They have weapons that could be of great use to me. Can you collect one of the finer ones you see and bring it back to me?

title: Helping A Friend
obj_text: Return to your trainer with news of your success.
desc_text: This sword... or dagger... is absolutely...$BPerfect!$BThank you for this! I found a shield while adventuring in the local spider cave not too far from here. I gave it to your trainer.$BI've already spoken to them and they know to give it to you. I'm sure it would be far more useful for you than it would be for me.

title: The Way of the Pyromancer
obj_text: Defeat Scorch and acquire his heart.
desc_text: Whoa... I don't feel so good, <name>.$BSo many whirls... I shouldn't have stared into the fire for so long.$BWhile I was whirling... I mean while I was swirling...swirling... Oooh...$BA group of rogue Pyromancers whirled around and summoned a fire elemental! He's bound to a campfire on the frozen lake and if you don't stop him he'll harm many innocent people!$BFind this elemental, his name is Scorch. Whirl and swirl him with your fire and obtain his heart, bring it back to me so I can study it.

title: Way of the Bear
obj_text:
Kill 8 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
 Frostmane Troll Whelp slain (8)
desc_text: Welcome, <class>. I have awaited your arrival here in Coldridge Valley.$BYou come to me for wisdom, and as such, I will deliver.$BThe first step to becoming a master <class> is mastering the way of the bear. With each successive mastery will come yet another challenge, but for now, let's focus on what it means to unlock your inner savage instincts.$BBears are large, ferocious creatures. They know only what they must to survive, and that is to kill. There is little one can do to escape from a bear who wishes to end their life.$BThrough the bear we gain savagery, viciousness, and strength, without mercy.$BShow me that you understand this by ending the lives of the Ice Trolls to the west of here and I will reward you.

title: The Way of the Pyromancer
obj_text: Defeat Scorch and acquire his heart.
desc_text: Even though my heart stopped beating years ago, the fire burns hot in my chest.$BDo you feel it too, <name>?$BThere are those who feel it a bit too much, and allow it to consume them completely.$BThey allow it to burn so hot they lose control of their impulses and do things they regret.$BA group of rogue Pyromancers burned so brightly they summoned an elemental from the domain of Ragnaros. They have bound it to a campfire in the hills, I task you with summoning and killing it.$BReturn to me with it's heart and I shall reward you with the control that they lacked.

title: The Way of the Pyromancer
obj_text: Defeat Scorch and acquire his heart.
desc_text: The fire rises, <name>.$BAs a Pyromancer, you must make sure it does not rise to engulf you, or you will burn in it.$BI have a task for you, a task that should aid you in controlling the raging inferno in your heart.$BA group of desperate Pyromancers have unleashed a force they could not control, they bound him to a campfire near the Burning Blade Coven.$BThe elemental's name is Scorch, I will mark his location on your map. Kill him, and bring me his heart.$BLok'tar ogar!

title: Way of the Bear
obj_text:
Kill 8 Webwood Spider.
 Webwood Spider slain (8)
desc_text: Welcome, <class>. I have awaited your arrival here in Aldrassil.$BYou come to me for wisdom, and as such, I will deliver.$BThe first step to becoming a master <class> is mastering the way of the bear. With each successive mastery will come yet another challenge, but for now, let's focus on what it means to unlock your inner savage instincts.$BBears are large, ferocious creatures. They know only what they must to survive, and that is to kill. There is little one can do to escape from a bear who wishes to end their life.$BThrough the bear we gain savagery, viciousness, and strength, without mercy.$BShow me that you understand this by ending the lives of the Webwood Spiders in the cave near here and I will reward you.

title: The Way of the Pyromancer
obj_text: Defeat Scorch and acquire his heart.
desc_text: *Yahk pats out a small fire on his beard*$BOh, hail <name>!$BIt's good to see you progressing along the path of flame!$BMy father, Pyromancer Loregrain, has left for the Blackrock Depths to learn more from the Dark Iron dwarves, and has left me in charge of training the next generation of Pyromancers here on Mulgore.$BUnfortunately, I have not been doing a good job.$BA few of my trainees lost their senses, and bound a powerful fire elemental to a campfire on the far side of the mesa.$BYou must stop this entity from burning the plains to cinder! Aid me, <name>, and I will ensure you do not suffer the same fate.

title: Way of the Bear
obj_text:
Kill 4 Felstalkers.
 Felstalker slain (4)
desc_text: Zug zug, <class>. I have awaited your arrival here in the Valley of Trials.$BYou come to me for wisdom, and as such, I will deliver.$BThe first step to becoming a master <class> is mastering the way of the bear. With each successive mastery will come yet another challenge, but for now, let's focus on what it means to unlock your inner savage instincts.$BBears are large, ferocious creatures. They know only what they must to survive, and that is to kill. There is little one can do to escape from a bear who wishes to end their life.$BThrough the bear we gain savagery, viciousness, and strength, without mercy.$BShow me that you understand this by ending the lives of the Felstalkers north of here and I will reward you.

title: Way of the Bear
obj_text:
Kill 8 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
 Frostmane Troll Whelp slain (8)

I have awaited your arrival here in Coldridge Valley.$BYou come to me for wisdom, and as such, I will deliver.$BThe first step to becoming a master <class> is mastering the way of the bear. With each successive mastery will come yet another challenge, but for now, let's focus on what it means to unlock your inner savage instincts.$BBears are large, ferocious creatures. They know only what they must to survive, and that is to kill. There is little one can do to escape from a bear who wishes to end their life.$BThrough the bear we gain savagery, viciousness, and strength, without mercy.$BShow me that you understand this by ending the lives of the Ice Trolls to the west of here and I will reward you.

 Bristleback Quilboar slain (8)

I have awaited your arrival here in Red Cloud Mesa.$BYou come to me for wisdom, and as such, I will deliver.$BThe first step to becoming a master <class> is mastering the way of the bear. With each successive mastery will come yet another challenge, but for now, let's focus on what it means to unlock your inner savage instincts.$BBears are large, ferocious creatures. They know only what they must to survive, and that is to kill. There is little one can do to escape from a bear who wishes to end their life.$BThrough the bear we gain savagery, viciousness, and strength, without mercy.$BShow me that you understand this by ending the lives of the quilboars at the ravine near here and I will reward you.

title: Perfect Timing
obj_text: Find Harodormu's wand in Anvilmar.
desc_text: Ahhh, <name>, I saw your arrival long ago. Now it is time to teach you what it means to be a Chronomancer. To weave the very fabric of space and time. To be equivalent to a god...$BLet me not get ahead of myself. For you, <name>, are new to the world of chronomancy, and before I can allow you to inhabit this world with such latent power... you must learn how to control yourself.$BAs a Chronomancer, you are a master of time magic. This means you must respect time on the most foundational of levels. It just so happens that I left my wand somewhere in this building.$BYou have 2 minutes. Find it for me.

title: Perfect Timing

desc_text: Ahhh, <name>, I saw your arrival long ago. Now it is time to teach you what it means to be a Chronomancer. To weave the very fabric of space and time. For you, <name>, are new to the world of chronomancy, and before I can allow you to inhabit this world with such latent power... you must learn how to control yourself.$BAs a Chronomancer, you are a master of time magic. This means you must respect time on the most foundational of levels. It just so happens that I left my wand somewhere in the abbey.$BYou have 2 minutes. Find it for me.

title: Call of the Shadowlands
obj_text:
Visit Gyrothor Turbospark in Anvilmar.
 Chat with Gyrothor Turbospark
desc_text: Ahh, finally, I have awaited another <race> such as myself to pursue such an envious craft!$B...you are bold. I can sense you have come to me to learn. I do have a simple task for you today, young <class>.$BIn this very room is a gnome who is near his end, Gyrothor Turbospark. Despite a life full of adventure and fulfillment, he is bitter of his encroaching end.$BHe will die and the Shadowlands will claim him. But today is not his day. Yet, I can feel his yearning to leave this plane, but he is unaware of what lays before him once he is gone.$BYou may not have expected such a task, but I would humbly ask you to pay him a visit and have a chat.

title: Perfect Timing
obj_text: Find Kalaeidormu's wand in Aldrassil.
desc_text: Ahhh, <name>, I saw your arrival long ago. Now it is time to teach you what it means to be a Chronomancer. To weave the very fabric of space and time. To be equivalent to a god...$BLet me not get ahead of myself. For you, <name>, are new to the world of chronomancy, and before I can allow you to inhabit this world with such latent power... you must learn how to control yourself.$BAs a Chronomancer, you are a master of time magic. This means you must respect time on the most foundational of levels. It just so happens that I left my wand somewhere in the in this building here.$BYou have 2 minutes. Find it for me.

title: Test Kill Quest
obj_text:
Kill 5 Murlocs and come back to the test character.
 Murloc Coastrunner slain (5)
desc_text: Got some time to spare?  Kill me some Murlocs and I'll give you something shiny!

title: The Hunt Begins
obj_text:
Reveal the witch and kill her.
 Find the Witch
 Witch slain
desc_text: I can feel an evil presence.$BYou can feel it too, can't you? That is why you have come to me at the most opportune of times.$BThere is one here. A witch. Brooding with evil and malintent.$BMay the Light bless us for what we're about to do.$BHere, take this torch. She's here in Anvilmar and I've marked her location on your map. Use the torch on her to reveal her true self. Kill it. No mercy.$BReturn to me when it's been slain.$BDamned witches.

title: Perfect Timing
obj_text: Find Quardormi's wand in Deathknell.
desc_text: Ahhh, <name>, I saw your arrival long ago. Now it is time to teach you what it means to be a Chronomancer. To weave the very fabric of space and time. To be equivalent to a god...$BLet me not get ahead of myself. For you, <name>, are new to the world of chronomancy, and before I can allow you to inhabit this world with such latent power... you must learn how to control yourself.$BAs a Chronomancer, you are a master of time magic. This means you must respect time on the most foundational of levels. It just so happens that I left my wand somewhere next door.$BYou have 2 minutes. Find it for me.

title: Runes of Power
obj_text: Figure out the riddle etched on the runestone.
desc_text: Greetings, <name>. I'm glad you could finally join me, I have awaited your arrival.$BToday, a simple lesson in problem solving for an aspiring Runemaster such as yourself. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will not.$BHere, I have a rune. Etched on the rune is a riddle. Figure the riddle out and return to me.$BA hint? The best I can do is tell you that the answer to this riddle lays within the Inn. Not without.$BI will know when you return if you have figured it out or not, do not worry. Succeed, and I will reward you.

desc_text: Staring into the card, the image blurs until you see yourself standing covered in the furs from many wolves and bears.  You can only assume this is your destiny should you invoke the tarot's power.

obj_text: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
desc_text: For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, <name>.$BTravel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Ahmo Thunderhorn. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.$BTake this totem to Ahmo. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.$BFollow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
