title: The Summoner's Path (WIP, THIS CANT BE COMPLETED)
obj_text: Collect 2 Cracked Skulls from the graveyard.
desc_text: The time has come for you to start your journey as Necromancer, <class>. We will start with basic summoning, you will learn to raise skeletal servants to overwhelm your enemies. Go to the graveyard nearby and collect 2 Cracked Skulls, then return to me, and I will share with you the incantation that will bring them into undeath.

title: Bookworm
obj_text: Speak with Seminarian Moroi, brother of Bianca Spada.
desc_text: <A woman greets you, visibly agitated. A sharp mix of anger and worry flashes in her eyes.>$BSorry, I didn’t mean to make a scene, but… that blasted brother of mine, always buried in his books! I’ve been out here forever, yelling my lungs out, and nothing. The guards have already warned me about “disturbing the abbey’s peace” one more time.$BWould you mind going in there and dragging him out by the ears if you have to? Our mother’s on her deathbed, and I’ve traveled a long way to fetch him so he can say goodbye. The ungrateful wretch.

title: The Ruins of Northshire
obj_text: Locate the cellar entrance to the Secret Inquisitorial Dungeon.
desc_text: A visit to the dungeon where the abbess was tried might shed some light…$BAccording to the book, the now-abandoned town of Northshire held a secret entrance to the Inquisitorial Dungeon.$BI’ll mark it on your map, but tread carefully. No one’s set foot in that place for years… I’d rather not imagine what vermin have claimed its ruins.

title: Accursed Sisterhood
obj_text: Purify the belongings of the former abbess, scattered throughout the Secret Inquisitorial Dungeon.
desc_text: The way is shut. The abbess cursed those who judged her, binding them to wander as restless spirits.$BThose who died are still chained by her power. The dignity and belongings they stripped from her became shackles. A simple prayer. A sincere plea. That would be enough...$BThey’ll find no rest until someone purifies the abbess’s relics, scattered throughout the dungeon.$BBut the Dead guard them well. And so, the way remains shut.

title: The Summoner's Path
obj_text: Collect a Lifeless Skeleton from
desc_text: It is now time for you to expand your undead legion. You will learn to raise skeletal archers that excel at swiftly taking out enemies from a distance. We will require a pristine skeleton, and a bow of some kind for it to use. Bring these things to me. You should be able to find a well conditioned skeleton within Tiragarde Keep.

title: Words That Shepherd Madness
obj_text: Find the hidden path leading to the top of the waterfall and confront the sins of the former abbess of Northshire.
desc_text: Sitis was... a storm. Her teachings were unorthodox; dangerous, even. Many students left the Church because of her.$BSo when the inquisitorial court summoned me to testify, I agreed to speak against her.$BI had learned she was holding secret gatherings with her closest circle at an old manor above the waterfall. In those meetings, Sitis spoke of the Light, of life, of death...$BAnd of the nature of the Shadow.$BHer heresy still stains that land. But beware if you go there; she had no shortage of followers, and the Inquisition never caught them all...

title: Smoke on the Wind
obj_text:
Follow in the footsteps of Grelbin, son of Groldha, and investigate the source of the smoke.
 Plating examined
 Crate examined
 Crystal shards examined
 Banner examined
desc_text: Ah, a traveler! One look at your garb and I knew you’d come from afar.$BCome closer, look. This newborn of mine suffers from an illness no healer has managed to cure. He has little time left. But his older brother refuses to accept that.$BSomewhere along the way, he heard whispers of a “congregation” claiming to have a cure for all ailments. Grelbin clung to that hope like a drowning man to driftwood, and left to find them.$BThat was two weeks ago. He hasn’t returned yet, and worse, the wind now carries an ugly black smoke from the direction I last saw him go. I fear the worst.$BPlease… follow in his footsteps, and bring him back to me. The gods have already judged that I must give up one son. I won’t lose them both.

title: A Promising Path
obj_text: Follow the mountain path to uncover the location of the mysterious group.
desc_text: <Before looting the body, you reason that the goblin won’t be missing the papers in his pocket.>$B<Thumbing through them, you piece together that the goblin was part of a crew sent to locate a mysterious group of ascetics in the Coldridge Mountains; the very same group Grelbin, Groldha’s son, went searching for.>$B<Among the papers, you find a map marking a path up the mountain to the ascetics’ hidden domain.>

title: His Radiant Majesty
obj_text: Tell Arathror when you’re ready to don the disguise. Then infiltrate Radiance Town and slay the cult leader, His Radiant Majesty.
desc_text: I’ve had too many run-ins with the Radiant; they’d spot me in a heartbeat. You, though… you’re new. An unknown face.$BAye, I think this disguise will pass. Let me know when you’re ready and I’ll help you into it. No, not like that, don’t be daft.$BOnce you’re disguised, keep your head down. Cross the village to the far side without drawing attention, and find their so-called king. Most cults fall apart without a strong leader.$BIf this is one of them, you might just be in time to save Groldha’s son from losing his mind.

title: Soaking the Masses
obj_text: Use the Radiation Sprayer to douse Radiaville’s townsfolk with radiation.
desc_text: New around here?$BForgive me; might be I’ve run into you before, but my memory… it flickers, in and out, like a dying bulb.$BFriend or stranger, I could use your help. <Lahud stifles a guilty little giggle, clearly embarrassed.> Don’t think I’m trying to weasel out of my duty; I meant to do it, truly! But then I got woozy…$B<The gnome swallows back a burp and jerks upright, twitching as if he’d grabbed a live wire.>$BAll you need to do is spray a bit of blessed radiation on some of the townsfolk. You know, their weekly dose. Do this for me and I’ll be forever in your debt!

title: A Fitting Disguise
obj_text: Slay Radiant fanatics and collect their armor pieces. Deliver them to Arathror so he can craft a disguise.
desc_text: Up ahead are the gates to Radiance Town, a rat’s nest of that sect’s rabble. They call themselves “The Radiants.” I’ve been keeping watch on them for a month now.$BThey believe bathing in the same radiation that devastated Gnomeregan will grant them some kind of revelation, or Light knows what.$BThey’re dangerous; heretics as well as rebels. Their leader’s crowned himself king, if you can believe it. And I have orders to see him executed.$BNow that you’re here… a plan comes to mind.$BFollow the road, scout the forest ahead, and cut down a few of those zealots. Bring me back some pieces of their armor. I’ve got an idea… you’ll see!

title: A Trail of Petals
obj_text: Channel Eldya’s power over the newborns in the Great Nest to transform them into butterflies. Then guide the butterflies back to Eldya.
desc_text: A visitor… Rarely do we welcome strangers among us, and with good reason: our practices were outlawed millennia ago.$BAt times I think, rightly so… Lady Aegya is willing to do things that would make even a satyr shudder. Do you know of what I speak? Elf children, offered up as tribute; war orphans no one would miss.$BHelp me save them. Go to the Great Nest and search among the carrion. Through you, I will channel my power and turn them into beautiful butterflies.$BI have enchanted this flower crown; its fragrance will be… irresistible. They will follow wherever you lead.$BBring them here. I will see to the rest.

title: QUEST_LEGION_CACHE_11
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
450 experience

title: Communion Banquet
obj_text:
Place the sanctified flesh upon the bowl in the Great Vulture’s nest. Then, aid Elydna in completing her communion.
 Communion completed
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: Here.$B<Gilgaen gropes at your hands and presses the sanctified flesh back into your palms.>$BLay it in the nest, with the other offerings Elydna has gathered to please the Great Vulture.$BYou’ve been granted a great honor, do you realize? To share in the communion of one of our own. Elydna can’t wait to meet you. I imagine you’re just as eager to meet her.

title: Knowledge Corrupts
obj_text: Recover the missing pages from Moroi’s unclassified manuscript, scattered throughout the abbey.
desc_text: Go on, take a look.$B<Moroi gestures toward the book holding his attention: a thin, battered manuscript, not unlike its reader.>$BI stumbled across it in the library; it’s not listed in the abbey’s records. I think it’s some sort of chronicle about an old abbess accused of heresy. In my haste, I’ve misplaced several pages. I’ve been trying to piece them back together, but some are still missing.$BCould you have a look around the abbey and recover the pages I lost? This is a banned book; if anyone finds out I’ve been poking my nose where it doesn’t belong, they’ll ship me back home… to my sister.$BDo me a mercy, will you?

title: Deciphering Radiation
obj_text: Slay radioactive slimes in Radiance Town and use the Contamination Extractor on their corpses to harvest mutagen.
desc_text: If you can sneak your way into Radiance Town… there’s something I could use your help with.$BI’ve been trying to understand how radiation works, looking for a way to counter its effects. For that purpose… I built this:$B<Redna shows you a contraption that only vaguely resembles a rifle.>$BKill a few radioactive slimes, then pull the trigger on this beauty. It’ll siphon the essence out of the slime and, with luck, let me isolate the mutagen.

title: Innocents for Sinners
obj_text:
Defeat the voodoo devotees guarding the path that leads to Hirsutta.
 Voodoo Devotee slain (5)
desc_text: It’s possible the Witch’s followers don’t even know the true purpose of the ritual. One way or another, we cannot allow them to stand between us and Hirsutta.$BYou understand… don’t you?$B<The orc’s face darkens. The hand he sets on your shoulder offers little comfort compared to what he is asking of you.>$BIn other words: you’ll have to cut through more than a few warriors before you reach her; innocents, mostly, who will die believing you were the villain of this tale.

title: Monsters With Noble Intentions
obj_text: Speak with Riscell Cain at the Heritage League camp.
desc_text: Greetings.$BI’m Anthon, proud member of the Heritage League. By order of our queen, my organization has taken on the royal duty of cataloguing, reclaiming, and restoring the cultural legacy of Lordaeron so it may serve the Forsaken.$BNot far from here, the road winds west, up the hill, to the Cain family estates.$BHere, I’ll mark on your map the location of my colleagues’ camp. They could use an extra hand; even before Lordaeron’s fall, there were rumors the manor was cursed… all because of a certain witch.

title: Restless Family Members
obj_text: Purify the remains of Riscell’s deceased relatives in the Cain Family Crypt, and send their spirits back to the Afterlife.
desc_text: We’ve made good progress on our own, but there’s still a great deal of work ahead.$BI’ll get straight to it. My parents died a few years before the Scourge came, yet their crypt suffered desecrations and humiliations I can hardly bring myself to name. So much so that their spirits now haunt the halls they once walked in life; confused, tormented.$BGo down into the family crypt, where my ancestors lie buried, and offer a brief prayer for their souls. That should draw their spirits back to their remains… where you can face them and send them on to the afterlife, where they belong.

title: The Friends We Make Along the Way
obj_text:
Slay the creatures prowling Cain Manor: zombies, ghouls, and bears.
 Necrotic Bear slain
desc_text: You’ve noticed, haven’t you? I can barely keep up here. And these wretches keep finding new ways to get themselves in trouble.$BI know someone who could lend us a hand… if we can get the right ingredients.$BI must remain here, protecting the camp. But you… you’ve already proven you can handle yourself.$BKill the creatures prowling around the estate: zombies, ghouls, bears… Don’t bother hauling back what they leave behind; their organs are volatile, and if not handled properly they could spoil... or worse. I’ll take care of extracting what we need from their bodies once this is all over.

title: The True Heir of the Cains
obj_text: Use the key to access the basement and defeat the creature within.
desc_text: Done.$B<Exsangue hands you the key, pieced together from the jagged remnants of the original. Twisted, splintered… its ability to hold remains as doubtful as whatever waits behind that door.>$BI’ll make sure no shambling corpse sneaks up on you while you deal with… whatever’s been locked away down there.$BMore than once, I’ve thought I heard a wail, followed by gurgling and screams. Tread carefully.

title: Death and Tribute
obj_text: Slay seven Grimtotem Marauders in Red Cloud Mesa, take their manes as proof, and deliver them to Lady Redhorn’s mistress.
desc_text: <The tauren sizes you up with a measured, judging gaze.>$BStrong. Well-built. Brave.$B<After a moment’s pause, he nods, convinced.>$BYes. You might prove useful.$BAcross this plain stands a lone cabin, the place of exile for my noble lady.$BShe is… a harsh judge. But generous. Slay seven Grimtotem Marauders and bring her their manes as proof. She will reward you well. And if she deems you worthy…$BShe will entrust you with the noblest of purposes.

title: Death and Exile
obj_text: Follow the Grimtotem Mountain Path to Hard Basin and show Morriga Hollowhoof’s ring to Sage Nauchol.
desc_text: I am Morriga Hollowhoof, daughter of the tyrant Malgorm Hollowhoof, lord of Three Totems.$BI have not always lived here. Once, I sought to free Three Totems from my father’s tyranny. I failed. My mate paid for that failure with his life, as did all who followed me in rebellion.$BI, however… my father lacked the courage to execute. Instead, he cast me out here.$BBut what he does not know is that I still have allies; both within the village, and beyond it. And you, stranger, will be my way of reaching them.$BFollow the path winding up the mountain, and seek out Sage Nauchol. Take him this ring. You’ll need say no more.

title: Death and Justice
obj_text:
Speak with Nauchol when you are ready for the disguise, then infiltrate Three Totems and slay Malgorm Hollowhoof.
 Malgorm Hollowhoof slain
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: You’ll find Malgorm Hollowhoof at the far end of the village, atop the hill, in the largest cabin of them all.$BAs you walk to him, keep your head high. Do not meet any gaze. Be confident. Proud. Arrogant, even. That is how his warriors behave. That is how he is.

title: Death by Laughter
obj_text: Channel the Great Hyena’s blessing into the village totems and defeat the guardian spirits that protect them.
desc_text: Don’t I stir a bit of pity in you? <The hyena scrunches its muzzle into something that almost resembles a pout.> So… alone. Out of place. Just like Morriga.$BShe’s lucky to have you. But what about me?$B<The pout stretches into a grin, rows of jagged teeth glinting.>$BLet’s play a game. Go into the village and channel my blessing through their totems. The spirits guarding them will be furious, but you and I will have ourselves a laugh at their expense.$BDo this for me… and perhaps fortune will bare its teeth for you as well.

title: An Unspeakable Secret
obj_text: Retrieve the key fragments held by the manor’s majordomo, maid, and stablemaster.
desc_text: With the spirits dealt with, there’s another matter… one far beyond the abilities of my colleagues.$BMy sister Priscilla, curse her name, turned the manor into a den of witchcraft. Her worst experiments were sealed away in the basement, whose key, we’ve just found out, was broken into three pieces, now held by the former majordomo, the maid, and the stablemaster. Brainless husks, the three of them.$BKill them and recover their fragments of the key. Exsangue will reforge it so you can open the basement and… give it a thorough cleaning.

title: A Noble Heritage
obj_text: Explore Cain Family Manor and recover whatever valuables remain. Then bring them to Thris.
desc_text: Do you know how the Heritage League funds itself?$BOur Queen allows us to keep a share of the treasures we recover. Which is why, up to now, we’ve restored far more palaces than fortresses.$BBefore their fall, the Cains were among the wealthiest families in the realm. I’d wager there’s still plenty in that manor worth laying hands on.$BGive it a look, will you? Depending on what you find, we might strike a deal.$BBut take care. The former lady of the manor, Riscell’s sister… Let’s just say the place is haunted.

title: The Saddest Among Us
obj_text: Defeat the Cursed Censor in the Secret Inquisitorial Dungeon.
desc_text: Slave to the hunger of the flames, always demanding more books to devour. When there were no more blasphemies left, they turned on the sacred texts instead.$BThe fire burns in his hollow sockets; there are no more tears left to shed.$BOnly death can release the Cursed Censor…

title: Death and Dishonor
obj_text: Gather pieces of armor and the identifying pendant of Three Totems warriors to complete your disguise.
desc_text: If you have faced fifteen of Malgorm’s warriors and lived, perhaps you have a chance against the tyrant himself. But not against an entire village.$BWe’ll need a disguise; to dress you as one of our own.$BAfter Morriga’s rebellion, her fallen warriors were denied the honor of funeral rites. Their bodies still lie scattered in the grass and muck, left to carrion. Their belongings won’t be missed, and the vultures will thank you for stripping them bare.$BOnly those who died loyal to Malgorm were given the rites. From their corpses you won’t find armor, but something far more valuable: the pendant that marks them as the tyrant’s chosen.

title: Unease Makes Tongues Wag
obj_text: Destroy the talking Tiki Masks around Zeb’Goro.
desc_text: De cubil folk ain’t de only ones sufferin’ from de spirits’ unrest. In Zeb’Goro, we face de same trouble. ’Til de Witch’s ritual set it right, we deal wit’ it how we can.$BSince ya here, I be askin’ ya.$BSome o’ de Tiki masks done started jabberin’ nonstop. At first it scare us. Den we laugh. But now… dey been yammerin’ for days, and dey don’t stop.$BSmash a few. Make dem hush.

title: To Whom I Devote
obj_text: Gather bones along the mountain path and offer them at the Great Hyena’s altar in Hard Basin.
desc_text: Numerous are the spirits who guide the Shu’halo. Some are more popular, well-known, and revered by all the tribes. Others…$BAt the end of the mountain path, in a corner of Hard Basin, stands a solitary totem honoring the spirit of the Great Hyena. My patroness.$BI owe her much, even in exile. Her wisdom has guided me through these long years.$BTake her an offering in my name. Bones; the bones of my enemies, and of the great beasts whose remains line the path.$BWe will need her blessing if we are to bring down my father, the tyrant.

title: Oracular Idol
obj_text: Collect three Prophet’s Oracular Orbs from the murloc oracles roaming the Shadewell Spring.
desc_text: <After the spasms and convulsions of a brutal death, the murloc slumps into the wet earth, dropping a sphere that rolls to a stop at your boots.>$B<On closer inspection, you realize it’s no common jewel at all; it’s an eyeball. Its slick surface reflects vague images that do not match the world around you. It’s as if… it’s as if it shows you what’s yet to come.>$B<Perhaps you should strike down the other oracles and examine their strange, blind eyes.>

title: Sever the Right Hand
obj_text: Defeat Right Hand of His Majesty in Radiance Town.
desc_text: Have you run into the exile, Redna?$BShe pitched her camp on the hill just above us.$BLast time I spoke with her, she said something I haven’t been able to shake off:$B“The only one who’ll defend a lie fiercer than the liar is the fool who believed it.”$BThe one they call “The Right Hand of His Majesty” is living proof of that. He’s no ordinary follower; Redna swears he’s crueler, more despotic, and more fanatical than his master.$BIf you’ve the steel for it, cut him down while you’re making your way through Radiance Town. Then, report to Redna. She and him had… unfinished business.

title: Restless entrails
obj_text: Defeat the Rotting Flesh Spawn in the Lunar Ossuary.
desc_text: Heading into the ossuary, are you?$B<The elf eyes you doubtfully, weighing your worth before deciding if you’re fit for the task.>$BA monstrosity of entrails and bone slithers through the ossuary tunnels, ravenous for corpses to gnaw. The worms, foolish defilers, are nothing but its spawn.$BKill the creature and… I’m certain the cult will reward you handsomely.

title: I'm Home
obj_text: Defeat the Hound of House Cain behind the manor.
desc_text: We are monsters. But sadder still than our fate is the confused, agonized misery of the beasts that roam our woods and fields.$BOnce, I think my heart might have pitied them. But I’ve no pity left. And besides, the practical thing is to put them down.$BEspecially the old, faithful hound of the Cain family.$BCircle the mansion, find his grave, and make sure he’s truly dead. He wouldn’t be the first undead mastiff to catch his master’s scent… and devour him.

title: The Carrion Road
obj_text: Walk the Carrion Path and defeat its guardians.
desc_text: <The elf greets you with a respectful bow of the head.>$BForgive me. I’ve come a long way, and no one here seems willing to help me. Perhaps… you could?$BI’ve been searching for my sister, Elydna. About half a year ago, she was invited to join a secret druidic circle, and left without even saying goodbye. She never returned.$BI managed to trace her steps here, to Shadowglen… but I’m just a merchant. I can barely hold a blade! And the path leading to this hidden grove of druids is well-guarded, and dangerous.$BWould you walk that road for me, and make sure my sister still lives?

title: Sharing the Land
obj_text:
Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
 Palemane Tanner slain (10)
 Palemane Skinner slain (8)
 Palemane Poacher slain (5)
desc_text: <name>, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as our elders have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.$BPalemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.$BWords are no longer the answer.

title: Fighting Over Carrion
obj_text: Defeat the Cruel Carrion Spirit in Hard Basin.
desc_text: Perhaps you noticed that wretched presence… the bird circling over Hard Basin, lording over the carrion scattered across the battlefield.$BHe’s nothing but an echo of an echo, but with me stuck down here and him flying free above… it makes my teeth itch.$BKill him, will you? If not for me, then for the reward.$B<The hyena spirit flashes a sly grin full of sharp teeth.>$BOh yes… the reward will be worth it. More than worth it.

title: The Threat Swept Downstream
obj_text:
Defeat the Defias lurking in the ruined tower and thin the ranks of the Shadewell murlocs atop the waterfall, across the rope bridge.
 Defias Plunderer slain (5)
desc_text: I need… help.$B<The soldier’s voice comes ragged, choked with pain. Each grimace is a fresh wound.>$BI was ordered to find the murloc village, to cut off their threat. But, as you can see, the road has not been kind to me. And worse yet: the only path to the upper river runs straight through that tower.$B<He nods weakly toward the looming, ruined structure.>$BYou, though… you might succeed where I could not.$BDeal with the Defias infesting the tower, thin the ranks of the murlocs above the falls, and you’ll be doing me a favor the whole kingdom will thank you for.

title: Finding the Good Meat
obj_text: Gather five cuts of good meat from the Moonlit Ossuary within the Vulture Cult Eyrie.
desc_text: The Great Vulture is fickle, but he remembers those who crawl and beg. With the right offering… perhaps he’ll look kindly on Elydna during her communion.$B<Lady Aegya’s crooked smile suggests the exact opposite.>$BGo into the barrow we call the Moonlit Ossuary and bring me five cuts of good meat from the corpses that rot within its rancid halls.$BBe careful, though. We leave their bodies to ferment, that their taste might better please the Great Vulture’s beak. And rot, as you well know, draws all manner of vermin…

title: The Sister Who Never Returned
obj_text: Speak with Lady Aegya, leader of the Vulture’s Cult, and ask what became of Thariel’s sister, Elydna.
desc_text: So… you’re not here of your own will, but out of… “altruism.” <The word drips with disdain, as though he thinks it more weakness than virtue.>$BI am bound by oath; I cannot speak of our members. You must beg before our lady, our teacher, our guide: Lady Aegya. She will decide what to do with you, and whether you’ll share in Elydna’s fate.$BYou’ll find Lady Aegya further inside, in the hall.

title: Transsubstantiating the Flesh
obj_text: Carry the gathered flesh to the Moonwell and sanctify it in the waters.
desc_text: One last step remains.$BThe flesh you’ve gathered drips with corruption, but it’s too dry. The Great Vulture likes his offerings moist, so they wet his cruel beak.$BTake this meat to our Moonwell. The face of Elune you know is only one among many. Long before she laid with Malorne, she took the Great Vulture to her bed. Still today, she loves him true.$BBless the flesh in the Moonwell’s waters and slay whatever shadow rises from its depths. Only then will Elydna be ready for her communion.

title: The Way is Shut
obj_text: Use the amulet given to you by Swa’li to break through the magical barrier guarding the entrance to the Sinister Lair.
desc_text: Nearby, we found a cave where the veil ‘tween worlds runs thin. A place o’ power, haunted by spirits dat take de form o’ beasts.$BDa Witch sent her apprentice to gather what be needed for da ritual: da spirit essence of a serpent, a bat, an’ a spider. But she never returned. Could be she already dead.$B<Swa’li presses into your hand a small troll idol, carved from bone and set with a blood-red gem.>$BA mighty spell wards de cave’s entrance. You’ll be needin’ dis to cross de barrier an’ reach de other side. If Anjali be dead… can we count on you to finish what she began?

title: A Sinister Ritual
obj_text: Confront Hirsutta the Witch and put an end to her dark ritual.
desc_text: Even as we speak, a shudder runs through the Valley of Trials. Anjali and Hirsutta are locked in a clash of wills; and though Anjali holds the power of the three essences, she is losing ground to the Witch.$B<The shaman speaks with his eyes closed, as though the struggle between the two sorceresses belongs to a world unseen.>$BIt must be done now, or never.$BI will commune with the elements and try to break the Witch’s focus. In the meantime… you have already gained some measure of field experience. Fight your way to her lair, and end her before it is too late.

title: Those Who Fell
obj_text: Use the Unremarkable Stone to extract samples of spiritual unrest from the restless orcs and trolls, and present your findings to the witch of Zeb'Goro.
desc_text: The spirits of the dead are restless. They torment us with dreams and visions that have already broken many among us. I have sought counsel with the elements, but… they will not answer me.$BTake this.$B<Esgramor places in your hand a stone far heavier than its modest size would suggest.>$BIt is a warding amulet. Go to the broken, to the tormented, and use the stone’s power to draw forth fragments of their unresting spirit. Gather what you can and bring them to the witch of Zeb’Goro. She is a sorceress of dreadful power and deep wisdom.$BI trust she will know what must be done.

title: A Door Left Ajar
obj_text: Defeat Techla’tu, Gatekeeper, in the Sinister Lair.
desc_text: I be feelin’ a presence up ahead. Among de spider spirit, de snake, de bat… someting else be movin’, pourin’ it power into de barrier guardin’ dis cave.$BIf we be succeedin’… if I be makin’ it outta here alive… ya gonna hafta strike down dat creature an’ send it back ta de other side, where it belong.

title: Tattered Chest
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
160 experience

title: Start Digging
obj_text: Meet Serina at the rendezvous point near Bandits’ Bastion.
desc_text: You don't seem to be from around here. This place is getting noisy. Too many eyes, too many questions. I don’t like repeating myself, and I don’t trust half the people within earshot.$BMeet me near the Bandit's Bastion, so I can go over the details.

title: The Sinister Triad
obj_text: Gather the spiritual essences of the beasts haunting the Sinister Lair. You will need one from a spider, one from a bat, and one from a serpent.
desc_text: De Witch… she not your ally. I don’t know all what she be plannin’, but I know dis: she won’t mend de troubles o’ de spirits.$B’Cause she de one who caused dem.$BShe been callin’ up de souls o’ de dead, tearin’ dem from deir rest, burnin’ dem as fuel for her ritual. All she still be needin’ are de spirit essences from dis cave. Dat why she mus’ not claim dem.$BBut if you were to bring dem to me instead…$BMy wounds be grave, but my resolve never been stronger. I believe I could bend de power of de essences to weaken de Witch’s Voodoo.

title: So That He May Hear Again
obj_text: Free the elementals next to the cave. Then, speak with Esgramor and tell him of Hirsutta’s true intentions.
desc_text: De power of de essences won’t be enough to stop de Witch.$BYou will have to face her yourself.$BBut first… dere be de matter of de elementals.$BDe Witch knew de spirits o’ de valley would rise against her, so before she began de ritual, she bid me bind dem—trap dem in a circle o’ power, so dey could not interfere.$BBefore you return to de shaman an’ confront de Witch, you must set dem free. When you leave de cave, follow de path dat winds to de right, through de rocks. At its end, you will find de circle of power.

title: Arcane Insight
obj_text: Deliver the mineral fragment to the Tower of Azora and seek magical insight into its properties and potential use.
desc_text: I don't recognize this mineral. That worries me. When gold’s involved, people talk. But this? This has everyone quiet.$BThe mages at the Tower of Azora may be able to tell us more. They deal in things not found on trade routes.$BTake the fragment to them. And be careful what you say, I don’t want this spreading before we know what we’re standing in.

title: Timber for the Coldhewn
obj_text: Chop down Dun Morogh trees near Coldhewn Camp and return with 12 Frostpine Logs.
desc_text: Did they send you? If you are another one of those scumbag contract managers, turn around and walk back the way you came. I am up to my neck in bad orders and worse paperwork.$BJust got an extra order from Ironforge. Big one. Sudden. And instead of giving us more hands, they swapped out the whole logging team. No time to train, no time to plan, just get it done.$BI am behind, and I hate being behind. If you are handy with an axe and do not mind the cold, I could use the help. We need Frostpine logs, twelve of them. You will find them in the woods nearby.$BIt is not charity work. I will make sure it is worth your while.

title: Fulfilling a Promise
obj_text:
Arugoo of the Stillpine has asked that you free 8 Stillpine Captives from cages found in Bristlelimb Village.
 Stillpine Captive Freed (8)
desc_text: The prophecy spoke of one that would rise and deliver us from the oppressive grasp of Bristlelimb -- that the spirits themselves would herald the arrival of this hero.$BAnd now,you have come.$BI humble myself before you,great one. I beg of you,save our younglings. They were taken by the Bristlelimb while our guard was down. You will find them in cages at Bristlelimb Village,to the southwest. The Bristlelimb furbolgs hold the keys to the cages. Strike them down and take their keys. Release my kin.

title: <DEPRECATED>From the Desk of Mogul Razdunk
obj_text: Take the Top Secret Venture Co. Plans to Admiral Odesyus at Odesyus' Landing.
desc_text: According to these plans,the goblins are here for the crystal wreckage of the Exodar. It would appear that the goblins are intent on strip-mining the island of the crystals and hijacking the two Alliance ships docked off-shore once their task is complete.$BYou should probably take these plans to Admiral Odesyus.

title: Defias Disruption
obj_text:
Thin the ranks of the Defias at the Bandit Bastion, east of Goldshire.
 Defias Bandit slain (6)
 Defias Rogue Wizard slain (4)
desc_text: Oh, um... are you one of those brave types? The ones who deal with danger and monsters and... all that?$BIt’s just that things have not been the same here lately. The taproom’s quieter, the roads feel emptier, and even the usual loud sorts have stopped passing through. I keep trying to tell myself it is just a slow season, but... I do not think that's it.$BI heard a rumor, just a rumor, that some of those Defias bandits have built up a camp somewhere east of here. People are saying they've been stopping travelers, stealing supplies, or maybe worse. I do not really know for sure, but... maybe if someone went out there and gave them a reason to think twice, things might calm down a bit?$BThat might bring folks back.

title: Elydna's Heirloom
obj_text: Speak with Thariel Wingstroke and deliver to him the pendant of his sister, Elydna.
desc_text: As you ponder our offer, remember that the Great Vulture rewards those who bring food to the nest. Thus, the possessions that once belonged to Elydna in life now find a new owner in the one who took hers away.$B<The elf's sharp hands, more like a vulture's talons than those of her kin, grasp yours and place an ornate pendant in your palms.>$BOne of Elydna's belongings. Her pendant. Do with it as you will.

title: Dwarven Digging
obj_text: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.$BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.$BBring 5 Broken Tools to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
desc_text: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.$BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.$BYou can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.

title: Into the Scar
obj_text: There are greater concerns now than a few misbehaving apprentices. Travel to the Scar, along the wall of the Ruins of Silvermoon, and give Ranger Jaela whatever aid she requires.
desc_text: The Scourge threat still festers just beyond the Ruins of Silvermoon. If Quel’Thalas is to truly heal, the corruption must be purged at its source. Rally your strength and take the fight to The Dead Scar—the desecrated path that cuts through Eversong like a scar across the land. Cleansing this blight is no small task, but the fate of Silvermoon depends on it.

title: Further Assistance
obj_text:
Your continued assistance would be of great value to the Sin'dorei. Find Apprentice Ralen to the east of here, along the road. north of the river bridge. There's work yet to be done.
 $BFind Apprentice Meledor
desc_text: Find Apprentice Meledor

title: Fastrider Reach
obj_text: We've repelled the attack and secured the walls, but there's no time to rest. Go West and South along the road, to Farstrider Retreat, and there speak with Magister Duskwither.
desc_text: The Scourge has been beaten back enough that we can breath, the walls of Silvermoon City are secure, but we cannot cower here and wait for the next assault, preparations must be made.

title: Supply Run
obj_text: Recover 4 Stolen Supply Crates from the Bandit Bastion, east of Goldshire.
desc_text: Listen, I have a bit of a follow up for you, if you're still feeling up to the task.$BThere’s talk that the Defias have gathered in a proper hideout east of here. It’s a large encampment, far more organized than the usual rabble.$BSome local merchants were hit in a raid not long ago. Crates of supplies were taken. Useful things like tools, cloth, even some rare spirits. The sort of goods folks rely on around here.$BIt’s not without risk, but if someone were to head in and recover what was lost, I know a few people who would be grateful. I would see to it that you're rewarded for your effort.

title: Report To The General
obj_text: ring this information to General Marcus Jonathan
desc_text: General Marcus Johnson will want to know about what you found here.  Bring this report to him, you should find him as you enter Stormwind.

title: A Betrayal Within
obj_text: Return to Marshal Dughan.
desc_text: You've found what looks like a genuine Alliance document, carried by a man dressed as a soldier stationed deep in a Defias outpost. The contents point to collusion between Alliance forces and local bandits.$BThis should not be happening. Someone loyal needs to see this.$BDeliver the document to an appropriate Alliance official. With any luck, they will know what to do with it.

title: Doctor's Orders
obj_text: Collect 8 Stone Arrowheads, 3 Discolored Fangs and 1 Clean Fishbones from the beasts of Echo Isles.
desc_text: Hey you! Witch Doctor! I need your help.$BVoodoomaster Sho'jin has taught me much since he came to the village. I need some supplies from Echo Isles to continue practicing the remedies he has shared with me. I'm far too busy here to go myself, maybe if you get them for me, I can share with you some of what he has taught me?$BYou can find Stone Arrowheads in the raptors of Echo Isles, Discolored Fangs from the tigers, and Clean Fishbones from the surf crawlers. Good luck, and please hurry!

title: A Darkhound's Treat
obj_text:
Find a treat and give it to Edwin's hound.
 Edwin's Darkhound Fed
desc_text: You still look a bit nervous, don't worry, he won't bite. Not unless I tell him to anyways.$BAlright, here, why don't you do something to earn his trust a bit? He's quite fond of those duskbats, took a while to train him not to just rush at them when they wander by the camp actually.$BI've been seeing a big one off to the east, been meaning to go hunt it for him, but since you're here, why don't you go find it and give him a piece?

title: Warborn Grounds: "Lowfang"
obj_text:
Defeat the first challenger: "Lowfang"
 $BDefeat "Lowfang"
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: You! You aren't just here to spectate, are you? You're the type who likes a good fight, I can see it in your eyes.$BWhy don't you give a round in the ring a go? There's wealth and glory in it if you win, and a good death if you lose. We've got another newbie all lined up, if you win I'll get some more experienced opponents for you.

title: Warborn Grounds: "Deathscreech"
obj_text:
Defeat the second challenger: "Deathscreech"
 $BDefeat "Deathscreech"
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: Don't get cocky now, Lowfang had no experience in the ring, he's just a warm-up.$BNext in line is a harpy all the way from the Dustwind tribe. Don't act like that's so odd, I'll take anyone willing to fight, doesn't matter what feuds are happening outside the ring. I didn't understand her real name, doesn't matter though, she talked in this horrible screech, so her name in the ring's Deathscreech.

title: Warborn Grounds: "The Masher"
obj_text:
Defeat the third challenger: "The Masher"
 $BDefeat "The Masher"
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: Word is spreading fast about you, <class>. The crowd is already calling you the Mysterious Stranger, and some are saying you might go all the way. You have not just surprised the fans. You have made believers out of them.$BBut this is it. The final round.$BYour last opponent is a walking disaster zone. The Masher. Ogre, massive, mean, and completely unhinged. He does not fight clean. He does not hold back. You beat him and the ring is yours.$BGo in strong. Walk out a champion.

title: The Nature of Freedom
obj_text: Test Rod Toxicstrike's concoction on 3 zombies, 3 skeletons, 3 banshees, and Mallek the Tormented
desc_text: You know, since you're going around these parts anyway, you could help me with something. I'm a scientist, not a fighter, you see. Unfortunately, those are two positions that intersect more often than I care to admit.$BWe Forsaken broke free of the Scourge, but many still serve it. Some are in far worse states of decay, like most of the ones around the Mills here, but others prove more difficult to explain. Our Dark Lady was once a banshee, yet I've spotted banshees in this region who remain bound to the Scourge.$BPerhaps it's simply a matter of will. Even so, surely there must be a way to nudge at least some who retain a portion of themselves into severing their bond to the Lich King, no? That’s the basis of my theory. Alas, this concoction is as far as I can safely get.$BPerhaps you could give it a try? It should instate a temporary surge of power which, if my thesis is correct, might give them a chance to assert control. In practice, it does little on its own, but if someone like you were to weaken the forces binding them first, I'd expect it to prove far more potent.

title: Mixed Reagents
obj_text: Get the Bundle of Samples to Dawn Brightstar.
desc_text: Now that we have both samples, I need them prepared properly and for that, we’ll need Dawn Brightstar.$BShe handles our volatile components and has a much steadier hand than I do.$BTake the spider legs and the filled vial to her inside the tower. Don’t spill anything and don’t let her talk you into trying anything. She gets... curious.

title: Apothecary Flemer
obj_text: Speak with Apothecary Flemer in Brill.
desc_text: You've done good work here.$BWhen you're finished at Deathknell, pay a visit to Apothecary Flemer in Brill. He's that “someone” I mentioned earlier.$BTell him that as soon as I'm able, I'll send a shipment of the flesh he needs for his abomination.

title: Test the Mix
obj_text: Drink the "Enriched" Mineral Water to check for any ill affects.
desc_text: Hmm.. It doesn't seem to react at all. Think at this dosage level the mineral has no reaction.$BYou look like a strong and healthy individual mind taking a sip? It is perfectly safe! I think..$BReport your findings to Theocritus.

title: Enchant the Mineral
obj_text: ring Mineral Fragment to Kitta Firewind.
desc_text: So amounts found in Jasperlode Mine are definately not enough for anything, even after prolonged exposure and appear to be safe.$BBut given Defias is mining for it, there must be something more to it. Bring the Mineral Fragment to Kitta Firewind inside Tower of Azora to see if she can enchant it for us to see if mineral reacts in any way to magic.

title: Fighter Fuel
obj_text: Shinga the nurse wants you to collect 4 Vials of Scorpid Venom, 4 Vials of Raptor Blood, and 4 Boar Tusks.
desc_text: At the rate these fighters are getting themselves hurt, I'm going to run out of healing herbs.$BI know another remedy that'd help them recover just as well, but it's rather dangerous to get, and I'm no fighter.$BIf you end up going out there, maybe you could bring the ingredients back? I need scorpid venom, raptor blood, and boar tusks. Don't worry, the venom isn't harmful if it's treated the right way.

title: Stay a While
obj_text: Take a moment from the noise and haste and stay a while to listen to Dark Priestess Ashara.
desc_text: <Looks like you're one of the rare curious souls ready to hear a banshee's sermon.>$B<Perhaps she has something worth sharing.>

title: Scarlet Correspondence
obj_text:
Find the Scarlet Crusade camp and put down their agents.
 $BScarlet Zealot Slain (5)

 Scarlet Mage
 Scarlet Battler
$B

 Scarlet Soldier
desc_text: <Correspondence exchanged between Alric Sading and a certain Belmont of the Scarlet Crusade.>$B<It seems the rebels had been in touch with the crusaders for some time, and were about to throw open the gates of their palisade as a token of goodwill.>$B<The humans' camp is marked to the north. A brief visit is in order... to remind them who holds lordship over these lands.>

title: Seven Years of Bad Luck
obj_text: Inspect the broken mirror shards that Aldia Crayon blames for the curse afflicting Lady Agria Spada.
desc_text: Hm...$B<The majordomo gives you a long, measuring look.>$BBefore you go... I need your help with one more matter.$BI've had the sense for some time that my lady's ailments aren't physical, but magical. A curse.$BIt started with a broken mirror. And you know what they say. However thorough I've been, shards keep turning up; bits of glass tucked around the manor and the grounds.$BWould you kindly deal with them?

title: More Than the Sum of its Parts
obj_text: Collect Necrotic Spores from the fungus in the abandoned tower overlooking Brill. They come in two forms: clinging to creatures and encapsulated in mucous globules on the ground.
desc_text: How to put this so a lay mind like yours might grasp it?$BAn abomination is more than the sum of its parts. For the Scourge, the secret ingredient was a dash of necromancy. We, of the Royal Apothecary Society, are obliged to find... more creative solutions.$BThe tower that looms over Brill shelters a fungal growth unlike any I've seen for miles. It fattened itself on death and necromancy, and its spores still pulse with that essence.$BBring me every spore you find, whether they're clinging to the hides of its wardens, or trapped in mucous globules scattered across the floor.

title: Worm-Eaten Apple
obj_text: Find and destroy the kobold warrens around Goldshire.
desc_text: Whispers. They think no one's noticed,but I sleep with my ear to the floor! Ha!$BThey dig and dig and dig. They'll strike when you least expect it... unless you do something first.$BKobolds and kobolds and more kobolds. Under our feet! Watch where you step. Mind your footing!$BFind their warrens and set them alight. Crush them. With a big, heavy hammer!$B<She laughs to herself, then stares into the middle distance.>

title: The Maid I Left Behind
obj_text: Find Dulcinea, Bianca's maid, in Goldshire.
desc_text: You've been in and out of the abbey all day, yet I still haven't seen my brother anywhere.$BI take it you couldn't snap him out of it. Well... worth a try.$B<Her long, weary sigh says enough.>$BHeading out again? Maybe you can do me one more favor. On the way to the abbey I left one of my maids in Goldshire with a long list of ingredients to buy; medicine for my mother.$BHer name is Dulcinea. Could you find her and let her know I'll be late?

title: Esgramor's Master
obj_text: Speak with Karagar in Razor Hill.
desc_text: The Valley of Trials lived up to its name with you, friend.$BMy place is here, but the road's calling you. And I think I've a fair guess where you'll head next.$BI know a sage in Razor Hill who could use your help. His name is Karagar. Find him, and while you're at it, tell him everything about Hirsutta, the ritual, and your heroic intervention to foil her plans.

title: Stay a While
obj_text: Take a moment from the noise and haste and stay a while to listen to Aliscar Lend.
desc_text: As it turns out, I'm the leading authority around here when it comes to the village's history. Care for a short lesson?$B<The aging sorcerer seems eager, almost desperate, to talk.>$B<Perhaps he has something worth sharing.>

title: Amphora of Sacred Water
obj_text: Fill the amphora with the blessed water of the Iris Sanctuary, and bring it to Sage Muudren in Bloodhoof Village.
desc_text: This sanctuary was raised in honor of the Earthmother and the Sky-Father. When it rains, the hollowed stone at its heart gathers the water the clouds so generously bestow.$BThen, with all due ceremony, I bless it.$BFill an amphora with the water that washes the totem's feet, and carry it to Sage Muudren in Bloodhoof Village. With it, he can soothe the roused elements and restore the village's spiritual harmony.$BI do not know if it will mend Ardunno's rashness, but it will help to soften its effects.

title: Echoes of Hirsutta
obj_text:
Defeat naga in Rivenruin Cave on the Durotar coast.
 Rivenruin Myrmidon slain (10)
 Rivenruin Sorceress slain (5)
desc_text: The powers Hirsutta loosed drew the eye of the ever-hungry naga that prowl Durotar's shores.$BEver crossed paths with one? Elf-and-serpent hybrids. They've slithered out of the sea and holed up in the ruins of a coastal cave, east of here.$BI doubt they know exactly what sparked the surge they sensed, but they're here to probe its nature. Sooner or later, they'll be a problem.$BUnless you see to them first.

title: Stay a While
obj_text: Take a moment from the noise and haste and stay a while to listen to Bagamul Skyfang.
desc_text: Sit down, don't worry. There's room for both of us.$B<The old orc gestures in welcome, murmuring as if to himself.>$B<Perhaps he has something worth sharing.>

title: Smoke on the Horizon
obj_text: Speak with Ammus Grey-Eye at the summit of the Iris Sanctuary.
desc_text: Headed to Bloodhoof Village, beyond these walls?$BI've been watching the horizon that way, and I'd swear the wind was carrying smoke; a scorched tang to it.$BIt wouldn't be strange; even here in Mulgore, the tauren are not without enemies.$BPay a visit to Ammus Grey-Eye, up on the mesa. She's the wisest among us and tends the sanctuary at the summit alone.$BWe usually go to her for the water she blesses for our rites. If Bloodhoof Village faces a crisis, they'll need those blessings more than ever.

title: Stay a While
obj_text: Take a moment from the noise and haste and stay a while to listen to Ammus Grey-Eye.
desc_text: <The elder Tauren fits the description of the sanctuary leader, reputed to be among the wisest of her kind.>$B<Perhaps she has something worth sharing with you.>

title: Durotar's Dire Drought
obj_text: Fill the pitcher with water from one of the pools outside Razor Hill, then give the mine peons a drink.
desc_text: New to Razor Hill?$BName's Dirgran; foreman over the peons working this mine.$BWant to earn a little coin?$BI need someone to fill this pitcher and head into the mine to slake my peons' thirst.$BYou've noticed, I'm sure, doesn't take a keen eye, that water's scarce in Durotar. But there are a few pools just outside town, by the road, still fit to drink.

title: Agria's Medicine
obj_text: uy the potion's ingredients at the Goldshire market: Elgris Blossom Petals, Dun Kazad Liquor Concentrate, Pumpkin Juice, and a Murloc Eyeball.
desc_text: Lady Agria Spada is a woman besieged by age. Of late she's borne a litany of ailments that keep her to her bed.$BOnly one thing eases her: the draught brewed by her master alchemist.$BI've gathered a few ingredients, but the list is long and fussy. We still need Elgris Blossom Petals, Dun Kazad Liquor Concentrate, Pumpkin Juice, and a Murloc Eyeball.$BTake a turn through the market. Once you've got the lot, report to my lady's manor. I don't dare the roads alone, but you... you're made of sterner stuff, aren't you?

title: Exile of Embers
obj_text:
Channel the blessing to weaken the fire elementals prowling around Ardunno's hut and banish them back to their elemental plane.
 Devouring Fire slain (5)
desc_text: Ardunno was the shaman who set the blaze. He died of his own foolishness, and, luck for us, the flames did not spread beyond his hut.$BEven so, the elementals he summoned moments before his death still wander among the charred remains. You know the kind I mean: wrathful spirits whose very flesh is fire.$BOf the four elements, the most volatile.$BI will lay the blessing of these waters upon you. Use it to weaken the fire elementals you find and banish them from this village, from this world, back to their prison-plane.

title: Goldshire's Generosity
obj_text: Gather Melons, Pumpkins, and Apples from the farms around Goldshire. Then deliver them to Eldor Hammer, leader of the refugees.
desc_text: Welcome.$BI am Thorm—Harvend Thorm—mayor of Goldshire, serving on behalf of Lord Bruk and his house.$BYou may have noticed the makeshift camp in the shadow of this grand hall. Of late, Goldshire has taken in countless refugees out of Westfall. At times I fear it's beyond our means...$BEven so, I won't turn away while they go hungry. Walk the village fields and take a little from each harvest to bring to the camp. You have my leave—and, by extension, Lord Bruk's.

title: A Dark Warning
obj_text: Speak with Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
desc_text: Wait.$BThere's something else. <Thariel's voice comes out tight; the words stumble off his lips.>$BThat cult. The lunatics who lured in my sister. Something must be done.$BI'll stay here in Aldrassil and report the cult to Tenaron Stormgrip. You head to Dolanaar and tell Tallonkai Swiftroot everything.$BBetween them, they'll know how to shut this down.

title: The Smoke that Remembers
obj_text: Obtain incense for Ancestor Emnil's altar. You will need Prairie Sage and Kodo Tallow.
desc_text: Young <race>, my name is Emnil, ancestress of the Bloodhoof.$BI crossed the veil centuries ago, long before the children of my children laid claim to these lands. Then they brought my ashes and scattered them in this place; and they raised behind me the great totem you behold.$BArdunno, fiery of spirit, reckless, ever enamored of the flame, kept the ritual incense; but with his death the sacred smoke grows thin, and with it my bond to the realm of the living.$BWill you, out of honor, rekindle the fragrance and replenish the sacred incense?

title: Auction the Past
obj_text: Recover Elven Relics of Old from the ruins in Rivenruin Cave, Durotar.
desc_text: You here about the naga?$BPerfect!$BSee, I was poking around the cave ruins, scooping up elven relics to flip at auction (you'd be amazed what those antiques fetch) when the first naga showed up.$BI had to hightail it! And, as you can imagine, I barely grabbed a thing.$BSince you're heading into the cave anyway, mind picking up a few relics for me? I'll cut you in for a percentage of whatever I pull at the Auction House!

title: The Aid of Theren-Dion
obj_text: Speak with the Sentinels at Theren-Dion Sanctuary and challenge them to duels to aid their training.
desc_text: You survived the Vulture Cult, and that more than proves your worth.$BAbove us, perched on the cliff, stands the Theren-Dion Sanctuary, where the Sentinels test their mettle.$BThey'll welcome someone like you putting them through their paces. Might clear your head, and you might pick up a thing or two from them.$BChallenge them to a bout, then report to their leader, Adrilia Soultemper. Tell her I'll need her Sentinels to move on the cult threat.

title: Stay a While
obj_text: Take a moment from the noise and haste and stay a while to listen to Alenna Whisperbough.
desc_text: <Gazing at her, you're certain that Teldrassil itself could go up in roaring flame and Alenna would not be moved.>$B<Perhaps she has something to share.>

title: No Place for Scavengers
obj_text: Destroy Vulture Eggs around the Theren-Dion Sanctuary near Dolanaar.
desc_text: The Vulture Cult's nearness explains a problem we've been facing of late.$BIt's rare for the carrion birds of mainland Kalimdor to reach Teldrassil's boughs; yet lately, dozens have settled on the rocks around this sanctuary.$BBefore you return to Dolanaar, help my Sentinels blunt their threat. Destroy the vulture eggs and be ready for the parents' fury.$BThen report back to me.

title: A Growing Business
obj_text: Speak with Eyma Thunderbrew at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.
desc_text:
<The dwarf waves from afar to catch your eye; big sweeping arms at first, then he starts hopping in place.>$BWell met! I saw how you handled Groldha. I'm guessing you won't be lingering in Anvilmar much longer...$BIf that's the case and your feet carry you to Kharanos, I've a message that needs delivering.$BFind Eyma at the inn and tell her the talks in Anvilmar bore fruit. They want a shipment of our best ale; if it wins them over, we've got ourselves regular buyers. The ancestors smile on us, <class>!
                Completion
<The dwarf woman's inquisitive brow softens when you mention Norhi and the message he asked you to deliver.>$BThat's good news, <she says, without much enthusiasm.>$BI'll see to it the shipment's ready as soon as possible.$B
Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
530 experience$B
250 reputation with Ironforge$B
250 reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles$B

Related

title: Thunderbrew's Hop
obj_text: Harvest seven Thunderbrew Hops from the Thunderbrew Distillery grounds in Kharanos.
desc_text: Nori must've seen something in you, to trust you with that message.$BSince you're here, maybe you can lend a hand.$BStep out of the inn and look left; you'll see the distillery's hop yard. Special strain of hops, for the finest brew in all Dun Morogh.$BWe're swamped today with customers. Would you mind picking hops and bringing them back to me? Hardly hero's work, I know. But it pays, and it pays well.

title: Live-Fire Demo
obj_text: Test Gornarn's Blunderbuss and ammo on the practice targets up on the ridge above Kharanos.
desc_text: <The dwarf braces a blunderbuss between his knees and runs a rod down the barrel; push, twist, pull, until the grime comes loose and spatters out.>$BSorry, didn't notice I had an audience.$BFancy putting a few rounds downrange? Targets are always hungry for lead; with luck, we'll catch a buyer's eye.$BAll this ammunition isn't going to sell itself.

title: Bots on Strike
obj_text:
Defeat Out-of-Control Automata clogging the Kharanos tunnel and recover Reusable Mechanical Parts from their remains.
 $BOut-of-Control Automaton destroyed (7)

 Out-of-Control Automaton v1.2
 Out-of-Control Automaton v1.3
$B

 Out-of-Control Automaton v1.1
desc_text: Careful! The tunnel's been impassable for a few days now.$BMy inventions, the automata I built with these very hands <he shakes them in your face, more comic than tragic>, have betrayed me. They've turned on me!$BNow they attack anything that wanders close. They've already claimed a life and, worse yet, they've wrecked my reputation!$BDon't go into that tunnel unless... <the gnome's eyes take on an opportunistic glint>.$BYou're not like the others, now that I look at you. You might just survive them. Destroy them... That's it! Go in there, take them apart, and bring me their parts.

title: Stay a While
obj_text: Take a moment from the noise and haste and stay a while to listen to Gravedigger Nonuid.
desc_text: <The gravedigger's weary look tells of a long day at the shovel. The pit impresses you not so much by its depth as by the clean, polished finish of its earthen walls.>$B<Perhaps he has something worth sharing.>

title: Final Dig
obj_text:
Find Defias mole inside Lion's Pride Inn.
 $BFind the Mole

 Innkeeper Farley
 Tomas
$B

 Dunrik Stonekeg
desc_text: While you were out looking into the uses for the mineral. I managed to put back together who might be the mole for Defias in Lion's Pride Inn from all the Charred Documents we recovered earlier.$BBased on said documents it should be someone working in the Inn, someone who has extended history with them.$BWe just need to question few people inside and see who slips up.

title: Extravagant Order
obj_text: Return 4 Gem Encrusted Spider Silk to Tharynn Bouden.
desc_text: Ah, Hero, may I have a moment? You see, I've come across a grand business opportunity and could use your expertise. I've gotten recent reports of a spider infestation—disgusting things—in the Jasperlode Mines. Bad news for the Kobolds, but a great opportunity for us!$BApparently the spiders produce a very unique, and very valuable type of silk—Gem Encrusted Spider Silk! I've hypothesized it has something to do with feasting on the kobold miners located in and around the mine, but it's just a theory. Anyway, if you could bring me 4 of these Gem Encrusted Spider Silks I could reward you handsomely!

title: Unexpected Results
obj_text: Test the Enchanted Mineral Fragment.
desc_text: e very, very careful while handling this. Mineral appears to be highly unstable when exposed to magic.$BWe need to test its full potential.$BGo outside of Tower of Azora and test it on local wild life.

title: Ancestral Armaments
obj_text:
Kill Zalazane's apprentice, Makasgar, on the coast just North of Sen'jin Village.
 Makasgar slain
desc_text:
Young Witch Doctor - you show great promise in our arts. For your journeys I want to equip you with the tools that you will need to survive in this world, before you embark on greater adventures. If you can help me with bringing an end to the one they call Makasgar, who trained under Zalazane in the forbidden ways, I will give you a powerful weapon from my own personal collection. You can find Makasgar on the rocky coast between here and Tiragarde Keep. Be swift!Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
980 experience

title: Stolen Supplies
obj_text: Return the Stolen Supplies to Pa Maclure.
desc_text: Damn Defias have come through and ransacked our supplies! What did we ever do to them? Other than feed them before they decided to turn on us of course. Well I won't stand for it!$BYou can find their encampent not far East of here at Jarod's Landing. Give them hell and then return those supplies and I'll see you compensated appropriately.

title: Spotless Standing
obj_text:
Find the Forsaken Rebels entrenched along the shores of Brightwater Lake and put them down.
 Alric Sading Slain
 $BBrightwater Rebel Slain (8)

 Brightwater Rebel
$B

 Brightwater Rebel
desc_text: Chisels, hammers, squares, compasses... that's what we have in abundance here, the Masons' Lodge. Swords, bows, staves, axes? We wouldn't even know which end to hold. You, on the other hand...$BEast of here, dug in along Brightwater Lake, a band of rebels has rejected the Dark Lady's rule; simple-minded fools who think the living will greet them with open arms.$BMy brother is among them. If I wait for Magistrate Sevren to send his Deathstalkers, word will get out; my name stained, and with it my spotless standing as head of the lodge.$BPut the rebels down. Leave none alive. And above all, make certain my brother does not walk away.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text:
Log description.
                Description
Hey little man,do something worthy and talk to Jonathan LeCraft.
                Rewards
You will receive: 2 10 if completed at level 80                    Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
90 experience$B

Related

title: Termites in Teldrassil
obj_text:
Enter the bark of Teldrassil near Dolanaar and defeat the termites infesting its depths.
 Barkshredder Termite slain (10)
 Barkshredder Queen slain
desc_text: Ishnu-alah, <class>.$BTeldrassil has grown dangerous of late, and Dolanaar is no exception.$BSouthwest of here, the earth yawns open to bare the vast heartwood of the World Tree's trunk. My sisters have found a termite colony there and are holding the line... but we're too few, and for every termite we kill, two more scuttle in to take its place.$BHelp us stem the termite threat, and I'll see you're rewarded in full for the risk you'll take down there.

title: Path to Ascension: Westfall
obj_text:
Explore Stormwind to your heart's content, then visit Flightmaster Dungar Longdrink to fly to Westfall to continue your adventure.
 Explore Stormwind to your heart's content, then visit Flightmaster Dungar Longdrink to fly to Westfall to continue your adventure
desc_text: Hail, Hero.$BWelcome to Stormwind, capital of the Alliance. I assume you've arrived to rest and restock. You'll find many things to aid you on your adventure, from personal banks and the Auction House to blacksmiths, enchanters, and of course other heroes. Explore as you like, but when you're ready to return to your adventure, speak to Flightmaster Dungar Longdrink. There is trouble brewing in the western province that requires your aid.

title: Wanted: Lenore the Hoarder
obj_text:
Kill Lenore the Hoarder and return to Protector Gariel at Sentinel Hill.
 Lenore the Hoarder slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Wanted: Lenore the Hoarder$BBy order of the People's Militia, Lenore the Hoarder is hereby declared a threat to the stability of Westfall.$BThis individual is responsible for orchestrating repeated raids on supply caravans bound for militia outposts. Reports confirm she is stockpiling stolen goods and distributing them to Defias agents operating in the region.$BShe is clever, fast, and rarely seen twice in the same place. Do not underestimate her.

title: The Balnirs' Rest
obj_text: Put the spirits of the Balnir family, Jorum Balnir, Vara Balnir, and Jarim Balnir to rest.
desc_text: The Balnir family once bred some of the finest steeds on all of Azeroth, favored by even the royalty. Even with such clients, they never let it get to their head, they were kind, humble folk, I believe their horses took after them, and that was why they were favored so.$B...But that is all in the past. The farmstead is in ruins now, and only the restless dead lives there. I am certain the Balnirs themselves must be amongst them, but though I may wield the light, it pains me now, I do not trust my power in a fight anymore.$BIf you would have it in your heart, could you put their poor souls to rest in my stead. There were three in total, Vara, Jorum, and their son Jarim.

title: Path to Ascension: Crossroads
obj_text:
Explore Orgrimmar to your heart's content, then seek out Flightmaster Doras to continue your adventure.
 Explore Orgrimmar to your heart's content, then seek out Flightmaster Doras to continue your adventure
desc_text: Stand at attention when I speak. You stand before the gates of Orgrimmar, capital of the Horde. Inside stand all manner of tools to aid you: banks, the Auction House, blacksmiths, enchanters, and of course other heroes eager to spill blood. Explore as you like, but do not linger: I have recieved reports of battle from the Crossroads to the west. You will travel there and slay the enemies of the Horde. Speak to Flightmaster Doras when you are ready to embark

title: Take It Back
obj_text: Protector Gariel wants you to gather Westfall Supplies, then return to her at Sentinel Hill.
desc_text: We are stretched thin out here. Rations are low, morale is worse, and every night another crate goes missing. The Defias are relentless, picking us apart while we try to hold what little ground we have left.$BWord is they are stashing stolen goods somewhere nearby. Not just scraps either. Real supplies, food, bandages, tools, maybe even weapons. We have reason to believe they are hiding them in that old tower to the west.$BIf you can make your way in and recover anything useful, it could turn the tide out here. The militia is doing what it can, but we need every edge we can get.

title: Brewing Disarray
obj_text: Slay Lieutenant Sanders in Venomweb Vale and bring his head to Apothecary Ralden
desc_text: eing stationed out here, we face constant attack from the Scarlet Crusade. We've held off their attacks thus far so the Apothecaries can do their work, and mostly they've stopped sending their people to their deaths.$BBut recently, some upstart Lieutenant got placed in charge of their camp in Venonweb Vale, and he's been organizing more coordinated attacks against us. I'm not sure how much longer we can hold out, so I'd like to see Lieutenant Sanders dead.$BWithout him, we can only hope they'll become disorganized enough to leave us alone for now. Apothecary Ralden has been asking constantly if we've taken off the Lieutenant's head, so go bring it to him when you're done so he'll be off our backs.

title: Riverpaw Genocide
obj_text:
Slay 8 Riverpaw Brutes, 12 Riverpaw Mongrels, and 10 Riverpaw Herbalists.
 Riverpaw Brute slain (10)
 Riverpaw Mongrel slain (8)
 Riverpaw Herbalist slain (12)
desc_text: Confoundit, <name>, look at my farm! Not that there's much to look at nowadays. It wasn't much to begin with, but I had ambition! Now... now I have nothing, and it's all because of those damn gnolls!$BListen <name>, I don't have much, but give a poor farmer what's owed to him—revenge! I want you to go out there and slay every last gnoll you find. Every. Last. One.$BOnce you've dealt with at least 8 Riverpaw Brutes, 12 Riverpaw Mongrels, and 10 Riverpaw Herbalists then return here to me for your reward. You should be able to find these gnolls to the West and then more to the North, parallel to the coast. And <name>, I wouldn't mind if you lost count after a while, if you know what I mean.

title: This Is Justice
obj_text:
Use Ralden's Transformation Elixir to infiltrate the Scarlet Monastery's courtyard and infect their supplies.
 Scarlet Supplies Infected (6)
desc_text: There. It's done. With this, the Scarlet Crusade won't even know they've lost until it's too late.$BNow the last step is getting it to them without raising suspicion. That's what the lieutenant's head was for.$BI've whipped up an elixir that'll make you look just like him. It should get you into the monastery without much trouble. Just don't get too close to anyone if you can help it, and keep moving. This sort of thing isn't foolproof, but as long as you don't do anything idiotic, you'll be fine.$BAnd don't even think about picking a fight. The monastery guards aren't like the ones at that camp. They can scatter your insides across the grass with one swing. If they figure out you aren't their lieutenant, they won't hesitate to prove it.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
desc_text: Word was sent here from Darnassus,<name>. It seems one of your priestesses wants you to return home. Speak to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon whenever you're able. It seems she is pleased with your progress. I am sure she takes great pride in seeing one of Elune's servants take such great strides in <his/her> faith.$BThe Light be with you.

title: Deepest, Darkest Cavern
obj_text: Enter the cave and find the Guri flower.
desc_text: You seek the Guri flower, don't you? I know your heart’s desire, but be warned—the path is perilous.$BVenture north along the rugged shoreline to a cave, shrouded in danger.$BWithin its depths, amidst treacherous shadows, lies the elusive Guri flower. Gather it with care, for this ingredient is as potent as it is rare, and the cave will test the mettle of even the bravest souls.

title: Price of Doing Business
obj_text:
Polish gravestones at Father Alastor's cemetary and Invincible's grave at Balnir Farmstead.
 Gravestones Polished (12)
 Invincible's Gravestone Polished
 $BRequired money: 10
desc_text: If you might hear a simple request, these old bones do not have the strength they once did. Faith in the light...it is not something meant for those like us, so this body does not always have the strength fulfill my duties.$BThe graves out in the cemetary have not been cleaned in far too long now. Those poor souls likely have no one left who still walks this world, but their graves deserve dignity nonetheless.$BIf you have the time, you might also grant the same care to the grave of Arthas's steed at the Balnir Farmstead. His master's atrocities may be many, but he was a loyal horse, and had died before the Lich King's rise.$BHad he lived longer, perhaps things may not have gone this way...

title: Icehide the Unbroken
obj_text: You’ve been asked to track and slay Icehide, the elite Frostsaber haunting Coldhewn Ridge above the camp.
desc_text: You see that rise above the camp? That is where it took the last hunter. We found the blood trail. Nothing else.$BThey call it Icehide. Ice leopard. Big, silent, and too smart for our traps. It strikes fast, leaves nothing but red in the snow, and then it is gone again.$BToo many have died chasing it. This is not about pride or sport anymore. We cannot work those hills while it still prowls. And I will not send another one of ours to vanish into the cold.$BIf you are willing to take the risk, do it. But be sure of your shot. Icehide will not give you a second.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
desc_text: Aye,good to see you're doing well in your training,young <priest/priestess>. One of your kind was here looking for you not too long ago. It seems you're wanted back in Darnassus. Something about Priestess Alathea and the Temple of the Moon. It sounded important. Perhaps you should return there soon.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
desc_text: Oh,<name>,I am pleased to catch you. There has been talk that you are prepared for your next test at the Temple of the Moon. Priestess Alathea herself wishes to speak to you. You should return to Darnassus as quickly as you can. Finish whatever business you have here and make haste.

title: <NYI> A Blessing of Light
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
desc_text: Ah,<name>,I'm glad you stopped to talk to me for a moment. One of your priests of Light was here a few moments ago looking for you. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to meet with you. I would not be surprised if it was about the progress you've made so far. Many of my order are continuously tested and given greater responsibilities as we progress in our studies.

title: <NYI> A Blessing of Light
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
desc_text: You just missed a messenger here from Stormwind that was looking for you,<name>. You've done well for yourself it seems. The High Priestess Laurena wants to talk to you. I think the church feels you're ready for the next step of your training.$BWhen you're all set and done with your business here,head to Stormwind,the Cathedral of Light,and speak to her. I'm sure she's waitin' for you.

title: <NYI> A Touch of Voodoo
obj_text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: Hey,<race>. A messenger came through here not too long ago looking for you. Said you were to return to Orgrimmar to speak to Ur'kyo in the Valley of Spirits. He didn't sound angry,but it did sound important. Might want to check it out.

title: <NYI> A Blessing of Light
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
desc_text: Young <priest/priestess>,your church has sent word for you to return to Stormwind. The High Priestess Laurena would have words with you when you are ready. It seems your superiors feel you are ready for the next step of your training.$BI believe you can find your High Priestess in the Cathedral of Light. Elune go with you on your journey and peace be with you.

title: <NYI> In the Dark It was Created
obj_text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
desc_text: I would teach you all you need know,<name>,but there things that only your own tribe can show you. One be how to create a new robe for you... one that reflect your place in your faith.$BAelthalyste say that I direct you to her in the Undercity. She be in the War Quarter waiting for you. If you not go then she be very displeased with both of us.

title: <NYI> In the Dark It was Created
obj_text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
desc_text: Glad to see you're... alive,<name>.$BAelthalyste has asked you to return to the Undercity when you've finished your business here in Thunder Bluff. It seems you've grown powerful enough that she thinks you're due new garments... a robe,I believe.$BShe'll be waiting for you in the War Quarter.
