obj_text:
Log description.
                
 Jonathan LeCraft slain


Description
Do something else,<class>!
                Rewards
You will receive: 3 50 (or 5 10 if completed at level 80)                $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
840 experience$B

Related

title: Hero's Call: Westfall!
obj_text: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.$BYou can reach Gryan Stoutmantle by traveling west from Elwynn Forest.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Unlocking Your Potential [PH]
obj_text: ring this dude some stuff.
desc_text: Today you unlock a page in your spellbook, one you may not have realized it was there.  Bring me something, and I'll open it up for you.

title: Hero's Call: Darkshore!
obj_text: Report to Gershala Nightwhisper at Auberdine in Darkshore.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Gershala Nightwhisper in Darkshore..$BTravel north from Ashenvale along the coastal road until you reach the serene and ancient lands of Darkshore. Auberdine, nestled along the coast, serves as the Alliance's foothold in this region. The people of Auberdine call for your aid to preserve the beauty and balance of these lands.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Hero's Call: Loch Modan!
obj_text: Report to Magistrate Bluntnose at Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Magistrate Bluntnose at Thelsamar in Loch Modan..$BThe resurgence of the kobolds and troggs has the mountaineers stretched thin. Reinforcements are desperately needed! Travel east through South Gate Pass from eastern Dun Morogh to reach Thelsamar.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Investigate the Scourge of Silvermoon
obj_text:
Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Silvermoon and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
 $BInvestigate a circle
desc_text: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Silvermoon from these accursed invaders?$BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!

title: Investigate the Scourge of Exodar
obj_text:
Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Exodar and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.  Then return to Lieutenant Kregor.
 $BInvestigate a circle
desc_text: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend the Exodar from these accursed invaders?$BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!

title: Warchief's Command: The Barrens!
obj_text: Report to Sergra Darkthorn at The Crossroads in the Barrens.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Sergra Darkthorn at The Crossroads in the Barrens.$BShe requires your assistance in defending this vital outpost against the threats of the quilboar, centaur, and Alliance forces. To reach the Crossroads, travel south from Durotar or north from Mulgore.$BDestiny calls!

title: Journey into Thunder Bluff
obj_text: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
desc_text: You will now be revered within our great city. Any <race> worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.$BFor your final quest, seek out our young leader, Baine Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.

title: Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest!
obj_text: Report to Dalar Dawnweaver at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Dalar Dawnweaver at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.$BNow, more than ever, your help is needed in routing the enemy infestation of the region and the savage worgen prowling the shadows.$BTo reach Silverpine Forest, travel south from Tirisfal Glades through the Ruins of Lordaeron.$BDestiny calls!

title: Slimy Solution
obj_text: Retrieve 10 Slimy Murloc Spittle Samples and return to the Tower of Azora.
desc_text: Hi! Sorry if this sounds a little strange, but would you be willing to help with a research assignment?$BThe master has begun to study magical residue in... well, spit. Murloc spit, to be precise. He wants to see how lingering arcane energy reacts in biological material. I know, kind of gross, but fascinating, right?$BThere are Murloc Lurkers and Foragers near Eastvale Lodging Camp, both north and south of the lake. If you can gather ten samples of their spittle and bring them back, I will make sure you're properly rewarded. I even prepared a vial for collection.

title: The Master's Orders
obj_text: Recover 10 Depleted Mana Gems and return to the Tower of Azora.
desc_text: Hi there! I just got assigned to help with a research project, and I think this might be my big chance to show the master I am ready for more responsibility.$BWe are studying magical depletion, and for that, we need samples of spent arcane matter. I think you can collect them from the Defias Rogue Wizards near Stone Cairn Lake. They're dangerous, but I heard they've been overcasting their spells lately, which makes them perfect for what we need.$BWould you be willing to bring back ten of their Depleted Mana Gems? I'll make sure you're rewarded. And if this goes well... maybe I'll get to try casting something bigger than Mage Armor!

title: Last Memento
obj_text: Return the Smudged Note to Imelda in Stormwind.
desc_text: "My dearest Imelda. Even though you have moved to Stormwind, I hope you know that no distance could ever keep us apart. My love for you is that of infinite burning suns. You shall forever own a piece of my heart. Never forget.$B-Ethan"$BI should attempt to return this note to Imelda. She will probably want to know how Ethan felt.

title: King's Justice
obj_text:
Slay 8 Defias Bandits and return the Supply Cache to Guard Jacob at Ridgepoint Tower.
 Defias Bandit slain (8)
desc_text: Hero, I've got a problem. Our scouts have reported that a shipment that was en route to Lakeshire was intercepted by the Defias. I need you to retrieve that shipment and give the Defias what's coming to them.$BI don't believe they've yet had time to move the shipment to one of their safehouses. It seems a small band of Defias is guarding the shipment just East of here.$BI unfortunately can't spare the men, but if you kill 8 Defias bandits and return to me with the shipment I will make sure you are compensated appropriately.

title: A Humble Duty
obj_text:
Polish 6 gravestones at Father Alastor's cemetary and Invincible's grave at Balnir Farmstead.
 Gravestones Polished (6)
 Invincible's Gravestone Polished
desc_text: If you’ll hear a simple request, these old bones do not carry the strength they once did. Faith in the Light... it was never meant for those like us. And this body doesn’t always answer when duty calls.$BThe graves in the cemetery have gone untended for far too long. Those poor souls likely have no one left in this world to remember them, but they deserve dignity all the same.$BIf you find the time, you might also tend to the grave of Arthas's steed at the Balnir Farmstead. His master’s crimes are many, but the horse was loyal... and he died before the Lich King's shadow ever fell across the land.$BHad he lived longer, perhaps the tale might have ended differently.

title: Reclaim the Harvest
obj_text: Retrieve 8 Mirror Lake Apples and return them to Sergeant De Vries in Westbrook Garrison.
desc_text: It's a shame, <name>. The Defias have overrun the Mirror Lake Orchard and are hijacking the harvest. I remember my mother making her famous Mirror Lake apple pie for me when I was a child. It's something I wish I could share with the rest of the men here at the garrison.$BSay, you look like a well traveled <race>. Do you think you could venture to the Mirror Lake Orchard to the northeast of the garrison and gather enough apples there for me to make some pies? I'll even whip a few up for you! Oh, and feel free to give the Defias our regards.

title: Delivery to Lakeshire
obj_text: Deliver the Supply Cache to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
desc_text: Uh, one moment, Hero. Listen, I hate to ask another favor of you, but I simply can't spare any men at the moment. Could you be so generous as to deliver this supply cache to Lakeshire.$BI think Magistrate Solomon will want to hear of what you did for his people and I'm sure he'll see you rewarded for your good deeds.

title: One With The Wild
obj_text: Collect 3 Crude Leather from beasts throughout Azeroth.
desc_text: Greetings, <name>, it's been reported to me that strange beasts have been attacking Ranger falcons all over Azeroth.$BOur scouts whisper that these assaults aren’t random. The wilds are restless, and a sinister force may be orchestrating these strikes. I need you to be strong and adept <name>, for the time may come where we will have to deal with whoever is behind these ruthless attacks. As a result, and as a dedicated protector of nature, your first trial awaits.$BAs you adventure into the world and slay various beasts, you’ll find remnants of their hides. Your task is to gather 3 pieces of Crude Leather. As a Ranger, your mastery over the wilds has accumulated into an adept understanding of how to use what nature gives you to create practical things to make your next journey even easier. Maps, tents, even various bits of leather that can be used to upgrade your equipment.$BEach hide is a tribute to the life of a fallen beast and a step toward mastering the ancient rites of the wild. And be warned, the deeper you roam, the more you might feel the eyes of unseen watchers upon you, as if the wilderness itself is keeping score. This is known.$BReturn with the leather, and together we will unlock the secrets of the wild and fortify our defenses against those who dare threaten our kin.$BGood luck, Ranger. The wild awaits your courage.

title: Disarming the Gnolls
obj_text: Retrieve 6 Gnoll Blades and 10 Gnoll Axes and return to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
desc_text: As if the murloc infestation weren't bad enough, we also have gnolls gnawing at our borders. If it's not one problem, it's another!$BDo the kingdom and the people of Elwynn justice and disarm this threat before it even has a chance to become a real problem. Bring me 6 Gnoll Blades from the gnoll runts and 10 Gnoll Axes from their outrunners.$BYou can find their encampment along the North and Northwestern ends of Stone Cairn Lake. If you do this, the Stormwind Army will be sure to reward you accordingly.

title: The First Ingredient
obj_text:
Find Riddly in Ratchet and ride to Tukah's home.
 Find Riddly in Ratchet and ride to Tukah's home.
desc_text: Ahhh, <class>. I've heard of your deeds already. You have come to help me, yes? You wish to learn more about being a Witch Doctor and I am the one who can help you.$BI have a simple task for you. An oh so simple task! I am working on a particular potion, for no particular reason, and it also happens to require very particular ingredients.$BWe'll start with the first ingredient - the rare and elusive Guri flower. To my knowledge this can only be found in a single location in all of Azeroth, a cave on the south-western coast of Kalimdor. Nobody ever goes there, but one individual happens to have made their home right next to that cave.$BThey go by the name of Tukah. They are open to outsiders, I can only imagine their extreme solitude has given them a feeling of loneliness, so they should be happy to see you.$BReaching the home of Tukah will not be easy by foot. As far as I can tell it would require you to build your own boat... or to swim. However, luckily for you I do have a contact who can take you on their own personal boat. They commandeer a small vessel so you must meet them in Ratchet. An old goblin that goes by the name of Riddly.$BFind Riddly in Ratchet and tell him I sent you and why. He is already paid. The rest is up to you.

title: Call of the Wild
obj_text: Speak to a guard to find your class trainer in a nearby capital city.
desc_text: You've taken your first steps on the path of the ranger, but the road ahead is long and full of hidden lessons.$BWord has reached us of a seasoned practitioner who has appeared near one of the capital cities. This ranger is said to possess deep knowledge in the art of bushcraft, an understanding of the land, the beasts, and the ways to survive where few dare tread.$BYour current skills have prepared you for this journey. Travel to the nearest capital and seek out this master. There, you will continue your training and begin to understand the wilds in ways you never imagined.$BWhen you find them, speak with purpose. The wild hears all, and it favors those who walk with honor.

title: Bushcrafting
obj_text:
Craft a Waterskin for your trainer.
 Craft a Waterskin using Crude Leather
desc_text: Well done on collecting that Crude Leather, <name>.$BCrude Leather is unique to Rangers. Anyone can learn to skin a beast, but few would understand the nuance of the cruder scraps amongst their pelts.$BWe are resourceful as Rangers and, as such, can make incredibly useful things for ourselves with very little.$BGive it a go, <name>. Craft a Waterskin and then return to me.

title: Fairbreeze Village
obj_text: The news from the spire is indeed troubling. It seems I'll need to remain here a bit longer. Travel to Fairbreeze Village in my stead and determine the situation
desc_text: Troubling reports are emerging from the outskirts of these woods. I was intending to travel to Fairbreeze Village to assess the circumstances of these reports, but I must remain behind and deal with the afflicted apprentices.

title: The True Story
obj_text: Find Efry Cogspark at the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar.
desc_text: Old Mirsinth will talk now. Brother Jun’Kon been dead to her long, long time…deader still since he cast Old Mirsinth out. She should not be mourning him, but some wisdom will not come to her from age or loa…$BYour being of metal was made as tool, yes? Hammer, sword, knife, more parts, seem like magic to Old Mirsinth’s people, but still just tool, yes? Tool should do as used, serve its purpose. But being of metal is not tool.$BBeing of metal is alive. Metal yes, but alive. Creator did not tell you that, no? Does not know, perhaps?$BShe is fool.$BSpirits are not tools. Tell her that. You will find nothing without her truth. Make her tell, and when she tells, tell her Old Mirsinth needs more to find metal being.

title: Avianna's Rose
obj_text: ring the information you learned to Sakari in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: Have knowledge, yes, yes, yes! Make skin not green, but Avianna’s Rose rare, very rare, only ever one, no more, sometimes less! Harpy never removed curse, never used magic on Avianna’s Rose. Yet you already have one, yes, yes, yes!$BYou bring shinies, crush rebellion, help you, yes, yes, yes! Magic need other material, bright shiny stone, yellow, very shiny, very very very, at south place. Find, use flower, fix curse!

title: The Metal Being
obj_text: Defeat Nylrisa near Ironband's Excavation Site and collect her components.
desc_text: Old Mirsinth is done, found metal being spirit. Metal being near excavation of one your people call Ironband, above. Old Mirsinth only know where, not why, but where is what you needed, yes? Old Mirsinth’s job is done, it seems.$BOld Mirsinth will wander now, perhaps. This world is not much home for her. Too many ancient feuds, too many cycles, but loa have shown Old Mirsinth many things, so wander world that is not home she will.$BIt has been long time since Old Mirsinth has called one friend. Perhaps she is too quick to use the word with one she has spoken with too little. Still, Old Mirsinth hopes to meet you again in wandering, friend.

title: Reversion
obj_text: Watch Sakari create the cure.
desc_text: Alright, I believe I understand the properties of all of this, at least well enough. I only get one chance, so I’d better make it work. I couldn’t have done this without you, so, you should at least stick around and see this through.

title: Riverpaw Genocide
obj_text:
Slay 12 Riverpaw Bandits, 10 Riverpaw Taskmasters, and 8 Riverpaw Mystics.
 Riverpaw Bandit slain (12)
 Riverpaw Taskmaster slain (10)
 Riverpaw Mystic slain (8)
desc_text: You've already done a poor farmer a great service, <name>, but my revenge is not yet sated. Not while there are still gnolls alive a drawing breath.$BI know there's another encampment of gnolls to the East. I want them dead! Slay at least 12 Riverpaw Bandits, 10 Riverpaw Taskmasters and 8 Riverpaw Mystics, and maybe then I can finally be at peace. At least as much peace as one can be with his hope and dreams laid bare before him.

title: The Last Piece
obj_text: Find Ouru’gai Crystal in the Barrens.
desc_text: Well, I don’t know how true the origins are, but the story has to originate from somewhere, and if it has powerful curse removal properties, that would make sense. But substituting alchemical means I might be able to stretch it and make several cures, though that isn’t many. The flower only has one seed, but maybe if I could find a way to grow more out of it…$BAh, I’m ahead of myself. We need to be sure this method even works. You’ve come this far with me, if you can get the crystal the harpy mentioned and meet me in the Barrens with it when you’re done, I believe I can use the demon blood as a way to make it latch onto our own demon blood and nullify it.

title: Aroy Test Quest
obj_text: Do something
desc_text: description

title: <NYI> <TXT> In the Dark it was Created
The Deathstalkers
obj_text: Deliver Andron's Ledger to Varimathras in the Hall of the Dark Lady in the Undercity.
desc_text: The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.$BHawkins will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.$BAh, and how could I forget?$BWelcome to the Deathstalkers.

title: The Deathstalkers
obj_text: ring Andron's Ledger to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of Undercity.
desc_text: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.

title: Warchief's Command: Ratchet!
obj_text: Report to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in the Barrens.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Mebok Mizzyrix at Ratchet in the Barrens.$BTo reach Ratchet, travel east from The Crossroads or follow the coast from the south. The goblins promise fair pay and ample opportunities for those willing to lend their blades, spells, or wits to the cause.$BDestiny calls!

title: The Circle’s Rite
obj_text: Collect 8 Ritual Totems and bring them to Maur Tharok Windhoof at Stonefather's Circle.
desc_text: My disciples were on the road from Thunder Bluff when the Windfury harpies swept down from the cliffs to the north.$BDrawn to anything carved or painted, they tore through the packs and snatched the sacred totems meant for our next rite. The disciples escaped with their lives, but the harpies now flaunt those totems as ornaments in their claws and feathers. Without them, the rite cannot begin.$BFind the Windfury to the north, <name>, and take back what they stole. Return the totems to me so the winds may carry our voices once more.

title: The Deathstalkers
obj_text: Speak with Andron Gant in the Undercity.
desc_text: The letter of introduction should be enough to convince Andron that you are the messenger he's been waiting for. I've met Andron before, he doesn't quite have the mental capacity to be that suspicious.$BOur leader suspects that Andron has been providing aid to some other group. He wishes to know what organization this is and requires proof of it.$BI want you to speak with Andron, and obtain this information. You'll find him at his shop near the Apothecarium.

title: The Deathstalkers
obj_text: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.
desc_text: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, the Dark Lady's elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.$BI will not lie to you, <name>, this task could mean your death.$BI have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.$BIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.

title: Sunken Treasure
obj_text: Find the Waterlogged Trunk off the coast of Westfall.
desc_text: The map is i smudged with seaweed and dirt. Fortunately there seems to be some text scribbled towards the bottom which you can barely make out.$B"I can't believe we managed to escape those horrendous fish 'things' with our lives, but we somehow made it out with their treasure too! I've marked the map so as not to forget where I've hidden the booty. Would be a shame to come this far only to forget which ship I've thrown the chest in. I'll be sure leave this map someplace safe where prying eye won't think to look." There seems to be more scribbled down, but you can't make it out.$BThere's not much to go off of, but it would seem the treasure this map speaks of is hidden beneath the waves in one of the shipwrecks.

title: Sunken Treasure
obj_text: ring the Carved Murloc Idol to the Explorers' League in Ironforge
desc_text: The idol looks like an idealized interpretation of a murloc, with very large teeth and eyes. Hopefully this will be worth something to somebody.$BSurely if anyone would be interested in a artifact from another civilization it would be the Explorers' League in Ironforge. Perhaps they have the answers.

title: Rogues Deck
obj_text: Use the Rogues Deck to summon a Darkmoon Fortune Teller and give the deck to them.
desc_text: Now that you have gathered all of the Rogue cards together into a deck, another card appears on top.  It depicts a fortune teller that seems to stare at you no matter how you hold the card.$BYou feel the card could be used to communicate with someone or something.

title: Solid Chest
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
270 experience

title: Save The Crocs
obj_text: Sinter Wive wants you to retrieve the Crocolisk Egg from the Trogg "Poachers" on the island to the North.
desc_text: I have been watchin’ a nest by the river for days now. One of the crocs finally laid, just one perfect egg. Beautiful thing. Spotted shell, warm to the touch. I was hopin’ to move it somewhere safe, give it a real shot at hatching.$BThen those filthy troggs showed up. Grunting and stomping through the brush, one of ‘em grabbed the egg like it was a rock and ran off screamin’.$BThey do not know what they are holding. They will eat it or smash it or boil it in mud if we do not get it back fast. You are faster than me, and you are not afraid to get dirty.$BBring that egg back. I will owe you one.

title: Warborn Grounds: "Shadowblood"
obj_text:
Defeat the fourth challenger: "Shadowblood"
 $B"Shadowblood" Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: More and more bets are pouring in on you, only one other fighter's stood up to the Masher's hammer before. A Shadow Hunter from the Darkspear tribe who took up fighting in the arena, she's the toughest active fighter of the ring right now.$BWe call her Shadowblood. She's got a penchant for not dying, maybe there's a trick up her sleeve, but that's on you to figure out. The actual champion hasn't fought in years, so beat her and you'll be the toughest we've got.

title: Warborn Grounds: One Last Battle
obj_text:
e crowned champion of Orcamania
 $BBecome the Champion
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: Looks like the ones who bet on you will be getting paid out well. You beat the best we've got, so only one thing's left now.$BStep out into the ring and you'll be crowned the latest champion of Orcamania!

title: Judging the Confessor
obj_text: Slay Inquisitorial Confessor Konrad on Normal difficulty.
desc_text: I have nothing to confess. Why do you keep beating me? I have nothing to confess, I swear...!$B<Another agonized scream, followed by a long silence. At last, he seems to register your presence.>$BThe Confessor. Kill him! I can't take any more... He's a torturer. A murderer. A monster worse than the creatures at his mercy.$BGive us peace. Get rid of him.

title: Path of the Dreadrider
obj_text:
Kill Rathorian in Dreadmist Den.
 Rathorian slain
desc_text: As a Knight of Xoroth, you must form a bond with a warsteed of Xoroth which you will ride into battle and bring fire and death upon the enemies of your faction. In order to subjugate one of these steeds, you must make a great show of power and defeat a powerful demon in battle. Atop the Dreadmist Peak in the barrens, and within the Dreadmist Den you will find Rathorian, an ancient felguard who leads the Burning Blade Cultists in the area. Kill him, and drink from his vile essence, then bring to me an Infernal Stone. Only then can I bind a warsteed to your service, young demonheart.

title: What Levels Us All
obj_text: Slay the undead that dwell within the Vaults of Inquisition on Normal difficulty.
desc_text: Please. Please...$B<The ghost moans and mumbles under his breath, lost in memories of the time he was captive of the Church.>$B<This place, you realize, is cursed. And the ghosts who haunt it now—prisoners and jailers alike—have been trapped here far too long.>$BEnough. Enough. Enough...$B<It would be an act of mercy to purge the dungeon and lay to rest every creature, ghost or not, that wanders its halls.>

title: A Sinister Family
obj_text:
Defeat the bats, spiders, and hissers on the Road to De Other Side on Normal difficulty.
 Bat of the Other Side slain (5)
desc_text: Though Hirsutta's ritual was spoiled, da creature she tried to call from da world o' flesh managed to force a part o' itself into dis in-between.$BIt be a monstrous chimera. An abomination if ever there was.$BHir'eek, Dambala, and Shadra infested dis path to da Other Side. Somehow, I be thinkin' its life be tied to da spirits of spider, serpent, and bat wanderin' dese caverns.$BSlay dem all.$BMy lord Bwonsamdi will be generous.

title: Make The Voice Be Quiet!
obj_text: Venture into the Vaults of Inquisition and defeat the Presence of the Deceiver on Normal difficulty.
desc_text: Something's wrong, wrong! Terribly wrong!$B<Clara the Mad wrings her clammy hands in a nervous frenzy.>$BThe door has opened again. The seal is broken. Could it have been my sisters? Impossible. I'm not going back to Northshire. No!$B<Clara the Mad's gaze pierces through you, wild, feverish.>$BYou do it! Silence the Voice! I’ll give you what little I have! They lied: “The Light will protect us,” they said. Ha! Now they're all dead. All of them! Except her. All but her!$B<Clara laughs to herself before her eyes drift into the void.>

title: The Will of the Loa of Death
obj_text: Defeat Vol'zeen, the dire undead troll on Normal difficulty.
desc_text: Da Upstart Three were craftier than we thought.$BMy master Bwonsamdi be hatin' da undead, and for dat very reason dey set one to guard their chimeric whelp.$BVol'zeen be his name; a dire troll, a blood-mad berserker, as dey be callin' him.$BMe mojo be worthless against a t'ing like dat. Bring it down, and I'll see ya paid in kind.

title: Road to De Other Side
obj_text:
Assemble a full party of five adventurers, journey into the treacherous Road to De Other Side, and defeat the Chimeric Embryo on Normal difficulty.
 Chimeric Embryo slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: <Though the old man's eyes remain closed, the furrow in his brow reveals a worry even the spirits cannot hide.>$BThe echo of Hirsutta, the Witch, still trembles between the veils of the world. She dwells in an interstitial plane, where the living and the dead blur into one. Whatever she is weaving, her voodoo power has not waned with death.$BThere is an open wound upon this land, a rift leading to the Other Side. That threshold must lie hidden within the Sinister Lair, in the Valley of Trials, where the name Hirsutta was last spoken.$BStop whatever she is conjuring... before her corruption devours the fragile boundary that still shields our reality.

title: A Resounding Echo
obj_text:
Venture into the Road to De Other Side and defeat the Chimeric Embryo on Normal difficulty.
 Chimeric Embryo slain
desc_text: <Though the old man's eyes remain closed, the furrow in his brow reveals a worry even the spirits cannot hide.>$BThe echo of Hirsutta, the Witch, still trembles between the veils of the world. She dwells in an interstitial plane, where the living and the dead blur into one. Whatever she is weaving, her voodoo power has not waned with death.$BThere is an open wound upon this land, a rift leading to the Other Side. That threshold must lie hidden within the Sinister Lair, in the Valley of Trials, where the name Hirsutta was last spoken.$BStop whatever she is conjuring... before her corruption devours the fragile boundary that still shields our reality.

title: Old Friends, Fishy Waters
obj_text: Gubber Blump has asked you to travel south to Moonrest Sanctuary and check on his old fishing companion, Eldrin Tidecaller.
desc_text: Say, <name>... you look like you have still got your sea legs, and that is lucky, because I got a friend in a real salt slick mess.$BUsed to fish these shores with a fella named Eldrin Tidecaller. Real calm sort. Knew the fish by name, talked to the waves like they talked back. He set off to Moonrest Sanctuary a while back to find some quiet waters, but I just got a message carved into a driftwood plank floatin' near shore. Said only three things: Frenzies. Greymist. Help.$BNow, I know Eldrin is not the panicky type, so if he is sendin' cryptic driftwood messages, things are serious.$BHead south to the Moonrest coast and find him, would ya? If he is tangled in murlocs or bait for a frenzy, he is gonna need someone with a sharp blade and sharper reflexes.

title: Night of the Eclipse
obj_text: Install Lilly's device at the top of the nearby house
desc_text: There it is. A delicate weave of enchantments, power sources, cursebinding arrays, even a little dreamstuff. If theory holds, this should restore the Worgen’s senses or at least give them a chance to resist the madness.$BIt needs to be placed somewhere high, close to the village. The upper floor of that structure should work. From there, the enchantments can saturate the area.$BAnd no, I am not going. This hat only works from a safe distance, and I prefer my limbs exactly where they are.$BJust get in, set it down, let it charge, and get out. Simple enough for someone like you, right?

title: Hidden Enemies
obj_text:
Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to the Call Board.
 Bazzalan slain
 Jergosh the Invoker slain
desc_text: This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them.

title: Blood in the Brine
obj_text:
Slay the local murlocs and frenzied sea creatures that have turned the waters deadly.
 Coastal Frenzy slain (2)
 Greymist Seer slain (4)
 Greymist Netter slain (2)
desc_text: The sea has been restless lately, <class>. Fish vanish, the tides churn, and something dark stirs in the kelp.$BI came here to fish in peace, not to watch the coast get torn apart by scales and teeth.$BThe Greymist murlocs have overrun the cove, poisoning the waters and dragging nets across the seabed. Their Seers chant vile things to the surf, and their Netters have taken to hauling in anything that moves. As if that were not enough, the shoreline teems with Coastal Frenzies, mindless, razor finned beasts drawn by the scent of blood and magic.$BCut down the creatures defiling this place and help restore the stillness of the tide.

title: Vaults of Inquisition
obj_text: Assemble a full party of five adventurers, descend into the perilous Vaults of Inquisition, and defeat the Presence of the Deceiver on Normal difficulty.
desc_text: Something's wrong, wrong! Terribly wrong!$B<Clara the Mad wrings her clammy hands in a nervous frenzy.>$BThe door has opened again. The seal is broken. Could it have been my sisters? Impossible. I'm not going back to Northshire. No!$B<Clara the Mad's gaze pierces through you, wild, feverish.>$BYou do it! Silence the Voice! I’ll give you what little I have! They lied: “The Light will protect us,” they said. Ha! Now they're all dead. All of them! Except her. All but her!$B<Clara laughs to herself before her eyes drift into the void.>

title: The Sun King's Command
obj_text: Take the Sun King's Command to Vindicator Boros at Blood Watch.
desc_text: This document looks to be important. Unfortunately,it is written in Thalassian,a language that you cannot understand.$BPerhaps Vindicator Boros will know what to do with the letter.

title: Rites of the Earthmother
obj_text: aine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
desc_text: You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.$BBut in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.$BWe are hunters, <name>. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.

title: The Killing Fields
obj_text:
Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 15 Harvest Reapers.
 Harvest Reaper slain (15)
desc_text: <name>, after seeing what you're capable of I think I have another offer to make. You see, the Harvest Watchers aren't the only things that have claimed these once fertile farmlands.$BTo the Southeast of here is what they now call the Dead Acre. There you will find Harvest Reapers. They're just like the Harvest Watchers only meaner, but I don't think that will be a problem for you.$BCome back to me once you've slain 15 of 'em and I'll make sure it's worth your time.

title: Warchief's Command: Ashenvale!
obj_text: Report to Mitsuwa at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Mitsuwa in Ashenvale.$BShe requires your aid in defending our lands against the encroaching Night Elves and their allies. To reach Ashenvale, you must take the Gold Road north from Crossroads in the Northern Barrens.$BDestiny calls!

title: REUSE
obj_text: Eralan in Tranquillien wants you to retrieve the Archeologist's Shrunken Head from one of the chests in Zeb'Tela or Zeb'Nowa.
desc_text: Remember how I told you about the fat merchant who was looking for that ring?  As it turns out,he had his archeologist son looking for the thing and it didn't turn out so well.  By not so well I mean they killed him and shrunk his head.$BNow this might seem cold,calculating,and exceptionally callous,but he'd pay a lot to get his son's head back.  Sounds like the perfect job for you!$BGo east until you find the troll ruins of Zeb'Tela and Zeb'Nowa.  You're bound to find it one of the chests there.

title: Night of the Eclipse
obj_text: Gather a Curse-Binding Rod, an Arcane Amplification Crystal, and a Curious Dreamcatcher from Ambermill to help complete Lilly's device.
desc_text: Watch your step around here. These woods are still crawling with Worgen, and while I might look like just another corpse, even I prefer my limbs attached.$BI came out here to study them. Safer than poking around Pyrewood, at least. The hat helps. Masks the scent. Keeps them confused enough not to pounce.$BTruth is, I am past the studying phase. I think I have cracked how to suppress the curse. Not cure. Suppress. But I lack the resources to go further. Ambermill turned me away. Said something about sending me back to the grave. Charming, really.$BYou, though, you might have better luck. I need three things. A stable source of magical power. Something that interacts with curses. And a means to channel enchantments through the Emerald Dream. That last part is tricky, but I remember the magi in Dalaran collecting all kinds of strange trinkets. Odds are they have something that could work.$BIf you can bring me what I need, we might just have a way to tame this affliction.

title: The Brewin' Brothers
obj_text: Look into the missing ale shipment from the Brewin' Brothers Company for Vidra Hearthstove.
desc_text: Traveler, I'd make a request of ye, if I may.  The Inn's runnin' low on ale, and we 'aven't received our scheduled shipment from the Brewin' Brothers yet.$BIf ye could go to 'em and find out what the hold up is, maybe bring us back some brews, I'll make it worth yer while.  Ye can find 'em at their brewery in the east, across the Loch, the Cask and Crucible.

title: Club Thieving Fingers
obj_text: rother Bran wants you to deal with the ogres that have been stealing from the Brother's Tapworks.
desc_text: We at the Brother's Tapworks have had enough of those filthy ogres up north.$BThey have been stealing from us for too long, and it is time they were taught a proper lesson. Show them there are consequences for messing with our ale.

title: The Rookery
obj_text: Obtain a Pristine Black Dragon Egg
desc_text: Well, I might as well work on something else while I wait for for Jasper to finally wake up.$BI've been trying to learn more about the black dragons of this region, and how the orcs seem to have made them into allies.$BThey have a rookery deep in the woods where they raise new whelps from eggs, but it's closely guarded. If you do manage to get through them, I'd get the best information from the best egg they have.

title: Alenappers!
obj_text: rother Bran has asked you to recover the stolen Crate of Ales from the ogres to the north.
desc_text: Aren’t you a sight for sore eyes, traveler. We had a shipment of ale all boxed up and ready, but those ogres up north nicked it in the dead of night.$BIf you’re up for it, I’d have you go retrieve it. With any luck, there might be a bottle or two left for you in there.

title: Brothers Brew Delivery
obj_text: Deliver Crate of Ale to Vidra Hearthstove in Stoutlager Inn.
desc_text: Thanks to you, <name>, we finally recovered our crate of ale from those ogres. They've been intercepting our shipments for weeks, stalling business and leaving the Stoutlager Inn without it's best drink.$BNow we just need to finish the job. Take this crate to Vidra Hearthstove at the Stoutlager Inn. Try not to jostle it too much. It's a delicate delivery.

title: <NYI>Thunderbrew Secrets
obj_text:
Steal Grimbooze's Secret Recipe from Grimbooze's camp in Westfall and return to Barleybrew in the Brewfest Grounds.
                Description
Now I'd never steal a thing from our Thunderbrew cousins. They're good people. But if you want to get ahead in this business,sometimes you have to do unfortunate things,and that's why I hire other people to do it for me.$BGrimbooze Thunderbrew is a nutty member of the family who lives south of Moonbrook in the hills of Westfall. I hear he has a new recipe for ale,and I want it before it hits the market. You can fetch it for me,can't you? I'll reward you. A Barleybrew pays his debts.
                Rewards
You will receive:                 $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Related

obj_text: Return this pamphlet to Aalun outside the Exodar on Azuremyst Isle.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Aalun.$BAalun can be found at the entrance to the Exodar on Azuremyst Isle.

title: Learn to Ride in the Eversong Woods
obj_text: Return the pamphlet to Perascamin at Thuron's Livery in Silvermoon City.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Perascamin.$BPerascamin can be found at Thuron's Livery, southeast of the Shepherd's Gate leaving Silvermoon City.

desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Ultham Ironhorn.$BUltham can be found at the Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh, found along the road east out of Ironforge.

obj_text: Return the pamphlet to Binjy Featherwhistle at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Binjy Featherwhistle.$BBinjy can be found at Steelgrill's Depot, just northeast of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

title: Hero's Call: Duskwood!
obj_text: Report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke at Darkshire in Duskwood.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to Commander Althea Ebonlocke in Darkshire.$BYou can reach Darkshire in Duskwood by following the road south at the border between Elwynn Forest and the Redridge Mountains.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains!
obj_text: Report to Guard Howe at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Guard Howe at Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains.$BTravel east from the border of Elwynn Forest and into the Three Corners area of Redridge to reach Lakeshire.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Warchief's Command: Hillsbrad Foothills!
obj_text: Report to Deathguard Samsa at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Deathguard Samsa at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.$BThe Alliance encroaches upon our lands, and the Syndicate grows bolder with each passing day. Your strength is needed to secure our foothold and push back these threats.$BTo reach Tarren Mill you must follow the road south through Silverpine Forest and take the east fork leading into Hillsbrad Foothills.$BDestiny calls!

title: The Power to Reforge
obj_text: What is it you have there Hero?
desc_text: Ah.. this crystal.. I've seen its power before.. Somewhere in my memories.  There was an Alter once with the power to reforge our gear in battle, we gained the advantage on our enemy and turned the tide of the war.  I tried to return to the alter to claim it for our cause, but it was gone.  Hidden by those who wish to protect the power.  I wish I could be of more help Hero.$BTake this my Hero, this is my last memory I have of the War I wish to forget.$BStay strong, stay true.  For the Alliance!!

title: Hero's Call: Ashenvale!
obj_text: Report to Shindrell Swiftfire at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Shindrell Swiftfire in Ashenvale..$BThe Horde's aggression in Ashenvale cannot be allowed to stand! Your help is needed to repel the invaders and restore the sacred forest. Head south through the Twilight Vale in Darkshore to reach the forest of Ashenvale.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Adventurer's Contract: Hunting for Sport!
obj_text:
Kill 10 Ghostpaw Runners and 10 Wild Bucks.
 Wild Buck slain (10)
 Ghostpaw Runner slain (10)
desc_text: eing a capable hunter isn't just about killing your prey... it's about not becoming prey yourself. Hunt down Ghostpaw Runners and Wild Bucks in Ashenvale.$BBe careful though... you are not the only hunter in these woods.

desc_text: Adventurers Wanted:$BSilverpine Forest is under attack by undesirables! Refugees have begun passing through The Greymane Wall. Travel to the wall and dissuade anymore from coming through.$BDalaran may be gone now, but they didn't take all their residents. They are trying to build a new home in Ambermill. Show them some Horde hospitality.

title: Adventurer's Contract: Riding The Storm
obj_text:
Kill 10 Stormsnouts and 10 Thunderheads.
 Stormsnout slain (10)
 Thunderhead slain (10)
desc_text: Adventurers Wanted:$BSomeone or something keeps hunting our hunters, but the job still needs done. Think you can cull the population of Stormsnouts and Thunderheads without becoming prey yourself?$BKill 10 Stormsnouts and 10 thunderheads in the Southern Barrens.

title: Adventurer's Contract: Flesh and Gore
obj_text:
Kill 6 Greater Fleshrippers, Great Goretusks, and Riverpaw Mystics.
 Greater Fleshripper slain (6)
 Great Goretusk slain (6)
 Riverpaw Mystic slain (6)
desc_text: Adventurers Wanted:$BSomeone or something keeps hunting our hunters in Westfall! I don't know if I should blame Outlaws or the Riverpaw Gnolls. Either way the job still needs done. The Riverpaw Mystic might be directing the attacks on our hunters. Kill their Mystics and can cull the population of Greater Fleshrippers and Great Goretusks without becoming prey yourself.$BKill 6 Greater Fleshrippers, Great Goretusks, and Riverpaw Mystics in Westfall.

title: Reborn RE quest
obj_text: Apply a mystic enchant.
desc_text: You must learn how to apply a mystic enchant.

obj_text: Return the pamphlet to Xar'Ti at Sen'jin Village in southern Durotar.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Xar'Ti.$BXar'Ti can be found at Sen'jin Village in southern Durotar.

title: Learn to Ride in Tirisfal Glades
obj_text: Return the pamphlet to Velma Warnam at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Velma Warnam.$BVelma can be found at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

title: Mark of the Beast
obj_text:
Craft a Map and return it to your trainer.
 Craft a Map for your trainer.
desc_text: My falcon has returned with troubling news. While scouting it spotted a secluded cave hidden deep within the wilds of Ashenvale that seems to house the location of the owner of the beast that attacked you.$BMore disturbingly, by the falcon’s eye, I recognized a beast not unlike the one that attacked you during your first trial. It is a similar and unique creature. There is no doubt.$BBefore I can share the location with you, I need you to create something for me. Craft a leather map. This is one of our traditions. It must be made by hand and imbued with your focus. Only then will I mark the path to the camp.$BOnce you return with the map, I will give you what you seek. Then, it is up to you to track them down and face whatever awaits.

title: Learn to Ride in Mulgore
obj_text: Return the pamphlet to Kar Stormsinger at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Kar Stormsinger.$BKar can be found in Mulgore's Bloodhoof Village.

title: Proving Your Mettle
obj_text:
Help Scout Peter defend his post.
 Scout Peter's Post Defended
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Listen here, adventurer. Every sellsword and farmhand thinks they can swing a sword, but defending a position? That takes real backbone. Lakeshire has stood against orc raids for months because our guards know how to hold the line when it matters. You want to learn what we know? Then prove you've got the spine for it.  Don't you dare step away from that post, no matter what comes at you. The moment you break ranks, you've failed. Our people depend on guards and scouts who won't flinch when the enemy charges.

title: Death Note
obj_text: Find the cave where the Hunter was last seen.
desc_text: The map you crafted has served its purpose. I will mark the location that my falcon scouted. It lies deep within the wilds of Ashenvale, far from any traveled road.$BThere, you will hopefully find the one we have been searching for and with them, a creature not unlike the one that attacked you during your first trial. Their presence is no coincidence. Something connects them.$BYou must go to this place and confront whatever truths wait in the wild. This trial may require far more than just your combat skillset. Be prepared to use every tool in your arsenal.

title: Proving Your Mettle
obj_text:
Help Guard Lorak defend his post.
 Guard Lorak's Post Defended
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Listen up, grunt. Swingin’ a blade is one thing. Holdin’ your ground when death’s breath is on your neck? That takes guts. The Alliance dogs have pushed into our lands again. But they’ll learn what it means to face warriors who don't back down. Our outpost still stands because we hold the line — no matter the cost. You want to earn your place among the Horde? Prove you won’t break when the fight turns bloody.$BStand your post. Don’t flinch. Don’t fail. The Horde has no use for cowards.

title: Learn to Ride in Orgrimmar
obj_text: Return the pamphlet to Kildar in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Kildar.$BKildar can be found in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.

obj_text:
Defend the island from contenders for 5 minutes while the King's body dries out.
 Saltspittle Contender slain (10)
 Murloc the Warlock slain
desc_text: King Gillian, First of His Name, Swimmer of the Lake, Master of Murlocs, Eater of small bugs, has passed away. His body is barely dry and they already vie for his crown! None of these murlocs can hope to fill Gillian's shoes.   Defend his legacy. Do not let these weak contenders claim his throne!

desc_text: This pamphlet advertising riding training and mount purchases was sent from Randal Hunter.$BRandal can be found at Elwynn Forest's Eastvale Logging Camp, along the road east out of Stormwind.

I see no need to get salty when there are so many farmers in the fields. Slaughter the humans in Hillsbrad fields and soak the soil with their blood to prevent any further crops from feeding their armies.

title: The Stormscale Threat
obj_text: Defeat Stormscale Protectors at the Ruins of Mathysra
desc_text: If you're going down there anyways, perhaps you can try to thin their numbers a bit?$BI'm not worried about the ones patrolling the edges, if need be I can fend those off myself, but the ones protecting the depths, and the casters that went down there, both seem a lot more dangerous than an average naga.$BI'd feel a lot better about my position here if there weren't so many of them.

title: The Ruins of Mathysra
obj_text: Find Sentinel Fadrieth Moonblade at the Ruins of Mathysra
desc_text: We sent one of our own to investigate the Ruins of Mathysra to the north-east - it was supposed to be a simple scouting mission, but she hasn't been back yet.$BThis is Fadrieth's first time doing a mission like this without her sister, and a few of us are starting to worry.$BWould you mind checking up on her?

title: Ritual Beneath the Ruins
obj_text: Investigate the Stormscale activity at the Ruins of Mathysra
desc_text: These naga are definitely up to something. I suppose that much goes without saying, but this seems a bit more concerning than the usual naga schemes.$BI've seen several, spellcasters from the looks of them, going deep into the ruins, and they still haven't come back out. Their guards are vigilant, I can't get any closer without being spotted, and I know I can't fight them all off.$BPerhaps you can have better luck at figuring out what they're doing down there.

title: Demon's Contract: Prevent the Peace
obj_text:
Kill Foulweald Furbolg at Greenpaw Village
 $BFoulweald Furbolgs slain (7)

 Foulweald Warrior
 Foulweald Pathfinder

 Foulweald Ursa

 Foulweald Furbolgs

title: Once Beautiful
obj_text:
Defeat Shadethicket creatures at the Ruins of Stardust
 Shadethicket Raincaller slain (8)
 Shadethicket Wood Shaper slain (4)
desc_text: The Ruins of Stardust were holy once. When I first visited, it was one of the most beautiful places I'd seen.$BAlas, all things must come to an end. Corruption from the northern lands has seeped into the waters, the already abandoned shrine has crumbled into ruins. Even the plants are enraged, they suffer, yet they cannot understand why, so they lash out against anyone who comes close.$BIf it is not stopped soon, it will spread. We have a ritual to purify such corruption, but the shrine is too dangerous. Most of my sect are healers, not fighters, therefore there is little we can do.$BI beseech you, lay to rest the plants that have awakened, they deserve peace, and without them the ruins will become safer, perhaps safe enough for us to begin.

desc_text: Mystral Lake is a valuable source of water and magics. It is critical to Ashenvale's survival.$BPoison it.$BDestroy the Befouled Water Elementals. Spread their filth to the water they protect.

title: Meat for the Hold
obj_text: Collect 6 Stag Meat for Brammuk Earthhoof at Highwind Hold.
desc_text: The wyverns won’t say much when they’re hungry, but I can tell. They move slower. Their eyes lose focus. Even the wind seems quieter.$BWe've run low on meat these past few days. Most of what remains is being saved for the sick and the broodmothers. The stags around here are plentiful, though, and their meat keeps well. It's what we have used since the hold was founded.$BIf you have the time, gather what you can. Six should be enough to keep the young ones strong.$BJust take what is needed. The herds here have kept us going for years. I would like to keep it that way.

title: Eggs for Highwind Hold
obj_text: Collect 10 Wyvern eggs for Brammuk Earthhoof at Highwind Hold
desc_text: In time, even the fiercest creature may learn to trust, but only if we begin early.$BThe wyverns that soar above these peaks are proud and strong, but most are too wild to accept riders. It is the unhatched we look to now. Raised with care, they may come to see the Horde as kin, not as a threat.$BThere are nests scattered along the cliffs. If you find any eggs still whole, bring them to Highwind Hold. We will see to their growth and guide them as best we can.

title: Taken By the Dark
obj_text: Find Julie Addle at the Scarlet Raven Tavern
desc_text: I remember now, heard tell of a Julie Addle staying at the inn in Darkshire. Have to keep eyes on everyone these days, never know when a commoner might turn out to be something more.$BThe three of us are needed here, there's too few of us already. Still, doubt we'll get any further this way, if you find yourself at Darkshire, maybe you could seek her out yourself and see if she'll be any help.

title: The Interrogation
obj_text:
Oswin Drake of the Night Watch needs help interrogating the captured worgen
 Worgen Interrogated
desc_text: Wouldn't hurt anything at least, and might help us get our answers sooner, so if you want to try I won't stop you.$BJust don't get too close to the cage, it might try and rip out your throat.

title: May We Be Reunited
obj_text:
Speak with Arvis Addle, the captured worgen
 Arvis Addle Questioned
desc_text: <Julie takes a deep breath.>$BAlright, whatever happens here, I'm ready.

title: How to Tame a Dragon
obj_text:
efriend 5 whelps by feeding them Seared Crocolisk Meat.
 Dragon Whelps Befriended (5)
desc_text: Flamecrest helped you sear the crocolisk meat just the way dragons seem to prefer it. As he finishes, he turns his gaze to the east. You cannot say what draws his attention, but something about the look in his eyes is clear.$BHe wants you to help the others.$BThere are more whelps out there, wary and alone. If you bring them this seared crocolisk meat, perhaps they will trust you too.$BYou have a feeling that earning their trust could lead to something more. Maybe even dragons have friends.

title: Addle's Stead
obj_text: Find some trace of Arvis Addle's old life at Addle's Stead
desc_text: I apologize. I hadn't expected any news of him, but I'll be fine. If he remembers my name, there might still be some hope.$BOur farmstead was attacked by worgen some time back, we tried to flee, but they were faster. So my husband...he...he told me to run, and started fighting. Neither of us are fighters, but I didn't know what to do, so I listened. I ran until I found myself here...I never saw him again after that.$BI haven't tried to return. There's nothing left for me there now, and I've heard even though the worgen are gone, it's been taken by bandits now.$BStill, maybe there's something left there that he might recognize, some trace of his old life. It might be your best chance.

title: Befriend Flamecrest
obj_text: ring Flamecrest 5 Tender Crocolisk Meat to earn his trust!
desc_text: Flamecrest watches you intently as you approach. Though wary, he seems intrigued by your presence. Perhaps he’s expecting something. You notice his gaze lingering south of here, toward the river where crocolisks roam. Maybe bringing him some tender crocolisk meat will warm him up to you?$BHelp Flamecrest by bringing him some Tender Crocolisk Meat, and you might just earn a fiery little friend!

title: Their First Steps
obj_text: Three young Thunderheads have become separated from the herd. Guide them safely back to the Sanctuary of the Plains.
desc_text: The kodo have walked these lands longer than any of us. Their steps carved the Barrens into what it is. I have followed them since I was a child, learning the ways of the herd and the stories passed through their line.$BBut something is wrong. The calves are few, their cries missing from the wind. I have seen the herds shift, restless and incomplete.$BTo the south, in the Field of Giants, the earth has been stirred by creatures that do not belong. Silithid tunnels, sharp and wrong, burrow too close to the grazing grounds. I fear the young have been taken or scattered.$BIf you find any calves alive, guide them home. If any have fallen, ensure they are not taken deeper. Bring balance to the herds again. The Barrens will feel their absence until you do.

title: Addle's Stead
obj_text: ring the half-finished book and a bottle of Sweet Nectar to the captured worgen
desc_text: efore you go, I should also mention that he used to stop by this tavern for Sweet Nectar. Never was much for harder drinks, made it hard to write he always said. Maybe if you bring him some that will help too.$B...Why am I not coming with?$BNo, you're right. I'm afraid to see him like this. I don't even know how much of the man I loved he'll still be, but he's more likely to recognize me than his half-finished novel and a favorite drink.$BIf you get the nectar, I'll bring the book and meet you there. One way or another, I have to face him.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
desc_text: Hmph,good to see you're doin' so well for yourself,<priest/priestess>. Bet you're wonderin' when it's time for you to be called back home to Darnassus for some kind of celebration for your greatness,huh? Well,not today... well,not any kind of celebration anyway.$BHigh Priestess Alathea's sent word to me that I should direct you to her if I came across you. You can find her in the Temple of the Moon still... in case you forgot. Haha.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak with High Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
desc_text: The time has come for you to return to Darnassus again,<name>. Speak to High Priestess Alathea in the Temple of the Moon. She will tell you what you need to know.$BIf I am not mistaken,it will be something about new garments for your station within your order. May the Light be with you.

title: <UNUSED>
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
desc_text: Oh,<brother/sister>,I am so pleased for you! It is time for you to return to Darnassus and speak to High Priestess Alathea once again. Her messenger was almost certain it had to do with earning your newest garments of our order.$BWhen you can,return home,and give our order my very best.$BElune be with you.

title: <NYI> The Light Protects You
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
desc_text: The time has come again for you to journey to Stormwind,young <priest/priestess>. The High Priestess Laurena would reward you for your time spent in the service of the Light. She is still in the Cathedral of Light--look for her there.$BUntil then,you're welcome to stay here and train as much as you'd like. If there is anything I can do for you,please,just ask.

title: <NYI> The Light Protects You
obj_text: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
desc_text: The time has come again for you to return to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind,<name>. High Priestess Laurena would have you meet with her when you're ready. It is more than likely to repay you for all you have done for your people and the Light.$BGood luck,and may Elune be with you in your travels.

title: <NYI> The Rites of Old
obj_text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: Your spiritual leader Ur'kyo seeks audience with you,<name>. Do not keep him waiting.$BYou will find him in the Valley of Spirits in the great Horde city of Orgrimmar. Do your people proud.

title: <NYI> The Rites of Old
obj_text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: Hey there,<race>! I'll teach you whatever it is you want to know,but you should know that Ur'kyo--that's his name,right?--is looking for you. Something was said about you coming back to the Valley of Trials... no,that wasn't it. It was the Valley of Spirits... in Orgrimmar. Yeah,that's it!$BYeah,so,Ur'kyo... Valley of Spirits. He wants to talk to you.

title: <NYI> No Longer a Shadow
obj_text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
desc_text: Good to see you again,<name>. But I'm gonna have to cut our reunion short--Aelthalyste sent word that you were to return to her in the Undercity. She's still in the War Quarter.$BDon't worry though--I think it's a good thing. It was mentioned that she was pleased with your progress,so don't fret too much.

title: Hero's Call: Wetlands!
obj_text: Report to Valstag Ironjaw at Menethil Keep in the Wetlands.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Valstag Ironjaw at Menethil Keep.$BWetlands has become overrun with wild beasts, orcish raiders, and savage gnolls! To reach the Wetlands, you must travel north from Loch Modan through the dwarven hold of Dun Algaz.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Warchief's Command: Thousand Needles!
obj_text: Report to Hagar Lightninghoof at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Hagar Lightninghoof at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.$BThe Horde must strengthen its presence in the arid lands of Thousand Needles and defend against the encroaching threats from the Alliance and the hostile Centaur tribes.$BTo reach Freewind Post, travel south from the Barrens and follow the winding paths into the heart of Thousand Needles. The towering spires and vast canyons await your arrival.$BDestiny calls!

title: Swords Deck
obj_text: Use the Swords Deck to summon a Darkmoon Fortune Teller and give the deck to them.
desc_text: Now that you have gathered all of the Swords cards together into a deck, another card appears on top.  It depicts a fortune teller that seems to stare at you no matter how you hold the card.$BYou feel the card could be used to communicate with someone.

title: Warchief's Command: Stonetalon Mountains!
obj_text: Report to Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains..$BThe Stonetalon Mountains are under threat! The savage harpies of the Bloodfury tribe are raiding our supply lines and terrorizing our allies, while the treacherous goblins of the Venture Co. exploit the land's resources, heedless of the destruction they leave in their wake.$BTo reach Sun Rock Retreat, travel southwest from The Barrens.$BDestiny calls!

title: <NYI> No Longer a Shadow
obj_text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
desc_text: I welcome you back to the Valley of Spirits,<name>,but I must tell you,you are wanted back in your Undercity. Your head priestess there would be wantin' to speak to you.$BYou already know where she at: the War Quarter deep in your city.$BGo there and do not forget,you are always welcome to train here with my people.

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
200 experience

title: Minervia's Legacy
obj_text:
Search the Three Corners Tower and Lakeshire for clues to Archmage Minervia's staff.
 Ask Ley-Tracker Hestlor
 Ask Magistrate Solomon
desc_text: So you're interested in her too, are you?$BShe disappeared not long after the attack, some say she died, some say she just retired off in a quiet corner of Azeroth, if there even is such a thing.$BI need to know! She saved my life, she's the reason I wanted to study here to begin with...I owe her so much but I don't even know what happened to her. I've read through every book in the tower but it's all the same.$BYou seem like the adventuring sort though. Maybe you can find something I missed? Just, please, tell me if you learn anything!

title: Minervia's Past
obj_text:
Investigate the Tower of Ilgalar for clues to Archmage Minervia's disappearance.
 Search the Tower of Ilgalar for Minervia's whereabouts
desc_text: So she was the one that sent you on this, was she? I really should've known. Wish I'd just told her the truth years ago, but I never knew when the right time was. Promise you'll keep this to yourself for now, will you, it'd be better she hears it from me next time she visits.$BArchmage Minervia is my mother, I know she's known as a great archmage and all, but when I was a boy, she ran off, didn't hear from her again until that attack, and even then there wasn't much time to talk. I hated her for a while, but I think her saving Alex was her way of making amends, you know? Hard to really hold a grudge against someone who saved my daughter's life.$BBesides, I did learn why eventually, she had a dark past. Even though she escaped that, I don't think she ever quite trusted herself. Probably thought I was safer without her around...$BYou might try poking around the Tower of Ilgalar, I think the group she was with is still there, so you might find something.

title: Conflict of Interest
obj_text:
Slay Mosshide Gnolls in Wetlands
 Mosshide Brute slain (6)
 Mosshide Fenrunner slain (6)
 Mosshide Trapper slain (6)
 Mosshide Alpha slain (2)
desc_text: Say, you did good work on that last contract. How'd you feel about takin' on another?$BSame deal. Full pay, no questions. This one came in from some folks out at Menethil Harbor. They want the Mosshide gnolls cleared out from the marsh roads. Easy job, should be no trouble.$BProblem is, we've got Mosshides in our own ranks now. Not many, but enough. Asking them to attack their own kin? That would not sit well. Even bringing it up could stir things up, and discontent spreads faster than coin.$BI cannot risk that. This crew talks too much, and one wrong word turns into ten. So here's the ask. You handle it. Quietly. Get the job done out of sight, and none of the gnolls have to know a thing.$BYou get paid, I get credit with the harbor, and nobody here gets riled up. Deal?

title: Unfriendly Dragons
obj_text:
Slay Red Whelps, Lost Whelps, and Crimson Whelps in Wetlands
 Red Whelp slain (4)
 Lost Whelp slain (4)
 Crimson Whelp slain (4)
desc_text: Dragons are bad news ye see, keep comin' here breathin' fire all over me rams! Bothers 'em quite a lot getting their fur all singed like that.$BThink ye could teach some of those bad dragons a lesson 'fore they get bigger and become a real menace?

title: Minervia's Fate
obj_text:
Investigate the grave at Lakeshire.
 Uncover the truth of Minervia's disappearance
desc_text: ...Minervia?$BNow there's a name I haven't heard for years. If you're here, it seems you've got a pretty good idea about her.$BBefore Morganth became the Mage of Ilgalar, the one who ruled this tower was a scholar of dark magics by the name of Minervia. She had studied with Mage Theocritus in Dalaran many years before, and though she was our enemy, he always spoke of her with admiration. It was years ago now that he finally managed to bring Azora's wisdom to her, and our greatest enemy turned away from Ilgalar's path.$BWhatever she may have done, we seek only enlightenment, not vengeance, and all amongst us were most pleased with this outcome. Theocritus most of all.$BStill, Theocritus has spoken of how much that past haunted her new life even still. I don't know what became of her, but I only hope she was able to find her own peace with that past in the end.

title: Ram Ranch's Woes
obj_text: Return the lost rams to Ram Ranch
desc_text: Adventurer! Some of me rams have run amok!$BThe lands around here ain't safe for rams in the slightest ye see, I can't bear to think what'll happen if those rams get pounded to death by fen dwellers, or eaten by crocolisks, or roasted alive by gnolls...$BWe're farmers, not fighters, would ye please bring me rams back safe?

title: Adventurers Needed: The Wailing Caverns.
obj_text:
Enter The Wailing Caverns and slay Mutanus the Devourer.
 $BMutanus the Devourer slain

 Mutanus the Devourer (1)
 Mutanus the Devourer (2)
$B

 Mutanus the Devourer (3)
 Mutanus the Devourer
desc_text: I'm loath to send you on such a dangerous task without more training, but the threat has presented itself now. Gather a party of skilled adventureres before you take on this threat.$BTravel deep into the Wailing Caverns and stop Mutanus before his nightmare enters our world.$BThis quest must be turned in before level 29!

title: Adventurers Needed: The Dead Mines.
obj_text:
Enter The Deadmines and slay Edwin Vancleef.
 $BEdwin VanCleef slain

 Edwin VanCleef
 Edwin VanCleef - Heroic
$B

 Edwin VanCleef - Mythic
 Edwin VanCleef - Ascended
desc_text: I'm loath to send you on such a dangerous task without more training, but the threat has presented itself now. Gather a party of skilled adventureres before you take on this threat.$BRout the bandits that have taken up residence in the Deadmines. Put an end to leader Edwin Vancleef to ensure the threat is truly dealt with.$BThis quest must be turned in before level 29!

title: Demon's Contract: Hell Hath No Fury Like... Me.
obj_text:
Kill Bleakheart Satyrs
 $BBleakheart Satyr slain (7)

 Bleakheart Satyr
 Bleakheart Trickster
 Bleakheart Shadowstalker
$B

 Bleakheart Hellcaller
 Bleakheart Satyr
desc_text: The Bleakheart Satyrs sought to call Hell itself. Answer them.$BIf you do not return I shall know they are worthy and they will take your place as my eternal servant.

title: Demon's Contract: The Price of Loyalty
obj_text:
Kill Searing Infernals, Felguards and Mannoroc Lashers.
 $BFellfire Hill Demons slain (7)

 Searing Infernal
 Felguard
$B

 Mannoroc Lasher
 Fellfire Hill Demons
desc_text: Loyalty to me is absolute, but that loyalty does not go both ways. You live only because you serve.$BSome of my servants have grown weak. They delay their attack. Show the Fel at Felfire Hill the cost of being weak in my army.

title: Lost Secrets
obj_text: Recover the Codex of Secrets' lost page.
desc_text: I am the Codex of Secrets and I can help you uncover the truth of this world until you have come to understand its nature. I'm also your guide to knowledge that many might consider "forbidden".$BAh, but alas, my purpose has become somewhat muddled of late. An accursed orc who sought my knowledge proved far too impatient for her own good, and ripped out one of my pages, such absoluate barbarism! She has proven entirely unworthy of my generous gifts!$BShe now studies it atop a tower near Stonewatch Keep, I hardly care for the rest of those fools, but I would see her slain for her arrogance and most importantly, my lost page recovered.$BI trust you are the far more civilized sort?

title: Demon's Contract: A Fortress of Corpses (Group)
obj_text:
Defeat the Dun Garok Forces.
 $BDun Garok Forces slain (12)

 Dun Garok Mountaineer
 Dun Garok Rifleman
 Dun Garok Priest
 Dun Garok Mountaineer
$B

 Dun Garok Rifleman
 Dun Garok Priest
 Dun Garok Forces
$B
$B
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Dun Garok Fortress will be an excellent base of operations when we take the fight to the Undercity. The Legion is currently garrisoned by a group of dwarves that have proven more resilient than we first believed. Gather a group of Felforged and claim the Fortress for the Legion!

title: The Icon of Ironbeard
obj_text: Recover the Icon of Ironbeard
desc_text: I can see that look in your eyes. You are not the type to stick around. That's fine. I won't ask you to sign on, but maybe you're up for a quick job while you are here? Good pay, bit of danger. Seems like your kind of deal.$BTruth is, we took a contract to recover some old dwarven relic from the tomb nearby. Should have been a simple In and out. But I keep losing people to whatever is down there, and to be honest, it's really starting to cut into my bottom line. I can't keep tossing good mercs into the dark, but if I back out now, word gets out that we don't finish jobs.$BThe relic is called the Icon of Ironbeard. You bring it back, and I will pay you like you were on the full contract. So what do you say? You in?

title: Hero's Call: Arathi Highlands!
obj_text: Report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.$BAncient Stromgarde's honor must be redeemed! Too long have ogres and criminals sullied its streets. Travel north from the Wetlands and cross the Than'dol Span to reach Arathi. Follow the road to Refuge Pointe and present yourself to the captain.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Warchief's Command: Arathi Highlands!
obj_text: Report to Tor'gan at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
desc_text: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Tor'gan at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.$BThe Stromgarde forces grow restless, and the Syndicate's treachery threatens our operations. Your courage is needed to secure our position and crush these enemies.$BTo reach the Arathi Highlands, travel east from Hillsbrad Foothills and follow the road past Thoradin's Wall.$BDestiny calls!

title: Hero's Call: Hillsbrad Foothills!
obj_text: Report to Marshal Redpath at Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Marshal Redpath at Southshore.$BTravel south from the bustling trade routes of Silverpine Forest, through the rolling fields of Hillsbrad, and make your way to the fortified Alliance outpost of Southshore. Marshal Redpath and his forces stand vigilant against the growing Horde incursions and the dark forces that plague the region.$BYour courage and strength are needed to turn the tide in this vital region of Lordaeron.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Hero's Call: Northern Stranglethorn!
obj_text: Report to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.$BTravel south from Duskwood and follow the road west after crossing into the jungle to reach the Rebel Camp.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Hero's Call: Desolace!
obj_text: Report to Corporal Melkins at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Corporal Melkins in Desolace..$BThe brave soldiers of Nijel's Point are beset by demons and the armies of the Horde and they need your help. To reach Desolace, travel south on the road from the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Adventurer's Contract: Are You Sick of Fighting Yeti?
obj_text:
Kill 16 Cave Yeti and 16 Ferocious Yeti.
 Cave Yeti slain (16)
 Ferocious Yeti slain (16)
desc_text: The Yeti have taken up residence inside a cave in Hillsbrad Foothills. One way in... One way out... Can you defeat the Yeti and make it out alive?$BKill 16 Cave Yeti and Ferocious Yeti.

title: Relic of the Earthen Ring
obj_text: ring your four totems to Gotura Fourwinds in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You have progressed far in your training, <name>. Now that you have mastered the four basic elements, you must strive to keep all four in balance. There is a practical benefit to this discipline - with practice, you may carry only a single relic instead of all four totems.$BSpeak to Gotura Fourwinds at the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, and hone your mastery of the elements.

title: Hero's Call: Hillsbrad Foothills!
obj_text: Report to Marshal Redpath at Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
desc_text: y order of his royal highness, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Marshal Redpath at Southshore..$BTravel south from the bustling trade routes of Silverpine Forest, through the rolling fields of Hillsbrad, and make your way to the fortified Alliance outpost of Southshore. Marshal Redpath and his forces stand vigilant against the growing Horde incursions and the dark forces that plague the region.$BYour courage and strength are needed to turn the tide in this vital region of Lordaeron.$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!

title: Adventurer's Contract: Bask in this Salt!
obj_text:
Kill 15 Saltstone Basilisk.
 Saltstone Basilisk slain (15)
desc_text: You are becoming quite the hunter. It's one thing bringing your prey down when you can sneak up on them. It's quite another to hunt while out in the open...$BKill 15 Saltstone Basilisk around Weazel's Crater in the Shimmering Flats.

title: Adventurer's Contract: Dreadlord Death Squad
obj_text:
Kill 8 Mannoroc Lashers, Roaming Felguards,  and Searing Infernals.$BKill Gorgannon.
 Mannoroc Lasher slain (5)
 Felguard slain (5)
 Searing Infernal slain (5)
 Gorgannon slain
desc_text: Adventurers Wanted:$BA dreadlord named Gorgannon has taken up residence in Demon Fall Canyon in Ashenvale. Fight your way through his minions and destroy him.$BKill 8 Mannoroc Lashers, Roaming Felguards,  and Searing Infernals.$BKill Gorgannon.
