obj_text:
Kill 12 Highland Striders.$BKill 12 Plains Creepers.$BKill 5 Young Mesa Buzzards.
 Highland Strider slain (12)
 Plains Creeper slain (12)
 Young Mesa Buzzard slain (5)
desc_text: Adventurers Wanted:$BCan you complete your hunt without becoming prey?$BKill 10 Highland Striders, Kill 10 Plains Creepers, and Kill 5 Young Mesa Buzzards in Arathi Highlands.

title: Adventurer's Contract: Where Your Enemies Lie
obj_text:
Kill 10 Skeletal Warders, Skeletal Raiders, and Skeletal Healers.
 Skeletal Warder slain (10)
 Skeletal Raider slain (10)
 Skeletal Healer slain (10)
desc_text: Adventurers Wanted:$BWhere do you think all those bodies end up after your battles? Travel to the Duskwood Catacombs in Raven Hill Cemetery. Put your enemies to rest one final time.$BKill 10 Skeletal Warders, Skeletal Raiders, and Skeletal Healers.

title: Relic of the Earthen Ring
obj_text: ring your four totems to Farseer Eannu in Ironforge.
desc_text: You have progressed far in your training, <name>. Now that you have mastered the four basic elements, you must strive to keep all four in balance. There is a practical benefit to this discipline - with practice, you may carry only a single relic instead of all four totems.$BSpeak to Farseer Eannu near the Great Forge in Ironforge. He will help you hone your mastery of the elements.

title: Sanctioned Hunt: Alterac to Arathi
obj_text:
Kill 7 Boulderfist Enforcers in Arathi Highlands, 7 Mudsnout Shamans in Hillsbrad Foothills, and 7 Giant Yetis in Alterac Mountain.
 Boulderfist Enforcer slain (7)
 Mudsnout Shaman slain (7)
 Giant Yeti slain (7)
 Allegiance (Neutral)
desc_text: The Law has sanctioned a hunt! Are you willing to travel across Alterac to Arathi to hunt your prey?$BOutlaws are sure to try to stop you, but you seem to have no problem dealing with them do you?

title: Harvest Time!
obj_text:
Defeat Phil Grim in the Barrens or Westfall.
 Phil Grim slain
desc_text: Ah, the time of Pilgrim's Bounty is upon us, <class>!$BIt's a season to reflect, to give thanks, and most importantly... to feast! But a feast is only as good as the hands that prepare it, and those who take the time to raise and nourish the wonderful ingredients that will be used. THAT is where a particular problem has come up...$BOur farmers have come into a bit of a pickle and its making their harvests less productive and their shipments less reliable. There is a... contraption that has gone astray. If you could deal with it we would all be very grateful to you!$BMay your heart be as full as our tables when you return!

title: Adventurer's Contract: Dig This!
obj_text:
Kill 14 Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws.

Travel to the Ruins of Zul'Kunda and slaughter the scalpers. We cannot allow an evil greater than the Legion to threaten destroying Azeroth before we do.

desc_text: Ah, you there... a moment, if you please.$BYou wouldn't happen to know a gnome named Khazno, would you?$BStrange fellow... but a good heart, once. Brilliant mind, before the... incidents.$BLast I heard, he was headed into the Swamp of Sorrows. Muttered something about following a trail, trying to put an end to the 'witch fiasco'... a fiasco of his own creation, I might add.$BThat was some time ago. title: Green Guile
obj_text: Find and open the locked chest hidden in Stranglethorn Vale.
desc_text: So… Za’Bor is gone.$BCould’ve been one of us, once. But he chose the beasts over the bow. Thought friendship with the wild meant more than respect. That’s where Hunters go wrong. They blur the line. They cling to beasts like they’re kin.$BRangers don’t. We walk that edge with precision.$BHunters take. Rangers know when to take, and when to watch. We keep falcons, yes, but not because they’re cute. They serve. They scout. They survive. Lucky for them they don’t have hides worth skinning.$B<name>, you’ve shown strength, but if you want to be more than just another tracker with good aim, you’ll need to prove something else.$BRangers are slick. We’re clever. We vanish like mist and strike like flint. Some of us keep the peace in the woods. Some... take what the world denies us. Either path begins the same.$BIn Stranglethorn Vale, there’s a chest hidden in the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mounds in the hands of the Mogg'Ogg Lords. Most will never acquire it. Fewer still open it. It takes guile.$BIf you can figure it out, inside you’ll find a letter and your next step towards becoming an Initiate of the Ranger’s Guild.$BFind it. Open it. Read. Prove yourself.

Their dark rituals and relentless aggression cannot be tolerated any longer. We must strike back with fury and rid these lands of their corruption.$BTo reach Revanktusk Village, cross into the Hinterlands from the mountain pass in eastern Hillsbrad Foothills and make your way to the eastern coast.$BDestiny calls!

Enemies of Zanzrakka
obj_text:
Slay 15 players and return to Thrain with news of your success.
 $BPlayers slain (15)
desc_text: You feel that? That tremble in the air? That ain’t just jungle heat—it’s Zanzrakka, stirrin’ again. And I’ll tell ye why.$BIt ain’t the murlocs.$BIt ain’t the trolls.$BIt’s the other blasted adventurers!$BSneakin’ into the ruins, slayin’ the fish-folk like they own the place. Stealin’ kills meant to feed the Hexed One. Poking at things they don’t understand.$BNow she’s restless. Angry. I can feel it in me bones.$BSo here’s how we calm her down: we spill adventurer blood. Lots of it. Doesn’t matter the flag, doesn’t matter the colors.$BGo find adventurers and kill them. Prove you’re not one of the weak. And maybe, just maybe... Zanzrakka’ll stay quiet another day.

title: Slayer of Zanzrakka
obj_text: Return the head of Zanzrakka to Zul'tiki-Tiki at the camp outside of Booty Bay.
desc_text: You have achieved a feat most would never dare attempt, yet alone be capable enough of succeeding in.$BZanzrakka, the Hexxed Scourge of Zul'gurub has been slain by your hand and the hand of your worthy allies.$BTake his head to Zul'tik-Tiki at the camp outside of Booty Bay and collect your reward!

title: Nefarious Intent
obj_text: Slay 8 Murlocs at the Vile Reef and then return to Zul'gar with news of your success.
desc_text: <Zul’gar snarls, cracking his knuckles as he stares toward the misty coastline>$BThe jungle stinks of fish. It always stinks of fish. You kill a dozen, a hundred, and still they come. Gurgling. Gasping. Grinning with those bulgin’ eyes like they own the place.$BBut now they’re crawlin’ outta the Vile Reef. Big ones. Tougher. Meaner. Full of fat, cursed flesh perfect for Zanzrakka’s twisted appetite.$BWe feed the Hexed One, sure. Keep her quiet, keep her focused. But between you an’ me?$BI don’t care about Zanzrakka.$BI just want murlocs dead. Every last slimy one of ‘em.$BTake your blade, your fire, your fists—I don’t care what you use.$BJust go to the reef, and make the water red.

title: Bring It More Meat!
obj_text: Collect Kal'ai Murloc meat and bring it to Grizzik in order to appease Zanzrakka.
desc_text: <Grizzik Goldgrin twitches with nervous energy, one hand clutching a greasy wrench, the other scribbling on a meat-stained ledger>$BYou hear about Zanzrakka yet? No? Well lemme give ya the short version:$BThey call ‘im the Hexxed Scourge of Zul’Gurub. Big, mean, drippin’ with cursed mojo, and stomped half o’ Stranglethorn Vale into the dirt last week.$BNOBODY—and I mean nobody—knows how to deal with 'im. Trolls are runnin’, hunters are hidin’, even the Gurubashi are keepin' their distance.$BBut ol’ Grizzik? I got ideas. If we can’t kill 'im... maybe we can feed 'im. Keep that rage pointed somewhere else, ya get me?$BI need meat, and the best kind comes from those slime-scaled freaks out in the Kal’ai ruins. I'm talkin' Murkgill meat.$BMurkgill Oracles, Hunters, Warriors, and even their big ol’ Lords. Take ‘em down, bring me the bodies, and I’ll prep the buffet for Zanzrakka.$BDo this right, and you might just save Stranglethorn—and get a lil’ sumthin’ shiny for your trouble.

title: WANTED: Krelin, the Swashbuckler
obj_text: ring Krelin's head to Captain Dubi outside of Booty Bay.
desc_text: <Captain Dubi adjusts his hat, scowling at a crumpled, jungle-stained wanted poster in his hand>$BKrelin. That loudmouthed, overly-accessorized swashbuckler has been causing chaos all across this sector of the Vale. He’s plundering supplies, charming fools out of their gear, and worst of all—he keeps calling himself “Captain.”$BHe is not a captain. He never even passed the Gnomeregan Naval Aptitude Test! I graded it! He got a negative score!$BHe’s holed up somewhere west of here, rallying dropouts and washed-up pirates under his banner like he’s some kind of folk hero. Bah! More like a walking fashion disaster with a stolen rapier.$BTrack him down. Take him out. Bring me his head.$BAnd if you happen to step on his ridiculous feathered hat while you’re at it... all the better.

It's totally unacceptable. Visit the Scarlet Monastary and deliver his fair and totally justified punishment. Death.$BThis quest must be turned in before level 49!

title: Krelin's Log
obj_text: Find Krelin's stash.
desc_text: Entry 1:$BBooty Bay has grown too hot. The Bloodsail pirates are on my trail, and I can’t trust anyone. I’ve slipped north, away from prying eyes.$BEntry 2:$BI skirted the jungle’s edge, keeping the towering arena ruins in the distance. The further I sail, the quieter the sea becomes—except for the distant crash near that cursed reef.$BEntry 3:$BI’ve stashed my haul on a lonely patch of sand. No map could properly show how the tide surges around the reef nearby, but those who know Stranglethorn’s waters will figure it out. The locals avoid the place; talk of sharks and roaming elementals. Good. It keeps curious fools away.$BEntry 4:$BThis will be my last entry for now. If anyone finds this journal, may they prove resourceful enough to piece together where I’ve hidden my treasure. My only warning: watch for the tide and keep your courage near that swirling shore. My fortune remains where land meets reef—beyond the jungle’s vile secrets, yet somehow still just as connected.$B—Krelin

title: The Felwood Sprint
obj_text: Race Fleetwind Hoofrunner and reach the finish line before he does.
desc_text: The forest is thick with poison and shadows… but still, I run.$BI am Fleetwind, once of Thunder Bluff, now of the winding path. The Earthmother teaches through movement, through breath, through the pounding of hooves against the land. Even here, in cursed Felwood, I carry her lessons forward.$BIf your legs still hold strength, and your spirit burns bright, race me. Not for dominance. For clarity. For fire.$BDo you accept the challenge, runner?

title: Bloom in the Ash
obj_text: Collect 5 Sunfire Petals from glowing plants near titan relics in Un'Goro Crater.
desc_text: The grove feels strained. The wind carries more silence than it should. Something beneath the soil draws the life out of the plants. Slowly. Purposefully. Yet not all yield.$BThere is one bloom that endures. Bright and stubborn. We call it the Sunfire Petal. It grows only where the grove still breathes deeply. In warm patches the rot has not claimed.$BFind them. Take only what you must. Their light is not for us alone, but it may help us understand what sickens this place.

title: Kill 'Em With Sleep Deprivation
obj_text: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, you will find the sleeping quarters of the Dark Iron dwarves.$BTravel to the sleeping quarters and steal 20 Dark Iron Pillows. Return to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge when you have accomplished this task.
desc_text: If we want to put a dent in the productivity of the Dark Iron forces working out of the Slag Pit, we have to hit them where it's going to hurt the most.$BIt's a little known fact but dwarves, particularly of the Dark Iron variety, need rest! Lots of rest!$BNow I ask you; How can they sleep without pillows? Exactly, <name>, they can't. This is why you must weasel your way into the Slag Pit and steal their pillows.

desc_text: <name>,when you feel you are ready,there is a wisened furbolg hunter by the name of Ogtinc who resides in Azshara.  He may be able to enhance your teaching,and provide you with guidance.$BOgtinc is atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.

title: Deliverance for the Dead
obj_text: Find the owner of the necklace and inform her of her friend’s demise.
desc_text: The body before you is cold and covered in blood.$BIn trying to identify her, you find a pendant with the words ‘Best Friends for Eternity - Andriel and Eldanna’ around her neck.$BPerhaps you can find one of the names mentioned and inform them of their friend’s grisly end.

title: One More Soul to the Cause
obj_text:
Speak with the High Priestess
 Travel to Thel'dralor's Heart and find the High Priestess
desc_text: It is unwise to pester me. Are you arrogant, ignorant… or both?$BI am an acolyte of the Fading Light, caretakers of the forgotten dead. We guard what is left of our home in grief and silence. You are no child of Thel'dralor, and neither I nor the spirits welcome your presence.$BYet still you intrude, heedless of our ire. If you insist on walking among our sacred grounds, then you must learn the sorrow we bear. I will not waste my time with you, seek the High Priestess at the heart of the remnants. She alone will decide if such an unwieldy wanderer is worthy to aid the lost.

title: Duties of the Devout
obj_text:
Assist the various Caretakers of the Fading Light in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
 Assist Acolyte Thiandris
 Assist Groundskeeper Dalenian
 Assist Groundskeeper Theladrin
 Assist Priestess Ir'lynn
desc_text: Unexpected as your presence may be, I have never turned away a soul who wished to tend to our brethren, they deserve all we can give… and still so much more.$BOur priesthood is few in number, though we have grown slightly over the years as survivors have come to pay their respects. The others are scattered throughout Thel'dralor, each struggling with their grief in their own way. If you would, check on them, offer what help you can… perhaps, together, we may bring some small measure of peace to these poor souls.$BThough I confess… such a thing has never been achieved before.

title: A Focused Mind
obj_text: Deliver the Elixir of Clarity to Priestess Filaria in the Remnants of Thel’dralor, before it spoils.
desc_text: Ah, you there! Yes, you look like you have legs, perfect.$BNow, don’t just stand there blinking at me, I needed a tangible courier yesterday.$BThis is an Elixir of Clarity. Priestess Filaria has been attempting a new ritual to commune with the spirits, and if she doesn’t get this soon, she’ll probably fall over and crack her pretty little head on a gravestone.$BSo! Run this to her, fast as you can. No sightseeing, no chatting up ghosts, and for Elune’s sake, don’t drink it. You wouldn’t survive the headache.

title: The Missing Groundskeeper
obj_text:
Investigate the nearby area for the Missing Groundskeeper.
 Find a clue to the Groundskeeper's location
desc_text: <You find a crumpled note hastily tucked into a journal.>$BTheladrin,$BI… I know you told me not to go, but I can’t ignore it anymore. The whispers… the woods… they’re screaming, and something is wrong. I can feel it in my chest, in my bones…$BI have to see for myself. I… I’ll be careful, I promise. I’ll run at the first sign of danger. I just… I can’t do nothing.$BIf you don’t hear from me soon… please… don’t blame yourself. I… I just had to try…$B<Something terrible may have happened here. Perhaps you should investigate before it’s too late...>

title: Lost Knowledge
obj_text: Recover scattered relics across the Remnants of Thel'dralor.
desc_text: Ah, the High Priestess sent you? A new face is a welcome sight, indeed.$B<Theladrin gives you a small smile, though his eyes soon wander back toward the ruins.>$BPleasantries aside, I could use an extra set of hands. Scattered throughout the rubble are relics and keepsakes — fragments of the past, fragments of our people. Aerithel would see them recovered, and I will see her will done.$BTake care with what you unearth. To her, every piece of the past is sacred.

title: Trapped in Darkness
obj_text:
Escort Groundskeeper Dalenian to safety in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
 $BEscort Dalenian safely out the cave
desc_text: My wounds burn, and I… I can barely move.$B<He looks at you pleadingly, voice trembling.>$BPlease… I need your help to get out of here. I can’t… I can’t make it alone. I’ll follow your lead, I swear I won’t slow you too much… I just… I’m too weak to face them or even run.$BI… I never wanted to come here. I never should have… but I… I couldn’t ignore the spirits. Please… just get me out.

title: An Unfortunate End
obj_text:
Find the Enraged Spirit in the Remnants of Thel’dralor and lay them to rest.
 Slay the Enraged Spirit
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: The spirits clutch at their grief and let their emotions overtake them. They cannot rest while their deaths remain unjust. At least, that is what the High Priestess taught me. I am only an acolyte… as Eldanna once was.$BIf she attempted to soothe a spirit that refused her rites, and became angered by our presence, then it may still be bound in rage — able to lash out at the living or drag other spirits into chaos.$BCreed aside, something must be done. You look far more capable than I. Will you seek out this spirit and lay it to rest?

title: Vexing the Spirits
obj_text: Speak with Groundskeeper Dalenian in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
desc_text: As a friend, it may interest you to know that Dalenian’s wounds have healed. To be taken by satyrs, our accursed brethren, is a torment I would not wish on any soul, least of all a dear companion.$BI have endured the satyrs prowling at the edges of Thel’dralor… but now they burrow within our sacred home, desecrating these ruins, tormenting spirits and survivors who have already suffered so greatly. This, I will NOT allow.$BMeet with the groundskeeper. In his recovery, he has gained knowledge vital to purging the woods of these monsters.

title: Words for the Goddess
obj_text:
Venture to the various Thel’dralor moonwells and /pray with each of the Well-Watchers.
 Pray with Well-Watcher Karania
 Pray with Well-Watcher Delvanna
 Pray with Well-Watcher Nerielle
desc_text: If you wish to aid us, you must understand what Thel’dralor was - and what we have lost.$BWe, the Priestesses of the Fading Light, were once the wisdom and guidance of the city. We chose to oppose Queen Azshara and her demons… and for that, our friends, our families, the innocents I swore to protect, suffered a horrendous fate. Those who perished in the Sundering fighting Azshara, died with lives unfulfilled, loves lost, dreams vanished… and it was my choice.$BI pray to Elune every day for their souls, for guidance, for light. Perhaps you should do the same.

title: Too Close for Comfort
obj_text:
Drive out the Satyrs from the Legash Encampments.
 Legashi Rogue slain (7)
 Legashi Satyr slain (7)
 Legashi Hellcaller slain (5)
desc_text: I must confess… I can still feel their claws on my skin, even though my wounds have fully healed. Their touch lingers, and every time I close my eyes, I see them waiting for me again. They have terrified me so utterly, disturbing my peace, my mind… I cannot sleep without waking in terror.$BAnd that is only the impact on me. The spirits, the poor souls who were tormented further by their awful hexes… I cannot bear the thought of such a thing repeating.$BI… I cannot face them myself, but you… you are stronger, far stronger than I. If you would drive them back, even just a little, perhaps we could all breathe easier.

title: Supplying the Faithful
obj_text: Gather various supplies from the wildlife around the Remnants of Thel'dralor.
desc_text: …Oh my, a newcomer…!$BAs you can see…we’re still alive, and us, the living… unfortunately have needs too. It’s no excuse… but I’ve been so distracted with the spirits… I’ve let even the simplest things fall to the wayside.$BI… I didn’t mean to trouble you, really… I should be taking care of these things myself, but… I cannot will myself to leave. Not now. Not like this…

title: Honoring the Departed
obj_text: Use the Polishing Cloth to clean the various statues in the Remnants of Thel'dralor.
desc_text: After the Sundering… Thel’dralor lies in ruins. This… this is all that remains of our beloved home. Day after day we toil to restore what was lost, not only for ourselves, but for those trapped here in undeath. They deserve a home to return to… more than any of us.$BWe have unearthed statues, faces of old friends I had begun to forget. I… I cannot forgive myself for letting their memories slip, even for a moment.$BI shall never allow their visages to fade again. Take this polish… care for them, and perhaps, through their remembrance, you may learn the sorrow these souls carry… and the weight I bear for forgetting.

title: Demonic Thieves
obj_text: Recover the stolen offerings from the Legash Encampments.
desc_text: From my capture… I learned much from Xorthal’s minions.$BThey come to Thel’dralor in the dead of night, stealing offerings and relics - things we have long used to calm the spirits, to soothe their anger and sorrow.$BThey delight in enraging our fallen kin, in turning our family against us…waiting for the day when they grow so enraged they lose themselves and… and they might… No, I cannot think of this.$BPlease… recover what we have lost, before more harm comes to those already burdened by grief.

title: Demon's Contract: Challenges
obj_text:
Kill Gordok Ogres.
 $BGordok Ogres slain (8)

 Gordok Enforcer
 Gordok Mauler
$B

 Gordok Ogre-Mage
 Gordok Ogres
desc_text: Few warriors can match the Legion in combat. The Gordok Ogre will probably kill you, but your life is mine to spend.$BLive or die makes no difference to me. Soften the Gordok forces before my Legion arrives.

obj_text:
Kill Winterfall Furbolgs.
 $BWinterfall Furbolgs slain (8)

 Winterfall Den Watcher
 Winterfall Totemic
$B

 Winterfall Pathfinder
 Winterfall Furbolgs
desc_text: The Furbolgs have grown content living near their Hot Springs and Timbermaw Post. Slaughter them. I want those Springs overflowing with their blood.

title: Hippogryph Steak
obj_text: Jinx Swiftchop wants you to get the following items:$B10 Hippogryph Meat. You can get these off any hippogryph in Azshara.$B10 Goblin Spices. You can get these from Jinx, or any respectable chef in a Goblin city.$BGather all of the items and return to Jinx.
desc_text: Now I know you've maybe got your hands full trying to learn B.O.O.M, but if you really want to be a master chef you need to be able to multi-task! That's why I'm going to teach you P.O.P as well! That's:$BPerfect ingredients is what we strive for.$BObey me at all times no matter what.$BPrepare the food exactly as I say.$BThis is the only rule other than B.O.O.M you need to know. They're also pretty easy to learn together.$BGood, now for our second lesson here's what I'm going to need:

title: Demon's Contract: Red Snow
obj_text:
Kill Fledgling Chillwind and Shardtooth Bear
 Fledgling Chillwind slain (2)
 Shardtooth Bear slain (5)
desc_text: The only time snow is acceptible is when it is painted in blood or melting under the feet of my Infernals.$BYou have the canvas, the creatures native to winterspring will provide the paint.

title: From Satyrs to Sanctuary
obj_text: Report to the High Priestess in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
desc_text: I’ve probably kept you longer than I should… oh, but I cannot thank you enough!$BPlease, hurry back to the High Priestess and tell her of your deeds- of your bravery! I’ll be singing your praises so loudly, even the most faded of spirits will hear me!$BOh… thank you, truly, thank you!

title: When Light Fades
obj_text: Ensure Aerithel Sorrowsong's soul finds rest.
desc_text: The spirits still cannot rest…even with all that has happened.$BEven though I saw her die with my own eyes…I swear upon the stars, I can still feel her spirit…$BIf her soul is bound here, I beg of you…find her…and bring her peace. Let this be finished…

title: In Solemn Remembrance
obj_text: Claim Aerithel’s belongings in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
desc_text: I heard what you did. It pains me deeply that her spirit remains tormented. If her soul and the others are trapped in an endless cycle of unrest, calling one another from the grave… will she ever find peace?$BI cannot express to you how my heart mourns, perhaps it is I who now calls her from the grave, inadvertently chaining them in undeath once more. The cycle… it continues.$BI do not dare hope, but I’ve gathered what little of her belongings remain in a chest up the hill. Take them with you when you leave Thel’dralor. Perhaps, through them, Aerithel’s spirit may finally be coaxed from this accursed place… and find the rest she was denied.

title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
obj_text:
Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
 Fresh Dinosaur Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling (15)
desc_text: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.

title: Demon's Contract: Alone
obj_text:
Kill Rogue Icethistles.
 Rogue Ice Thistle slain (4)
desc_text: Kill the Rogue Ice Thistles. Watch as they die alone, isolated from thier tribes with no one to help them. I want you to watch how they die.$BDo you imagine your death will be any different if you fail in your servitude?

title: Gorishi Grub
obj_text:
Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
 Silithid Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling (10)
desc_text: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.

title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
obj_text:
Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
 Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling (12)
desc_text: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.

title: Venomhide Eggs
obj_text: ring 4 Venomhide Ravasaur Eggs to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands.
desc_text: Now that you've built up an immunity to venomhide toxin, you can safely handle the animals and their eggs. Venomhides are vicious and must be trained from the moment they hatch.$BIf you want to ride one, you'll need an unhatched egg. Scattered throughout the Marshlands are a number of ravasaur nests. Look for the eggs with lighter colored shells -- those are the ones that will hatch venomhides.$BIf you bring me several of the eggs, I'll allow you to keep one and raise its hatchling, with my guidance.

title: Searing Roc Feathers
obj_text: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.
desc_text: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.

title: Shadows in the Temple
obj_text: Speak with Groundskeeper Theladrin in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
desc_text: Now that you understand our position, and the importance of history and remembrance… know that not all cities are as fortunate as Thel’dralor, where survivors have returned to restore what was lost.$BThough my Temple remains unrecovered, others have been claimed by all manner of creatures. I would purge them myself, but I cannot bear to leave Thel’dralor again. The last time I did… I returned to ruins. Call me a coward if you will, but I cannot face such devastation again.$BI apologize, my friend, I... I… need a moment to myself. Please, speak with Groundskeeper Theladrin, he shall tell you more.

title: Toxic Tolerance
obj_text:
Mor'vek in Un'goro Crater claims that if you were poisoned by Venomhide Ravasaur blood 20 times, you could ride one without dying. Attack Venomhide Ravasaurs for a chance to be poisoned.
 Splashed with Venomhide blood (20)
desc_text: You want to ride a Venomhide? Then I've got bad news for you.$BThe Venomhide Ravasaurs, they're all poison: Poison blood, poison spit, poison skin. You climb on one, you fall off dead in a few hours.$BYou'd have to build up a resistance to their toxins before I sold you one, and that takes a long, LONG time... you'd need to be splashed with poisonous blood while fighting one numerous times. If you're really interested, the venomhides prefer the northern area of of the Marshlands, northwest of here.

The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.

title: Small Moments of Joy
obj_text: ring the good news to the High Priestess in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
desc_text: If you could, bring our good tidings back to the High Priestess.$BTell her the Temple is spared further harm, the barnacles cleared, and that we’ve done our best to preserve what remains of its beauty. I’m sure your news will bring a smile to Aerithel’s face… or at least, let us hope it does.$BShe carries so much on her shoulders already, a moment of joy is the least we can offer her.

title: Clearing the Crawlers
obj_text:
Clear out Arkkoran’s followers from the Temple of Arkkoran.
 Arkkoran Clacker slain (5)
 Arkkoran Muckdweller slain (5)
 Arkkoran Pincer slain (5)
 Arkkoran Oracle slain (5)
desc_text: Aerithel often forgets that, because of our presence, Thel’dralor is the anomaly, not the standard.$BAs much as the High Priestess would enjoy smiting the sea god herself, I confess… I am glad she sent you instead. Not that I have any ill intent toward you, of course.$BThat being said, if you could clear out some of Arkkoran’s followers - without provoking the sea giant himself - perhaps we can ease some of Aerithel’s guilt.$BShe cannot save the world… nor every soul or ruin she encounters. I only wish I could help her understand that.

title: Ruins of Faith
obj_text:
Clear the Hardened Barnacles attached to the walls of the Temple of Arkkoran.
 Barnacles Removed (15)
desc_text: Abandoned or occupied by unfriendly neighbors, it wounds the artisan in me to see the temple in such a state.$BAh, my friend… if only you could have seen the Temple of Elune in its glory days. Streaming lights, colorful banners, and the most beautiful women in the world…$BThough we have uncovered much of Thel'dralor over the past millennia, we are still far from restoring the temple. Its half-submerged state worries me and I fear for the damage being done to its marble walls.$BTake this Barnacle Scraper and right-click it to scrape the hardened barnacles from the temple walls.

title: Restless Still
obj_text:
Speak with Priestess Filaria in the Remnants of Thel’dralor about a possible change in the temperament of the spirits.
 Speak with Priestess Filaria
desc_text: With the satyrs gone and the grounds cleared… I had hoped to see something- anything. Some sign of change in the spirits… but still… nothing. Always nothing.$BNot a thing we do seems to bring them peace. We can only stand by, helpless, as all hearts overflow with despair. This is no life… no peaceful rest… only sorrow, as all remain trapped in the past.$BPriestess Filaria has always been the most attuned to the spirits… Perhaps, and I can only pray that if any change has occurred, she can sense it.$BPlease… speak with her. I must know.

title: An Impossible Ask
obj_text:
Convince the High Priestess to abandon her work and leave the Remnants of Thel’dralor forever.
 Convince the High Priestess to leave Thel'dralor
desc_text: She does not believe me. Even now, after all we’ve seen, she clings to her vigil… to duty… to grief. Elune help me, I cannot fault her for it. It is the heart I once loved most in her—the part that could never turn away, no matter the cost.$BBut that heart is breaking her… and it is chaining the dead.$BPlease, I beg you. Speak with her. You have aided us, made a difference in Thel’dralor and uncovered the plight of the spirits whereas I have only dusted off relics. She trusts you. Tell her to remain is to condemn them, and to let go… is to give them peace. If she cannot listen to her husband, then perhaps she will listen to her champion.

title: Voices Beyond the Veil
obj_text:
Using Eldara’s Magical Focus, help Priestess Filaria commune with the spirits in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
 Hand the Magical Focus to Filaria
 Assist Filaria in communing with the Shimmering Spirit
desc_text: Now then! Let’s hope this actually works… and that I’m not the cause of yet another tragic tale in Thel’dralor.$B<Priestess Ir’lynn gives you a smile, though it’s noticeably weaker.>

title: Ill Discoveries
obj_text:
Speak with Groundskeeper Theladrin in the Remnants of Thel’dralor and discover the source of the Shining Light.
 Question Groundskeeper Theladrin
desc_text: I do not know whom, or what, the spirits speak of.$BIf such a conjuring were summoned by magic, surely its presence would have been apparent upon my return to Thel’dralor.$BPerhaps the spirits’ words are more literal, more tangible than I have interpreted.$BSeek out Groundskeeper Theladrin. If there is anyone with deep knowledge of these ruins still alive… it would be him.

title: In Need of Focus
obj_text:
Retrieve a magical focus from the naga for Priestess Ir’lynn in the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
 (Optional) Speak With Arcanist Drienna
desc_text: Of all the irresponsible, foolhardy - BAH!$BShe better hope this works, or Aerithel’s going to smite someone—probably me!$BNo... no, this is too risky. Filaria only just ascended to become a full priestess, I don’t want to say I don’t trust her… but this is more than she can handle.$BThere must be something else we can do. Rather than amplify Filaria as a conduit, we could use something that wasn’t, perhaps, living? This area was home to many great highborne mages. If any relics like this remain, I wouldn't be surprised if one of those accursed naga snatched them in the ruins.

title: A Bitter End
obj_text:
Meet with the Caretakers of the Fading Light at the edge of the Remnants of Thel’dralor.
 Meet with the Caretakers of the Fading Light
 Ensure the Caretakers leave Thel'dralor safely
desc_text: I will gather the others, and what few belongings remain to us. Whether they will find the strength to leave behind their home… their kin… their memories… I cannot yet say.$BBut we shall see. Meet us at the edge of Thel’dralor. We will need a moment there, to offer our farewells before we depart.

title: They Grow Up So Fast
obj_text:
Return 20 Venomhide Baby Teeth,  the Venomhide Hatchling, 20 Runecloth, 20 Rugged Leather, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeastern part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
 $BRequired money: 80
desc_text: With your expert feeding and care, your venomhide hatchling will grow quickly. As they grow, their hatchling teeth will be replaced by adult teeth. If you keep the teeth shed by your hatchling as it grows, you'll have an easy way to tell when it's mature enough to be trained as a mount.$BYour venomhide will let you know what it needs, so pay close attention. When it has shed all of its baby teeth, return to me with your venomhide and the materials for your saddle and I'll do the rest.

title: Time Crystal
obj_text: Locate 15 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city.  Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
desc_text: I have been hard at work, and I believe I have discovered a way to create a Time Crystal. With enough Andorhal Watches, I will be able to craft a crystal that will give us a glimpse into the past and future. This will allow us to unlock time magic and make changes to prevent disasters that may occur.$BJourney to Andorhal and collect as many of these watches as you can. Bring them back to me so that I can begin my experiment. I understand that this task will not be easy, but I am confident that with your help, we will be able to create a Time Crystal and unlock the secrets of time magic.$BAre you ready to take on this important task? The future is counting on us!

title: Steamed Makrinni Claws
obj_text: Jinx Swiftchop wants you to get the following items:$B10 Makrinni Claws. You can get these off any makrinni, even the arkkoran, in Azshara.$B10 Goblin Spices. You can get these from Jinx, or any respectable chef in a Goblin city.$BGather all of the items and return to Jinx.
desc_text: So, you've come to train from a real chef? Then listen up, <name>, because you'll need to learn the first and most important rule for being a master chef, and that's B.O.O.M. That stands for:$BBest ingredients only.$BObey me at all times.$BOnly do what I say.$BMaster chef Jinx always knows best.$BIf you've got a problem with any of those, then this isn't going to work out, but as long as you always remember B.O.O.M then you'll do great!$BNow, for our first lesson here's what I'm going to need:

Could they make any less sense..?$BAnyways, we really don't want to admit that they were right, so we are looking for any heroes to stomp out the problem, even if it is only temporary.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

obj_text:

desc_text: Intel says that the Blackhand have been trying their hand at diplomacy for a change. Absurd, right?!$BThe strength of the Blackhand forces lies in their assassins, who have recently been given orders to not indiscriminately kill passer-bys. Let's kill two birds with one stone.$BGo snuff out some Blackhand troops to bait out their assassins. Once you have killed 10 Blackhand Assassins, come back for your reward.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: Not Enough Mana
obj_text:
Kill 20 Mana Wraiths.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Mana Wraith slain (20)
desc_text: Hero, the city arcanists have made an astounding new discovery!$BWe can imbue our warriors with arcane power, increasing their effectiveness on the battlefield 10 fold! And best of all, it seems to have a 30% success rate, and those who failed usually aren't in a position to sue, or do much of anything for that matter..$BAnyways, we have run into a problem with our work, all of our arcanists seem to have run out of mana. Luckily, we can supplement using another source of mana. Some of the Blood Elves in Azshara have so much of the stuff, that when they die, they actually create living manifestations of it!$BYou can take care of the killing. Go snuff out some Blood Elves and kill the Mana Wraiths that follow their untimely deaths. We will send someone to collect the cores.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: For The Light
obj_text:
Kill 10 Shadowy Constructs.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Shadowy Construct slain (10)
desc_text: Attention all Heroes!$BDecent people everywhere are offended by the abominations that are the Shadowsworn Cultists. Apparently the heathens have been playing with some kind of strange spell, and have let their souls become vessels for some kind of strange, shadowy entity.$BKill the Shadowsworn and strike down the Shadowy Constructs that follow their untimely deaths.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: Global Warming
obj_text:
Kill 10 Rampaging Earth Elementals.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Rampaging Earth Elemental slain (10)
desc_text: Hey heroes, I heard another crazy rumor! Apparently the Twilight Cultists have been playing with elemental forces that they simply don't understand. One of my friends told me that some primordial elementals have been displeased with their perversion of nature. Hilarious, right?$BWell, it couldn't hurt to go there and check it out, right? Go to Silithus and kill some Twilight Cultists and their Raging Earth Elementals. Then we will see if anything changes. Again, not like it would! It just wouldn't hurt to see is all, I don't think anything will happen though...$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: A Harmless Prank
obj_text:
Kill 10 Firewater Furbolgs.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Firewater Furbolg slain (10)
desc_text: Hey heroes! I am sure everyone will just laugh about this when it all blows over, but me and some friends thought it would be funny to give the Furbolgs in Winterspring some Firewater. It was great at first! The Furbolgs were freaking out, had no clue what it was doing to them. However, it seems they found some kind of a sweet spot with their dosage...$BYeah, funny thing is hero, they ended up using it to increase their strength by ten fold, and even learned where to find the stuff... A few dead passer-by's later, I figured I should probably post this here.. So if you could just kill a few of those Furbolgs, get them to use up their stores and kill the Firewater-high Furbolgs.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: You'll Make an Arthas Yet
obj_text:
Kill 30 Scarlet Ghouls.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Scarlet Ghoul slain (30)
desc_text: It seems the Scarlet in the Eastern Plaguelands have contracted some kind of plague. Many of them are getting sick and transform into the mindless dead when they die.$BArthas was once faced with this very same dilemma, and purged the entire city of Stratholme to stop the plague from spreading. You'll make a great Arthas yet Arthas! Arthas, go kill the infected Scarlet and the mindless dead that follow. If you get this done in a timely manner Arthas, in addition to your reward, you may even be promoted to Grand Arthas Arthas, Arthas!$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: A Geistly Problem
obj_text:
Kill 10 Geists.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Marauding Geist slain (10)
desc_text: Some Geists have started scouting about the Eastern Plaguelands. If unprovoked they aren't hurting anyone, but they are quite unsightly..$BGo to the Eastern Plaguelands and kill some of the scourge there. That should get them to come out of hiding to attack you. After you have killed 10 Geists, come back for your reward.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: Rain, Rain, Go Away!
obj_text:
Kill 40 Thundering Invaders.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Thundering Invader slain (40)
desc_text: Azshara is dangerous enough as is with that damned dragon strolling around there all day. The water level is rising every day, and these Shamans keep hounding me about global warming,then they tell me about how we are going to have an Ice Age soon.. It can't be getting colder and hotter at the same time..$BAnyways, Azshara has enough water, and the last thing we need is more rain there. I can't have you take care of the water in Azshara, but you can solve our rain problem. Kill some Thundering invaders in Azshara, and maybe those damn Shamans will stop bothering me with their drivel.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: Tornado Season
obj_text:
Kill 40 Whirling Invaders.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Whirling Invader slain (40)
desc_text: I swear, these Shamans are idiots. Apparently global warming is an issue. Then we are going to have a new Ice Age. But apparently, they failed to mention massive dust storms all over Silithus! What are we hiring them for if they can't identify these things as problems?!$BGo to Silithus and kill some Whirling Invaders and return for your reward.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: A New Ice Age
obj_text:
Kill 40 Watery Invaders.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Watery Invader slain (40)
desc_text: Some Shamans say we are overdue for an Ice Age. And all of those Shamans complain about the world getting hotter. It can't be getting both hotter and colder.. They could be crazy, but we can afford to throw some gold and equipment your way just incase.$BGo to Winterspring and kill 40 Watery Invaders to stave off any potential Ice Ages.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: A Fiery Imbalance
obj_text:
Kill 40 Blazing Invaders.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
 Blazing Invader slain (40)
desc_text: Attention all Heroes!$BThe League of Shamans has recently gone on strike, and, while we would love to ignore them, Thrall joined them.. They say that the Fire Elementals that recently invaded Un'goro Crater are raising the global temperature. I swear, these idiots, maybe next week they will force me to send Heroes to Winterspring to stop an Ice Age!$BAnyways, since Thrall got himself wrapped up in this whole mess, it would probably be cheaper to just hire some Heroes to take care of the elementals. Kill some Burning Invaders and come back for your reward.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: An Extraordinary Event: Gurubashi Blood
obj_text: Kill 40 Players in the Gurubashi Blood Bowl.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)
desc_text: Attention all Heroes!$BI don't have any noble cause or heartfelt plea for help. I just want to see blood. Lately, the competitors in the Blood Bowl have been getting bored of the same old fighting every single time. Let's spice things up and get some new blood in the arena!$BKill five opponents during the Gurubashi Blood Bowl and come back for your reward.$B(This quest requires a specific rotating event to be active to be completed)

title: In Service Of The Lich King
obj_text: Report to Instructor Razuvious in the Heart of Acherus.
desc_text: All that I am: anger, cruelty, vengeance - I bestow upon you, my chosen knight. I have granted you immortality so that you may herald in a new, dark age for the Scourge.$BGaze now upon the lands below us. The Scarlet Crusade scurries to undo my work, while Light's Hope stands defiantly against us - a blemish upon these Plaguelands. They must all be shown the price of their defiance.$BYou will become my force of retribution. Where you tread, doom will follow. Go now and claim your destiny, death knight.

title: The Emblazoned Runeblade
obj_text: Search the weapon racks in Ebon Hold for a Battle-worn Sword and then use it on a runeforge to craft a Runebladed Sword.$BReturn the Runebladed Sword to Instructor Razuvious in Ebon Hold.
desc_text: The single most important piece of equipment to a death knight is the runeblade. It is through the runeblade that a death knight commands the powers of frost, blood and the unholy. The runeblade also acts as a vessel to store the death knight's runic power.$BThe time has come to create your first runeblade. Search the weapon racks on this floor and locate a battle-worn sword. Once found, take the sword to a nearby runeforge and use it to create a runeblade.

title: Dominion Over Acherus
obj_text: Report to Master Siegesmith Corvus on the garrison floor of Ebon Hold.
desc_text: ehold, Acherus, the grand citadel of death! It has no equal in this world! Not even the mighty Naxxramas could withstand a direct assault from the Ebon Hold.$BThough your thoughts may still be hazy, we haven't a moment to spare. You must claim dominion over Acherus and your mind! The horns of war surge!$BTake the stairs on this floor - located north, south, east and west - to the garrison floor above us. Seek out Master Siegesmith Corvus and acquire his status report. It must be delivered to Thalanor.

title: Company of the Damned
obj_text: Deliver Corvus' Report to Scourge Commander Thalanor at the garrison floor of Ebon Hold.
desc_text: <Corvus salutes.>$BOur stockpiles of weapons, armor and munitions are nearly at maximum capacity. We are ready for war!$B<Corvus rolls up a fleshy piece of vellum.>$BOn the other side of this garrison floor, southwest of here, you will find the officers' quarters. Take this status report there and deliver it to Scourge Commander Thalanor, battalion commander of the Company of the Damned.

title: The Eye Of Acherus
obj_text: Report to the Lich King in Ebon Hold.
desc_text: ehold, Acherus, the grand citadel of death! It has no equal in this world! Not even the mighty Naxxramas could withstand a direct assault from the Ebon Hold. Looming above the face of the necropolis is the all-seeing eye of Acherus. From it the master is able to see great distances into the territories held by our enemies. What the eye sees, the Lich King sees, and now the time has come for you to peer through the eye! The Lich King has called for you, <name>.$BGo now! Suffer well, <brother/sister>...

title: The Scarlet Harvest
obj_text: Report to Prince Valanar at Death's Breach.
desc_text: elow Acherus stands Death's Breach, the staging point for our assault upon the Scarlet Crusade. You are to ride one of my Scourge gryphons, located on either side of this platform, and report to Prince Valanar. Do as he says and you may live to see these lands fall before us.

title: If Chaos Drives, Let Suffering Hold The Reins
obj_text:

Leave their corpses so that we may utilize them for the death march.$BBut most importantly: kill the fleeing villagers. Soldiers dying are an affordance, but villagers? That is what strikes fear into the hearts of man.

title: The Might Of The Scourge
obj_text: The Lich King commands you to carry his orders to Highlord Darion Mograine at Ebon Hold.$BUse the glowing transporter behind the Lich King to reach Highlord Darion Mograine in the Hall of Command.
desc_text: Listen well, death knight, for I give to you the words that will start a war. My final judgment has been passed: Death. To. All. None shall stand so boldly against the might of the Scourge without reprisal!$BAs you have served me well in your first task, so too shall you serve me in your next task. Take my judgment to Highlord Mograine at the command post of Acherus, found on the first floor. Tell him to begin the assault.$BAnd when the Crusade has been dealt with, we will finish off the Argent Dawn.

title: Death Comes From On High
obj_text:
The Lich King commands you to use the Eye of Acherus to analyze the Scarlet Hold, New Avalon Forge, New Avalon Town Hall and the Chapel of the Crimson Flame.$BControl the Eye of Acherus by using the Eye of Acherus Control Mechanism.

 Chapel of the Crimson Flame Analyzed
desc_text: Towering above this platform is the eye of Acherus. From it you will call forth a probe that you will then use to analyze Scarlet Crusade fortifications at New Avalon. The eye has a host of powers that should make the acquisition of this data simple.$BUse the eye's siphon to analyze the forge, town hall, hold, and chapel. The eye's control mechanisms are located on either side of this platform. Waste no more time, <name>.$BThe Scourge will have this place. The Lich King commands it!

title: Grand Theft Palomino
obj_text:
Salanar the Horseman asks that you steal a horse from the Havenshire Stables and return it to him at Death's Breach.
 Horse Successfully Stolen
desc_text: How fortuitous it is that the Crusade has a stable full of horses a mere stone's throw from this post. Though they guard it tenaciously, an enterprising young death knight could break through their defenses and take what is rightfully <his/hers>!$BOnce you acquire a horse from the Havenshire Stables, return it to me and I will see what can be done about transforming it into a proper deathcharger.$BRemember, <name>, it's only stealing if you're caught. Watch out for that deranged stable master, Kitrik!

title: Into the Realm of Shadows
obj_text:
Salanar the Horseman at Death's Breach has challenged you to slay the Dark Rider of Acherus and take his Acherus Deathcharger.$BShould you succeed, return the Acherus Deathcharger to Death's Breach and use the Horseman's Call to summon Salanar.
 $BThe Horseman's Challenge
desc_text: The horse you stole has been taken to the Realm of Shadows. It is there that my dark rider will slay the beast and raise it as a deathcharger. Do you think yourself brave enough to enter the Realm of Shadows in pursuit of the deathcharger?$BIf you accept, I will transport you to the shadow world. Once there, seek out a dark rider in the open fields south of us. To emerge victorious you must slay him, overtake his deathcharger and return it to Death's Breach. Issue the Horseman's Call should you succeed.

title: Gothik the Harvester
obj_text: Speak with Gothik the Harvester at Death's Breach.
desc_text: CHAOS, <name>! The Crusade is in a frenzy. They have diverted all forces outside of New Avalon to set up a blockade at Light's Point, east of here. They are desperately trying to strip the Havenshire Mine of all resources and load the cargo aboard the frigates they have docked on the coast.$BLet's stir things up a bit, shall we? Gothik the Harvester, grand necromancer of the Lich King, has graced us with his presence. He has a gift he'd like to bestow upon the Scarlet Crusade. Seek him out.

title: Tonight We Dine In Havenshire
obj_text: Orithos the Sky Darkener at Death's Breach wants you to recover 15 Saronite Arrows.
desc_text: The Sky Darkeners are mindless constructs with one purpose: KILL! Specifically, they are aiming to kill any man or woman that they see fleeing Havenshire for the safety of New Avalon. We certainly can't allow those cowards to make it to safety and then take up arms against us!$BThere is one slight problem. They use saronite arrows for maximum range and damage. Saronite, however, is a metal only found in Northrend, so supplies are limited! Retrieve those arrows for me and I will reward you handsomely.

title: An Attack Of Opportunity
obj_text: Speak with Prince Valanar at Death's Breach.
desc_text: Only the Scarlet forces at New Avalon and Light's Point challenge us! The time to attack the Scarlet fleet at Light's Point has come.$BThe diversion at the mine has caused chaos amidst their ranks. They are frantically working to clear the area and return to their ships.$BThe time is ripe! Prince Valanar is seizing this opportunity to finish off the Scarlet fleet. Report to him at once!

title: Massacre At Light's Point
obj_text:
Prince Valanar at Death's Breach has commanded you to slaughter 100 Scarlet Defenders.
 $BScarlet Defender slain (100)

 Scarlet Fleet Defender
 Scarlet Land Cannon
$B

 Scarlet Fleet Guardian
 Scarlet Fleet (PROXY)
desc_text: In their haste the Crusade will make one fatal error: forgetting to check the mine cars.$BYou are to return to Havenshire Mine, east of here, and locate the mine car that my minions have planted near the outhouse. Climb inside the mine car and a Scarlet miner will unwittingly see to it that you are placed safely behind enemy lines.$BOnce aboard one of their ships, use the cannons against them! SLAUGHTER THEM ALL!$BCall the Scourge gryphon from the cannon when you are ready to return.

title: The Gift That Keeps On Giving
obj_text:
Gothik the Harvester at Death's Breach has given you the Gift of the Harvester to use on Scarlet Miners. Create 5 Scarlet Ghouls with the device and return the ghouls to Gothik.
 Scarlet Ghoul Returned (5)
desc_text: I have come from the frozen heart of Naxxramas to feast on souls and deliver a vicious thrashing upon our sworn enemies - and I'm all out of souls.$BThis device I am about to give to you is a portable plague spreader. Take it east, to the Havenshire Mines, and unleash it near the Scarlet miners working inside. Use it to turn the miners into ghouls and return to me when you have a small army at your side. I have saved a special place for them in the vacuum cleaner of souls!

title: The Crypt of Remembrance
obj_text: Report to Prince Keleseth at the Crypt of Remembrance.
desc_text: The attacks upon the gates of the last Scarlet bastion have begun. Our ghouls are wearing the Crusade's front lines down while we labor to fortify our new forward base, the Crypt of Remembrance.$BVenture south to the crypt, which borders New Avalon, and report to my dear brother, Prince Keleseth.$BHe will be expecting you.$BPrepare yourself, <name>, for you are about to witness the next stage of Scourge warfare: DOMINATION!$BRide now, death knight!

title: The Will Of The Lich King
obj_text: Return to Death's Breach and report to Prince Valanar.
desc_text: It is the will of the Lich King that drives us onward, <name>. None are more aware of this than death knights. Our very existence is intrinsically tied to his consciousness. Surely you have heard him speak to you - invading your thoughts...$BCan you hear him now? Perhaps it is too early for you.$B<Mograine closes his eyes and nods to an unseen host.>$BYes, my lord. It will be done.$B<name>, you are to return to Death's Breach and report to Prince Valanar. The Lich King commands it!

title: Victory At Death's Breach!
obj_text: Deliver Prince Valanar's Report to Highlord Darion Mograine in Acherus: The Ebon Hold.
desc_text: <Prince Valanar hands you a sealed scroll.>$BThis is the full report of our victory at Death's Breach. You are to deliver this to Highlord Mograine - inside Acherus. I have made sure to include your heroics in the report. Mograine will undoubtedly reward you greatly for this victory, <name>.$BGo now!

title: Noth's Special Brew
obj_text: Place the Pile of Crusader Skulls inside the Plague Cauldron.
desc_text: The cauldron is ready to begin spewing its foul corruption across the land!$BNow, death knight, a brief lesson in plague cauldrons. The gas that the cauldron emits is deadly to the living, but empowers Scourge. As with all Scourge creations, it feeds off of death and grows stronger the longer it feeds.$BTake these Crusader skulls and drop them in the cauldron. You will be quite happy with the results.

title: Lambs To The Slaughter
obj_text:
aron Rivendare at the Crypt of Remembrance has commanded you to slay 10 Scarlet Crusade Soldiers and 15 Citizens of New Avalon.
 $BScarlet Crusade Soldier slain (10)

 Scarlet Marksman
 Scarlet Commander
 Scarlet Preacher
 Scarlet Crusader
 Scarlet Lord Jesseriah McCree
 Scarlet Commander Rodrick
$B

 High Inquisitor Valroth
 High Inquisitor Valroth
 Galvar Pureblood
 Marjhan
 [Chapter II] Scarlet Crusader Proxy
$B
$B
 $BCitizen of New Avalon slain (15)

 Citizen of New Avalon
 Citizen of New Avalon
$B

 Citizen of New Avalon Proxy
desc_text: Most humans would have fled the moment a Scourge necropolis took up residence in their air space. Not the Scarlet Crusade!$BI must confess - I rather enjoy our exchanges with the Crusade. Through the years, Scourge battles against them have resulted in several of the most tragic events in human history. Yet here we stand - AGAIN - locked in battle!$BWe shan't deny them the pleasures of eternal servitude to the Lich King! Enter New Avalon and fulfill their death wish. Leave no survivors.

title: How To Win Friends And Influence Enemies
obj_text:
Prince Keleseth at the Crypt of Remembrance has ordered you to discover the truth about the "Crimson Dawn."$BRemove Keleseth's Persuaders from the Ornately Jeweled Box and use them to "persuade" the Scarlet Crusade into talking.
 $B"Crimson Dawn" Revealed
desc_text: In my travels across this world I have made several interesting discoveries. For instance, did you know that with the proper amount of encouragement one can extract all the truths that a man dares hide? As luck would have it, I happen to have some encouragement on hand.$B<Keleseth pulls something out of an ornately jeweled box.>$BThese are my "persuaders." Equip them and take to the field, death knight. Apply the pointy ends to the soldiers of New Avalon. Discover the truth about this "Crimson Dawn."

title: Nowhere To Run And Nowhere To Hide
obj_text:
Prince Keleseth at the Crypt of Remembrance has ordered you to kill Mayor Quimby and recover the New Avalon Registry.
 Mayor Quimby slain
desc_text: Nothing less than total annihilation will suffice, <name>. To that end, a few hundred mindless ghouls assaulting the front gate of New Avalon will not do. We must infiltrate the inner sanctum and dispose of their officials. They must be shown that no one can escape the Scourge's grasp!$BMake your way to the New Avalon Town Hall, southwest of here, and assassinate the mayor. Search the building for the New Avalon registry and bring it to me.

title: Behind Scarlet Lines
obj_text: Report to Orbaz Bloodbane at the Scarlet Tavern in New Avalon.
desc_text: I have sent Orbaz, Thassarian and Koltira behind enemy lines to search for the courier. They have set up a base of operations at the Scarlet Tavern, located at the southern end of New Avalon. The tavern is tucked away behind the two orchards, adjacent to the Chapel of the Crimson Flame. You are to make your way to the tavern and report to Orbaz Bloodbane. He will update you on their situation.

title: The Plaguebringer's Request
obj_text: Noth the Plaguebringer has requested that you bring him 1 Empty Cauldron, 1 Iron Chain and 10 Crusader Skulls.
desc_text: Look at this pumpkin patch! Notice anything missing? Of course you don't, because you're a moron! Your brain was probably the first thing to die.$B<Noth sighs.>$BI have been commanded to put together a plague cauldron. You will help me.$BDirectly inside the gate of New Avalon is the inn. Enter the inn and steal an empty cauldron. Then go to the forge, also near the gate, and steal some iron chains. Bring those back to me along with 10 Crusader skulls. Do I need to tell you where to get those too?

title: The Path Of The Righteous Crusader
obj_text: Orbaz Bloodbane at the Scarlet Tavern in New Avalon has ordered you to steal the New Avalon Patrol Schedule from the Scarlet Hold.
desc_text: We haven't got a damned clue about when or where this courier is supposed to show up. None of these humans had an answer either.$B<Orbaz points to the Scarlet corpses strewn across the floor.>$BI did manage to beat something useful out of the last one. Inside Scarlet Hold they keep a schedule of all patrol routes. I want you to break into the hold and steal the schedule.$BThe hold is the largest building in New Avalon - northeast of here.

title: Brothers In Death
obj_text: Search for Koltira Deathweaver in the Scarlet Hold.
desc_text: reaking through the Scarlet lines was no easy task. We suffered many casualties during the assault and lost one of our best death knights, Koltira Deathweaver. I don't know whether he's dead or alive, but I'll be damned if we don't search for him.$BI last saw him being bound in irons and dragged away to the Scarlet Hold, northeast of here. Tear that keep asunder, death knight. Find Koltira!

title: Death's Challenge
obj_text:
Olrun the Battlecaller has ordered you to win 5 duels against other death knights.$BYou may choose to battle death knight initiates or players.
 Death Knights defeated in a duel (5)
desc_text: orn of the Lich King's victory over Illidan Stormrage in the heart of the frozen wastes, Death's Challenge is a rite of passage that all death knights must undergo.$BSeek out other death knights of Acherus and challenge them to a duel. They must accept and fight until a victor emerges!$BGo now, <name>! Victory for the Scourge! Glory to the Lich King!

title: Bloody Breakout
obj_text: Slay High Inquisitor Valroth and take Valroth's Head to Thassarian at the Scarlet Tavern in New Avalon.
desc_text: The alarms have been sounded. The High Inquisitor and his acolytes will be here soon. I'm too badly injured to be of much use, but I'll do what little I can to help.$BSlay the High Inquisitor and his cronies. Tear off his head and return with it to Thassarian. Vengeance will soothe his savage soul.$BOne more thing, <name>. If you do manage to survive and make it back to Thassarian, tell him that they're executing prisoners at the chapel. Perhaps he'll send you there to play the hero once more.

title: A Special Surprise
obj_text:
Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Malar Bravehorn, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
 Malar Bravehorn slain
desc_text: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, <name>. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty tauren in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

title: A Special Surprise
obj_text:
Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Ellen Stanbridge, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
 Ellen Stanbridge slain
desc_text: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, <name>. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty human in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

title: A Cry For Vengeance!
obj_text: Report to Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame.
desc_text: The cry for vengeance must be heard, <name>. Commander Plaguefist and a company of death knights are on their way to raze the Chapel of the Crimson Flame. If there are any death knights imprisoned at the chapel, Plaguefist will get them out.$BYou can still catch up to them if you hurry. The chapel is due west of here.

title: A Special Surprise
obj_text:
Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Yazmina Oakenthorn, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
 Yazmina Oakenthorn slain

That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. obj_text:

 Iggy Darktusk slain

That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. In particular, there's a real feisty troll in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

title: The Light of Dawn
obj_text:
Defeat the forces of the Argent Dawn and uncover the Light of Dawn.$BReport to Highlord Darion Mograine should you survive.
 The Light of Dawn Uncovered
desc_text: The Argent Dawn stands defiantly against us at Light's Hope Chapel. They dare oppose the Scourge and for that reason alone they must be destroyed!$BThe mighty armies of the Lich King stand at the ready as the final battle for the Plaguelands approaches. Today we ascend into the immortal realm of Scourge heroes!$BWhen you are ready for battle, report to Highlord Darion Mograine. It is the highlord who will issue the final march orders and command our armies at Light's Hope Chapel.

title: A Sort Of Homecoming
obj_text: Return to Thassarian at the Scarlet Tavern in New Avalon with news of your victory.
desc_text: Return to Thassarian at the Scarlet Tavern and let him know that Koltira's cry for vengeance has been answered. The Chapel of the Crimson Flame will be a pile of ashes in a matter of hours.$BYou're one cold-blooded monster, <name>. I salute you, <brother/sister>.

title: The Lich King's Command
obj_text: Report to Scourge Commander Thalanor at Browman Mill.
desc_text: The Scarlet Enclave is no more. What remains of the Crusade will be dealt with in Northrend.$BWe now turn all of our efforts to Light's Hope Chapel. No longer will this affront to your master be allowed to exist!$BI have issued my final command. Scourge Commander Thalanor awaits your arrival at the edge of Browman Mill. Go northwest, through the cave, into the Noxious Glade and take the path leading out of the glade to the mill.$BDo not fail me, <name>.

title: Runeforging: Preparation For Battle
obj_text:
Instructor Razuvious in Ebon Hold has commanded you to use your Runeforging ability to engrave a rune [of your choosing] upon your Runed Soulblade.$BYou may freely replace the engraving upon your weapon at any time, so long as you are near a Runeforge.
 $BWeapon emblazoned
desc_text: The mark of war is etched indelibly upon your soul, death knight. You have learned the dark art of runeforging and with it you will engrave runes of power upon your weaponry.$BPreparations for battle must be made. Return to one of the runeforges, here in the Heart of Acherus, and use the power of runeforging to emblazon your weapon with a rune of power!$BReturn to me when your blade glows with dark energy!

title: The Scarlet Apocalypse
obj_text: Seek out the Lich King at Death's Breach.
desc_text: The trap has been sprung, death knight. The armies of Hearthglen and Tirisfal have arrived, just in time to see their enclave in flames! If they turn back now, they fight us with their backs turned.$B<Mograine shakes his head.>$BNo, they have only one option, which has only one outcome: APOCALYPSE!$BAs we speak, they prepare to make one final stand.$BThe Lich King awaits your return, champion. He stands watch below us, at Death's Breach.

title: Scarlet Armies Approach...
obj_text: Deliver The Path of Redemption to Highlord Darion Mograine at Acherus: The Ebon Hold.
desc_text: We must prepare for the encroaching armies, <name>. You will take what you have discovered to Highlord Mograine at once! I will open a portal directly to Acherus. Step inside and it will transport you.$BGive Highlord Mograine Abbendis' journal as well. Perhaps he'll find it useful.

title: The Scarlet Onslaught Emerges
obj_text: Deliver The Path of Redemption to Orbaz Bloodbane at the Scarlet Tavern in New Avalon.
desc_text: Listen well, courier. The Scarlet lands are lost. New Avalon and Havenshire are overrun by Scourge. The specter of death looms overhead and threatens to overtake us at any moment.$BReturn to Galvar with this message:$B"Turn your armies around and prepare your ships for travel to the frozen wastes. When next we meet it will be in Northrend."$BGive this to Galvar.$B<Abbendis hands you a journal.>$BIt will explain everything.$BThe Scarlet Crusade is no more. Long live the Scarlet Onslaught!

title: An End To All Things...
obj_text:
The Lich King has commanded you to eradicate the Scarlet Crusade.$BUse the Horn of the Frostbrood to call forth a Frostbrood Vanquisher and with it slay 150 Scarlet Soldiers and destroy 10 Scarlet Ballistas. Avoid incoming projectiles by moving out of their line of fire!
 $BScarlet Soldiers slain (150)

 Hearthglen Crusader
 Tirisfal Crusader
$B

 Scarlet Soldier Proxy
$B
$B
 Scarlet Ballista destroyed (10)
desc_text: You have slaughtered legions beyond number and still your dark heart craves more. Your hunger knows no end, <name>.$B<The Lich King pauses.>$BThere must come an end to all things, death knight. The Scarlet armies make their final stand against us. For them, there is no escape... no choice. And for this reason they will fight with a ferocity that you have yet to witness.$BUse this horn to call forth one of my wyrms. Climb upon its back and command it into battle. With it you will end the Scarlet Crusade.

title: The Endless Hunger
obj_text:
Instructor Razuvious in Ebon Hold has commanded you to free an Unworthy Initiate and then kill the Unworthy Initiate in cold blood!$BIt's your life or theirs!
 $BUnworthy Initiate dominated

 Unworthy Initiate
 Unworthy Initiate
 Unworthy Initiate
$B

 Unworthy Initiate
 Unworthy Initiate
desc_text: The endless hunger will soon take hold of you, <class>. When it does, you will feel pain immeasurable. There is only one remedy for the suffering: the hunger must be sated.$BI give you the key to your salvation.$BChained to the Heart of Acherus are those deemed unworthy of the dark brotherhood. Use the key to free an unworthy initiate. Allow them to equip their gear and battle you for their freedom. Kill and the pain will cease. Fail and suffer for eternity.$BLive or die - the choice is yours to make.

title: The Power Of Blood, Frost And Unholy
Report To Scourge Commander Thalanor
obj_text: Report to Scourge Commander Thalanor at the balcony on the first floor of Ebon Hold.
desc_text: Scourge Commander Thalanor awaits your arrival at the overhang located directly southeast of our current position. Report to Thalanor and requisition a Scourge gryphon to deliver you to Death's Breach.$BPrince Valanar will be waiting for you down below.$BSuffer well, <brother/sister>!

title: Taking Back Acherus
obj_text: Use your Death Gate spell to return to Acherus: The Ebon Hold. Report to Highlord Darion Mograine once you arrive.
desc_text: The haze has been lifted. I can see as clearly now as the day that I plunged the Ashbringer into my own heart to free my father's cursed soul: my last memory as a free man.$BWe must take back Acherus from the Scourge if our order is to survive in this new world. I have taught you how to call forth a death gate. The death gate will return you to Acherus when you call upon it, <name>. Use it now and meet me at Acherus. The first battle of the Knights of the Ebon Blade is underway! Death to the Scourge!

title: The Battle For The Ebon Hold
obj_text:
Slay 10 Scourge and help kill Patchwerk. Return to Highlord Darion Mograine should you succeed.
 Patchwerk slain
 $BScourge slain (10)

 Val'kyr Battle-maiden
 Scourge Necromancer
 Terrifying Abomination
 Patchwerk
 Val'kyr Battle-maiden
 Scourge Necromancer
 Terrifying Abomination
$B

 Patchwerk
 Val'kyr Battle-maiden
 Scourge Necromancer
 Terrifying Abomination
 Patchwerk
 Acherus Scourge Proxy
desc_text: The Hall of Command has been secured, but the Lich King has left us a little present in the Heart of Acherus. The stitched terror, Patchwerk, and a horde of abominations have taken over the second floor.$BUse the teleporter to get to the second floor and destroy the Scourge forces that remain. Do not engage Patchwerk alone! You must fight the monstrosity with other death knights of Acherus!$BGo, <name>. You have my strength to carry you!

title: Warchief's Blessing
obj_text: Deliver the letter to Thrall, Warchief of the Horde at Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You are now, and forever will be, a Knight of the Ebon Blade, <name>, but know this: you were once a hero of the Horde.$B<Darion stares at you.>$BThis order must establish allies for itself if it is to survive. You must represent the Knights of the Ebon Blade to the Horde.$BOn the platform, southeast of me, is a portal to Orgrimmar. Take this letter, given to me on your behalf by Lord Fordring, and deliver it to Thrall. Use the portal.

title: Ambush At The Overlook
obj_text: Orbaz Bloodbane at the Scarlet Tavern in New Avalon has ordered you to kill the Scarlet Courier and retrieve the Scarlet Courier's Belongings and the Scarlet Courier's Message.
desc_text: While you were out burning churches and murdering vermin, I've been busy formulating a plan.$BThe Scarlet courier is scheduled to pass by the Scarlet Overlook within the hour. The roads by the overlook are wide open and swarming with Crusaders. Use this makeshift cover to hide at the overlook and wait for the Scarlet Courier to pass. When he's close enough, strike with all your fury! Cut him down and take his belongings - including his clothes!$BThe overlook is 200 paces east of here.

title: The Siege of Shadra'Alor
obj_text:
Defend Shadra's brood until it hatches.
 Shadra's brood defended
 High Priest Dajemba defeated
desc_text: My liberation lies atop the three altars surrounding Shadra'Alor.$BThe most powerful of my brood will soon spawn and feast upon the innards of these crazed heretics.$BHowever, Dajemba has learned of their presence and has sent for reinforcements.$BThe little gnat intends to destroy both me and my entire brood in one fell swoop.$BIf you can hold the Hakkari forces off long enough for my brood to hatch, victory shall be ours.$BWhen you entered Shadra'Alor, I granted you access to its ancient defenses.$BUse the altars' defenses to repel the Hakkari forces. Tactics, strategy and meticulous planning will be key.$BRemember, all three eggs must survive in order for us to triumph.

title: Whispers in the Swamp
obj_text: Find Khazno in Winterspring.
desc_text: You said you found my chalice in the cave? On one of these beasts, no less...$Bor was it?$B... could it have to do with the dagger...?$BHmm, this is certainly a predicament.$B<name>, was it? Well listen, <name>, I think I have been sabotaged, or something to that effect.$BAll I know is that they want my dagger, Whisper. But they cannot have it. It is mine and only mine.$BI must hide it. Quickly, <name>, meet me in the one place they could never find it...$BWinterspring. Lake Kel'Theril to be exact!$BThat is where I originally found it, hehe! Where it laid dormant for so many years...$BFind me there, I will leave momentarily.$BDon't worry, you won't get there before I do.

obj_text:
You have been called to thin the Scourge’s ranks in Plaguewood by destroying its undead horrors.

desc_text: Empirical observation confirms that the dead are not resting. Plaguewood remains saturated with undeath, animated by residual necromantic energy. You will serve as the active agent in this operation.$BRemove them. One at a time is acceptable. Efficiency is preferred.

desc_text: y order of the Argent Crusade:$BThe abomination known as the Construct Surgeon has been sighted within the plague-forged ziggurats near Plaguewood. No remains are to be recovered.$BA reward will be granted to any who bring proof of its unmaking.
