 Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
desc_text: I'm beginning to think you might have potential. Care to prove me right?$BIt seems I'm the only one who paid attention in history class? Every heard of the Sandfury clan? They were responsible for the most bloody chapter in the history of Tanaris, and that's saying something! Kill Chief Ukorz Sandscalp before his clan is strong enough to challenge the goblins.$BThis quest must be turned in before level 59!

desc_text: lasted wyrm… my camp’s near ruined, my men scattered. Charstone Keep swarms with its spawn, and I’ll not last long on my own.$BIf this reaches anyone with steel enough in their gut, find me at what’s left of my camp near the keep. I’ve plans yet, and work enough for those willin’ to risk their hides.

title: Wanted: Zivarstria
obj_text:

 Zivarstria slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Zivarstria… that cursed dragon roosts above Charstone Keep like a tyrant king, daring any to challenge its reign. I was foolish enough to try. The beast’s flames scattered my men, and its minions tore my camp to shreds.$BWe won’t be taking back the keep, not yet. But we can strike a blow, make the dragon bleed, and remind it that mortals aren’t prey to be toyed with.$BGather your strength, find stout allies, and face Zivarstria head-on. Slay the beast, and I’ll see you rewarded for your bravery.

The beast commands a clutch of drakes, each one cruel, cunning, and near as deadly as their master.$BRethysria, Ilvission, Lifarion, and Enocia. Together, they’ve turned the keep into a fortress of fire and fang. As long as they draw breath, there’s no striking at Zivarstria without being torn apart first.$BTake your allies and bring the four down. Cut the wings from the wyrm’s army, and we may yet stand a chance when the time comes to face Zivarstria itself.

title: The Ashen Dawn
obj_text:
Defeat Zivarstria, Dragon of the Ashen Dawn
 Zivarstria slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: My master thinks little of you, and I can see why. Still, I may have some use for you.$BAmongst our kin is an arrogant who fancies herself some sort of god amongst lesser beings. She rules over an outpost of the orcs with an iron claw, devouring those who do not pay her enough tribute.$BWhatever she may be, she certainly lives up to the strength she claims, and those who challenge her end up as charred corpses or fresh meat. Few of our kind hold any favor for her, but her strength at least allows her to be tolerated.$BShe would slaughter you as well as any others who try to challenge her, but if you can rally a few of your kind, you might be able to at least irritate her before she burns you all to a crisp. That alone would be enough for me.

title: Claws of Rage
obj_text:
Defeat the three Claws of Rage in the Burning Steppes
 Afyllian slain
 Ilvission slain
 Enocia slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: While most of our kind may hold little patience for her, there are a few sycophants who see value in her might, and thus seek to curry her favor. These six call themselves the "Claws of Zivarstria". They are fools, but they are not weak.$BThose most skilled in the art of physical combat call themselves the Claws of Rage, Afyllian, Ilvission, and Enocia. They are hardly weak, Zivarstria is a mighty patron to those who give her unquestioning loyalty, but it would bring me some sense of joy to see that loyalty beaten into the charred earth.

desc_text: The order has come down, <class>. Sylvanas herself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.$BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.$B<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>$BTravel to the Undercity at once and report to the Dark Lady. Do not embarrass me, <class>!

title: Treasure Hunt #1
obj_text: Find the second clue.
desc_text: The words written on the orb seem etched into your memory.$B'Travel west to a land of bones,$BThen west again where serpents roam.$BNear secluded isle I do reside,$BAnchored away beneath the tide.'$BYou feel confident that this will lead you to the second clue.

title: Treasure Hunt #1
obj_text: Find the third clue.
desc_text: The words written on the orb seem etched into your memory.$B'I desire so furiously to be found,$BBut my cries fall quiet underground.$BAbove me faintly I hear the thunder roar,$BDrowned out by snarls of demon I abhor.'$BYou feel confident that this will lead you to the third clue.

title: Treasure Hunt #1
obj_text: Find the key and save the prisoner.
desc_text: The words written on the orb seem etched into your memory.$B'Exiled to a land where the dead roam free,$BThere wanders a man who holds the key.$BAmongst the ruins he does reside,$BWithin a shelter he cowers and hides.$BA path of righteousness he will implore you to take,$BBut be wary of the deceit he makes.$BHis blood must flow and the key you must take,$BFor then from my prison will I escape.$BOnce the deed is done and you hold what I need,$BTravel to where winter never recedes.$BTo a place that's hidden and sacred to few,$BAnd unlock the secrets you wish you knew.'$BYou are filled with determination.

title: The Crimson Courier
obj_text: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.
desc_text: We cannot attack the Scarlet Crusade's command directly; they are too well defended. But there's more than one way to skin a cat. They'll be nothing without their main force.$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, <race>! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.

title: Treasure Hunt #1
obj_text: Find the first clue.
desc_text: Hidden behind the shadow of the Firelord;$BUpon an unholy altar I lie dormant.

title: This Entire World Must Be Purged
obj_text: High Inquisitor Fairbanks wants you to "purge" 1000 "Evils" from the face of the world while wielding the Corrupted Ashbringer.
desc_text:
Something something.Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
9,550 experience$B
500 reputation with Argent Dawn

title: There Must Always Be A Ashbringer
obj_text: Scarlet Commander Mograine wants you to talk to High Inquisitor Fairbanks
desc_text:
