9,550 experience$B
500 reputation with Argent Dawn

title: Winterfall Purge
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Winterfall Pathfinders and 6 Winterfall Totemics in Winterspring.
 Winterfall Pathfinder slain (6)
 Winterfall Totemic slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the tranquility of Winterspring is under threat! The Winterfall tribe has been consuming a mysterious firewater, driving them to madness and aggression. Their Pathfinders and Totemics have been causing havoc across these snowy plains, disrupting the balance of nature and threatening the residents of this region. We cannot let this continue. I call upon your strength and courage to put an end to their reckless acts. Thin their numbers and help restore the peace in Winterspring.

title: Treasure Hunt #1
obj_text: Deliver the Soulstone.
desc_text: You have received a Mysterious Note on the corpse of the Avatar of Detheroc. Perhaps it will hold some clues as to what I'm meant to do next.

title: A Reward for a Hero
obj_text: Speak to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
desc_text: You want a reward? Is getting rid of the Broodmother not reward enough?$BWell, we have acquired some trinkets fit for a hero.

title: The Tidebringer
obj_text: High Inquisitor Fairbanks wants you to find and slay Mrgrlgnh the Tidebringer.
desc_text:
Something something.Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
9,550 experience$B
500 reputation with Argent Dawn

title: A Reward for a Hero
obj_text: Speak to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
desc_text: You want a reward? Is getting rid of the Broodmother not reward enough?$BWell, we have acquired some trinkets fit for a hero.

title: Alexandros Mograine
obj_text: Find someone who knew Alexandros Mograine.
desc_text: Something something.

title: Wanted: Collune
obj_text:
Slay Collune
 Collune slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Champion, a grave threat looms in Winterspring. The notorious frost elemental Collune, Tyrant of Frost, has emerged to lay claim to the Frostfire Hotsprings. Already, Collune's icy grip chokes the life from the land, and its powers grow with each passing moment. I need our mightiest hero to travel to the Hotsprings immediately and confront this menace. Slay Collune before its freezing curse spreads further across Winterspring.

title: Reclaimers of Eldarath
obj_text:
Slay Spitelash Naga near the Ruins of Eldarath
 Spitelash Siren slain (6)
 Spitelash Myrmidon slain (6)
 Spitelash Serpent Guard slain (6)
desc_text: The Spitelash naga have come to the Ruins of Eldarath in force, seemingly intent on claiming the artifacts of the Highborne that once inhabited the area. Their numbers are too great to get anywhere near the ruins for ourselves. Cull the Spitelash's numbers and weaken their hold on the ruins, and we might be able to gather some of the artifacts instead of allowing them to fall into the hands of the naga.

title: A Bath In The Holy Light
obj_text: High Inquisitor Fairbanks wants you to bring him 40 Stratholme Holy Water.
desc_text:
Something something.Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
9,550 experience$B
500 reputation with Argent Dawn

title: Breaking Through
obj_text:
Slay Spitelash Naga barring the path to the Ruins of Eldrath
 Spitelash Warrior slain (6)
 Spitelash Screamer slain (6)
desc_text: We're trying to get through to the Ruins of Eldrath to find relics left behind by the Highborne, but the Spitelash Naga block our efforts at every turn. Their Screamers and Warriors have formed a front line that has proven almost impossible to get past so we can reach the ruins. We need you to go through and defeat as many of their Screamers and Warriors as you can find to break their front line so we can push through.

title: A Bath In The Holy Light
obj_text: High Inquisitor Fairbanks wants you to bring him 40 Stratholme Holy Water.
desc_text:
Something something.Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
9,550 experience$B
500 reputation with Argent Dawn

title: Frostfire Sulphur
obj_text:
Gather a reading from the hot spring in Winterspring.
 Winterspring Geyser Reading
desc_text: Hero, the balance between fire and ice has always been a delicate one in Winterspring. The very essence of this region is captured in the rare Frostfire Sulphur. Found only in the hot springs of this icy land, this unique element possesses properties that are vital for many sacred rituals and ancient remedies.$BHowever, recently, this precious resource has been diminishing. We need you to scour the hot spring and get a reading. With your aid, we can ensure the continued traditions and balance of Winterspring.

title: Timbermaw Paws
obj_text: Recover Timbermaw Paws in Winterspring.
desc_text: Hero, a grave injustice has been done. The Winterfall tribe, in their madness and aggression, have slain many of our Timbermaw brethren and taken their paws as trophies of their heinous acts. These paws are not just symbols of our strength and unity, but they also hold spiritual significance to our people. Their loss is a painful reminder of the Winterfall tribe's ruthlessness. We implore you, brave soul, to retrieve these Timbermaw Paws so we may honor our fallen and perform the necessary rites to guide their spirits to rest.

title: Frostsaber Fruition
obj_text:
Slay 6 Frostsaber Cubs, 6 Frostsaber Huntresses, and 5 Frostsaber Stalkers at Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring.
 Frostsaber Cub slain (6)
 Frostsaber Huntress slain (6)
 Frostsaber Stalker slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, there's a growing concern in Winterspring. The Frostsabers, once noble creatures of this frozen land, have grown increasingly aggressive. It's believed that an unknown force is tainting their very essence, causing them to act out against both nature and its inhabitants. To prevent further harm and restore the balance of this region, we must thin their numbers. Journey to the Frostsaber Rock, a known haven of these magnificent creatures, and quell their growing threat before it's too late.

title: Mmurggll Massacre
obj_text:
.
 Arkkoran Clacker slain (8)
 Arkkoran Muckdweller slain (6)
 Arkkoran Oracle slain (6)

title: Recovering Winterfall Totems
obj_text: Collect the Timbermaw Totem of Nourishment, Timbermaw Totem of Might, and Timbermaw Totem of Power in Winterspring.
desc_text: Hero, as the Winterfall tribe's aggression continues to spread throughout Winterspring, we've discovered a link between their newfound power and certain totems they possess. These are not just any ordinary totems, but ancient Timbermaw relics believed to hold significant power. We suspect the Winterfall have been corrupting these totems for their own dark purposes. We need you to recover the Timbermaw Totems of Nourishment, Might, and Power. With these totems in the right hands, we might be able to restore balance and peace to the region.

title: The Winterspring Hunt
obj_text:
Slay 6 Chillwind Ravagers, 6 Elder Shardtooths, and 6 Winterspring Screechers in Winterspring.
 Chillwind Ravager slain (6)
 Elder Shardtooth slain (6)
 Winterspring Screecher slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the very essence of Winterspring is in turmoil. Creatures that once peacefully roamed these snowy plains are now acting with unprecedented aggression. The Chillwind Ravagers, Elder Shardtooths, and Winterspring Screechers are among those posing a significant threat. Their unpredictable behaviors have become a concern not only for the balance of nature but for the safety of all beings in Winterspring. As a guardian of peace and balance, we need you to step in and address this pressing issue. Venture into the wild and reduce their menacing presence.

title: A Link to the Past
obj_text: Collect Tridents and Pendants from the Spitelash Naga
desc_text: We aren't entirely sure what makes the naga so interested in claiming Eldrath, but we suspect there is more than just the power of Highborne artifacts at play. We've spotted engravings on the pendants and weapons carried by the naga which seem to match several of the carvings found at the ruins. We need a closer look to be able to draw any further conclusions though, and the naga are far from willing to part with either. We would ask you to take the weapons and pendants of the naga by force and bring them back here so we can begin to study what their connection to these ruins might be.

title: Wanted: Turekkon
obj_text:
Slay Turekkon
 Turekkon slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, a vile chimera named Turekkon stalks the frigid peaks of Winterspring, preying mercilessly upon the outskirts of Everlook. This savage beast grows more fearsome by the day, and if left unchecked, Turekkon will become an unstoppable scourge upon the land. The goblins of Everlook are willing to offer a small fortune to anyone who would put an end to Turekkon's reign of terror.

title: Purify the Highborne
obj_text:
Slay 6 Suffering Highborne and 6 Anguished Highborne at Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring.
 Suffering Highborne slain (6)
 Anguished Highborne slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the ancient spirits of the Highborne still linger in Winterspring, particularly around the hauntingly serene Lake Kel'Theril. These spirits, once noble and proud, now manifest as tormented echoes of their past - the Suffering and Anguished Highborne. Their restless souls bring sorrow and disturbance to the land. The time has come to grant them peace. Journey to Lake Kel'Theril and release these spirits from their torment, allowing them to finally find the rest they've been denied for millennia.

title: Cobalt Cult
obj_text:
Defeat Cobalt Broodlings, Cobalt Mageweavers, and Cobalt Scalebanes to stem the tide of their dark influence.
 Cobalt Broodling slain (6)
 Cobalt Mageweaver slain (6)
 Cobalt Scalebane slain (6)
desc_text: The Cobalt dragons, once revered and powerful, have now fallen into a dark descent, plaguing the lands and threatening its inhabitants. Hero, the balance must be restored. Face the Cobalt Broodlings, Mageweavers, and Scalebanes to halt their growing malevolence.

title: Winterfall’s End
obj_text:
Eliminate the Winterfall Den Watcher, Winterfall Ursa, and Winterfall Shaman in Winterspring.
 Winterfall Den Watcher slain (6)
 Winterfall Ursa slain (6)
 Winterfall Shaman slain (4)
desc_text: The Winterfall furbolgs, once peaceful inhabitants of Winterspring, have grown increasingly aggressive, threatening the delicate balance of the region. Disturbed rumors suggest a dark influence has taken hold. Hero, it's upon you to confront the Winterfall Den Watchers, Ursa, and Shamans, and bring an end to their tainted reign.

title: Essence of Winterspring
obj_text: Collect Owlbeast Feathers, Frostsaber Teeth, and Chillwind Claws in Winterspring.
desc_text: Hero, the spirit of Winterspring is enshrined in its unique flora and fauna. As the disturbances in the region grow, there is an increasing need to harness the power of the land to restore balance. The Owlbeast Feathers, Frostsaber Teeth, and Chillwind Claws are said to be imbued with the raw essence of Winterspring. These items, when combined, could help us craft a totem potent enough to quell the unrest and bring harmony back to these icy plains. Your expertise and courage are needed to gather these essential components.

title: Wanted: Icewhomp
obj_text: Slay Icewhomp
desc_text: Champion, a savage yeti named Icewhomp lurks in the caves of Ice Thistle Hills, emerging to ambush travelers and spread havoc across the land. Left unchecked, Icewhomp's aggression will only worsen, endangering all who cross Winterspring. I need a legendary hunter to venture into Icewhomp's frigid den and end the yeti's reign of terror once and for all. Slay Icewhomp before the beast's bloodlust claims more innocent lives.

title: Frost Giant Massacre
obj_text:
Slay 6 Frostmaul Giants in Winterspring to halt their destructive advance.
 Frostmaul Preserver slain (6)
desc_text: The mighty Frostmaul Giants, once dormant in the deep icy caverns of Winterspring, have awakened. Their rampages threaten the delicate ecosystem and the inhabitants of the region. Hero, your strength and courage are needed. Face these behemoths and ensure the safety of Winterspring.

title: Night's Talon Takedown
obj_text:
Eliminate 6 Crazed Owlbeasts, 6 Moontouched Owlbeasts, and 2 Berserk Owlbears in Winterspring.
 Crazed Owlbeast slain (6)
 Moontouched Owlbeast slain (6)
 Berserk Owlbeast slain (2)
desc_text: The serene lands of Winterspring have been disrupted by the heightened aggression of its nocturnal inhabitants. Crazed Owlbeasts, Moontouched Owlbeasts, and the fearsome Berserk Owlbears now threaten the balance of the region. Hero, venture into the snowy expanses and quell their rage, ensuring peace returns to the frosty realm.

title: Darkwhisper Scorn
obj_text:
Vanquish 8 Hederine Slayers, 8 Hederine Initiates, and 5 Hederine Manastalkers in Darkwhisper Gorge.
 Hederine Slayer slain (8)
 Hederine Initiate slain (8)
 Hederine Manastalker slain (5)
desc_text: Darkwhisper Gorge echoes with the malevolent energy of the Hederine demons. Their presence is a blight upon Winterspring, their dark magics seeping into the very essence of the land. Hero, these Hederine must be halted before their dark influence engulfs all. Confront the Slayers, Initiates, and the dangerous Manastalkers to push back this looming threat.

title: Culling the Felpaw
obj_text:
Eliminate 6 Deadwood Shamans, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 4 Deadwood Den Watchers in Felwood.
 Deadwood Shaman slain (6)
 Deadwood Avenger slain (6)
 Deadwood Den Watcher slain (4)
desc_text: Felwood, a once-vibrant forest now tainted with demonic corruption. The Deadwood tribe, under this malefic influence, wreak havoc and deepen the woods' corruption. The Deadwood Shamans, Avengers, and their vigilant Den Watchers are the driving force behind this chaos. Hero, your blade and determination are needed to stem the tide of this darkened tribe and bring hope back to Felwood.

title: Timber and Blight
obj_text:
Slay 6 Irontree Stompers and 6 Toxic Horrors.
 Irontree Stomper slain (6)
 Toxic Horror slain (6)
desc_text: The forests of Felwood are under threat. Irontree Stompers, once guardians of the woodland, now trample its very essence, while the Toxic Horrors poison the lifeblood of the region. Hero, the land cries out for aid. Venture forth and confront these menaces, and help restore some of Felwood's natural beauty.

title: Wanted: Akaariel
obj_text:
Slay Akaariel
 Akaariel slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: The demons in Darkwhisper Gorge are led by an ellusive succubus known as Hederine. We've been unable to track down Hederine herself, but Hederine's loyalists are kept in line by an Eredar by the name of Akaariel.$BSome reports suggest that Akaariel is regarded as more than simply a lieutenant by Hederine, and it is hoped that, in addition to defeating a powerful adversary, Akaariel's death may help to lure Lady Hederine out of hiding. Strike quickly, while we still know Akariel's location.

title: Demon Dispersal: Exorcising the Jadefire
obj_text:
Exterminate 6 Jadefire Hellcallers, 6 Jadefire Betrayers, and 6 Jadefire Tricksters in Felwood.
 Jadefire Hellcaller slain (6)
 Jadefire Betrayer slain (6)
 Jadefire Trickster slain (6)
desc_text: The malevolent Jadefire satyrs, remnants of a cursed past, spread their treachery and dark magic throughout Felwood. With their Hellcallers leading dark rituals, Betrayers sowing discord, and Tricksters deceiving the innocent, their reign threatens to plunge the forest into irreversible darkness. Hero, it is upon you to intervene. Exorcise the Jadefire threat and bring respite to the tainted woods.

title: Relics of the Frostlands
obj_text: Collect Cobalt Dragon Scales, Highborne Essences, and Furbolg Furs in Winterspring.
desc_text: Amidst the snowy expanses of Winterspring lie potent relics from beings of old. The Cobalt Dragon Scales shimmer with a power that resonates with the arcane; the Highborne Essences contain whispers of a past long forgotten; and the Furbolg Furs are testament to the strength and endurance of Winterspring's native denizens. Hero, gather these items so that we may understand and protect the delicate balance of this icy realm.

title: Wanted: Zazzuth’ul
obj_text: Slay Zazzuth’ul
desc_text: Hero, dire news from Jadefire Run. A sinister satyr named Zazzuth'ul leads vicious raids across Felwood, leaving only ruin in his wake. If left unchecked, this rogue and his followers will despoil all they touch. I need a legendary champion to venture to Jadefire Run and slay Zazzuth'ul, before the satyr's corruption spreads further across the land.

title: Deadwood Decimation
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Deadwood Warriors, 4 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners in Felwood.
 Deadwood Warrior slain (6)
 Deadwood Pathfinder slain (4)
 Deadwood Gardener slain (6)
desc_text: Deep within Felwood, the Deadwood tribe continues its destructive path, with Warriors leading the charge, Pathfinders navigating their raids, and Gardeners tainting the flora with every touch. These corrupted furbolgs not only pose a threat to the inhabitants but also exacerbate the land's existing corruption. Hero, your might and resolve are called upon once again. Push back the Deadwood onslaught and restore a glimmer of hope to the shadows of Felwood.

title: Feral Frenzy
obj_text:
Neutralize 6 Felpaw Scavengers, 6 Angerclaw Bears, and 6 Angerclaw Maulers in Felwood.
 Felpaw Scavenger slain (6)
 Angerclaw Bear slain (6)
 Angerclaw Mauler slain (6)
desc_text: The wildlife of Felwood, once symbols of nature's harmony, now show signs of a malevolent transformation. Felpaw Scavengers ransack the land, while the mighty Angerclaw Bears and Maulers exert dominance with unparalleled ferocity. This aberrant behavior threatens not just the inhabitants, but the very essence of Felwood. Hero, step forth and quell this frenzied menace to preserve the delicate balance of the forest.

title: Shadows of Jaedenar
obj_text:
Vanquish 7 Jaedenar Guardians, 7 Jaedenar Cultists, and 6 Jaedenar Adepts in the depths of Felwood.
 Jaedenar Guardian slain (7)
 Jaedenar Cultist slain (7)
 Jaedenar Adept slain (6)
desc_text: Deep within Felwood, the malevolent enclave of Jaedenar harbors dark secrets. The Guardians stand vigilant, protecting the Cultists who further the cult's dark aims, while the Adepts hone their forbidden magics. The very heart of Felwood quivers in the wake of their dark rituals. Hero, your valor is needed now more than ever. Delve into Jaedenar and extinguish these shadows that seek to consume all of Felwood.

title: Wanted: Damugg
obj_text:
Slay Damugg
 Fel Lord Damugg slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Champion, dire news from the Shrine of the Deceiver. The vile orc warlock Damugg performs profane rituals, binding demonic minions to his will. Left unchecked, Damugg's power threatens to surge out of control. I need you to infiltrate the Shrine immediately and slay Damugg before his evil spreads.

title: Demon Dispersal: The Jadefire's Reckoning
obj_text:
Eliminate 6 Jadefire Satyrs, 6 Jadefire Felsworn and recover 6 Demon Souls in Felwood.
 Jadefire Satyr slain (6)
 Jadefire Felsworn slain (6)
desc_text: As the dark energies pulsate deeper into Felwood, the Jadefire Satyrs and their Felsworn kin intensify their wicked rituals, ensnaring the very souls of the forest's inhabitants. The trapped Demon Souls serve as a source of their unholy power. Hero, your intervention is critical. Strike down the Satyrs and Felsworn, reclaim the ensnared souls, and restore the essence of Felwood before it's forever consumed.

title: Clambake Calamity
obj_text: Collect Seaweed and Clam Meat in Azshara
desc_text: My friends and I are hosting a celebration at Booty Bay, a rare event where members of both the Alliance and Horde can come together, free of the ties of their factions, at least for a time. Everyone is counting on my famous, well, somewhat famous clam bake. I had planned to start making the dish today, but I discovered all my ingredients were stolen by pirates.$BI use a specific variety of seaweed and clams found only in Azshara, but the celebration is tomorrow, and I don't have time to gather more. I need someone to gather clam meat and seaweed from Azshara, or this whole event will be a calamity.

title: Winterspring Artifacts
obj_text: Collect Frostmaul Fragments, Owlbeast Feathers and Hederine Hearts in Winterspring.
desc_text: In the frostbitten expanse of Winterspring, powerful elements lie hidden, each holding a piece of the region's essence. The Frostmaul Fragments, remnants of the ancient giants, resonate with the land's enduring strength. The Owlbeast Feathers, light as snowflakes yet strong as the fierce winds, speak of the sky's secrets. Lastly, the Hederine Hearts, pulsing with a dark, unknown power, could unlock deeper mysteries. Gather these items, Hero, and help us uncover the true nature of Winterspring's power.

title: Elements of Corruption
obj_text: Collect Deadwood Totems, Irontree Barks, and Jadefire Horns.
desc_text: Felwood, a land tainted by corruption, holds secrets that may aid in its restoration. The Deadwood Furbolgs carry totems imbued with their twisted energies, the Irontree ancients bear unique barks resistant to the land's blight, and the Jadefire Satyrs possess horns brimming with malevolent magic. Hero, gather these items for study, and perhaps we can find a way to reverse the damage done to this once-thriving forest.

title: Purifying the Plagued Gladel
obj_text: Gather Noxious Essences from the creatures in the Noxious Glade.
desc_text: The Noxious Glade, once a sanctuary of natural beauty, now lies tainted with a potent plague that twists and corrupts all life within its bounds. This foul contagion emits from the very essence of the creatures that now dwell there. Hero, take this sacred vial given to you. Collect the Noxious Essences from the plagued inhabitants and use the vial's purifying powers to cleanse the glade, restoring peace and vitality to the land.

title: Plague's Predatory Pests
obj_text:
Eliminate 4 Frenzied Plaguehounds, 6 Carrion Devourers, and 6 Monstrous Plaguebats.
 Frenzied Plaguehound slain (4)
 Carrion Devourer slain (6)
 Monstrous Plaguebat slain (6)
desc_text: The region has witnessed a horrifying mutation amongst its native creatures, turning them into monstrous versions of their former selves. Frenzied Plaguehounds roam the grounds with an insatiable hunger, Carrion Devourers scavenge and spread decay, and the skies darken with the Monstrous Plaguebats that bring terror from above. These pests exacerbate the existing plague and pose an imminent threat. Hero, it falls upon you to cull these creatures and lessen the plague's stranglehold.

title: Silencing the Mossflayers
obj_text:
Dispatch 6 Mossflayer Scouts, 6 Infected Mossflayers, and 6 Mossflayer Shadowhunters.
 Mossflayer Scout slain (6)
 Infected Mossflayer slain (6)
 Mossflayer Shadowhunter slain (6)
desc_text: The Mossflayers, once a tribe of harmony, have succumbed to a dark influence that drives them to aggression and malevolence. Scouts prowl the perimeter, Infected Mossflayers spread the dark affliction, and the Shadowhunters meld darkness with their rituals, casting a shadow over the land. Hero, your prowess is needed. Confront these Mossflayers and quell their uprising to prevent further harm to the region and its inhabitants.

title: Owlerly Purge
obj_text:
Slay 8 Moontouched Owlbeasts and 8 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.
 Moontouched Owlbeast slain (6)
 Berserk Owlbeast slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the pristine silence of Winterspring is being shattered by an unusual menace. The Owlbeasts, particularly the Moontouched and Berserk breeds, are emerging from their hidden lairs, bringing chaos and disruption to the region. Tales of their haunting cries and unbridled aggression have spread like wildfire. These creatures, usually reclusive by nature, now threaten the peace of Winterspring. We need you to confront these feathered fiends and ensure the tranquility of our land is preserved.

title: Scarlet Sweep: Magic and Might
obj_text:
Eliminate 6 Scarlet Warders, 6 Scarlet Enchanters, and 6 Scarlet Clerics.
 Scarlet Warder slain (6)
 Scarlet Enchanter slain (6)
 Scarlet Cleric slain (6)
desc_text: The Scarlet Crusade, once revered paladins and priests, have lost their way, now harboring fanatical ideals that threaten the very lands they claim to protect. Among their ranks, the Scarlet Warders, Enchanters, and Clerics wield significant power and influence, advancing their zealous cause. It falls upon you, Hero, to confront these key figures and curb the Scarlet Crusade's strength. Head into their territory, confront their might and magic, and ensure the safety of the innocents they threaten.

title: Wanted: Zar'nai
obj_text:
Slay Zar’nai
 Zar'nai slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: A powerful lich has seized its hold over the trolls of Zul'Mashar. The lich itself has been deemed far too dangerous even for your abilities, but it has used the corpse of a long-dead warrior called Zar'nai as a weapon to attack our forces in the area.$BWe would like you to destroy Zar'nai at Zul'Mashar. Be warned, our attacks have proven entirely ineffective against Zar'nai. You may need to find a way to break the lich's protections before you can slay Zar'nai.

title: Dismantling the Siege
obj_text:
Vanquish Scourge Siege Engineers and procure Siege Engine Parts.
 Scourge Siege Engineer slain (6)
desc_text: The Scourge, in their relentless pursuit of dominion, have deployed Siege Engineers to fortify their offensive. These engineers are amassing Siege Engine Parts to assemble deadly war machines capable of breaching even the strongest defenses. Hero, time is of the essence. Strike down these engineers and seize the parts they've gathered. Only by dismantling their siege capabilities can we hope to thwart the Scourge's impending onslaught.

title: Flagging Their Faith in Tyr's Hand
obj_text:
Place the challenge flag outside the cathedral in Tyr's Hand and defend it against Scarlet Crusade attackers.
 Heroes Banner Placed
 Defend the Heroes' Banner
desc_text: Tyr's Hand, a bastion of the Scarlet Crusade's fanaticism, stands defiantly, with its cathedral representing their misguided zeal. To challenge their dominion and send a clear message of resistance, we've crafted a flag that embodies the true spirit of the land. Hero, your mission is not just to place this flag outside the cathedral but to defend it against any who would see it torn down. By doing so, we strike at the very heart of their faith and inspire hope in those they oppress.

title: Breaking the Scarlet Elite
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Scarlet Praetorians, 6 Scarlet Curates, and 6 Scarlet Archmages.
 Scarlet Praetorian slain (6)
 Scarlet Curate slain (6)
 Scarlet Archmage slain (6)
desc_text: The strength of the Scarlet Crusade lies not just in their numbers, but in the capabilities of their elite. The Scarlet Praetorians, formidable guardians of their cause; the Scarlet Curates, spiritual guides steeped in zealotry; and the Scarlet Archmages, masters of arcane with fanatical devotion. These figures represent the backbone of their order. Hero, for peace to stand a chance in these troubled lands, these elites must be confronted and their threat neutralized. Venture into the heart of their domain and break the chains of their dominance.

title: Emblem-atic Endeavors
obj_text: Collect Scarlet Emblems from members of the Scarlet Crusade in Tyr's Hand.
desc_text: The Scarlet Crusade, in their unyielding fanaticism, bears emblems representing their order and cause. These symbols, often worn by their members in Tyr's Hand, not only serve as a badge of allegiance but also carry information and plans crucial to their operations. By gathering these emblems, we can decode their strategies and gain the upper hand. Hero, venture into the heart of Tyr's Hand and retrieve these Scarlet Emblems. Their secrets will be our key to dismantling their efforts.

title: Wanted: Zealot Francena
obj_text:
Slay Zealot Francena
 Zealot Francena slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Champion, a grim task awaits in Tyr's Hand. The fanatical paladin Zealot Francena leads bloody crusades from there, rallying the Scarlet Crusade around her. Francena must be stopped, but her faith drives her to zealotry. I am entrusting you with the burden of ending the paladin's reign by any means necessary. Fight your way through Tyr's Hand and slay Zealot Francena.

title: Eradicating the Land and Sea Surge
obj_text:
Slay 6 Plaguebats, 6 Carrion Grubs, and 6 Plaguehound Runts.
 Plaguebat slain (6)
 Carrion Grub slain (6)
 Plaguehound Runt slain (6)
desc_text: The Plaguelands have long been a breeding ground for the Scourge's twisted creations. From the skies, Plaguebats swoop down, spreading disease with every flap of their wings. Carrion Grubs, creatures of decay, corrupt the very soil they slither upon, while the Plaguehound Runts roam, hungry for the flesh of the innocent. These creatures are not just symptoms of the plague but catalysts for its spread. Hero, the time has come to push back against this surge of corruption both on land and from the sea. Eradicate these threats and bring a glimmer of hope back to this blighted region.

title: Silencing Corin's Corruptions
obj_text:
Eliminate 6 Hate Shriekers, 6 Gibbering Ghouls, and 4 Vile Tutors.
 Hate Shrieker slain (6)
 Gibbering Ghoul slain (6)
 Vile Tutor slain (4)
desc_text: Deep in the heart of the Plaguelands, dark experiments under the guidance of the twisted necromancer Corin have led to the creation of monstrous aberrations. The Hate Shriekers, with their terrifying screams, spread despair. The Gibbering Ghouls, once innocent souls, now turned to malevolent entities, haunt the land. The Vile Tutors, masters of forbidden magics, seek to spread the plague further. Hero, these creatures are not only a threat to the living but a mockery of life itself. Journey forth and put an end to Corin's Corruptions. Restore balance to the disturbed lands.

title: Purge the Fungal Vale
obj_text:
Slay the Inhabitants of the Fungal Vale.
 $BSlay Inhabitants of the Fungal Vale (12)

 Dark Adept
 Shadowmage
 Deathspeaker Selendre
 Dark Adept
 Shadowmage
 Deathspeaker Selendre
$B

 Shadowmage
 Dark Adept
 Dark Adept
 Shadowmage
 Deathspeaker Selendre
 Orc Skeleton
desc_text: The land around Corin's Crossing and the Fungal Vale whispers tales of stolen souls and nature's anguish. Corin, with his dark magic, has trapped countless souls, their essence floating aimlessly, awaiting release. Concurrently, the Fungal Vale churns with Fungal Plaguei, a grim reminder of the land's sickness. Hero, it falls upon you to retrieve these stolen souls and gather the Fungal Plaguei. By doing so, we can study them to find a way to heal the Plaguelands and free the spirits entrapped by Corin's wickedness.

title: Wanted: Kasavon the Bleak
obj_text:
Slay Kasavon the Bleak
 Kasavon the Bleak slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the vile necromancer Kasavon the Bleak has surfaced in the Fungal Vale, raising the spirits of the dead to hold the Scourge's control over the area. His dark magic spreads sickness and suffering, while his undead minions attack all who cross their path. I beseech you, brave hero, to hunt down this fiend and end his reign of terror. Venture into the vale and face Kasavon.

title: Quel'Lithien Unrest
obj_text:
Travel to Quel'Lithien Lodge and slay 8 Woodsmen, 8 Rangers, and 4 Pathstriders.
 Woodsman slain (8)
 Ranger slain (8)
 Pathstrider slain (4)
desc_text: Quel'Lithien Lodge, situated in the northern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, was once a beacon of elven civilization. Its denizens, primarily Woodsmen, Rangers, and Pathstriders, lived harmoniously, safeguarding the borders of the elven territories. However, in recent times, a strange animosity has taken root within them. Their aggression towards outsiders threatens the fragile peace we've established in the Plaguelands. Hero, journey to the Quel'Lithien Lodge and quell the aggression of these elves, so that we might uncover the root of their sudden change.

title: Hunger of the Damned
obj_text:
Seek out and slay 6 Stitched Horrors, 6 Cannibal Ghouls, and 4 Cursed Mages in the Eastern Plaguelands.
 Stitched Horror slain (6)
 Cannibal Ghoul slain (6)
 Cursed Mage slain (4)
desc_text: The Plaguelands, once a lush region, is now a land of nightmares and sorrow. Among the countless abominations that roam these cursed grounds are the Stitched Horrors, creations of dark necromancy, the ravenous Cannibal Ghouls, and the Cursed Mages, damned souls that wield twisted magics. Their unending hunger for the living threatens the few sanctuaries we have managed to establish. Hero, we must ensure the safety of these havens. Venture into the heart of the Plaguelands and quell the hunger of these damned creatures.

title: Crypt Crawler's Demise
obj_text:
Venture across the Eastern Plaguelands and slay 6 Crypt Fiends, 6 Crypt Walkers, and 4 Crypt Horrors.
 Crypt Fiend slain (6)
 Crypt Walker slain (6)
 Crypt Horror slain (4)
desc_text: The Eastern Plaguelands are riddled with numerous threats, not the least of which are the vile creatures that emerge from the crypts and mausoleums scattered across the land. The Crypt Fiends, Walkers, and Horrors are abominations that are believed to be the remnants of adventurers and villagers who were unfortunate enough to fall victim to the Scourge's malevolent influence. These creatures now roam the lands, spreading fear and darkness. Hero, the time has come to confront these undead menaces and put an end to their terror.

title: Bones of Contention
obj_text:
Venture into the Western Plaguelands and slay 6 Skeletal Flayers, 6 Slavering Ghouls, and 4 Skeletal Sorcerers.
 Skeletal Flayer slain (6)
 Slavering Ghoul slain (6)
 Skeletal Sorcerer slain (4)
desc_text: The skeletal remains of the fallen now roam the Western Plaguelands, cursed to an eternity of servitude under the malevolent grip of the Scourge. These abominations – the Skeletal Flayers, Slavering Ghouls, and Skeletal Sorcerers – serve as a constant reminder of the tragedy that befell this land and the souls who were robbed of their eternal rest. We must put them to rest once more. Hero, your prowess is needed. Traverse the plagued land and lay these restless spirits to rest, ensuring they do not rise to torment the living.

title: Echoes of Stolen Fate
obj_text: Gather Corin's Stolen Souls and collect Fungal Spores from the Fungal Vale and Corin's Crossing.
desc_text: The land around Corin's Crossing and the Fungal Vale whispers tales of stolen souls and nature's anguish. Corin, with his dark magic, has trapped countless souls, their essence floating aimlessly, awaiting release. Concurrently, the Fungal Vale churns with Fungal Plaguei, a grim reminder of the land's sickness. Hero, it falls upon you to retrieve these stolen souls and gather the Fungal Plaguei. By doing so, we can study them to find a way to heal the Plaguelands and free the spirits entrapped by Corin's wickedness.

title: Andorhal Exorcism
obj_text:
Travel to the Ruins of Andorhal and you will find Araj the Summoner performing dark rituals to raise more undead armies for the Scourge.
 Araj the Summoner slain
 Skeletal Warlord slain (2)
desc_text: The once-proud buildings of Andorhal lie in ruins, overrun by the sinister forces of the Scourge. Make your way through the ghost town to the crumbling remains of the church at its heart. As you climb over piles of debris and bones, an ominous chanting reaches your ears. Among the ruins, you spy the lich Araj the Summoner, wreathed in glowing dark magic.$BSurrounding him are skeletal guards and abominations, swaying in time with his evil incantations. Dark portals swirl overhead as Araj calls more souls from beyond to bolster the Scourge legions.$BYou must disrupt the ritual before the church becomes a flooded with undead warriors. Attack Araj and his vile summoning ceremony with all haste! The longer his spell continues, the more Scourge filth will enter this world!

title: Restless Unrest
obj_text:
Venture into the Ruins of Andorhal and slay 8 Soulless Ghouls, 8 Skeletal Executioners, and 6 Skeletal Acolytes.
 Soulless Ghoul slain (8)
 Skeletal Executioner slain (8)
 Skeletal Acolyte slain (6)
desc_text: The Ruins of Andorhal are a cursed place, the very ground tainted by the Scourge's presence. Among the shattered remnants of this once great city, restless undead continue to wreak havoc, preventing any hope of restoration or recovery. Soulless Ghouls, Skeletal Executioners, and Skeletal Acolytes are the primary culprits behind the ongoing devastation. Hero, we need you to face these malevolent beings and put an end to their reign of terror. Only then can we hope to reclaim Andorhal and bring peace to its tormented spirits.

title: Echoes of Despair
obj_text:
Slay 6 Wailing Deaths, 6 Hungering Wraiths, and 6 Haunting Visions in the Western Plaguelands.
 Wailing Death slain (6)
 Hungering Wraith slain (6)
 Haunting Vision slain (6)
desc_text: The Western Plaguelands have become a breeding ground for the restless spirits of those who perished during the great wars. Haunting Visions, Wailing Deaths, and Hungering Wraiths wander the land, their mournful cries a testament to the anguish they suffered in life and the torment they now endure in death. Hero, these spirits deserve peace, but as long as they are bound by the dark magic of the Plaguelands, they'll continue to sow misery and despair. Venture forth and put an end to these tormented souls, granting them the release they've been denied for so long.

title: Wanted: Akorzal the Cold
obj_text:
Slay Akorzal the Cold
 Akorzal the Cold slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the necromancer Akorzal the Cold has emerged in the Ruins of Andorhal, raising legions of undead. His freezing magics bring only death and sorrow, empowering the Scourge. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this monster and end his reign of terror.

title: Undying Threats
obj_text:
Slay 6 Rotting Cadavers, 6 Blighted Zombies, and 6 Skeletal Terrors in the Western Plaguelands.$B
 Rotting Cadaver slain (6)
 Blighted Zombie slain (6)
 Skeletal Terror slain (6)
desc_text: The lands of the Western Plaguelands, tainted by the Lich King's malevolence, have become home to the nightmarish undead that continue to haunt its every corner. The Rotting Cadavers, Blighted Zombies, and Skeletal Terrors are the undead remnants of soldiers and citizens who once lived in these lands. These poor souls, now turned abominations, wander in constant torment and pose an imminent threat to any living being that crosses their path. Hero, your duty is clear. Venture into the heart of this damned land and vanquish these creatures. It is the only way to restore some semblance of peace and ensure the safety of those who dare tread here.

title: Fragments of the Fallen
obj_text: Recover Bone Fragments from the undead in the Ruins of Andorhal.
desc_text: The Ruins of Andorhal are not just a testament to the Scourge's might, but also a burial ground for countless souls who once called this place home. These Bone Fragments, scattered amidst the ruins, are remnants of the fallen, tokens of lives lost to the Scourge's wrath. Collecting these fragments will not only help us in understanding the magnitude of the destruction, but also serve as a gesture of respect and remembrance. Hero, we beseech you to recover these fragments so that we may honor the fallen and, in doing so, cleanse Andorhal of its haunting past.

title: Unearthly Treasures
obj_text: Gather Elvish Trinkets, Crypt Cloths, and Plagued Plasmas from the undead of the Eastern Plaguelands.
desc_text: In the wake of the Scourge's devastation, many of the land's treasures and artifacts were lost, now lying in the grasp of the vile creatures that roam the Plaguelands. The Elvish Trinkets are remnants of a once-great civilization, Crypt Cloths bear inscriptions that could be key to understanding the undead, and the Plagued Plasma holds potent energies that our scholars are keen to study. Hero, as you confront the abominations of this land, keep an eye out for these items. Their retrieval could be essential in understanding and combating the dark powers that linger here.

title: Wanted: Kethrevon the Dark
obj_text:
Slay Kethrevon the Dark
 Kethrevon the Dark slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the vile necromancer Kethrevon the Dark has surfaced at the cursed village called Gahrron's Withering. His foul magics raise legions of shadows, plaguing the land and attacking all living things. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this villain and end his evil before it spreads. Venture to Gahrron's Withering, withstand his dark powers, and slay him so his reign of darkness ceases.

title: Timber and Tactics: Scarlet Onslaught
obj_text:
Slay 6 Scarlet Lumberjacks and 6 Scarlet Knights in the Western Plaguelands.
 Scarlet Lumberjack slain (6)
 Scarlet Knight slain (6)
desc_text: The Scarlet Crusade continues to be a thorn in the side of all who seek peace in the Western Plaguelands. Particularly, their Lumberjacks and Knights have established a dominating presence, relentlessly cutting down the sacred woods and enforcing their misguided beliefs upon any they encounter. Reports have come in that these individuals carry with them special Scarlet Tokens, symbols of their rank and commitment to their cause. Hero, your mission is twofold: to thin the numbers of these persistent foes and to retrieve these tokens as proof of their diminishing strength. Only with their influence curtailed can we hope for a semblance of peace in this tortured land.

title: Scarlet Skirmish and Tower Topple
obj_text:
Defeat Scarlet Avengers, Scarlet Mages and Scarlet Spellbinders.
 Scarlet Avenger slain (4)
 Scarlet Mage slain (4)
 Scarlet Spellbinder slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the once sacred lands of the Plaguelands are now teeming with the malevolent members of the Scarlet Crusade. These zealots blindly follow a cause of eradication, showing no mercy to any they deem tainted. Their sorcerers, in particular, draw power from dark sources and threaten to bolster their forces with their arcane might. While we weaken their numbers, there's a strategic tower in the area that they've claimed as a lookout point. We need to ensure it is wrested from their control. Place our flag atop this tower as a declaration that their reign here is coming to an end.

title: Chill and Decay
obj_text: Gather Skeleton Souls in the Western Plaguelands.
desc_text: The restless spirits of the Western Plaguelands wander aimlessly, trapped in a state of anguish and torment. Bound to their skeletal forms, they are denied the peace of the afterlife. As the darkness continues to pervade these lands, the trapped souls of the fallen soldiers grow more restless. It is our duty, Hero, to grant them the respite they so desperately seek. Using this ethereal net, gather the souls of the lost and bring them to me. By doing so, you not only free them from their ceaseless suffering but also strike a blow against the forces that seek to keep this land in eternal darkness.

title: Dismantling the Scarlet Force
obj_text:
Eliminate Scarlet Workers, Scarlet Paladins, and Scarlet Sentinels in Hearthglen.
 Scarlet Worker Slain (6)
 Scarlet Paladin slain (6)
 Scarlet Sentinel slain (6)
desc_text: Hearthglen, once a beacon of hope and prosperity, now stands as a stronghold for the Scarlet Crusade's misguided zealotry. This former city of nobility has been tainted with their fervent and brutal vision for a new world. The workers fortify their defenses daily, while paladins patrol its streets, ensuring none oppose their reign. The sentinels stand guard, watching and waiting for any sign of resistance. Hero, it is time to weaken their grip on Hearthglen and send a clear message: their tyranny will not stand.

title: Wanted: Zealot Anselm
obj_text:
Slay Zealot Anselm
 $BZealot Anselm slain

 Zealot Anselm
 Zealot Anselm
$B

 Zealot Anselm
$B
$B
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the fanatical paladin Zealot Anselm leads the Scarlet Crusade's murderous efforts from Hearthglen. His righteous fury leaves only death and destruction, as he orders the elimination of all non-believers. I beseech you, champion, to infiltrate Hearthglen and end Anselm's cruel zealotry.

title: Tarring Them Down
obj_text:
Eliminate the Tar Lurkers, Tar Lords, Tar Creepers, and Tar Beasts emerging from the Lakkari Tar Pits.
 Tar Lurker slain (5)
 Tar Lord slain (5)
 Tar Creeper slain (5)
 Tar Beast slain (5)
desc_text: The Lakkari Tar Pits have always been a mysterious part of Un'Goro Crater. Recently, the pits have become more active than usual, churning out bizarre tar creatures that are encroaching upon the surrounding territories. These creatures, formed from the very essence of the pits themselves, threaten the fragile ecosystems nearby. As a hero in this ancient land, your duty is clear: you must venture to the Lakkari Tar Pits and suppress the emerging threat. Put a stop to these tar monstrosities and ensure the safety of Un'Goro's inhabitants.

title: Hearthglen Harvest
obj_text: Collect Scarlet Skulls from the fallen members of the Scarlet Crusade in Hearthglen.
desc_text: Hearthglen, once a beacon of hope in these Plaguelands, is now corrupted by the zealous Scarlet Crusade. These misguided souls, in their twisted mission, have claimed many lives. The tide must be turned against them, and a message sent that their reign of terror ends now. As you engage them, Hero, collect the skulls of the Scarlet zealots. Let it be a testament to their fate and a warning for any who dare follow in their path.

title: Gorilla Warfare
obj_text:
Thin out the Gorilla population at Fungal Rock by slaying Un’Goro Thunderers, Un’Goro Gorillas, and Un’Goro Stompers.
 Un'Goro Thunderer slain (6)
 Un'Goro Gorilla slain (6)
 Un'Goro Stomper slain (6)
desc_text: The Gorillas at Fungal Rock have grown increasingly aggressive, posing a threat to explorers and researchers seeking to understand the mysteries of Un'Goro Crater. Their sudden belligerence not only jeopardizes our operations but has also disturbed the delicate balance of this prehistoric land. Hero, venture to Fungal Rock and reduce their numbers. We must ensure safety for those venturing into the Crater and restore equilibrium to this sacred place.

title: Thorny Predicament
obj_text:
Cull the aggressive Bloodpetal population in Un'Goro Crater by eliminating Bloodpetal Threshers, Bloodpetal Lashers, and Bloodpetal Trappers.
 Bloodpetal Thresher slain (5)
 Bloodpetal Lasher slain (5)
 Bloodpetal Trapper slain (5)
desc_text: The flora of Un'Goro Crater has always been as wondrous as it is perilous. Recently, the Bloodpetal plant creatures have become more aggressive, encroaching upon the pathways and terrorizing travelers. These once passive creatures are now attacking on sight, making any journey through Un'Goro treacherous. We can't let them overrun the Crater. Hero, it falls to you to venture into the heart of their territory and thin their numbers.

title: Wanted: Unstable Power Crystal
obj_text:
Destroy the Unstable Power Crystal
 Unstable Power Crystal slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Most of the power crystals in Un'Goro are harmless, providing only a power source for the nearby pylons. One of them, however, seems to have absorbed far more energy than it should, and its power has been lashing out around it, disintegrating anyone who comes near. This crystal seems to be growing in power, and we fear it could destroy the nearby area if left unchecked. We need someone with the strength to endure its power to destroy it before it reaches that point.

title: Ravaging the Ravasaurs
obj_text:
Cull the Ravasaur threat in Un'Goro Crater by taking down Venomhide Ravasaurs and Ravasaur Hunters.
 Venomhide Ravasaur slain (6)
 Ravasaur Hunter slain (6)
desc_text: Deep within the overgrown jungles of Un'Goro Crater, the Ravasaurs dominate with their fierce presence. The Venomhide Ravasaurs, with their deadly poison, and the cunning Ravasaur Hunters, pose an enormous threat to the adventurers and researchers trying to uncover the mysteries of the land. With reports of attacks increasing, it's clear that they're growing bolder with each passing day. Hero, we must act before their numbers grow too strong, and they push out of their usual territory.

title: Extinguishing Un'Goro's Flames
obj_text:
Combat the fire elemental threat in Un'Goro by defeating Scorching Elementals and Living Blazes.
 Scorching Elemental slain (6)
 Living Blaze slain (6)
desc_text: Un'Goro Crater, while renowned for its lush greenery and exotic creatures, also possesses the intense heat of fire elementals that roam the land. As of late, the Scorching Elementals and Living Blazes have been wreaking havoc, setting the land aflame and endangering its inhabitants. This cannot continue. Hero, we need your expertise. Venture into the fiery territories and quell these fiery foes. Let's ensure Un'Goro remains a paradise of nature, not a burning inferno.

title: Apex Predators
obj_text:
Reduce the population of the dominant predators in Un'Goro: Diemetradons, Ravasaurs, and Ravasaur Runners.
 Ravasaur slain (6)
 Ravasaur Runner slain (6)
desc_text: In the heart of Un'Goro Crater, a balance of nature has always been maintained. However, recently, certain predators have been growing in numbers and disrupting this delicate equilibrium. The Diemetradons, Ravasaurs, and their swift counterparts, the Ravasaur Runners, are now posing a considerable threat to other creatures and even travellers like you. As a defender of the balance, Hero, we need your skills. Thin their numbers so that peace can be restored to Un'Goro.

title: Wanted: Inceratas
obj_text:
Slay Inceratas
 Inceratas slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the monstrous fire elemental Inceratas haunts Fire Plume Ridge, spewing flames that scar the land. Its searing magics incinerate all life, while lesser elementals swarm at its command. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this infernal tyrant. Journey to the ridge, withstand Inceratas' fiery rage, and slay it before its blazing onslaught consumes Un'Goro.

title: Un'Goro Mix and Match
obj_text: Collect Tar, Bloodpetal Leaves, and Gorilla Hides from around Un'Goro Crater.
desc_text: Un'Goro Crater is a land of vibrant life, unique energies, and countless mysteries. Some of the indigenous residents and explorers alike have spoken of the synergy between certain materials native to this land. They believe that the tar from Lakkari Tar Pits, leaves of the aggressive Bloodpetal plant, and the tough hide of Un'Goro gorillas can be combined for mysterious, perhaps even powerful purposes. We need a brave soul to gather these materials for further study. Step forth, Hero, and collect these items so we can unravel another of Un'Goro's enigmas.

title: Gorishi Hive Havoc
obj_text:
Slay Gorishi Reavers, Workers, and Wasps to curb the insect threat in Un'Goro.
 Gorishi Reaver slain (6)
 Gorishi Worker slain (6)
 Gorishi Wasp slain (6)
desc_text: Deep within the bowels of Un'Goro Crater, the Gorishi insects have formed a vast, sprawling hive, with each caste of insect playing its unique role in their society. However, recently, their aggressive behavior has increased, endangering nearby habitats and travelers alike. Hero, we need you to venture into the Gorishi hive and cull their numbers. By targeting the Reavers, Workers, and Wasps, we hope to bring a temporary halt to their aggressive expansion.

title: Sky Terror and Ancient Predators
obj_text:
Subdue the Frenzied Pterrordaxes in the skies and confront the Elder Diemetradons on the ground.
 Frenzied Pterrordax slain (6)
 Elder Diemetradon slain (5)
desc_text: The harmonious balance of Un'Goro Crater is under threat once again, Hero. Soaring above, the Frenzied Pterrordaxes are creating havoc, targeting smaller creatures and striking fear into the hearts of many. On the ground, the Elder Diemetradons, remnants of a prehistoric age, are asserting their dominance over smaller creatures and challenging the natural order. We ask you to step in and restore balance by dealing with these formidable foes.

title: Slimed and Primed for Battle
obj_text:
Slay 6 Devouring Oozes, 6 Rotting Behemoths, and 6 Vile Slimes in The Weeping Cave of the Western Plaguelands.
 Devouring Ooze slain (6)
 Rotting Behemoth slain (6)
 Vile Slime slain (6)
desc_text: The Weeping Cave, once a place of quiet reflection and natural beauty, now emanates an aura of despair and decay. This transformation is the work of the oozes and slimes that have overrun it, products of the plague that still lingers in the Western Plaguelands. Among them, the Devouring Ooze, Rotting Behemoth, and Vile Slime are the most potent, leaving trails of corruption in their wake and jeopardizing the fragile balance that we seek to restore. Hero, you are tasked with entering the cave and ridding it of these loathsome entities. Purge the cave and allow nature's healing touch to begin its work once more.

title: Essence of Un'Goro: Claws, Cores, and Hearts
obj_text: Collect Ravasaur Claws, Fire Cores from the elementals, and Ravasaur Hearts for the ritual.
desc_text: With these essential components, we are one step closer to understanding the intricate balance of life in Un'Goro. Your efforts have ensured that the ritual can proceed, and for that, we are deeply grateful. By understanding and honoring the strengths of these creatures, we aim to protect and preserve the wonder that is the Un'Goro Crater. Your name will be sung in the ancient chants, Hero.

title: Wanted: King Vashak
obj_text:
Slay King Vashak
 King Vashak slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the colossal devilsaur known as King Vashak dominates Un'Goro Crater through brute strength alone. This terrifying beast batters all who cross its path, while lesser devilsaurs obey its savage commands. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this menace.

title: Not So Ogre-whelming
obj_text:
Enter Dreadmaul Rock in the Burning Steppes and slay Firegut Ogres, Firegut Brutes, and Firegut Ogre Mages.
 Firegut Brute slain (6)
 Firegut Ogre Mage slain (6)
 Firegut Ogre slain (6)
desc_text: Dreadmaul Rock, a towering bastion within the Burning Steppes, has long been the refuge of the Firegut Ogres. This horde of brutes, consisting of the powerful Firegut Ogres, their even stronger Brute brethren, and the shadowy Ogre Mages, have asserted dominion over the rock and pose a growing threat to nearby settlements and unsuspecting travelers. Their increasing affinity for dark magics and mounting strength cannot be overlooked. Hero, it's imperative we tackle this situation head-on. Delve deep into Dreadmaul Rock and thin their numbers. We must act swiftly, ensuring they do not cement their stronghold further.

title: Steaming Up in Un'Goro
obj_text:
Collect a reading from Un'Goro's hot springs.
 Un'Goro Hot Spring Reading
desc_text: Un'Goro Crater's renowned hot springs are truly a natural wonder of Azeroth. The heated waters harbor potent elemental energies from deep within the earth. Usually dormant, lately these forces have stirred, causing the springs to seethe and roil.$BAdventurer, I have an important task for you. Journey to the springs and take readings of their current elemental activity. This disturbance in the natural balance concerns me. The springs must be calmed before the upwelling of elemental power triggers something drastic.$BUse this Thermal Anomaly Detector to monitor the temperature, gas composition, and arcane fluctuations around at the spring.

title: Shadows of Thaurissan's Legacy
obj_text:
Engage and eliminate the War Reavers, Thaurissan Spies, and Thaurissan Firewalkers around the ruins of Thaurissan.
 War Reaver slain (5)
 Thaurissan Spy slain (6)
 Thaurissan Firewalker slain (5)
desc_text: The ruins of Thaurissan are not just remnants of the once-great dwarven empire; they are also a hive of activity for Dark Iron Dwarves loyal to the nefarious Thaurissan lineage. These dwarves, along with their monstrous constructs, pose a grave threat to our operations in the Burning Steppes. The War Reavers are particularly concerning, as their strength is unmatched by any of our foot soldiers. To ensure our foothold remains strong, we need you to strike them down and sow chaos among the Thaurissan ranks.

title: Draggin' Down the Dragonkin
obj_text:
Slay Black Wyrmkin, Black Broodlings, and Black Dragonspawn in the Burning Steppes.
 Black Wyrmkin slain (6)
 Black Dragonspawn slain (6)
 Black Broodling slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, a disturbing development is afoot. The Black Dragonflight has fortified its presence within the Burning Steppes. Reports suggest Black Wyrmkin, Broodlings, and Dragonspawn swarming the region in large numbers, and their intentions are never pure. Historically, where these dragonkin convene, the Black Dragonflight is scheming something dire. We must cut the head from the snake before their plans reach fruition. Engage these dragonkin and cull their numbers; we cannot afford the Black Dragonflight gaining a foothold in these parts.

title: Repelling the Blackrock Onslaught
obj_text:
Defeat Blackrock Sorcerers, Blackrock Slayers, and Blackrock Battlemasters in the Burning Steppes.
 Blackrock Sorcerer slain (6)
 Blackrock Slayer slain (6)
 Blackrock Battlemaster slain (4)
desc_text: In the smoldering heart of the Burning Steppes, the Blackrock clan exerts a shadow of fear and domination. With sorcerers weaving nefarious magics, slayers patrolling vital paths, and battlemasters orchestrating their forces, the clan's grip tightens by the day. The land cries out for a hero to disrupt this iron hold. Your prowess in combat and strategy is crucial to push back these forces, maintain the region's balance, and ensure the Steppes do not fall completely into darkness.

title: Taming the Flamescale Threat
obj_text:
Defeat Flamescale Dragonspawn and Flamescale Wyrmkin in the Burning Steppes.
 Flamescale Dragonspawn slain (6)
 Flamescale Wyrmkin slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the Burning Steppes is already scorched and barren, but the Flamescale brood seeks to add a new level of devastation. These malevolent dragonkin worship the relentless sun, drawing power from its blistering rays. The Flamescale Dragonspawn and Wyrmkin threaten to intensify the inferno that already blights this land. It's crucial to suppress their efforts and keep the balance. Will you rise to the challenge and put an end to their solar-fueled frenzy?

title: Wanted: Vel’kash
obj_text: Slay Vel’kash
desc_text: Hero, the ogre chieftain Vel'kash rules over the Firegut ogres of Dreadmaul Rock with an iron fist. His savagery is unmatched, as he brutally crushes all challengers to his reign. I beseech you, brave champion, to infiltrate Dreadmaul Rock and end Vel'kash's tyranny. Seek him out, withstand and slay the chieftain so his brutality spreads no further.

title: Wanted: Drahga Shadowburner
obj_text:
Slay Drahga Shadowburner
 Drahga Shadowburner slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: A Twilight Hammer emissary has been spotted in the Burning Steppes, overseeing Blackrock forces in the Ruins of Thaurassian. The emissary, Drahga Shadowburner, is a powerful sorcerer of the Twilight Hammer. He is a dangerous opponent, but this may be our only opportunity to defeat Drahga and weaken the Twilight Hammer.

title: Primal Offerings of Un'Goro
obj_text: Collect Gorishi Husks, Dinosaur Bones, and Stegadon Hides from the creatures of Un'Goro Crater.
desc_text: In the heart of Un'Goro Crater, the flora and fauna vibrate with raw, primordial energy. To truly understand the essence of this place, one must gather tangible symbols of its life. From the tough husk of the Gorishi insects to the sturdy bones of the Pterrodax, and the thick hide of the living Stegadons, collecting these will give insight into the life force that drives Un'Goro. Can you bring me these tokens, Hero?

title: Stronghold Showdown
obj_text:
Defend the flag planted at Blackrock Stronghold in the Burning Steppes.
 $BDefend the Heroes Banner
 Heroes Banner Placed
desc_text: Hero, the Blackrock Stronghold stands as a monument to the fierce Blackrock clan, a group that has long plagued the lands of the Burning Steppes with their ruthless tactics and ambition for power. The time has come to challenge their dominance and plant a symbol of defiance right in their stronghold.$BYour task is to infiltrate the Blackrock Stronghold, plant our flag, and defend it from any who seek to tear it down. It's a bold move, and one that will surely be remembered as a sign that we are not to be trifled with. Stand strong, and ensure our banner flies high above their fortress!

title: Burnished Collectibles
obj_text: Collect Ogre Skulls, Dragonkin Scales, and Dwarven Pocket Watches.
desc_text: The Burning Steppes are a land rich with remnants from past battles. While most consider them mere souvenirs, our researchers believe these artifacts tell the stories of the land, of the clashes between ogres, dragonkin, and the Dark Iron dwarves. Retrieve these items so we can piece together a clearer history of this treacherous land.

title: Disciples of Arkkoroc
obj_text:
Slay 6 Arkoran Clackers, 6 Arkoran Muckdwellers, and 6 Arkoran Oracles in the submerged regions of Azshara.
 Arkkoran Clacker slain (6)
 Arkkoran Muckdweller slain (6)
 Arkkoran Oracle slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, deep beneath the azure waters of Azshara, followers of the mighty Arkkoroc have begun to amass. These disciples, known as the Arkoran, were once dormant, but recent disturbances in the arcane leylines have reawakened their fealty to the ancient sea giant. Their growing presence and allegiance pose a significant threat to the balance of power within Azshara. Your strength and expertise are required to confront and quell these devout followers before they can fully execute their master's will.

title: Shadows of the Legashi
obj_text:
Slay 6 Legashi Satyrs, 6 Legashi Hellcallers, and 6 Legashi Rogues in the forested areas of Azshara.
 Legashi Satyr slain (6)
 Legashi Hellcaller slain (6)
 Legashi Rogue slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the forests of Azshara are echoing with malevolent whispers. The Legashi, a faction of treacherous satyrs, are growing in numbers and audacity. Known for their dark rituals and allegiance to the Burning Legion, their presence here might be a harbinger of greater evils yet to come. We cannot allow their influence to spread unchecked. It falls to you to push back these shadows and restore peace to the woods of Azshara.

title: Of Lava, Life, and Legacy
obj_text: Retrieve Blackrock Banners, Dragonkin Eggs, and Lava Essence from around the Burning Steppes.
desc_text: The Burning Steppes is a land rife with conflict, Hero. Among its molten hills and smoke-choked skies, the Blackrock clan flaunt their dominance by displaying their banners at every corner. But their arrogance doesn't end there; they've been stealing dragonkin eggs, hoping to harness their power. Furthermore, the fiery essence of this land, the very Lava Essence, is being hoarded for nefarious purposes. You must retrieve these stolen items and thwart their plans. For every banner you tear down, every egg you recover, and every essence you collect, their grip on this land weakens.

title: Elven Intrusion
obj_text:
Slay 6 Blood Elf Surveyors and 6 Blood Elf Reclaimers in Azshara.
 Blood Elf Surveyor slain (6)
 Blood Elf Reclaimer slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, a new threat has set foot in Azshara. Blood Elf Surveyors and Reclaimers have been spotted trying to extract arcane energy and ancient relics from the land. Their meddling with Azshara's treasures not only disrupts the balance but risks awakening dormant dangers. We cannot stand by as they pillage and drain the magical essence of this place. Venture forth and halt their advances, ensuring the arcane sanctity of Azshara remains intact.

title: Wanted: Arkkalash
obj_text:
Slay Arkkalash
 Arkkalash slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Legends say that long ago, Arkkoran ruled the seas alongside his brother, Arkkalash, but Arkkalash was lured by dark whispers from the depths of the sea, and tried to slay his brother. For his actions he was banished to the depths of the sea.$BIt is impossible to confirm these legends, but a sea giant claiming to be Arkkalash has appeared around the Temple of Arkkoran, trying to sway Arkkoran's disciples against their god.

title: Taming the Spitelash
obj_text:
Slay 6 Spitelash Battlemasters and 6 Spitelash Enchantresses in the coastal regions of Azshara.
 Spitelash Battlemaster slain (6)
 Spitelash Enchantress slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, troubling waves ripple across the shores of Azshara, carrying whispers of the Spitelash Naga's aggressive movements. The Spitelash Battlemasters and Enchantresses have been rallying their forces, seemingly preparing for a significant push inland. We must not allow them to gain a stronger foothold in Azshara. Dive into the depths and confront these serpentine foes, ensuring the shores remain free from their grasp.

title: Arcane Interference
obj_text:
Slay 6 Draconic Mageweavers and 6 Blue Dragonspawn in Azshara.
 Draconic Mageweaver slain (6)
 Blue Scalebane slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the arcane-rich lands of Azshara are drawing unwanted attention. The Draconic Mageweavers and Blue Dragonspawn, members of the once-noble Blue Dragonflight, have begun to converge and tap into the land's latent energies. Their meddling threatens to disrupt the fragile balance of arcane magic in Azshara. Their intentions remain veiled, but it's crucial to confront them and ensure the arcane sanctity of the region remains undisturbed.

title: Echoes from the Cliffs
obj_text:
Slay 4 Cliff Breakers, 4 Cliff Walkers, and 4 Cliff Thunderers in the cliff regions of Azshara.
 Cliff Breaker slain (4)
 Cliff Walker slain (4)
 Cliff Thunderer slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the towering cliffs of Azshara reverberate with the stomping of the formidable giants known as the Cliff Breakers, Cliff Walkers, and Cliff Thunderers. These behemoths, while typically solitary, have become increasingly aggressive, threatening the safety of those traversing the region. Their sudden coordinated behavior is alarming and demands immediate intervention. Venture to the cliffs and confront these titanic threats, ensuring safe passage for all through Azshara.

title: Threatening Beauty
obj_text:
Slay Mosshoof Coursers and recover Mosshoof Hides in Azshara.
 Mosshoof Courser slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the Mosshoof Coursers, majestic as they are, have started to multiply rapidly in Azshara, leading to an imbalance in the region's ecosystem. While it pains us to cull these beautiful creatures, it's necessary for the good of the land. As you confront them, be sure to collect their hides. The Mosshoof's ethereal pelt is known for its protective and arcane properties, and we could use them to reinforce our defenses against greater threats.

title: Echoes of Azshara
obj_text: Gather the Blood Elf Artifacts from Blood Elf locations, the Arkkoran Relic from Arkoran regions, and the Legashi Grimoire from areas where the Legashi satyrs dwell in Azshara.
desc_text: Hero, the vast expanses of Azshara hold relics and artifacts of immense power and historical significance. Recently, we've learned of three particular items of interest: the Blood Elf Artefact from their surveyors, the Arkkoran Relic from the depths where the Arkoran reside, and the Legashi Grimoire, a dark tome held by the Legashi satyrs. Each holds a piece of Azshara's history and potential power. It's imperative that these artifacts be secured and studied to ensure they do not fall into the wrong hands.

title: Whispers in the Wind
obj_text:
Slay 6 Dust Stormers and 6 Desert Rumblers in the elemental-infested regions of Silithus.
 Dust Stormer slain (6)
 Desert Rumbler slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the desert winds of Silithus carry more than just sand; they bring with them the tumultuous roars of the Dust Stormers and Desert Rumblers. These elemental beings, manifestations of raw nature's fury, are causing disturbances across the region. Their unchecked rage disrupts the flow of energies in Silithus, threatening both the land and its inhabitants. You must confront these stormy adversaries and restore balance to the desert.

title: Wanted: Val’xas
obj_text:
Slay Val’xas
 Val'xas slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the sinister satyr Val'xas stalks the forests surrounding Ravencrest Monument, ambushing travelers with shadowy blades. He has ventured quite far from Legash Encampment, seemingly intent on stealing some artifact from the dragons nearby. This is our chance to ambush him while he's alone. His assassination efforts sew chaos while striking fear into villagers nearby. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this fiend.

title: Stirrings in the Sands
obj_text:
Slay 6 Hive’Ashi Defenders, 6 Hive’Ashi Swarmers, and 4 Hive’Ashi Sandstalkers in the silithid-infested areas of Silithus.
 Hive'Ashi Defender slain (6)
 Hive'Ashi Swarmer slain (6)
 Hive'Ashi Sandstalker slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the arid expanse of Silithus has long concealed secrets beneath its sands. The Hive'Ashi silithid have emerged with a fervor we've not seen before. These subterranean dwellers, with their Defenders, Swarmers, and Sandstalkers at the forefront, are a menace to the delicate balance of the desert. Silithus cannot fall prey to the silithid's unchecked expansion. Delve deep into their territory and halt their advance.

title: Twilight's Tumult
obj_text:
Slay 6 Twilight Geolords, 6 Twilight Avengers, and 4 Twilight Stonecallers in the Twilight's Hammer encampments of Silithus.
 Twilight Avenger slain (6)
 Twilight Geolord slain (6)
 Twilight Stonecaller slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the very sands of Silithus are tainted with the malevolent whispers of the Twilight's Hammer cult. Their Geolords, Avengers, and Stonecallers perform dark rituals, channeling sinister forces to further their apocalyptic goals. The cult's activities have already begun to twist and warp the land. You must venture into the heart of their encampments, confront these devotees of chaos, and halt the cult's nefarious plans.

title: Wanted: Rexidius
obj_text:
Slay Rexidius
 Rexidius slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the earth revenant Rexidius stalks the Crystal Vale, corrupting the land with its twisted presence. The creature seems to be bound by the Twilight Hammer, which are using it as a means of controlling the other earth elementals in the area. Destroy it, and we can weaken the Twilight Hammer's hold over the area.

title: Shadows of the Hammer
obj_text:
Slay 6 Twilight Geolords, 6 Twilight Avengers, and 4 Twilight Stonecallers in the Twilight encampments scattered throughout Silithus.
 Twilight Avenger slain (6)
 Twilight Geolord slain (6)
 Twilight Stonecaller slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the Twilight's Hammer cult continues its dark machinations in Silithus, harnessing the desert's latent powers for their catastrophic visions. The Geolords, Avengers, and Stonecallers among their ranks are instrumental in these rituals, drawing forth energies that could unmake the world itself. You must intervene, piercing the veil of the Twilight's camps, and put an end to their ambitions before they realize their dire plans.

title: Unraveling the Hive
obj_text:
Slay 4 Hive’Zora Reavers, 8 Hive’Zora Wasps, and 6 Hive’Zora Sisters in the silithid-infested regions of Silithus.
 Hive'Zora Reaver slain (4)
 Hive'Zora Wasp slain (8)
 Hive'Zora Hive Sister slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the ever-shifting sands of Silithus conceal beneath them the vast networks of the Hive'Zora silithid. Reavers, Wasps, and Sisters from the hive have begun to spill out in numbers, their aggressive expansion threatening the region. The undercurrents of their hive mind's intentions are still unclear, but what's certain is the danger they pose. Journey into their territory, confront these silithid, and halt their march across the desert.

title: Scourge of the Sands
obj_text:
Slay 5 Sand Skitterers, 5 Dredge Strikers, and 5 Stonelash Scorpids in the dunes and oases of Silithus.
 Sand Skitterer slain (5)
 Dredge Striker slain (5)
 Stonelash Scorpid slain (5)
desc_text: Hero, the desert of Silithus is not only challenged by the arcane and the malevolent cults but also by its very own inhabitants. Creatures like the Sand Skitterers, Dredge Strikers, and Stonelash Scorpids have become unusually aggressive, preying on both adventurers and native fauna alike. This unnatural aggression disrupts the ecosystem, placing the balance of Silithus at risk. Dive deep into the desert, confront these creatures, and restore harmony to the sands.

title: Desert Predators
obj_text:
Slay 5 Rock Stalkers, 5 Dredge Crushers, and 5 Stonelash Pincers in the arid plains of Silithus.
 Rock Stalker slain (5)
 Dredge Crusher slain (5)
 Stonelash Pincer slain (5)
desc_text: Hero, Silithus, while a barren wasteland to many, teems with life adapted to its harsh conditions. But some of its inhabitants, such as the Rock Stalkers, Dredge Crushers, and Stonelash Pincers, have grown increasingly hostile, disrupting the natural balance and preying on the weaker creatures. This cannot stand. Venture out into the sun-baked expanse and curb the threat of these desert predators.

title: Wanted: High Priestess Azil
obj_text:
Slay High Priestess Azil
 High Priestess Azil slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: The Twilight Hammer forces in Silithus are overseen by one of their most devoted members, High Priestess Azil. Rumors suggest she is one of the few to survive communing with the eldritch masters the cult serves, though her sanity was all but broken, she inspires the cultists under her oversight to sacrifice themselves in the name of their masters. Her defeat would be a crucial blow to the Twilight Hammer.

title: Duskfall in Silithus
obj_text:
Slay 6 Twilight Geolords, 6 Twilight Avengers, and 4 Twilight Stonecallers.
 Twilight Avenger slain (6)
 Twilight Geolord slain (6)
 Twilight Stonecaller slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the Twilight's Hammer cult continues its dark machinations in Silithus, harnessing the desert's latent powers for their catastrophic visions. The Geolords, Avengers, and Stonecallers among their ranks are instrumental in these rituals, drawing forth energies that could unmake the world itself. You must intervene, piercing the veil of the Twilight's camps, and put an end to their ambitions before they realize their dire plans.

title: Silencing the Regal Hive
obj_text:
Slay 6 Hive’Regal Spitfires, 6 Hive’Rega Hive Lords, and 4 Hive’Rega Slave Makers.
 Hive'Regal Spitfire slain (6)
 Hive'Regal Hive Lord slain (6)
 Hive'Regal Slavemaker slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, the Hive'Regal silithid have become increasingly aggressive and their expansion threatens the balance of Silithus. Among them, the Spitfires, Hive Lords, and Slave Makers are particularly troublesome, leading and coordinating their brood's activities. We must strike at these key targets to halt the silithid's advance and preserve the fragile equilibrium of the desert.

title: Release from Agony
obj_text:
Slay 6 Tortured Sentinels and 6 Tortured Druids.
 Tortured Sentinel slain (6)
 Tortured Druid slain (6)
desc_text: In the depths of Silithus, an unspeakable evil has taken hold of the land's guardians. Sentinels and druids, once protectors of nature, now roam in torment. Hero, it's a heart-wrenching task, but they must be freed from this twisted existence. Lay them to rest, and perhaps the land might find some peace.

title: Secrets of the Sands
obj_text: Collect Zora Husks and Twilight Cloth.
desc_text: Amidst the burning dunes and ancient monoliths of Silithus lie materials steeped in mystery and power. The husks of the Zora silithid, resilient and intricate, have much to reveal. Similarly, the dark-woven cloth worn by mysterious denizens might unlock secrets of forbidden rites. And scattered across the desert are shimmering Silithus crystals, pulsating with raw energy. Gather these items, Hero, and help us unravel the desert's enigmas.

title: Wanted: The Speaker Kuuran
obj_text:
Slay The Speaker Kuuran
 The Speaker Kuuran slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the Qiraji prophet known as The Speaker Kuuran resides outside the hive of Hive'Regal, empowering the Silithid swarm. His vile magics enable their relentless attacks, while his voice rallies their insectoid legions. I beseech you, brave champion, to infiltrate the hive and silence The Speaker.

title: Restorative Elements
obj_text: Collect Tortured Souls, Hive Husks, and Twilight Tablets.
desc_text: The land of Silithus is tainted with dark energy, yet within the corruption, elements exist that could help us understand and combat this growing threat. Souls of the tortured, remnants from the mighty silithid hives, and forbidden tablets from the Twilight's Hammer are all pieces of a larger puzzle. Gather them, Hero, and bring them to us. Only by understanding the shadows can we hope to push them back.
