title: Ranger of the Grove
obj_text: Deliver the bow to Thu'lis in Felwood
desc_text: Return to Thu'lis and receive your training on becoming a Grove Ranger

title: Whisperspring
obj_text:
Kill the Reaper hiding in Lake Kel'Theril.
 Verac the Wraithbound slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: I must hide it... I must hide Whisper... before they find me again.$BIt never sleeps. It never lets me go. Always whispering... always calling them.$BI tried to bury it once. Deep beneath the cold earth. Thought the silence would come... thought the dreams would stop. But they never do.$BThe dreams only grew louder. And now... now he has come.$BYou, <name>... you must listen. Listen carefully.$BThere is a Reaper in the shadows. I have seen him in my waking hours, and again in my sleep. Always watching. Always waiting.$BHe doesn’t want me. No, no. Not yet. He wants it.$BWhisper calls to him... it beckons to all those touched by death. And he has heard it, just as I did... just as you will if you hold it too long.$BFind him.$BHunt him down.$BEnd him before he tears the dagger from my hands and binds it anew in blood and sorrow.$BPlease, <name>...$BHelp me. Help it.$BBefore it consumes us both.

title: Keeper of the Grove
obj_text: Take the Unenchanted Bow to Remulos in Moonglade.
desc_text: You have set out on a quest to bring a bow to a keeper of the grove who resides in Moonglade. The bow you have crafted with the finest materials is a symbol of your determination and skill, but it is not yet complete.$BThe final step in your journey is to have the bow blessed by the power of the druids. Only then will it truly become a weapon of great power, capable of defending the your allies and vanquishing your foes.$BYou must bring the bow to Keeper Remulos, who will imbue it with the magic of the forest and the wisdom of the ancient druids. He will make the bow a true instrument of the balance between life and death, and grant you the power to use it for good.$BBe wary on your journey, as the road to Moonglade is treacherous and filled with danger. But fear not, for the power of the bow and the blessing of the druids will be with you.

title: The Past Speaks To Us
obj_text: Travel to Azshara and locate Aelric Dawnrend.
desc_text: I understand now. The dagger... it was not meant for me. It is not even meant for this world anymore.$BThe voices... they're no longer whispers, they are screams. Cries.$BThe past itself clutches at Whisper. It demands to be heard, to be reconciled... to be freed.$BThere was a man once... no, a warrior. A name carried to me on the winds of the dead: Aelric Dawnrend.$BHe fought in the War of the Ancients, centuries ago. Aelric wielded Whisper against the Burning Legion itself, until he fell, betrayed and slaughtered by demons who stole his soul-bound blade.$BSince that moment, Aelric's spirit has never left. His agony breached into Azeroth through Whisper, reaching... searching...$BWe must end this.$BSeek the place where ancient wars were fought. The whispers are screaming at me and they tell me one word;$B'Azshara'.$BAelric's ghost clings to his old home. Find him, and listen to his demands. He will guide you to what must be done.$BI will return to my tree in the swamp... I have grown rather fond of it. I do enjoy the adventure between here and the Swamp of Sorrows.

title: Silithus Swindlers
obj_text: ring Axanhtos back his stolen good from the Twilight Hammer thieves. They can be found in the deserts of Silithus.
desc_text: What a mess <name>! I've been expecting a shipment of rare goods smuggled from the heart of the Qiraji Kingdom, but I haven't heard back from my... procurement team in far too long!$BI have no doubt the Twilight Hammer must be involved in this delay. Could you see to them? I'll reward you handsomely for your efforts, <race>.

title: The Power to Reforge
obj_text: Speak to Overlord Runthak to receive a Reforge Token.
desc_text: Ah.. this crystal... I've seen its like before... Though, I have only fleeting memories of it.  There was once an Altar with the power to reforge our gear in battle. It gave us the advantage we needed to turn the tide of the war. When the war ended, I sought to claim the Altar for the Horde. I searched and searched, but it was gone. Hidden by those who wished to protect its power.  I wish I could tell you more.$BTake this, Hero. A token of that long-forgotten war.$BStay strong, stay true.  FOR THE HORDE!

title: Warden of the Grove
obj_text: Gather components to create the bow
desc_text: Day 1:$BToday I set out on my journey to become a healer. I have always felt a deep connection to nature and the forces that shape it, and I have come to understand that I have a gift for healing magic. I have heard that the druids have a deep understanding of nature magic, so I have sought them out.$BDay 5:$BI have been studying with the druids for the past few days and I am already learning so much. They have taught me how to commune with nature and tap into its power. I can feel the magic flowing through me, and I am eager to continue my training.$BDay 10:$BToday I performed my first healing ritual. It was an amazing experience. I felt the magic of nature coursing through me, and I was able to heal a wounded deer. I could see the gratitude in its eyes, and I felt a deep sense of satisfaction knowing that I was able to help.$BDay 20:$BI have made great progress in my training. The druids are pleased with my progress and they have taught me many advanced techniques for healing. I can now heal wounds, soothe pain, and even purify water. I am confident that I will be able to help many people with my magic.$BGather some Iron wood.$BGather some sturdy, Elven string. There are rumours that one of the Shindigger brothers may have ways to acquire some.$BGather some medicine that is known to have properties for curing jungle fever.

obj_text: ring your gathered blood samples to Sakari so that we may study the properties of pit lord vitae and better understand the true power and danger of fel blood.
desc_text: Research into the properties of the fel blood is progressing slowly as expected. Some progress has been made regarding how it relates to the standard fel corruption other orcs experience. Perhaps some of these have managed to replicate properties of demon blood, provided they are not$B- Abyssal Elxir, seems to be a potion created to empower the orcs.$B- Blood of the Legions, besides the Fel Orc's vague naming, may provide different properties to study?$B- Demonic Elixir, possibly similar to Abyssal Elixir, Fel Orcs seem to describe it as a separate substance though.$BUnfortunately I lack the means of fighting past the Fel Orcs to obtain any of these, and have not been able to procure additional support in my research besides these prisoners. desc_text: Stop looking at me with that questioning face. Of course I can read this. I've spent a good part of my life studying this language and I would be willing to help you but first i need a favour.$BSee, there's this blue dragon in the mountains of Winterspring. Her name is Haleh and her elven form is just breathtaking. Her skin, her hair, her face and her figure... everything about her is just... perfect...$BWell let's just say that I've developed a bit of a liking for her. You can find her ontop of a mountain that you can reach by using a teleportation circle in the caverns below.$BDeliver this letter to her and come back with an answer.

To do that, we need forward staging areas.$BOur scouts identified three fortifications near Hellfire Citadel.  We want you to help secure these forts.  Capture each fort, and then report back to me.$BMay fortune shine upon you in the conflicts ahead, <name>, for you will no doubt clash with Horde forces eager to gain these same fortifications.

title: Decrypting the Symbols
obj_text: Talk to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun.
desc_text: A NOTE? All he had was... a note? We can't even read this, it's draconic. Bring it to Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun. He's an old acquaintance of mine. I'm sure he will help us with this "predicament".$BLast I heard, he's been drowning himself in alcohol at Ratchet.$BAnd don't you dare try any tricks on me. I'll be watching closely.

title: The Power to Reforge
obj_text: Speak to Field Marshal Afrasiabi to receive a Reforge Token.
desc_text: Ah.. this crystal... I've seen its like before... Though, I have only fleeting memories of it.  There was once an Altar with the power to reforge our gear in battle. It gave us the advantage we needed to turn the tide of the war. When the war ended, I sought to claim the Altar for the Alliance. I searched and searched, but it was gone. Hidden by those who wished to protect its power.  I wish I could tell you more.$BTake this, Hero. A token of that long-forgotten war.$BStay strong, stay true.  For the Alliance!

title: Journey Back to Booty Bay
obj_text: Deliver the note to Melvin.
desc_text: More powerful? The leader of the Thalo'dan Privateers is not POWERFUL enough for her? Whatever, there's plenty of dragons in the sky.$BA deal is a deal. Here's your translated note.

title: Fancy a Witch Hunt?
obj_text: Find Myranda the Hag.
desc_text: Finally! What took you so long? Another day n' I would've put a notice for your head on the contract's board.$BThis note talks about a witch called Myranda. It seems like she's the one who is currently in possesion of the amulet. Track her down n' get it back. Use any means necessary.

title: The Lord of Blackrock
obj_text: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.
desc_text: Go to the Valley of Heroes and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

title: Celebrating Good Times
obj_text: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.
desc_text: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes, <name>. He will be expecting you...

title: A Job Well Done
obj_text: Follow Melvin.
desc_text: Mine, at last! There's only one thing left to do. The amulet must be dipped in the blood of a powerful black dragonspawn and i know just the right one. General Drakkisath, the leader of the dragonspawn armies which are currently residing in the Upper Blackrock Spire.$BFollow me, <name>, let's discuss our strategy.

title: Heroic Dungeon: Stratholme - Service Entrance
obj_text:
Kill Baron Rivendare.
 Baron Rivendare
desc_text: aron Rivendare, once a rich landowner, supporter of Kel'thuzad and one of the main delinquents responsible for the spread of the plagued grain across the northern human kingdoms.$BHe is now commanding the scourge forces that are currently infesting the eastern parts of Stratholme. Continously fighting against the Scarlet Crusade over full control of Stratholme.$BVenture into the traitors lair and bring him to justice!

title: Heroic Dungeon: Stratholme - Main Gate
obj_text:
Stop the Scarlet Crusade in Stratholme.
 Timmy the Cruel
 Cannon Master Willey
 Archivist Galford
 Balnazzar
desc_text: Although the Scarlet Crusades main focus is to fight the Scourge they are ever so dangerous to all the living races too. In their blind fanaticism they actually believe that any non-human race is either part of the scourge or allied with them.

title: Forged in Blood
obj_text: Go to the Blackrock Spire and kill General Drakkisath.
desc_text: Well, I never liked the guy anyway. My things have been disappearing way too often since he's arrived.$BAnyway, don't think I don't know about your plan. I'll help you... but you'll owe me one.$BGo to the Blackrock Spire. There you'll find General Drakkisath. Bring me his blood and I'll use it to unlock the full potential of this amulet.

Destroy the Dark Iron Clan.
 Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
desc_text: Rumors have it that the dwarves of the Dark Iron clan are serving a great evil being known as Ragnaros. Also titled "The Firelord", he is one of the elemental lords currently residing in the elemental planes deep inside Azeroth. If their efforts to summon their "deity" to our planes are succesful, it could spell absolute disaster for Azeroth.$BThis situation needs to be investigated and taken care of!$BGo to the Blackrock Depths and put an end to their summoning efforts!

Keeping Evil at Bay: Alcaz Island
obj_text: Return with 12 Naga Pearls from Alcaz Island off the coast of the Dustwallow Marsh
desc_text: ATTENTION ALL HEROES:$BThe Naga have become quite an issue for the people of Dustwallow Marsh. They have been assaulting trading and supply ships going and coming from Theramore and Ratchet. The time has come to teach them a lesson that they won't soon forget.$BGo, adventurer. Seek out their home on Alcaz Island, slay the water-mongrels, and return with their pearls.$BBe wary, however. Our forward scouts have reported some strange rumblings of a mad Gnomish scientist in that area...

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Oneiros
obj_text: Return with 40 Oneiros Scales from Oneiros in Feralas.
desc_text: ATTENTION ALL HEROES:$BOur next strike upon The Green Dragonflight in Feralas will be an assault on the Dragonkin residing in Oneiros, a section of the Dream Bough in Feralas.$BThey show no signs of stopping or slowing down. Their forces continue to grow, and their expansion must be stymied.$BReturn with their scales and you will be rewarded for your acts of heroism.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Jademir Lake
obj_text: Return with 10 Dream Bough-Infused Scales from Jademir Lake in Feralas.
desc_text: ATTENTION ALL HEROES:$BTroubling news from Feralas, adventurer!$BThe Green Dragonflight, corrupted as a result of the Emerald Nightmare, have been expanding their forces throughout Feralas. They seem to be becoming more numerous.$BThey have been spotted around Jademir Lake. Their advance must be stopped forthwith.$BSeek out any Green Dragonflight members that you find there, and return with their scales as proof of your deeds.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Lake Mennar
obj_text: Return with 30 Blue Dragonkin Claws from Lake Mennar in Azshara.
desc_text: ATTENTION ALL HEROES:$BThe Blue Dragonflight in Azshara have been digging up the remains of the Mennar Academy seeking powerful artifacts that lay dormant under the rubble and soil.$BTheir encroachment must not be met with passivity. Travel to Lake Mennar and kill any members of the Blue Dragonflight that you see.$BReturn with 30 Blue Dragonkin Claws as proof of your deeds.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Dream Bough
obj_text: Return with 40 Dream Bough Scales from the Dream Bough in Feralas.
desc_text: ATTENTION ALL HEROES:$BCorrupted by the Emerald Nightmare, the Green Dragonflight in Feralas seem to be preparing for something. Whatever that may be, it does not bode well for anyone, especially if it involves the Dragons of Nightmare.$BThey gather in the Dream Bough in northern Feralas. Go forth, adventurer, and cull their forces. They cannot be allowed to build their armies unperturbed.$BDrive them back, and return with scales of their fallen.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Darkwhisper Gorge
obj_text: Deal with the demon threat in Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring.
desc_text: MERCENARIES NEEDED:$BA large amount of demonic energy has been felt emanating from Darkwhisper Gorge at the foot of Mount Hyjal in Winterspring. It appears that a large demonic force has amassed there.$BThis can only be bad news for us. We need you to seek out the Hederine Lieutenants residing there and slay them.$BOur forward scouts report that they carry strange runes. Take the runes from the bodies of the Lieutenants and return with them for further analysis.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Mazthoril
obj_text: Return with scales from Mazthoril in Winterspring
desc_text: MERCENARIES NEEDED:$BWe advise that you bring some warm gear for this task.$BWe've heard reports of Dragonkin emerging from Mazthoril in Winterspring.  Join forces with fellow Heroes to help quell this threat.$BReturn with the required amount of their scales and you shall be duly rewarded for your efforts.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: The Tainted Scar
obj_text: Return with 15 Demonic Essence from the Tainted Scar
desc_text: ATTENTION ALL HEROES:$BOur reconnaissance forces have detected unusual demonic activity in the Tainted Scar, located within the Blasted Lands.$BRemnants of the Burning Legion's army are suddenly exhibiting organized and, therefore, dangerous behavior.$BWe believe they are forming ranks and consolidating what forces they have left for what could be a final desperate assault.$BPerhaps they expect reinforcements from beyond the Dark Portal? We can only hope not.$BWe will not be taken by surprise and we shall brook no threat from the Burning Legion.$BDecimate their forces. Return with their Demonic Essences as proof of the deed.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Frostwhisper Gorge
obj_text: Return with 15 Frostmaul Shards and 4 Frostmaul E'ko from Frostwhisper Gorge in Winterspring
desc_text: TO ANY INTERESTED PARTIES:$BThe elements and composition of the Frostmaul Giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in Winterspring have always had intriguing properties. The shards and E'ko seem to be crystallic ice that never melts.$BWe expect these can be useful to us in some way. Travel to Frostwhisper Gorge and collect Frostmaul Shards and Frostmaul E'ko in the name of SCIENCE!

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Isle of Dread
obj_text: Return with the horns of the Chimaerok from the Isle of Dread.
desc_text: HELP WANTED:$BThe Chimaerok population in Feralas is growing fast. Too fast. If it continues at the rate it is going currently, they will outgrow their home of the Isle of Dread and spread throughout Feralas like a plague.$BAzeroth's ecological balance must be preserved and if these Chimaeroks migrate out of the Isle, they would cause havoc throughout Kalimdor.$BReduce their population. Return with four wings from each type of Chimaerok.

title: Seasonal Warchest: Thanks for Supporting Us!
Keeping Evil at Bay: Purgation Isle
obj_text: Return with 15 Ghostly Essence from Purgation Isle
desc_text: GHOSTHUNTERS NEEDED:$BDo you believe in ghosts?$BDo you believe in killing them for money?!$BThen you've come to the right callboard, pal. Our client has a special request.$BPurgation Isle, south of the shores of Hillsbrad Foothills, is just brimming with those ectoplasmic piñatas.$BWhack em' until they die a second horrible death and their Ghostly Essence comes flyin' out.$BCollect 15 of those and, who knows, you might even get a finder's fee!$B- SIGNED,$BEgon Fizzlecrank

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Tyr's Hand
obj_text: Return with 25 Scarlet Emblems from Tyr's Hand
desc_text: MERCENARIES NEEDED:$BThe Scarlet Crusade have once again overstepped their bounds.$BThey have become overzealous and are attempting to recruit from our forces in the Eastern Plaguelands.$BSend them a clear message that indoctrination of our soldiers will NOT be tolerated.$BInfiltrate Tyr's Hand, the heart of their operations, and collect Scarlet Emblems from their bloodied corpses.$BThe only good fanatic is a dead fanatic.

title: Keeping Evil at Bay: Dragonmaw Gates
obj_text: Return with 30 Royal Red Dragonscales from the Dragonmaw Gates

He described it as a "crimson, bloody red".$BHe seems to believe that if his opponent cannot tell that he is bleeding, he will be at some kind of tactical advantage.$BThe Dragonmaw Gates in the Wetlands are guarded by plenty Scalebane Royal Guards. Their scales should suffice.$BI'll be needing at least 30 Royal Red Dragonscales to complete the full set for my client.

title: The Mysterious Tooth
obj_text: Find someone who knows about the Sandworm Tooth.
desc_text: The Sandworm Tooth is unlike anything you have seen. It is harder than the finest steel, yet it weighs almost nothing. It is absolutely unyielding, but somehow still seems flexible. You have never seen an object like this.$BAs you look at the tooth, and overwhelming sensation washes over you. It is as if the very air around you hums with power. Placing the tooth in your palm sends a wave of unbearable pain through your body. You cannot hold it.$BA formless whisper echoes in your mind. You must find out more about the nature of the ancient power imbued in this weapon.

title: Dead Quest
obj_text:
Kill 20 players and complete 1 battleground.
 Complete 1 Battleground
 $BPlayers slain (20)
desc_text: So you think you have what it takes to be a powerful combatant, yeah?$BLet me make it very clear.$BYou don't.$BBut if you want to try? Be my guest. This isn't like fighting your average bandit or wayward creature, <class>. This is real fighting, and it's not easy.$BIf you want to make it here? You'll have to be patient, strong-willed, maybe even a tad optimistic, and willing to learn.$BI'll tell you what. Go off and fight. Prove you can fight it out with the best of them, then come back to me, and I'll make it worth your while in honor.

title: Hoarfrost
obj_text: Gather all the E'ko components to combine in to the Hoarfrost.
desc_text: In the frigid land of Winterspring, there are several powerful creatures that possess the E'ko I need.$BI require Winterfall E'ko from the furbolgs, Shardtooth E'ko from the majestic Shardtooth bears, Wildkin E'ko from the elusive wildkin, Chillwind E'ko from the deadly Chillwind Chimeras, and Ice Thistle E'ko from the cunning Ice Thistle Yetis.$BBring these to me and I will combine them in to the Hoarfrost you seek. This skill will grant great power to whoever wields it. But be warned, mon, the creatures of Winterspring are not to be trifled with. Only the strongest and bravest heroes should undertake this quest. Do you have what it takes?$BRememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

title: A Threat to Azeroth: Kazzak
obj_text:
Defeat Lord Kazzak!
 Lord Kazzak slain
desc_text: Attention all Heroes of Azeroth: There have been reports of a formidable demon known as Kazzak spotted in the Blasted Lands. Also known as Kil'jaeden's Right Hand and Lord of the Doomguard demons, Kazzak was known as one of Archimonde's most trusted lieutenants during the Third War. He is a formidable and powerful demon of the Burning Legion$BKazzak, wielding the fabled blade of Archimonde, was last seen in the Blasted Lands at the Tainted Scar.$BRally together your fellow heroes to save the world of Azeroth from the Burning Legion.

title: A Threat to Azeroth: Azuregos
obj_text:
Slay Azuregos!
 Azuregos slain
desc_text: Attention all Heroes of Azeroth:$BBefore the Great Sundering, the night elf city of Eldarath flourished in the land that is now known as Azshara. A blueflight dragon known as Azuregos has been aimlessly wandering the region. Some believebelieved that many ancient and powerful Highborne artifacts may be found among the ruins of the once-mighty stronghold. For countless generations, the Blue Dragon Flight has safeguarded powerful artifacts and magical lore, ensuring that they do not fall into mortal hands. The presence of Azuregos, the blue dragon, seems to suggest that items of extreme significance, perhaps the fabled Vials of Eternity themselves, may be found in the wilderness of Azshara. Whatever Azuregos seeks, one thing is certain: Azuregos is a threat to Azeroth and must be slain.

title: A "Fair" Trade
obj_text:
Return to Belpix with 250 Fel Blood, a Ressurection Stone, and 1000 gold.
 $BRequired money: 1000
desc_text: Hello mortal.. Should you ever find yourself seeking to retrieve a forlorn soul from the depths of the Twisting Nether, know that you should look no further than I, the great Belpix!$BI am benevolent, but I am not a charity case.. Bring me Fel Blood of fallen Legion forces, and one Resurrection Stone$BOh, and, throw in about a thousand gold and we should good! I need that for uhm.... For the trade! Yes, the trade..

title: A Threat to Azeroth: Lethon
obj_text:
Slay the Nightmare Dragon Lethon!
 Lethon slain
desc_text: Attention all Heroes of Azeroth:$BLethon's exposure to the aberration within the Emerald Dream not only darkened the hue of the mighty dragon's scales, but also empowered him with the ability to extract malevolent shades from his enemies. Once joined with their master, the shades imbue the dragon with healing energies. It should come as no surprise, then, that Lethon is considered to be among the most formidable of Ysera's wayward lieutenants.

title: A Threat to Azeroth: Emeriss
obj_text:
Slay the Nightmare Dragon Emeriss!
 $BEmeriss slain

 Emeriss
 Emeriss - Heroic
 Emeriss - Mythic
$B

 Emeriss - Ascended
 Emeriss
desc_text: Attention all Heroes of Azeroth:$BThe mysterious dark power within the Emerald Dream has transformed the once-majestic Emeriss into a rotting, diseased monstrosity. Reports from the few who have survived encounters with the dragon have told horrifying tales of putrid mushrooms erupting from the corpses of their dead companions. Emeriss is truly the most gruesome and appalling of Ysera's estranged green dragons.

title: A Threat to Azeroth: Setis
obj_text:
Destroy Setis!
 $BSetis slain

 Setis
 Setis - Heroic
 Setis - Mythic
$B

 Setis - Ascended
 Setis
desc_text: Attention all Heroes of Azeroth: the Qiraji have been infesting Azeroth for as long as we can remember.$BRecently, we they have begun utilizing the powers of the Anubisath in Silithus. The Abunisath are animated giants of living stone that possess strange powers. One particular incarnation of the Abunisath known as Setis has been causing havoc for the noble members of the Cenarion Circle located in Silithus,$BGather your forces to destroy Setis.

title: Voidwalkers Gone Wild
obj_text: ring the Pulsating Voidwalker Essence to Mahuram Stouthoof in Thrallmar.
desc_text: Examining the essence reveals violent swirls of energy sealed within a vessel made of unidentifiable material. As you consider it,you can feel it beginning to tug at your mind,inviting you to come closer and to look deeper.$BFeeling your will begin to slip away,you break your gaze immediately. Its presence remains at the edge of your consciousness as you determine what to do with it.

title: Ravager Roundup
obj_text:
Slay 10 Captive Ravager Hatchlings and retrieve 12 Ravager Eggs for Mahuram Stouthoof in Thrallmar.
 Captive Ravager Hatchling slain (10)
desc_text: Outland is rife with fascinating creatures. Fascinating -- and extremely dangerous.$BThe area is rich with predators,which seems strange for such a barren land,but a closer look reveals something of a hierarchy.$BThe rock flayers seem to have domesticated another predator,the ravager,and breed them as hunting companions and guard animals. I need to know more about how they're training these ravagers. We must shut down and examine their breeding site to the southwest,near the Terokkar Forest.

title: Silithid Snack
obj_text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:$B10 Sandworm Meat. You can acquire these from the Dredge Crushers and Dredge Strikers of nearby Silithus.$B10 Goblin Spices. Any respectable chef in Goblin cities will carry this!$B10 Silithid Innards. These vile, and potentially hazardous, goods can be got from only the strongest and most deadly Silithid from Silithus.$BGather all of the items and return to Dirge.
desc_text: <name>, are you looking for a tasty little treat? On second thought, maybe I could whip you up a salad. Ah, it's none of my business!$BIf you're looking to put on a little "heroic mass" then I've got just the thing! That's right, Dirge, renowned chef extraordinaire, has designed the perfect snack. It's got spice, it's got panache, and it explodes into a burst of boiling hot juices as soon as you take a bite!$BIf you're looking for the next big hit in Kalimdor then bring me the following:

title: A Peon's Work is Never Done
obj_text: Gather 8 Clefthoof Hides and 8 sets of Clefthoof Bones from the Raging Clefthoof. Return to Watch Commander Krunk in Thrallmar once you have all the materials.
desc_text: The Legion's constant assaults take a heavy toll on our defenses. If the palisade falls,so will Thrallmar. I've assigned peons to reinforce and repair the walls,but we're running out of materials.$BGrelag,one of the Far Seer's students,is well versed in the old ways and suggested returning to an ancient practice. Long ago,the clefthoof hunt supplied us with meat,hides,and bones. Taking up the hunt again,with the clefthoof to the southeast,would provide what's needed and honor the ancestors.

title: Dirge's Nevermelt Ice Cream
obj_text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:$B10 Shard of Nevermelting Ice. You can only harvest these from the giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in Winterspring.$B10 Ice Cold Milk. Most food and water vendors will carry this.$B10 Sugar. Any respectable chef in Goblin cities will carry this!$BGather all of the items and return to Dirge.
desc_text: <name>, do I have a treat for you! No, really. What, you don't believe me?!$BLook, I'm not talking about that Tigule and Foror's excuse for food either. No, I'm talking about so good ol' fashioned Goblin goodies. Now, I just need you to get your hands on some of the famous nevermelting ice of the Frostwhisper Giants for me. What, I didn't say it would be easy.$BBuckle up and grab me these things:

title: Ghostly Goulash
obj_text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:$B10 Bear Flanks. You will get those from large bears wondering areas like Felwood, Feralas, and Winterspring.$B10 Refreshing Springwater. Most food and water vendors will carry this.$B10 Goblin Spices. Any respectable chef in Goblin cities will carry this!$B10 Ghost Dust. This spooky item can be find from the ghostly denizens of Purgation Isle.$BGather all of the items and return to Dirge.
desc_text: Welcome back my amicable apprentice! Now listen up, because I've just come up with a goose bump inducing recipe. Unfortunately, I require someone with unwavering resolve and mettle to get me the goods I need to make it, and I don't see anyone around who fits the bill.$BThat's where you come in! If you're willing to stick your neck out I can promise you it will be worth your while. Assuming, of course, you don't lose your soul and wind up wandering the Purgation Isle for the rest of eternity, but there's only, like, a one percent chance of that happening.$BAnyway, here's what I need:

title: Hydra Scale Soup
obj_text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:$B10 Raw Spinefin Halibut. Your best bet for these will be the coastal life of Azshara.$B10 Refreshing Springwater. Most food and water vendors will carry this.$B10 Goblin Spices. Any respectable chef in Goblin cities will carry this!$B10 Large Hydra Scale. You can snag these bad boys off the Hydras of Alcaz Isle, but be careful, <name>, they bite.$BGather all of the items and return to Dirge.
desc_text: Ah, just the suc--I mean super star I was looking for! Now I know you have fallen in love with those devilishly delightful clamlettes, but I'm afraid I'm going to have break your heart... because this new recipe is going to rock your socks and warm your boots!$BSee, there's this new soup I've been working on, but soup is boring. I mean you just throw stuff in a pot of water and, well, you get soup. So I thought, "Hey, why not throw something crazy in the water to make some crazy soup!?" That's how I came up with this new recipe which has a real bite to it.$BSo, here's what I'm going to need:

title: Forge Camps of the Legion
obj_text:
Kill 10 Gan'arg Servants,5 Forge Camp Legionnaires,and 5 Sisters of Grief,then search Forge Camp: Rage for evidence of the Legion's intentions.
 Gan'arg Servant slain (10)
 Forge Camp Legionnaire slain (5)
 Sister of Grief slain (5)
desc_text: If you've spoken to Humphry,he's undoubtedly told you that he finds the infestation in the mines a minor annoyance,but I know it for what it is: a symptom of a larger evil.$BTo the northeast of the Horde outpost of Thrallmar,the Legion's minions labor night and day on something,but what is it?$BNone of the scouts I've dispatched to the camps have ever returned. The time for subtlety has passed,<name>. Fight your way into Forge Camp: Rage and find out just what the Legion is up to.

title: Back In Business
obj_text: Get some ore.
desc_text: Take my shredder.  Go into the mine and get some ore.

title: Fortifying the Felhunter
obj_text: Gather 6 Warp Hound Blood and bring them to Angela "The Claw" Kestrel in Thrallmar.
desc_text: Greetings,<class>. Say hello to Jir'see here,too. Don't worry,he won't bite unless I tell him to.$B<Angela makes a cooing sound at the felhunter.>$BHe's so tiny in comparison to the warp hounds that live in Outland. But we're going to fix that right up,yes we are,aren't we,Jir'see?$BI think I've figured out a way to do it. I'll need plenty of blood from the warp hounds and that's where you come in. While you're hunting them in the southeast,I'll get ready for the experi... err,treatment.

title: The Legion's Plans
obj_text: Retrieve the Forge Camp: Spite Plans and return them to Field Marshal Rohamus at Expedition Point.
desc_text: You make a copy of the glowing glyphs etched into the ground, but without the second half, the diagram doesn't make sense.$BField Marshall Rohamus mentioned another camp to the west, Forge Camp: Spite. Could that be where the Legion is keeping the other half of the plans?$BIf the Legion has undertaken a massive production campaign, assembling at multiple sites would make sense.

title: Searching for New Materials
obj_text: Gather 8 Clefthoof Hides and 8 Clefthoof Sinews from the Raging Clefthoof. When you have the materials,bring them to Humphry in Honor Hold.
desc_text: <The dwarf looks up from his work expectantly.>$BIf you're looking to commission a piece,get in line,<class>. I've got my hands full maintaining the Sons' equipment and preparing us for the day when we'll take the battle to the enemy again.$BOur metal stocks are getting very low since crust borers invaded the mines. I've been experimenting with natural materials from the raging clefthoof that graze in the areas northeast of the Hold,and while they're no substitute for iron,I'm learning to make do.

desc_text: Giselda the Crone's ambitious daughter, Kriella, has summoned a dangerous Eredar warrior known as Sulkaia in an effort to prove herself to her mother, or perhaps even overthrow her.$BSulkaia is a deadly opponent who has slaughtered Mag'har and Broken alike at Kriella's behest. A large gold reward will be given by Warden Bullrok to any who can defeat her.

title: A New Calling
obj_text: Speak with Akino Solarsong
desc_text: The Cenarion Refuge recognizes your valor in assisting the Druids and studying the Naga sorcerers. Impressed by your dedication, Ysiel Windsinger knows someone that is looking for a person of your caliber, find Akino Solarsong in Nagrand.$BShe is an adept of the sun and nature, so you'll most likely find her in a place with a lot of sun exposure. She tends to be a "lone wolf", so don't expect to find her in crowded places.

title: Chest of Fortune
obj_text: Complete the quest to accept your Chest of Fortune.
desc_text: The Chest of Fortune will grant you Scroll of Fortune on levels you no longer roll new abilities. You will be given the opportunity to choose level 50 and 60 talents with this saved Ability Essence at level 60.

title: [DEPRECATED]<txt><nyi>The Dragons of Dragons' End
obj_text: Rexxar has asked you to speak to him about riding &&& out to Dragons' End to recover a Black Dragon Corpse.  Return to him at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains when you have it.
desc_text: We must do something that will infuriate Goc if we're to face him.$BAnd now that you've freed &&&,I think I know just what will do!$BWhen you are ready,let me know,and I will ask &&& to fly you out to one of the dragon corpses impaled upon the rocks at Dragons' End.$BRecover the corpse and bring it back to me here so that we can create something that is sure to bring Goc out of hiding!

title: Necro Overlord Mezhen
obj_text:
Kill Necro Overlord Mezhen. Then, return to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep.
 Necro Overlord Mezhen slain
desc_text: The Scourge are at Gjalerbron and they have necromancers with them! They must be working to bring the vrykul into Arthas' fold.$BI want the leader of these necrolords eliminated!$BDo whatever it takes, <name>, but see to it that Necro Overlord Mezhen, and whatever he's attempting to accomplish, is neutralized.$BI will not see the vrykul successfully allied with the Scourge!$BLook for Mezhen on the platform in the rear right section of Gjalerbron.

title: One Last Time
obj_text:
Escort the Ghost of Explorer Jaren safely to Explorer Irena Stonemantle at Steel Gate in the Howling Fjord.
 $BThe Ghost of Explorer Jaren safely escorted to Irena Stonemantle
desc_text: Hello there. Am I dead? I think I am, because I'm hovering over my body!$BOh, what an unfortunate turn of events. I was about to propose to Irena when the Scourge descended on us.$BI know that she's still alive... I can feel her in my heart.$B<class>, do you think you might safely get me to her? The Scourge can still see my ghost, and no doubt can do horrible things to me.$BI'd like to look upon her beautiful face one last time. You can tell her that I love her for me.

title: The Frost Wyrm and its Master
obj_text:
Slay Wyrmcaller Vile and use the Wyrmcaller's Horn to call down and slay Glacion. Then, return with the horn to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep.
 Wyrmcaller Vile slain
 Glacion slain
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: You were right to bring this to me, <name>. You must take help back north with you to Gjalerbron and slay that wyrm and its master, Wyrmcaller Vile!$BEven now, as we speak here, the frost wyrm may be on its way.$BHowever, if I'm reading these plans correctly, blowing the wyrmcaller's horn on his platform, outside in the rear left area of Gjalerbron, will call Glacion back. When the creature lands, destroy it!$BAnd <name>, please bring me the horn. We wouldn't want it falling back into the wrong hands.

title: All Hail the Conqueror of Skorn!
obj_text: Return the Westguard Command Insignia to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: We -- well, you -- have done everything that we were sent here to accomplish <sir /ma'am>. I must say that it's been a pleasure taking orders from such a fine, young <race>.$BThe captain is sure to want to hear of your success, but if you decide to stay out here for whatever reason, I am at your disposal.

title: Gjalerbron Attack Plans
obj_text: Deliver the Gjalerbron Attack Plans to Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: These plans detail an imminent attack upon Westguard Keep. It would appear that the frost wyrm, Glacion, who circles overhead is to be used for the offensive.$BSurely Mage-Lieutenant Malister would be of some assistance in this matter. Deliver the plans to him at the keep to the south.

title: Necro Overlord Mezhen
obj_text:
Kill Necro Overlord Mezhen. Then, return to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
 Necro Overlord Mezhen slain
desc_text: The dead ones are at Gjalerbron and they have necromancers with them?$BWe must eliminate the leader of these necrolords.$BDo whatever it takes, <name>, but see to it that Necro Overlord Mezhen, and whatever he's attempting to accomplish, is neutralized.$BWe cannot afford to see the vrykul successful in whatever they are doing with these undead creatures!$BLook for Mezhen on the platform in the rear right section of Gjalerbron.

title: The Conqueror of Skorn!
obj_text: Return the Winterhoof Token to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
desc_text: You have done everything that we were sent here to do, <class>. I must admit that you fight well. Your people are not as strange as I first thought.$BChieftain Ashtotem is certain to want to hear of your success, but if you decide to stay out here for whatever reason, I will continue to fight at your side.

title: Stop the Ascension!
obj_text:
Present the Vrykul Scroll of Ascension near the Thane's Pyre to call him out and slay him. Afterward, due to the nature of the ritual, you're sure that Father Levariol at Westguard Keep will be interested in seeing the scroll.
 Halfdan the Ice-Hearted slain
desc_text: This huge scroll is made from dragon skin. Unfurling its more-than-ten-foot length, you can see that the images painted upon its scaly surface depict a mysterious vrykul ritual.$BA vrykul thane, surrounded by angelic-looking beings, ascends into the heavens. A mysterious, darkened figure looms large in the picture's background.$BA tingling in your gut tells you that the thane of Skorn is about to do this. You must stop it! A large pyre sits at the top of Skorn in front of the thane's lodge.

title: Aelric's Curse
obj_text: Collect the items Aelric needs to break his bondage.
desc_text: Another soul drawn to the blade... another pawn of my sorrow.$BWhisper... my soul...$BI forged her in defiance of the Legion... yet she was torn from me by betrayal and death.$BEver since, my spirit has wandered, reaching across the veil, clinging to the blade that was once part of me."$BThe War of the Ancients shattered more than stone and flesh. It shattered oaths. It shattered faith.$BWhisper is cursed not by evil, but by longing... my longing.$BYou, mortal... you have heard the cries, have you not? The screams through the blade?$BThey were mine. They were the others, too... countless souls drawn into Whisper's shadow.$B<Aelric lowers his head>$BI beg you. Sever the chains.$BCollect the relics necessary to perform the cleansing that will remove my bondage from this weapon. I require the following items:$BMoondust Tears, said to be dropped by Anguished Highborne in Winterspring, the Seal of the Forgotten, said to be dropped by Eldreth Sorcerers in Dire Maul, and a Shard of Fel Ruin, said to be dropped by Doomguard Commanders in the Blasted Lands.$BI'll also require the Sorrowbrand Relic - an ancient artifact used in old Highborne rituals... I believe your little friend back in the swamp may have found it.$BOnly then will Whisper be free... and so too shall I be.

 Compare Runes with the Broken Tablet
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: If we can locate what's luring the giants northwest, we might be able to stop them before they reach their destination.$BAlthough I was able to decipher many of the runes on the samples you brought me, the ones I don't know concern me the most. When I visited Giants' Run, I noticed a large broken tablet jutting from the ground where the northeastern part of the area met the snow at the foot of Frostblade Peak. Take this sample, compare the runes with the tablet, and see what you can learn.

title: Demolishing Megalith
obj_text:
Defeat Megalith and return to Sage Edan at Camp Winterhoof.
 Megalith slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: inder Murdis created Megalith to be a kind of keystone for the runed giants and to lead them in their mission. Defeating Megalith will leave them lost and without direction. I will ask Chieftain Ashtotem to divert some of our men as we move north and dedicate them to eliminating the last of the runed giants. Without their giants, the Iron Dwarves cannot stand against us.$BSearch the foothills of Frostblade Peak, north of Giants' Run for Megalith and defeat him!

title: Demolishing Megalith
obj_text:
Defeat Megalith and return to Researcher Aderan at Fort Wildervar.
 Megalith slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: inder Murdis created Megalith to be the most powerful of the runed giants and to lead them in their mission. Defeating Megalith will leave them lost and without direction. After the expeditionary force arrives, our soldiers will be able to isolate and defeat the remaining giants and oust their Iron Dwarf masters from their camps.$BSearch the foothills of Frostblade Peak, north of Giants' Run for Megalith and defeat him!

title: March of the Giants
obj_text:
Sage Edan and Camp Winterhoof wants you to use the Runeseeking Pick on the corpses of 4 Runed Stone Giants.
 Runed Stone Giant Corpses Analyzed (4)
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: To the east, at Giants' Run, rune-inscribed stone giants have started to migrate north toward Frostblade Peak. I know nothing of their goals, nor of their destination.$BThe glowing runes inscribed in the stone flesh of the giants guide them on their journey. Fell some of these giants.$BTake this pick with you and use it on the corpses of the runed stone giants. It will deactivate the runes. Once you've tested enough giants, return to me with your findings.

title: March of the Giants
obj_text:
Researcher Aderan at Fort Wildervar wants you to use the Runeseeking Pick on the corpses of 4 Runed Stone Giants.
 Runed Stone Giant Corpse Analyzed (4)
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: To the east, at Giants' Run, rune-inscribed stone giants have started to migrate north toward Frostblade Peak. What their ultimate destination is, I do not know.$BThe glowing runes inscribed in the stone flesh of the giants guide them on their journey.$BUse this pick to deactivate the runes on the giants' corpses and return with your findings.

title: The Lodestone
obj_text:
Sage Edan at Camp Winterhoof wants you to compare the Rune Sample with the Broken Tablet.
 Compare Runes with the Broken Tablet
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: We must find what's luring the giants northwest, so we can stop them before they reach their destination.$BWhile the rune samples gave us some clues, the unknown runes worry me.$BWhen I visited Giants' Run, I noticed a large broken tablet jutting from the ground where the northeastern part of the area met the snow at the foot of Frostblade Peak. Take this sample, compare the runes with the tablet, and see what you can learn about the identity of this lodestone.

title: The Honored Ancestors
obj_text:
Elder Atkanok outside Coldrock Quarry wants you to identify the statues of Elder Kesuk, Elder Sagani, and Elder Takret.
 Elder Kesuk identified
 Elder Sagani identified
 Elder Takret identified
desc_text: <A distant voice echoes in your head as you regard the stone statue.>$BDo not be startled, stranger. I am Elder Atkanok, an ancient ancestor of the tuskarr people, a skilled craftsman in my own time and the guardian of this quarry for centuries.$BThe quarry has been overrun, leaving many statues unfinished while the ancestors' spirits wander the world. Will you aid me in righting this wrong?$BFirst, I must know the names of these wandering ancestors. Look for the markers near their statues.

title: The Lost Spirits
obj_text:
Elder Atkanok, on the outskirts of Coldrock Quarry, wants you to free the spirits of 3 Kaskala Craftsmen and 3 Kaskala Shaman.
 Kaskala Craftsman spirits freed (3)
 Kaskala Shaman spirits freed (3)
desc_text: In the attack on the quarry, the shaman and craftsmen working here were slain. The violence threw the spirit world into utter chaos and we'll be unable to guide the ancestors home unless we find a way to soothe the spirits of the murdered.$BThe aggressors themselves pay no heed to the spirits, but their companions, the beryl hounds, sense the spirits and hold them in thrall.$BKill the beryl hounds, and using the raw energy left behind, break the imprisonment of the spirits of the innocent.

title: We Strike!
obj_text:
Help Longrunner Proudhoof and his Warsong raiders to survive the assault upon Steeljaw's Caravan and finish off the spirit of Force-Commander Steeljaw.$BIf successful, report to Overlord Bor'gorok at Bor'gorok Outpost.
 $BSuccessfully assisted Longrunner Proudhoof's assault.
desc_text: One of your orcs named Steeljaw tried to save some time by taking a shortcut through our burial grounds. This had better not be how your Horde normally acts, <race>, or you will find the taunka to be the end of you!$BBut, you look as if you want to help fix this situation. Good!$BSteeljaw's cursed spirit now haunts this place and disturbs the remains of my ancestors. We must put an end to him!$BIf we live through this, tell your Overlord Bor'gorok at the outpost to the north.$BAre you with me?

title: Reclaiming the Quarry
obj_text:
Etaruk, camped near the entrance to the Coldrock Quarry, wants you to kill 12 Beryl Treasure Hunters.
 Beryl Treasure Hunter slain (12)
desc_text: You're a welcome sight, <class>. My name is Etaruk, and I used to be a craftsman here at the Coldrock Quarry.$BMy companions and I were preparing a new set of statues for their last set of rites when we saw those mysterious blue platforms come flying over the plateau.$BWhen they landed, the mages they carried swarmed the quarry, murdering my fellows and plundering the quarry. If we don't stop them, they'll destroy our statues and make off with our artifacts. Will you help me defeat the invaders?

title: Surrender... Not!
obj_text: King Mrgl-Mrgl at Winterfin Retreat has asked you to bring him a Claw of Claximus.
desc_text: The time has come to put an end to this unnatural situation, <name>. For the Winterfin murlocs to have a chance at a future, Claximus must die!$BI want you to take my spare murloc suit and enter the Winterfin Caverns under the pretext of surrender. With the white flag in hand, the murlocs won't attack you.$BYou'll find him in the southwestern most corner of the caverns. Once you get close enough, deal with Claximus. Bring me one of his claws as proof that the grisly deed has been done.

title: Picking Up the Pieces
obj_text: ring 6 Tuskarr Ritual Objects to Elder Atkanok, who stands outside Coldrock Quarry.
desc_text: With the spirits of the murdered craftsmen and shaman at rest, the way is clear for us to complete the ceremonies interrupted by the attack. You must perform a role traditionally reserved for a tuskarr shaman, and you must possess all the necessary ritual items.$BThere is no time to craft new ones, so you will need to scour the quarry for those left by the victims of the attack. Handle these objects with care, <name>, for some are centuries old. You may need to wrest them from the hands of the invaders.

title: Leading the Ancestors Home
obj_text:
Elder Atkanok wants you to guide the spirits of Elder Kesuk, Elder Sagani, and Elder Takret to their stone monuments.
 Elder Kesuk's ceremony completed
 Elder Sagani's ceremony completed
 Elder Takret's ceremony completed
desc_text: With your help, the ancestor spirits can now be guided to their rightful homes, the statues lovingly prepared by Kaskala's craftsmen and shaman.$BThe ceremonies for these ancestors were interrupted during the attack on the quarry, and you will need to complete them. Take with you the objects that you recovered from the quarry, stand in front of the statues with the name markers, and recite this chant.$B<Words in a strange language flood your head, but you have no difficulty recalling them.>

title: Hampering Their Escape
obj_text:
Etaruk, outside the Coldrock Quarry, wants you to destroy the North Platform, the East Platform, and the West Platform.
 East Platform Destroyed
 North Platform Destroyed
 West Platform Destroyed
desc_text: I'm sure you've seen those blue and white platforms hovering over the quarry. They're the transportation the mage hunters used to land their forces here, and now they're loading them up with our artifacts and fragments of our statues.$BWe must stop them before they leave the quarry.$BThe small creatures digging in the quarry carry explosives. Take them and use them to destroy the three floating platforms. The leader keeps watch from a fourth, grounded platform, but we'll deal with him afterward.

title: The Slumbering King
obj_text:
Defeat Queen Angerboda and stop the ritual to awaken King Ymiron. Should you manage to do so, return to Camp Winterhoof and report your success to Chieftain Ashtotem.
 Queen Angerboda slain
desc_text: A sheaf of parchment drops from the still hand of the overlord. Upon it you can discern the outline of the rituals that are taking place in the catacombs below.$BHowever, it appears that the queen of the vrykul, Angerboda, is having difficulty awakening King Ymiron. The ritual is taking place within the large chamber, known as the Winter's Terrace, on the north end of Gjalerbron.$BIf you hurry, you may be able to stop her before it is too late.

title: A Visit to the Curator
obj_text:
Etaruk, on the outskirts of the Coldrock Quarry, wants you to kill Curator Insivius.
 Curator Insivius slain
desc_text: The leader of the mage hunter forces is a fearsome creature called Curator Insivius. My people have hunted the beasts of the seas and land for countless generations, but I've never seen anything like this curator before.$BHe's landed one of those flying disks on the upper rim of the quarry and oversees the operation from there. <name>, I can only believe the ancestors themselves sent you to my rescue and I hope you will help me drive the mage hunters from this quarry once and for all.

title: The Slumbering King
obj_text:
Defeat Queen Angerboda and stop the ritual to awaken King Ymiron. Should you manage to do so, return to Westguard Keep and report your success to Captain Adams.
 Queen Angerboda slain
desc_text: A sheaf of parchment drops from the still hand of the overlord. Upon it you can discern the outline of the rituals that are taking place in the catacombs below.$BHowever, it appears that the queen of the vrykul, Angerboda, is having difficulty awakening King Ymiron. The ritual is taking place within the large chamber, known as the Winter's Terrace, on the north end of Gjalerbron.$BIf you hurry, you may be able to stop her before it is too late.

title: Boiling Point
obj_text:
Imperean wants you to beat Simmer and Churn into submission.  Return to her at the Ruins of Eldra'nath when they have submitted.
 Simmer has submitted
 Churn has submitted
desc_text: Ah, it is information that you crave: the whereabouts and condition of your 'farseer'. He did not see so far as to avoid the trouble which befell him.$BNevertheless, I will give you the means to acquire the knowledge. But first, you will do some things for me.$BNo doubt you have seen the war between fire and water to the south. Simmer keeps boiling Churn's pool, and the two have been battling for ages.$BGo to the Charred Rise and Blistering Pool, and convince each of them to stop their bickering.

title: The Bad Earth
obj_text: ring 8 clods of Scourged Earth to Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: y curing the hides with the blighted earth outside the Temple City, Sage Aeire believes she can create a cloak which will cause most of the Scourge minions to ignore your presence. You should blend right in, she says.$BShe'd best be correct. It's our only chance to gather information and plan our counterattack.$BYou should be able to find the earth she needs poking in the areas to the south and west of the fortress. Bring it to me when you've finished gathering it.

title: Blending In
obj_text:
Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village wants you to wear the Imbued Scourge Shroud in the Temple City of En'kilah and scout the Spire of Blood, the Spire of Pain, and the Spire of Decay.
 Spire of Decay Scouted
 Spire of Blood Scouted
 Spire of Pain Scouted
desc_text: Sage Aeire has finished the shroud. Take it with you and travel to the Temple City of En'kilah. Don the cloak within the city's bounds to hide yourself from most of the Scourge there. This will be our best opportunity to gather information about the enemy's fortifications and leaders.$BWhile wearing the cloak, scout the three large spires on the grounds of the city. While the shroud will shield you from most of the Scourge, the En'kilah abominations will be able to find you if you get too close.

title: Shrouds of the Scourge
obj_text: Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village wants you to bring him 5 Scourged Mammoth Pelts.
desc_text: To the northeast looms the Temple City of En'kilah, the Scourge's seat in Borean Tundra. From behind its walls, the Scourge commander has sent his Nerubians to surround us.$BRemaining on the defensive would doom my people, but my advisors differ in their strategies. Durm would charge in blindly, while Sage Aeire favors stealth.$BThe Temple City has blighted the nearby lands and the native creatures. Aeire believes the pelts of the scourged mammoths can serve as a cloak that may hide an infiltrator.

title: Kaganishu
obj_text:
Retrieve Kaganishu's Fetish and use it upon Farseer Grimwalker's Remains.$BYou will need to give the fetish to Farseer Grimwalker's Spirit inside of Magmoth.
 Farseer Grimwalker set free
desc_text: After my small force of grunts were killed, I was dragged down here and ritually murdered. The snobold who did this is known as Kaganishu.$BThough you have vanquished his shaman helpers, my spirit is still tethered to this place. After he slew me, he created a fetish from my body, which anchors me here. Kaganishu is using it to learn all that I know of shamanism.$BYou must retrieve the fetish from him and use it upon my spirit. Kaganishu is nearby in the caves.$BOnly then will I truly be free.

title: A Courageous Strike
obj_text:
Slay 15 En'kilah Ghouls and 5 En'kilah Necromancers and report back to Durm Icehide at Taunka'le Village.
 En'kilah Ghoul slain (15)
 En'kilah Necromancer slain (5)
desc_text: From the beginning, I've counseled that Chieftain Wintergale should assemble our mighty warriors and attack our enemy at their base. My advice has fallen on deaf ears and he has proven that he'd rather tip-toe around according to Sage Aeire's plans.$BI'll wait no longer. If Chieftain Wintergale is too cowardly to send our warriors into battle, perhaps you'd be willing to show him that a direct attack can succeed. Storm the Temple City of En'kilah and slay all in your path, <name>.

title: Neutralizing the Cauldrons
obj_text:
Sage Aeire at Taunka'le Village wants you to use her totem to neutralize the East Cauldron, the Central Cauldron, and the West Cauldron in the Temple City of En'kilah.
 East Cauldron Cleansed
 Central Cauldron Cleansed
 West Cauldron Cleansed
desc_text: The presence of plague cauldrons within the Temple City of En'kilah worries me greatly, <name>. It's clear that Chieftain Wintergale trusts your judgment and your knowledge of our enemy. Would you help me deal with the cauldrons as you help the chieftain carry out his plans in the Temple City?$BI've prepared a totem which will attack and neutralize the contents of the cauldrons. All you must do is locate the cauldrons and use the totem near each. Each Scourge weapon we destroy brings us closer to victory.

title: Words of Power
obj_text: ring High Priest Naferset's Scroll, High Priest Talet-Kha's Scroll, and High Priest Andorath's Scroll to Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: Within the spires you described dwell the main lieutenants of the Scourge leader, the high priests. Not only do they command the Scourge forces, but they hold the key to the necropolis above, and their master.$BAn endless stream of Scourge minions will overrun us if we can't find and defeat their leader. I cannot leave my people defenseless, however much Durm might want to bring the fight to the enemy. It falls to you, <name>, to slay the high priests and take the scrolls they hold.

title: Get Me Outa Here!
obj_text:
Escort Bonker Togglevolt to safety and then report in with Fizzcrank Fullthrottle at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
 $BBonker Togglevolt escorted to safety.
desc_text: I knew they'd send someone for me sooner or later... turned out to be later, of course.$BI came in here to parlay with the snobolds, but their main shaman, Kaganishu, decided instead that I'd make a tasty snack for Magmothregar.$BWait... what?! They didn't send you?!$BDID THEY FORGET ABOUT ME?!$BOkay, you're here now and that's all that matters.$BAs soon as you break this chain we'll make our way back to the airstrip. Then you can tell Fizzcrank I'm safely back.$BIf he remembers me, that is.

title: The Doctor and the Lich-Lord
obj_text:
Destroy Doctor Razorgrin and Lich-Lord Chillwinter. Then, return to Sage Highmesa just to the south of The Dens of Dying.
 Doctor Razorgrin slain
 Lich-Lord Chillwinter slain
desc_text: There are two... that must... be killed.$BThe doctor and... the lich-lord... are above. Find them... destroy them... before....$B...it is too... late....

title: The Gearmaster
obj_text:
Research the Gearmaster's Manual and return Mechazod's Head to Fizzcrank Fullthrottle.
 The Gearmaster's Manual researched
desc_text: Gearmaster Mechazod is insane! He says that he offers us immortality by removing this so-called 'Curse of the Flesh', but what he's really making are robotic slaves!$B<name>, we're pretty certain that he's still at the pumping station out in the middle of the pools to the east.$BThe last we saw of him, he was in the command hut up top. Go up there and research his stuff.$BYou must confront Mechazod if gnomes everywhere,... no, everyone everywhere, are to stay alive!

title: The Spire of Blood
obj_text: Search the Spire of Blood for more information about the Vial of Fresh Blood.
desc_text: As you inspect the captured blood vial, you realize its contents are still warm. The victim must have just been bled and may still be alive.$BWhat use would the Scourge have for blood? They've never shown an interest in live prisoners in the past. Perhaps if you can locate the source of the blood, you'll be able to discover what the Scourge is planning.

title: It Was The Orcs, Honest!
obj_text:
While disguised as a Warsong orc, plant the Warsong Banner in the corpse of Magmothregar. Then, return with the disguise to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
 Warsong Banner Planted in Magmothregar
desc_text: With all of those outfits you, er, recovered, I fashioned a Warsong orc disguise. I had the genius idea of combining it with some old stuff that I had left hanging around from last Hallows' End, so it should be foolproof!$BHere, in this sack is the disguise and the banner you recovered. Head down into the bowels of Magmoth and slay the magnataur chieftain, Magmothregar.$BIf you're going to convince them to turn their attention on the Warsong orcs, you'll need to plant the banner while disguised.

title: The Culler Cometh
obj_text:
Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Karen the Culler.
 Karen "I Don't Caribou" the Culler slain
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: Near the southern end of this bluff is where you will find the treacherous leader of the caribou trappers. She is a savage like no other, making a mockery out of the carcasses of the slain animals: drinking from their blood and howling to the moons!$BFind this murderer, Karen, and end her worthless existence.$BPrepare yourself properly, <name>. Karen the Culler has indulged in the riches that Nesingwary has lavished upon her! She will be well armed and guarded by lackeys.

title: Happy as a Clam
obj_text:
Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill 10 Loot Crazed Divers.
 Loot Crazed Diver slain (10)
desc_text: To the west of us you will find Lake Kum'uya. It is, as far as we know, the only freshwater giant clam habitat in the world.$BOf course Nesingwary's lackeys are now using the lake as a giant pearl farm. They must be stopped! A lesson must be taught to those that would think to endanger an entire species.$BGo to Lake Kum'uya and locate the loot crazed divers. Slay them until the water runs red! Return to me when a proper example has been made!

title: Unfit for Death
obj_text:
Zaza at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the Pile of Fake Furs to trap 8 Nesingwary Trappers.$B
 Nesingwary Trapper Trapped (8)
desc_text: Just south of us the caribou used to roam freely, peacefully. Then Nesingwary showed up and everything changed. Now the caribou are in a perpetual state of frenzy, always in a panic. They are stalked by the hunters and trappers hidden in the field.$BNesingwary's executioners are unfit for death. They must feel the torture that they put the caribou through!$BTake this pile of fake furs and lay it upon their caribou traps to the south. Watch as the hunters are caught in their own deadly traps!

title: Defeat the Gearmaster
obj_text:
Research the Gearmaster's Manual and return Mechazod's Head to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village.
 The Gearmaster's Manual researched
desc_text: Clearly this Gearmaster Mechazod creature is not in his right mind. If his offer of a cure and immortality means all of us becoming robotic slaves then he must be stopped!$BThe winds that guide me whisper that he's atop the pumping station out in the middle of the pools to the west.$BMost likely, he'll be found in the command hut on top of the structure. Go inside and research his works.$B<name>, you must confront Mechazod if we are to survive!

title: The Nefarious Clam Master...
obj_text:
Slay Clam Master K and return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment.$B
 Clam Master K slain
desc_text: It's despicable, really, to anoint one's self as the "Clam Master," as if they hold mastery over the creatures of the sea. None may make such claims!$BThis "Clam Master" must be found and slain. He was last seen at the wreckage just off the coast of the Abandoned Reach. Find him and kill him.$BOnce this is done, return to Hierophant Cenius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment, north of here, and let her know that the mission was a success.

title: The Abandoned Reach
obj_text: Seek out Hierophant Liandra at the Abandoned Reach.
desc_text: We have just gotten word from Liandra that mercenaries hired by Nesingwary are moving goods off the beach and onto the main Nesingwary shipping vessel. No doubt they plan on making a fortune from their murderous trade!$BShe has asked that we send assistance to the Abandoned Reach, directly south of here on the beachfront of the Borean Tundra.$BMake haste, Liandra awaits you there!

title: Shatter the Orbs!
obj_text:
Destroy 5 Blood Globes and report to Snow Tracker Junek at Taunka'le Village.
 Blood Globes Shattered (5)
desc_text: They're... bleeding the prisoners... putting the blood... in those globes.$B<Grumm's eyes close momentarily and he leans his head back.>$BThe blood... taken up to necropolis... to feed blood prince...$B<Grumm gasps for breath.>$BP-promise... you'll... destroy blood... globes... bring word... to Junek.$B<The snow tracker collapses into unconsciousness.>

title: Khu'nok Will Know
obj_text:
Take the Orphaned Mammoth Calf to Khu'nok the Behemoth in the Borean Tundra.
 $BOrphaned Mammoth Calf Delivered to Khu'nok
Call Mammoth Orphan (Provided)
desc_text: Although you have acted valiantly in freeing the trapped calves, many of them will still die. You see, without a caretaker, these calves must fend for themselves in the wild.$BBut there is a way! Hope yet remains!$BNorth of here in the mammoth fields, bordering the Scalding Pools, you will find Khu'nok the Behemoth: a mammoth as wise as he is ancient. Take this mammoth orphan and present it to Khu'nok. He will know what to do.

title: Ears of Our Enemies
obj_text: Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra has said that he will reward you should you bring him 15 Nesingwary Lackey Ears.
desc_text: Whether they be treasure seekers or bloodthirsty hunters of the wastes, any being that supports Nesingwary and dares to strike at our beloved wildlife shall be considered an enemy of D.E.H.T.A.$BShould you slay these filthy Nesingwary sympathizers, bring me proof of their demise and you shall be rewarded with a blessing from the druids of D.E.H.T.A.

title: Can't Get Ear-nough...
obj_text: Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Outpost in the Borean Tundra has said that he will reward you should you bring him 15 Nesingwary Lackey Ears.
desc_text: Whether they be treasure seekers or bloodthirsty hunters of the wastes, any being that supports Nessingwary and does dare strike at our beloved wildlife shall be considered an enemy of D.E.H.T.A. Should you slay these filthy Nesingwary sympathizers, bring me proof of their demise and you shall be rewarded with a blessing from the druids of D.E.H.T.A.

title: Ned, Lord of Rhinos...
obj_text:
Killinger the Den Watcher at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Nedar, Lord of Rhinos and his companion, "Lunchbox."
 Nedar, Lord of Rhinos slain
 "Lunchbox" slain
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: West of here, on the high bluffs above Lake Kum'uya, roams a despicable being known as Nedar. The self proclaimed "Lord of Rhinos" hunts the wastes for the injured or young - rhinos unable to defend themselves against Ned's cowardly attacks. To add insult to injury, Ned has raised a rhino of his own to become his mount and bodyguard.$BIt is a rare thing that D.E.H.T.A. would ever call for the death of an animal, but Ned's tainted rhino must be disposed of... Kill them both and return to me.

title: Help Those That Cannot Help Themselves
obj_text:
Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the D.E.H.T.A. Trap Smasher to free 8 Mammoth Calves.
 Mammoth Calf Freed (8)
desc_text: They're majestic beasts, aren't they?$B<Lathorius points towards the mammoths of the northern tundra.>$BWith each passing day their numbers diminish. Demons that call themselves hunters slay the beasts for sport and riches.$B<Lathorius' face contorts with anger.>$BIt's the whimpers that drive me to madness, <name>. You can hear them, carried by the wind. The mammoth calves, trapped in the hunters' vile traps, call out to us.$BTake this hammer and smash those traps. Free the calves!

title: The Fall of Taunka'le Village
obj_text: Speak to Mother Tauranook outside the gates of Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: We are lost, <name>. This place has been our home for many generations, but it is no longer safe. There remains only death... Death and a memory of what used to be.$BI have called for the evacuation of Taunka'le. All remaining taunka must leave at once and make their way to our capital city, Icemist, located in the Dragonblight.$B<Wintergale points east.>$BYou must help get my people to safety, <name>. Mother Tauranook awaits you at the village gates. Hurry! The Scourge closes in from all sides!

title: Not On Our Watch
obj_text: Hierophant Liandra at the Abandoned Reach in the Borean Tundra wants you to recover 12 Shipments of Animal Parts.
desc_text: Strewn across this beach, amidst the flotsam and jetsam, are crates and sacks of animal parts. It would seem that Nesingwary is in cahoots with the Northsea Freebooters. Those dirty pirates are transporting the goods that Nesingwary's murderous lackeys gather offshore. No doubt they will end up in the homes and on the backs of wealthy, unscrupulous individuals across Azeroth.$BThis won't happen. Not on our watch. Bring me all shipments that you find upon this beach. They'll never have them!

title: Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer
obj_text: Kill Kaw the Mammoth Destroyer and recover Kaw's War Halberd. Deliver Kaw's War Halberd to Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment in the Borean Tundra.
desc_text: You cannot defeat the being responsible for the slaughter of my kind by yourself. The mammoths of the tundra will help you!$BVenture forth to the plains and find a mammoth bull. He will allow you to mount him and control his movements and actions. Ride upon his back and find Kaw, north of here at Kaw's Roost. Together, you will be the instrument of Kaw's demise.$BDestroy Kaw's armies and take from Kaw his coveted war halberd. Return to Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Encampment should you succeed.

title: Across Transborea
obj_text:
Escort the Taunka'le Evacuees across Transborea to Wartook Iceborn on the border of the Dragonblight.$B
 $BSecure Passage to Dragonblight
desc_text: The path across Transborea, to the east, is the only way to reach the Dragonblight. Many perils await you as you make your journey across the tundra. Beware the Scourge and its influence upon the beasts of the land. Rumors have started to spread about our very own taunka brothers and sisters rising from the dead and attacking caravans on their way to the Dragonblight! Defend your caravan and get the evacuees to safety!$BWartook Iceborn waits for you across the bridge leading into the Dragonblight.

title: The Assassination of Harold Lane
obj_text:
Arch Druid Lathorius at the D.E.H.T.A. Outpost in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Harold Lane.
 Harold Lane slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: You have done much for the animals of the Borean Tundra, <name>. Nesingwary's lackeys have been beaten back and taught a lesson that they will not soon forget.$BHarold Lane, the primary agent responsible for the mass slaughters in Nagrand, has been identified as the man in charge of Nesingwary operations in the tundra. He is stationed at Lake Kum'uya, west of here.$B<Lathorius hands you an intricately carved oak horn.>$BFind Lane and kill him. Use this horn should you require our aid.

title: Buying Some Time
obj_text:
Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat in Borean Tundra wants you to inflict 20 casualties against the Scourge inside the Temple City of En'kilah.  Use Lurid's Bones if you need assistance.
 $BEn'kilah Casualty (20)

 En'kilah Necromancer
 En'kilah Abomination
 En'kilah Crypt Fiend
 En'kilah Gargoyle
$B

 En'kilah Ghoul
 En'kilah Necrolord
 [PH] Icecrown Gauntlet Ghoul
 En'kilah Unit
desc_text: Now that we have this phylactery, I shouldn't have any problems getting the information I need.  It won't take long for the Scourge in the Temple City to notice something's up, however.$BI won't be able to fend off a full scale attack here.  Or maybe I would... but I'd rather not find out.$BI want you to head down there and inflict some casualties.  Hopefully they'll be distracted long enough for these two to spill their guts... figuratively, of course.  Take Lurid with you, he might be of aid.

title: Surrounded!
obj_text:
Corporal Venn at Death's Stand wants you to slay 7 Ziggurat Defenders.
 Ziggurat Defender slain (7)
desc_text: Our situation is nearly hopeless.  We were ordered to take the Wailing Ziggurat with a handful of men.$BWe'll be lucky if we can hold this position against the Scourge.  We're outnumbered, injured and have no escape route.$BIf you can take some of the pressure off of us, we might be able to solidify our position.  Kill some of the undead circling the structure - we'll hold off their advance.

title: Muahit's Wisdom
obj_text: Find Elder Muahit in Kaskala.
desc_text: Listen, <name>.  Warriors like me are replaceable.  If I fall, my brothers and cousins will pick up my spear and fight.$BMy people cannot survive without wise elders.  Stubborn Muahit, our most venerable shaman, refuses to leave the altar to Tayutka in the central island.  We would suffer a significant loss if he was slain by these monsters.$BYou are an outsider, maybe he'll listen to you.  Show him reason... ask him to flee to the safety of Unu'pe before it's too late.

title: Not Without a Fight!
obj_text:
Ataika wants you to slay 12 Kvaldir Raiders in Kaskala.
 Kvaldir Raider slain (12)
desc_text: Kaskala is a sacred place for us, <race>.  Our ancestors were guided here by the spirit of Tayutka herself.$BNow these foul creatures attack us from the mists without any provocation.$BWe will show them that our spears are not merely for whaling.  Fight alongside us, friend.  Perhaps my people might repay you some time in the future.

title: Words of Power
obj_text: Thassarian at the Wailing Ziggurat wants you to go to the Temple City of En'kilah and retrieve High Priest Talet-Kha's Scroll from the Spire of Pain, High Priest Naferset's Scroll from the Spire of Decay and High Priest Andorath's Scroll at the Spire of Blood.
desc_text: The lich has spoken, <name>.  The high priests of En'kilah hold the secret to entering Naxxanar.$BGo to the Spire of Blood, the Spire of Pain and the Spire of Decay and slay each of the priests.$BReturn once you've obtained the three scrolls.

title: Preparing for the Worst
obj_text: Utaik wants you to gather 8 Kaskala Supplies in Kaskala.
desc_text: Dark times are upon us.  Karkut's spirit walks the earth and gathers the spirits of dead tuskarr.$BThe sons of the mist have taken many of our brethren.  Soon dear Kaskala will be reduced to ashes.$BThere is hope yet.  Not for us perhaps, but we've sent our families to Unu'pe.  We fight here so there may be a future for them.$BThey will need supplies or they will starve.  There's not enough food in Unu'pe.  Salvage any supplies before it's too late for our families.

title: Spirits Watch Over Us
obj_text: Elder Muahit at Njord's Breath Bay wants you to find Iruk's corpse in the water and retrieve Issliruk's totem.
desc_text: Powerful spirits watch over my tribe -- Kaskala will not be lost.$BIssliruk will give us courage, Tayutka will make sure our survivors always have food and shelter and Karkut will watch over the fallen so they do not lose their way.$BIssliruk's guidance is the one we need the most right now.  I asked my nephew, Iruk, to bring me Issliruk's totem, but the Kvaldir's spears struck him down and his body fell into the waters to the north.  Bring me the totem, <name>.  Don't let my nephew's death be in vain.

title: A Tauren Among Taunka
obj_text: Seek out Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp.
desc_text: <Wartook points northeast.>$BShe is quite kind, you know. If it were not for your emissary, the surviving refugees may have given up hope. While she may not be taunka by birthright, the tribe has taken to her as a village elder for the time being.$BIf you are who I think you are, please go and pay Emissary Brighthoof a visit inside the refugee camp. She has been waiting for you.

title: Let Nothing Go To Waste
obj_text: Retrieve 6 Stolen Moa'ki Goods from the wolvar. Return them to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor.
desc_text: The wolvar have always been our natural enemies. But the incursion of your peoples into the Great Dragonblight has forced them into a small space upon the glade to the north.$BCombined with the land's upheaval this morning, they have become even more aggressive than ever before. They have made several raids upon our goods... things that we'll need if we are to survive the trek from our home here.$BAs a sign of good faith and friendship, retrieve our goods from the Snowfall Glade wolvar.

title: Pride of the Horde
obj_text:
lood Guard Roh'kill at the Westwind Refugee Camp in the Dragonblight wants you to slay 15 Anub'ar Ambushers.$B
 Anub'ar Ambusher slain (15)
desc_text: I was one of the guards chosen to escort the caravan carrying the armament shipment to this camp. The attack came fast and without warning. We fought and killed dozens of the beasts, but in the end there were simply too many. Tor'zin and I barely made it out alive...$BIf not for our injuries we would be out in the woods hunting down those fiends ourselves. Will you help us regain our lost pride? Search the woods east of here for Anub'ar Nerubians and kill them! For the Horde!

title: Your Presence is Required at Agmar's Hammer
obj_text: Speak with the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: <class>, I know these tuskarr will ask you to do many favors for them, but you must get to Agmar's Hammer with all due haste!$BThe upheaval in the land this morning is sure to have broader repercussions than just inconveniencing the natives.$BThe Hammer is westward past the intersection of the road leading north out of the harbor. Archmage Aethas Sunreaver himself will be expecting you!

title: Into the Fold
obj_text: Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp in the Dragonblight wants you to recover 10 Horde Armaments.
desc_text: efore we can officially bring these taunka into the Horde we must recover our armaments from the Anub'ar Nerubians that infest the nearby woods.
