The armaments were lost when a caravan from Agmar's Hammer was ambushed by the Scourge late last night.$BVenture out into the woods to the east of Westwind Refugee Camp and recover those armaments, <race>.

title: The Taunka and the Tauren
obj_text: Seek out Emissary Brighthoof at the Westwind Refugee Camp.
desc_text: The Scourge have seized control of the capital city of the taunka, Icemist Village! All living taunka that escaped the massacre are being held in protective custody at the Westwind Refugee Camp on the western border of Dragonblight.$BLord Hellscream believes that the taunka must join the Horde if they are to survive and has sent a tauren emissary to Westwind to bolster our relationship with the winter tauren. Travel to Westwind Refugee Camp and seek out Emissary Brighthoof. You will assist her.

title: Your Presence is Required at Stars' Rest
obj_text: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: <class>, I know these tuskarr will ask you to do many favors for them, but you must get to Stars' Rest with all due haste!$BThe upheaval in the land this morning is sure to have broader repercussions than just inconveniencing the natives.$BStars' Rest is westward past the intersection of the road leading north out of the harbor. There is an archmage there named Modera. She will be expecting you.

title: Avenge this Atrocity!
obj_text:
Kill any combination of 15 Dragonblight Mage Hunters, Moonrest Stalkers, Surge Needle Sorcerers, and Focus Wizards. After you have done that, return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens.
 $BBlue Dragonflight forces at Moonrest Gardens slain (15)

 Surge Needle Sorcerer
 Moonrest Stalker
 Focus Wizard
$B

 Dragonblight Mage Hunter
 Dragonblight Mage Hunter
desc_text: These so-called mage hunters came here and destroyed our resting place.$BAvenge us, or I will see to it that your base of operations is overrun with the spirits of the dead!

title: Agmar's Hammer
obj_text: Travel to Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight and speak to Overlord Agmar.
desc_text: Directly east of this refugee camp stands Agmar's Hammer - testament to the Hordes' power in the Dragonblight.$BWhile I have no doubt that our Horde brothers and sisters are already seeing the result of your efforts to bring the taunka into the Horde, I want you to deliver news of your success to Overlord Agmar in person.$BGo now, <name>! Race the winds! East to Agmar's Hammer!

title: Blood Oath of the Horde
obj_text:
Speak to the taunka at Westwind Refugee Camp and make 5 of them pledge their allegiance to the Horde.$BReturn the Blood Oath of the Horde to Emissary Brighthoof once you have completed this task.
 $BTaunka Admitted Into the Horde (5)

 Taunka'le Refugee
 Taunka'le Refugee
$B

 Taunka'le Refugee
desc_text: They are ready, <name>. These taunka will all willingly join the Horde and give all that they have to see the Scourge driven from this world.$B<Brighthoof hands you a scroll bearing the insignia of the Horde.>$BWithin this scroll you will find the blood oath of the Horde. Tradition dictates that our new taunka brothers and sisters utter the sacred words herein.$BTake the scroll and swear the taunka into the Horde, commander. Return the scroll to me when you have completed your duty.

title: Rifle the Bodies
obj_text: Find the Moonrest Gardens Plans and return them to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: The Moonrest Gardens to the southwest were the final resting place of a noble group of Highborne elves. It was also a powerful ley line nexus.$BThe blue dragonflight used a magical device they call a surge needle to destroy that nexus, freeing the power to redirect at their will.$BI need more information and I hope that you will get it for me.$BAfter the upheaval at the ruins, the ghosts of the Highborne rose up and decimated half of the mage hunters present. Go rifle their corpses for clues.

title: Rifle the Bodies
obj_text: Find the Moonrest Gardens Plans and return them to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: The Moonrest Gardens to the southwest were the final resting place of a group of Highborne elves. It was also a ley line nexus.$BThe blue dragonflight used a magical device they call a surge needle to destroy that nexus, freeing the power to redirect at their will.$BI want more information and you are going to get it for me!$BAfter the land was destroyed at the ruins, the ghosts of the Highborne rose up and decimated half of the mage hunters there. Go rifle their corpses for clues.

title: Last Rites
obj_text:
Go to the Temple City of En'kilah and find the teleportation orb beneath the floating Scourge citadel of Naxxanar.  Use it to reach the top and help Thassarian there.
 Last Rites
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: I served Arthas in death, because I had no choice.  He had control over my will and my body.  The Cult of the Damned serves Arthas in life... willingly.$BNow that we know the words of power to enter Naxxanar we can put an end to the cultist blight.  Go to En'kilah and look for the teleportation orb beneath the floating citadel.$BWork your way up and meet me at the top.  Arm yourself with what courage you can, we might not make it out of this alive.

title: Signs of Big Watery Trouble
obj_text: Inform Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor about the wrecked crab trap.
desc_text: This crab trap appears to have been destroyed by something much larger than the nearby circling sharks.$BPerhaps Tua'kea, the fisherman at Moa'ki Harbor, should be told about this?

title: The Bait
obj_text: Obtain The Flesh of "Two Huge Pincers" and deliver it to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor.
desc_text: I'm sure of it... our ancient aquatic nemesis, Tu'u'gwar, "He Who Plays With Food", has returned. We must lay a trap for him, you and I.$BIf Tu'u'gwar has one weakness it's his stomach. There's one meat for certain that he'd never be able to pass up.$B"Two Huge Pincers", the mother of all crabs, Kili'ua, paces upon her island out in the waters to the southwest. You must pay her a visit and return with her meat.

title: Tua'kea's Crab Traps
obj_text: Collect 8 of Tua'kea's Crab Traps and return them to him at Moa'ki Harbor.
desc_text: With all of the troubles, I've lost my assistants. I was wondering if maybe you could help me?$BI have many crab traps under the waves of the harbor. Will you retrieve them for me? I'm too old for that sort of thing and the waters can be very dangerous.$BPlease, take this bladder. It will help you to breathe while you're down there.

title: Elder Mana'loa
obj_text: Speak with the statue, Elder Mana'loa, at Indu'le Village.
desc_text: My people....$B<The mystic is on the verge of breaking down.>$BWhile your spirit was flying through the village, I sensed that Elder Mana'loa took notice of you. <name>, he wishes to speak with you. The stone elders are revered by us as fonts of ancient wisdom.$BThe elder must want to help. Seek him in the northwest corner of the village.

title: Spiritual Insight
obj_text:
Speak with Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor after you have attained your spiritual insight.
 $BSpiritual insight concerning Indu'le Village attained.
desc_text: <race>, we have not heard from our people at Indu'le Village since the ground shook and was torn apart!$BHave you ever been upon a vision quest? You've bested Loguhn, so you must be capable.$BI will give you a special incense to sprinkle into my brazier. Breathe deep from its vapors and your spirit will be sent aloft to view what has transpired at Indu'le.$BAs your spirit soars, I will be able to look through your eyes.

title: I'm Stuck in this Damned Cage... But Not For Long!
obj_text: Collect an Engine-Core Crystal, a Magical Gyroscope, and a Piloting Scourgestone. Deliver them to Tinky Wickwhistle at Talramas.
desc_text: The cultists magicked me into this cage and there's no door to it. Little did they know that I'm the chief transmatter engineer for the airstrip!$BWith your help, and a little elbow-grease, I won't be in here for long.$BI'm going to need an engine-core crystal from one of the ghouls in here, a magical gyroscope from their doctor, and a piloting scourgestone from the lich-lord up top.$BWith all of that stuff, I should be able to make a port device to get back to Fizzcrank's and escape the gnome way!

title: Freedom for the Lingering
obj_text:
Put to rest any combination of 15 Indu'le Fishermen, Mystics and Warriors, then return to Elder Mana'loa at Indu'le Village.
 $BIndu'le spirits put to rest (15)

 Indu'le Mystic
 Indu'le Warrior
$B

 Indu'le Fisherman
desc_text: The sacred ground of the elves to the west has been torn asunder. Now their magic is moving through the land causing ruin where it flows.$BThe souls of the Kalu'ak are in danger as the blue dragons forces attempt to control the magic.$BThe power came up through the lake, instantly slaying most in the village. Those that survived were driven insane.$B<name>, you must release these spirits so that they may move on. Leave the deranged living alone; they may yet regain their sanity in time.

title: Conversing With the Depths
obj_text:
Commune with The Pearl of the Depths and do as the sea-goddess Oacha'noa instructs.$BShould you survive the ordeal, return to Toalu'u the Mystic at Moa'ki Harbor.
 $BOacha'noa's compulsion obeyed.
desc_text: The watery goddess, Oacha'noa, must be consulted; only she will know what the destiny of the Kalu'ak is to be. And only The Pearl of the Depths can call her forth from the murky nether.$BOff the coast to the southwest rises The Briny Pinnacle. Atop it sits the altar upon which the pearl rests.$BCommune at the altar and Oacha'noa is certain to hear your call. Do as she says lest you incur her wrath and bring ruin upon all of the tuskarr.$BShould you survive, return to the mystic.

title: Victory Nears...
obj_text: Speak to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: There remain only two primary threats that stand in our way. One is the dread citadel of Naxxramas, far to the east, above the Alliance fortress of Wintergarde and the other is the Pit of Narjun, exit point for the undead armies of Azjol'Nerub. It is from the Pit of Narjun that the Anub'ar Nerubians assaulted and ultimately razed the taunka village of Icemist.$BWe will destroy the Anub'ar and close off the Pit of Narjun.$BReport to Senior Sergeant Juktok for your mission orders.

title: Message from the West
obj_text:
Read the Letter from Saurfang and then destroy it.$BSpeak to Messenger Torvus once you have completed this task.
 $BLetter from Saurfang read and destroyed
desc_text: <Torvus shakes your hand, giving you a letter in the process.>$B<Torvus speaks under his breath.>$BJust play along, <name>.$BIt is good to see you here, soldier! Lord Hellscream has undoubtedly sent his strongest warriors to Lord Agmar!$B<Torvus speaks under his breath.>$BRead it and then destroy it in the fire pot next to me.

title: From the Depths of Azjol-Nerub
obj_text:
Explore the Pit of Narjun and return with your findings to Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer.
 $BPit of Narjun Explored
desc_text: The undead Nerubians that attacked Icemist Village came from a gigantic sinkhole known as the Pit of Narjun. If left alone, those fiends will no doubt flank our forces at the Wrathgate and end our march to victory.$BI need eyes on the ground, <name>. You are to head west and investigate the Pit of Narjun. We need to locate their primary exit point and seal it off! Find me that location.

title: An Enemy in Arthas
obj_text:
Kilix the Unraveler at the Pit of Narjun in the Dragonblight has asked that you slay 6 Anub'ar Underlords.$B
 Anub'ar Underlord slain (6)
desc_text: We are in the midst of a civil war. At the heart of this world the last living members of my species defend themselves against total annihilation. The Lich King seeks to rule the kingdom of Azjol-Nerub at any cost. Those that do not acquiesce are branded enemies of the Scourge and marked for death.$BIn Arthas we both have an enemy...$BJoin our cause and rid this place of the taint of Anub'ar! Let Anub'arak himself hear the anguish of their death cries!

title: Seared Scourge
obj_text:
Mack at Granite Springs wants you to use his grog to burn 30 Famished Scourge Trolls.
 Scourge Trolls Burned (30)
desc_text:
Whatcha waitin' fer, <class>? Them shcourged trolls ain't gunna kill themselves!$BYou know the drill. Git up ta Drak'Tharon up north... Take some o thish here grog and hurl it at 'em from a distance....  Then jusht sit back an' watch 'em burn.
                Progress
Ya getter done, <name>?$B
Completion
Well done!$B<Mack laughs hysterically for a moment.>$BAww, come on now. That was funny...hic.$B
Rewards
You will receive: 5 $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
20,300 experience$B

Related

title: Black Blood of Yogg-Saron
obj_text: orus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to recover 10 Black Blood of Yogg-Saron Samples.
desc_text: Angrathar, the Wrathgate... I watched as the metal holding the gate together pulsed and undulated as if it were alive! In 50 years I've never seen metal "breathe."$BOnly ones who knew anything about it were the tuskarr. They called it the "Black Blood of Yogg-Saron" and told me to keep my distance.$BThere's a sinkhole outside Icemist Village to the west called the Pit of Narjun. I've heard of these sinkholes being rich with this strange ore. If you head that way, could you try and get me some samples?

title: The Lost Empire
obj_text: Deliver Kilix's Battle Plan to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer to the east.
desc_text: You have proven that you are willing to assist the Azjol Empire in its time of need and as such the Azjol Empire will assist the Horde.$BTake this scroll back to your leader. It documents the strengths and weaknesses of the Nerubians attacking Icemist Village. Consider it a gesture of good faith - a willingness to help your people. Use the knowledge on those pages to crush the Anub'ar and you will have done a service for us all.$BFarewell, <race>.

title: The Might of the Horde
obj_text:
Senior Sergeant Juktok at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Warsong Battle Standard at Icemist Village and defend it against attackers.$BReturn the Warsong Battle Standard when you are finished.
 $BWarsong Battle Standard Defended
desc_text: The taunka are now our brothers in arms. We must show our solidarity and retake Icemist Village.$BYou will find Icemist Village west of Agmar's Hammer, sitting at the foot of the mountains. Travel there and challenge the Anub'ar Nerubians! Plant our beloved Horde banner at Icemist Village and destroy all that dare come to tear it down!$BLet the Anub'ar feel the true might of the Horde! Let our battle standard be the last thing that they see before death!

title: Strength of Icemist
obj_text: Find Banthok Icemist at Icemist Village.
desc_text: <Greatmother Icemist bows.>$BIt is an honor to meet you, hero. It is because of your actions that many of us are here now, alive and ready for battle against the Scourge.$BYou have done so much for us that it shames me to ask you for your assistance once more. Despite my pleas, my only son, Banthok, left here to go in search of his father, High Chief Icemist. He was last seen heading west, towards Icemist Village. Please find Banthok. I do not know what I would do if I lost my son.

title: Scourge Armaments
obj_text: orus Ironbender at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to bring him 8 Scourge Armaments.
desc_text: I can't make a damned thing out of this ore. It simply will not hold together! Despite my best efforts the Scourge metal will not bend!$BPerhaps if I had some samples of some forged Scourge armaments I might be able to reverse engineer the process by which the items are created.$BIcemist Village is crawling with armored Scourge Nerubians. Go there and get me some Scourge armaments! With your help I might actually succeed in creating something from this ore.$BYou'll find Icemist to the west.

title: Projections and Plans
obj_text:
Get close to and observe the projection atop the Surge Needle floating above Moonrest Gardens.$BAfterward, return to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest with the information.
 Object on the Surge Needle observed
desc_text: This is a teleportation device. If I had to guess, I'd say that it leads to the surge needle platform floating above the Moonrest Gardens to the west.$BI need you to use it to investigate what's up there. It appears that the device works both ways so you shouldn't have to jump off.$BI expect that once you teleport to the top of the surge needle, there will be some sort of apparatus on it to observe.$BYou should be able to use the teleporter from anywhere within the gardens.

title: The Focus on the Beach
obj_text:
Obtain the Ley Line Focus Control Ring and use it to gain information from the Ley Line Focus on the Glittering Strand.$BThen, return to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
 Ley line focus information retrieved
desc_text: The mage hunter forces are active on the Glittering Strand to the south of Moonrest Gardens. My guess is that you'll find a heavily guarded focus on the beach and a captain who is in charge of it.$BNo doubt the captain of the force down there will have some sort of controlling device on their person. Get the controller and use it on the focus.$BWith any skill on your part, we'll be able to get some more information about what they're really up to out there.

title: Attack by Air!
obj_text: Speak with Valnok Windrager at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: They have seen the might of the Horde by land, now they must feel it from the air! I want you to report to Valnok Windrager at once! You will find him here, in Agmar's Hammer.$BValnok has already been briefed on your mission and is expecting you.

title: Projections and Plans
obj_text:
Get close to and observe the projection atop the Surge Needle floating above Moonrest Gardens.$BAfterward, return to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer with the information.
 Object on the Surge Needle observed
desc_text: This is a teleportation device. If I had to guess, I'd say that it leads to the surge needle platform floating above the Moonrest Gardens to the southwest.$B<name>, I need you to use it to investigate what's up there. It appears that the device works both ways so you shouldn't have to jump off.$BI expect that once you teleport up to the top of the surge needle, there will be some sort of apparatus on it to observe.$BYou should be able to use the teleporter from anywhere within the gardens.

title: Marked for Death: High Cultist Zangus
obj_text: Kill High Cultist Zangus and return High Cultist Zangus's Head to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: I witnessed his treachery with my own eyes! The traitor led an Anub'ar assault on this stronghold, taking out some of my best soldiers.$B<Gort shakes his head.>$BHe'd been working with the Scourge the whole time and we didn't have a clue! How many more like Zangus are there? We'll find 'em all and when we do...$B<Gort makes a cutting motion across his neck.>$BFirst on the list is Zangus. Our scouts report that he is hiding in The Pit of Narjun, west of here. Find him, kill him, bring me his head.

title: The Flesh-Bound Tome
obj_text: Return the Flesh-bound Tome to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: The tome is bound in flesh and appears to be bleeding. Upon examination you discover page after page filled with strange symbols that appear to be written in blood.$BWhatever knowledge is held within the pages of this tome could be important. Return it to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer, east of Icemist Village.

title: The Focus on the Beach
obj_text:
Obtain the Ley Line Focus Control Ring and use it to gain information from the Ley Line Focus on the Glittering Strand.$BThen, return to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
 Ley line focus information retrieved
desc_text: The mage hunter forces are active on the Glittering Strand to the south of Moonrest Gardens. My guess is that you'll find a heavily guarded focus on the beach and a captain who is in charge of it.$BNo doubt the captain will have some sort of controlling device on their person. Get the controller and use it on the focus.$BWith any luck, we'll be able to get some more information about what they're really up to out there.

title: A Strange Device
obj_text: Deliver Goramosh's Strange Device to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: Picking up this strange device, you are certain that it is magical in nature. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to connote any other kind of use.$BPerhaps the archmage back at Stars' Rest to the east of the Moonrest Gardens would be able to tell what it's used for?

title: Atop the Woodlands
obj_text:
Obtain the Ley Line Focus Control Amulet and use it to gain information from the Ley Line Focus in the Lothalor Woodlands.$BThen, return to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
 Ley line focus information retrieved
desc_text: I'm convinced that there must be more of those foci, each of them in-turn redirecting the ley line energies. We still don't know precisely what they're doing with all of that power, though.$BMy guess is that you'll find another one atop the Lothalor Woodlands to the southeast. Once again you'll need to find the person in charge and take whatever controlling device they have in their possession as I'm sure that each focus has its own.$BBe careful, <name>, those woods are very dangerous.

title: A Strange Device
obj_text: Deliver Goramosh's Strange Device to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: Picking up this strange device, you are certain that it is magical in nature. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to connote any other kind of use.$BPerhaps the archmage back at Agmar's Hammer to the northeast of the Moonrest Gardens would be able to tell what it's used for?

title: Atop the Woodlands
obj_text:
Obtain the Ley Line Focus Control Amulet and use it to gain information from the Ley Line Focus in the Lothalor Woodlands.$BThen, return to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
 Ley line focus information retrieved
desc_text: I'm convinced that there must be more of those foci, each of them in-turn redirecting the ley line energies. We still don't know precisely what they're doing with all of that power, though.$BMy guess is that you'll find another one atop the Lothalor Woodlands to the south. Once again you'll need to find the person in charge and take whatever controlling device they have in their possession as I'm sure that each focus has its own.$BBe quick about your business, <class>. I feel that time may be running out.

title: Blightbeasts be Damned!
obj_text:
Use Valnok's Flare Gun to call down a Kor'kron War Rider at Icemist Village. Mount the Kor'kron War Rider and then use it to kill 25 Anub'ar Blightbeasts!$BReturn to Valnok Windrager at Agmar's Hammer should you complete this mission.
 Anub'ar Blightbeast slain (25)
desc_text: You've no doubt seen the army of Anub'ar blightbeasts that are being constructed at Icemist Village. The Anub'ar have plans to send those monsters against our soldiers at the Wrathgate. This cannot happen!$BVenture west to Icemist Village with this flare gun and use it to call down one of my war riders. Climb on its back and command it to destroy the blightbeasts that are out of reach from the ground!$BOnce you have decimated their aerial forces, return to me for your reward!

title: A Little Help Here? DEPRECATED
obj_text:
Corporal Venn at Death's Stand wants you to kill 8 Ziggurat Defenders.
 Ziggurat Defender slain (8)
desc_text: We were sent here to take over the Howling Ziggurat, due north.  We weren't expecting to make it back alive.... hell, we already lost half our crew.$BTassarian was on point and the higher ups... well, they didn't like something about him.$BHe took off this morning... he might've gone to the ziggurat on his own.  But right now we have more pressing matters to worry about.  The Scourge keeps getting closer and closer to the camp, we need to take care of them -- now!

title: Chains of the Anub'ar
obj_text: anthok Icemist at Icemist Village in the Dragonblight has asked that you bring him Anok'ra's Key Fragment, Tivax's Key Fragment and Sinok's Key Fragment.
desc_text: They have my father bound by magical chains in the middle of Icemist Village. From what I have been able to gather, the prison is controlled by three powerful Anub'ar magi - each holding a piece of the key.$BScour Icemist and locate the magi. Kill them and take their key fragments. With all three pieces we might be able to free my father. Once he is free...$BRetribution will come swiftly.

title: The Son of Karkut
obj_text: Go east to Death's Stand, just beyond Unu'pe.
desc_text: The man you seek went far to the east, to a place near the coast called Death's Stand, beyond Unu'pe.$BBe careful if you go in search of him, <name>.  He bore the mark of Karkut... he who watches over the dead.

title: A Letter for Home
obj_text: Deliver Captain Malin's Letter to Commander Saia Azuresteel at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: You find a letter secreted in the lining of her robes. It reads:$B"Father,$BI'm sorry for disappearing on you. If you're reading this letter, then I'm dead.$BI've been forced to work for Malygos's armies under threat that our family would be killed if I didn't. I feel so ashamed.$BIf there's anything that you can do to fight them, don't worry about me. I have them fooled and I'm sabotaging them from the inside.$BI love you, Daddy!$BEm"$BCommander Saia Azuresteel will want to see this!

title: Thassarian, the Death Knight
obj_text: Look for Thassarian inside the Wailing Ziggurat, north of Death's Stand.
desc_text: Well, <name>, you helped us out... so I figure it's only fair that we help you out as well.$BYou're looking for Thassarian?  He disappeared this morning.  We think he went off north to the Wailing Ziggurat.  If we hadn't fought side by side by him we'd even think he was a traitor.$BSee, he's a Death Knight... and I know they're on our side and all... but it wasn't too long ago they were servants of Arthas.$BBut not Thassarian, he's a good guy.  Go to the Wailing Ziggurat, see if he's doing okay.

title: Strengthen the Ancients
obj_text:
Use the Bark of the Walkers to strengthen 3 Lothalor Ancients and then return to Sarendryana at Stars' Rest.
 Lothalor Ancient strengthened (3)
desc_text: It's not only the <race> race that has been impacted by what the blue dragonflight forces have done. The ancients of the Lothalor Woods to the southeast have been affected as well.$BSome have been corrupted-- avoid them at all costs--but most can still be saved. However, the treants of the woods seem to be immune to the magic seeping through the land and the arcane wyrms that have come with it.$BAsk the treants for their bark and feed it to the ancients. Hopefully that will be enough to save them.

title: A Letter for Home
obj_text: Deliver Lieutenant Ta'zinni's Letter to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: You find a letter secreted in the lining of his robes. It reads:$B"Deino,$BTa'zinni sorry for disappearing on ya. If you're reading this letter, then I be dead.$BI been forced to work for Malygos's armies under threat that the family would be killed if I didn't. Ta'zinni wasn't gonna let that happen!$BDon't worry about me, just keep your kids safe. I have them fooled and I'm sabotaging them from the inside.$BI love you, sistah!$BTa'zinni"$BOverlord Agmar is sure to want to see this!

title: Search Indu'le Village
obj_text: Search for the commander of the mage hunter forces at Indu'le Village and Lake Indu'le.
desc_text: I'm certain that you'll find the next ley line focus somewhere in the remains of Indu'le Village to the southeast. The problem is, we've had absolutely no reports of there being one there.$BIf you would, please investigate the village for any signs of the focus or the mage hunters and their commander in the area.$BDon't forget to search in the lake if you have to.

title: Strengthen the Ancients
obj_text:
Use the Bark of the Walkers to strengthen 3 Lothalor Ancients and then return to Earthwarden Grife at Agmar's Hammer.
 Lothalor Ancient strengthened (3)
desc_text: The ancients of the Lothalor Woods to the south are being corrupted by arcane wyrms... wyrms which have risen out of the ground!$BThose that are already corrupted are deadly and of no use to us, but most can still be saved. Luckily, the treants of the woods seem to be immune to everything happening up there.$BAsk the treants for their bark and when you get some, feed it to the ancients. This should strengthen them.$BNow leave me to my business! I have to keep an eye on these apothecaries.

title: Containing the Rot
obj_text:
Soar Hawkfury at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to kill 15 Infected Wildlife and recover a Rot Resistant Organ.
 $BInfected Wildlife slain (15)

 Blighted Elk
 Rabid Grizzly
$B

 Infected Wildlife
desc_text: With Scourge comes death and disease. We often overlook that the wildlife of a Scourge infested area is ravaged and ultimately destroyed by rot and contagion.$BFor most of the indigenous beasts of the Dragonblight it is too late. The festering disease that the Scourge brings has already infected the beasts and they are now rabid and rotting.$BYou must venture west, towards the Pit of Narjun, and cull the infected wildlife. Check their corpses for a preserved organ as we need one to devise a vaccine.

title: Search Indu'le Village
obj_text: Search for the commander of the mage hunter forces at Indu'le Village and Lake Indu'le.
desc_text: I'm certain that you'll find the next ley line focus somewhere in the remains of Indu'le Village to the southeast. The problem is, I've had absolutely no reports of there being one there.$BI need you to go investigate the village for any signs of the focus or the mage hunters and their commander in the area.$BSearch in the lake if you have to!

title: The Good Doctor...
obj_text: Deliver the Rot Resistant Organ to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: Our Forsaken allies have sent their apothecary core here to assist us in destroying the Scourge at the Wrathgate. One among them, Doctor Sintar Malefious, is well versed in the Scourge rot and methods of containing the spread. I had previously worked out a deal with him in regards to devising a vaccine for wildlife. He's since been waiting on the organ.$BDeliver this rot resistant organ to Dr. Malefious and let him know it's from me. He'll direct you on your next task.

title: The End of the Line
obj_text:
Use the Ley Line Focus Control Talisman to gain information from the Ley Line Focus under Lake Indu'le. Then, head east to the Azure Dragonshrine near south central Dragonblight and observe what is occurring there from the western ledge.$BAfterward, return to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
 Ley Line Focus information retrieved
 Azure Dragonshrine observed
desc_text: Within his robes you find two things of interest.$BOne is a talisman, which is clearly a focus controlling device. The other is a set of orders from someone named Sidragos, which were ultimately intended for the leader back at the Moonrest Gardens.$BThe water-soaked parchment informs Goramosh that he is to move all mage hunter forces east to the Azure Dragonshrine.$BPerhaps you should get what information you can from the focus and head east to observe the dragonshrine from its western ledge.

title: Travel to Moa'ki Harbor
obj_text: Travel to Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight and speak with Elder Ko'nani.
desc_text: <race>, word just arrived from Moa'ki Harbor. Something very bad happened over there this morning!$BYou've been very helpful to us here. Would you consider using the boat from Unu'pe to travel to the great Dragonblight?$BBy the sound of things, Elder Ko'nani could certainly use your assistance.

title: The Lost Courier
obj_text: Speak to Courier Lanson at Star's Rest in Dragonblight.
desc_text: We're lucky we made it this far, <name>.  We were ambushed by Scourge as soon as we landed.$BOne of our men turned out to be a spy for the Cult of the Damned.  Thassarian appears to have more evidence of cultist infiltration.  Apparently it goes all the way to the top.$BI've sent one of my best couriers to our outpost in western Dragonblight, but he has not yet returned. I fear he may have fallen to the Scourge. Will you go to Dragonblight and search for him? Courier Lanson is his name.

title: Travel to Moa'ki Harbor
obj_text: Travel to Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight and speak with Elder Ko'nani.
desc_text: <race>, word just came in off the boat from Moa'ki Harbor. Something very bad happened over there this morning!$BYou've been very helpful to us here. Would you consider using the boat to travel to the great Dragonblight?$BBy the sound of things, Elder Ko'nani could certainly use your assistance.

title: The End of the Line
obj_text:
Use the Ley Line Focus Control Talisman to gain information from the Ley Line Focus under Lake Indu'le. Then, head east to the Azure Dragonshrine near south central Dragonblight and observe what is occurring there from the western ledge$BAfterward, return to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
 Ley Line Focus information retrieved
 Azure Dragonshrine observed
desc_text: Within his robes you find two things of interest.$BOne is a talisman, which is clearly a focus controlling device. The other is a set of orders from someone named Sidragos, which were ultimately intended for the leader back at the Moonrest Gardens.$BThe fragile water-soaked parchment informs Goramosh that he is to move all mage hunter forces east to the Azure Dragonshrine.$BPerhaps you should get what information you can from the focus and head east to observe the dragonshrine from its western ledge.

title: Koltira and the Language of Death
obj_text: Take the Flesh-Bound Tome to Koltira Deathweaver.
desc_text: There is one who recently joined our cause that might be able to decipher this tome. An unbound death knight known as Koltira Deathweaver has temporarily taken residence here at Agmar's Hammer. As he was once a death knight of Arthas and member of the Scourge, he might be able to translate the language of the dead.$BTake the flesh-bound tome to Koltira and ask him to translate the pages.

title: Gaining an Audience
obj_text: Deliver your Letter of Introduction to Wyrmrest Temple to Tariolstrasz at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <name>, you must travel as swiftly as you can to Wyrmrest Temple and present this letter to the steward, Tariolstrasz.$BThe temple sits in the center of the Dragonblight. Follow the road east until it ends, and then cross The Dragon Wastes to get to it.$BI'm sure that when the steward reads your introduction, he'll see to it that you gain an audience with Queen Alexstrasza. We can only hope that we're not too late.$BThank you for all that you have done on our behalf. Safe journeys!

title: The Liquid Fire of Elune
obj_text:
Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest has asked you to use the Liquid Fire of Elune to cleanse the corpses of 6 Blighted Elk and 6 Rabid Grizzlies.
 Blighted Elk's corpse cleansed (6)
 Rabid Grizzly's corpse cleansed (6)
desc_text: <race> will you assist me?$BThe Scourge have moved into Icemist to the north. Wherever they go, they spread their taint, and the creatures of the land suffer.$BTake this vial, which is filled with the liquid fire of Elune from the moonwell. Please, use the liquid to cleanse the corpses of the blighted wildlife that you find.

title: Gaining an Audience
obj_text: Deliver your Letter of Introduction to Wyrmrest Temple to Tariolstrasz at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <name>, you must travel as swiftly as you can to Wyrmrest Temple and present this letter to the steward, Tariolstrasz.$BThe temple sits in the center of the Dragonblight. Follow the road east until it ends, and then cross The Dragon Wastes to get to it.$BI'm sure that when the steward reads your introduction, he'll see to it that you gain an audience with Queen Alexstrasza. We can only hope that we're not too late.$BThank you for all that you have done on our behalf. Safe journeys!

title: Kill the Cultists
obj_text: Collect 5 Functional Cultist Suits for Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: The Anub'ar cultists are indirectly responsible for the plaguing of the beasts, and we must put an end to it!$BThe fumes that emit from the cultists' suits seep into everything they come near, poisoning and corrupting their surroundings.$BYou must go north to Icemist Village and slay them. Bring back any of their suits that survive your assault and I will see to it that they are properly disposed of.

title: Imbeciles Abound!
obj_text: Travel to Venomspite in Dragonblight and speak with Chief Plaguebringer Middleton.
desc_text: The shipment from New Agamand was to arrive at Venomspite last week and then be delivered to me after some simple field tests. It is a Horde imperative - the last piece of the "victory puzzle."$B<Sintar sighs.>$BIt is quite disheartening to know that you are surrounded by imbeciles and incompetent boobs!$BYou must travel to Venomspite, near the eastern border of Dragonblight. Find that buffoon, Middleton, and let him know that I am waiting on the package.

title: Of Traitors and Treason
obj_text: Show the Alliance Missive to Palena Silvercloud at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: The list I hold must be delivered to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He commands the 7th Legion, stationed at Wintergarde Keep on the eastern borders of Dragonblight.$BIf any of the traitors on this list are stationed at Wintergarde... it could be catastrophic.$BHurry, <name>. Show the document to Palena Silvercloud here at Stars' Rest and explain the nature of your mission. She will put you on her fastest hippogryph to Wintergarde!

title: High Commander Halford Wyrmbane
obj_text: Deliver the Alliance Missive to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in eastern Dragonblight.
desc_text: <Palena hands the missive back to you.>$BSnowstorm will take you to Wintergarde, <name>. I guarantee you that it will be the fastest flight you've ever taken. Go now!

title: To Venomspite!
obj_text: Deliver the Blight Specimen to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in eastern Dragonblight.
desc_text: I got a special bat all lined up for you, buddy. Fastest and smoothest ride I've got. He'll take you right to Venomspite - in style.$BJust hand that vial over to Chief Plaguebringer Middleton once you land.

title: Give it a Name
obj_text: Show the Blight Specimen to Tobias Sarkhoff at New Agamand.
desc_text: My, my, how long has it been? How long have we been working on this damned plague? Finally, after an eternity of failure, we are blessed with perfection. This... It doesn't even have a proper name yet! This blight... That's it, BLIGHT! This blight will tear down the very fabric of life!$B<Harris hands you a vial.>$BNow, find the bat handler, Tobias, and show him the specimen. He'll get you on your way to Venomspite.

title: Wanted: The Scarlet Onslaught
obj_text:
Kill 20 members of the Scarlet Onslaught and report to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite.
 $BMembers of the Scarlet Onslaught slain (20)

 Onslaught Raven Priest
 [PH] New Hearthglen Scarlet Footman
 Onslaught Knight
 Onslaught Workman
 [PH] New Hearthglen Scarlet Commander
 Onslaught Executioner
 [PH] New Hearthglen Scarlet Scout
 Captain Shely
 Onslaught Deckhand
 Blacksmith Goodman
 Lead Cannoneer Zierhut
 Stable Master Mercer
$B

 Commander Jordan
 Foreman Kaleiki
 High Abbot Landgren
 Bishop Street
 Devout Bodyguard
 Onslaught Footman
 Onslaught Footman
 High Abbot Landgren
 Onslaught Knight
 Raven Priest Kassandra
 Onslaught Footman
desc_text: y order of High Executor Wroth all members of the illegal organization known as the Scarlet Onslaught are to be put to death immediately.$BNo quarter is to be offered, and those proceeding to action upon this decree should be aware that any who are captured by the humans will be left to die, or worse!$BIn the High Executor's words, "Paint the snow red with their blood!"

title: The Forsaken Blight and You: How Not to Die
obj_text: Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight wants you to bring him 10 Ectoplasmic Residue.
desc_text: The details behind the functionality of the blight are hardly important. All you need to know is that it does the job it was designed to do. I have managed to synthesize a strain of the blight that is inert.$B<Middleton uncorks a vial and inhales.>$BSee, my body is still, mostly, intact. Now mix this with a reactive agent and we'd all be turned to shapeless piles of goo.$BOn the beach south of here you will find pathetic specters of Alliance soldiers past. Slay them and bring me ectoplasmic residue.

title: The Favor of Zangus
obj_text: Deliver the Favor of Zangus to Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: An inscription on the back of the favor reads,$B"To my favorite pupil,$BIf you continue to show promise, I will teach you wonders beyond your imaginings.$BIf you do not, I will have you destroyed!$BAs ever,$BHigh Cultist Zangus"$BNo doubt the warden at Stars' Rest will want to see this.

title: Emerald Dragon Tears
obj_text: Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight wants you to collect 8 Emerald Dragon Tears.
desc_text: With an inert specimen of the blight compound complete and the activating agent in hand there only remains a need for a suitable shell to house the components.$BSouthwest of here, on the shores of central Dragonblight, is where you will find the Emerald Dragonshrine. Within the shrine you will find the hardened remnants of a green dragon's tear drop. I don't know the whole story, but apparently they cry a lot right before they die. Go figure.$BGo to the Emerald Dragonshrine and gather tears.

title: Blighted Last Rites
obj_text:
Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite has asked you to test the Flask of Blight upon the Scarlet Onslaught Prisoner.
 Flask of Blight tested
desc_text: Have you read the wanted poster? What is the high executor thinking?!$B<Vicky looks around and continues in hushed tones.>$BWe can't very well have those Scarlet Onslaught idiots being raised by their priests, or worse, rising as the Scourge, now can we?$BNo, I'm in total agreement with you, we have to do something about the corpses.$BI have just the thing. Take this blight that we just created and test it on the prisoner in the cage right here.$BNo muss, no fuss, no returning enemies.

title: Fresh Remounts
obj_text:
Hansel Bauer at Venomspite has asked you to steal 3 Onslaught Warhorses and deliver them to him, handing over the reins when you do so.
 Scarlet Onslaught Warhorse reins handed over (3)
desc_text:
Hello. I am Hansel. Pleased to meet you, <sir /ma'am>.$BThe high executor came to me and said, 'Hansel, I want you to get us new mounts.'$BWhere does he think dreadsteeds come from? The ground?$B Actually, they do if you can find a horse graveyard.$BBut we don't have one of those, so what we need you to do is go south to New Hearthglen, kill the knights, take their riding crops, and steal their warhorses.$BRide the horse back to me here and hand over the reins, if you would.
                Progress
I'm sure glad that you came around. I was afraid that I was going to have to go down there and rustle them up myself.$B
Completion
Ah, nothing makes me happier than a job well done.$BYou've done Venomspite a great service in acquiring these horses, <class>.$B
Rewards
The following spell will be cast on you:                 $B


Quest 12214 reward serverside spell
 


$B
You will receive: 5 $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
20,300 experience$B
250 reputation with The Hand of Vengeance$B

Related

title: Spread the Good Word
obj_text:
Chief Plaguebringer Middleton at Venomspite in Dragonblight wants you to use the Forsaken Blight Spreader's Blight Bomb to destroy 30 Hungering Dead on the outskirts of the Carrion Fields.
 Hungering Dead slain (30)
desc_text: efore I can ship you off to Doctor Malefious with the good news, you will have to run a simple field test of the blight with the modifications I have made.$BThe hungering dead stream out from what remains of Old Wintergarde. Commandeer a vehicle from the east gate and drive it northeast through Vengeance Pass until you reach the twin towers at the southeastern edge of Wintergarde. Drop the blight bomb on the undead that cover the area. Report back to me with the results!

title: Materiel Plunder
obj_text: Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite has asked you to steal 8 Scarlet Onslaught Armor and 8 Scarlet Onslaught Weapons.
desc_text: Ah good, new meat. Do you wish to prove yourself, new meat?$BThe Scarlet Onslaught, the most zealous and racist of the Scarlet Crusade, are in our backyard to the south. If we're going to fight them, we'll need more armor and weapons than I can make in such a short time.$BWhy don't we take theirs?$BMore to the point, why don't YOU take theirs?

title: Let Them Not Rise!
obj_text:
Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite has asked you to use her Container of Rats to pick clean the corpses of 15 Scarlet Onslaught members at New Hearthglen.
 Scarlet Onslaught corpses picked clean (15)
desc_text: I don't understand it. The blight should have worked!$BNo sense worrying about it now.$B<The apothecary seems relieved for some reason.>$BThough it doesn't work on the Onslaught for some strange reason, we still need to keep their priests from raising them.$BI have another idea, one that their corpses shouldn't have any protection from.$B<name>, take a container of my rats and unleash them upon any Onslaught corpses you come across at New Hearthglen. I starve the vermin, so they should be voracious!

title: The Forsaken Blight
obj_text: Deliver The Forsaken Blight to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: I have prepared a package that must be delivered to Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer. The contents of the package include the final blight specimen along with instructions on preparation and samples of the reactive agent.$BYou will find Agmar's Hammer in western Dragonblight. Just look for the black, jagged metal orc buildings - that will be Agmar's Hammer.

title: Naxxramas and the Fall of Wintergarde
obj_text: Speak with Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station in Wintergarde Keep.
desc_text: Lord Fordragon has led a crushing assault against Arthas at the Wrathgate. In response to this affront, Arthas has sent Naxxramas down upon us. While Kel'Thuzad hides in the floating citadel, his ground commander, Thel'zan, lays siege to Wintergarde Keep. The lower village is already lost and any chance of extracting survivors from the ruins diminishes by the minute.$BWe must act quickly! Report to Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station at once! He'll get you up to speed.$BLeave me!

title: Stealing from the Siegesmiths
obj_text: Deathguard Molder at Venomspite has asked you to retrieve 6 Siegesmith Bombs.
desc_text: I'm tasked with the destruction of the Scarlet Onslaught's ballistae. Unfortunately, the apothecaries and I are at odds on the use of our resources, so I've nothing to destroy them with!$BTo the northeast are the Carrion Fields. The Scourge siegesmiths there at their forge and meat wagons are demolition masters.$BLuckily for us, they also leave their bombs lying about.$BI want you to retrieve them for me, off of the ground or the siegesmiths, I don't care which.

title: The Spy in New Hearthglen
obj_text: Deliver the Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders to Agent Skully at New Hearthglen.
desc_text: I have a spy within the ranks of the Scarlet Onslaught. I need you to deliver these daily orders to her so that she can plan the next phase of our assault.$BShe goes by the name of Agent Skully and she's under a magical guise to appear as the Onslaught's cemetery caretaker.$BHere, take these orders to her, and then do as she asks. You'll find the graveyard on the side of the abbey.

title: Flight of the Wintergarde Defender
obj_text:
Rescue 10 Helpless Wintergarde Villagers and return to Gryphon Commander Urik at Wintergarde Keep.
 $BHelpless Villager Rescued (10)

 Helpless Wintergarde Villager
 Helpless Wintergarde Villager
$B

 Helpless Wintergarde Villager (Peasants)
 Helpless Villager Proxy
desc_text: With this whistle you can call down a Wintergarde gryphon. Mount the creature and head towards the ruins of Wintergarde Village, now known as the Carrion Fields, southeast of here. Once at the fields, keep your eyes peeled for helpless Wintergarde villagers. When you spot one, fly low and use the gryphon to pick them up. Return the rescued villager here, to the gryphon station.$BThere are Scourge all over the place so you'll need to keep your wits about you, hero. Good luck!

title: No Mercy for the Captured
obj_text:
Spy Mistress Repine has asked you to slay Deathguard Schneider, Senior Scrivener Barriga, Engineer Burke, and Chancellor Amai.$BWhen you've accomplished this task, report your success to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite.
 Deathguard Schneider slain
 Senior Scrivener Barriga slain
 Engineer Burke slain
 Chancellor Amai slain
desc_text: We have more fools for you to kill.$BMy agents tell me that several of our good citizens have seen fit to fall into the hands of the Scarlet Onslaught.$BThis will not do.$BGo back to New Hearthglen and eliminate Deathguard Schneider, Senior Scrivener Barriga, Engineer Burke and Chancellor Amai.$BFrom what I hear, they're spread out throughout the area. No doubt they are being kept in cages awaiting torture.$BSpeak with them and then kill them!

title: Need to Know
obj_text: Spy Mistress Repine at Venomspite has asked you to steal the Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Abbey, Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Barracks, and Scarlet Onslaught Daily Orders: Beach.
desc_text: I need to know what New Hearthglen is up to.$BI want you to steal their orders of the day so that I can find that out.$BHead south and in their abbey, in their barracks, and on their beach, find those daily plans!$BJust in case you're confused, the barracks is the large building right next to the smithy.

title: A Means to an End
obj_text:
Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite has asked you to use the Levine Family Termites to lure Foreman Kaleiki out and kill him.
 Foreman Kaleiki slain
desc_text: I received a few barrels of termites from my sister at the Bulwark back home in the last shipment. I think they're going to come in handy for something I have in mind for you.$BThe lumbermill operations at New Hearthglen are problematic for us, but so far we haven't been able to get anyone in there to take out their foreman.$BI think that if you were to unleash these termites on his precious woodworks, he'd be sure to come running.$BReady to take him out, <class>?

title: Return to the High Commander
obj_text: Speak with High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at once, <name>. Let him know that your mission was a success and that the few remaining villagers that were rescued are back to work.

title: The Fate of the Dead
obj_text:
Commander Lynore Windstryke at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to kill 15 Vengeful Geists.$B
 Vengeful Geist slain (15)
desc_text: The town square, down this path, is overrun with the undead citizens of Wintergarde! Our own crypt provides a seemingly endless supply of soldiers for the Scourge to throw at us. Take no pity on them, though, <name>. While they were once mortal, capable of compassion and thought, they are now ravaging undead with only one purpose: our destruction.$BVenture forth to the town square and deliver the vengeful geists to their maker. Give them peace.

title: Rescue from Town Square
obj_text:
High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to rescue 6 Trapped Wintergarde Villagers.
 Trapped Wintergarde Villager Rescued (6)
desc_text: Just down this path here is Wintergarde's town square. Once a hive of activity for the citizens of Wintergarde, now a warzone, filled with murderous geists hell-bent on vengeance towards the living.$BIn the buildings surrounding the town square are trapped villagers that must be rescued! I ask much of you, now, <name>, but you are the only soldier I can spare. Free our people. Take this path down into town square and enter those houses. Kill anything that gets in your way! Return to me should you survive.

title: Torture the Torturer
obj_text:
High Executor Wroth at Venomspite wants you to use the branding iron 5 times on Torturer LeCraft to get the information out of him. After that, kill him.
 Torturer LeCraft fully questioned
 Torturer LeCraft slain
desc_text: Enough! I want you to put an end to the torture of my people!$BThe Onslaught's torturer, LeCraft, has been bleeding information out of everyone that gets caught by those fiends! I need to know what they know.$BMy sources tell me that he has set up shop in the basement of their barracks, which is right next to the smithy.$BI'll loan you my personal branding iron to see to it that the job is done right.$BFind him and get that information.

title: The Demo-gnome
obj_text: Speak with Siege Engineer Quarterflash at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Quarterflash recently requisitioned my group for a specialist that he could send on a reconnaissance mission to the Wintergarde Mine. To that end, I sent him Slinkin, my demolitionist. I foolishly thought that he could close off that pit of damnation after his mission for Quarterflash was complete, securing another victory for us against the Scourge.$BAn entire day has now passed and Slinkin has not returned. I want answers! Speak with Siege Engineer Quarterflash and track down my missing agent!

title: Bombard the Ballistae
obj_text:
Deathguard Molder at Venomspite has asked you to use the Siegesmith Bombs to bombard 5 New Hearthglen Ballistae.
 New Hearthglen Ballista bombarded (5)
desc_text: At last, our chance to strike at their siege engines! Don't flub it.$BI kid.$BA little.$B<class>, bombard New Hearthglen's ballistae with these bombs.$BWe'll show the Royal Apothecary Society how it's done old style. No concoctions required!

title: Fire Upon the Waters
obj_text:
Apothecary Vicky Levine at Venomspite has asked you to use her Apothecary's Burning Water to set the sails of the Sinner's Folly afire.$BWhile the deckhands are busy attempting to put the fires out, head belowdecks and retrieve Captain Shely's Rutters from the captain.
 Sails of the Sinner's Folly set afire
desc_text: I have another mission for you.$BI was able to repurpose some of the blight to concoct my world-famous burning water. I want you to take it and set the sails of the Sinner's Folly ablaze!$BUse it from the dock. Once the sails are on fire, the deckhands will be busy putting them out, and you'll slip belowdecks to 'retrieve' the captain's rutters.$BYou'll find the ship on Crusader's Landing, below and south of New Hearthglen. Look for the captain's quarters on the first lower deck, behind the stairs.

title: The Perfect Dissemblance
obj_text:
Agent Skully at New Hearthglen has asked you steal the image of a Onslaught Raven Priest. Return the Banshee's Magic Mirror to her when you have done so.
 Onslaught Raven Priest's image stolen
desc_text: You may wonder how I can maintain this guise; I use a magic mirror that was loaned to me by the spy mistress.$BIt only has so much power in it, but I think there's enough for the both of us. Here, take it. I want you to use it to impersonate one of the Onslaught raven priests.$BBe quick about it... I have no idea how long my glamour will last while you have the mirror.$BRealize that you won't immediately be perfectly disguised, so don't count on it being foolproof until I've had a chance to help you.

title: Without a Prayer
obj_text: Agent Skully at New Hearthglen has asked you to acquire Bishop Street's Prayer Book.
desc_text: These plans indicate something imminent is being planned.$BBut first, there's the matter of this strange protection that the Onslaught forces have. If Venomspite is to deal with them once and for all, we must find out who's behind it and eliminate them.$BI've noticed that the bishop in the chapel on the far side of New Hearthglen, across from the lumbermill, has stepped up his blessing of the troops. Kill him and steal his prayer book.$BMaybe it will give us a clue.

title: Leave Nothing to Chance
obj_text:
Retrieve a Wintergarde Mine Bomb and use it to blow up the Upper Wintergarde Mine Shaft and the Lower Wintergarde Mine Shaft. Report back to Siege Engineer Quarterflash at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight when you have completed this task.
 Upper Wintergarde Mine Shaft Destroyed
 Lower Wintergarde Mine Shaft Destroyed
desc_text: If there is good in your heart and your conscience is clear, read on.$BIn this mine, near the foreman's scaffold, rests a hefty cargo of dynamite. Go there and pick up several bundles of the explosive and make your way towards the entrance of the mine. Once there, set the dynamite and blow up the entrance. Remember to do this for the upper and lower entry points of Wintergarde Mine.$BYou must leave nothing to chance. The evil that exists here must never be allowed out. Light guide you.

title: Not In Our Mine
obj_text: Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to recover 10 Wintergarde Miner's Cards.
desc_text: That blasted necropolis blindsided us! In the wake of its destruction Wintergarde Mine was lost. Worse yet, Kel'Thuzad's acolytes have raised the slain miners as Scourge and are using them to supply their siegesmiths with materials from our mine!$BThe supply line must be halted and our lost brothers must be put to rest.$BTravel to Wintergarde Mine, northeast of here in the Carrion Fields, and destroy the risen miners. Return to me with their miner cards so that I may put their passing in our registry.

title: The Bleeding Ore
obj_text: Siege Engineer Quarterflash at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to recover 10 samples of Strange Ore from Wintergarde Mine.
desc_text: Hours before the Naxxramas invasion, one of the miners stumbled upon a dark ore that was oozing a viscous fluid. In the chaos that occurred during the evacuation of the mine, we lost the samples taken from the alien node. Now the Scourge prospects the ore for use in their machines of death.$BYou must get back to Wintergarde Mine, due northeast of here in the Carrion Fields, and recover the strange ore. It is imperative to our mission's success!

title: The Rod of Compulsion
obj_text: Deliver the Torturer's Rod to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite.
desc_text: A rod drops from LeCraft's dead hand. There are pulsing magical runes along its length.$BCould this be how he was getting his confessions?$BBetter let the high executor have a look at it.

title: Understanding the Scourge War Machine
obj_text: Deliver Quarterflash's Package to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep.
desc_text: We must take solace in the fact that Slinkin's death, while tragic, was for the greater good. His discovery coupled with your heroics in the mine and the samples you returned brings us one step closer to understanding the Scourge war machine.$BTake this package to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. It holds a sample of the strange ore and my analysis.

title: The Search for Slinkin
obj_text: Find Slinkin the Demo-gnome in Wintergarde Mine. Use Quarterflash's Homing Bot if you need help finding the mine.
desc_text: While I have not heard from Slinkin or know what fate has befallen him, perhaps I can assist in finding him.$B<Quarterflash holds up a tiny mechanical toy.>$BThis is not a toy, newfound compatriot. It is, in fact, my latest mechanical creation. The machine was created with the sole purpose of finding that which has been lost. These are unfortunate circumstances, but the machine is your best chance at finding Slinkin.$BWhen you are ready to begin your search, place the bot on the ground next to me.

title: Imprints on the Past
obj_text: Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to recover his Scrying Orb.
desc_text: The memories of the past haunt this land, <name>. I hear the cries of the fallen echo across Northrend - calling to me.$BArthas left a terrible imprint on everything he touched. Only wither and decay remains in his wake. It is important, then, for us to study the past so that we may better know our enemy. Perhaps untold truths shall surface that could help in our campaign.$BFirst, you must recover my scrying orb from the town hall, <name>. Exit this tower and turn left down the path to reach the town square.

title: Orik Trueheart and the Forgotten Shore
obj_text: Seek out the assistance of Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight.
desc_text: I have gazed upon the orb and seen the path that you must walk, <name>.$BMany years ago an atrocity was committed upon the shores of Dragonblight. The act itself remains shrouded in darkness, but I am certain that your destiny lies south, amidst the ruins of the Forgotten Shore.$BTake the road southeast through the ravaged town square. Follow the trail until you arrive at Dawn's Reach. You will meet an old friend of mine there known as Orik Trueheart. He will be expecting you.

title: The Truth Will Out
obj_text: Agent Skully has asked you to acquire The Diary of High General Abbendis and to deliver it to High Executor Wroth at Venomspite.
desc_text: We have to figure out what's going on here. We need the general's diary!$BI'm pretty sure that you'll find it on her nightstand upstairs at her house. It's the one next to church, across from the stables and the lumbermill.$BOnce you acquire the diary, take it to the high executor back at Venomspite.$BYou'll have to do this the old-fashioned way; the power of the mirror is low and there's only enough left for me.$B<The agent smirks.>

title: The Murkweed Elixir
obj_text: Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight wants you to recover 5 Murkweed from the Eldritch Heights.
desc_text: The spirits of the damned haunt the coast. In life they were brave and noble soldiers of the Alliance, but in death they are cursed - bound to this world until the end of days. We must discover the source of their anguish if we are to free them!$BTo the southeast, on the Eldritch Heights, you will find a rare herb known as murkweed. It is murkweed that I will use to concoct an elixir that will allow you temporary entry into the world of the forgotten. Go now and gather the weed.

title: The Forgotten Tale
obj_text:
Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight wants you to hear the tales of a Forgotten Peasant, Forgotten Rifleman, Forgotten Knight and Forgotten Footman.
 Forgotten Peasant Questioned
 Forgotten Rifleman Questioned
 Forgotten Knight Questioned
 Forgotten Footman Questioned
desc_text: The toxins in the murkweed elixir will render you unconscious. So powerful is the effect of the murkweed that even your spirit will be fooled, allowing you to temporarily enter the world of the dead.$BOnce a spirit, you must speak to the ghostly denizens of the Forgotten Shore. Seek out the cause of their anguish and return to me.$BRemember, <name>, these spirits were once Alliance soldiers. Treat them with respect, honor and dignity.$BNow, with elixir in hand, venture south to the Forgotten Shore.

title: Of Traitors and Treason
obj_text: Captain Adams has asked you to show the Alliance Missive to Greer Orehammer at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: The list I hold must be delivered to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He commands the 7th Legion, stationed at Wintergarde Keep on the eastern borders of the Great Dragonblight.$BIf any of the traitors on this list are stationed at Wintergarde... it could be catastrophic.$BHurry, <name>. Show the document to Greer Orehammer here at Westguard Keep and explain the nature of your mission. He'll put you on his fastest gryphon to Wintergarde!

title: Beachfront Property
obj_text:
Surveyor Hansen, just north of the Forgotten Shore, has asked you to slay 20 Forgotten ghosts.
 $BForgotten ghosts slain (20)

 Forgotten Knight
 Forgotten Rifleman
 Forgotten Peasant
$B

 Forgotten Footman
 Forgotten Captain
desc_text: It's time for Venomspite to expand!$BWe'll take care of the Onslaught in due time, but I want you to spearhead our efforts on the Forgotten Shore. The property value has outstanding potential and just look at that view!$BUnfortunately, there's an infestation of human ghosts, shipwrecked crews and the like who haven't quite realized that they're dead.$BClear the beach and the waters off the shore, and maybe you and I will talk about building a cozy, new mausoleum down there soon.

title: High Commander Halford Wyrmbane
obj_text: Deliver the Alliance Missive to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in eastern Dragonblight.
desc_text: <Greer hands the missive back to you.>$BSkysong will take you to Wintergarde, <name>. I guarantee you that it will be the fastest flight you've ever taken. Go now!

title: Parting Thoughts
obj_text: Return to Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
desc_text: You have honored me and honored the memory of hundreds of Alliance veterans, <name>. Zelig was wise in sending you here. Please return to him and give him my thanks. He will be happy to hear of the events that transpired at the Forgotten Shore.$BI do not have the gift of foresight like Zelig, but I am certain that great things await you, friend.$BFarewell.

title: Find Durkon!
obj_text: Seek out Cavalier Durkon at the Wintergarde Crypt in Dragonblight.
desc_text: After the Scourge breached the south wall, I ordered Cavalier Durkon to investigate the town crypt. Moments ago I was handed his report.$BThe undead that plague us are coming from two sources: the ruins of Wintergarde, now a breeding ground for Scourge, and our very own town crypt! Amidst the chaos and confusion the Scourge managed to get a necrolord inside the crypt.$BIn his message, Durkon requested assistance. You will find him and help him, <name>. The crypt is on the western border of the town square.

title: The Truth Shall Set Us Free
obj_text:
Orik Trueheart at Dawn's Reach in Dragonblight wants you to use Orik's Crystalline Orb in the ruins located at the Forgotten Shore to redeem the Forgotten.
 $BThe Forgotten Redeemed
desc_text: Zelig gave this crystal ball to me years ago with specific instruction on its use. For five years - whenever I would feel anger, anxiety, or sorrow over the events that transpired here - I was to focus my thoughts upon the orb.$BI now understand why Zelig gave this crystal to me.$BTake my crystalline orb to the Forgotten Shore. Find the ruins of my old base on the upper reaches of the beach and place the orb in the center of town. Let the forgotten see the world through my heart and soul.

title: Funding the War Effort
obj_text: Quartermaster Bartlett at Venomspite has asked you to recover 6 Forgotten Treasure.
desc_text: <The quartermaster lowers his voice and whispers to you.>$B<class>, I need your help; our coffers are empty. The Kor'kron Vanguard at the Wrath Gate has taken all of our coin for the fight there.$BBut, I've heard whispers that there's treasure to be had amongst the wrecks on the Forgotten Shore to the southeast.$BWe have to do something soon, or we won't be able to continue the fight against the Scarlet Onslaught. War isn't cheap, you know!

title: The Noble's Crypt
obj_text:
Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Keep wants you to slay Necrolord Amarion.
 Necrolord Amarion slain
desc_text: Held within the cold stone walls of this crypt are the remains of the nobles and dignitaries that died in Northrend. At its very core now sits a necrolord who raises the corpses as servants of the Scourge.$BYou must make your way to the bottom of the Wintergarde Crypt and kill Necrolord Amarion. Only then will the assault from within cease!$BAnd <name>, be on the lookout for any information that might be laying about inside the room where Amarion resides.

title: A Disturbance In The West
obj_text: Speak to Rodney Wells at Wintergarde Keep to secure a ride to Stars' Rest in western Dragonblight.
desc_text: Another force threatens to destroy all that we have worked for, <name>. You must head westward to Stars' Rest. Archmage Modera has sensed a great disturbance in the magical ley lines of our world that must be dealt with immediately!$BGo now, <name>! Speak to Rodney Wells at the gryphon station here in Wintergarde and let him know the nature of your mission. He will place you on his fastest gryphon to deliver you to Stars' Rest. Speak with Archmage Modera when you arrive.

title: To Stars' Rest!
obj_text: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest in western Dragonblight.
desc_text: When you are ready I will place you on my fastest gryphon to Stars' Rest. Once you get there, find and speak with Archmage Modera.$BGood luck, ally!

title: Speak with your Ambassador
obj_text: Speak with Golluck Rockfist at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <The dragon in elf form takes your letter of introduction, perusing it for a moment and then stashing it away within his sleeve.>$BEverything seems to be in order. However, if you don't mind, I would ask that you speak with your ambassador here at the temple.$BHe has something of great import for you that needs taking care of before we send you up to the queen.$B<He pats at the letter under his sleeve.>$BI'll keep this safe for you until your return.

title: Speak with your Ambassador
obj_text: Speak with Lauriel Trueblade at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <The dragon in elf form takes your letter of introduction, perusing it for a moment and then stashing it away within his sleeve.>$BEverything seems to be in order. However, if you don't mind, I would ask that you speak with your ambassador here at the temple.$BShe has something of great import for you that needs taking care of before we send you up to the queen.$B<He pats at the letter under his sleeve.>$BI'll keep this safe for you until your return.

title: Slay Loguhn
obj_text:
Smear the Blood of Loguhn upon yourself and then return to Elder Ko'nani at Moa'ki Harbor.
 Loguhn's Blood Smeared
desc_text: Already it goes from bad to worse. There is only one course to take... regrettably, Loguhn must die!$BHe's the alpha male of the Snowfall Glade tribe and one mean wolvar. But it's the only way to get a short break from their attacks and stealing forays.$BYou will find the "Render of Flesh" in front of his hovel upon the northern rise of the glade. It's larger than the others and hard to miss. Kill him and smear his blood upon yourself, both to show your dominance and respect.

title: Truce?
obj_text:
Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to use the Dull Carving Knife near his cage and then speak to him.
 Blood Pact With Drakuru
desc_text: Watch yerself, mon.$BDrakuru shrunk more <race> heads than I can remember - and even if I could remember, I couldn't count that high. Lucky for you I be stuck in dis cage or I'd be addin' one more to da list.$BBut things bein' what they are, mebbe we be puttin' our differences aside fer a time, eh?$BDrakuru know things, mon. Things that will aid you in your struggle here.$B<Drakuru cuts the palm of his hand on one of his tusks and extends it through the cage.>$BSo, what you say, mon... truce?

title: A Letter Home
obj_text: ring the letter home to Lady Alustra in the Eastern Carrion Fields.
desc_text: This letter appears to be addressed to a resident of Stormwind from one of the late Villagers in the Carrion Fields.  Perhaps one of the surviving residents in the Eastern camp would be interested in forwarding it to its intended recipient.

title: End Arcanimus
obj_text:
Destroy Arcanimus and then return to Ethenial Moonshadow at Moonrest Gardens.
 Arcanimus slain
desc_text: There is one last thing that I would have you do, <name> the <race>. I would have you destroy Arcanimus!$BThe sorcerers to the west used that giant device in the sky to bore a massive pit into our resting place. When they did that, they unleashed a monstrosity!$BI would not care if it were only a concern for mortals, but Arcanimus feeds upon the spirits of the dead.$BYou will put an end to it now!

title: Meat on the Hook
obj_text:
Slay Tu'u'gwar and then return to Tua'kea at Moa'ki Harbor.
 Tu'u'gwar slain
desc_text: The time has come my friend: Tu'u'gwar must be dealt with!$BI've prepped the meat so that the beast is sure to come once you bait the hook I have out in the water. Just follow the fishing line here down to it.$BWhatever you do, don't let Tu'u'gwar swallow you whole, <name>!

title: Sweeter Revenge
obj_text:
Kill the Abomination on the hillside in Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lord Bevis once the slaughter is complete.
 Carrion Abomination slain
desc_text: Satisfyingly crunchy.  Now... you... <race> thing... there's an Abomination wandering the hillside to the south.  Go kill it.  Kill it good.

title: Sweet Revenge
obj_text: Obtain 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle from Carrion Gargoyles in the Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lord Bevis when the task is complete.
desc_text: You there... you look the fighting type.  I want some sweet Revenge on the Scourge that killed my family.  Go get me 2 Stone Hunks O' Gargoyle so that I can throw them on the ground and stomp on them violently until they are mashed into itty bitty pebbly bits.$BYes. Go. Kill.

title: Prevent the Accord
obj_text: Deliver Wind Trader Mu'fah's Remains and the Scales of Goramosh to the Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest.
desc_text: We need to kill two birds with one stone here, <class>. You're the stone.$BOur two birds are Wind Trader Mu'fah and Goramosh. They should be somewhere in the western half of the Moonrest Gardens. Most likely they're in the larger two-story building overlooking the pit.$BI require proof of their demise, if you would be so kind.

title: A Scarlet Among Us
obj_text: Search for evidence of the Scarlet Crusade on the freshly risen Carrion Ghouls in the Eastern Carrion Fields.  Return to Lady Alustra with anything you find.
desc_text: It's good to see that you were not ravaged by the Scourge as well.  Perhaps you'd be willing to lend a hand.$BThe Scarlet Crusade has taken up a post to the north with the obvious intent of battling the Scourge.  The thing that bothers me is that they were building before we were attacked - they must have known something.$BI need to know if one of our Villagers was involved.  Search for evidence on those of us that were brought back as ghouls.  If you find anything, bring it to me.

title: Recording the Fallen
obj_text: Search the skeletons in the Carrion Fields for Alliance Settlement Documents.
desc_text: Thank you for coming <name>.  We haven't recieved any word from Wintergarde Keep.  I'm sure they're still battling the Scourge, but I can believe they left us alone to this slaughter.$BWe need to gather the names of the dead so that we can notify their families.  When the Alliance Military brought us here, we all filled out Settlement Documentation and were required to keep it on our persons.$BGo sift through the corpses and bring me any Documents that you find so that I can start a list of the names.

title: Return to Soar
obj_text: Deliver Sintar's Vaccine to Soar Hawkfury at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: <Doctor Malefious hands you a vial full of murky liquid.>$BHere you are then, <race>. Take this back to the cow and let him know that all debts have been paid. We are officially "square."$BNow leave me before I set Jennings upon you.

title: Return of the High Chief
obj_text: Free High Chief Icemist using the Anub'ar Prison Key and assist him in defeating Under-king Anub'et'kan.$BRecover a Fragment of Anub'et'kan's Husk and return it to Overlord Agmar at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: <Banthok hands you the prison key.>$BYou must hurry, <name>. Take the key and use it to unchain my father from the Anub'ar prison. Once he is freed, assist him in destroying the Anub'ar leader, Under-king Anub'et'kan. When the Under-king is defeated, take from his chitinous carapace a fragment as a trophy to present to the Horde at Agmar's Hammer. Let Agmar see the might of the High Chief!

title: In Search of the Ruby Lilac
obj_text: Doctor Sintar Malefious at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to collect 1 Ruby Lilac.
desc_text: How fortuitous it is that the Ruby Dragonshrine lays just to the east. It is there that you will find a flower called the ruby lilac. This lifegiving plant is all that I need to concoct a vaccine for the untainted beasts of this region.$BTravel east and search the Ruby Dragonshrine for the lilac.$BJust one thing: The dragonshrine, like all the dragonshrines in this blasted wasteland, is beset by the Scourge. Watch your step. We wouldn't want you to be devoured by an emberwyrm.$B<Sintar laughs.>

title: Where the Wild Things Roam
obj_text:
Soar Hawkfury at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Pack of Vaccine to vaccinate 5 Snowfall Elk and 5 Arctic Grizzlies.
 Snowfall Elk Inoculated (5)
 Arctic Grizzly Inoculated (5)
desc_text: Inside this pack are several vials containing the vaccine that Sintar created. I now want you to search the nearby woods for Snowfall elk and arctic grizzlies. When you locate the animals, find a safe distance and throw a vial in their general direction. The vial will shatter and release a fine gas that will act as the inoculating agent. The beasts merely have to step inside the gas and they will be vaccinated - ultimately saved.$BInoculate as many of the beasts as you can and return to me.

title: The Translated Tome
obj_text: Deliver the Translated Flesh-bound Tome to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: Here it is, <name>. I have translated everything printed upon the pages of the tome. Inside it you will find a list of the names of Cult of the Damned members spanning the entire continent.$BTheir network of spies and operatives is impressive, to say the least.$BFarewell, friend. May the book serve you and your people well.

title: In Service of the Unholy
obj_text: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Unholy Gem on Duke Vallenhal and return to him with a Filled Unholy Gem.
desc_text: The power of the unholy is coveted among my kind. It makes up the very fiber of our existence, granting death to those that dare make a mockery of it! Thankfully there is a font from which I may draw from in my time of need.$BTake this unholy gem and make your way to the Ruby Dragonshrine, east of here. It is there that you will find Duke Vallenhal, death knight of Arthas. Weaken his resolve in battle and unleash the power of the gem upon him. It will finish him off and steal his unholy energy!

title: Pest Control
obj_text:
Kontokanis at Dragon's Fall wants you to kill 10 Snowplain Snobolds and 3 Dragonblight Magnataur at the magnataur camps surrounding Wyrmrest.
 $BSnowplain Snobolds (10)

 Snowplain Zealot
 Snowplain Shaman
$B

 Gormok Zealot
 Snowplain Disciple
$B
$B
 $BDragonblight Magnataur (3)

 Magnataur Patriarch
 Magnataur Youngling
 Gigantaur
 Icefist
 Chilltusk
$B

 Bonesunder
 Iceshatter
 Bloodfeast
 Drakegore
 Magnataur Alpha
