desc_text: Oi, mon! One of dose little snobold runts trashed our camp during da last dragon attack. Dey've been houndin us wheneva we turn our backs and I've had enough.$BTo da east you'll find da snobolds hiding under da skirts of some of da local magnataur. Go slaughter dem. If da magnataur interfere on behalf of deir slaves, kill dem as well.

title: All Hail Roanauk!
obj_text:
Seek out Roanauk Icemist at Agmar's Hammer and initiate him as a member and leader of the Horde forces.$BReturn to Overlord Agmar with the Blood Oath of the Horde when you complete this task.$B
 Roanauk Icemist initiated
desc_text: Like the tauren, Forsaken, trolls and blood elves, so too do the taunka need a leader born of their own blood. The one you saved from Icemist, Roanauk, will be this leader.$B<Overlord Agmar hands you a parchment.>$BI give to you something familiar - the blood oath of the Horde.$BTake the oath to Roanauk Icemist and initiate him into the Horde as leader of the taunka.$BLet us not keep him waiting.$B<Agmar nods.>

title: Canyon Chase
obj_text:
Duane wants you to chase the snobolds down the canyon northeast of 7th Legion Front and deal with their leader.
 Chilltusk slain
desc_text: I can't believe this! Another band of those vermin just tried to take off with more of our supplies. They're scurrying off towards that north canyon, get after them and deal with whoever they're going to!

title: The Power to Destroy
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to enter the world of shadows and defeat 6 Shadowy Tormentors.$BSpeak to Koltira Deathweaver should you need to re-enter the world of shadows.
 Shadowy Tormentor slain (6)
World of Shadows (Provided)
desc_text: While you have done much for me, one task remains.$BBeside the world you know exists another world. It is from that world, the world of shadows, that my tormentors assault me. While I am powerless to face my own demons, you could end their reign of terror. You have the strength, I have seen it with my own eyes.$BEnter the world of shadows and face the demons that torment me!$BDo this and I will translate the tome, as promised.

title: In Service of Frost
obj_text: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Frost Gem on Ice Revenants and return to him with a Filled Frost Gem.
desc_text: The biting cold protects the death knight while repelling his enemies. He that commands the power of frost can incite chaos and destruction!$BTake this frost gem and travel far across the open tundra of the Dragonblight until you come upon the Mirror of Dawn, east of Wyrmrest Temple. It is there that you are to battle the legions of ice revenants that dwell upon the lakes surface and take from them the essence of frost. Utilize the power of the gem when they are weak, <name>!

title: Canyon Chase
obj_text:
Kontokanis wants you to chase the snobolds down the canyon south of Dragon's Fall and deal with their leader.
 Icefist slain
desc_text: I can't believe dis! Another band of dose vermin just tried ta take off with more of our supplies. Dey're scurrying down da canyon now, get after dem and deal with whoever dey're going to!

title: Pest Control
obj_text:
Duane at the 7th Legion Front wants you to kill 10 Snowplain Snobolds and 3 Dragonblight Magnataur at the magnataur camps surrounding Wyrmrest.
 $BSnowplain Snobolds (10)

 Snowplain Zealot
 Snowplain Shaman
$B

 Gormok Zealot
 Snowplain Disciple
$B
$B
 $BDragonblight Magnataur (3)

 Magnataur Patriarch
 Magnataur Youngling
 Gigantaur
 Icefist
 Chilltusk
$B

 Bonesunder
 Iceshatter
 Bloodfeast
 Drakegore
 Magnataur Alpha
desc_text: Ugh! One of those little snobold runts trashed our camp while we were busy with that last dragon. They've been plaguing us whenever we turn our backs... I've had enough!$BTo the south you'll find the snobolds hiding under the skirts of some of the local magnataur. Go slaughter them.$BIf the magnataur interfere on behalf of their slaves, kill them as well.

title: Mighty Magnataur
obj_text:
Hunt down and kill Bloodfeast, Iceshatter, and Drakegore east of Wyrmrest$BBloodfeast resides in the southeastern corner of the Dragon Wastes, just north of the Emerald Dragonshrine. Iceshatter patrols the northern edge of the Mirror of Dawn. Drakegore wanders at the bottom of the cliffs west of the Bronze Dragonshrine.$BReturn to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest once the magnataur have been slain.
 Iceshatter slain
 Bloodfeast slain
 Drakegore slain
 $BSuggested players: 2
desc_text: Magnataur are hideously violent creatures... this is the main reason we rarely see them come together in any real numbers without killing each other. A powerful leader has stepped up somewhere among them and we need to hunt him down if we are to stop this threat.$BI will start asking around. I need you to disrupt them as much as possible in the meantime.$BEast of here there are 3 torches erected. Near them, there are 3 dominant Magnataur - put them down to buy us some time to hunt down this leader.

title: Troll Season!
obj_text: Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge wants you to speak to Samir at Granite Springs.
desc_text: You, <race>! No sense standing around here when there's work to be done!$BDrak'Theron Keep is the most direct route to Zul'Drak. We MUST capture it to ensure safe passage for the Alliance. But until we get the numbers to make an assault, we'll have to content ourselves in thinning out the ice trolls and collecting intel.$BTo that end, we've conscripted a gang of thugs to capture and deliver live trolls for interrogation. Travel northwest and speak with Samir at Granite Springs. He'll direct you further.

title: Prevent the Accord
obj_text: Deliver Wind Trader Mu'fah's Remains and the Scales of Goramosh to the Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: We need to kill two birds with one stone here, <class>. You're the stone.$BOur two birds are Wind Trader Mu'fah and Goramosh. They should be somewhere in the western half of the Moonrest Gardens. Most likely they're in the larger two-story building overlooking the pit.$BI require proof of their demise, if you would be so kind.

title: The Kor'kron Vanguard!
obj_text: Report to Saurfang the Younger at the Kor'kron Vanguard.
desc_text: You have done well, <brother/sister>. All that you have faced, you have done as a champion of the Horde. The Scourged Anub'ar of Azjol-Nerub, crushed under your foot! The taunka, brave and powerful new members of the Horde, because of you! Our super-weapon against the Scourge, tested and perfected by you!$BThe time has come, the moment is now - our elite soldiers at the Wrathgate need you. The son of Saurfang awaits your arrival at the Kor'kron Vanguard. Go now, northeast to the Wrathgate.

title: Attunement to Dalaran
obj_text:
The Image of Archmage Modera at Stars' Rest has asked you to become Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend.
 Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend
desc_text: Welcome, mage.$BBy now you must be wondering where Dalaran is and how to get there. I will help you.$BBut before I can teach you how to teleport to our great city, you must attune yourself to the ley lines of Northrend. Otherwise, you risk destroying yourself in the process.$BTake this attunement crystal and use it in the pit under the surge needle at the Moonrest Gardens to the west. Then you will be ready to learn the spell.

title: Disturbing Implications
obj_text: ring the Emblazoned Battle Horn to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in assessing the potential threat.
desc_text: The underside of the horn boasts an emblazoned seal with a hammer and a lightning bolt. Something about the horn seems extremely out of place on a Magnataur.$BTake the horn south down the Path of the Titans to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in these threatening implications.

title: Attunement to Dalaran
obj_text:
The Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at Agmar's Hammer has asked you to become Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend.
 Attuned to the Ley Lines of Northrend
desc_text: Hello, mage.$BBy now you must be wondering where Dalaran is and how to get there. I can help you with this if you can survive a simple test.$BBefore I teach you how to teleport to our great city, you must attune yourself to the ley lines of Northrend. Otherwise, you will destroy yourself in the process!$BTake this attunement crystal and use it in the pit under the surge needle at the Moonrest Gardens to the southwest. Then you will be ready to learn what I have to teach.

title: Mmm... Amberseeds!
obj_text: Speak with Master Woodsman Anderhol in Amberpine Lodge.
desc_text: Your stomach growls as the pungent smell of hearty nuts draws your attention to the the bucket of seeds.$BSome thoughtful soul has obviously left these complimentary morsels here to rejuvenate weary visitors. Grateful, you take the remaining few and devour them.$BThe seeds do not disappoint. Finding yourself hungry for more, you set out to discover their origins....

title: One of a Kind
obj_text: Find and kill Bonesunder in or near the canyon northwest of the Azure Dragonshrine. Bring any evidence you find back to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: Such a strange seal to see among magnataur... it suggests an unusual amount of organization.$BMagnataur rarely put aside their aggressive natures to cooperate with each other.  I suspect they have their eyes set on raiding a large settlement.$BI very much doubt that this horn is unique, I need you to prove me wrong. In the canyon northwest of the Azure Dragonshrine you will find Bonesunder. Go challenge him and bring me back any evidence you find that might confirm my concerns.

title: Disturbing Implications
obj_text: ring the Emblazoned Battle Horn to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in assessing the potential threat.
desc_text: The underside of the horn boasts an emblazoned seal with a hammer and a lightning bolt. Something about the horn seems extremely out of place on a Magnataur.$BTake the horn east across the Dragon Wastes to Wyrmrest and seek out someone who might be interested in these threatening implications.

title: Just Passing Through
obj_text: Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to bring him 5 Blackroot Stalks.
desc_text: We must act quickly, <race>! We can't risk letting those precious seeds become fully digested. They need to come out, NOW.$BForage up some blackroot from the riverbank just west of here and I'll make you a purgative that should get things moving.$BHurry now! And remember, you brought this upon yourself....

title: [Depricated]Sewing Your Seed
desc_text: No, no... You hold on to these.$BYou didn't actually expect me to handle them after all of that did you?$Bhere's what you're going to do....

title: The Denouncement
obj_text:
High Executor Wroth at Venomspite has tasked you with using the Rod of Compulsion on Commander Jordan, Lead Cannoneer Zierhut, Blacksmith Goodman, and Stable Master Mercer.$BOnce the rod has been used on them, kill each to exact a denouncement of the Scarlet Onslaught as their final words.
 Commander Jordan's denouncement & death
 Lead Cannoneer Zierhut's denouncement & death
 Blacksmith Goodman's denouncement & death
 Stable Master Mercer's denouncement & death
desc_text: It's time for us to utterly demoralize the Onslaught forces!$BI want you to take the rod and use it on four of their leaders: Commander Jordan upstairs at the barracks, Lead Cannoneer Zierhut down the southeast ramp overlooking the beach, Blacksmith Goodman at the smithy, and Stable Master Mercer at the stables.$BPlace them under the rod's compulsion, concentrate on making them denounce the Onslaught, and then kill them!

title: A Fall From Grace
obj_text:
Agent Skully at New Hearthglen has asked you to ring the bell in the abbey and then go speak with the high abbot and get information out of him.
 Abbey bell rung
 High Abbot spoken with
A Fall from Grace: Quest Accept (Provided)
desc_text: We need more information from the high abbot, and now that we have the visage of one of the raven priests, I think we can get you close to talk with him.$BUnfortunately, we need to separate him from his bodyguards or you'll never get any information out of him.$B<The agent leans on her shovel and thinks a moment.>$BI think I've got it! While in disguise, go to the top of the abbey and ring the bell. That should bring the abbot's bodyguards running and you can then head down to speak with him.

title: Doing Your Duty
obj_text: Anderhol in Amberpine Lodge wants you to take the Anderhol's Slider Cider and use the nearby outhouse to retrieve the Partially Processed Amberseeds.
desc_text: Alright, <race>. Here's the juice.$BIt works immediately, so don't use it until you're safely inside the outhouse.$BNow go get me those seeds!

title: Do Unto Others
obj_text: High Executor Wroth at Venomspite has ordered you to return with The Head of the High General.
desc_text: Their attack is imminent, <class>. I need you to get in there and sever the head of the Scarlet Onslaught, literally!$BIt's not going to be easy... Abbendis is sure to be surrounded by a great many of her men. I suggest that you take at least a couple of friends along.$BBring back her head and I'll see to it that you're properly rewarded for saving Venomspite.$BFail and don't even bother to return!

title: A Righteous Sermon
obj_text:
Wait for Inquisitor Hallard to finish his Righteous Sermon and return to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight with the information you uncover.
 $BRighteous Sermon Heard
desc_text: Godfrey Goodard, once a righteous man and mayor of Wintergarde, is now an agent of the Scourge. His transformation from man to undying ghoul has taken place slowly, over time. He hears the call of the Lich King now and lives only to serve his master.$BBut as with all Scourge, Godfrey knows the language of death and with proper motivation, will tell us what we need to know about the tome.$BOnce you hear what you need to hear, return to the High Commander at the front lines. I'll clean up here as needed.

title: Steamtank Surprise
obj_text:
Use an Alliance Steam Tank to destroy 6 Plague Wagons and deliver the 7th Legion Elites to Wintergarde Mausoleum. Speak with Ambo Cash inside the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight should you succeed.
 Plague Wagon Sabotaged (6)
 7th Legion Elite Safely Dropped Off
desc_text: This is a seek and destroy mission. You'll be driving a tank into the Carrion Fields to dismantle Scourge plague wagons. With the tank comes a crew of three 7th Legion soldiers. All must survive if this mission is to succeed!$BYou'll need to get in close to a plague wagon to unleash your engineer. Let them do their deed and move on to the next one. When the field is clear of plague wagons, head to the mausoleum in front of the ruined keep and drop off the rest of your crew. Meet with Ambo Cash inside.

title: Secrets of the Scourge
obj_text: Deliver the Flesh-bound Tome to Cavalier Durkon at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Scrawled across the flesh-bound chapters of this tome are strange symbols and shapes that seem to have been scraped into the pages with a blade. You have no idea what is written, but you are certain that whatever it is, it must be important.$BDeliver the tome to Cavalier Durkon standing guard topside at Wintergarde Crypt.

title: Into Hostile Territory
obj_text: Speak with Gryphon Commander Urik to secure a ride to Thorson's Post. Report to Duke August Foehammer when you arrive at Thorson's Post in Dragonblight.
desc_text: You have done much to advance our efforts against the Scourge, <name>. In fact, the morale of all those who have come into contact with you soars! Such is your influence over the soldiers and citizenry of Wintergarde, ally.$BAnd because of you we are now prepared to go on the offensive! You are to report to Duke August Foehammer, across the Carrion Fields at Thorson's Post, east of here. Gryphon Commander Urik at the gryphon station has prepared a special gryphon to drop you behind enemy lines. Go now!

title: The Chain Gun And You
obj_text:
Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to save 8 Injured 7th Legion Soldiers.
 Injured 7th Legion Soldier Saved (8)
desc_text: We've set up chain guns and barricades directly to the east and to the west. Our injured soldiers are hiding in both rooms - trying their best to not alert the mindless ghouls to their presence.$BNow that we have ammo, I need you to man one of the chain guns and use it to blast a path clear for our soldiers! Once you're on board, call a soldier out from hiding and then lay down heavy fire to keep the Scourge off him!$BGet a move on!

title: Understanding the Language of Death
obj_text: Take the Flesh-bound Tome to Inquisitor Hallard at the Wintergarde Keep prison.
desc_text: Take the book and follow the path leading up to the barracks. Once inside the barracks take the staircase down to the prison. At the prison you will find Inquisitor Hallard and our mayor, Godfrey. I believe Godfrey might be the missing piece of this puzzle and Hallard the man to put it all together.$BGo now!

title: Mystery of the Tome
obj_text: Take the Flesh-bound Tome to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
desc_text: What can it be, <name>? That was certainly no ordinary curse that the blasted lich put on you!$B<Durkon flips through the grisly pages of the tome.>$BI don't even know if I'm looking at it the right way. We must find out what information is held within this tome!$B<Durkon hands the book back to you.>$BThe High Commander will know what to do. Take the flesh-bound tome to him and tell him exactly what happened here.

title: Scattered To The Wind
obj_text: Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to recover 8 Wintergarde Munitions.
desc_text: The munitions drop went badly, friend. The shipment of ammo from Westguard Keep was intercepted by the frostwyrms circling overhead. The flying machines were torn apart in a matter of seconds and their cargo was scattered to the wind. Most of it is still topside - on the Carrion Fields.$BI'm gonna need you to go back up and recover the munitions crates that are scattered all over this damned place.$BHurry it up! We can't start this offensive without guns and ammo, <buddy/missy>!

title: Breaking Off A Piece
obj_text:
Yord "Calamity" Icebeard at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to kill Necrolord X'avius, Necrolord Horus, and 15 Naxxramas Scourge.$B
 Necrolord Horus slain
 Necrolord X'avius slain
 $BNaxxramas Scourge slain (15)

 Tattered Abomination
 Scourge Technician
 Leprous Servant
 Naxxramas Dreadguard
$B

 Naxxramas Shade
 Dreadbone Construct
 Wailing Soul
 Mausoleum Scourge Proxy
desc_text: Just down the steps lies the gateway to damnation: Scourge as far as the eye can see and getting thicker with each passing moment. What little intelligence we've been able to gather indicates that two Scourge necrolords are furiously working at emptying the first two crypts down below. Before we can breach the inner chamber to Thel'zan, we'll need to take care of those two clowns and their Naxxramas cronies.$BGo down into the mausoleum and take out the necrolords and the Naxxramas dreadguards and shades.

title: Plunderbeard Must Be Found!
obj_text: Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight wants you to find Plunderbeard.
desc_text: There's been talk of a tunnel dug by Scourge that connects the embalming chambers of the mausoleum with the large crypts, now unearthed by Thel'zan and his minions. I recently sent my best rogue, Plunderbeard, in search of answers, but have yet to hear back from him. If I were a betting man I'd wager that he's a goner.$BI want you to go down those steps and head straight through the embalming chamber and look for Plunderbeard. Dead or alive, he'll have answers.

title: Chasing Icestorm: The 7th Legion Front
obj_text: Report to Legion Commander Tyralion at the 7th Legion Front in central Dragonblight.
desc_text: You need to get to the 7th Legion Front in northern Dragonblight. Return to Wintergarde Keep and take the north gate out of town. Keep north until you hit a road. Take a left on that road and follow it until you reach the snowline. Once at the snowline keep heading west until you hit the Path of the Titans. Follow that north and it'll lead you right into the 7th Legion Front.$BOnce there, speak with Legion Commander Tyralion. He'll be expecting you.$BAnd <name> - it has been a pleasure. Farewell.

title: An End And A Beginning
obj_text:
Defeat Thel'zan the Duskbringer and report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
 $BThel'zan the Duskbringer Defeated
desc_text: Every good story has a beginning and an ending, <name>. While your story is far from over, I'll be damned if it's not already turning out to be the stuff of legend! No matter what happens to us when this is all over, what you've done at Wintergarde will be a tale told for years to come.$BNow, ally, when you are ready I will use the phylactery to coax Thel'zan out of hiding.$BShould we somehow succeed, report the victory to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep.

title: The Return of the Crusade?
obj_text:
Commander Lynore Windstryke at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to kill 20 Scarlet Onslaught at the Onslaught Base Camp.
 $BScarlet Onslaught slain (20)

 Onslaught Infantry
 Onslaught Scout
 Onslaught Mason
 Onslaught Commander Iustus
$B

 Scarlet Highlord Daion
 Onslaught Commander Iustus
 Onslaught Commander Justus
 Onslaught Base Camp Proxy
desc_text: To the northeast of Wintergarde Keep is a newly built encampment, set up by the Scarlet Crusade - or rather - the Scarlet Onslaught as they now call themselves. While we are unsure as to why they are in Northrend, they are certainly no less dangerous than they were before. As of last night the Scarlet Onslaught has killed twelve of our soldiers. They must be taught a lesson, <name>.$BGo to Onslaught Base Camp and thin them out.

title: To Fordragon Hold!
obj_text: Venture to Fordragon Hold in Dragonblight and speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
desc_text: With the Naxxramas war machine stopped dead in its tracks the time has come for you to help our forces at Angrathar, the Wrathgate. Nestled against the mountain in northern Dragonblight is our base of operations, Fordragon Hold. It is there that Lord Fordragon awaits your arrival! Go now, <name>!$BTake the north gate out of town and travel north by northwest until you arrive at your destination.$BLight protect you!

title: Chasing Icestorm: Thel'zan's Phylactery
obj_text: Recover Thel'zan's Phylactery from Icestorm and return it to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep.
desc_text: Your frostwyrm is out there.$B<Tyralion points west.>$BAnd it's a big one!$BWhen you're ready to fight, go speak with "Wyrmbait." He'll "fetch" her. Once Icestorm is close enough we'll chain her to the ground and finish her off! Hopefully, with your help, we'll be able to take her down and get you that phylactery.$BOnce you've got the phylactery, return to Wintergarde Keep and report to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane. He's been making preparations for the final showdown with Thel'zan.

title: Finality
obj_text: Take Thel'zan's Phylactery to Legion Commander Yorik inside the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Thanks to your heroics, Lord Fordragon has given the command to launch a full assault against Thel'zan. 7th Legion have made their way into the summoning chamber of the mausoleum and located what appears to be a gateway to hell. The only piece that's missing now is you.$BTake the phylactery and report to Legion Commander Yorik inside the Wintergarde Mausoleum.$BThere is a tunnel that the Scourge dug out just outside the keep that you can take to get to Yorik quickly. Go now, <name>! Lead us to victory!

title: What Secrets Men Hide
obj_text: Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to find the Onslaught Map and return it to him.
desc_text: After the betrayal at the Forgotten Shore, Prince Arthas - with Muradin in tow - began his quest for Frostmourne. Could the location of the cavern where Frostmourne was found be near? What secrets could it hold? While the orb has no answers for these questions, it does show me something.$BTo the northeast of Wintergarde Keep is an outpost built by the Scarlet Onslaught. Somewhere within that outpost is a map. The orb tells me that this map will be of great use to us.$BRetrieve it!

title: The Path of Redemption
obj_text: Return "The Path of Redemption" to High Commander Halford Wyrmbane at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight.
desc_text: "The Path of Redemption," ever heard of it? It is allegedly a journal that holds the prophetic ramblings of High General Abbendis of the Scarlet Onslaught. Within that book can be found the motivations and goals of the Scarlet zealots - not to mention a whole lot of insanity.$BVenture to Onslaught Base Camp, northeast of Wintergarde Keep, and recover a copy of "The Path of Redemption" from one of the Onslaught soldiers.

title: The Hills Have Us
obj_text: Report to Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge in western Grizzly Hills.
desc_text: While we focus to hold our ground at Wintergarde and deal with the unfolding events of the Wrathgate, battalions from as far away as Westfall battle their way through the dense foliage and inhospitable denizens of Grizzly Hills. All in hopes of finding an alternate route into Icecrown.$BLieutenant Dumont, stationed at Amberpine Lodge, has enlisted the aid of able bodied citizens willing to risk life and limb in the uncharted wilds. Will you rise to meet this challenge?

title: Plunderbeard's Journal
obj_text: Recover Page 4 of Plunderbeard's Journal, Page 5 of Plunderbeard's Journal, Page 6 of Plunderbeard's Journal, and Page 7 of Plunderbeard's Journal and return them to Ambo Cash at the Wintergarde Mausoleum in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Whatever was written on the remaining pages of Plunderbeard's journal must be recovered. Search the chambers located on the other side of this tunnel for Plunderbeard's assailants. They must be the ones who tore the journal apart!$BShould you recover the missing pages, return them to Ambo Cash at the entrance of the Wintergarde Mausoleum.

title: An Injured Colleague
obj_text: Take the Battered Tribal Shield to Aponi Brightmane on Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff.
desc_text: The fight's been hard up here, <class>, as I'm sure you know. We're holding out, but not everyone has gone unscathed.$BA warrior in our band, Aponi Brightmane, was taken ill by an infected wound in her arm. She's been taken back to Thunder Bluff for recuperation. It seems she left her shield here at the front in the confusion, however - could you take it to her, along with our well-wishes? Her smile is missed around here.$BYou can find her on Elder Rise on the Bluff.

title: Frostmourne Cavern
obj_text:
Zelig the Visionary at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to use Zelig's Scrying Orb at the bottom of Frostmourne Cavern. Unlock the secrets of the past!
 Secrets of the Past Revealed
desc_text: They have labeled the cave as Frostmourne Cavern. Why the Scarlet Onslaught is interested in such things is unknown, but by the look of things, the area surrounding the cave is heavily guarded. Nonetheless, we must proceed!$BTake this scrying orb and travel north out of town and then northwest towards Scarlet Point. Make your way into the cave and battle your way to the bottom. Once there, use the orb. Return here with what you discover.

title: A Cautious Return
obj_text: ring Daros' Journal to Mordent Evenshade in Darnassus.
desc_text: A moment of your time, <class>.$BChange is coming. It has drawn us out of the ruins of Eldre'Thalas and into the wide world once more. I have come to research this city and cannot stray from it, but if you are inclined, I have an errand for you.$BMy colleague set out for Darnassus to speak with the High Priestess there, that we might come to an understanding. Take this journal to Mordent Evenshade in the temple. It may help in his diplomacy mission.

title: The Clutches of Evil
obj_text:
Destroy 15 Proto-Drake Eggs and 15 Proto-Whelps, and then return to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep.
 Proto-Drake Egg destroyed (15)
 Proto-Whelp slain (15)
desc_text: <name>, I don't trust anyone but you to take care of this.  I need the proto-drake eggs and proto-whelps in the burning forest to the southeast destroyed!$BSince we arrived here, the Ember Clutch has been ablaze; there must be some sort of perverse magic at work. And lately it seems to be growing. My men tell me that if we don't do something quickly, we'll be surrounded on all sides by the fire within a few weeks' time!$BGet down there and eliminate the threat by destroying those eggs and the proto-whelps.

title: Break the Blockade
obj_text:
Take Petrov's Cluster Bombs and drop them on enough pirates to kill or destroy 10 Blockade Pirates and 5 Blockade Cannons.  Once you've accomplished that, return to Bombardier Petrov at Westguard Keep.
 $BBlockade Pirate slain (10)

 Blockade Captain
$B

 Blockade Pirate
$B
$B
 Blockade Cannons destroyed (5)
desc_text: All of our ships are sunk! We need your help to break the pirate blockade below in the Shattered Straits!$BTake these cluster bombs and hitch a ride on the zeppelin that Harrowmeiser has 'loaned' to us.  He'll fly you over the decks of those pirate scoundrels, and you make sure to give it to them good!$BIf you can't bomb them to smithereens, I'm afraid we'll never be able to break the blockade.

title: The New Plague
obj_text: Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing wants you to recover 10 Intact Plague Containers from the wrecked ship to the southeast.
desc_text: Not long after Arthas condemned us to this wretched existence, we in the Royal Apothecary Society endeavored to create a plague of our own.  A plague that would devour all flesh: living, dead or undead.$BWe've succeeded in creating this plague and we're here to hand deliver it to the Scourge's doorstep.$BThe Alliance intercepted the ship carrying the latest strain engineered in our Undercity laboratories.  Head to the wreckage southeast of here and salvage whatever containers you can.

title: My Daughter
obj_text: Old Man Stonemantle has asked you to find his daughter, Overseer Irena Stonemantle, at Steel Gate.
desc_text: Tell me, is it true? Did the explorers that went into Whisper Gulch go mad?$BMy daughter is the overseer of the Explorers' League that went north to some place called Steel Gate. With the horrible events that have befallen us, I fear for her safety.$BPlease, <class>, I am too old to make the journey. Her name is Irena. Will you go make certain that she is alright?

title: Shoveltusk Soup Again?
obj_text: Chef Kettleblack has asked you to obtain 6 Shoveltusk Meat and deliver them to her at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: With all of the strange disappearances of our livestock, we better resupply in a hurry, or the beasties around these parts will be the least of our worries!$BSeeing as I'm in charge of feeding this lot, I'm going to need you to head east and get me some meat. More to the point, I'm looking to cook us up some tender shoveltusk meat.$BJust beware the stags... they're mean!

title: Scare the Guano Out of Them!
obj_text: Collect 10 Darkclaw Guano and deliver them to Engineer Feknut at Steel Gate.
desc_text: You, yes you... I need your help!$BPetrov sent me up here to get bat guano for the cluster bombs he's making back at the keep. He sent me to my doom!$BThe darkclaw bats hang out in the Rivenwood to the north, but I'm not taking a step off of this platform unless it's to go home!$BBut you... you could get it for me! Yes? Pretty please?!!!$BHere, take these firecrackers. My thinking is that if you drop 'em underneath the bats, the guano will be scared right out of them!

title: Test at Sea
obj_text:
Speak to Bat Handler Camille and take a riding bat to intercept the Alliance reinforcements.  Once above their fleet, use the Plague Vials to infect 16 North Fleet reservists.
 North Fleet Reservist Infected (16)
desc_text: We've just received word of reinforcements coming to the aid of the Alliance forces.  Their timing couldn't be better!$BWe're in sore need of test subjects and these North Fleet reservists will do nicely!$BTake these plague vials with you and speak to Camille, the Bat Handler.  Tell her you need to commandeer a riding bat for a special assignment for us.$BOnce you're at sea, drop the vials on the reinforcement fleet.  I can't wait to see the results!

title: Spiking the Mix
obj_text: ring 3 Giant Toxin Glands from Giant Tidecrawlers to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
desc_text: I've a feeling the long trip across the sea is affecting the effectiveness of our plague.  What is needed is a potent toxin to boost the potency of the strain.$BThe crabs near this beach are a distant relative of the much smaller brown-shelled tidecrawler.  The smaller tropical variety produces a paralytic toxin strong enough to knock out an ogre.$BAs we all know bigger is better!  The much larger glands on the local variety should prove more potent.  Bring me a few!

title: See to the Operations
obj_text: Explorer Irena Stonemantle has asked you to speak with a Steel Gate Chief Archaeologist at Steel Gate.
desc_text: Our work out here is really just beginning. But now that we've brought these flying machines in from Westguard Keep, it should really pick up.$BThe problem is that we're lacking enough qualified pilots. And with things getting worse in the Rivenwood to the north, I'd like to get things wrapped up here quickly and then head back home.$BIf you can lend a hand, go have a chat with one of my chief archaeologists. You'll find them next to the flying machines on the north and south sides of the site.

title: Root Causes
obj_text:
Slay 5 Dragonflayer Handlers and Skeld Drakeson.  If you manage to do so, return to an Ember Clutch Ancient in the Ember Clutch.
 Dragonflayer Handler slain (5)
 Skeld Drakeson slain
desc_text: All things in nature seek a balance. It is only through the interference of those not in tune with that harmony that the balance is shifted.$BYou waste your efforts when you kill the whelps and drakes. The real culprits behind the expansion of these magically burning woods are the newly awakened vrykul and their master, Skeld Drakeson.$BIf it's blood on your hands that you seek, start with them. You will find their lair on the south side of the Ember Clutch.

title: Mage-Lieutenant Malister
obj_text: Captain Adams has asked you to speak with his advisor, Mage-Lieutenant Malister, at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: THIS IS OUTRAGEOUS! Those proto-drakes are attacking the keep!$BBeasts such as that should have been scared off when you took care of their clutches and whelps.$BYou did take care of them, right?$B<name>, this calls for more direct action. Speak with my advisor, Mage-Lieutenant Malister. He'll provide you with the means to get at those infernal creatures.

title: Report to Scout Knowles
obj_text: Captain Adams has asked you to report to Scout Knowles at the Ember Spear Tower.
desc_text: <name>, now that those damnable proto-creatures have been dealt with, I've another task for you.$BOne of my scouts has reported back some suspicious activity by the Forsaken to the south. It looks like they're up to no good at the vrykul village known as Halgrind.$BI want you to personally take over the investigation down there. Speak with Scout Knowles to find out what he's uncovered and proceed from there.$BHis last reported position is at the Ember Spear Tower, just to the west of Halgrind.

title: [Temporarily Deprecated Awaiting a New Mob]Finlay Is Gutless
obj_text: Collect 7 Pristine Mistsaber Catgut for Finlay Fletcher and return to him at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: All these crossbowmen, and who is it that has to maintain all of their weapons? Me, Finlay Fletcher!$BThe commander commandeered my assistant to get ready for the move up to Fort Wildervaar, and I haven't the time to go out and get all of the catgut that I need for their strings!$B<class>, be a good <lad /lass> and gather me up some catgut. The mistsabers prowling about the fjord will do, but mind that you only bring back the most pristine of intestines from them! Severed gut won't do us any good.

title: Reports from the Field
obj_text:
Speak to Dark Ranger Lyana and Deathstalker Razael in the battlefield at the Bleeding Vale south of Vengeance Landing.  Return to High Executor Anselm when you've completed this task.
 Listen to Razael's Report
 Listen to Lyana's Report
desc_text: Our mission in Northrend is to destroy Arthas.  The Alliance are but an obstacle that we'll crush wherever we find them.$BWe've managed to destroy their easternmost fleet; but the survivors have barricaded themselves on the Derelict Strand, south of here.$BOur forces should've overwhelmed their make-shift defenses long ago, but we underestimated their will to live.  Seek my officers in the field, Dark Ranger Lyana and Deathstalker Razael and get them to report on the situation.

title: Two Wrongs...
obj_text:
Mage-Lieutenant Malister at Westguard Keep has tasked you with the destruction of 3 Proto-Drakes.
 Proto-Drake slain (3)
desc_text: Now that we've riled up these Ember Clutch proto-drakes, they may be inclined to continue their attacks upon the keep. This will not do.$BI hate to compound one wrong with another, but in this case it would appear that we will have to destroy the creatures. A regrettable course of action, but one that we need to undertake regardless.$BTake my wand. I've been experimenting with increasing its range, but it doesn't pack much of a punch. However, what it will do is get a proto-drake's attention.

title: Mission: Eternal Flame
obj_text:
Scout Knowles at the Ember Spear Tower has recommended that you use the Ever-burning Torches to destroy the four Plague Tanks surrounding Halgrind.
 Southwest Plague Tank Destroyed
 Northwest Plague Tank Destroyed
 Northeast Plague Tank Destroyed
 Southeast Plague Tank Destroyed
desc_text: The Forsaken are up to no good and from what I can tell, those plague tanks of sludge are a big part of it.$BIf I may suggest, <sir /ma'am>, we should probably destroy them before they can get any more use out of the things. I took the liberty of preparing a bundle of torches from the Ember Clutch. These things have been burning for days!$BHere, I'm sure you can put them to better use than I in destroying those tanks.

title: One Size Does Not Fit All
obj_text: Cannoneer Ely has tasked you with rounding up 10 Westguard Cannonballs and returning them to him at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: <Lad /Lass>, who's the genius that made our cannons a non-standard size? Now we have ta make special cannonballs ta shoot out o' the infernal contraptions!$BI would look kindly on ye if ye would go out and find the balls we've already shot. No doubt with the way these louts shoot they be all o'er the place ta the south and east.$B<The cannoneer spaces his hands apart to give you an idea of how big the cannonballs are.>$BThat would be faster than us making 'em from scratch fer a certainty.

title: Send Them Packing
obj_text:
Explorer Abigail has asked you to /raise 10 Abandoned Pack Mules and then return to her at Westguard Keep.$BHandle emote "/raise" on the Abandoned Pack Mules and they will do their job for you!
 Abandoned Pack Mule Sent Packing (10)
desc_text: I've heard rumors of bad happenings in the Whisper Gulch to the north. Most of the Explorers' League went down into that place, and some say they went mad with what they discovered.$BThat doesn't change the fact that they took most of our mules and equipment with them, though. I won't lose those mules!$BIf you find yourself in there, and happen across any of my mules, just get up close on them and threaten them with a raised hand. They'll spook and come home for sure.

title: Of Keys and Cages
obj_text:
Father Levariol has asked you to collect enough Gjalerbron Cage Keys to free 10 Gjalerbron Prisoners. Return to him at Westguard Keep when you manage to do so.
 Gjalerbron Prisoner Freed (10)
desc_text: The captain may not care, but from the little we know, the vrykul are conducting heinous rites in some sort of 'awakening' ritual up north in Gjalerbron.$BThey're using living sacrifices to fuel their unholy rituals!$B<class>, you must put a stop to this! It matters not who or what is in those cages, they must be freed. I'd bet that the vrykul hold the keys.$BThe Light knows the last thing we need is more of those strange vrykul walking about, or worse yet, them wakening something even more evil!

title: Ambushed!
obj_text:
Captain Harker aboard the Windrunner wants you to kill 15 North Fleet Marines.
 North Fleet Marine slain (15)
desc_text: This should have been a walk in the park.  Their forces are hungry, injured and ill equipped.  Yet somehow, we walked right into their trap.$BWe approached these reefs from the south to gain cover and were immediately boarded by the Alliance dogs.$BI'm sorry to say, if you want our cannons to fire at anything, you're going to have to help us take our ships back.

title: The Windrunner Fleet
obj_text: Speak to Bat Handler Camille at Vengeance Landing and obtain passage to the Windrunner.  Report to Captain Harker aboard the ship.
desc_text: We have the Windrunner, the Queen's Reprisal and the Oblivion stationed just east of the Derelict Strand.  Send orders to the fleet's commander, Captain Harker, that they're to destroy the Alliance's cannons.$BSpeak to our bat handler, Camille, and ask for passage to the fleet's location.  Be quick, <name>, every minute we spend fighting the Alliance is a minute we could've spent fighting Arthas.

title: Let Them Eat Crow
obj_text:
Pontius, the kennel keeper at Vengeance Landing, wants you to use the Plaguehound Cage to summon a Hungry Plaguehound and feed it Crow Meat from Fjord Crows west of Vengeance Landing.
 Plaguehound Fed (5)
desc_text: The high executor wants me to use my dogs to sniff out enemy scouts, but I can tell you right now these plaguehounds aren't going anywhere until they're properly fed.$BIf our military doesn't understand that these beasts are picky enough to not eat the rubbish they've given me, then they can't expect them to be of any use in the field.$BYou seem to have some time on your hands, why don't you take one of these dogs out hunting for crows out west?  Their meat isn't very tasty to us, but my boys love it!

title: Danger! Explosives!
obj_text: Use Steelring's Foolproof Dynamite to collect 6 Whisper Gulch Ore Fragments and 18 Whisper Gulch Gems. Then return them to Sapper Steelring at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: <name>, the captain's tasked me with a mission. I'd like you to help.$BA bunch of my fellow Explorers' League people went nuts digging up stuff in the Whisper Gulch just to the north. They're attacking anyone trying to get in!$BThe captain is only concerned with the ore for the keep. Lucky for us, I have just the thing to do the trick.$BGet in there, blow up the ore, and bring it back along with any gems you find. Running this place isn't cheap you know!$BI gotta warn you though, that ore is strange!

title: Guide Our Sights
obj_text:
Use the Smoke Flares at the location of the Alliance Cannons on the northern wall of the Derelict Strand.  Report to Dark Ranger Lyana at the Bleeding Vale after you've completed this task.
 Eastern Cannon Marked
 Western Cannon Marked
desc_text: We should be able to kill our way back to our guns.  Unfortunately, visibility is less than desirable so you will have to mark our targets from the ground.$BTake these smoke flares with you and use them to mark the locations of the cannons along the northern wall in the Derelict Strand, west of here, where the Alliance are holding out.$BLet Lyana know as soon as the way is clear for the ground troops.  We can take care of ourselves over here.

title: Landing the Killing Blow
obj_text:
Dark Ranger Lyana south of the Vengeance Landing wants you to kill Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne, and Sergeant Lorric at the Derelict Strand.
 Captain Olster slain
 Lieutenant Celeyne slain
 Sergeant Lorric slain
desc_text: You've proven yourself in the field of battle, <name>.  You might very well have changed the tides in our favor.$BI've an important assignment for you now.  I'm not sure how much longer the weakness we've exposed is going to last, so we must use the element of surprise to our advantage.$BI want you to use the confusion created by our attack and go behind enemy lines to assassinate their leaders.  In order of rank, they are: Captain Olster, Lieutenant Celeyne and Sergeant Lorric.  Good luck, <class>.

title: Report to Anselm
obj_text: Report back to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
desc_text: Let's send word back to old Anselm then.  Victory has come later than expected, but better late than never.  Tell him it will take our forces a few hours at most to finish off the stragglers here.$BGlory to the Banshee Queen!

title: Trail of Fire
obj_text:
Escort Apothecary Hanes out of the Derelict Strand.  Report to Apothecary Lysander at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord when you've completed this task.
 $BRescue Apothecary Hanes
desc_text: Thanks for bailing me out of this mess, <name>.  I was not looking forward to what these Alliance scumbags had in store for me.$BLet's get out of here and see if we can get back at them somehow.  Is that a campfire over there?

title: Dealing With Gjalerbron
obj_text:
Captain Adams has asked you to kill 15 Gjalerbron Warriors, 8 Gjalerbron Rune-casters, and 8 Gjalerbron Sleep-watchers. Afterward, return to him at Westguard Keep.
 Gjalerbron Warrior slain (15)
 Gjalerbron Rune-Caster slain (8)
 Gjalerbron Sleep-Watcher slain (8)
desc_text: And now we have a different problem. My scouts that have lived to return have informed me that the vrykul are up to no good at their main fortress to the north.$BThey call the place Gjalerbron, though you'd pronounce the 'Gj' as if it were an 'Sh'. Odd creatures.$BBut that's not important; what is, is that you get up there and put an end to the lives of as many of those creatures as you can while trying to figure out what they're up to.$BI know that I can count on you, <name>.

title: Leader of the Deranged
obj_text:
Slay Squeeg Idolhunter and then report back to Sapper Steelring at Westguard Keep.
 Squeeg Idolhunter slain
desc_text: So, I hate to say it, pal, but while you were out, the captain took a keener interest in that place.$BLooks like he wants my old Explorers' League boss in there dead. My guess would be that we're gearing up for an offensive to clear out the rest of them, and the captain wants their head lopped off, as it were.$BDo me a favor? Head back into Whisper Gulch and put an end to Squeeg Idolhunter. From what I remember, my guess would be that he's in the cave in the northwest corner.

title: In Service to the Light
obj_text:
Slay 10 Deathless Watchers, 4 Fearsome Horrors, and 2 Putrid Wights. Afterward, inform Father Levariol at Westguard Keep of your success.
 Deathless Watcher slain (10)
 Fearsome Horror slain (4)
 Putrid Wight slain (2)
desc_text: Your service has been exemplary, <name>, but there is something that is troubling me: the Scourge.$BThe Light cannot abide their presence, and neither shall we. I hope that it is not asking you too much, but I would have you return north to Gjalerbron and crush the unholy Scourge in that vile lair! Be sure to check for them in the Waking Halls beneath Gjalerbron as well.$BPurification is the key to salvation, my child. Make us proud!

title: Towers of Certain Doom
obj_text:
The Westguard Sergeant has informed you that using the Sergeant's Flare to target all four of the towers at Skorn for cannon volleys would be advisable.
 Northwest Tower Targeted
 East Tower Targeted
 Southwest Tower Targeted
 Southeast Tower Targeted
desc_text: <Sir /Ma'am>, as we move through Skorn, we have to bring down those towers!$BIf you have a look at them, you'll notice that their tops are lined with casters. Getting too close to them would mean certain doom for us!$BHowever, we do have it within our means to call in cannon volleys from Westguard Keep. To do so, we need to get close enough so that you can lob a smoke flare atop of them.$BJust don't get too close!

title: Burn Skorn, Burn!
obj_text:
The Westguard Sergeant has orders that you should use the Sergeant's Torch to set fire to the Northeast and Northwest Longhouses and the Barracks at Skorn.
 Northwest Longhouse Set Ablaze
 Northeast Longhouse Set Ablaze
 Barracks Set Ablaze
desc_text: Captain Adams gave me strict instructions to make sure that a good deal of infrastructure damage was inflicted on this site.$BHowever, since you're in charge out here, that's at your discretion, <sir /ma'am>.$BMay I suggest that we burn down the two longhouses and the barracks that are in the lower area of Skorn? All we have to do is get inside each and throw this torch.

title: Gruesome, But Necessary
obj_text:
The Westguard Sergeant has asked you to use The Sergeant's Machete to dismember 20 Vrykul of the Winterskorn tribe at Skorn.
 Winterskorn Vrykul Dismembered (20)
desc_text: We've had reports that these vrykul can rise from the dead; not unlike the Scourge, but a different kind of undeath.$BLet's not take any chances.$BHere, take my machete. As we move through this place, you'll need to carve up the remains of the vrykul that we take down. I'd do it, but I have a sensitive stomach.$B<The sergeant smirks.>$BI spent all morning sharpening it, so it should do the job.

title: Fresh Legs
obj_text: Scout Valory wants you to investigate the sounds of battle coming from the northeast of Wyrmskull Village.
desc_text: It's come at great cost, but we've completed our inspection of the site.$BThe news isn't good. Nearly everyone has been slain or captured. Only a few veteran guards remain unaccounted for.$BThe scouts have done all we can here. You must pick up where we've left off.$BSounds of a skirmish are coming from up the hill to the northeast. Have a look, <class>. We can only hope there are some who have survived, and that they may have some intel we can use against this enemy.

title: Operation: Skornful Wrath
obj_text: Captain Adams has asked you to use the Westguard Command Insignia at Skorn, and then to speak with the Westguard Sergeant.
desc_text: <name>, I must now ask you to undertake an operation so hazardous, so deadly, that only you can see it through.$BThe vrykul fortress, Skorn, sits on our eastern border. My scouts inform me that those 'giants' are poised to strike us, and with my forces scattered all over the fjord, I don't have the men to take the place by force.$BInstead, you're going to use your cunning. I've sent a sergeant ahead with the details. Show this command insignia at Skorn and he'll reveal himself and follow your orders.

title: Sniff Out the Enemy
obj_text: Use the Plaguehound Leash near the plaguehound cages at Vengeance Landing and look for clues at the location you're led to by the Plaguehound Tracker.
desc_text: Now that this rascal's belly's full, maybe he will be more willing to cooperate.  Here's his leash, just come get him from his cage whenever you're ready to take him.$BI don't know what Anselm expects you to find, but look for clues wherever it is that the dog takes you.

title: The Dragonskin Map
obj_text: ring the Dragonskin Map to High Executor Anselm in Vengeance Landing.
desc_text: Upon closer inspection, the scroll appears to be a heavily-illustrated map of the fjord.  The location of various villages are depicted in what seem to be tribal symbols.$BThe location of Vengeance Landing is marked with a disproportionately large skull.$BThis map will almost certainly be of military value to High Executor Anselm.

title: Gruesome, But Necessary
obj_text:
The Winterhoof Brave has asked you to use The Brave's Machete to dismember 20 Vrykul of the Winterskorn tribe at Skorn.
 Winterskorn Vrykul Dismembered (20)
desc_text: Our elders say that these vrykul may be able to rise from the dead; not unlike the walking dead you call the Scourge, but a different kind of undeath.$BWe should not take any chances.$BHere, take my machete. As we move through this place, carve up the remains of the vrykul that we slay.$BI spent the morning sharpening it, so it should cleave even through their thick bones.

title: Skorn Must Fall!
obj_text: Chieftain Ashtotem has asked you to use the Winterhoof Emblem at Skorn, and then to speak with the Winterhoof Brave.
desc_text: <name>, the vrykul fortress, Skorn, sits to the south. Its strange giants have recently awakened and have begun to spread, attacking us wherever they can.$BMy scouts inform me that they are poised to strike at us here, but I do not have the strength to repel such a force. Instead, we will prepare to leave north to less dangerous lands.$BI ask that you use your cunning to buy us time. I've sent a brave ahead with the details. Show this emblem at Skorn and he'll reveal himself and do all he can to aid you.

title: Of Keys and Cages
obj_text:
Greatmother Ankha has asked you to collect enough Gjalerbron Cage Keys to free 10 Gjalerbron Prisoners. Return to her at Camp Winterhoof when you manage to do so.
 Gjalerbron Prisoner Freed (10)
desc_text: From the little we know, the vrykul are conducting unnatural rites in an 'awakening' ritual to the west in Gjalerbron.$BThey're using living sacrifices to fuel their rituals.$B<name>, you must stop this. It matters not who or what is in those cages, they must be freed. I would guess that the vrykul hold the keys.$BThe last thing we need is more of those strange vrykul threatening us, or worse, them wakening something even more evil....

title: Into Utgarde!
obj_text: Defender Mordun has tasked you with the execution of Ingvar the Plunderer who resides deep in Utgarde.$BYou are then to bring his head to Vice Admiral Keller.
desc_text: Listen up, youngster. I've put down me share of these creatures - and your share too fer that matter. Here be what ya need to know....$BThe vrykul are fearless in a fight. Seems they actually yearn fer a death in battle. With their numbers and that ferocity, we're doomed - plain and simple.$BThere's one they esteem though, goes by the name of Ingvar. I dunno why they be seekin' his praise, but bring him down and you'll deal a mighty blow to their spirit.$BThen, perhaps, we'll have a chance....

title: Dealing With Gjalerbron
obj_text:
Chieftain Ashtotem has asked you to kill 15 Gjalerbron Warriors, 8 Gjalerbron Rune-casters, and 8 Gjalerbron Sleep-watchers. Afterward, return to him at Camp Winterhoof.
 Gjalerbron Warrior slain (15)
 Gjalerbron Rune-Caster slain (8)
 Gjalerbron Sleep-Watcher slain (8)
desc_text: My longrunners that have lived to return have informed me that the vrykul have awakened at their main fortress to the west.$BIt is a forbidden place known as Gjalerbron. The longrunners tell me that the vrykul are performing strange rituals.$BWe cannot allow this to continue.$BAre you willing to continue to assist us? Will you kill the vrykul at Gjalerbron before they finish whatever they are doing and attack us here?

title: Burn Skorn, Burn!
obj_text:
The Winterhoof Brave suggests that you use the Brave's Torch to set fire to the Northeast and Northwest Longhouses and the Barracks at Skorn.
 Northwest Longhouse Set Ablaze
 Northeast Longhouse Set Ablaze
 Barracks Set Ablaze
desc_text: Chieftain Ashtotem ordered me to destroy many buildings here.$BHowever, you are in charge, so it falls to your hands, <name>.$BI suggest that we burn down the two longhouses and the barracks that are in the lower area of Skorn. All we have to do is get inside each and set them ablaze with this torch.

title: The Walking Dead
obj_text:
Slay 10 Deathless Watchers, 4 Fearsome Horrors, and 2 Putrid Wights. Afterward, inform Greatmother Ankha at Camp Winterhoof of your success.
 Deathless Watcher slain (10)
 Fearsome Horror slain (4)
 Putrid Wight slain (2)
desc_text: Your assistance to us has been tremendous, <name>, but there is something that is troubling me: these so-called Scourge.$BThe spirits of the land and air, the waters and the fire below the world, would not abide their presence, but seem to do nothing about them. We will see to it that they are dealt with!$BPerhaps it is asking too much, but I would have you return west to Gjalerbron and destroy the unnatural Scourge in that vile lair. Be sure to check in the Waking Halls below Gjalerbron as well!

title: Towers of Certain Doom
obj_text:
The Winterhoof Brave has informed you that using the Brave's Flare to target all four of the towers at Skorn for air strikes would be advisable.
 Northwest Tower Targeted
 East Tower Targeted
 Southwest Tower Targeted
 Southeast Tower Targeted
desc_text: As we move through Skorn, we must destroy the towers.$BIf you have a look at them, you'll notice that their tops are lined with casters. Getting too close to them would mean certain doom.$BHowever, we can call in wind rider air strikes from Camp Winterhoof. To do so, we need to get close enough so that you can lob a smoke flare atop of them.$BJust don't get too close.

title: My Old Enemy
obj_text: Deliver The High General's Head to Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Wintergarde Keep.
desc_text: My old enemy, High General Abbendis, has come to Northrend.$BSomehow she survived the attacks upon Tyr's Hand and brought a small force north. They've established New Hearthglen to the south.$BWhile they could prove useful in fighting the Scourge, Abbendis herself is far too shrewd an opponent to let live. Trust me, if we let them stand, she will be at our throats before the dust settles.$BSo, we'll deprive them of their leadership and go about our business. Bring me her head as proof.

title: Ingvar Must Die!
obj_text: Dark Ranger Marrah has asked you to kill Ingvar the Plunderer in Utgarde Keep, then bring his head to High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing.
desc_text: Finally, someone's come. I've been here far too long and my wits are beginning to fail me. Of our entire recon party, only I remain.$BI shall give you my report and it will be up to you to act upon the information. Know this, <class>; it did not come cheaply.$BThese vrykul are relentless fighters. Given their numbers and their savage tactics, our only hope is to bring down their leader and pray it brings chaos to their ranks.$BIngvar is his name. Bring his head to Anselm when your duty is done.

title: Down to the Wire
obj_text: Gil Grisert wants you to bring him 10 clumps of Spotted Hippogryph Down.
desc_text: The vanguard of the Alliance force will be arriving within days. The soldiers will be expecting their winter gear to be prepared, but I've still got more cloaks to make.$BI've been using spotted hippogryph down for the cloaks' linings, but my stock won't last!$BYou've got to help me, <name>. Captain Adams will have my hide if those cloaks aren't ready in time! Bring me all the down you can find out there. It's dropped to the ground by molting hippogryphs flying over the wilderness around the fort.

title: War is Hell
obj_text:
High Executor Anselm at Vengeance Landing wants you to take the Burning Torch and use it to burn 10 of the corpses littered to the west of town.
 $BFallen Combatant burned (10)

 Alliance Corpse
 Forsaken Corpse
$B

 North Fleet Corpse
 Fallen Combatant
desc_text: We're slowly finishing off the remnants of Stormwind's North Fleet stationed on this coast.  The bodies to the west are a testament to how brutal this confrontation has been.$BThis does not happen to bother my refined aesthetics, but it does present a danger to our lives.$BIn the lands of the Lich King, the dead are a weapon that can rise against us at any point in time.  Take this torch - you're going to make sure that doesn't happen.

title: Hasty Preparations
obj_text: Ahota Whitefrost at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring him 10 clumps of Spotted Hippogryph Down.
desc_text: The down of the spotted hippogryph is prized by my people and used for everything from fletching to ceremonial clothing. We're making preparations to leave the post, so this is the last chance I'll get to gather it this season.$BWith your help, I'll have enough to make sure everyone has the equipment they need for the long trek into the hills. Conditions worsen very quickly up there and a storm can blow in without warning.$BThe down can be found all over the ground in the area surrounding the post.

title: A Score to Settle
obj_text:
High Executor Anselm wants you to to go into Utgarde and slay Prince Keleseth.
 Prince Keleseth slain
desc_text: This elf prince thinks he can come to my town, insult my queen, kill my men and get away with it?  He thinks we're going to stand by while the hordes of Utgarde build up to launch an attack?$BNot in a million years.$BYou're going to walk right into Utgarde and kill him in front of any of these vrykul gorillas that might be watching.  I want Arthas to know that we've arrived and we're playing for keeps.

title: The Depths of Depravity
obj_text: Glorenfeld at the Utgarde Catacombs wants you to collect 10 Wyrmskull Tablets.
desc_text: They're keepin' Daegarn locked up in a cage at the large fightin' ring nearby. From what I've gathered, the Dragonflayers bring out their prisoners to battle against their most powerful gladiators. They dump the losers in the basement where Scourge necromancers turn 'em into ghoulies! It's horrifying!$BBut first things first! The tablets are strewn about all across this dungeon. Let's get those recovered before you go off tryin' to be a hero.

title: Making the Horn
obj_text: Nokoma Snowseer at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring her 6 Undamaged Ram Horns.
desc_text: My people have been hunting the giant yeti of these hills for generations and I will be participating for the first time this year. It will probably be the last before we leave the post forever.$BTo prepare for the hunt, I must fashion a loud horn from the horns of the dire rams that roam the snowy areas near our camp. The elders tell me the sound mimics the mating call of the female yeti, but I have my doubts.$BBring me the best dire ram horns you can find, <name>, and I'll select one from among them.

title: Draconis Gastritis
obj_text:
Plaguebringer Tillinghast at New Agamand wants you to use Tillinghast's Plagued Meat to attract down a Proto-Drake and observe its reaction to eating the stuff.
 Proto-Drake Plague Results Observed
desc_text: Wait, that gives me an idea! What if it didn't kill the whelps because it was sprayed on the outside of their eggs?$B<name>, we have to get the plague inside of them!$BI know! I've got some plagued meat here. Take it to the Ember Clutch and get them to eat it!$BBut no, we're thinking too small. Let's get one of the proto-drakes flying overhead to come down and eat it.$BYes!$BStay close to the meat and observe what happens. Yes, it might attack you, but such is the price of progress.

title: Mimicking Nature's Call
obj_text:
Test the Carved Horn and then return to Nokoma Snowseer at Camp Winterhoof with the results.
 Test Nokoma's Horn
desc_text: The horn has been roughed out, but before I make the traditional carvings, I want to be certain that it will work. Ahota tells me that he tests his horns at the foot of the frozen waterfall to the northeast of the post. Ahota tells me that our hunters have used the acoustics of frozen water in this way for generations. I can't wait to learn more!$BWill you help me test out the horn? If I've done everything right, you may even attract a yeti, so be prepared! Bring the horn back once you've tested it.

title: A Lesson in Fear
obj_text:
Gorth wants you to kill Ulf the Bloodletter, Oric the Baleful and Gunnar Thorvardsson and drive the Forsaken Banner through their corpses.  Slay Vrykul across the Forsaken blockade until they appear.
 Oric the Baleful's Corpse Impaled
 Ulf the Bloodletter's Corpse Impaled
 Gunnar Thorvardsson's Corpse Impaled
desc_text: When you've been in lots of fight like Gorth, you learn that to beat enemy good you have to make them really scared to die!$BBut these vrykuls not afraid.  You kill one and another comes... screaming louder and with a bigger weapon than the one before.$BOnly thing that makes vrykuls afraid is when we kill the biggest and baddest vrykul of all.$BGo fight the Winterskorn across the blockade until hero vrykuls show up!  Then you kill them dead and put queen's flag on corpses.  They must learn to fear!

title: Baleheim Bodycount
obj_text:
Sergeant Gorth wants you to kill 16 Winterskorn Vrykul inside Baleheim.
 $BBaleheim Bodycount (16)

 Winterskorn Spearman
 Winterskorn Bonegrinder
 Winterskorn Skald
$B

 Dragonflayer Huscarl
 Thane Torvald Eriksson
 Baleheim Bodycount
desc_text: Them vrykuls just keeps coming and coming out from town west of here.  No end in sight!$BGorth has an idea.  You go INSIDE town and kill them Winterskorn there.  THEN they stop coming here!

title: Green Eggs and Whelps
obj_text: Plaguebringer Tillinghast has asked you to collect 10 Plagued Proto-Whelp Specimens and deliver them to him at New Agamand.
desc_text: This new plague that we're working on is wonderful and I think we should expand its testing.$BHow about testing it on proto-whelps?!$BJust think of the possibilities. The ability to infect not only humanoids, but extend our reach to any creature!$BHere, I've hoarded an extra plague canister for the right time and place, and you look like the right person.$BSpray the eggs at Ember Clutch to the northwest, then get specimens from the plagued proto-whelps that hatch.

title: The Yeti Next Door
obj_text:
Foreman Colbey at Fort Wildervar wants you to defeat Shatterhorn.
 Shatterhorn slain
desc_text: Maybe if the sentries won't help me, you will? I'm the foreman of the mine just across the bridge. My men are mining ore for the weapons our expeditionary force will need to carve a path into the Grizzly Hills.$BA giant yeti has invaded the mine, blocking the tunnel we need to expand! We've tried yelling at him and smoking him out, but nothing's worked.$BMaybe you could rouse it from its sleep with a meal of meat from the frosthorn rams in the snowy areas around town? Please? We're desperate!

title: Return to Valgarde
obj_text: Take Glorenfeld's Package to Beltrand McSorf at Valgarde Port.
desc_text: 'Tis a shame we lost two of our best dwarves while uncovering these relics. They sacrificed their lives to keep this information safe.$B<Glorenfeld wraps the cipher and tablets in a tattered cloth.>$BTake these back to Valgarde. McSorf will know what to do with the find.$BAs for me? I'll be alright on my own. I've gotten this far in one piece!

title: Baleheim Must Burn!
obj_text:
Sergeant Gorth wants you to go to Baleheim and use Gorth's Torch to burn 1 Winterskorn Dwelling, 1 Winterskorn Watchtower, 1 Winterskorn Bridge and 1 Winterskorn Barracks.
 Winterskorn Dwelling Burned
 Winterskorn Watchtower Burned
 Winterskorn Bridge Burned
 Winterskorn Barracks Burned
desc_text: Killing the Winterskorns maybe not enough.  Maybe we burn their houses too!  Uh... and their bridges.  We should burn whole town to be safe!$BYou take this torch.  Go to Baleheim, to the west, and burn EVERYTHING!  That teach them good.

title: Find Sage Mistwalker
obj_text: Greatmother Ankha has asked you to check on the condition of Sage Mistwalker. She believes him to be at or near Steel Gate.
desc_text: <class>, I grow worried that my son, Sage Mistwalker, has been gone for such a long time. The land is cruel and deadly.$BHe spoke of a recurring vision that he had of a wolf, and went west with a small group of longrunners to seek its source. I believe the name of the place he mentioned was Steel Gate.$BWill you find him? I want to make sure that no ill has befallen him.

title: The Artifacts of Steel Gate
obj_text: Sage Mistwalker has asked you to collect 10 Steel Gate Artifacts. When you have all of them, return to him at Steel Gate.
desc_text: I came out here for a different reason; an old friend of mine has been calling to me in my dreams. But now that I see these small things with their machines making a big hole in the ground, it makes my blood boil.$BFrom what I can see, these dwarves, as they are known, are digging up artifacts; artifacts that could be important to our past.$BI want you to go down there and get these things for me. Don't let any of those dwarves stand in your way.

title: The Offensive Begins
obj_text: Speak to Sergeant Gorth at the blockade near the elevator west of Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
desc_text: No one seems to know very much about the vrykul.  Our records show no signs of activity in their lands for centuries.  Yet here they are, just as we move against Arthas.$BThe map you retrieved makes it clear that we'll have to defeat them if our forces are to get any further into Northrend.$BOne of my best sergeants, an abomination known as Gorth, oversees the blockade beyond the lift.  Assist him in launching a pre-emptive strike on Baleheim.  If a vrykul attack occurs, it will be launched from there.

title: Keeping Watch on the Interlopers
obj_text: Speak to Apothecary Malthus at the Apothecary Camp.
desc_text: Even the earth cannot hold back the tide of death washing over it. Corpses walk the land, spreading their putrefaction with alarming speed.$BA small expedition has made its way up the western cliffs and rests near Whisper Gulch. Take a look for yourself, <name>. See if you can learn their purpose and dissuade them from bringing their poisons into our lands. Travel southwest from the post, toward the cliffs overlooking the western beach. Their camp will be west of the excavation at Steel Gate.

title: The Ring of Judgement
obj_text: Find Daegarn in the Ring of Judgement located inside the Utgarde Catacombs.
desc_text: You might have already seen the room where Daegarn is being held while you were gatherin' the tablets. It's through this corridor and then down a set of steps. Daegarn will be in the room at the bottom of the steps - locked up tight!$BGet down there and find him. At the very least you might be able to get the cipher from him.

title: The Shining Light
obj_text: Ares the Oathbound in the Utgarde Catacombs wants you to recover the Sacred Artifact.$BThis is a timed quest.
desc_text: <Ares gasps for air as he tries to speak.>$BI am an envoy of the Argent Crusade, charged with a sacred duty.$BOur forces were decimated in the Plaguelands. By the light of dawn, the artifact was cleansed and made pure once more. So many perished in the wake of its redemption.$BThere is still a chance... still time.$BThe artifact was hurled into the den of the fallen, far below us. Guarded by the unmerciful dead.$B<Ares' body glows with blinding light.>$BLight. Will. Protect. You.

title: The Ambush
obj_text: Speak to Lydell at Lydell's Ambush.
desc_text: The vrykuls in Baleheim is completely defeated, no doubt about it.  But still their leader stays in town and won't give up.$BGorth sends Lydell and his assassins to make good ambush to the northwest.  You talk to Lydell and figure out how to get Vrykul chieftain to come out.  Then you kill him.  You kill him real good.

title: Guided by Honor
obj_text: Return the Sacred Artifact to Lord Irulon Trueblade at Valgarde.
desc_text: <Ares smiles.>$BGlory to the Light. You have done it!$B<Ares coughs.>$BTake the artifact and return it to Valgarde. Lord Irulon Trueblade awaits its return.$BFight with honor, friend. Always. Honor.$B<Ares dies.>

title: New Agamand
obj_text: ring Lysander's Strain to Chief Plaguebringer Harris in New Agamand in western Howling Fjord.
desc_text: I'm afraid our equipment isn't exactly the best here at Vengeance Landing.  After all it's a military controlled outpost.$BI will need you to take a sample of this strain to Chief Plaguebringer Harris in New Agamand, follow the road beyond Baleheim south and then west.  They have better equipment there - he will know what to do.$BYou must hurry, <name>.  Our enemies are stronger and more numerous than us.  We need to develop a viable weapon against them!

title: What's in That Brew?
obj_text: Apothecary Malthus at the Apothecary Camp wants you to bring him 5 Dwarven Kegs.
desc_text: To the southeast is an area called Whisper Gulch. It's overrun with members of the Explorers' League who've gone mad! They attacked our caravan as it passed through the area, and they've harried our foraging parties as well.$BI must know what's causing this madness! I suspect that whatever they're drinking from the kegs scattered around the gulch contributes to their insanity. I want you to steal the kegs from those dwarves while they're busy mining away.

title: Stunning Defeat at the Ring
obj_text: Defeat the gladiators at the Ring of Judgement and face Oluf the Violent. Defeat Oluf and recover the Ancient Cipher.$BReturn the Ancient Cipher to Glorenfeld at the entrance to the Utgarde Catacombs.
desc_text: Oluf will come out if you defeat the other gladiators. That's 'bout the only way we're getting' that cipher back. Put on your whompin' boots and get busy in the Ring of Judgement. If you do manage to get the cipher back, return it to Glorenfeld o'er near the entrance to these catacombs.$BMe? Don't worry about me! We're on the brink of discovering the missing link to human-kind!

title: Brains! Brains! Brains!
obj_text: Apothecary Grick at the Apothecary Camp wants you to bring him 12 Deranged Explorer Brains.
desc_text: Has Malthus drawn you in with his blather about beer kegs and crazy dwarves?$BI'm not questioning that the dwarves are crazy, but I don't think stealing their beer is going to do any good.$BWhat we need is brains. Lots of brains. We'll get down to the bottom of this mystery in no time, and perhaps even find a new component for the plague.$BTake this saw, go southeast into the Whisper Gulch, and kill yourself some dwarves. Use the saw to help you harvest the brains and bring them back here.

title: Field Test
obj_text:
Venture into Halgrind and use the Plague Spray on 10 Plagued Dragonflayer Vrykul.  Return to Chief Plaguebringer Harris to report the results.
 Plagued Vrykul Sprayed (10)
desc_text: Now that we have a strain of the plague that has adapted to vrykul carriers, we really ought to test it on our specimens in Halgrind.  If all goes according to plan, they will disintegrate immediately as the plague devours their innards!$BYou will find Halgrind north of here.  Our plaguebringers are deploying the previous strain there - shouldn't be hard to spot.

title: Time for Cleanup
obj_text: Speak to "Hacksaw" Jenny in New Agamand.
desc_text: eing the practical man that I am, I'm going to declare our research here a success.  After all, what army can't be stopped by turning its rank and file against each other?$BI will send word of our achievements to Vengeance Landing soon enough.  But first I need you to take care of cleaning up our experimentation site.$BSee "Hacksaw" Jenny about making you a custom abomination.  One packing some explosive power if you catch my drift.

title: Apply Heat and Stir
obj_text: Fill the Empty Apothecary's Flask at the Cauldron of Vrykul Blood, then mix the Flask of Vrykul Blood with Harris's Plague Samples nearby until you've obtained a Balanced Concoction.$BReturn to Chief Plaguebringer Harris when you've completed this task.
desc_text: You've done well so far, <name>.  I'd like to teach you some of my more advanced techniques, so that you gain a better understanding of the plague.$BTake this empty flask and fill it with blood from the cauldron to my left.  Mix it with the plague samples to my right until you obtain a well balanced mix.

title: Suppressing the Elements
obj_text:
Wind Tamer Kagan at Camp Winterhoof wants you to kill 8 mountain elementals. You may kill either Howling Cyclones or Iceshard Elementals.
 $BMountain Elementals slain (8)

 Howling Cyclone
$B

 Iceshard Elemental
desc_text: If you are to survive here, as we have, you must learn to face the environment's challenges head on. The elements will claim your life if you're not vigilant, as the proliferation of elementals in these northern hills shows.$BWe must cull the elementals one last time before we can leave this place. Are you willing to aid us while we continue to make preparations?$BYou must kill any iceshard elementals or howling cyclones you encounter in the snowy hills surrounding the outpost.

title: The Frozen Glade
obj_text: Speak with Lurielle at the Frozen Glade.
desc_text: For generations, my people have told tales of frost nymphs cavorting in glades hidden away in the wilderness. I used to search for them as a child, against the advice of my parents, until I nearly froze to death.$BThese days, it isn't necessary to comb the forests for them. They've decided to reveal themselves for reasons I can only guess, but I don't think the change can be ignored. Venture southeast to the Frozen Glade and seek out the nymphs, but beware; you will pass the Twisted Glade on your way.

title: Parts for the Job
obj_text: "Hacksaw" Jenny in New Agamand wants you to obtain 6 Shoveltusk Ligaments and 1 Fresh Pound of Flesh.
desc_text: So Harris wants a demolition job, eh?  Yeah, I can help out.$BYou're gonna have to get me some parts, though.  I can't afford to use up my choice components on something that's gonna get blown up.$BFirst of all, I'm going to need shoveltusk ligaments... way better than the human kind.$BI will also need a pound of flesh.  A fellow known as Anton sells cheap meat.  He travels up and down the road to the west.

title: Warning: Some Assembly Required
obj_text:
Use the Abomination Assembly Kit in Halgrind and round up plagued Vrykul with your Mindless Abomination.  Slay at least 20 and return to "Hacksaw" Jenny in New Agamand when you're done.
 Plagued Vrykul exterminated (20)
desc_text: Well, here you are!  Our friend's going to be somewhat... unstable.  So I suggest not putting him together until reaching Halgrind.$BOnce you're there, use the abomination to round up as many vrykul as you can before self-destructing.$BCome back with whatever's left once you're done.  I can always use more body parts!

title: Wild Vines
obj_text:
Lurielle at the Frozen Glade wants you to kill 8 Scarlet Ivy.
 Scarlet Ivy slain (8)
desc_text: The sisters who lived in the Vibrant Glade, to the southwest, used to tend to gorgeous beds of scarlet ivy, but the same force that has driven them mad has transformed their beloved ivy.$BThe vines now grasp at the feet of the unwary, or lash at any who approach the glade. Before we can reclaim the glade, the vines must be tamed and uprooted.$BClear as much of the ivy as you are able. It has already begun to grow out of control.

title: Spawn of the Twisted Glade
obj_text:
Lurielle at the Frozen Glade wants you to kill 10 Thornvine Creepers.
 Thornvine Creeper slain (10)
desc_text: The glade to the west has been transformed into a hideous place called the Twisted Glade. Horrible beasts dwell among the trees, stones, and pool of the glade.$BI cannot guess where the creatures came from or what horrible forces animate them, but they must be dealt with!$BI fear that if they are allowed to dominate the glade, they will poison it beyond redemption. Clear the glade of these creatures who murdered our sisters.

title: The Fallen Sisters
obj_text:
Lurielle at the Frozen Glade wants you to use her pendant on 7 Chill Nymphs.
 Chill Nymphs Freed (7)
