desc_text: To the southwest was a glade that used to look much like this one. Mysterious forces and alien magics are reshaping the land. The glade has thawed, the sisters living there driven mad by the sudden change.$BWe thought to reach out to them, but they attacked us. I fear many may be beyond saving, but I cannot give up hope.$BTake my pendant, travel southwest to the Vibrant Glade, and use it to try to free my sisters.

title: Spirits of the Ice
obj_text: Lurielle at the Frozen Glade wants you to bring her 15 Icy Cores.
desc_text: The ice elementals surrounding our glade were once our companions, but a volatile and destructive force has swept through the land, turning them against us!$BThis is but one of the horrors my sisters and I have endured. We have revealed ourselves to you in the hope that you will help us stave off the decay that has crept into our glades and poisoned our sisters!$BWe've been gathering the cores of the ice elementals and keeping them safe so that one day, we might be able to restore them. Will you help?

title: The Cleansing
obj_text:
Sage Mistwalker at Steel Gate has advised you to cleanse yourself of Your Inner Turmoil through meditation at the Frostblade Shrine.
 Cleansed of Your Inner Turmoil
desc_text: We braved the Rivenwood because of my troubled dreams concerning my worg life-friend, Ulfang. He has called out for help, and you must go to him.$BBut, you do not have the means to speak with him, or walk amongst the other worgs. I know a way.$BFirst, you must cleanse your inner turmoil.$BThere is a shrine that sits at the top of Frostblade Peak, northeast of Camp Winterhoof. A single path leads up to it from the western base of the mountain.$BMeditate there and then return to me.

title: Seeds of the Blacksouled Keepers
obj_text:
Lurielle at the Frozen Glade wants you to freeze 8 Spores.
 Spores frozen (8)
desc_text: The glade to the northwest, now the Twisted Glade, used to be home to a number of keepers of the glade. Together with the sisters, they saw to the glade's upkeep.$BWhen the glade changed, the sisters died, but somehow the keepers managed to survive. Now, they seed the land with poisonous spores that wither healthy greenery.$BI'll give you one of the cores from the ice elementals. Once you've destroyed a spore, use the ice crystal to freeze it and keep it from regenerating.

title: The Cleansing
obj_text:
Watcher Moonleaf at Steel Gate has advised you to cleanse yourself of Your Inner Turmoil through meditation at the Frostblade Shrine.
 Cleansed of Your Inner Turmoil
desc_text: Of late I've had nightmares concerning a worg named Ulfang. He has called out for help, and you must go to him.$BHowever, you do not have the means to speak with him, or walk amongst the other worgs. I know a way.$BBut first, you must cleanse your inner turmoil through meditation.$BThere is a shrine that sits at the top of Frostblade Peak, far to the northeast. A single path leads up to it from the western base of the mountain.$BMeditate there to cleanse yourself and then return to me.

title: In Worg's Clothing
obj_text: Sage Mistwalker has asked you to seek out and help Ulfang in the Rivenwood.$BIf you somehow lose the Worg Disguise, return to Sage Mistwalker for a replacement.
desc_text: From my dreams, I know that Ulfang is in a cave on the snowy northwestern edge of the Rivenwood.$BHe is in great danger.$BI have devised a magical disguise that will make you appear as a worg while you are within the Rivenwood. The disguise is weak, relying upon the strange magics of that haunted wood. While it will only convince the worgs, it will allow you to get close to Ulfang.$BPlease, <class>, find and help him.

title: A Tailor-Made Formula
obj_text: Obtain the Dragonflayer Patriarch's Blood from Thorvald at Thorvald's Camp and bring it to Chief Plaguebringer Harris in New Agamand.
desc_text: We've been spraying down the vrykul village of Halgrind for weeks now and the vrykul just won't drop dead.$BLet's face it, <name>, by now our Plague has been exposed to humans, dwarves, dogs, livestock... you name it.  As our strains adapt to their hosts, more impurities get thrown in the mix.  What we need is a strain made custom for the vrykul's biology.$BHalgrind's chieftain fled the town after we took it over; you'll find him west of here.  As a patriarch of the Dragonflayer clan, his blood is ideal.

title: In Worg's Clothing
obj_text: Watcher Moonleaf has asked you to seek out and help Ulfang in the Rivenwood.$BIf you somehow lose the Worg Disguise, return to Watcher Moonleaf for a replacement.
desc_text: From my dreams, I know that Ulfang is in a cave on the snowy northwestern edge of the Rivenwood.$BHe is in great danger!$BI have devised a magical disguise that will make you appear as a worg while you are within the Rivenwood. The disguise is weak, relying upon the strange magics of that haunted wood. While it will only convince the worgs, it will allow you to get close to Ulfang.$BPlease, <class>, find and help him.

title: You Tell Him ...Hic!
obj_text: Peppy Wrongnozzle has suckered you into giving the bad news about the Forsaken plague to Captain Adams. Visit him at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: Here'sh the deal. I'm not going to the captain with thish news. I'm an amateur alchemist, thish ishn't my job, and I'm on break!$BBeshides, he'sh a big grumpkin... and you know him better than I do!$BSho, jusht go up into the keep and tell him. I'm sure he'll be reashonable about the whole thing ...hic.$B<Peppy turns back to her drinking.>

title: Alpha Worg
obj_text:
Ulfang has asked you to slay Garwal. Then, return the Worg Disguise to Watcher Moonleaf at Steel Gate.
 Garwal slain
desc_text: When you've eaten Talonshrike's eyes, you should be able see Garwal and rip out his throat!$B<race>-thing, seek out and slay Garwal in the western Rivenwood. After you have killed him, go and tell Moonleaf that I am once more the alpha worg!

title: Alpha Worg
obj_text:
Ulfang has asked you to slay Garwal. Then, return the Worg Disguise to Sage Mistwalker at Steel Gate.
 Garwal slain
desc_text: When you've eaten Talonshrike's eyes, you should be able see Garwal and rip out his throat!$B<race>-thing, seek out and slay Garwal in the western Rivenwood. After you have killed him, go and tell Mistwalker that I am once more the alpha worg!

title: Mission: Forsaken Intel
obj_text: Scout Knowles has asked you to deliver the Apothecary's Package to Peppy Wrongnozzle at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: Right, so I think you should get this stuff over to Peppy Wrongnozzle back at the keep. She's something of an amateur alchemist, but she's the only one we've got.$BOne thing about Peppy; she does love her drink. So, you'll likely find her at the tavern 'soaking up the atmosphere'.$BI'm sure she'll know what to do.

title: Mission: Package Retrieval
obj_text: Scout Knowles has asked you to retrieve the Apothecary's Package from inside Halgrind. Once you have it, return to the scout at the Ember Spear Tower.
desc_text: Well darn, we need some of that plague-stuff.$BI know!$BWhile you were destroying the vats, I happened to spy one of the apothecaries from New Agamand being pulled into Halgrind by the vrykul down in there. Poor fella'.$B<name>, I'd bet anything that apothecary has the goods on him. Think you could go into Halgrind and retrieve his package?

title: Mission: Plague This!
obj_text:
Captain Adams has ordered you to get 5 bomb hits on the Plague Tanks at New Agamand. Do not return to him at Westguard Keep until you have accomplished that.
 Plague Tank Hits (5)
desc_text: The Royal Apothecary Society thinks they're going to perfect a new plague to melt us down where we stand?!$BNot on my watch!$BGet out to the courtyard and speak with Greer Orehammer. He's got a gryphon and some bombs ready for you. I want you to bomb the plague tanks at New Agamand to smithereens!

title: Absholutely... Thish Will Work!
obj_text:
Peppy Wrongnozzle at Westguard Keep has suggested that you take her Peppy's Special Mix and administer it to the Dragonflayer Vrykul Prisoner to witness its results.
 Peppy's Mix Administered To The Vrykul Prisoner
desc_text: Voila, inshtant plague vacshine!$BBut I sure as heck am not going to try thish on myself. And I know you don't want to be my tesht shubject!$BOh, I've got... I've got an idea!$BWe've got a vrykul prishoner being held down in the cells under the keep. Why don't you take thish mix I whipped up down there, and get that giant to drink it ...hic?!

title: Into the World of Spirits
obj_text: Thoralius the Wise at Valgarde wants you to find his Reagent Pouch.
desc_text: While the Explorers' League may discern bits and pieces of the past through their archaeological findings and the Vice Admiral might extract some knowledge of the present through brute force, the truth lies with the spirits.$BWith the proper reagents I am able to see into the spirit world. It is there that the past, present and future of Northrend resides.$BIf you wish to learn more, I will require my reagent pouch. It was lost in a ship that is now at the bottom of Daggercap Bay, just east of here.

title: The Echo of Ymiron
obj_text:
Thoralius the Wise wants you to search Wyrmskull Village while you are in the spirit world and find information about the Secrets of Wyrmskull.
 $BSecrets of Wyrmskull Uncovered
desc_text: The spirit world has fallen under the sway of the Lich King. Fearsome creatures made of pure nightmare now stand watch over the realm of the elements. I sense that these val'kyr are guarding a terrible secret.$BI am too old and weak to survive another journey. You must go in my place, <name>.$BTake this incense burner to Wyrmskull Village and use it to enter the spirit world. Find the large dwelling in the northeast! Avoid the val'kyr at all costs lest they make you a permanent fixture in their world.

title: The Book of Runes
obj_text: Prospector Belvar at Fort Wildervar wants you to bring him The Book of Runes.
desc_text: The vast rocky area to the southeast, Giants' Run, has been overrun by Iron Dwarves. Scouts have reported seeing the dwarves coaxing stone giants from the ground, then carving runes on them.$BI can't fathom their motives, but I suspect they're somehow trying to turn the giants into weapons. The iron rune stonecallers and binders carry large tomes with them, which must contain the runes they're carving on the giants.$BCapture the pieces of this book, assemble them, and bring it back to me, <name>.

title: Anguish of Nifflevar
obj_text:
Thoralius the Wise wants you to search Nifflevar while you are in the spirit world and find information about the Secrets of Nifflevar.
 $BSecrets of Nifflevar Uncovered
desc_text: All that we know of the vrykul indicates that they only recently appeared in Northrend. Why, then, are we seeing vrykul in visions that date back 15,000 years? Surely if the vrykul had previously existed in Northrend we would have known.$BYou must press on to Nifflevar. To get there you must go northeast, through Wyrmskull Village, and take the path leading up through the dam. Nifflevar is on the bluffs of the fjord.$BUse the incense burner once you arrive at Nifflevar and search the area for clues.

title: The Rune of Command
obj_text:
Prospector Belvar at Fort Wildervar wants you to test the Rune of Command and defeat Binder Murdis.
 Test Rune of Command
 Binder Murdis slain
desc_text: Can you feel the power emanating from the runes I've carved on this tablet? They're smaller versions of the runes that the Iron Dwarves are using. We'll use it to shut down their operation.$BTake it to Giants' Run and use it on a stone giant that the dwarves have not altered.$BThe giant should obey you, but I've tailored the runes to restore it to its natural state after a time. The giant may prove a valuable ally in the battle against Binder Murdis, the leader of the Iron Dwarf forces at Giants' Run.

title: Mastering the Runes
obj_text: ring a set of Iron Rune Carving Tools to Prospector Belvar at Fort Wildervar.
desc_text: I've got a set of picks, hammers, and chisels with me, but they won't work for carving these runes. The tools used by the Iron Dwarves are imbued with magic during their forging.$BWhen they're used to carve runes, the symbols form much more than mere words. These runes have the power to bind, compel, and twist.$BI believe I know how it works, but without a set of those tools, I can't be certain. Look for kits resembling mine near the Iron Dwarf pavilions at Giants' Run and bring them to me.

title: The Rune of Command
obj_text:
Longrunner Pembe at Camp Winterhoof wants you to test the Rune of Command and defeat Binder Murdis.
 Test Rune of Command
 Binder Murdis slain
desc_text: Can you feel the power emanating from the runes I've carved on this tablet? They're smaller versions of the runes that the Iron Dwarves are using. We'll use it to shut down their operation.$BTake it to Giants' Run and use it on a stone giant that the dwarves have not altered.$BThe giant should obey you, but I've tailored the runes to restore it to its natural state after a time. The giant may prove a valuable ally in the battle against Binder Murdis, the leader of the Iron Dwarf forces at Giants' Run.

title: The Book of Runes
obj_text: Longrunner Pembe at Camp Winterhoof wants you to bring him The Book of Runes.
desc_text: Chieftain Ashtotem dispatched me on a scouting mission to Giants' Run, a broad, rocky plateau to the southeast, past the Frozen Glade.$BThe area has been taken over by Iron Dwarves who seem to be altering the giants as they emerge from the earth.$BThe iron rune stonecallers and binders carry large tomes with them, which must contain the runes they're carving on the giants.$BCapture the pieces of this book, assemble them, and bring it back to me. It's the only way we'll understand their plans.

title: Steel Gate Patrol
obj_text:
You're Steel Gate's ace pilot now, so the Steel Gate Chief Archaeologist wants you to keep patrol around the dig site and fight off anything that attacks.$BReport back to him when you're done with your patrol.
 Gjalerbron Gargoyle slain (8)
desc_text: Eh? Yer back for another day's work?$BWell, alright, here's the keys. We don't need any haulin' today, so just keep an eye out for anything suspicious, okay?$BI've hooked her up with some rockets and a machine gun - just in case.

title: Mastering the Runes
obj_text: ring a set of Iron Rune Carving Tools to Longrunner Pembe at Camp Winterhoof.
desc_text: I think I've figured out what the Iron Dwarves are doing. The tools they use are imbued with magic during their forging.$BWhen they're used to carve runes, the symbols form much more than mere words. These runes have the power to bind, compel, and twist.$BIf I had a set of those tools, I could mimic the runes in the book. I captured one of these boxes from one of the pavilions at Giants' Run, but it was empty. Look for similar boxes and recover a set of tools from them.

title: I've Got a Flying Machine!
obj_text:
The Steel Gate Chief Archaeologist wants you to transport 3 Sacks of Relics from the bottom of the site and take them to the platform on the north or south side of Steel Gate.$BUse the grappling hook on the flying machine to do this.$BReport back to him after you've done so.
 Sack of Relics Delivered (3)
desc_text: Well, what are you waiting for, there's work to be done!$BHere's the keys to our flying machine. Grab three sacks of relics and haul them up to the crane platforms on the north and south sides of Steel Gate.  I'll mark them for you.$BHurry up! We haven't got all day!

title: Where is Explorer Jaren?
obj_text: Overseer Irena Stonemantle has asked you to locate her fiance, Explorer Jaren.
desc_text: <name>, my betrothed, Jaren, went west with a small group of explorers to check into rumors of artifacts on the Chillmere Coast. But there are murloc down there, and I fear the worst has befallen them.$BSurely you have time to see if they're alright? There's a way down to the beach just to the southwest, though watch out for the worgs and other things lurking in the woods.

title: And You Thought Murlocs Smelled Bad!
obj_text:
Explorer Jaren has asked you to kill 15 Scourge of any type along the Chillmere Coast. Return to him once you have done so.
 $BChillmere Coast Scourge Killed (15)

 Unstable Mur'ghoul
 Mur'ghoul Flesheater
 Servitor Shade
$B

 Necrotech
 Rotgill
 Mur'ghoul Corrupter
desc_text: Originally I came down here to investigate some rumors about artifacts to be dug up. I knew that there were murlocs along the coast here, but I never in a million years thought I'd see this.$B<The explorer pokes his head out to look around the tree.>$BThe Scourge are out there, and they're changing murlocs, and anything else they can get their hands on, into the walking dead!$B<class>, I think it's our duty to do something about this. Think you could take out a good chunk of those Scourge?

title: Bring Down Those Shields
obj_text:
Explorer Jaren on the Chillmere Coast has asked you to destroy 3 Scourging Crystals.
 Scourging Crystals Destroyed (3)
desc_text: Look at the button on the side of the controller here. I bet if you got close enough to one of those scourging crystals, you could use the controller to bring its shield down. Then it would simply be a matter of destroying the thing before its shield goes back up.$BWhat do you say, <name>? You up for it? I can guarantee a nice reward for you if you can bring down those shields and destroy the crystals.$BIt's the least we can do to keep the Scourge from making more of their own kind.

title: And You Thought Murlocs Smelled Bad!
obj_text:
Apothecary Anastasia has asked you to destroy 15 Scourge of any type along the Chillmere Coast. Return to her at the Apothecary Camp once you have done so.
 $BChillmere Coast Scourge Killed (15)

 Unstable Mur'ghoul
 Mur'ghoul Flesheater
 Servitor Shade
$B

 Necrotech
 Rotgill
 Mur'ghoul Corrupter
desc_text: I came here to investigate a rumor about a Scourge presence nearby. I expected murlocs along the coast down below, but I never thought I'd see this!$BThe Scourge are down there, and they're changing murlocs, and anything else they can get their hands on, into the walking dead!$B<class>, we will not suffer them to create more of their kind, especially not from murlocs! There is a ramp down to the beach just northwest of the camp. See to it that you deal with the Scourge in a timely fashion!

title: Brother Betrayers
obj_text:
Ulfang has asked you to kill the traitorous worgs, Bjomolf and Varg. Return to him in disguise in the Rivenwood after you have done so.$BIf you somehow lose the Worg Disguise, return to Sage Mistwalker for a replacement.
 Bjomolf slain
 Varg slain
desc_text: Mistwalker is from my dreams! If you are his friend, you are mine.$BI was alpha male until the last full moon. Then the strange white worg, Garwal, came from the north, and with the help of my once-brothers, he quickly became alpha. There is something unnatural about him.$BTo help, you must first kill those who betrayed me.$BBjomolf hunts to the northwest of a place the two-legs call Steel Gate. And look for Varg to the southeast, near the West Spear Tower.$BThey will not be fooled by your form.

title: Brother Betrayers
obj_text:
Ulfang has asked you to kill the traitorous worgs, Bjomolf and Varg. Return to him in disguise in the Rivenwood after you have done so.$BIf you somehow lose the Worg Disguise, return to Watcher Moonleaf for a replacement.
 Bjomolf slain
 Varg slain
desc_text: Watcher Moonleaf is from my dreams! If you are her friend, you are mine.$BI was alpha male until the last full moon. Then the strange white worg, Garwal, came from the north, and with the help of my once-brothers, he quickly became alpha worg. There is something unnatural about him.$BTo help, you must first kill those who betrayed me.$BBjomolf hunts to the northwest of a place called Steel Gate. And look for Varg to the southeast, near the West Spear Tower.$BThey will not be fooled by your form.

title: Bring Down Those Shields
obj_text:
Apothecary Anastasia at the Apothecary Camp has asked you to destroy 3 Scourging Crystals.
 Scourging Crystals Destroyed (3)
desc_text: Look at the button on the side of the controller here. I bet if you got close enough to one of those scourging crystals, you could use the controller to bring its shield down. Then it would simply be a matter of destroying the thing before its shield goes back up.$BBrave enough to hazard another trip down there, <name>? I can guarantee a nice reward for you if you can bring down those shields and destroy the crystals.$BHow can you refuse if it means less Scourge, especially ones made from murlocs?

title: The One That Got Away
obj_text:
Christopher Sloan at Fort Wildervar wants you to defeat Frostfin.
 Frostfin slain
desc_text: The barbfish you brought should work well as bait for most fish, but I fear it'll attract a monster!$BWhen I first arrived, I put some of Nat Pagle's favorite bait on my hook and cast it into the water. A huge monster latched on, with giant teeth and icicles hanging from its fins!$BWould've pulled me into those icy waters if I hadn't cut the line! I can't use the new bait until ol' Frostfin's been dealt with. Use this bait near the sunken boat in the middle of the lake. He won't be able to resist!

title: Eyes of the Eagle
obj_text: Ulfang has asked you to collect the Eyes of the Eagle. Return to him in disguise in the Rivenwood after you have done so.$BIf you somehow lose the Worg Disguise, return to Watcher Moonleaf for a replacement.
desc_text: Garwal hides himself behind an unnatural magic. None can see him unless he wants you to. There may be one chance we can take, though.$BMy enemy, the great eagle, Talonshrike, is said to have eyes that can see anything. If you were to take her eyes, then you would surely be able to see Garwal.$BTalonshrike keeps her nest at the base of a waterfall just to the southwest of the vrykul place called Skorn. If you touch the eggs in her nest, she will come down from the sky to kill you.$BGet her eyes.

title: It's a Scourge Device
obj_text: Deliver the Scourge Device to Apothecary Anastasia at the Apothecary Camp.
desc_text: The Scourge creature you just destroyed had this device held in its clutches. It has a jewel set into it which looks similar to the one that tops the scourging crystals.$BSurely, Apothecary Anastasia would like to have a look at this.

title: Eyes of the Eagle
obj_text: Ulfang has asked you to collect the Eyes of the Eagle. Return to him in disguise in the Rivenwood after you have done so.$BIf you somehow lose the Worg Disguise, return to Sage Mistwalker for a replacement.
desc_text: Garwal hides himself behind an unnatural magic. None can see him unless he wants you to. There may be one chance we can take, though.$BMy enemy, the great eagle, Talonshrike, is said to have eyes that can see anything. If you were to take her eyes, then you would surely be able to see Garwal.$BTalonshrike keeps her nest at the base of a waterfall just to the southwest of the vrykul place called Skorn. If you touch the eggs in her nest, she will come down from the sky to kill you.$BGet her eyes.

title: It's a Scourge Device
obj_text: Deliver the Scourge Device to Explorer Jaren on the Chillmere Coast.
desc_text: The Scourge creature you just destroyed had this device held in its clutches. It has a jewel set into it which looks similar to the one that tops the scourging crystals.$BSurely, Explorer Jaren would like to have a look at this.

title: The Path to Payback
obj_text: Guard Captain Zorek at Valgarde in Howling Fjord wants you to recover the Harpoon Operation Manual.
desc_text: Two weeks ago our chief engineer got his hands on a vrykul harpoon gun - the same type of gun that the vrykul use to take down our ships. By studying that gun he managed to put together a comprehensive operation manual.$BUnfortunately he was abducted and taken north of here to Wyrmskull Village. We eventually did find him, but near death and without the manual. His dying words indicated that the manual was lost in the Utgarde Catacombs, located at the northwest end of Wyrmskull. Get me that manual!

title: Trident of the Son
obj_text: Old Icefin wants you to obtain Rotgill's Trident. Return it to him on the small island on the Chillmere Coast.
desc_text: <From the scratches he makes in the rock, you see several symbols: a trident, a mur'ghoul, the sun, a wrecked ship, and a rough stick-figure of yourself.>$B<Puzzling out what the murloc is conveying takes a while. Obviously he wants you to get a trident from the Chillmere Coast, but the image of the sun is puzzling. That is until you realize he means his son.>$B<His son was changed into a mur'ghoul! He wants you to find him to the south near the wrecked ship and return with his trident.>

title: It Goes to 11...
obj_text:
Lieutenant Icehammer in the Howling Fjord wants you to destroy the Dragonflayer Longhouse, Dragonflayer Dockhouse, Dragonflayer Storage Facility and 8 Dragonflayer Defenders.$BReturn the Harpoon Control Mechanism to him once the task is complete.
 Dragonflayer Defender (8)
 Dragonflayer Longhouse Destroyed
 Dragonflayer Dockhouse Destroyed
 Dragonflayer Storage Facility Destroyed
desc_text: We must strike while the vrykul forces are in disarray! Take the harpoon control mechanism to Nifflevar and locate the northernmost harpoon building on the bluff side of the village.$BOnce there, commandeer one of the vrykul harpoon guns that are stationed on the building's deck. Use the harpoon gun to rain hell upon Wyrmskull Village! Destroy the longhouse, dockhouse, storage facility and any defenders that the vrykul may send at you!$BDo this and Daggercap Bay will become a much safer port!

title: Keeper Witherleaf
obj_text:
Lurielle at the Frozen Glade wants you to kill Keeper Witherleaf.
 Keeper Witherleaf slain
desc_text: You have been a great friend and ally to us, <name>. There is one more thing I must ask of you.$BYou have seen the corruption of the Twisted Glade and the beasts that dwell there. The blacksouled keepers will continue raising these abominations from the waters and soil of our glade unless we act against them.$BThe most powerful of the blacksouled keepers is known as Keeper Witherleaf. Slay him, <name>, and open the way for the redemption of the glade as you once redeemed my sisters.

title: Harpoon Master Yavus
obj_text:
Lieutenant Icehammer in the Howling Fjord wants you to slay Harpoon Master Yavus at Nifflevar.
 Harpoon Master Yavus slain
desc_text: That was a fairly strong showing at Baleheim, <name>. Before you go off patting yourself on the back there's work to be done at Nifflevar.$BWe've located the vrykul responsible for the majority of the harpoon attacks on our frigates - goes by the name of Yavus. You'll find him in the main harpoon structure on the bluffs of Nifflevar, southeast of here.$BTrack him down and execute him for crimes against the Alliance!$BDo me proud, <name>!

title: Sleeping Giants
obj_text:
Ahota Whitefrost has tasked you with slaying 5 Dormant Vrykul. Return to him at Camp Winterhoof when you have done so.
 Dormant Vrykul slain (5)
desc_text: I've overheard what you've had to say with Greatmother Ankha. With all due respect, she's not having you go far enough.$BYou must also deal with the vrykul that lie dormant in the Waking Halls beneath Gjalerbron!$BI have no doubt that the rituals involved with awakening them are the key to their downfall. Most likely the necrolords have some device that you can use to bring the vrykul out of their dormant state prematurely.$BSurely such a disruption will prove fatal to the vrykul.

title: Shield Hill
obj_text: "Hacksaw" Jenny wants you to bring her 5 Ancient Vrykul Bones from the reanimated Vrykul in Shield Hill, south of New Agamand.
desc_text: My work should be extremely easy in a time of war.  There ought to be usable body parts everywhere.$BIt's not that simple, though.  With these eggheads making all sorts of killer plagues and sending them to enemy towns, most of the material gets contaminated.$BThere is a place, though, where usable samples exist.  Shield Hill, south of here, is an ancient vrykul burial ground where the dead walk but are not afflicted with any plague - ours or the Lich King's.  Get me some bones, I'll pay ya well.

title: Sleeping Giants
obj_text:
Mage-Lieutenant Malister has tasked you with slaying 5 Dormant Vrykul. Return to him at Westguard Keep when you have done so.
 Dormant Vrykul slain (5)
desc_text: I've overheard what you've had to say with Father Levariol. Allow me to suggest that he's not having you go far enough.$BYou must also deal with the vrykul that lie dormant in the Waking Halls beneath Gjalerbron!$BI have no doubt that the rituals involved with awakening them are the key to their downfall. Most likely the necrolords have some device that you can use to bring the vrykul out of their dormant state prematurely.$BSurely such a disruption will prove fatal to the vrykul.

title: Drop It then Rock It!
obj_text:
Lieutenant Icehammer in the Howling Fjord wants you to place the Alliance Banner in Baleheim and then defend the banner against attackers.$BReturn to Lieutenant Icehammer with the Alliance Banner should you survive.
 $BAlliance Banner Defended
 Alliance Banner Placed
desc_text: I'm not about to put the fate of this mission into the hands of some untested scrub.$BNow, if you want to prove to me that you've got what it takes to carry out this mission, you'll need to do what I tell you.$BTake this battle standard and head over to Baleheim, directly north of here. Once you're at Baleheim, find the center of town and drop our flag. Fight off any vrykul dirt bags that attempt to take down our beloved flag and return to me once you've established Alliance dominance!

title: Meet Lieutenant Icehammer...
obj_text: Guard Captain Zorek wants you to take the Harpoon Control Mechanism to Lieutenant Icehammer stationed outside of Nifflevar.
desc_text: Do you see those vrykul buildings on the bluffs to the northeast? The vrykul call that place Nifflevar. It's where most of their harpoon attacks on our frigates originate.$BWell guess what? The time for payback has come, <name>. I need you to take this harpoon control mechanism and meet up with Lieutenant Icehammer, who is hiding out in a vrykul building northwest of Nifflevar.$BWhen you're ready I'll place you on the back of one of our gryphons and zip you right to him!

title: Let's Go Surfing Now
obj_text:
Use the large Vrykul Harpoon Gun in Nifflevar to launch yourself into Valgarde. Report your victory over the Vrykul to Guard Captain Zorek.
 $BGo Harpoon Surfing
desc_text: Navigating the steep bluffs of Howling Fjord can be nerve-racking! I've come up with a solution to ease that burden by utilizing vrykul technology and dwarven ingenuity. With just a few adjustments and some fine tuning I've created Icehammer's harpoon controller! Of course it hasn't been tested, but that's what you're here for!$BTake the controller to the big gun in Nifflevar and use it to launch yourself into Valgarde. Report your victory to Zorek. Oh yea, you can keep the controller.

title: The Explorers' League Outpost
obj_text: Deliver McSorf's Bundle to Stanwad at the Explorers' League Outpost in Howling Fjord.
desc_text: It's all a bunch of cryptic nonsense! Even with this cipher I can't make heads or tails of these tablets. Admittedly, cryptography is not my strong point.$BYou'll need to take the cipher and tablets to our cryptographer, Stanwad. Unfortunately, I haven't heard from Stanwad in two weeks. He took a team of twenty scientists to the dig sites on the southeastern bluffs of the fjord and hasn't been heard from since. The best I can do is have McGoyver over there give you a lift with his flying machine.

title: Daggercap Divin'
obj_text: Harold Lagras at the bottom of Daggercap Bay wants you to recover 10 Valgarde Supply Crates.
desc_text: Hey... Uh... What's up? What are you doing down here?$BMe? Oh... Well, you see... I'm... Um... I'm trying to clean this place up! Orders from Keller himself! He says to me, "Harry, I want you to put on a divin' bell and search the shipwrecks of Daggercap for OUR stuff..."$BSay, maybe you could lend me a hand while you're down here. Throughout the bay here are all kinds of goodies, err, I mean supplies. Go out and bring me back whatever you find. Use this diving helm so you don't run out of air and die.

title: Feeding the Survivors
obj_text: Elder Atuik at Kamagua in Howling Fjord wants you to obtain 6 pieces of Island Shoveltusk Meat from Island Shoveltusk in the Isle of Spears.
desc_text: We tuskarr rely mostly on our fish catch for sustenance.  In times of great need, however, we will on occasion hunt land animals.$BThe nearby village of Iskaal was recently attacked by pirates and the survivors just keep pouring in.$BOur catch has been modest this week, but there are many shoveltusk on the island and their meat is plentiful.$BAid my people by hunting these great beasts and obtaining their meat.

title: The Fragrance of Money
obj_text: Handsome Terry at Scalawag Point in Howling Fjord wants you to obtain 4 Bear Musk from the Rabid Brown Bears in the surrounding area.
desc_text: Us pirates are known for many things, but hygiene isn't one of them.  Most pirate ships be carrying five or six times as many rats as people.$BIt's no wonder all the bears on this island caught the rabies soon after we moved in.  Long story short, the boss wants 'em all dead.$BIt just so happens I know a recipe for a bear musk fragrance popular among Stormwind nobles.  We kill the bears and sell the musk.  I see a fine business opportunity for us here.  What say ye?

title: Arming Kamagua
obj_text: Elder Atuik wants you to obain 3 Chimaera Horns.
desc_text: Issliruk, the spirit of war, is depicted as a silver eagle by my people.  Our stories tell of how Issliruk fought against a hundred worgs to save his young.$BIt is time for us, too, to fight against our foes to save our brethren.  We will need to craft new weapons.  The horns of the frostwing chimaera that make their home in the snowy parts of the island are sharp and are easily crafted into spear tips.  Bring me the best of these horns that you can find.

title: Avenge Iskaal
obj_text:
Elder Atuik wants you to go to Iskaal and slay 8 Northsea Slavers.  Use the Horn of Kamagua should you need assistance.
 Crazed Northsea Slaver slain (8)
desc_text: The totem of Issliruk is ready, <name>, and for that I thank you.  We must cast our peaceful ways for the time being and strike at those who've attacked our land and our kin.$BThe pirate slavers that raided Iskaal have lost their minds and slaughtered all their captives.  Go to Iskaal, to the east of here and do what must must be done.  Take this horn and call on my brethren should you need assistance.

title: Forgotten Treasure
obj_text: Handsome Terry at Scalawag Point wants you to bring him 1 Amani Vase and 1 Eagle Figurine from the shipwreck to the south.
desc_text: I've made my fortune by specializing in treasure that regular pirates don't appreciate: art, antiquities, collector's pieces.$BBlack Conrad's fleet sank south of here years ago.  All the gold and jewelry was picked clean by divers, but two ancient relics remain there.  One is a museum-quality Amani vase, the other is an eagle figurine.$BGo and retrieve them for me and I'll vouch for you with the other pirates.  I'll even throw in something to make your underwater adventure a bit more manageable.

title: Zeh'gehn Sez
obj_text: Return to Handsome Terry to decipher what Zeh'gehn asked of you.
desc_text: Is like dis, mon.  Ye be wantin' me 'elp spotting some craven bag-o-wire been cardin' da crew?$BYe gotta bring me a croaker, matey.  Aft I an' I show ye who da blaggard be, mon.  Nah, nah, croaker show ye.  Ye'll ku fer yerself with yer own deadlights, yahso.$BBring us a carver yahso too, 'atsteppa.  Galang, bucko.

title: Trust is Earned
obj_text:
Hidalgo at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to find a Fjord Grub and feed it to one of the falcons in the cage by his feet.
 $BFjord Rock Falcon Fed
desc_text: The first and most important factor in falconry is the bond between the falconer and <his/her> bird. Trust must be earned by the master!$B<Hidalgo points to the falcons in the cage at his feet.>$BIf you are to earn their trust you will first need to fill their bellies.$BThe fjord rock falcon, as these birds are known, primarily eat grubs. Throughout the fjord you will find loose rocks that serve as breeding grounds for these grubs. Find a grub and return here to feed the falcons in the cage.

title: The Enemy's Legacy
obj_text: Go into Nifflevar, north of Ghostblade Post and look for the Saga of the Winter Curse, the Saga of the Val'kyr and the Saga of the Twins.
desc_text: As our armies march through Northrend, our enemies will not suffer mere defeat.  Their houses will burn, their corpses will be devoured by our plagues, all trace of their existence will be lost.$BThis worries me as a seeker of knowledge.  The eastern town of Nifflevar will soon be razed by our forces in Vengeance Landing.  The vrykul bard, Helgus, lived there and wrote three sagas: the Saga of the Twins, the Saga of the Winter Curse and the Saga of the Val'kyr.  Obtain them before Nifflevar is destroyed.

title: Handsome Terry
obj_text: Don the Pirate Disguise and speak to Handsome Terry inside Scalawag point.
desc_text: Your people paid me good money to infiltrate the Northsea Freebooters and get your foot in the door.$BI talked you up to a fellow in Scalawag Point called Handsome Terry.  I told him you come highly recommended.$BPut your disguise on and go see him.  Here comes someone to take you there.$BYou're going to have to prove yourself a bit before they introduce you to their higher ups.  But that's all up to you.  Remember, <name>, once you're inside you're on your own!

title: Pirates of the North Seas
obj_text: Find Grezzix Spindlesnap on the northern end of Garvan's Reef off of the Southwestern coast of Howling Fjord.
desc_text: The past few weeks have seen an increase in pirate attacks against our supply ships.  We've hired a goblin spy to pave the way for one of our agents to infiltrate the suspected pirates.$BThis group of Northsea Freebooters operates out of Scalawag Point, on Garvan's Reef.  We don't know much about them, but we do know that Sylvanas wants their leader's head.$BYou come very highly recommended, <name>.  If you take on this task, we can keep our military focused against Arthas' forces.  Are you up to it?

title: Gambling Debt
obj_text: Taruk at Scalawag Point wants you to collect "Silvermoon" Harry's Debt.
desc_text: I heard you did a little work for Terry.  I was hoping someone reliable would show up around these parts.$BSee, pirates love to gamble.  They, however, do not love to pay their gambling debt.$BIf you're interested in collecting some coin on my behalf, I'd be willing to give you a cut.$BLet's start you out with an easy one.  "Silvermoon" Harry's a bit of an eccentric, keeps all sorts of expensive blood elf knickknacks inside his tent - yet when I see him he always pretends to be broke.  Get my gold.

title: Jack Likes His Drink
obj_text: Taruk at Scalawag Point in Howling Fjord wants you to collect Jack Adams' Debt.
desc_text: Our next customer,  Jack Adams, won't be the pushover that Harry was.  He spends all day drinking with his friends, tough pirates all of them.  Let's not use force this time, could get ugly.$BSee if you can use his drinking habit to your advantage.  There's only so much alcohol someone can handle before passing out.$BMaybe one of the bar wenches will be of assistance.  Once he's out, see if you can slip your hand into his pocket and get what's mine.

title: A Traitor Among Us
obj_text: Speak to Zeh'gehn at Scalawag Post.
desc_text: Our second in command, Annie Bonn, has been acting rather paranoid as of late.  She seems sure we have an infiltrator in our ranks, can ye believe it?$BAnyhow, we have a foolproof way of uncovering rats around these parts.  See, good ole' Zeh'gehn over here happens to be an authentic witch doctor.  His family hails all the way from Zul... something or other.$BGo let him know that we're in need of his divination skills.  I must warn ye, <name>, only one or two of us can understand anything Zeh'gehn says.

title: Problems on the High Bluff
obj_text: Speak with Walt.
desc_text: As usual, the real work is left up to me and my crew. Thankfully McSorf's team didn't die for nothin'. The cipher they recovered will help us crack the stuff we've found up here - that is if we can ever get back to it! Damned iron dwarves have sprung up like leaks all over the place and are now attemptin' to bury the sites! Can you believe it? Bastards want to bury our finds!$BAnyhow, talk to Walt over yonder. He'll get you started.

title: Dead Man's Debt
obj_text: Taruk at Scalawag Point wants you to search for Black Conrad's Treasure on the plateau in the northeastern end of the Isle of Spears, just north of Iskaal.
desc_text: You might've heard of Black Conrad, he's a famous pirate around these parts.$BWell, he had a thing for gambling on my fights.  He had a thing for not paying, too.$BI'd love to collect, but trouble is... he's dead.$BI was about ready to write the whole thing off, when I came across this...$B<Taruk unfolds a map of the Isle of Spears with an X on a northeastern plateau.>$BHe hid his treasure on tuskarr land.  I want you to get it.  I'll be damned if I let that bilge sucker get away without paying.

title: The Ransacked Caravan
obj_text: Hidalgo at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use the Trained Rock Falcon to recover 5 Fjord Turkeys.$BReturn to Hidalgo with the cage once you have completed this task.
desc_text: I was leading a caravan here from Valgarde that was attacked by Dragonflayers. I was the only survivor of that ambush. Unfortunately, I couldn't make it back here with the cargo of fjord turkeys. This is the perfect opportunity for you to get your feet wet with your rock falcon.$B<Hidalgo hands you a cage.>$BTake this falcon cage and head west down the road leading out of this camp. Use the falcon to capture the loose turkeys and return here when you've gathered enough.$BRemember to feed the falcon!

title: "Crowleg" Dan
obj_text:
Confront "Crowleg" Dan, who is in one of the ships at Scalawag Point. Speak to Handsome Terry when you've completed this task.
 "Crowleg" Dan slain
desc_text: Croaker's spoken, matey. "Crowleg" Dan's on da ship yonder.$BBest go trace that blaggard, mon.  Show'im dis set's not fe be crossed.  Gaan back fe Terry when ye keelhaul 'is behind.

title: Swabbin' Soap
obj_text: Scuttle Frostprow wants you to obtain Big Roy's Blubber as the main ingredient for her magic swabbin' soap. Return to her on the eastern pirate ship at Scalawag Point when you have it.
desc_text: Yeah, I got to get the deck swabbed spotless afore Mad Jonah comes 'round. An' I ain't gonna do it on my hands and knees neither!$BProblem is, we're all outa soap. That's more your problem than mine though, mate. Being the newbie 'round here, I gots a special trip for ya to make.$BUp on the northwest coast of this island, there's a whole mess o' sea lions. Amongst the nearby ice floes you'll find the alpha bull, Big Roy. Bring me back his blubber and I'll magic-up the best soap ya ever seen!

title: Falcon Versus Hawk
obj_text: Hidalgo at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use your Trained Rock Falcon to capture 10 Fjord Hawks.$BReturn to Hidalgo with the cage when you have completed this task.
desc_text: Do you feel the closeness, <name>? Surely you feel a true bond forming between you and your falcon. Would you believe me if I told you that when the time is right you'll be able to see through the eyes of your bird? Aye, it is the ultimate level of falconry.$BBut first you must hunt more! The bird must hone and quicken its reflexes. Send it against a more formidable opponent! The fjord hawks of the region make the tops of the trees around us their homes. They shall be your next target!

title: Outpost Over Yonder...
obj_text: Deliver Donny's Letter to Stanwad at the Explorers' League Outpost.
desc_text: I see that you haven't visited my brothers at the Explorers' League Outpost south of here. Why don't you do Donny a favor and deliver this message to Stanwad. He'll be interested to hear about the activities of the iron dwarves up here.$BLike I said, mount up and start heading south. You'll see the outpost right before you get to Baelgun's.

title: Iron Rune Constructs and You: Rocket Jumping
obj_text:
Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use the Iron Rune Construct's Rocket Jump ability at Walt's Iron Rune Carving.$BDismiss your construct by dismissing it from the pet window once you have completed the quest.
 $BRocket Jump Mastered
desc_text: Alright, <name>; the time has come for you to climb inside this thing and learn how to use its basic abilities. When you're ready, get on the work bench and I'll get you situated inside the construct.$BYour first lesson is going to be using the construct's transportation system. You'll notice that the iron dwarves have set up special rune carvings around the dig site. Their constructs use those rune carvings to power up and fly from point to point. Try it with the rune carving I built here.

title: The Jig is Up
obj_text: Annie Bonn at Scalawag Point wants you to bring her Jonah Sterling's Spyglass.
desc_text: I know why you're here, <name>.  You've been sent to kill our leader, Jonah Sterling.$BI'd like to offer my help.  Jonah's leadership threatens our operation.$BAttacking the Horde and the Alliance fleets simultaneously?  Suicidal.  Trying to sell the tuskarr as slaves when they die days after leaving this climate?  Disastrous.$BJonah's hideout is located inside a cave west of here.  Bring me his spyglass as proof of the deed  and my first action as lead will be to end all attacks against your allies.

title: There Exists No Honor Among Birds
obj_text: Hidalgo at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use your Trained Rock Falcon to capture 8 Fjord Hawk Eggs.$BReturn to Hidalgo with the cage when you have completed this task.
desc_text: You are most definitely ready for the next step in falconry, <name>.$BTake your trained falcon east of here, to the vrykul hawk roost near the Stonewall Lift. From the roost you will send out your falcon to steal the eggs of the hawks. Their nests will be located in remote areas of the cliff walls surrounding the roost. Locate those nests and use your falcon to scavenge for the eggs!$BBeware the fjord hawk matriarchs, <name>. Should you come under attack, use your falcon's escape and soar abilities to flee!

title: Iron Rune Constructs and You: The Bluff
obj_text:
Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use the Iron Rune Construct's Bluff ability on Lebronski after you've walked on his rug.$BDismiss your construct by dismissing it from the pet window once you have completed the quest.$B
 $BLebronski Bluffed
desc_text: You always gotta have a contingency plan in case your main plan backfires! That's why I've built in some anti-intelligence systems into the construct.$BYour shiny new ride might rouse some suspicion while you're at Baelgun's excavation site. That's what your bluff ability is for! Just use that any time you're confronted and you'll be safe from harm.$BTest it out on Lebronski by walking on his rug. Once he starts huffin' and puffin', use the bluff!$BGet on the work bench when you're ready to begin.

title: Tools to Get the Job Done
obj_text: Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to recover his Building Tools.
desc_text: I've been studying this deactivated construct for days, <name>. I think I can create a reasonable facsimile of the golem that would have room inside to fit one passenger. The idea being that it would fool those iron dwarves and allow us to get inside Baelgun's.$BNow I'm not gonna be able to make anything with a hammer and poker. I need my tools! Unfortunately I left those behind at Ivald's Ruin when the iron dwarves first attacked. Get me my tools!$BIvald's Ruin is located far to the northeast.

title: Meet Number Two
obj_text: Speak to Annie Bonn at Scalawag Point.
desc_text: All the good work you've done for us hasn't gone unnoticed, <name>.  Our second in command, the delightful Annie Bonn, is incredibly impressed with what you've done so far and wants to meet you.

title: Iron Rune Constructs and You: Collecting Data
obj_text:
Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use the Iron Rune Construct's Collect Data ability while standing near the Iron Dwarf Relic.$BDismiss your construct by dismissing it from the pet window once you have completed the quest.
 Test Data Collected
desc_text: The most important part of your job while controlling the construct is the collection of data. I've placed an iron dwarf relic in the cart over yonder. It's the floating, lightning infused crystal.$BGet on the work bench and I'll put you back in the construct. Once you're back in the driver's seat, use the construct's data collection ability to pick up the test data.

title: A Carver and a Croaker
obj_text: Get a Shiny Knife from "Silvermoon" Harry and capture a Scalawag Frog.  Bring these to Zeh'Gehn at Scalawag Point.
desc_text: Some of the pirates around here... we have our own special way of talking.  Zeh'gehn has... many different special ways of talking... all mixed together.$BFrom what I can tell he wants a frog and a knife.$B"Silvermoon" Harry might have a knife on the cheap.  There's frogs all over town, just grab one and bring it to him along with the knife.$BI'd hate to be in the poor critter's shoes, if you know what I mean.

title: Lightning Infused Relics
obj_text:
Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use the Iron Rune Construct's Collect Data ability to collect 15 sets of Iron Rune Data.$BDismiss your construct by dismissing it from the pet window once you have completed the quest.
 Iron Rune Data Collected (15)
desc_text: Your construct is ready to go. All abilities have been given a once over and I've programmed the machine to both comprehend and speak the language of the titans.$BTake the construct to Baelgun's Excavation Site, due south of here, and collect data from the lightning infused relics that litter the site. Remember to bluff any iron dwarves that suspect your construct to be a fake. And don't forget about rocket jumping from rune to rune to get around in there!$BGet on the table when you're ready!

title: The Delicate Sound of Thunder
obj_text:
Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to use the Iron Rune Construct to explore the thundering cave at Baelgun's Excavation Site.$BDismiss your construct by dismissing it from the pet window once you have completed the quest.
 $BThundering Cave investigated
desc_text: The cavern that we opened at Baelgun's was the one place that most steered clear of... Can't say I blame 'em. The sound of thunder shot out of that cave, <name>! Loud, booming thunder!$BI think near the end, it was abandoned by all. Bad, bad things happened to any that went in to explore - most never coming back.$BI want you to check that cave out while you're at Baelgun's. Explore around the titan statue inside and report back with your findings.

title: News From the East
obj_text: Speak with Captain Adams at Westguard Keep.
desc_text: Westguard needs to know what's going on here, <name>. I want you to personally deliver the news to Captain Adams.$BWhenever you're ready, let me know and I'll put you back in the construct for one final flight. It'll take you to Westguard Keep, but more than likely blow up in the process.$BIt's been a pleasure...

title: We Have the Technology
obj_text: Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to bring him a Pristine Shoveltusk Hide and Steel Ribbing.
desc_text: While the infrastructure for a piece of machinery like this is important, we can't underestimate the appearance of the construct. If we're to fool the iron dwarves the clone must be exact!$BI can make this happen.$BBring me a pristine shoveltusk hide from the shoveltusk of this region and steel ribbing from vrykul in Nifflevar or Baleheim to the northwest.

title: Grezzix Spindlesnap
obj_text: Speak with Grezzix Spindlesnap.
desc_text: The pirate thieves have set up port at Scalawag Point, far to the south. Unfortunately, they have fortified their camp with many deadly defenses.$BThere is someone that might be able to assist us in infiltrating Scalawag.$BA pirate mercenary by the name of Grezzix Spindlesnap recently came to our village in search of food and shelter. In exchange he gives us information about our enemies and feeds them misinformation about our attack plans. Seek him out at his ship just off the coast here - southwest.

title: Street "Cred"
obj_text: Speak with "Silvermoon" Harry at Scalawag Point about the missing Vrykul artifacts.
desc_text: The Northsea Freebooters all fear and respect Grezzix. I'm thinking they recognize my special talents and envy my amazing ship. All you need to do is tag along with my cabin boy, Lou, and you'll be in like... In like tin. Pirates love tin.$BJust talk to Lou when you're ready to go and he'll take you to Scalawag.$BOh yea, you'll want to talk to "Silvermoon" Harry first. He'll have more information on the stuff they pilfered. Just watch what you say around him. He's a freak... crazy for blood elves.

title: We Can Rebuild It
obj_text: Walt at the Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord wants you to bring him a Large Barrel, Industrial Strength Rope and Dark Iron Ingots.
desc_text: Tools? Check. Materials? Negative.$BIf we're going to build this thing, you're going to have to get me the materials.$BFirst things first, <name>. For the skeletal structure I'm going to need a large barrel from Nifflevar, some dark iron ingots from Valgarde, and industrial strength rope from Baleheim.$BNifflevar and Baleheim are vrykul towns northwest of here. Valgarde is located in Daggercap Bay, also to the northwest. Speak with McGoyver to get the ingots. He'll fly you back here once you're all done.

title: Elder Atuik and Kamagua
obj_text: Orfus of Kamagua in the Howling Fjord wants you to deliver Orfus's Bundle to Elder Atuik at Kamagua.
desc_text: <Orfus bundles up the clues you brought him.>$BMy people are bitterly entrenched in a war with the Northsea Freebooters. If any tuskarr could help us in our quest to right the wrongs of the pirates, it will be Elder Atuik of Kamagua. You must take these clues to him at once.$BTo get to Kamagua you must take the Ancient Lift, behind me. Take the lift directly to Kamagua and find Elder Atuik.

title: The Lost Shield of the Aesirites
obj_text: Speak with Captain Ellis aboard the Sister Mercy.
desc_text: If you listen real close you can hear cannon fire coming from the northeast. That's Captain Ellis's ship, Sister Mercy. Thing is, Ellis and his entire crew were killed 'bout a month ago.$B<Harry nods.>$BGhost ship...$BIf it's info you be wantin' 'bout the shield, Ellis is the man to ask.$BSister Mercy docks on the small island between here and Sorlof's Strand to pick up more souls for the ship's crew 'bout once every five minutes. There be no shortage of souls 'round these parts...

title: "Scoodles"
obj_text: "Silvermoon" Harry at Scalawag Point wants you to recover his Sin'dorei Scrying Crystal from the orca, "Scoodles."
desc_text: One of the first things Jonah Sterling did after he went crazy was to take my prized sin'dorei scrying crystal and feed it to the bane of my existence, "Scoodles" the orca.$BNo I didn't name the damned thing. I just know that she swims out past the ships directly southeast of Scalawag. Kill that overinflated goldfish and rip out my beautiful sin'dorei crystal from its stomach.$BDo this and we can get down to business.

title: The Frozen Heart of Isuldof
obj_text: Recover the Frozen Heart of Isuldof and deliver it to Orfus of Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
desc_text: Some say Jonah was never quite right in the head, but I know the truth. It was the heart. That damned frozen heart! I saw the change in him the second he pulled it from the grave. I could see the blood freeze in his veins... It was then that the madness truly took over.$BHe left us to hole up in his cave on the north side of this island. Last I heard he had thrown the heart in the back of his bear den. Too little, too late...$BI'll kill you myself if you even think about bringing that heart back here!

title: The Staff of Storm's Fury
obj_text: Recover the Staff of Storm's Fury and deliver it to Orfus of Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
desc_text: Those artifacts are cursed and you'd be crazy to go looking for them, <race>. I know for certain that anyone that's come into direct contact with any of those items has either gone mad or been killed.$BTake that staff, for example. Last I heard the ship that held it was abandoned and left to rot on the coast of the Isle of Spears, north of here.$BIf you want that thing, check the ship's hold.$BWhatever you do, don't bring that staff back here! And steer clear of Abdul! He'll tear your heart out.

title: Oh Noes, the Tadpoles!
obj_text:
King Mrgl-Mrgl has asked you to rescue 20 Winterfin Tadpoles. Return to him at Winterfin Retreat once you have done so.
 Winterfin Tadpole rescued (20)
desc_text: Oh good, you're back!$BWhen the landslide at the village across the water exposed the caverns, a malevolent lobstrok, known as Claximus, came out of the caves and stole the Winterfin tadpoles away.$BSomething happened to all of the murlocs that followed him in there, and when they re-emerged, they were under his control.$B<class>, you must swim across the waters and rescue the Winterfin tadpoles in the village and caverns.$BThe future of the Winterfin tribe depends upon you!

title: Mutiny on the Mercy
obj_text: Captain Ellis aboard the Sister Mercy in the Howling Fjord has asked that you recover 5 Barrels of Blasting Powder from the ship's hold.
desc_text: Aye, we got problems, matey. Me gunners have mutinied! M'n'the crew up top be tryin' to kick Sorlof's keester while dealin' with the mutinous gunners down'blo.$BYe're gonna have to go down'blo and deal with those mutinous sea dogs and take their blastin' powder for the big'un o'er on the poop deck.$BWith ye mannin' the big'un, Sorlof is sure to die and give up the booty!

title: Them!
obj_text:
rglmurgl at Winterfin Retreat has asked you to kill 15 Winterfin murlocs. Any combination of warriors, oracles, and shorestrikers will do.
 $BWinterfin murlocs slain (15)

 Winterfin Shorestriker
 Winterfin Oracle
$B

 Winterfin Warrior
desc_text: Our brothers and sisters across the water are now our mortal enemies. They have kidnapped our tadpoles, driven us out of our village, and killed more of us than I can count.$BProve yourself, <race>! Swim across the rift and slay them!$BDespite the favor that the new king has shown you, only then will we consider accepting you here. Fail to do so, and you might as well leave now and never return!

title: Sorlof's Booty
obj_text: Slay Sorlof using the Big Gun and recover Sorlof's Booty. Return Sorlof's Booty to Captain Ellis aboard the Sister Mercy.
desc_text: Me crew is gonna get the big'un all primed an'ready for ya, matey. She's restin' snuggly on the bow, o'er on the other side of the ship. Go'n man it and be ready to fire when Sorlof is in our sights!$BOnce we take that landlubber down, ye'll have to recover the booty for us, seein' as how we can't leave the damned ship! Bring that booty back to me and ye'll get your cut - the shield...

title: I'm Being Blackmailed By My Cleaner
obj_text: King Mrgl-Mrgl has asked you to speak with Mrmrglmr at the northwest end of Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: I have something embarrassing to admit: I'm being blackmailed!$BMrmrglmr agreed to clean some of my things, and got hold of my spare murloc costume. He's threatening to reveal my true nature to the other murlocs.$BI need not explain to you what a disaster that would be! Besides, I have a plan that's going to require that we get that costume back.$BPlease, <name>, go to Mrmrglmr at the other end of the Retreat to the north and do whatever he asks of you.

title: The Shield of the Aesirites
obj_text: Return the Shield of the Aesirites to Orfus of Kamagua at the Ancient Lift in the Howling Fjord.
desc_text: Here's yer shield. Me hopes it doesn't curse ye like it did me'n'me crew. Ye don't have to go home, but ye can't stay here... I be certain that thar be some that would be interested in getting' it back.$BNow get that thing off me ship!

title: The Dead Rise!
obj_text: Orfus of Kamagua at the Ancient Lift in the Howling Fjord wants you to find Fengir's Clue, Rodin's Clue, Isuldof's Clue and Windan's Clue.
desc_text: The path east of us is a primary hunting trail of the tuskarr. At least that's what it used to be...$BMore recently our hunters have been returning to Kamagua claiming that the dead have risen and are out for blood! That is what has brought my son and me here. Elder Atuik asks that we find resolution in the bluffs.$BWill you assist us in our time of need? I seek heroes willing to brave the perils of Shield Hill, southeast of here. Search the desecrated graves for clues and return your findings to me.

title: Winterfin Commerce
obj_text: Collect 5 Winterfin Clams and deliver them to Ahlurglgr at Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: Now that you can speak with the Winterfin, it is time for you to let them get to know you. One of the best ways to do that is to conduct business with them.$BThe murlocs prize clams over any other object and their only surviving merchant is Ahlurglgr. If I were you, I'd collect a handful of Winterfin clams and give them to him as a gift.$BThe clams can be found all over down in the trench, as well as across it in the Winterfin village and their caverns.

title: Escape from the Winterfin Caverns
obj_text:
Escort Lurgglbr to safety and then report to King Mrgl-Mrgl at Winterfin Retreat with the good news.
 $BEscort Lurgglbr to safety
desc_text: The lock on my cage doesn't look too solid, but I'm not foolish enough to try to leave without assistance.$BWill you help me safely get out of these caverns? There's no time to waste, <race>.$BWhen you get back to the retreat, please let the king know that I'm okay. He's sure to give you a reward.

title: Succulent Orca Stew
obj_text: Cleaver Bmurglbrm has tasked you with acquiring 7 Succulent Orca Blubber. Return with them to him at Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: Word is, strange <race>, that you might be going after the king of the orcas, Glrggl.$BThat's all fine and good, but if you want to taste the stew that makes life worth living, then you'll bring me back the succulent blubber of the orcas that swim in Glimmer Bay.$BHurry... I have quite a bit of cutting to do on this carcass if you want to reap the benefits of your efforts.

title: The Spare Suit
obj_text: Return King Mrgl-Mrgl's Spare Suit to him at Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: Very well, your king's secret is safe with me as long as he continues to help us against our enemies.$BHere, take this to him. I cleaned it up nicely, though I have no idea why he needs a second disguise.$BMaybe he has something in mind for you?

title: Return to Atuik
obj_text: Deliver the bad news to Elder Atuik at Kamagua.
desc_text: Return to Elder Atuik at Kamagua. He and the rest of my people must be warned of this impending doom that approaches from the sea.$B<Orfus shivers.>$BUse the Ancient Lift to reach him. Please hurry!

title: A Return to Resting
obj_text:
Use the Bundle of Vrykul Artifacts at the ransacked burial mounds of Shield Hill to return the Frozen Heart of Isuldof, the Shield of the Aesirites, the Staff of Storm's Fury and the Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir.$BReturn to Orfus of Kamagua at the Ancient Lift should you succeed.
 Shield of the Aesirites Returned
 Staff of Storm's Fury Returned
 Frozen Heart of Isuldof Returned
 Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir Returned
desc_text: <Orfus hands you a satchel.>$BWithin this satchel are the artifacts that you recovered. Locate the burial mounds of Shield Hill, far to the southeast, where the items were originally stolen from and return the artifacts. It is my hope that this gesture will quell the spirits that now haunt our hunting grounds.$BBe strong, <name>...

title: Keymaster Urmgrgl
obj_text: Glrglrglr inside the Winterfin Caverns has asked you to retrieve Urmgrgl's Key.
desc_text: I have to get out of these caverns! There's magic stuff seeping in from Coldarra, above, and affecting everyone's minds.$BI don't intend to be controlled like these others!$BKeymaster Urmgrgl is in the cave below and to the south. He holds the key to my cage. Get it from him and bring it back so that I can unlock my cage and get out of here.$BHurry!

title: Grmmurggll Mrllggrl Glrggl!!!
obj_text: Mrmrglmr wants you to return to him at Winterfin Retreat with Glrggl's Head.
desc_text: If your pathetic little eyes were any good, you'd see that we're being slaughtered by the orcas to the north in the bay!$BAssuming your precious night elf king wants his spare costume back, I think you'll do me a favor and bring back the head of the king of the orcas, Glrggl: he who swims against the tides of fate -- eradicating the hope of life for all those who hear the siren song of death upon the waves!$BBe quick about it, <race>, Winterfin murlocs are losing their lives even as we waste time talking!

title: The Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir
obj_text: Recover the Ancient Armor of the Kvaldir and deliver it to Orfus of Kamagua in the Howling Fjord.
desc_text: I was on the vessel that was bringing in the armor. We'd just boarded the ship and were headin' back here when we were attacked by a Forsaken destroyer.$BThey boarded our ship, took all the booty for themselves, and then sunk her.$BThat was the last I'd seen of that armor. If you want, you can take my bomber from Scalawag to the dreaded isle that the destroyer be docked. Talk to my woman, Alanya, outside. She'll get you on the bomber.$BIf you manage to find the stuff, don't you dare bring it back!

title: Too Close For Comfort
obj_text: Endorah wants you to go to Amber Ledge north of Warsong Hold and thank those there for rescuing her.
desc_text: I told them all that I remember. Why don't they believe me?$BI was gathering herbs by the rift. They came from nowhere, dark wizards with magical beasts - I was surrounded!$BA magical box appeared above me, opened up and pulled me inside. Just as it began to close around me, my rescuers swooped in on the backs of red drakes. It was breathtaking!$BI never thanked them for saving me. Please, <class>, find them, and pass on my gratitude.

title: Orfus of Kamagua
obj_text: Find Orfus of Kamagua at the Ancient Lift in Howling Fjord.
desc_text: Hail, traveler. I am Lunk-tusk of the Kalu'ak. We are known as tuskarr to your people. My partner and I were recently sent up to investigate strange happenings along one of our hunting trails. It was when we approached the graveyard known as Shield Hill that we were attacked by the undead. I was lucky to make it to this camp, but I am uncertain as to what became of Orfus.$BWe parted ways at the Ancient Lift, southeast of here along the cliff edge. Will you go see if he is ok?

title: Nick of Time
obj_text: Midge in Valiance Keep wants you to go to Amber Ledge to the north and thank those there for rescuing her.
desc_text: I told them all that I remember. Why don't they believe me?$BI was gathering herbs by the rift. They came from nowhere, dark wizards with magical beasts. I was surrounded!$BA huge magical cube appeared above me. It opened up and pulled me inside. I swear it's true!$BJust as it began to close around me, my rescuers swooped in on the backs of drakes - It was amazing! My captors scattered and I was able to escape.$BI never thanked them for saving me. Please, <class>, if you see them, pass on my gratitude.

title: Hellscream's Vigil
obj_text: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream in Warsong Hold.
desc_text: Throm-Ka, <race>! Welcome to Warsong Hold. My heart swells with pride to see that such a distinguished hero of the Horde has answered the call of duty!$BThis impregnable fortress is a testament to the tenacity of the Horde. Through much we have battled to establish this foothold in Northrend. It is from here that our journey to Icecrown begins and it is through the leadership of the son of Hellscream that we will succeed!$BGarrosh awaits your arrival below.$BLok'tar ogar!

title: Hellscream's Vigil
obj_text: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream in Warsong Hold.
desc_text: Throm-Ka, <race>! Welcome to Warsong Hold. My heart swells with pride to see that such a distinguished hero of the Horde has answered the call of duty!$BThis impregnable fortress is a testament to the tenacity of the Horde. Through much we have battled to establish this foothold in Northrend. It is from here that our journey to Icecrown begins and it is through the leadership of the son of Hellscream that we will succeed!$BGarrosh awaits your arrival below.$BLok'tar ogar!

title: Learning to Communicate
obj_text: King Mrgl-Mrgl has given you a conch to use upon Scalder's remains. Return The King's Filled Conch to him at Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: To help, you must learn how to speak the Winterfin dialect. We'll work with the forces of nature and magic to do that.$BTake this empty conch shell. At the bottom of the watery trench below exists Scalder, an elemental of air and watery fury.$BOnce she is defeated, use the conch upon her remains to capture her magical steam. Return the full conch to me, and I'll imbue my knowledge of the Winterfin tongue into you.$BLuckily, a friend taught me a water breathing spell, which I will cast upon you.

title: Prison Break
obj_text:
Librarian Donathan on Amber Ledge wants you to collect the Beryl Prison Key from one of the Beryl Mage Hunters at Beryl Point and use it to release a trapped mage from an arcane prison.
 $BArcane Prisoners Rescued

 Arcane Prisoner
$B

 Arcane Prisoner
desc_text: Greetings, <class>. I am Donathan, a loyal representative of Dalaran.$BForgive my abruptness, but we find ourselves in the midst of a crisis. Mages all across Azeroth are being abducted and I have been authorized to conscript anyone able to assist in the unraveling of this mystery.$BThe camp just south of ours is where our investigation begins. I call upon you to rescue one of the imprisoned mages held there. You must obtain a key from one of the mage hunters and use it to open an arcane prison.

title: Monitoring the Rift: Sundered Chasm
obj_text:
Garren at Amber Ledge wants you to use the Arcanometer at the Sundered Chasm anomaly and return to him with the readings.
 Sundered Chasm Reading Taken
desc_text: Did you feel that?! That was just an aftershock... you should've been here a few minutes ago!$BI'm afraid I must call upon your services again. My instruments indicate that there is an immense disruption just west of here, far beneath the water's surface.$BJust as before, I need you to take the arcanometer and capture the anomaly's data.$BI'll cast a spell that will enable you to breathe underwater. If it wears off before you find it, come let me know and I'll renew its effects.

title: Monitoring the Rift: Cleftcliff Anomaly
obj_text:
Garren on Amber Ledge wants you to use the Arcanometer at the Cleftcliff Anomaly.
 Cleftcliff Anomaly Reading Taken
desc_text: Greetings, <race>. I am Garren of Dalaran.$BNot long ago, the rift was a peaceful place - geothermally speaking at least.$BRecently though, earthquakes have occurred with alarming frequency and scars in the earth have appeared, exposing unique energy fields of chaotic power.$BMy mission here is to chart and monitor these anomalies. My instruments indicate that another has appeared on the cliff face to the southwest.$BTake this device with you and use it when you locate the new disruption.

title: Report to Steeljaw's Caravan
obj_text: Speak with Grunt Ragefist at Steeljaw's Caravan.
desc_text: That dimwitted cur, Steeljaw, tried to take our caravan of supplies on a shortcut through a taunka graveyard!$BWe just struck up relations with them!$BNow the caravan lies in ruins, overrun by the taunka spirits that rose out of their graves as he was trampling them.$BHead south and see if you can salvage the situation, <class>. I sent Grunt Ragefist and a few others down there with him to help out.$BWhy don't you see if you can lend a hand.

title: Put Them to Rest
obj_text:
Put 20 taunka spirits, either Ghostly Sages or Risen Longrunners, to rest and then report back to Grunt Ragefist at Steeljaw's Caravan.
 $BTaunka spirits laid to rest (20)

 Risen Longrunner
$B

 Ghostly Sage
desc_text: Force-Commander Steeljaw's idiocy caused this mess. What was he thinking taking a caravan through a taunka burial mound?$BStill, what's done is done. Now it is up to us to deal with the consequences.$BOverlord Bor'gorok asked me to help Longrunner Proudhoof in any way that I can. The longrunner has asked that we lay to rest the spirits of his ancestors.$BWhat do you say, <class>? Are you <man /strong> enough to handle such a simple task?

title: The Defense of Warsong Hold
obj_text: Report to Overlord Razgor at the hut on the south side of Warsong Hold.
desc_text: Hellscream has the weight of the Horde upon his shoulders. Do not be dissuaded from your duties because of his temperament, <name>.$B<Saurfang nods.>$BDid you think that I would forget the name of a hero of Orgrimmar? It is not every day that I have the pleasure of putting the head of Nefarian on a pike!$BThe Scourge have begun their assault upon this fortress. Our soldiers steady the line, but are in desperate need of backup. Report to Razgor. He is stationed directly outside of Warsong Hold.

title: Abduction
obj_text:
Donathan wants you to use the Arcane Binder on a wounded Beryl Sorcerer at Beryl Point and return to Amber Ledge with him.
 Captured Beryl Sorcerer
desc_text: <name>, we have a situation.$BI've just learned that one of our archmages en route from Dalaran has gone missing. Naturally, we suspect the mage hunters are behind her disappearance.$BTime is clearly of the essence. We must know what has become of Lady Evanor at once if we are to have any hope of rescuing her.$BTake this device. Return to Beryl Point and use it on a Beryl sorcerer when he is near death. It should bind him long enough for you to bring him here for questioning.

title: The Defense of Warsong Hold
obj_text: Report to Overlord Razgor at the hut on the south side of Warsong Hold.
desc_text: Do not let Hellscream dissuade you from your duties as a soldier of the Horde, <race>. He bears a terrible burden in these frozen wastes, with the outcome of his charge resulting in victory over the Scourge or the extinction of all life on Azeroth. It is for this reason that we require your strength and wisdom.$BThe Scourge have begun their assault upon this fortress. Our soldiers steady the line, but are in desperate need of backup. Report to Razgor. He is stationed directly outside of Warsong Hold.

title: The Defense of Warsong Hold
obj_text: Report to Overlord Razgor at the hut on the south side of Warsong Hold.
desc_text: It seems that we always meet in the direst of circumstances, Scarab Lord. Were you not saving the world from certain destruction the last time we met?$B<Saurfang chuckles.>$BYour assistance is most welcome in Northrend, despite what the young chieftain might say.$BIf we had even a dozen more soldiers with your power, we would be sitting in Orgrimmar right now, hunched over a warm fire.$BReport to Overlord Razgor, right outside the main entry to Warsong Hold, to the south.

title: The Honored Dead
obj_text:
Grunt Ragefist at Steeljaw's Caravan has asked you to use Ragefist's Torch to burn any combination of 10 Dead Carvan Guards and Workers.
 $BFallen Caravan Guards & Workers Torched (10)

 Dead Caravan Worker
$B

 Dead Caravan Guard
desc_text: Our fallen deserve a hero's funeral, but we cannot bury them here on sacred taunka ground.$BI'll not ask you to drag their bodies back here, but take this and head further into the cemetary.  When you come across our dead caravan guards and workers, put them to the torch.$BHonor our dead, <class>!

title: Taking Back Mightstone Quarry
obj_text:
Overlord Razgor at Warsong Hold wants you to kill 15 Nerub'ar Nerubians.
 $BNerub'ar slain (15)

 Nerub'ar Invader
 Nerub'ar Skitterer
 Nerub'ar Web Lord
$B

 Nerub'ar Corpse Harvester
 Nerub'ar Sky Darkener
 Nerub'ar Proxy
desc_text: While Warsong is protected by 10 feet of steel and stone on all sides, this quarry is soft and primed for attacks by the Nerubians.$B<Razgor points west.>$BBeyond this quarry stand thousands of Scourge, awaiting orders to attack. Should the Nerubians take down our inner defenses, we will be overrun by the undead legions of Arthas.$BWe can't let that happen - which is why you're going on the offensive and slaughtering the Nerubians in the quarry.$BBlood and thunder, soldier! Take 'em both with you.

title: Thassarian, My Brother
obj_text: Look for William Allerton inside the Farshire mine.
desc_text: I recently received word from William Allerton, a family friend, that my brother enlisted here in Valiance Keep on the same day he did.  Thing is... my brother's been dead for years.$BI sold everything I owned to come looking for Thassarian, only to be stonewalled by the local bureaucracy.  I've even been threatened with arrest if I keep snooping around.$BI need someone in the good graces of the higher-ups... someone like you.  If you can help me, I heard that William's stationed at the Farshire mine.

title: Lost and Found
obj_text: Speak to James Deacon at the inn in Valiance Keep.
desc_text: Poor Mr. Allerton might yet help us find my brother.$B<Leryssa unveils a voluminous book, not unlike an army recruitment ledger.>$BI borrowed it, ok?  Let's see, does that enlistment card have a date?$BWilliam saw Thassarian at the enlistment line.  Their entries must be near each other... here it is!$BHe was assigned to... Unit S?  All the other military units are named after Alliance towns.$BWho's in the unit?  Where are they deployed?  We need rumors.  See if the innkeeper's heard anything.

title: The Late William Allerton
obj_text: ring the Enlistment Card to Leryssa at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.
desc_text: William's neck has been cut by a sharp object.$BFurther inspection reveals a single clue to bring to Leryssa - an enlistment card bearing the name of William Allerton.

title: A Deserter
obj_text: Find the prison inside Inner Hold in Valiance Keep and speak to the deserter.
desc_text: Unit S... Unit S.... hmmmpph.... don't make any sense... it oughta be named after a town...$BDarkshire was sent to Dragonblight.  The Goldshire boys were sent to the Fjord.   Where did I hear...$BOh, yes... the deserter!  There's a turn-tail in the barracks prison.  Got thrown in not too long ago.  Kept saying that "S" stood for suicide.$BLook for the deserter.  He might have some information for you.

title: Taken by the Scourge
obj_text:
Foreman Mortuus at Warsong Hold wants you to free 5 Warsong Peons.
 Warsong Peon Freed (5)
desc_text: <Mortuus sighs.>$BPeons...
