We may as well post up a sign offering the Nerub'ar a free meal.$BSee, the problem with a peon is that: (1) they're dumber than dirt; and (2) they're weaker than a leper gnome. Of course they're the first to be taken by the Scourge!$BThis puts me in a bit of a predicament, you see. Without peons, manual labor comes to a halt. No peons, no construction.$BFind and release my peons, <race>. If they're alive, you'll find 'em spun up in webbing throughout Mightstone Quarry.

title: Karuk's Oath
obj_text:
Karuk wants you to slay 6 Skadir Raiders and 5 Skadir Longboatsmen.
 Skadir Raider slain (6)
 Skadir Longboatsman slain (5)
desc_text: They call themselves the Kvaldir.  My people have legends about them; we call them the tuk-hariq - walkers of the fog.$BMy village was destroyed by these giant mist-men.  Everyone I knew was slain, including my father Ariut.$BBy tuskarr law I must seek retribution against those who shed my kin's blood.$BI am but a fisherman and I've not yet passed the test of manhood... I cannot stand toe-to-toe with the vile Kvaldir.$BIf you were to carry out my blood duty for me, I will be in great debt to you.

title: Reinforcements Incoming...
obj_text: Seek out Shadowstalker Ickoris at the Warsong Farms Outpost west of Warsong Hold.
desc_text: <Hellscream shakes his head.>$BYou may not have noticed that we're trying to win a war here, <race>. I need all available soldiers at the primary points of conflict. This means that we don't have any real soldiers to spare for these minor incursions.$B<Hellscream pauses to think.>$BIf Barthus wants reinforcements at the farm...$B<Hellscream claps his hands together.>$B...he shall have them! Report to Barthus's assassins at the farms, west of here. Let them know that reinforcements have arrived.

title: In Wine, Truth
obj_text: Salvage a bottle of Kul Tiras Wine from the underwater shipwreck northeast of Valiance Keep and bring it to Old Man Colburn in the Valiance Keep inn.
desc_text: The military was all that old man Colburn had.  After he retired, he still clung to it like a lifeline.$BHe knows the name of every general, unit, brigade, detachment... you name it.  He's the man you need.$BProblem is, his mind is scarred.  He won't talk to anyone unless he gets his Kul Tiras wine.  Takes him back to the times he was a marine.$BI haven't received a shipment in months.  The last merchant ship out of Kul Tiras sunk northeast of here.  See if you can salvage a bottle to bring Colburn.

title: Untold Truths
obj_text: Find Shadowstalker Luther in Mightstone Quarry.
desc_text: We are here by order of Varimathras! The mission of the Shadowstalkers is a simple one: spy. Well, spy with a little assassination on the side.$BOne of my best field agents has gone missing. I haven't heard from him in days, which has left me fearing the worst. No, not death! Death would be ideal. I fear he may have gone rogue... turned traitor even.$BHis last known location was northern Mightstone Quarry. He was gathering intelligence on the Nerubians. Find him.$BHe better be dead...

title: A Father's Words
obj_text: Look for Veehja at the Shrine of Scales on Riplash Strand.
desc_text: There is someone who might shed light on this mystery, <race>.  It is rumored that the Kvaldir have kept a naga priestess alive at the temple on the west side of the shore.$BShe will no doubt have great reason to resent her uninvited Kvaldir guests.  Perhaps my father is expecting her to cooperate with you in some way.

title: Bury Those Cockroaches!
obj_text:
Quartermaster Holgoth at Warsong Hold wants you to use the Seaforium Depth Charge Bundle to destroy the Nerub'ar sinkholes to the south, east, west and north of Warsong Hold.
 South Nerub'ar Sinkhole Destroyed
 East Nerub'ar Sinkhole Destroyed
 West Nerub'ar Sinkhole Destroyed
 North Nerub'ar Sinkhole Destroyed
desc_text: North, south, east and west. Those are the locations that you should be concerned about. Surrounding this fortress, within Mightstone Quarry, are four perfectly situated Nerub'ar sinkholes.$B<Holgoth hands you a bundle.>$BBe very careful with that package, <name>. Mishandle it and you'll be dog meat.$BInside the bundle are seaforium depth charges. Get to each of those Nerub'ar sinkholes and plant a depth charge at their center point. If all goes well, the tunnels will collapse.$BGet a move on!

title: Patience is a Virtue that We Don't Need
obj_text: Quartermaster Holgoth at Warsong Hold wants you to recover 15 crates of Warsong Munitions.
desc_text: We can kill all the Nerubians that we see and destroy all the eggs that we find, but those things won't stop coming until we blow their tunnels and passageways up. Of course, we can't do that without some heavy grade munitions. Unfortunately, most of our stockpile is being used up by the goblins and blacksmiths for our siege tanks and weaponry.$BWe do happen to have a pretty good supply of the stuff out in Mightstone Quarry - underneath all the Nerubian crap. You'll just have to go out and get it for me.

title: The Sky Will Know
obj_text: Speak with Imperean at the Ruins of Eldra'nath.
desc_text: I must find out what happened to my master, Farseer Grimwalker!$BEarlier, he was observing the magnataur at nearby Magmoth. But one of his grunts just returned, saying that the group had been crushed, and that the farseer was dragged into the depths of the place.$BBefore I send you on a suicide mission, I wish to consult with the spirits to learn more.$BThere is an air elemental known as Imperean in the ruins of Eldra'nath to the west. She is wise and may give you the information we seek.

title: Secrets of Riplash
obj_text: Find Veehja at the ruins of Riplash in Borean Tundra.
desc_text: There is someone who might shed light on this mystery, <race>.  It is rumored that the kvaldir have kept a handful of naga priestesses alive inside the temple.$BThe high priestess, Veehja, will no doubt have great reason to resent her uninvited kvaldir guests.  Perhaps she can tell you more about what the writing on the tablet means.

title: Message to Hellscream
obj_text: Take Barthus's Note to Garrosh Hellscream at Warsong Hold.
desc_text: <Barthus tears out the last page and rolls it up.>$BTake this to Hellscream at once! In the meantime, I'm going to send a team to scout out the farms.$BBe sure to tell Hellscream that we're going to need reinforcements.

title: Gamel the Cruel
obj_text:
Karuk wants you to defeat Gamel the Cruel at Riplash Strand.
 Gamel the Cruel slain
desc_text: My own father was slain by the leader of this raiding party, Gamel the Cruel.  He has made his abode inside a cave on the beach.$BYou've dealt with his men already.  Finish what you've started, <name>.  Avenge my father and I will share with you what little I still have.

title: Vision of Air
obj_text:
Use Imperean's Primal to perform a ritual at Snarlfang's Totem at Bor'gorok Outpost to gain information concerning Farseer Grimwalker.$BAfterward, speak with Spirit Talker Snarlfang.
 Farseer Grimwalker's fate divined
desc_text: Here, <name>, I've attuned the primal to you.$BOpen your soul to it in the presence of my totem of air and concentrate upon the fate of Farseer Grimwalker.$BThe spirit of the wind touches all; with any luck you will be granted a vision.

title: Magic Carpet Ride
obj_text: Talk to Yanni at Warsong Hold to arrange safe travel to the coast. Speak to Gorge the Corpsegrinder once you arrive at Garrosh's Landing.
desc_text: Tanks, mon. I be talkin' bout siege machines! We got heavy tanks stationed at Garrosh's Landing on da west coast. We gonna get you to da tank and you gonna use da tank to lay down some Horde justice on da Scourge!$BDa only tricky part be getting' you der. No way we be sendin' you on our wind riders. Too risky.$BYou see dat pixie o'er der? Dat blondie elf? Yanni be his name, mon. He can get you to da coast, safely. Once der, talk to Gorge da Corpsegrinder!

title: Wind Master To'bor
obj_text: Report to Wind Master To'bor at Warsong Hold.
desc_text: You're a tough mother, <name>. I think your talents are better suited elsewhere - like the root of the whole damn problem!$B<Razgor points to the west.>$BA thousand Scourge, at least four full sized floating death machines and who knows what else.$BBut you're gonna find out and then you're gonna handle it... That's right, you're gonna beat the hell out of the Scourge army that's currently beating down our door.$BGet to the top of Warsong Hold and report to Wind Master To'bor. He'll be expecting you.

title: Farseer Grimwalker's Spirit
obj_text: Speak with Farseer Grimwalker's Spirit inside of Magmoth.
desc_text: You must go to Magmoth to the east.$BYou must descend into the depths of their caverns.$BYou must speak with Farseer Grimwalker's spirit!

title: Return to the Spirit Talker
obj_text: Deliver Imperean's Primal to Spirit Talker Snarlfang at Bor'gorok Outpost.
desc_text: You have done what was asked, and now I give you that which you desire.$BDeliver this primal to the spirit talker back at your Bor'gorok Outpost. If she is wise, she will know a ritual to gain you the information which you seek.

title: The Emissary
obj_text:
Find Leviroth in the waters below the iceberg floating among the northern edge of Riplash Ruins.  Use the Trident of Naz'jan to slay him and return to Karuk to the north of Riplash Strand.
 Leviroth slain
desc_text: Raj Naz'jan was the emperor of Riplash when Leviroth was imprisoned.  Azshara herself blessed his trident so it would slay the beast should it ever escape.$BNow you wield it, <race>.  As much as it disgusts me, I will have my revenge on these barbaric giant-men.$BTake the trident to the depths beneath Riplash.  You will find Leviroth below an iceberg closest to northern Riplash.$BDrive the trident into his flesh and slay him!  Return to whomever sent you when you're done; I wish to see no more of you.

title: Tank Ain't Gonna Fix Itself
obj_text: Speak with Mobu at Garrosh's Landing.
desc_text: We need to get these tanks back up and runnin'! They ain't gonna fix themselves. Mobu's gonna be the one to handle that stuff. Talk to him and see what he needs. Maybe you can shut him up before he finally drives me into a berserker frenzy and I cleave his little gnome-sized frame in two!$BI hate gnomes...

title: Revenge Upon Magmoth
obj_text:
Kill 10 Magmoth Shaman, 5 Magmoth Foragers, 3 Magmoth Crushers, and 3 Mates of Magmothregar. Then, return to Ortrosh at Bor'gorok Outpost.
 Magmoth Shaman slain (10)
 Magmoth Forager slain (5)
 Magmoth Crusher slain (3)
 Mate of Magmothregar slain (3)
desc_text: The overlord refuses to allow the shaman to heal my wounds. He says that it will be a good lesson for me and give me time to reflect upon my failure.$BBut you could get revenge for me and the others who fell at Magmoth!$BI know that the spirit talker wants you to go in there to save the farseer.$BIt's just to the east. Go, <class>... go slay the magnataur and their snobold servants. Regain the outpost's honor!

title: The Trident of Naz'jan
obj_text: Veehja in Riplash wants you to go to the far northeastern end of the Riplash Ruins.  Once there slay Ragnar Drakkarlund and obtain the Trident of Naz'jan from him.
desc_text: Five hundred years ago, Azshara imprisoned a being named Leviroth in the waters below.  Now these barbarians seek to undo our queen's work!$BThey took over our city and began to sacrifice my brethren to awaken him!  When they ran out of naga, they began to take tuskarr.  Their spirits will know no peace!$BI will help you, for it will go a long way towards quelling my vengeance.  Their captain, Ragnar, dwells deep inside northeastern Riplash.  He has in his possession a golden trident.  Bring it to me!

title: The Borean Inquisition
obj_text: Donathan ordered you to offer your assistance to Librarian Normantis in the mage tower on Amber Ledge.
desc_text: Listen closely, <name>, for there is not a moment to spare.$BYour prisoner is being prepared for interrogation here in our tower. In the event that he is less than forthcoming, your assistance may be required.$BMake your way up to where he is being detained and tell Librarian Normantis that I've sent you to assist him.

title: Mobu's Pneumatic Tank Transjigamarig
obj_text: Mobu at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to recover his Pneumatic Tank Transjigamarig.
desc_text: These wrenches are useless, buddy. I need my pneumatic tank transjigamarig to get these things up and running! Unfortunately, I left it at my old digs, on the other side of this landing. It's the beat down hut next to the stables. You're gonna have to go and get it for me, because I sure as hellfire am not going to go anywhere near the mist.$BOh yea, buddy, watch out for the mist. The mist is what tore up these shores.

title: What the Cold Wind Brings...
obj_text: Take Ith'rix's Hardened Carapace to High Overlord Saurfang at Warsong Hold.
desc_text: You hold the carapace fragment of Ith'rix the Harvester and realize that this is only the beginning. Even now you sense that victory is fleeting. Surely the Lich King has a thousand more beasts like Ith'rix, waiting to be unleashed upon the Horde.$BTake your trophy and present it to High Overlord Saurfang, inside Warsong Hold. He should be notified of your victory over a powerful Scourge agent.

title: Super Strong Metal Plates!
obj_text: Mobu at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to collect 10 Super Strong Metal Plates.
desc_text: I need metal to patch these tanks up! Super strong metal plates can be found scattered about all across Garrosh's Landing and at the bottom of the bay.$BJust be careful when you're out there searching for plates. The mist is... um... AGGRESSIVE! The mist is what took out the landing and the adjoining tuskarr town. Poor little tuskarr...

title: The Art of Persuasion
obj_text:
Librarian Normantis on Amber Ledge wants you to use the Neural Needler on the Imprisoned Beryl Sorcerer until he reveals the location of Lady Evanor.
 Prisoner Interrogated
desc_text: It is fortunate you're here, <race>.$BYou see, the Kirin Tor code of conduct frowns upon our taking certain 'extreme' measures - even in desperate times such as these.$BYou, however, as an outsider, are not bound by such restrictions and could take any steps necessary in the retrieval of information.$BDo what you must. We need to know where Lady Evanor is being held at once!$BI'll just busy myself organizing these shelves here. Oh, and here, perhaps you'll find this old thing useful....

title: Dirty, Stinkin' Snobolds!
obj_text: Retrieve 10 boxes of Crafty's Stuff and return them to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
desc_text: Those dirty, stinkin' snobolds... they stole all of my supplies!$BWhat's a snobold you ask? It's like a kobold, 'cept they serve the magnataur; kinda take care of them. I know, weird!$BAnywho, wanna help me out? I know the little creeps stole off with all of my stuff. Stupid me thinkin' that it'd be nice and safe, packed up on the north side of the airstrip.$BWhy don'tcha do me a favor and head north to their stupid Magmoth. There's a cash reward if you bring all my stuff back quick!

title: Tanks a lot...
obj_text: Speak to Gorge the Corpsegrinder at the Coast of Echoes.
desc_text: Thanks for all your help, buddy. You can let Gorge know the tanks are ready for action. Hopefully you can clean up this place once and for all!

title: Motes of the Enraged
obj_text: Obtain 5 Tempest Motes and deliver them to Imperean at the Ruins of Eldra'nath.
desc_text: Now that their little squabble is dealt with, there is still the matter of helping you and your spirit talker.$BAs you can see, my vassals have been enraged by the ongoing war between fire and water. This will not change anytime soon, but it will serve to your advantage.$BIn order to assist you, what we need are their motes. Head further into the ruins and retrieve them from the tempests.

title: Return My Remains
obj_text: Deliver Farseer Grimwalker's Remains, which are resting below his spirit, to Spirit Talker Snarlfang at Bor'gorok Outpost.
desc_text: <name>, now that my spirit has been freed would you do me the honor of returning my remains to Spirit Talker Snarlfang? They lay upon the ground beneath me.$BI sense that the spirit talker is still at Bor'gorok Outpost to the west where last I saw her.

title: The Plains of Nasam
obj_text:
Use the Horde Siege Tank to destroy 100 Scourge Soldiers and rescue 3 Injured Warsong Soldiers on the Plains of Nasam. You must also discover the identity of the leader of the Scourge assault.$BReport to Garrosh Hellscream at Warsong Hold should you succeed.
 $BScourge Leader identified
 $BScourge Unit obliterated (100)

 Nerub'ar Destroyer
 Stitched Warsong Horror
 Undying Aggressor
 Scourge Overlord
 Soldier of the Frozen Wastes
 Mindless Aberration
$B

 Nerub'ar Warrior
 Nerub'ar Tunneler
 Minion of Thel'zan
 Mindless Aberration (Unkillable)
 Scourge Proxy Unit
$B
$B
 $BInjured Warsong Soldier rescued (3)

 Injured Warsong Warrior
 Injured Warsong Mage
 Injured Warsong Shaman
$B

 Injured Warsong Engineer
 Injured Warsong Proxy
desc_text: Once you're ready, jump into one of the tanks and drive it out to the Plains of Nasam, southeast of here.$BUse the tank's weapon arsenal to take down the Scourge army. If you get in a jam, the "Meatpounder" will tear 'em up and the land mines will finish 'em off! If you find any of our soldiers, grab 'em! One last thing, fuel tanks can be found all over the field.$BTry to get close enough to that structure in the center and see what's going on.$BIf you do all of this and live, go to Hellscream!

title: Nerub'ar Secrets
obj_text: Take Luther's Journal to Shadowstalker Barthus at Warsong Hold.
desc_text: You skim through the pages of the book, looking for anything of importance. On the last page you discover what appears to be frantic scribbling:$BNecrolords. At least a dozen by my count.$BFarms to west being used as some sort of horrible spawning glade for Scourge.$BRow upon row of victims.$BI think they're on to me. Made a dash for the hold. I won't be captured alive.$BDreadvenom hemotoxin. If they decide to bite into me, they'll be in for a surprise.$BTake this information back to Barthus.

title: Hah... You're Not So Big Now!
obj_text:
Test out Crafty's Ultra-Advanced Proto-Typical Shortening Blaster on 5 Magmoth Crushers or Mates of Magmothregar. After you have done so, return to her at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
 Crafty's Blaster Tested (5)
desc_text: That'll do her, chief! So, here's what I want ya to do....$BTake my blaster and head north to Magmoth. If we're gonna have a chance at all against those monsters, we need to cut them down to size... so to speak.$BIn order to gauge its effectiveness, I need you to slay the magnataur while the blaster's effects are still on it. Any of the crushers or mates will do, but don't bother with the offspring... they're too small to worry about.

title: Burn in Effigy
obj_text:
Waltor of Pal'ea at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the Tuskarr Torch to burn the Kvaldir ships at Pal'ea and Garrosh's Landing. You must destroy the following ships: The Serpent's Maw, The Kur Drakkar, Bor's Hammer and Bor's Anvil.$B
 The Serpent's Maw destroyed
 The Kur Drakkar destroyed
 Bor's Hammer destroyed
 Bor's Anvil destroyed
desc_text: Tuskarr magic is similar to what your people call shamanism. While we serve the elements differently than you, the power that we are able to call forth is formidable.$B<Waltor waves a torch-like baton in front of you.>$BWith this tuskarr torch I want you to return to the mist and strike at the Kvaldir vessels. You will find three of their vessels docked behind the mist at Garrosh's Landing, north of here, and one docked off the shores of Pal'ea, to the south. Burn their ships in effigy! For all to see!

title: Seek Out Karuk!
obj_text: Seek out Karuk at Riplash Strand.
desc_text: A fellow survivor of Pal'ea known as Karuk has made his way to the main base of the Kvaldir in the Borean Tundra - far to the south where the snow was once bountiful. Karuk hides along the bluffs overlooking Riplash Strand.$BSeek out Karuk and let him know what you did for my people here at the Coast of Echoes.$BThe safest route to Karuk is through your fortress. From Warsong Hold, take the road south and follow it around until you reach Riplash Strand.

title: Into the Mist
obj_text: Waltor of Pal'ea at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Kvaldir and recover 8 Tuskarr Relics.
desc_text: Across the mist to the north you will find Garrosh's Landing. To the south are the ruins of my old home, Pal'ea. Both have been ransacked by an ancient force known as the Kvaldir.$BThese fearsome savages slew all of my people without mercy and drove your people inland.$BAll that remains of the tuskarr of Pal'ea are our personal effects, taken as relics by the Kvaldir. While we are not a vengeful race, justice must be served. The tuskarr relics must be returned to me. Enter the mist and find them...

title: Escaping the Mist
obj_text:
Follow Mootoo the Younger out of the mist. Speak to Elder Mootoo should you successfully save Mootoo the Younger.
 $BMootoo Saved
desc_text: I can hear the mist creatures outside. Their yells are driving me mad, but I dare not try to escape. And where would I even go? How long would it be until they caught up with me and executed me like the others?$BI wonder, how far has the mist crept, stranger? Has it overtaken this whole continent?$BWould you be willing to help me try and escape the mist? I think I can lead us back toward my father. I still sense his life spirit. He is close.

title: Horn of the Ancient Mariner
obj_text: Waltor of Pal'ea at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to bring him the Horn of the Ancient Mariner.
desc_text: A Kvaldir lieutenant known as Orabus directed the initial incursion against my people at Pal'ea, He oversaw the destruction of both villages and then disappeared into the mist.$BIn those early days there was talk of a horn that Orabus gifted to the Kvaldir mistweavers. This horn could be used to summon him should the need arise.$BWe need to get that horn from the Kvaldir mistweavers and call forth Orabus. If he is destroyed, these savages might retreat.$BSeek out mistweavers at Pal'ea, to the south.

title: Sharing Intelligence
obj_text: Normantis has asked you to report to Librarian Donathan on Amber Ledge.
desc_text: Thank you, <class>! The information you've extracted is of vital importance to the Kirin Tor.$BReturn at once to Donathan as we make plans for the rescue of Lady Evanor.

title: Orabus the Helmsman
obj_text:
Waltor of Pal'ea at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to use the Horn of the Ancient Mariner to summon Orabus the Helmsman. Once summoned, slay Orabus the Helmsman.
 Orabus the Helmsman slain
desc_text: Take the horn and travel west to the Warsong Jetty. Make your way to the end of the jetty and blow into the horn. The sound should rouse Orabus.$BSlay the foul beast and return to me!

title: Enlistment Day
obj_text: Meet with General Arlos inside the barracks in Valiance Keep.
desc_text: You've come to enlist, right?  Normally you'd have to stand in line like the other recruits.  Normally you'd be out of luck because the recruitment ledger's gone missing and I can't process anyone until the new books get here.$BFortunately for you, <name>, I've heard about you and what you did in Outland.  To be honest, you're a cut above these poor saps.  Lines aren't for you.$BGo to the barracks and speak to General Arlos.  He'll be more than happy to meet with someone of your caliber.

title: Sage Highmesa is Missing
obj_text: Find Sage Highmesa near the Dens of Dying.
desc_text: There are many new mysteries walking the lands now. One of our sages, Highmesa, has foolishly gone north with only one longrunner to investigate something strange near the Dens of Dying.$BWhat are the dens, you ask? They are a sacred place to the magnataur, where they go in their old age to die. She saw something fall from the sky near them a few days ago.$BIf you would be friend to the taunka, I would have you find and help her. She is not so stubborn that she will not accept your aid.

title: Plan B
obj_text: Collect 10 Warsong Outfits and a Warsong Banner. Bring them back to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
desc_text: Okay, don't panic! The blaster might not've worked, but we still have options.$B<Crafty snaps her fingers.>$BWe're going to divert attention away from the airstrip! To make this work, we'll need a few things first.$B<Wobblesprocket looks you up and down appraisingly.>$BSteeljaw's caravan, just to the west, stupidly took a shortcut through a taunka graveyard and was destroyed by their risen spirits.$BHead over there and get some outfits off of the dead orcs. Pick up one of their banners, too!

title: A Proper Death
obj_text:
Destroy 10 Plagued Magnataur and then return to Sage Highmesa south of The Dens of Dying.
 $BPlagued Magnataur slain (10)

 Aged Magnataur
$B

 Plagued Magnataur
desc_text: The magnataur at the Dens of Dying have contracted a plague. We must find the cause, but first we must put them out of their misery.$B<race>, you must go north onto the slopes in front of us and destroy as many of the poor creatures as you can.

title: Merciful Freedom
obj_text:
Shadowstalker Canarius at Warsong Farms Outpost wants you to free 5 Scourge Prisoners.
 Scourge Prisoner Freed (5)
desc_text: The soldiers that they didn't kill are being held in cages scattered across this farmland. Through some thievery we've managed to find a few keys, but we're unable to get close enough to any prisoners without being attacked.$BWe need your "talents" in securing those keys and freeing the prisoners. Bash in the brains of the necrolords and aberrations and take their keys. Use those keys to free Scourge prisoners.

title: Find Bristlehorn
obj_text: Find Longrunner Bristlehorn at Talramas.
desc_text: ristlehorn should have returned by now.$BThe other reason why we came up here was to investigate that Scourge structure to the west, which fell from the sky. He's impetuous and has likely gotten himself into trouble.$B<name>, go to that place and find him, please.

title: Dragonspeak
obj_text: Lady Evanor has sent you to speak with Surristrasz on Amber Ledge.
desc_text: I am aware of your recent deeds here, <name>, and again I thank you.$BAs for this local menace, we've learned all we need to know from them. They'll be dealt with in short order. On now to more important issues....$BAzeroth needs you. The region just west of here is the center of an urgent crisis.$BI'll leave the details to Lord Surristrasz. You must speak with him at once.$BGood luck, friend of Dalaran.

title: Stop the Plague
obj_text:
Sage Highmesa, standing just south of The Dens of Dying, has asked you to use Highmesa's Cleansing Seeds at a Den of Dying Plague Cauldron to neutralize it.
 Plague Cauldron neutralized
desc_text: I'm convinced that the plague is being caused by something in the caves up there.$B<class>, I want you to take these seeds. I normally use them as a ward against the Scourge, though perhaps they can be used to disrupt whatever foulness is happening in the dens.$BFind the source of the plague and throw them into it.

title: A Race Against Time
obj_text: Donathan on Amber Ledge has tasked you with using the Beryl Shield Detonator to bring down the shield at Beryl Point. You are then to defeat Salrand and collect the key she holds.
desc_text: So it's true. They have her.$BIt's clear what must be done, <race>. She WILL be saved.$BI must remain here and aid in the rescue preparations. I call upon you again; this time to collect the prison key. All we know of this Salrand figure is that she cannot be harmed so long as her shield is intact.$BWe've customized a special explosive that should strip her of this protection, allowing you to perform your duty. Return to me when you've collected the key.$BHurry, <name>. Lady Evanor is suffering!

title: Rescuing Evanor
obj_text:
Anzim on Amber Ledge wants you to fly with his war mages to free Lady Evanor at Beryl Point. You are then to report to her in the mage tower on Amber Ledge.
Amber Ledge to Beryl Point (Provided)
desc_text: At last, we attack!$BOnce we've cleared the platform I'll use the key.$BYou are to ensure that Lady Evanor remains safe after her release.$BHurry now, let us be off!

title: Fallen Necropolis
obj_text:
Destroy 20 Scourge of any type at Talramas and the Festering Pools. Then, return to Sage Highmesa just to the south of The Dens of the Dying.
 $BTalramas Scourge Destroyed (20)

 Cult Plaguebringer
 Doctor Razorgrin
 Lich-Lord Chillwinter
$B

 Talramas Abomination
 Bone Warrior
 Festering Ghoul
desc_text: The fallen necropolis to the west can only be assumed to still be filled with Scourge.$BWhile you are at Talramas, <class>, I would ask that you dispatch all of the Lich King's servants that you find within and in the surrounding pools where it fell.

title: Taking Wing
obj_text: Give Salrand's Key to Warmage Anzim when you are ready to free Evanor.
desc_text: The key is forged anew.$BNow heed my counsel, <race>. Succeed in your endeavor or die trying, for if a single scale falls from one of my drakes I shall hold you personally accountable.$BNow, off with you.

title: Just a Few More Things...
obj_text: Collect Crafty's Tools, an Overcharged Capacitor, and a Handful of Rocknar's Grit. Deliver them to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
desc_text: As you may have noticed, we created the airstrip on the southern border of a magnataur den!$B<Crafty says something uncharitable about Fizzcrank under her breath.>$BThe old man has put me in charge of finding a... ahem... creative solution to this situation: if we don't deal with them soon, they'll come down here and tear us limb from limb!$BThat's where you come in. I want you to get me everything on this shopping list. Please.

title: Damned Filthy Swine
obj_text:
Farmer Torp at Warsong Farms Outpost wants you to kill 10 Unliving Swine.
 Unliving Swine slain (10)
desc_text: Just look at 'em! My beautiful kodos are helpless to defend themselves against those filthy swine! I need you to buy me some time, <race>. I think I can cure the kodo of the sickness, but you need to keep the unliving swine off 'em, else there'll be nothin' left to cure!$BGet out there and send those swine to their graves - permanently!

title: Scouting the Sinkholes
obj_text:
Greatfather Mahan at Taunka'le Village wants you to use the Map of the Geyser Fields to mark the locations of the South Sinkhole, the Northwest Sinkhole, and the Northeast Sinkhole.
 Mark Location of South Sinkhole
 Mark Location of Northeast Sinkhole
 Mark Location of Northwest Sinkhole
desc_text: Can you feel the tremors in the earth?$BThe Scourge's nerubians are on the move deep beneath the ground. They've emerged to the southwest in the Geyser Fields, and are harassing the patrols Chieftain Wintergale sent out.$B<The taunka elder offers you a worn map.>$BPerhaps a single person can succeed where the patrols have failed. Take this with you to the Geyser Fields and map out the locations of the Nerubian sinkholes.

title: The Warsong Farms
obj_text:
Shadowstalker Ickoris at Warsong Farms Outpost wants you to scout Warsong Granary, Torp's Farm, and Warsong Slaughterhouse.
 Scout Warsong Granary
 Scout Torp's Farm
 Scout Warsong Slaughterhouse
desc_text: According to Luther's notes the Scourge is now using this place as a breeding ground for those monsters you see lumbering across the field.$B<Ickoris shudders.>$BThose monsters were once orcs... tauren...$BWe need more information before a plan can be devised. I want you to investigate three sites that are heavily trafficked by Scourge: the Warsong Granary, southwest of us, Torp's Farm, directly west of us, and the old Warsong Slaughterhouse, north of us.$BReturn to me once you've scouted 'em out.

title: Reforging the Key
obj_text: Donathan wants you to speak to Surristrasz on Amber Ledge.
desc_text: Delays, delays... the one thing we cannot afford right now!$BAs much as I hate to disturb Lord Surristrasz, he's our only hope of saving our beloved Evanor.$BBring him the key fragments and hope that his mood is favorable.$BHurry, <class>, our assault team is waiting.

title: Return with the Bad News
obj_text: Speak with Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: The greatmother will need to know, <name>.$BWill you please return to Taunka'le? Tell her that I will be following shortly.

title: The Heart of the Elements
obj_text: ring 5 Elemental Hearts to Wind Tamer Barah at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: Now that we know the exact locations of the nerubian sinkholes, we can collapse them to halt the Scourge offensive and cripple their force. Wind Tamer Barah knows a way to harness elementals to destroy the tunnels the Nerubians are using, but she will require your help.$BSoutheast of the village, near the coast beyond the Frozen Reach, you'll find an area dominated by frozen earth elementals. The hearts of these elements are exactly what Wind Tamer Barah will need.

title: Oh Great... Plagued Magnataur!
obj_text:
Kill 10 Plagued Magnataur and then return to Bixie Wrenchshanker to the south of The Dens of Dying.
 $BPlagued Magnataur slain (10)

 Aged Magnataur
$B

 Plagued Magnataur
desc_text: Tinky and I came out here stalking some old magnataur. Apparently those caves up there are where they go to die.$BOf course, we had no idea that they were going to get plagued when they went in there. We can't have plagued things just roaming about; it's not healthy.$BSay, why don't you put down a number of those things while I figure out what our next step should be?

title: Check in With Bixie
obj_text: Mordle Cogspinner has asked you to find Bixie Wrenchshanker to the south of The Dens of Dying.
desc_text: You're a proven <hero /heroine>. I have another problem!$BMy boss, Tinky, went east with Bixie Wrenchshanker and I CAN'T get the outgoing on this thing to work! Tinky's the only one that can fix it and we really need it working one-hundred percent.$BYou think you could find them? Bixie said something about following some old magnataur to a place called The Dens of Dying.$BI'm guessing that's where you'll find them.$BYou can catch a ride out there by talking with Kara Thricestar at the runway.

title: Bring 'Em Back Alive
obj_text:
Farmer Torp at Warsong Farms Outpost wants you to rescue 8 Infected Kodo Beasts.
 Kodo rescued (8)
desc_text: Take this riding snaffle, <name>. You'll notice that I've placed a tiny medicine dispenser in the mouthpiece. That thing will cure the infection as soon as a kodo bites down. Once you've cured the sick out of 'em, you'll need to ride 'em home. They'll be weak so you'll need to gently direct 'em here.$BBring my babies back, <name>!$BOne last thing, you've got ten minutes! That's how long the antidote will remain effective inside that snaffle.

title: Rats, Tinky Went into the Necropolis!
obj_text: Find Tinky Wickwhistle inside Talramas.
desc_text: I told Tinky not to go off on her own, but she just HAD to check out that crashed necropolis to the west.$BI'm 100% certain that those cultists came from inside that thing, which means I'm now 100% certain that Tinky's in trouble!$BShe's the airstrip's number one engineer. Without her we're doomed!$BI'd find her myself, but one of those things got in a swipe on my leg before I could vanish again. <name>, if anyone can get her out, it's you!

title: There's Something Going On In Those Caves
obj_text:
ixie Wrenchshanker, skulking just to the south of The Dens of Dying, has asked you to use Bixie's Inhibiting Powder at a Den of Dying Plague Cauldron to neutralize it.
 Plague Cauldron Neutralized
desc_text: So, while you were out taking care of those plagued beasts, I took a peek inside the caves up there.$BThere are cultists in there plaguing them!$BThey have some sort of noxious concoction brewing in a cauldron. I have a powder that I normally use as an anti-poison, and I mixed it up with some other stuff. I think it'll neutralize their brew!$BTake it up to one of those caves and see if it works.

title: Let Bixie Know
obj_text: Speak with Bixie Wrenchshanker just south of The Dens of Dying.
desc_text: My evil twin's out there somewhere now.$BI'm pretty sure that she's not back at the airstrip. In fact, wherever she ended up, it's colder there than here. But I could only 'feel' her for a moment.$BOh well, I'll reconfigure this thing and port myself back to the airstrip soon enough. In the meantime, do you think you could go east and let Bixie know that I'll meet her back there?$BThanks, <name>!

title: Might As Well Wipe Out the Scourge
obj_text:
Destroy 20 Scourge of any type at Talramas and the Festering Pools. Then, return to Bixie Wrenchshanker just to the south of The Dens of the Dying.
 $BTalramas Scourge Destroyed (20)

 Cult Plaguebringer
 Doctor Razorgrin
 Lich-Lord Chillwinter
$B

 Talramas Abomination
 Bone Warrior
 Festering Ghoul
desc_text: If the cultists up in those caves survived the crash, then that fallen necropolis to the west can only be assumed to still be filled with Scourge. There're probably lots of them out in front of it in the pools, too!$BWhile you're at Talramas, <class>, do you think you could dispatch all of the Lich King's flunkies that you find there?

title: Back to the Airstrip
obj_text: Speak with Fizzcrank Fullthrottle at Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra.
desc_text: Okay, I think I'm going to start making my way back to the airstrip, too. Of course, I'm moving a little slower with this leg injury.$BSay, do you think you could get there ahead of me and pass on the good news to Ol' Fizzcrank? I bet anything that there'll be a reward in it for you.$BThanks, <name>!

title: King Mrgl-Mrgl
obj_text: Speak with King Mrgl-Mrgl at Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: Dis is gonna sound weird, <class>, but dere be a murloc askin' for our help!$BHe goes by da name of King Mrgl-Mrgl, leader of da Winterfin murlocs. Him and his people been run outa dere village and wantin' you to come save dem.$BYou find him by headin' west and go down da cliffs. He hangin' out on da south side of da Winterfin Retreat.

title: Get to Getry
obj_text: Find Shadowstalker Getry at Warsong Farms.
desc_text: The Scourge agent that's overseeing the abduction and transformation of Horde soldiers into undead monsters is using the northwest farm as a spawning glade. Shadowstalker Getry has been staking out that monster for the past week and has gathered some vital information that might allow us to end this menace.$BGet to Getry and see if you can help him put a stop to this Scourge assembly line. You'll find Getry at the abandoned tower on the northwest border of these farms.

title: King Mrgl-Mrgl
obj_text: Speak with King Mrgl-Mrgl at Winterfin Retreat.
desc_text: This is the weirdest thing, <class>, but there's a murloc asking for our help!$BHe goes by the name of King Mrgl-Mrgl, leader of the Winterfin murlocs. It would seem that he and his people have been run out of their village and they want someone to come save them.$BThat someone is you!$BYou'll find Winterfin Retreat, and the king, by heading west down the road until you come to the cliffs. Head down to the water line near the Blistering Pool.

title: Foolish Endeavors
obj_text:
Help Getry defeat Varidus the Flenser at Warsong Farms.$BReport to Garrosh Hellscream should you succeed.$B
 $BVaridus the Flenser Defeated
desc_text: This is madness. How do they expect us to take on a Scourge necrolord and an unknown number of his minions?$B<Getry sighs.>$BIf Ickoris sent you he must think that you are capable of great feats. Perhaps you will call down a miracle today, eh?$BWhen you're ready we will descend and face Varidus.$BIf we make it out of this mess in one piece, report back to Hellscream in Warsong Hold.

title: Distress Call
obj_text: Speak with Fizzcrank Fullthrottle at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
desc_text: Oh good, you're <name>, right?$BWe need your help up north at Fizzcrank Airstrip, like yesterday! The magnataur, and the Scourge... and the pumping station!$BIt's madness I tell you, madness!$BYou've got to head up there and talk to old man Fullthrottle a.s.a.p.!

title: The Mechagnomes
obj_text:
Listen to Fizzcrank Fullthrottle's tale and then find Jinky Wingnut at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
 $BFizzcrank's tale listened to.
desc_text: Now that you're here, it's time for me to tell you the full story of what's going on.$BAfter you've heard my tale, go outside and find my second-in-command, Jinky Wingnut. She'll handle everything from here on out.

title: Nork Bloodfrenzy's Charge
obj_text: Speak to Warden Nork Bloodfrenzy at Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra.
desc_text: While you have done much to secure our foothold in these frozen wastes, other dangers still lurk in the shadows. I want you to assist Warden Nork Bloodfrenzy, stationed at the internment camp just outside and immediately southeast of Warsong Hold. Seek him out and offer your assistance for prisoner transport and exchange.$BYou are dismissed, <name>.

title: The Horn of Elemental Fury
obj_text: Reclaim the Lower Horn Half and Upper Horn Half from Chieftain Burblegoggle and Chieftain Gurgleboggle and bring them to Wind Tamer Barah at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: I can fashion the likeness of an elemental from these pieces of inanimate stone, but breathing life into it is different. For that, we'll need help and a bit of luck.$BLegend tells of an ancient artifact called the Horn of Elemental Fury, sought after by a great hero. I'll lend you a scroll with a copy of the tale. I don't know if the legend is true, but it's our best bet. If the legend is right, the parts of the horn may be in the Flood Plains surrounding the village to the north and southwest.

title: The Collapse
obj_text:
Wind Tamer Barah at Taunka'le Village wants you to collapse the Nerubian sinkholes using the Horn of Elemental Fury and defeat Lord Kryxix.
 Lord Kryxix slain
 Nerubian tunnels collapsed
desc_text: I have created and bound Alluvius using the Horn of Elemental Fury. He will respond to the horn's call when you stand near the southernmost sinkhole in the Geyser Fields.$BThe quake Alluvius will unleash should collapse the Nerubian tunnels and put an end to their flanking attack. I wouldn't be surprised if the Nerubian commander showed himself after the quake. If the collapse of the tunnels doesn't break the back of their assault, the defeat of their leader surely will.

title: Vermin Extermination
obj_text:
Scout Tungok at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill 8 Bloodspore Harvesters, 5 Bloodspore Firestarters and 2 Bloodspore Roasters.
 Bloodspore Harvester slain (8)
 Bloodspore Firestarter slain (5)
 Bloodspore Roaster slain (2)
desc_text: Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me clean up these fields? They're littered with dirty little rat men! Kobolds, snobolds, whatever you wanna call 'em, they're all over the damned place. The stink alone is making my life hell!$BTake care of the vermin for me and I'll make it worth your while, <name>.

title: What's the Matter with the Transmatter?
obj_text: Collect 15 Fizzcrank Spare Parts and deliver them to Mordle Cogspinner at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
desc_text: There're spare parts strewn all over to the east in the Scalding Pools, the Geyser Fields... heck, probably even up on the pumping station still, too. Bring back a whole bunch. Maybe then I'll be able to get outgoing teleport on this thing working, not to mention getting the incoming transmatter ports aligned.$BI'd hate to see another accident....

title: Re-Cursive
obj_text:
Jinky Wingnut at Fizzcrank Airstrip has asked you to use the Re-Cursive Transmatter Injection on 6 Fizzcrank Mechagnomes.
 Fizzcrank Gnome cursed & ported (6)
desc_text: If you listened to the old man, then you know that we have gnomes out there that were changed. Gearmaster Mechazod infected them with something that reversed the "Curse of the Flesh", and now they're robots!$BWe think we have a way to re-curse them back to normal. We want you to take this re-cursive transmatter injection and use it on the corpses of any mechagnomes you come across.$BWe're hoping that this stuff will cure them and allow us to lock onto them to port 'em out of there.$BWhaddya say, <name>?

title: Fueling the Project
obj_text:
Abner Fizzletorque at Fizzcrank Airstrip wants you to collect 8 Barrels of Oil using the Portable Oil Collector.
 Barrels of Oil Collected (8)
desc_text: I plan to build a machine that will collapse the tunnels the Scourge is using to deploy their Nerubians, but with the main drilling rig out of order, we'll have to collect the fuel for the device some other way.$BOut in the Geyser Fields to the southeast, small pools of oil bubble up away from the main rig. If you can collect enough of the oil from those pools, I can make a crude fuel to power the machine.$BSimply deploy the collector near the rig, and it will pump and store the oil in its tank.

title: Coward Delivery... Under 30 Minutes or it's Free
obj_text:
Take the Alliance Deserter to the crossroads east of Warsong Hold and fire your Warsong Flare Gun to signal the Alliance.$BReport to Scout Tungok once you have successfully delivered the Alliance Deserter to their destination.
 $BAlliance Deserter Delivered
desc_text: We're seeing more deserters show up at our gates with each passing day. We simply do not have enough room to keep all of these maggots caged up. Especially not if we want to keep the pigs happy.$B<Nork snorts as he laughs.>$BI want you to escort one of these cowards to the crossroads east of here and fire this flare gun. One of their captains will show up when they see the flare and take the coward off your hands.$BReport to Scout Tungok on the east road once the delivery has been made.

title: A Suitable Test Subject
obj_text:
loodmage Laurith at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra has asked that you use the Pollinated Bloodspore Flower and allow her to observe the results.
 $BBloodspore Flower Used
desc_text: <Laurith looks you over as if to size you up.>$BSo we've got this pollinated bloodspore flower and nobody to test its effects on. Say, would you perhaps be interested in rubbing this on your skin and letting me observe? What's the worst that could happen anyway?$BDon't you worry, <name>! Just take this sample and rub it all over your face.

title: The Wondrous Bloodspore
obj_text: loodmage Laurith at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra wants you to recover 10 Bloodspore Carpels.
desc_text: We are witnessing something amazing here, <race>. A whole undiscovered ecology lives and breathes not more than a few paces from us! I surmise it is the bloodspore plant that sets this environment abuzz.$BI have collected some pollen from the nearby male species of bloodspore plant but still lack female receptors for pollination. Fetch me a bushel of the bloodspore carpels. You'll find them near the larger plants surrounding us.$BBe wary of their guardians! The kobolds won't give them up easily!

title: Pollen from the Source
obj_text: loodmage Laurith at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra wants you to recover 5 Bloodspore Moth Pollen.
desc_text: It's obvious! The bloodspore moths are the entities responsible for pollination on these plains. It must be something that happens within the moth's internal system that acts as a catalyst for this pollen to work. It's all starting to make sense now, <name>. That's why the kobolds don't kill the moths and instead go to great lengths to protect them! Those stupid little rats have it all figured out!$BWell we'll just have to get our own moth pollen! What do you say? Fetch me some in the name of science?

title: A Time for Heroes
obj_text: Report to Sergeant Hammerhill at Valiance Keep.
desc_text: It's good to have you among us, <name>.  We've all heard of your past deeds.$BAs you know, King Wrynn is moving great armies into Northrend to meet those of Arthas.  But armies are nothing without true heroes to inspire and lead them.$BI want you to be that hero for my men.  Fight alongside them against the Scourge that lays siege to our stronghold.$BReport to Sergeant Hammerhill outside the inner hold.  Valiance Keep cannot fall.  The future of our campaign depends on it.

title: Finding Pilot Tailspin
obj_text: Locate Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle in the Geyser Fields.
desc_text: I should've flown the mission myself. It's not that I don't trust Tailspin. Far from it. Heck, he was the best wingman I ever flew with.$BNo, it's just that it's my responsibility to lead a mission of such import.$BI sent Tailspin out with our fastest recon squadron to gather information about the Nerubian infestation in the middle of the Geyser Fields.$BThe last report we received placed his squadron in the pools to the far south and just west of the Nerubian sinkholes.$BFind Tailspin, <name>.

title: Trophies of Gammoth
obj_text: Take the Head of Gammothra to Garrosh Hellscream in Warsong Hold.
desc_text: We cannot take all of the credit for this Horde victory, <name>. It was you who risked your life to test the bloodspore and it was you who ultimately put an end to Gammothra.$BHonor us by returning to Warsong Hold and presenting the head of Gammothra to Lord Hellscream.

title: Deploy the Shake-n-Quake!
obj_text:
Abner Fizzletorque at Fizzcrank Airstrip wants you to use the Shake-n-Quake 5000 to collapse the Nerubian tunnels and defeat Lord Kryxix.
 Lord Kryxix slain
 Deploy the Shake-n-Quake 5000
desc_text: ehold, the machine that will save us from the Nerubian threat!$B<Abner beams with pride as he presents the finished bot.>$BTake this remote control with you, and go out to the southernmost of the Nerubian sinkholes in the Geyser Fields. Use the remote to activate the Shake-n-Quake 5000. It will do the rest on its own.$BDon't be surprised if the quake it creates attracts the attention of a Nerubian leader. In fact, it would be a great opportunity to finish off the Nerubian offensive.

title: Massive Moth Omelet?
obj_text: Take the Massive Glowing Egg to Bloodmage Laurith at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra.
desc_text: This egg was obviously important to somebody, as the corpse nearby can attest. As you look the egg over you notice that it has already been tagged for shipment to the Bloodspore Plains, care of Bloodmage Laurith. That's just east of here!$BCollect the egg and take it to the expectant Bloodmage.

title: A Bot in Mammoth's Clothing
obj_text: Abner Fizzletorque at Fizzcrank Airstrip wants you to bring him 6 Thick Mammoth Hides.
desc_text: I've reconfigured the skeleton of an old bot to create an earthquake large enough to collapse the tunnels, but the machinery is delicate and sensitive to Northrend's biting cold.$BI've devised a means of insulating it using the thickest hides of the native mammoths. They roam the plains south of the airstrip and adjacent to the Geyser Fields. Bring back enough of the hides for me to finish the machine and then we'll be able to unleash it on the Nerubians!

title: Gammothra the Tormentor
obj_text: Slay Gammothra and return the Head of Gammothra to Primal Mighthorn at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra.
desc_text: Magnataur live in prides, much like lions: one or two dominant males and several females along with their offspring. In the case of Gammoth, the magnataur den west of here, Gammothra is the leader. It is Gammothra that controls this magnataur population and therefore it is Gammothra that must be slain to prevent any type of magnataur uprising.$BTake this pouch of crushed bloodspore flower to Gammoth. Use the powder from the pouch to weaken Gammothra and then slay him! Return his head to me as proof.

title: A Little Bit of Spice
obj_text: Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle in the Scalding Pools wants you to gather 4 Gorloc Spice Pouches.
desc_text: The wolves have been pawing through the wreckage ever since the crash and I'm afraid they consumed the microfilm from our mission in the process.$BI have a plan to recover that microfilm, but I need your help to make it work.$BTo the south and east, in the Flood Plains, live creatures called gorlocs. They prepare their foods with noxious spices, which would sicken any other creature. If you can gather enough of the spice pouches from gorloc steam belchers or gorloc waddlers, I can make the wolf bait.

title: Cultists Among Us
obj_text: Speak to Captain "Lefty" Lugsail above the Stormbreaker in Valiance Keep.
desc_text: This altar bears all the markings of the Cult of the Damned.  It appears fanatics from the mainland have made it into Northrend.  It might be prudent to notify the captain of the ship.$BPerhaps he is to be found above deck.

title: Traversing the Rift
obj_text:
Surristrasz wants you to travel to Coldarra. Once there, you are to speak with Archmage Berinand.
Amber Ledge to Coldarra (Provided)
desc_text: I've been mindful of your efforts, mortal. Do not feign surprise. Surely you've felt my eye upon you.$BThe time has come to peel back a layer of darkness from your mind. There are stark truths that you have grown ready to accept.$BBefore hearing the tale, you shall be shown firsthand what we face.$BPut your affairs in order, <class>....

title: The Invasion of Gammoth
obj_text: Speak to Primal Mighthorn at the Bloodspore Plains in the Borean Tundra.
desc_text: Hellscream assigned Mighthorn and I with the daunting task of magnataur extermination on the southern front of Warsong Hold. With us came an entire platoon of seasoned Horde soldiers. Our initial foray into the nearby magnataur dens proved quite unsuccessful as our entire squad was wiped out by the lair defenders. We're the only ones left...$BWe aren't scientists or researchers. We're soldiers of the Horde, just like you. Soldiers on a mission that cannot fail...$BSpeak to Primal Mighthorn now.

title: Notify Arlos
obj_text: Speak to General Arlos inside the Inner Hold at Valiance Keep.
desc_text: We must notify General Arlos at once.  I've known the captain for a long time and, believe me, he is one of the more careful ones.$BWho knows how many cultists have been smuggled into our settlements in Northrend in other ships?  This could be disastrous.

title: Master and Servant
obj_text:
Use the Ultrasonic Screwdriver to reprogram 15 robots and then return to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.$BMake sure to loot the dead robot before you reprogram it.
 Robots reprogrammed (15)
desc_text: The Ultrasonic Screwdriver is the ultimate tool. It can do anything to mechanical stuff!$BHead back into the pools and dismantle a number of Mechazod's robots. Then all you have to do is use the screwdriver on their remains, and I'm betting that they'll turn to our side, for a short time anyway.$BI'm pretty sure it won't work on the mechagnomes, so don't even bother with them.$BOh, and if you want to take anything from the robot's insides, you'll want to do so before using the screwdriver!

title: A Soldier in Need
obj_text: Medic Hawthorn, outside of Valiance Keep, wants you to go inside the Stormbreaker's hold and retrieve Hawthorn's Anti-Venom from a crate of First Aid Supplies.
desc_text: You there!  Please, I need your help.  This soldier will succumb to the cryptfiends' venom unless we act immediately.$BI've managed to slow down the poison, but without a suitable supply of antidote I cannot counteract it.$BI was promised a new shipment of anti-venom in the Stormbreaker's most recent trip from the south.  Go inside its hold and search for a chest of first aid supplies.$BHurry, <class>!  We can't afford to lose any more men unnecessarily.

title: Lupus Pupus
obj_text: Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle in the Scalding Pools wants you to bring him 8 pieces of Microfilm.
desc_text: Whatever you do, don't eat this bait yourself. Just set it down in the vicinity of an oil-soaked wolf. If they're desperate enough to eat the microfilm, they'll come running when they smell the bait.$BSimply wait for nature to take its course and then all you need to do is search the, uh... byproduct for the film.$BI'd offer you my special lupus pupus scupus for the job, but I left it back at the airstrip. I'm afraid you'll have to conduct the... err... search the old-fashioned way.

title: The Ultrasonic Screwdriver
obj_text: Deliver the Ultrasonic Screwdriver to Crafty Wobblesprocket at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
desc_text: The unit you just dismantled had this inside of its mechanical innards.$BIt looks pretty complicated... certainly someone back at the airstrip would want to take a look at it. Maybe Crafty Wobblesprocket?

title: The Hunt is On
obj_text:
Vindicator Yaala wants you to use the Oculus of the Exorcist in three different locations in Valiance Keep to uncover and defeat Cult of the Damned members.
 Cultist in docks defeated
 Cultist in jail defeated
 Cultist in kitchen defeated
desc_text: I've made it my business to learn as much as possible about the vile death cult, including their secret language.$BVurenn was right.  The cultists mention disguised operatives in various locations in Valiance Keep: the lower docks, the jail inside the inner hold and in the inn's kitchen.$BTake this oculus.  Use it at those three locations - anyone that has recently used the cult's necromancy will be enshrouded by a dark aura.  Take care of the cultists before something nefarious happens.

title: Enemies of the Light
obj_text: Harbinger Vurenn wants you to fight the Cultist Necrolytes near Farshire to the north of Valiance Keep and retrieve the Cultist Communique from them.
desc_text: Not so fast there.  I don't know about you, <class>, but I was hardly convinced by the general's words.  They rung unsure... as if they were not his own.$BSomething's amiss here.  All of our efforts to collaborate have been blocked and delayed.  It is time we took a more independent approach.$BIf we're to learn more about the cultists inside the keep... perhaps we should investigate those outside.$BIntelligence reports a small group of them aiding the Scourge north of here.  See if they carry any clues.

title: Emergency Protocol: Section 8.2, Paragraph C
obj_text: Recover 6 Fizzcrank Pilot Insignia from the bodies of Fizzcrank Recon Pilots and return them to Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle in the Scalding Pools.
desc_text: Injured or not, as squadron commander, I'm responsible for locating and returning the insignia of all fallen pilots under my command. In all the years I've flown with Fizzcrank, we've never failed to return the signet of a pilot.$BMy injuries make it dangerous for me to stray far from the safety of the wreckage, but perhaps you would be willing to help me recover the insignia? In the meantime, I'll make preparations to carry out my final duty as squadron commander.

title: Give Fizzcrank the News
obj_text: Make your way back to Fizzcrank Airstrip and speak with Fizzcrank Fullthrottle.
desc_text: Would you be willing to head back to the airstrip and let Fizzcrank know that I'll be along shortly to give my formal report? I've got to deal with the wreckage of my flying machine, and then I'll be on my way.$BI'll be certain that Fizzcrank knows that he has you to thank for my survival and the recovery effort.$BI only wonder what the old man would've done himself if he'd been flying with us. I miss those days.

title: Further Investigation
obj_text: ring the Cultist Communique to Vindicator Yaala inside the inn in Valiance Keep.
desc_text: I'm afraid this is a matter I must delegate to one of my operatives... someone who can work in secret.  Keep the evidence with you and take it to Vindicator Yaala inside the inn.$BTell her I sent you and speak of this matter to no one else.  We do not know who might be working for the cult.

title: Emergency Protocol: Section 8.2, Paragraph D
obj_text:
Iggy "Tailspin" Cogtoggle wants you to scuttle the Eastern Wreck, a Southern Wreck, and a Northwestern Wreck.
 Scuttle the Eastern Wreck
 Scuttle a Southern Wreck
 Scuttle a Northwestern Wreck
desc_text: There's only one more thing left to do before I can finally return to the airstrip and make my report. Section 8.2, paragraph D of the emergency protocol requires me to scuttle as much of the wreckage as possible, in order to prevent our technology from falling into enemy hands.$BI'll give you my torch if you agree to help me complete this last duty. I don't want to think about what the Horde's goblin allies will do if these machines fall into their hands.

title: The Siege
obj_text:
Sergeant Hammerhill wants you to kill 6 Crypt Crawlers in the Sands of Nasam outside of Valiance Keep.
 Crypt Crawler slain (6)
desc_text: Well, well, well.  It's good to see Arlos bring out the big guns.$BDon't get me wrong - our lads are doing the best they can, but someone of your renown fighting alongside them could really turn the tides for us.  I'm not sure how much longer we can hold out against these undead Nerubians.$BWhat do you say you get out there and kill me some creepers?  Show these boys how it's done.

title: Ride to Taunka'le Village
obj_text: Speak with Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: <race>, the chieftain is making me wait... time that Taunka'le does not have!$BThere has been talk of your prowess. Rather than wait for Garrosh to send help, I ask you to go and help my people.$BTaunka'le village lies far to the northeast. Follow the road east out of the hold, turning north at the intersection. Not long after, you will come to another intersection. Follow the path east, passing south and then east of the great pools along the flood plains.$BSpeak with Sage Earth and Sky when you arrive.

title: Load'er Up!
obj_text:
Help Jenny make her way from the crash site to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village without losing all her cargo.
 Return Jenny to safety without losing cargo
desc_text: Have you seen the flying machines buzzing around? That's gnomish innovation at its finest.$BI've long waited to get my hands on some of their technology and a perfect opportunity has presented itself. One of their recon wings crashed in the Scalding Pools, in the southwest part of the Geyser Fields.$BBlow this whistle near one of the crashed machines and my trusty mule, Jenny will answer. She'll follow you and carry the salvage, but you must keep her safe. She'll begin to drop the cargo if attacked.

title: Scouting the Sinkholes
obj_text:
Abner Fizzletorque at Fizzcrank Airstrip wants you to use the Map of the Geyser Fields to mark the locations of the South Sinkhole, the Northwest Sinkhole, and the Northeast Sinkhole.
 Mark Location of South Sinkhole
 Mark Location of Northeast Sinkhole
 Mark Location of Northwest Sinkhole
desc_text: Fizzcrank sent out an aerial surveillance team to map the Nerubian sinkholes in the southern part of the Geyser Fields, but they haven't yet returned. I can't afford to wait any longer for their information, so I'm going to need someone to check out the sinkholes on foot.$BI understand the dangers involved, and I'll compensate you accordingly. Take this map with you and record the vital information about each of the sinkholes you encounter out there.

title: Emergency Supplies
obj_text: Collect 7 Gnomish Emergency Toolkits from the bodies of crashed Fizzcrank Recon Pilots and bring them to Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: Rifling through the dead gnome's possessions, you come across a small packet filled with rations, tools, and a handy roll of gnomish duct tape. The contents of these kits might prove helpful to Fezzix Geartwist when it comes time for him to reassemble the wreckage of the gnomish flying machines.$BBringing a few of these kits to Fezzix might just be worth a nice bonus.

title: What Are They Up To?
obj_text:
Investigate the area surrounding the Fizzcrank Pumping Station. Then, return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
 $BFizzcrank Pumping Station environs inspected.
desc_text: The gnomes have run into some trouble in the pools to the west. It serves them right as they have been fouling up the land with their so-called inventions.$BI want you to go out to their pumping station and observe what has befallen them. Return to me after.

title: Master the Storm
obj_text:
Defeat the Storm Tempest and then return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
 Storm mastered
desc_text: From what you describe, the creatures of metal should be easy to deal with. But first, you must master the storm.$BBehind me in the lodge is a totem. When you are ready, focus your will upon it and the storm will come. You must defeat the storm and in so doing take its essence into yourself.$BIf others are there, it is enough that you all work together to defeat it. Return to me after, <class>.

title: Breaking Through
obj_text:
Defeat Prince Valanar and his lieutenants, Vanthryn the Merciless and Luthion the Vile, then report to Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village.
 Prince Valanar slain
 Luthion the Vile slain
 Vanthryn the Merciless slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: On the lowest tier of the Temple City, there is a gray altar bathed in light. Step into it to gain entry to the dread necropolis Naxxanar.$BBe cautious, <name>. Prince Valanar will certainly be defended by his personal retainers, who will give their lives to keep you from ascending to the top level of the necropolis.$BYou must find your way through the necropolis to the prince's seat. If you fail to defeat him, <name>, I fear my people will never know the safety Icemist offers.

title: Death From Above
obj_text:
Sergeant Hammerhill wants you to use the Reinforced Net to help you slay 6 Scourged Flamespitters outside of Valiance Keep.
 Scourged Flamespitter slain (6)
desc_text: We're doing a good job of holding the front lines against these bugs.  Some of these cheeky fiends, however, can fly over the aforementioned front lines and are really beating down on our inner defenses.$BI've requisitioned reinforced fishing nets from our civilian ships.  If you've got a good enough throwing arm, they'll help you knock the enemy out of the sky.  Thin their numbers so that our defenses can hold the keep.

title: Patching Up
obj_text: Fezzix Geartwist at Taunka'le Village wants you to bring him 5 Steam Cured Hides.
desc_text: Remember all that gnomish duct tape you brought me?$BWell, I've found a use for it. The body of this flying machine is so banged up in places, that I'm going to need to reinforce it if I ever hope to fly.$BDorain over there has been telling me that the taunka use steam cured caribou leather for making watertight containers. Marsh caribou live all around the village and in the Flood Plains to the south. Get the best hides you can find and cure them over the steam vents in the Geyser Fields.

title: The Power of the Elements
obj_text:
Dorain Frosthoof at Taunka'le Village wants you to use the Windsoul Totem to gather the energy of 10 Steam Ragers.
 Energy collected (10)
desc_text: I kept trying to tell that silly goblin his machines are unreliable.$BBut the power of the elements; that is deep and abiding. When my apprenticeship is over, I will wield their full power. What I know now should be sufficient to help out our friend Fezzix, though.$BTake this windsoul totem and plant it near any of the steam ragers to the west of the village. The totem will gather up the energies of slain elementals. Return the fully charged totem to me and I'll do the rest.

title: Reading the Meters
obj_text:
Archmage Berinand at the Transitus Shield has asked you to collect the readings from his instruments in Coldarra.
 Nexus Geological Reading
 Southern Coldarra Reading
 Northern Coldarra Reading
 Western Coldarra Reading
desc_text: I had hoped that the Nexus' impact was limited to this region. Recently though, reports have flooded in from all over Azeroth suggesting that geologic instability is growing exponentially!$BI need the Nexus monitored regularly as I work to develop a solution.$BI've placed sensitive instruments around Coldarra, disguised as Malygos' scrying orbs. One lies in the trench near the Nexus, and three are hidden in the structures around the valley's perimeter. Visit each and return to me with their readings.

title: Weakness to Lightning
obj_text:
While weakened by the Power of the Storm, destroy any 15 of the robotic units, except the mechagnomes, in the greater pools area surrounding the Fizzcrank Pumping Station.$BAfterward, return to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
 Robots weakened and destroyed (15)
Weakness to Lightning: Quest Accept Force Cast (Provided)
desc_text: You now have the power of the storm within you. I will give you the means to focus that power and weaken the robots in the pools.$BTake this lightning rod. Use it against the robotic creations of the mechagnomes you find within the greater pools area to the west. Do not worry about using it against the mechagnomes themselves; Greatmother Taiga has other plans for them.$BOnce the robots are weakened by the power of the storm, dismantle them utterly!

title: Pernicious Evidence
obj_text: Return to Gerald Green in Farshire.
desc_text: The sacks of grain emanate the foul stench you've come to associate with the Plague.  This probably explains what happened to the footmen defending the mine.$BYou'd best bring word back to Gerald Green.

title: Plug the Sinkholes
obj_text:
Sergeant Hammerhill wants you to use the Incendiary Explosives to collapse the sinkholes southwest and northwest of Valiance Keep.
 Explosives set at southern sinkhole
 Explosives set at northern sinkhole
desc_text: The Scourge are showing no sign of letting up, <name>.  It's those blasted sinkholes; they connect to tunnels all the way to Icecrown for all we know.  Giant undead worms burrow under the ground to create them.$BIf there's something years of mining has taught me it's that without support beams, tunnels will cave in easily after an explosion.$BTake these explosives and place them at the entrance to the sinkholes up on the ridge beyond the beach to the west.  Come back after you've collapsed them.

title: Military?  What Military?
obj_text: Gerald Green in Farshire wants you to go into the mine to the north and find out what happened to the military detachment that was sent there.
desc_text: There's Scourge everywhere, <class>.  We've organized the farmers and miners into a militia, but this just won't cut it.$BThe one detachment of troops that Valiance Keep sent is defending the mine.  We haven't heard from them in days!$BIf you really wish to help us, why don't you go to the mine and see what's going on?  Maybe we can get them to send us some reinforcements.

title: Souls of the Decursed
obj_text:
Use The Greatmother's Soulcatcher to capture the souls of 10 Fizzcrank mechagnomes. Then, return to Greatmother Taiga at Taunka'le Village once you have done so.
 Gnome soul captured (10)
desc_text: The mechagnomes in the pools to the west are a great mystery to us. They appeared not long after the gnomes disappeared from their pumping station and its environs.$BThey are an unnatural danger and must be dealt with.$BTake this soulcatcher and use it on the remains of the mechagnomes to capture their souls. When you return, we will set them free so that we might find out what happened.

title: It's Time for Action
obj_text:
Gerald Green in Farshire wants you to kill 14 Plagued Scavengers.
 Plagued Scavenger slain (14)
desc_text: Well, <name>.  With the last of our military in Farshire dead or worse, we can do but one thing: fight these Scourge ourselves.$BWe have deployed militia in what remains of Farshire.  Without your help, they've but little hope of winning.  Go and lend them a hand.  Me and the lads will watch this path.  We can't let the Scourge break through!

title: The Sub-Chieftains
obj_text:
Defeat Twonky, ED-210, Max Blasto, and The Grinder, and then report back to Sage Earth and Sky at Taunka'le Village.
 Twonky slain
 ED-210 slain
 Max Blasto slain
 The Grinder slain
desc_text: It is known that Gearmaster Mechazod has four sub-chieftains that manage the robots in the pools.$BWe must put an end to them!$BOur longrunners and snow trackers say that if you were to turn the valves at the west point, north point, mid point and south point stations, each of his sub-chieftains would come quickly to prevent you from fouling their operations.$BThe stations are centered on the spinning lights in the pools surrounding the pumping station.$BHurry, <name>!

title: Fruits of Our Labor
obj_text:
Go to the mine in Farshire, obtain the Cart Release Key from Captain Jacobs and use it to release the ore cart.  Return to Gerald Green in Farshire when you've completed this task.
 Ore Cart released
desc_text: The Scourge just keeps coming... but we can't give up!  Listen, <name>.  Inside that mine there's a cart with the last of the ore the Alliance is going to see on this side of the continent for a long time.$BThe problem is the cart release is locked.  When the military went in there, Captain Jacobs commandeered all the important equipment, including the cart release key.$BThe plague that affected the soldiers in the mine must also have affected Jacobs.  Get the key from him and salvage the ore.

title: Postponing the Inevitable
obj_text:
Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to use the Interdimensional Refabricator near the rift in the Nexus.
 Interdimensional Rift Stalled
desc_text: I've determined the cause of the instability!$BAzeroth's ley lines are being redirected to the Nexus. It's fascinating! If only I could spend the remainder of my days studying this anomaly....$BSadly, I must focus on the immediate crisis. The influx of arcane energies is tearing a rift between dimensions.$BDeep inside the Nexus, the fabric of our universe is being weakened. I cannot stop it, but I've discovered a way to slow it down.$BTake this into the Nexus and activate it near the forming rift.

title: Reference Material
obj_text: Jeremiah Hawning wants you to retrieve the book "Fields, Factories and Workshops" from the burning building next to the mine in Farshire.
desc_text: I was in charge of the harvest golems - an important job until the Scourge destroyed most of our farmlands.  I've an idea that would make the golems useful again, however.$BI think I can rewire the harvest collectors so they'll give us a hand fighting the Scourge.$BI'm not an expert at this just yet, so I'm going to need my manual.  The problem is, I left it at the workshop... which happens to be that burning building next to the mine.  Think you could go salvage it?

title: Cleaning Up the Pools
obj_text: Collect 15 Fizzcrank Spare Parts and deliver them to Iron Eyes at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: <A single tear rolls down the face of Iron Eyes.>$BI have heard that you are heading back into the pools to the west. I have something for you to do while you are out there, <race>.$BThe gnomes, who care nothing for the land, have polluted it with their machinery. I want you to pick up any spare parts that you come across.$BReturn them to me here. I will see to it that they are properly disposed of before we leave this place for good.

title: Lefty Loosey, Righty Tighty
obj_text:
Dismantle Twonky, ED-210, Max Blasto, and The Grinder, and then report back to Jinky Wingnut at Fizzcrank Airstrip.
 Twonky slain
 ED-210 slain
 Max Blasto slain
 The Grinder slain
desc_text: Okay, I think we're ready for the penultimate assault... before you can bring down Mechazod, you're going to have to dismantle his lieutenants first!$BYou'll find Twonky, ED-210, Max Blasto, and The Grinder at the West Point, North Point, Mid Point and South Point stations, respectively.$BTo get them to show up, just turn the valves at the stations to mess up whatever they're trying to do out there. You can't miss the places, they all have spinning lights.

title: Hellscream's Champion
obj_text: Seek out Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village.
desc_text: You have faced all challenges that have been set before you and squashed them beneath your boot heel. It is because of you, <name>, that the Horde is now firmly entrenched in Northrend.$BBut our work has only just begun. We must march to Icecrown and we must tear down its walls!$BYour next assignment begins to the east, at Taunka'le Village. Our taunka allies are in dire straits and require aid. Secure transport from the stable master, Durkot Wolfbrother, and seek out Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le.

title: Quickening
obj_text: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to enter the Nexus and collect 5 Arcane Splinters from Crystalline Protectors.
desc_text: Though we may be witnessing the end of our existence, I can't help but marvel. I've learned more in my short time here than in decades of studies.$BThese Ancients are being exposed to incredible levels of arcane energy. It's literally transforming them into something... different.$BI'm confident that there's another stage in their metamorphosis. I'll need you to actually enter the Nexus, <name>, and find me some evidence of their final state.$BDo be careful....

title: Take No Chances
obj_text:
Wendy Darren wants you to use Wendy's Torch to burn 8 sacks of Farshire Grain.
 Farshire Grain burnt (8)
desc_text: I heard what you told Gerald and I don't like it one bit.  If cultists managed to poison the grain in the mines with their foul plague, they could've easily done the same with the grain outside.$BWe don't have time to sort the good grain from the bad.  We must act quickly and burn it all.$BTake this torch and set fire to any sacks of grain you find out here.  It would be a tragedy if we survived this attack only to succumb to the plague afterwards.

title: Nuts for Berries
obj_text: Librarian Serrah in the Transitus Shield wants you to gather 10 Frostberries from the Frostberry Bushes in Coldarra.
desc_text: Oh! What a relief it is to see a fresh face. I was beginning to feel we had been forsaken.$BOur supply lines were cut off days ago, and things have been looking - well, bleak. To be honest, this was a suicide mission to begin with if you ask me.$BMaybe I'm simply not cut out for all of this violence - to say nothing of the bitter cold! I'd much rather be back in Dalaran studying ancient texts.$BTo the point, our food supply is nearly spent. Please, gather what you can and bring it to me.

title: Basic Training
obj_text:
Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to slay 10 Coldarra Spellweavers.
 Coldarra Spellweaver slain (10)
desc_text: This is war, mortal, and we are the tip of the spear.$BYour little spats over land or currency pale in comparison to this conflict. We face the aspect Malygos and his entire blue dragonflight. All you need to know is that if he is victorious, this world shall be no more.$BWe are but few here, and we fly against many. Our deaths are all but a certainty, and our ultimate success lies in merely delaying our enemy.$BGo now. Busy yourself while I decide what to do with you.

title: Keep the Secret Safe
obj_text: Librarian Serrah in the Transitus Shield needs you to kill Arcane Serpents near the Nexus and collect 5 Nexus Mana Essences from them.
desc_text: Our existence here depends entirely upon staying hidden. Should the shield fail, even for a moment, Malygos' minions would have us.$BOne of my responsibilities is to rejuvenate the warmages' mana levels so their focus doesn't falter. With our supply lines lost, I've been forced to improvise.$BI could use your help, <name>.$BVery near the Nexus, Arcane Serpents feast on the abundant magical energies. Once defeated, they will yield a mana essence that I can make use of.

title: Word on the Street
