obj_text: Find Leryssa at the inn in Valiance Keep
desc_text: Hey, <name>.  There's a girl in the inn that's asking about you.  Her name's Leryssa.$BI don't think she knows you, but she said she needed your help.  She sounded really desperate.

title: Drake Hunt
obj_text:
Raelorasz wants you to use Raelorasz's Spear to subdue a Nexus Drake Hatchling and return it to him at the Transitus Shield.
 Captured Nexus Drake
desc_text: The blues have begun to cover their drakes in mysterious runes. I must discover their significance.$B<Raelorasz pokes his hand with a spear and coats the tip with his blood.>$BTake this and use it on one of them. Wait for it to become subdued, then bring it here to me before it expires.$BTheir hatchlings feed around the northwest edge of the valley.

title: Farshire
obj_text: Travel to Farshire in Borean Tundra and speak to Gerald Green.
desc_text: My lads should be able to take it from here, <name>.  Valiance Keep is built to take a beating far worse than this.  I worry about our farmlands and mine in Farshire, however.$BWe sent a full detachment to protect our mining operations right before the invasion - they should be able to defend the civilians.$BGerald Green's in charge of the villagers there. There's a passage out of the northern wall out of Valiance Keep; it'll take you straight to him.  See what you can do to help them.

title: Cultists Among Us
obj_text: Speak to Captain "Lefty" Lugsail above the Stormbreaker in Valiance Keep.
desc_text: This altar bears all the markings of the Cult of the Damned.  It appears fanatics from the mainland have made it into Northrend.  It might be prudent to notify the captain of the ship.$BPerhaps he is to be found above deck.

title: Hatching a Plan
obj_text:
Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to kill Coldarra Wyrmkin and use their frozen axes to break 5 blue dragon eggs.
 Dragon Eggs destroyed (5)
desc_text: Our goals here are simple. We are to remain hidden from Malygos, observe his brood, and thwart his efforts wherever possible. To that end, I have a task for you.$BThe blues are laying their eggs at the base of the Nexus. Exposure to so much arcane energy will surely make them hatch sooner, and there's no telling what effect it will have on their spawn.$BI don't intend to find out. Slay the local wyrmkin and use their frozen axes to break the eggs.

title: Cowards and Fools
obj_text: Speak to Ataika in Kaskala, northeast of Valiance Keep.
desc_text: Listen, <name>.  No offense, but the operation they put Thassarian in charge of was pure suicide.$BA handful of our men were to launch an attack on the biggest Scourge presence in the area.  Call me crazy, but storming a Scourge ziggurat outside a plagued Nerubian city with a dozen men ain't my idea of fun.$BIf you're still interested in finding Thassarian, we were supposed to arrange for passage east with a tuskarr by the name of Ataika in Kaskala to the northeast.  Good luck with your fool's errand.

title: Secrets of the Ancients
obj_text: Archmage Berinand in the Transitus Shield wants you to collect 3 Glacial Splinters and 3 Magic-Bound Splinters from the Ancients in Coldarra.
desc_text: It's become clear that the instability in the region has had an effect on its indigenous creatures.$BI've taken a particular interest in the Glacial Ancients and their recent adaptations. I suspect that their transformation into these 'Magic-bound' Ancients may hold clues to our predicament here.$BFor my studies, I'll need samples from both. Do hurry....

title: Keristrasza
obj_text: Keristrasza wants you to speak to her when you are ready to prepare for a confrontation with Malygos.$BIf you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
desc_text: I am... free?$BI was destined to spend an eternity roaming an empty abyss, and now am saved? You cannot fathom my gratitude, mortal.$BWhen I refused to bend to his will Malygos bound me to that prison, then shattered it and scattered the pieces. Should I live one hundred of your lifetimes, I shall not forget this kindness.$BPerhaps, in time, I will find ways to repay you. For now, though, we must focus our attention on Malygos. I am weak, and there is much to be done.$BI need your help, <name>.

title: Drake Hunt
obj_text:
Raelorasz wants you to use the Blood-tipped Spear to subdue a Nexus Drake Hatchling and return it to him at the Transitus Shield.
 Captured Nexus Drake
desc_text: I need more drake hatchlings to continue researching the runes covering their bodies.$BThey can be found around the northwest edge of the valley....$B<Raelorasz pokes his hand with a spear and coats the tip with his blood.>$BTake this and use it on one of them. Wait for it to become subdued, then bring it here to me before it expires.
[PH]Quest to close this questline - summon and kill a mature drake (Elite?) - Fight a drake in the dungeon?

title: Cracking the Code
obj_text: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to get the Azure Codex from Inquisitor Caleras and collect 3 Shimmering Runes from his Coldarra Spellbinders.
desc_text: I sense a distinct peculiarity in the drakes here but the meaning of the runes that cover their bodies still eludes me.$BWithout a codex, it will take more time than we can afford for me to interpret them.$BNot far from here is a Kirin Tor traitor, Caleras, who is likely to have a copy of the tome I require. His underlings hold the runes I will need for my translation.$BHurry, mortal. Malygos gains strength with every passing moment.

title: Weapons for Farshire
obj_text: Return to Gerald Green in Farshire.
desc_text: Farshire is overrun and all that Gerald can think of is to get me my ore shipment?  I swear that man has as much heart as any of our soldiers on the frontlines.$BWe cannot let the civilians lose their lands if they're willing to fight for them.  We might not have the troops to spare, but we can send them weapons.$BThese were earmarked for new recruits, but I'll be able to cover those with the ore you've brought me.  Send word to Gerald that weapons are on the way.

title: Finding the Phylactery
obj_text: Go to Death's Stand and ride Dusk to the location of Tanathal's Phylactery.  Obtain it and bring it back to Thassarian inside the Wailing Ziggurat.
desc_text: No time for small talk, <name>.  I was sent on what was to be a suicide mission to take this ziggurat.  I've accomplished my duty as a soldier, now is the time to get some answers.$BThis lich has knowledge I seek, yet I cannot inflict pain to his physical body to obtain that knowledge.$BThe lich stored his soul in a phylactery, and while it remains hidden, I won't be able to pry the information from him.$BReturn to the camp and take my horse, Dusk, she will lead you to the phylactery.  Bring it to me.

title: Bait and Switch
obj_text: Keristrasza has asked you to collect 10 Crystalized Mana Shards from around Coldarra.$BIf you lose your Augmented Arcane Prison, speak to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
desc_text: During my captivity I was able to learn much about Malygos. Fate now allows us to use this knowledge against him.$BThere is a great blue dragon, Saragosa, who circles high above the Nexus. She serves both as the aspect's guardian and as his consort. If any serious threats arise, she alerts her master of the danger.$BI suffered greatly at the hand of Saragosa during my captivity, and now her time to die has come. First, however, we must fashion the perfect bait....

title: Puzzling...
obj_text: ring the Scintillating Fragment to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
desc_text: Something about this scrap of metal prevents you from casting it aside.$BPerhaps Raelorasz might be able to shed some light on its purpose.

title: Call to Arms!
obj_text:
Go to the town hall building in Farshire and ring the bell inside of it.
 Farshire Bell Rung
desc_text: Farshire has a fighting chance now, <name>.  That's all we could've asked for and you've made it possible.$BAll we need now is a rallying point.  I'll have my men deliver the weapons to our town hall.  Go and ring the town hall bell so any survivors know to rally there.$BIt's time to show the Scourge what we're made of.

title: One Last Delivery
obj_text: Deliver the Crate of Farshire Ore to Hilda Stoneforge in Valiance Keep.
desc_text: That's it then.  With the last of the ore you salvaged we now have enough to send to Valiance Keep.$BIf Farshire is wiped off the face of Azeroth, then at least let us be remembered as the first ones to defend our land and the last ones to give up.$BTake this ore to Hilda Stoneforge - she is a good friend of mine.  Tell her to make some good weapons with this ore.  We'll need plenty of them in the days to come.

title: The Tides Turn
obj_text:
Elder Muahit wants you to kill Heigarr the Horrible in Njord's Breath Bay.
 Heigarr the Horrible slain
desc_text: The spirits have heard our cry for help, <name>.  It's a sign that Kaskala might yet be saved.$BTake advantage of the confusion the weather has created and slay the Kvaldir leader.  Your actions will sway the battle in our favor, I am sure of it.

title: Prisoner of War
obj_text:
Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to enter the Nexus and release Keristrasza.
 $BKeristrasza Laid to Rest

 Keristrasza
 Keristrasza - Heroic
$B

 Keristrasza - Mythic
 Keristrasza - Ascended
desc_text: Malygos has taken Keristrasza to serve as his consort!? Unthinkable!$BShe'll never cooperate willingly, but Malygos is a powerful aspect, and will eventually bend her will.$BThis cannot come to pass, <name>. I refuse to allow her to suffer this indignity.$BYou must enter the Nexus and do whatever is required to spare her this fate.

title: The Cell
obj_text: Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield wants you to obtain the Prison Casing from General Cerulean and the Energy Core from Warbringer Goredrak.
desc_text: You've discovered a fragment of a special prison, <name>.$BMalygos' minions use similar prisons to hold their captured mages and other arcane entities, but this prison was constructed to hold something... stronger.$BIn hopes that the enemy of our enemy will prove to be a friend, you must search for the prison's remaining fragments.$BThey are likely to be in the possession of Malygos' most trusted underlings.

title: Springing the Trap
obj_text:
Raelorasz wants you to use Raelorasz' Spark at the signal fire in Coldarra.
 Malygos Lured
desc_text: We owe this opportunity in great part to your efforts, <name>.$BIt is only fitting that you initiate the attack on Malygos.$BTake this spark and use it to light the signal fire northwest of the Nexus. Keristrasza will direct you from there.

title: Saragosa's End
obj_text: Keristrasza wants you to use the Power Focus to lure Saragosa, and then defeat her.
desc_text: Using the mana crystals you provided, I have created this Power Focus.$BSaragosa is a glutton. She will be unable to resist its lure. Inside it lie magics that will greatly diminish her power. Let us hope she does not see through my ruse....$BPrepare yourself, <name>, and speak to me again when you are ready to face Saragosa.

title: To Bor'gorok Outpost, Quickly!
obj_text: Speak with Spirit Talker Snarlfang at Bor'gorok Outpost.
desc_text: Did you feel it?$B<Sauranok momentarily clutches his chest in confusion. His hand comes away trailing red-hot steam.>$BSomething terrible has happened to my old friend, Farseer Grimwalker. I just sensed it.$BHe had a pupil that he took with him when he went north. They were going to help the overlord establish an outpost on the edge of Sholazar Basin.$BHer name is Snarlfang. She is a spirit talker.$BPerhaps she will know what happened. Or, at least, she can help you to find out.

title: Cruelty of the Kvaldir
obj_text: Speak to Karuk about the Captured Tuskarr Prisoner.
desc_text: I thank you for saving me, <name>.  The kvaldir are animals!$BThey made us fight the other prisoners.  It would've been more merciful to just kill us all.$BThe youngling Karuk is still alive -- I noticed him arrive here.  Tell him his father fought until the end.

title: A Diplomatic Mission
obj_text: Speak to Karuk at Riplash Strand, southwest of Valiance Keep.
desc_text: I see that you are very eager to help, <name>.  You didn't come all the way to Northrend to stay holed up in a city!  I've just the task for you... something that'll take you far away from here.$BWe've long sought to gain the favor of the tuskarr native to Northrend.  Recently a young tuskarr came to us seeking help, something we couldn't offer at the time.$BNow that you're around, maybe you can lend him a hand.  Look for Karuk near the Riplash Strand, southwest of here, and see what you can do to help.

title: Against Nifflevar
obj_text:
Ranger Captain Areiel wants you to go to Nifflevar and slay 5 Dragonflayer Warriors, 4 Dragonflayer Rune-Seers and 4 Dragonflayer Hunting Hounds.
 Dragonflayer Warrior slain (5)
 Dragonflayer Rune-Seer slain (4)
 Dragonflayer Hunting Hound slain (4)
desc_text: We await reinforcements from Vengeance Landing to move against Nifflevar.  If we were to capture it earlier, though, it would provide us with a great advantage over the Alliance.$BHead into town and see if you can put a dent in their numbers.

title: Veehja's Revenge
obj_text:
Veehja at the Shrine of Scales wants you to slay 6 Skadir Mariners, 3 Skadir Mistweavers and 2 Skadir Runecasters.
 Skadir Mariner slain (6)
 Skadir Mistweaver slain (3)
 Skadir Runecaster slain (2)
desc_text: We share a common enemy today, <race>!  My people have been wiped out by these Kvaldir... my city has been all but destroyed.  It is time for exacting revenge!$BIn return for my help, I'd like you to slay the barbaric monsters that defile Riplash.  You will be well rewarded, <class>.

title: Repurposed Technology
obj_text:
Jeremiah Hawning at Farshire wants you to destroy 5 Harvest Collectors and then use Jeremiah's Tools to rewire them.
 Harvest Collector Rewired (5)
desc_text: Ok, I've got it!  The rewiring is a little complicated, but nothing a clever <class> like you can't handle.$BTake my tools and put some of the harvest collectors out of commission.  Once they're down use the tools to plug all the red wires into the blue sockets.  That'll make them go into self-defense mode.  Hurry, <name>.  Before long there won't be anything left to save.

title: Help for Camp Winterhoof
obj_text: Speak with Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
desc_text: I am Longrunner Nanik of the Taunka, sent by the chieftain of Camp Winterhoof to seek out allies in the fight against the vrykul. They mass to the west and south of our village, and though we slay 10 of them for every one of our dead, we cannot hold.$BApothecary Scyllis has promised to send brave <class>s northwest to our aid. Will you help my people fend off the vrykul assaults?$BFollow the road far to the northwest, across the river, and into the foothills of the mountains to reach Camp Winterhoof.

title: Adding Injury to Insult
obj_text:
Read the Vrykul Insult to Bjorn Halgurdsson in Baleheim, then lead him back to Lydell's Ambush and help slay him.
 Bjorn Halgurdsson insulted
 Bjorn Halgurdsson defeated
desc_text: The vrykul are being clever about this.  Fortunately I've a trick up my sleeve.$BThis leader of theirs, Bjorn, is a real hothead.  We've pieced together enough of their language to fashion what we think is a good insult.  Something involving his mother and large barnyard animals... we're not quite sure.$BTake this piece of paper and read it to him.  Once he starts chasing you, lure him back here.  We'll make sure he doesn't make it out alive.

title: Monitoring the Rift: Winterfin Cavern
obj_text:
Librarian Garren at Amber Ledge wants you to use the Arcanometer at Winterfin Caverns.
 Winterfin Cavern Reading Taken
desc_text: I need to compile my notes and prepare a presentation for my colleagues in Dalaran.$BWhile I do, I must ask that you visit the Winterfin Cavern to the north. You must use the Arcanometer while standing in the mouth of the cavern.$BReturn to me at once when you have the data. My documentation will be incomplete without it.

title: Omar's Test Quest
obj_text:
Get Omar some cloth
 Omar the Test Dragon slain (3)
desc_text: An honorable person gives me cloth

title: Mustering the Reds
obj_text: Keristrasza has asked you to bring her to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield.
desc_text: Malygos is certainly aware that something is amiss.$BI know him. His focus is fragmented. I am confident that I can lure him from the safety of his realm when he learns what has become of his precious Saragosa.$BTake me to Raelorasz at once, <name>. He must rouse every dragon he commands to face Malygos.

title: Have They No Shame?
obj_text: Librarian Serrah wants you to enter the Nexus and recover Berinand's Research.
desc_text: Archmage Berinand is the Kirin Tor's foremost authority on Malygos. He's spent his life studying the aspect and his behaviors.$BRecently, he loaned me his research on the Arcanomicron, some sort of map that Malygos is trying to assemble. I made the mistake of discussing it with a group of Horde adventurers while they were restocking their goods here - and now it's gone!$BIt must have been them, <class>. Please, follow them into the nexus and recover the book before Berinand comes to recover it.

title: Navigation Charts (Deprecated)
obj_text: Obtain the missing parts of the Skadir Navigational Chart and bring it to Karuk in Riplash Stand.
desc_text: You've uncovered the first part of a navigation chart drawn on flayed dragonskin.  If you could complete it you'd be able to find the kvaldir's future plans of attack.$BOther mariners in Riplash might have the missing charts on them.  Karuk would be interested in the information they contain.

title: Deprecated: Magical Augmentation
obj_text:
Description
Yes,let's enhance my magical properties.  That makes sense.  I was,after all,a wizard in life.$BJust because one's physical vessel is a weapon does not automatically make someone a brute.$BI will need you to collect some materials.
                Rewards
You will receive: 7 59  if completed at level 80                    Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
12,650 experience$B
250 reputation with The Violet Eye$B

Related

title: Disarmament
obj_text: Defender Mordun wants you to enter Utgarde Keep and steal 5 Vrykul Weapons
desc_text: Take it from me, <lad/lass>, them vrykul weapons be downright nasty!$BI've felt their edge personally, and there be somethin' unnatural about 'em. Deceptively well-balanced, wickedly sharp - just plain deadly.$BGet into their stronghold and if nuthin' else, pilfer some o' them weapons! Mebbe we can learn us a thing 'er two about 'em, mebbe not.$BBottom line - the fewer axes they be swingin' around, the better.

title: Disarmament
obj_text: Dark Ranger Marrah wants you to steal 5 Vrykul Weapons from Utgarde Keep and bring them to High Executor Anselm in Vengeance Landing.
desc_text: We must discover the secret to these savages' weapons!$BIf you'd have seen how easily they cut through my companions, you'd understand my sense of urgency. Just have a look at their forge if you doubt my words.$BScour the place. Gather all of their arms that you can carry and bring them to Anselm for his inspection.$BDo not fail us, <class>. Every weapon you are able to bring out of this place is one less that we must face in the field.

title: Deprecated: Keanna's Will
obj_text:
The Shattered Blade you found in Karazhan wants you to ask Koren to repair it.  You'll also need to attain Honored reputation with the Violet Eye to complete this quest.
 The Violet Eye (Honored)

I humbly request your aid in thinning their numbers. Journey south and slay the Bloodmaul brutes, drudgers, brewmasters, and dire wolves that stalk the land. Doing so will weaken the Bloodmaul's stranglehold and make the land safer for all.

I beseech you, venture to Jagged Ridge and cull their numbers. Slay the savage direwolves and bloodthirsty bloodletters that ravage the land. Doing so will restore peace and quiet to this place.

Slay their soldiers, overlords, and technicians to disrupt their dark plans.

This mythical beast is said to reside in the hallowed halls of the prophet, Medivh.$BMake haste!

title: The Fall of the Vekh'nir
obj_text:
Slay Vekh'nir in Trogma's Claim to remove the threat of the Vekh'nir voidcaller clan.
 Vekh'nir Stormcaller slain (5)
 Vekh'nir Dreadhawk slain (5)
 Vekh'nir Keeneye slain (5)
desc_text: <name>, the savage gronn of Blade's Edge Mountain have long terrorized the indigenous ogres and orcs alike. But a new threat has emerged in Trogma's Claim - the Vekh'nir, a clan of arakkoa outcasts wielding deadly void magic.$BTheir shadowy magic allows them to stalk their prey undetected, until it is too late. Many innocents have already fallen to their cowardly ambushes. But today we will be the hunters, not the hunted. Help me purge these void creatures from Trogma's Claim so that orcs and ogres alike may live without fear of the Vekh'nir's curses. Slay their warriors, their scouts, and their mystics alike - only then will Trogma's Claim be safe once more.

title: Breaking the Bash'ir
obj_text:
Slay Bash'ir Arcanists, Bash'ir Spell-Thieves and Bash'ir Raiders at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains.
 Bash'ir Arcanist slain (8)
 Bash'ir Spell-Thief slain (8)
 Bash'ir Raider slain (8)
desc_text: <name>, the sinister ethereals of Bash'ir Landing have become a scourge across Blade's Edge Mountains. Their raiders attack caravans, their arcanists steal powerful relics, and their spell-thieves siphon magic from the land. I need someone to break their power so that other innocents do not suffer their depravations. Venture to Bash'ir Landing and slay eight of their raiders, spell-thieves and arcanists each. Show them there is a steep price for their villainy. This will not end their threat completely, but it will give them pause and provide some measure of justice. I know you are up to the task, champion. Make haste, before they can inflict more harm.

title: Extinguishing the Flames
obj_text:
Slay Searing Elementals, Scorch Imps and Scalded Basilisks around Skald in Blade's Edge Mountains.
 Searing Elemental slain (6)
 Scorch Imp slain (6)
 Scalded Basilisk slain (6)
desc_text: <name>, the elementals and fire-twisted creatures around Skald have become dangerously aggressive as of late. Their flames threaten to consume our outpost. I need someone to thin their numbers and remind them this is our territory. Seek out the Searing Elementals, Scorch Imps and Scalded Basilisks infesting the area and extinguish six of each. Show them that Skald will not tolerate their fiery intrusion. With fewer fire creatures skulking about, our outpost will be safer. I know I can count on a champion like yourself to get the job done, hero. Make haste - we cannot afford to let their numbers grow.

title: The Vials of Eternity
obj_text: Soridormi at Caverns of Time wants you to retrieve Vashj's Vial Remnant from Lady Vashj at Coilfang Reservoir and Kael's Vial Remnant from Kael'thas Sunstrider at Tempest Keep.
desc_text: Seven vials were drawn from the Well of Eternity by Illidan.  He poured three into the lake on top of Mount Hyjal and a second Well of Eternity was created.  For years the rest were believed lost.$BWith the opening of the Dark Portal, we've come to know that he gave one each to his lieutenants Kael'thas and Vashj.  Retrieve what remains of them; we will need them as foci to open a gateway to any events tied to Mount Hyjal, recent or ancient.  The outcome of the Battle of Mount Hyjal must be preserved.

title: End of the Ruuan'ok Reign
obj_text:
Slay Ruuan'ok Skyfurys, Ravenguards, Cloudgazers and Ruuan Weald Basilisks in Ruuan Weald.
 Ruuan'ok Skyfury slain (3)
 Ruuan'ok Ravenguard slain (3)
 Ruuan Weald Basilisk slain (3)
 Ruuan'ok Cloudgazer slain (3)
desc_text: <name>, the vile Ruuan'ok hold sway over the creatures of Ruuan Weald, forcing them to do their bidding through dark magic. Their matriarchs lead grim rituals, their ravenguards enforce their will, and their cloudgazers spy from afar. We must end their corrupt rule if there is to be peace. Venture into the weald and slay three of their skyfurys, ravenguards and cloudgazers each. Also slay three of their enthralled basilisks to free them from the Ruuan'ok's control. It will be dangerous, but I know you have the strength to succeed. Go now and deliver the Ruuan Weald from their wicked grasp!

title: The Fall of the Vekh'nir
obj_text:
Slay Vekh'nir Arakkoa at Vekhaar Stand.
 Vekh'nir Stormcaller slain (5)
 Vekh'nir Dreadhawk slain (5)
 Vekh'nir Keeneye slain (5)
desc_text: The arakkoa of the Vekh'nir clan have become drunk with power, using dark magics to subjugate the other clans. Their stromcallers bend the elements, while deathhawks and keeneyes terrorize from above. I ask that you help topple them from their perch. Venture to Vekhaar Stand and slay their stromcallers, deathhawks, and keeneyes. Doing so will weaken their forces and break their hold over the region.

title: Recipe for Disaster
obj_text: Collect Dire Wolf Fangs and Bloodmaul Distillation Manuals in Blade's Edge Mountains.
desc_text: I have troubling news - the Bloodmaul ogres plan to begin mass production of a vile brew using dire wolf fangs as an ingredient. This concoction is sure to increase their strength and viciousness. I need you to hamper their efforts. Venture into Blade's Edge Mountains, slay dire wolves and collect their fangs. Also, infiltrate Bloodmaul camps and confiscate their distillation manuals. Doing so will disrupt their operations and prevent further harm. Can you handle this task?

title: Ale Raid on the Ogres
obj_text: Steal ale from the ogres of Blade's Edge.
desc_text: Ogres of Blade's Edge are planning a grand feast tonight. Their ale stores are overflowing with drink. I have a proposition for you - let us steal their ale right from under their noses! Find their empty steins and kegs around their outpost, and fill them from the ogre's reserves. According to our reports, they're storing most of the newly made ale in a large keg somewhere in the outpost.$BReturn with the pilfered ale, and we'll have drink aplenty for the village. What say you? Will you conduct this daring ale raid?

title: Breaking the Boulder'mok
obj_text:
Slay Boulder'mok Brutes and Shamans in Boulder'mok.
 Boulder'mok Brute slain (6)
 Boulder'mok Shaman slain (4)
desc_text: <name>, the savage Boulder'mok ogres of this region have become increasingly hostile, attacking travelers and settlements alike in their brutal raids. I need someone to break their power and remind them that such actions will not be tolerated. Venture into their camps and slay six of their ferocious brutes as well as four of their barbaric shamans. Show them that there are consequences for their savagery. This will not end their threat for good, but it will make them think twice before mindlessly attacking innocents again. I know you have the fortitude to take on this task. Go now, and teach the Boulder'mok a lesson in civility they won't soon forget!

title: Cutting Down Raven's Wood
obj_text:
Slay Raven's Wood Leafbeards, Dire Ravens and Raven's Wood Stonebark in Grishnath.
 Raven's Wood Stonebark slain
 Dire Raven slain (6)
 Raven's Wood Leafbeard slain (6)
desc_text: The forest of Raven's Wood in Grishnath has become dark and hostile, hero. Ancient treants and vicious ravens alike attack any who wander beneath its eaves. I believe dark magics are at work, twisting the creatures against their nature. Please, venture into the wood and slay 6 of the corrupted Leafbeard treants and six of the frenzied Dire Ravens. Also, seek out and destroy the elder treant Stonebark - he must be the source of the forest's blight. With his destruction, balance may be restored to Raven's Wood. Tread wary, hero - the creatures may appear benign but will show no mercy. For the good of the land, the forest must be cleansed.

title: Vekh’nir Egg Hunt
obj_text: Gather Vekh'nir Eggs in Trogma's Claim to prevent the rebirth of the sinister arakkoa clan.
desc_text: <name>, our campaign against the Vekh'nir has gone well - their numbers are dwindling in Trogma's Claim. But a new problem has emerged - their nests still dot the mountains, each filled with dozens of eggs. If left alone, they will replenish their ranks in time. I cannot allow that. Venture into their nesting grounds, hero, and gather their eggs. Bring them to me so I may properly dispose of them. The Vekh'nir must not rise again in Trogma's Claim. tread wary, hero, the remaining Vekh'nir will defend their nests fiercely. But this is a task that must be done for the safety of all.

title: Vanquishing the Grishna Enigma
obj_text:
Investigate Grishnath and slay Grishna arakoa to thwart their impending attack on Outland.
 Grishna Scorncrow slain (6)
 Grishna Harbinger slain (6)
 Grishna Falconwing slain (6)
desc_text: The Grishna arakoa of Blade's Edge Mountains have long been a threat to the innocent creatures of Outland. But lately, their attacks have grown bolder and more brutal than ever before. Scouts report that the Grishna are gathering dark magics and preparing for an all-out assault. These sinister bird-men must be stopped before their evil spreads across the land!$BHero, the people of Outland need your help. Journey to the Grishna village of Grishnath and put an end to their vile plans. Seek out their warriors - the Grishna Scorncrows, Harbingers and more - and vanquish them before they can carry out their attack. The survival of Outland depends on you, champion. Do not let the darkness prevail!

title: Scavenging Lost Arrows
obj_text: Recover Wyrmcult Lost Arrows in Ruuan Weald for later analysis.
desc_text: <name>, the wyrmcult of Ruuan Weald are a constant threat, their deadly arrows flying from the shadows. But many of their ambushes are thwarted by brave defenders, and the cultists are forced to flee, abandoning their weapons. Venture into the weald and recover 8 of their lost arrows. Do not engage the cultists directly - discretion is the better part of valor. With these recovered arrows, we can analyze their enchantments and devise stronger protections. The wyrmcult will rue the day they provoked our wrath. Make haste - the weald is vast and scattered with ruins where the arrows may lie.

title: Massacre at Forge Camp: Terror
obj_text:
Stop an impending massacre by the demons of Forge Camp: Terror.
 Abyssal Flamebringer slain (6)
 Vile Fire-Soul slain (3)
 Fear Fiend slain (6)
desc_text: Dark rumors swirl around the vile Forge Camp: Terror. Our scouts report the demons that dwell there are planning a murderous rampage against the innocent creatures of Blade's Edge. These cruel beings live only to sow chaos and destruction. They cannot be allowed to carry out their heinous designs!$BHero, your skills are needed to stop this massacre before it begins. Journey to Forge Camp: Terror and eliminate their forces - the Abyssal Flamebringers, Vile Fire-Souls and Fear Fiends. Show no mercy to these wicked demons. The good people of Outland are depending on you to halt this impending bloodshed. May your blades deal swift justice!

title: Crystal Creatures
obj_text:
Slay Vortex Pinnacle creatures mutated by crystals.
 Shard-Hide Boar slain (8)
 Aether Ray slain (8)
 Apexis Flayer slain (8)
desc_text: Strange crystalline anomalies have been spotted amongst the creatures of the Vortex Pinnacle. Local wildlife like the Shard-Hide Boars, Aether Rays and Apexis Flayers appear infused with shimmering prismatic crystals. The source of these mutations must be determined before the phenomenon escalates.

title: From Forest to Forge
obj_text: Gather Wooden Logs in Raven's Wood for the healers of Sylvanaar.
desc_text: <name> the botanists of Sylvanaar are in desperate need of materials to concoct remedies and potions for the wounded. With the Grishna threat growing daily, our healers' supplies are running low. I humbly request that you venture into Grishnath and collect Wooden Logs from the ancient trees that grow there.

title: Securing Forge Camp: Wrath
obj_text:
Assault Forge Camp: Wrath and eliminate their remaining forces while the camp is vulnerable.
 Wrath Hound slain (6)
 Furnace Guard slain (6)
 Wrath Corruptor slain (3)
 Wrath Speaker slain (2)
desc_text: Forge Camp: Wrath has long served as a bastion of Legion power in Blade's Edge Mountains. Now, our scouts report the camp is vulnerable to attack, with many veteran warriors called away to battle elsewhere. This is our chance to deal a crushing blow to the Legion and remove their foothold from this region.$BHero, lead the charge against Forge Camp: Wrath. Slay their remaining defenders - the Wrath Hounds, Furnace Guards, Corruptors and Speakers. With the camp cleared, we can claim it for our own forces. This is a vital opportunity we cannot waste. Ride out now and secure victory for the innocent peoples of Outland!

title: Legacy of the Grishna
obj_text: Discover lost Grishna relics in the ruins of Grishnath for researching their origins.
desc_text: The arakoa of Grishnath are a proud and ancient race, but their history is shrouded in mystery. Scholars believe ancient relics hidden amongst the ruins of their village could unlock the secrets of the Grishna past. This knowledge could prove invaluable against our feathered foe.

title: Crystal Collector
obj_text: Gather Crystals in Singing Ridge for elemental research.
desc_text: <name>, the ancient crystals that dot the cliffs of Singing Ridge resonate with powerful elemental magic. I am studying ways to harness their energies for good, but require samples to continue my research. Venture to the ridge and gather 3 blue crystals attuned to water, 3 red crystals attuned to fire, and 3 yellow crystals attuned to earth. With these samples I will unlock new paths in my studies that could greatly benefit our cause. Tread carefully in your search, hero - the wildlife of Singing Ridge is fierce and will protect their domain.

title: Disarming the Wyrmcult
obj_text: Collect Wyrmcult Poacher Bows and Wyrmcult Hewer Axes in Ruuan Weald.
desc_text: <name>, the wyrmcult of Ruuan Weald terrorize the land with their deadly axes and cursed bows. If we are to drive them back, we must separate them from their vile weapons. Venture into their camps and relieve five of their poachers of their spiteful bows. Also, take the hewer axes from 5 of their lumberers to break their supply chains. Bring these weapons to me so they may never again draw blood. The wyrmcult's reign ends today, hero. Make haste, and be wary - even disarmed, they remain dangerous foes.

title: Dismantling the Kil'sorrow
obj_text:
Defeat Kil'sorrow forces at Kil'sorrow Fortress.
 Kil'sorrow Cultist slain (8)
 Kil'sorrow Spellbinder slain (6)
 Kil'sorrow Deathsworn slain (8)
desc_text: The vile Kil'sorrow cultists have infested Nagrand for too long. Their dark magics and rituals twist the spirits of the land and must be stopped. Reports indicate they are gathering at Kil'sorrow Fortress for an ominous ritual. We cannot allow them to cement their foul hold on this region!$BHero, your skills are needed to dismantle the Kil'sorrow before their power grows. Strike now while they gather at the fortress. Destroy their forces - lay waste to cultists, spellbinders and deathsworn. Leave no one standing. Only by eliminating these twisted souls can we restore balance to Nagrand. Go forth and serve justice!

title: Breaking the Boulderfist Clan
obj_text:
Defeat Boulderfist ogres at the Burning Blade Ruins.
 Boulderfist Crusher slain (8)
 Boulderfist Mystic slain (8)
desc_text: The Boulderfist ogres of Nagrand threaten the land with their brute strength and arcane magics. If left unchecked, their numbers will swell and they will dominate the entire region. Reports indicate the Burning Blade Ruins are a key encampment for the clan. By striking here, we can crush their spirits and break their foothold.$BHero, your might is needed to dismantle the Boulderfist forces at the ruins. Eliminate their crushers and mystics before their power grows further. With these ogres defeated, the innocent peoples of Nagrand can rest easy. Go now and unleash your fury - for honor and for victory!

title: Thinning the Beasts
obj_text:
Cull overpopulated Talbuk, Clefthoof and Windroc in Nagrand.
 Talbuk Stag slain (8)
 Clefthoof slain (8)
 Windroc slain (8)
desc_text: The wilds of Nagrand teem with magnificent beasts, but their numbers have grown too dense as of late. Talbuk, clefthoof and windroc clash more fiercely over food and territory. This imbalance threatens the delicate ecology of the region. A culling must be ordered to restore stability to the land.$BChampion, I require your able hand in thinning local wildlife populations. Slay the overabundant talbuk stags, clefthoof and windroc. Bring balance back to Nagrand by ensuring no species dominates the landscape. Stay your heart - this harsh task is necessary for the greater good of all who dwell here. May your aim be true.

title: Fiery Cores
obj_text: Gather Unstable Fire Cores from demons at Forge Camp: Terror.
desc_text: The demons at Forge Camp: Terror are utilizing volatile cores to power their dark fire magic. If we can gather a stockpile of these unstable cores, our own arcanists could study them to discover weaknesses in the enemy's pyromancy. This knowledge could give us a critical advantage against their flame spells.$BHero, I ask you to venture into Forge Camp: Terror and collect as many Unstable Fire Cores as you can find off their flamecalling demons. With these cores, our mages can unravel the secrets of the enemy's fiery sorcery. Your success today could save countless lives across Outland. Gather all you can - the fate of the innocent depends on it!

title: Disrupting the Rituals
obj_text:
Disrupt Kil'sorrow rituals at Oshu'gun.
 Kil'sorrow Ritualist slain (5)
 Terrorguard slain (5)
desc_text: Dire news from Oshu'gun - the Kil'sorrow have overtaken the sacred mountain to perform dark rituals, bending its energies to their vile will. The land writhes in agony as these foul magics poison the spirits of Nagrand. We must put an end to their profane acts before the damage becomes irreversible!$BHero, your skills are needed to disrupt these wicked rituals. Journey to Oshu'gun and eliminate the Kil'sorrow channeling these dark rites - cut down their ritualists and terrorguard minions before they sink Nagrand into shadow. The fate of the land hangs in the balance - go now and be its salvation!

title: Dispelling Shadow, Earth and Wind
obj_text:
Dispel cursed creatures wandering the Spirit Fields.
 Shattered Rumbler slain (6)
 Living Cyclone slain (3)
 Voidspawn slain (6)
desc_text: A dark disturbance festers within the Spirit Fields of Nagrand. Shattered rumblers, voidspawn and living cyclones run amok, warped by fell powers that have invaded this place. If left unchecked, their swelling numbers will pour forth and engulf the land. These afflicted creatures must be put to rest before the shadow takes root.$BHero, I need you to journey to the Spirit Fields and dispel these manifestations - put down the rumblers, cyclones and spawn who wander there. Free them from the curse and bring balance back to this sacred ground. Nagrand's harmony depends on your success. Go now and be its healing hand!

title: Boulderfist Eradication
obj_text:
Eradicate Boulderfist ogre forces from Southwind Cleft.
 Boulderfist Warrior slain (8)
 Boulderfist Mage slain (8)
desc_text: The Boulderfist ogres of Southwind Cleft grow in strength, now boldly launching attacks against nearby settlements. If left unchecked, these brutes will dominate the entire region. We cannot allow their kind to gain further foothold in Nagrand. They must be erased from this land!$BHero, the time has come for decisive action against the Boulderfist threat. Journey to Southwind Cleft and lay waste to their forces - cut down their warriors and mages without mercy. Drive the ogres from this place through extermination. Only when the last of their number falls can there be safety and stability in Nagrand once more. Go now and enact retribution!

title: Dismantling the Vir'aani
obj_text:
Defeat Vir'aani forces in the Spirit Fields.
 Vir'aani Raider slain (8)
 Vir'aani Arcanist slain (8)
desc_text: The sinister Vir'aani elves encroach upon the Spirit Fields, seeking to overtake its potent ley energies for their profane magic. If they succeed, their power will grow unchecked, and all of Nagrand will feel their cruel hand. We cannot allow this to pass!$BHero, your skills are needed to dismantle the Vir'aani forces before they cement their control of the Spirit Fields. Journey there and eliminate their raiders and arcanists. Leave no survivor. Only once their presence is erased can balance be restored to this sacred place. Strike now before it is too late - Nagrand's fate rests in your hands!

title: Secure the Supplies
obj_text: Steal supplies from Windyreed Village to weaken the savage Broken.
desc_text: The savage Broken of Windyreed Village threaten our standing in Nagrand with their relentless attacks. If allowed to continue, they may grow strong enough to dominate the entire region. We must strike a decisive blow and dismantle their supplies, so they cannot sustain their vicious war machine.$BHero, infiltrate Windyreed and confiscate their stockpiles of food, tools and materials. Deprive them of the supplies they need to fuel their warmongering. With their resources diminished, their bloodlust will wane. Go now, and through this act we can pacify a great evil and protect the innocent.

title: Fragments of the Exiles
obj_text: Collect ancestral Windyreed necklaces from fallen Broken exiles.
desc_text: The Broken exiles of Windyreed cling to the remnants of their past through ritual necklaces passed down through generations. If we can gather a stock of their ancestral necklaces, our scholars may gain insight into the traditions of these tribal outcasts. This knowledge could be key to understanding and overcoming our savage foe.$BHero, I task you with infiltrating Windyreed and claiming their ancestral necklaces as trophies from fallen enemies. With these Fragments of the Exiles' history in hand, we can unlock their secrets. Your success today will bring us steps closer to defeating these vicious Broken. Go now and seize a victory for our cause!

title: Murkblood Massacre
obj_text:
Halt a planned Murkblood attack on Sunspring Post.
 Murkblood Putrifier slain (6)
 Murkblood Scavenger slain (6)
 Murkblood Raider slain (6)
desc_text: The vile Murkblood tribe threatens Sunspring Post with their relentless attacks and dark magic. Our scouts report they are planning an all-out assault to raze the outpost completely. We cannot allow these cruel beings to carry out their heinous designs!$BHero, your skills are needed to stop this massacre before it begins. Journey to Sunspring Post and eliminate the Murkblood forces - cut down their putrifiers, scavengers and raiders without mercy. Leave no survivor. Only when their blood stains the earth can our people rest easy. Go now and serve swift justice!

title: Eradicating the Land and Sea Surge
obj_text:
Eradicate emerging rock crushers and surging creatures in Halaani Basin.
 Enraged Crusher slain (8)
 Muck Spawn slain (8)
 Lake Surger slain (8)
desc_text: A surge of hostile creatures threatens Halaani Basin from below the earth and beneath the waters. Enraged rock flayers, vile muck spawn, and vicious lake surgers have been emerging in droves, driven to destroy all in their path. If left unchecked, these beasts will surely overrun the entire region. They must be eradicated at once!$BHero, we need you to journey to Halaani Basin and stem the tide - eliminate the enraged crushers, muck spawn and lake surgers before their numbers swell further. Drive these creatures back so balance can be restored. The future of the Basin depends on you culling this threat. Strike now and let not a single beast remain!

title: Cultural Insights
obj_text: Locate and recover Orc Ancestral Tablets in the Spirit Fields.
desc_text: The Spirit Fields hold remnants of ancient orcish culture long abandoned in Nagrand. Stone tablets engraved with traditions, folklore and more yet dot the landscape. If recovered, these treasures could provide invaluable insight into the orcs' history in Draenor before their corruption.$BHero, we must preserve what fragile pieces of orcish heritage remain. Venture into the Spirit Fields seeking ancestral tablets left behind in the ruins. Retrieve these Cultural Insights so our scholars can study them and preserve the legacy of our past. Go now and reclaim what knowledge you can before it is forever lost!

title: Culling the Clan
obj_text:
Slay Warmaul Shamans and Warmaul Reavers at the Laughing Skull Ruins in Nagrand.
 Warmaul Shaman slain (8)
 Warmaul Reaver slain (8)
desc_text: Hero, the Warmaul ogres at Laughing Skull Ruins threaten all of Nagrand with their dark magics and wanton aggression. Led by their vile shamans and bloodthirsty reavers, the Warmaul grow bolder by the day. We call upon you, champion, to venture to the ruins and cull their clan. Slay their Shamans and Reavers, and drive these brutes back. They must be made to understand that Nagrand does not belong to them. For the safety of the land and its people, these ogres must be culled without mercy.

title: War at Warmaul
obj_text:
Slay Warmaul warlocks and Warmaul brutes at Warmaul Hill in Nagrand.
 Warmaul Warlock slain (12)
 Warmaul Brute slain (12)
desc_text: Hero, the Warmaul ogres at Warmaul Hill grow in strength and boldness by the day. Led by their warring chieftains, these brutes and their warlock masters threaten to overrun all of Nagrand if left unchecked. The Mag'har call upon you, champion, to help turn the tide against the Warmaul. Venture to Warmaul Hill and slay Warmaul warlocks and Warmaul brutes. Give no quarter to these vile ogres. Only by spilling rivers of Warmaul blood can their ambitions be stopped. For the future of Nagrand, bloody war must come to Warmaul this day!

title: Intercepting Boulderfist Provisions
obj_text: Steal war supplies from the Boulderfist clan to prevent a massacre in Halaani Basin.
desc_text: The Boulderfist ogres of Southwind Cleft plan to launch another assault against Halaani Basin. If they succeed, countless innocents will perish. We must act preemptively to prevent this massacre before it occurs.$BHero, infiltrate Southwind Cleft and confiscate the Boulderfist's stockpiled war supplies. Deprive them of the materials they need to carry out their attack. With their resources diminished, the ogres will have no choice but to abandon their campaign of destruction against the Basin. Go now and through this act spare Halaani from merciless slaughter!

title: Ancestral Release
obj_text:
Release 6 Mag’har Prisoners at Warmaul Hill.
 Mag'har Prisoner Freed (6)
desc_text: Hero, the Mag'har of Nagrand suffer greatly from the Warmaul ogres' raids. Many warriors languish in Warmaul Hill's prison, their strength fading. I beseech you - travel to Warmaul Hill and release these proud orcs from their chains! Free as many Mag'har prisoners as you can without raising alarms. Restore their hope so one day they may again take up arms against the ogres. Acts of mercy can reignite the flames of resistance. The Mag'har's spirit depends on heroes like you, champion!

title: Death to Deathshadow
obj_text:
Venture to the Twilight Ridge and dismantle the gathered Deathshadow forces.
 Deathshadow Archon slain (4)
 Deathshadow Warlock slain (4)
 Deathshadow Overlord slain (2)
desc_text: Hero, dark tidings from the Twilight Ridge. The vile Deathshadow cult gathers, threatening Nagrand with their profane magics. Archons, warlocks, and an overlord lead them, poised to strike. We must act! I need you to journey to the Ridge and dismantle the Deathshadow forces. Eliminate their archons, end the warlocks' curses, and slay the overlord before their power grows. Leave them scattered so that Nagrand may know peace.

title: Legacy of Nesingwary
obj_text:
Slay greater windrocs, talbuk thorngrazers, and clefthoof bulls in Nagrand.
 Greater Windroc slain (8)
 Talbuk Thorngrazer slain (8)
 Clefthoof Bull slain (8)
desc_text: Hero, the spirit of Hemet Nesingwary seems to have possessed the beasts of Nagrand. The windrocs, talbucks, and clefthoofs have become more aggressive as of late. It is as if Nesingwary's lust for the hunt has spread to them as well. To restore balance, we ask that you take up Nesingwary's mantle and slay greater windrocs, talbuk thorngrazers, and clefthoof bulls. Show these creatures that Nesingwary is not the only one capable of slaying them. Only then will the beasts return to their peaceful ways.

title: Demonic Disruption
obj_text:
Venture to Forge Camp: Hate and disrupt the Burning Legion forces gathered there.
 Felguard Legionnaire slain (2)
 Gan'arg Tinkerer slain (6)
 Mo'arg Engineer slain (6)
desc_text: Champion, dire news from Forge Camp: Hate. Felguard legionnaires, gan'arg tinkers and mo'arg engineers feverishly prepare for war. Their dark machinations must be disrupted before it's too late! I need you to venture to the Forge Camp and dismantle their operations. Eliminate the legionnaires, sabotage the tinkers' work, and destroy the engineers' infernal constructs. Leave their efforts in chaos so they cannot threaten Nagrand.

title: Taming the Skies and Shadows
obj_text:
Cull the invasive sparrowhawks and twilight serpents threatening travelers in Nagrand.
 Twilight Serpent slain (8)
 Wild Sparrowhawk slain (4)
desc_text: Champion, the skies and shadows of Nagrand teem with dangerous beasts. Vicious sparrowhawks and shadowy twilight serpents now threaten travelers throughout the region. I need an expert hunter like yourself to cull these invasive species before they overwhelm the land. Slay the wild sparrowhawks and twilight serpents so that our roads may again know safety. Your actions will help restore balance to Nagrand's ecosystems.

title: Remnants of a Lost Empire
obj_text: Collect 12 Insignia of Mar'gok from the Warmaul ogres at the Laughing Skull Ruins in Nagrand.
desc_text: Hero, the Laughing Skull Ruins contain remnants of a once mighty ogre empire ruled by the tyrannical sorcerer king Mar'gok. Though Mar'gok is long dead, his evil legacy endures. We have learned that the Warmaul ogres now dwell in these ruins, and they possess insignia bearing Mar'gok's accursed image. We task you with venturing into the ruins and liberating these foul relics. Collect Insignia of Mar'gok from the Warmaul so that we may cleanse them of their darkness. Only by removing these remnants can the ghosts of the past finally be laid to rest. Will you help grant the old imperator's victims the peace they deserve?

title: Conquering the Forge
obj_text:
Venture into the Legion's forge bases and slay the mo'args operating their forges
 Cyber-Rage Forgelord slain (4)
 Gan'arg Mekgineer slain (7)
desc_text: Champion, the Legion's forge bases in Netherstorm pose a grave threat if left unchecked. Cyber-rage forgelords and gan'arg mekgineers at Gehenna and Oblivion produce dark armaments day and night. We must dismantle their operations! I need you to travel to the forges and put an end to their malignant industry. Eliminate the forgelords overseeing production, and sabotage the mekgineers maintaining the machinery. Leave their fiery forges cold and silent.

title: Powering the Monument
obj_text: Gather Apexis Crystals to activate an ancient monument.
desc_text: An ancient Apexis monument has been discovered in Blade's Edge Mountains, but its power remains dormant. Legends speak of four crystals that can awaken the monument's magic. If harnessed, this power could aid our cause greatly against the darkness now threatening Outland.$BHero, we must attempt to activate this monument! Venture into the crystal-infused areas nearby and gather the different crystals - one red, one green, one yellow, one blue. The fate of the region may well depend on the secrets you uncover today!

title: Chaotic Elements
obj_text:
Journey to The Crumbling Waste and cull the chaotic elementals overrunning the region.$B
 Warp Monstrosity slain (6)
 Sundered Thunderer slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, troubling news from The Crumbling Waste. Chaotic elementals - warp monstrosities and sundered thunderers - have proliferated unchecked, threatening to overwhelm the region. Their primal fury must be contained before more damage is done! I need you to travel to The Waste and cull these ferocious elementals. Eliminate the monstrosities and ground the thunderers so balance can be restored.

title: Oshu'gun Knowledge
obj_text: Gather void samples from Oshu'gun in Nagrand
desc_text: Hero, Oshu'gun holds ancient mysteries waiting to be unlocked. The voidspawn, vir'aani crystals, and terrorguards all radiate its strange energies. If we could collect samples - void energies, crystals, and terrorguard blood - our allies believe they could piece together Oshu'gun's secrets. Venture to the sacred mountain, obtain these specimens, and bring them to me for study. The knowledge gained could prove invaluable against the void.

title: Serpentine Secrets
obj_text: Gather serpent eggs from throughout Nagrand for our allies to study.
desc_text: Hero, our allies in Shattrath seek to better understand the mysterious serpents native to Outland. However, their secrets remain elusive. I believe studying eggs from the local serpentine species may provide insight. Please, venture into Nagrand and gather as many serpent eggs as you can find. Transport them safely to our allies so their mysteries may be unlocked.

title: Tidal Investigation
obj_text: Gather water samples from the Halaani Basin in Nagrand
desc_text: Hero, the waters of the Halaani Basin hold untapped secrets waiting to be uncovered. Our allies seek samples - vials of the water itself, as well as the acidic essences found within - to study their unique properties and harness their potential. I ask you to venture into the basin, gather water globes and acidic extracts, and bring them to me for analysis. Your efforts will arm our scholars with the knowledge to make wondrous discoveries.

title: Ethereum Purge
obj_text:
Slay Ethereum forces at the Ethereum Staging Grounds in Netherstorm.
 Ethereum Assassin slain (5)
 Ethereum Shocktrooper slain (5)
 Ethereum Nexus-Stalker slain (5)
desc_text: Hero, the Ethereum's staging ground swarms with their twisted creations. Assassins lurk in shadows, shocktroopers bristle with armaments, and nexus-stalkers warp reality itself as a weapon. Left unchecked, their forces will surge out of the staging grounds and threaten all of Netherstorm. I ask you to purge them - venture forth and slay their assassins, shocktroopers, and nexus-stalkers. Thin their numbers so they cannot spread their sinister tech further.

title: Culuthas’s Horde
obj_text:
Slay Culuthas's minions in the Ruins of Farahlon in Netherstorm.
 Eye of Culuthas slain (5)
 Hound of Culuthas slain (5)
desc_text: Hero, the demon Culuthas holds the Ruins of Farahlon in an iron grip, commanding legions of sinister beasts. His Eyes stalk the shadows, while savage Hounds roam relentlessly. If left unchecked, their numbers will surge. I ask you to venture to the ruins and cull Culuthas's horde - slay his Eyes and Hounds so his forces are weakened.

title: Sunfury Showdown
obj_text:
Disrupt Sunfury operations at Manaforge Duro in Netherstorm.
 Sunfury Bowman slain (7)
 Sunfury Centurion slain (5)
 Sunfury Conjurer slain (5)
desc_text: Hero, Kael'thas' forces occupy Manaforge Duro in force. Sunfury bowmen rain death from afar as centurions hold the line. Conjurers empower them all with destructive magics. If we do not confront them soon, the manaforge will be lost. I ask you to venture there and face the Sunfury head on - slay their bowmen, centurions and conjurers without mercy. The battle will be perilous, but your actions today could deal a devastating blow to their command of the manaforge.

title: Fel Fetch
obj_text: Gather fel machine bits from Gehenna and Oblivion in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, the Legion machines that haunt the Gehenna and Oblivion bases contain components our allies desperately need. Their fel-tainted bits and pieces could provide insights that empower our own technologies against them. I ask you to sally forth and battle these metal monstrosities - salvage their machine bits so our tinkers can study them. Your fetchings could arm us with new knowledge to overcome these foes.

title: Unstable Fel Collection
obj_text: Venture into fel-corrupted areas and collect unstable fel orbs for study.
desc_text: Champion, fel energies permeate Forge Camp: Hate, Forge Camp: Fear, and Twilight Ridge, condensed into volatile orbs. If we could safely contain them, studying these orbs may reveal weaknesses in the Legion's magics. I need you to venture into these dangerous places and collect any fel orbs you can transport. Take care not to touch them directly! Bring me as many as you can so our allies can unlock their secrets. This knowledge could turn the tide against the shadow

title: Dangerous Wildlife
obj_text:
Cull aggressive wildlife in Netherstorm.
 Mana Snapper slain (6)
 Warp Chaser slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the wild creatures of Netherstorm have become increasingly aggressive and dangerous. Mana snapper packs attack travelers, while warp chasers phase in and out to ambush the unwary. Vicious shredder birds circle endlessly overhead. If left alone, their numbers will surge out of control. I ask you to cull these beasts - slay the mana snappers, warp chasers, and shredder birds so that balance is restored across Netherstorm.

title: Scrapyard Slaughter
obj_text:
Disrupt the Legion scrapyard at Invasion Point: Destroyer in Netherstorm.
 Gan'arg Engineer slain (7)
 Mo'arg Doomsmith slain (7)
desc_text: Hero, the Legion's scrapyard at Invasion Point: Destroyer teems with their twisted engineers, crafting fiendish machines of war. Gan'arg engineers work tirelessly as Mo'arg doomssmiths oversee their efforts. If we allow their machinations to continue, horrors beyond imagining will be unleashed upon Netherstorm. I ask you to attack the scrapyard and put an end to their efforts - slay the engineers and doomssmiths so their evil creations never see the light of day.

title: Sunfury Slaughter
obj_text:
Slay Sunfury blood elves at Sunfury Hold in Netherstorm.
 Sunfury Archer slain (10)
 Sunfury Flamekeeper slain (3)
desc_text: Hero, Kael'thas' blood elves occupy Sunfury Hold in force, a festering threat in the heart of Netherstorm. Their archers harass all who pass by, while flamekeepers spread destructive magic. Left unchecked, their power grows daily. I ask you to venture to Sunfury Hold and paint its earth red with Sunfury blood - slay their archers and flamekeepers without mercy. Your actions could deal a devastating blow to their operations here.

title: The Chaos of Kirin’Var
obj_text:
Slay chaotic beings in Kirin'Var Village in Netherstorm.
 Mana Seeker slain (6)
 Mageslayer slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, Kirin'Var Village has fallen into chaos and ruin. Mana seekers roam the streets absorbing all magics, while mageslayers hunt practitioners of the arcane. Left unchecked, these sinister beings will eradicate the remaining village defenders and solidify their hold. I ask you to sally forth and face the chaos - slay the mana seekers and mageslayers so the village can begin to heal. Your actions today could help reclaim this land for good.

title: Dangerous Research
obj_text:
Disrupt Sunfury operations at Manaforge Coruu in Netherstorm.
 Sunfury Arcanist slain (6)
 Sunfury Guardsman slain (4)
 Sunfury Researcher slain (4)
desc_text: Hero, Kael'thas' forces conduct sinister research at Manaforge Coruu. Their arcanists tap chaotic energies, while researchers study dark magics. Sunfury guards defend them all. If we allow their work to continue, they will unleash untold horrors upon Netherstorm. I ask you to attack Manaforge Coruu, and put an end to their dangerous research - slay their arcanists, researchers, and guardsmen without mercy.

title: Disembodied Purge
obj_text:
Journey to the Ruins of Enkaat and purge the disembodied spirits that linger there.
 Disembodied Protector slain (6)
 Disembodied Vindicator slain (6)
desc_text: Champion, a darkness has settled over the Ruins of Enkaat. The cursed spirits of fallen draenei exarchs and vindicators wander aimlessly, consumed with torment. They are beyond saving, but we may still offer them peace through oblivion. I ask that you travel to the Ruins and put these souls to rest. Slay the exarchs and vindicators so they may find release from their eternal suffering. It is a grim task, but one that only you have the compassion and strength to complete. In death, may the Light embrace them once more.

title: Verdant Vines
obj_text: Pull verdant vines within gathering range in Eco-Dome Midrealm in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, the verdant vines in Eco-Dome Midrealm produce valuable fruits and resources, but many grow out of reach. By pulling the vines down where they can be harvested, you would provide sustenance and materials greatly benefiting our allies. I ask you to visit Midrealm, take hold of the vines, and draw them within gathering range. Bringing them within reach will yield bushels of precious fruits and vegetables to nourish our people.

title: Demonic Destruction
obj_text:
Journey to the Arklon Ruins and dismantle the demonic forces gathered there.
 Felblade Doomguard slain (4)
 Artifact Seeker slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the Legion's presence grows at the Arklon Ruins. Felblade doomguards and artifact seekers now crawl amongst the debris, no doubt searching for power. We cannot allow them to succeed! I need you to travel to the Ruins immediately and dismantle their forces. Eliminate the doomguards before their might grows, and stop the seekers from unearthing anything dangerous. Leave their ambitions in ruin.

title: Zaxxis Removal
obj_text:
Journey to The Heap and eliminate the parasitic Zaxxis infestation.
 Zaxxis Stalker slain (6)
 Zaxxis Raider slain (6)
desc_text: Champion, the Zaxxis Ethereals overwhelm The Heap, consuming its primal energies unchecked. Their stalkers and raiders feed ceaselessly, growing alarmingly in number. We must act now before the infestation spreads! I need you to travel to The Heap and cull the Zaxxis. Eliminate their cunning stalkers, and destroy the voracious raiders. Only a champion of your skill can accomplish this vital task. Remove this plague upon Netherstorm so that balance may be restored!

title: Ethereum Knowledge
obj_text: Gather Ethereum artifacts from the Staging Grounds and Manaforge Ultris in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, the Ethereum hold dangerous knowledge that could empower our fight against them. Their tomes, void residues, and flesh samples contain secrets waiting to be unlocked. I ask you to battle their forces at the Staging Grounds and Manaforge Ultris, gather these artifacts, and bring them to me. By studying our enemies' knowledge, we gain an advantage in defeating them. Your efforts today could provide the key insights we need.

title: Fel Havoc
obj_text: Gather demonic relics from Gehenna and Oblivion in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, the demons and fel elementals of Gehenna and Oblivion are sowing untold havoc across Netherstorm. If we could gather the foul artifacts they carry - skulls, munitions, chaotic energy - our allies believe they could be purified and used for good. I ask you to battle these creatures, claim their dark relics, and bring them to me. By turning our enemies' vile tools against them, we may achieve victory.

title: Rebuilding Kirin’Var
obj_text: Reactivate protective wards in Kirin'Var Village, Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, the protective wards around Kirin'Var Village have fallen inert, leaving the area vulnerable. If we reactivated them, it would bolster the village's defenses and allow them to begin rebuilding in safety. I ask you to travel to Kirin'Var and repower their ward pylons - restore their protective magics so the villagers can start reclaiming their home without fear. Your actions today could help the first steps of this land's restoration.

title: Fel Beasts Must Be Put Down
obj_text:
Slay fel beasts in Shadowmoon Valley
 Felboar slain (8)
 Felfire Diemetradon slain (8)
desc_text: Hero, the demonically-tainted beasts of Shadowmoon Valley have become increasingly vicious. Felboars attack travelers on sight while felfire diemetradons spew liquid flame. If left unchecked, their numbers will surge out of control. I ask you to venture across the valley putting these creatures down - slay the felboars and diemetradons before the land is overrun. Only a champion of your skill can face these fell beasts.

title: Arcane Scavenger
obj_text: Scavenge arcane artifacts from Manaforge Ultris in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, remnants of magical artifacts litter Netherstorm, soaked in arcane energies. Crystals, runestones, magical texts - if gathered, these could be studied by our allies to unlock their power and reverse engineer them for good. I ask you venture there, battle its twisted denizens, and scavenge what magical artifacts you can find. Bring them to me so their secrets may empower our cause.

title: Facing the Legion's Horde
obj_text:
Disrupt the Legion forces at Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley
 Shadow Council Warlock slain (6)
 Terrormaster slain (6)
 Wrathwalker slain (6)
 Mo'arg Weaponsmith slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the Legion's stronghold of Legion Hold teems with our enemies. Shadow Council warlocks work dark magics while terrormasters rally gruesome troops. Wrathwalkers and mo'arg forge fiendish armaments to fuel their war machine. I ask you to venture to Legion Hold and face the Legion head-on - slay their forces and leadership to throw Legion Hold into disarray. Your actions today could deal a devastating blow to their campaign.

title: Quelling Legions
obj_text:
Quelling Legions
 Felboar slain (8)
 Felfire Diemetradon slain (8)
desc_text: Quelling Legions

title: Arcane Collection
obj_text: Gather arcane crystals in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, powerful arcane crystals can be found scattered across Netherstorm, radiating magic. The blood elves, demons, and even beasts of the region utilize these crystals to empower their forces. If we could gather a sampling - Sunfury, Moarg, and Netherwarped crystals - our allies believe they could tap into their energies for good. Venture out, battle these factions, and collect their crystals so their power may be harnessed against them.

title: Repelling the Eclipsion Onslaught
obj_text:
Disrupt Kael'thas' forces at Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley
 Eclipsion Centurion slain (8)
 Eclipsion Archmage slain (8)
 Eclipsion Dragonhawk slain (8)
desc_text: Hero, Kael'thas' forces swarm Eclipse Point, preparing to strike. Eclipsion centurions assemble ranks while archmages weave destructive magics. Dragonhawks fill the skies. If we do not confront them soon, their next onslaught could ravage Shadowmoon. I ask you to venture to Eclipse Point and repel their forces - slay centurions, archmages, and dragonhawks alike. Break their ranks so their campaign of destruction fails.

title: Corruption Cleansing
obj_text: Recover corrupted naaru crystals from the Arklon Ruins for cleansing.
desc_text: Champion, remnants of sacred naaru crystals litter the Arklon Ruins, warped by fel energies. If cleansed, these crystals may yet recover their holy light. I need you to venture into the Ruins and gather as many corrupted crystals as you can safely carry. Bring them here, where our allies can attempt to restore their purity. What was meant for evil, may be turned to good purpose once more. Your actions today may help tip the balance toward the Light. Go forth boldly, hero!

title: Destabilising the Deathforge
obj_text:
Destabilising the Deathforge
 Deathforge Guardian slain (6)
 Deathforge Summoner slain (6)
 Deathforge Tinkerer slain (6)
desc_text: Destabilising the Deathforge

title: The Devouring Void
obj_text:
Journey to Manaforge Ultris and purge the void creatures threatening to consume it.
 Voidshrieker slain (5)
 Unstable Voidwraith slain (5)
 Seeping Sludge slain (6)
desc_text: Champion, a great darkness festers at Manaforge Ultris. Voidwraiths shriek endlessly, consuming all they touch, while vile seeping sludge emerges unchecked from the shadows. Left unchecked, they will devour the forge's energies entirely! I need you to travel to Manaforge Ultris and purge these void creatures before it is too late. Eliminate the voidwraiths, silence their shrieking, and destroy the spreading sludge. Strip the void of its power so that the Light may shine again. This will be dangerous, but I have faith in you.

title: Corrupted Blood Experiment
obj_text: Sakari has a subject to test the fel blood antidote on. She believes studying its effects could yield great power, but cautions the results may be unpredictable.
desc_text: While you're here, I could use some help with one more thing, if you're willing of course. I may have found a way to fully revert the corruption of one of these fel orcs. While I believe it should work, the fact that I've partially reverted the fel influence on them doesn't make them any less loyal to Kargath.$BI'm not much of a fighter, and I haven't been able to secure anyone who is. If you could stay for a moment while I release the orc to try this, it would be much appreciated. If I'm not able to sedate it properly and it tries something.

title: Destabilising the Deathforge
obj_text:
Disrupt the Legion forces at the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley
 Deathforge Guardian slain (6)
 Deathforge Summoner slain (6)
 Deathforge Tinkerer slain (6)
desc_text: Hero, the Legion's Deathforge churns out fiendish war machines that wreak havoc across Shadowmoon. Guardians protect the site as summoners call forth reinforcements. Tinkerers engineer monstrosities within. I ask you attack the Deathforge and destabilize their operations - slay their guardians, summoners and tinkerers so their work is disrupted. If we can shatter their productivity, it will grant us a reprieve from their horrors.

title: Sunfury Style
obj_text: Collect Sunfury scarves from Sunfury Hold and Manaforge Coruu in Netherstorm.
desc_text: Hero, the fashionable Sunfury elves craft intricate scarves imbued with arcane energy. Our allies believe these stylish accessories also contain secrets waiting to be unlocked. I ask you to venture to Sunfury Hold and Manaforge Coruu, battle the elves, and confiscate their ornate scarves. Bring these stylish specimens to me so their magical mysteries may be unraveled and used to empower our own enchantments.

title: The Stolen Shard of Light
obj_text: Return The Stolen Shard of Light to Xi'ri
desc_text: Xi'ri, prime naaru and beacon of the Light for the Draenei people, has sensed a grave disturbance. One of the sacred Shards channeling her holy energies has been stolen by sinister agents of the Void!$BWithout this missing Shard, Xi'ri's connection to the Light is threatened, leaving the Draenei vulnerable to the encroaching darkness. She implores you to recover this precious artifact taken by sinister void creatures before her radiance is extinguished.$BVenture into the shadowy lairs of the void-twisted netherwalkers to reclaim the Shard before Xi'ri's light dims! Only by restoring the naaru's beacon of the Light can balance be returned to the Draenei and Xi'ri's protective vigil be maintained.$BThe fate of the Shard, and Xi'ri's guidance, now rests in your hands, champion! Restore this holy relic so Xi'ri's benevolence over the Draenei endures against the dark forces that seek to extinguish her Light!

title: Fel Hides
obj_text: Collect fel hides from demons and fel corrupted beasts in Shadowmoon Valley
desc_text: Hero, the demonic beasts across Shadowmoon Valley possess hides imbued with fel energy. Our allies believe if collected and purified, these hides could be forged into armors resistant to dark magics. I ask you to battle fel creatures across the valley - harvest their hides so that armorers may craft them into protection against their ilk. The hides of demons themselves would suffice equally well for this task. Bring me the hides so this research can begin.

title: Purge of the Dragonkiller's Bloodline
obj_text: Take the Heavy Sack of Heads to Betrayer Grondstok
desc_text: The dreaded Sons of Gruul have been decapitated at last. Their severed heads contained in this sack are evidence of your heroic deeds on behalf of the people of Outland.$BGruul bred his progeny to be as cunning as they were brutal, but their centuries of cruel dominion have been brought to an end. The fearful shadows cast across the land by their cyclopean forms will stretch no longer.$BTake the sack of severed heads to Betrayer Grondstok. He will know what cleansing rituals must be done to purification against any vestiges of demonic corruption the Sons carried. The gratitude of all free people goes with you.

title: Recharging the Shredder
obj_text:
Recharge an Inactive Shredder
 Shredder Charged
desc_text: Hero, our allies' shredder machinery requires charging before it can be safely operated in Netherstorm's harsh conditions. The abundant elemental energies here should provide ample power if utilized properly. I need you to connect any inactive shredders you find to the nearby magical ley lines. Channel the raw arcane currents into their batteries until fully charged. Having these machines running again will greatly aid our efforts in the region.

obj_text:
Investigate the strange noises coming from the Grypholith statue.
 Grypholith slain
desc_text: <name>...travelers passing near Honor Hold have reported strange noises emanating from a stone gryphon statue known as the Grypholith. There are concerns that this construct may be possessed by dark magic and could pose a threat to the town. We need you to engage the Grypholith in combat to stop whatever malevolent force controls it before it can harm Honor Hold.

title: Mysterious Monolith
obj_text:
Investigate the strange noises coming from the Teralis statue.
 Adazekar slain
desc_text: <name>...adventurers visiting Shattrath City have reported strange noises coming from a stone wyvern statue known as the Teralis around Mag'har Post. There are concerns that this construct may have become possessed by unstable elemental magic and could pose a threat to our city. We need you to investigate these reports and eliminate any potential threat. Once you have contained this issue, return to Khadgar in Shattrath to report your findings.

title: Blood Samples
obj_text: ring your gathered blood samples to Sakari so that we may study the properties of pit lord vitae and better understand the true power and danger of fel blood.
desc_text: Research into the properties of the fel blood is progressing slowly as expected. Some progress has been made regarding how it relates to the standard fel corruption other orcs experience. Several substances may potentially aid in understanding the properties of fel blood.$B- The Blood of Mannoroth, most seems to have been consumed by the orcs already, and no method of reaching the demon Mannoroth has proven feasible.$B- Pit Lord's Blood, potentially from the demon Magtheridon imprisoned in this area, for understanding properties specific to Mannoroth's blood.$BBesides these, there seem to be several artificial substances created by the Fel Horde. Perhaps some of these have managed to replicate properties of demon blood, provided they are not$B- Abyssal Elxir, seems to be a potion created to empower the orcs.$B- Blood of the Legions, besides the Fel Orc's vague naming, may provide different properties to study?$B- Demonic Elixir, possibly similar to Abyssal Elixir, Fel Orcs seem to describe it as a separate substance though.$BUnfortunately I lack the means of fighting past the Fel Orcs to obtain any of these, and have not been able to procure additional support in my research besides these prisoners. This platform on Hellfire Citadel seems to remain isolated at least and it is my hope that it remains secure for the foreseeable future.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: Eclipsion Fields (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 5 Crazed Colossus.
 Crazed Colossus (5)
desc_text: Shadowmoon Valley has no shortage of threats to our operations in Outlands. The Colossus rarely wander from their stomping grounds, the giants in the Eclipsion Fields have grown Crazed. Simply avoiding them is no longer an option. Assemble a group of heroes and exterminate the threat.
