obj_text: Collect 20 Spicy Hot Talbuks
desc_text: Hero, we need your help!$BOur soldiers are in desperate need of a morale boost! And then, I got to thinking, maybe we could raise their spirits with a hearty meal!$BCollect 20 Spicy Hot Talbuks. Naturally, you will be handsomely rewarded for your assistance, hero.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: Invasion Point: Cataclysm (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 8 Catacylsm Overseers and 6 Fel Reaver Sentinels.
 Cataclysm Overseer (6)
 Shadow Council Zealot (9)
desc_text: A legion of infernals is preparing a massive assault on Shattrath City! The Skyguard will have no trouble bombing their staging ground once we eliminate the Cataclysm Overseers guarding the area. You must secure Invasion Point: Cataclysm for the Skyguard to ensure Shattrath Cities safety.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: The Path of Conquest (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 8 Sons of Gordok and 4 Illidari Watchers.
 Son of Corok (6)
 Illidari Watcher (3)
desc_text: The Blood Elves and Giants have begun cooperating in Shadowmoon Valley. This alliance is unprecedented and the consequences impossible to predict. We must investigate the issue immediately. Travel to the Path of Conquest and eliminate the Sons of Gordok and any security around Crimson Watch so our investigators can gather more information surrounding this alliance.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: Arklonis Ridge (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 6 Farahlon Giants.
 Farahlon Giant (6)
desc_text: Farahlon Giants have begun to assemble at Arklonis Ridge in the Netherstorm. Their numbers have grown so much that the goblins of Area 52 report a huge uptick in seismic activity. So much so that their rocket is in danger of tipping over! They assure us everything meets safety requirements, but Goblin Engineering being Goblin Engineering it is best to eliminate the giants before they unintentionally destroy Area 52.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: Netherstone (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 12 Farahlon Breakers.
 Farahlon Breaker (9)
desc_text: The Skyguard has developed a new experimental bomb for clearing out infernal staging grounds. The good news is that these bombs are highly effective, the bad news is that they require Netherstone and the extraction process is lengthy and dangerous. Extraction becomes nearly impossible with giants stomping around smashing up the gear and workers. Clear out the Farahlon Breakers around the Netherstone in the Netherstorm.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: Fallen Sky Ridge (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 20 Raging Colossus.
 Raging Colossus (15)
desc_text: We have never seen so many Colossus gathered in one area. It is unclear if the giants are gathering around Fallen Sky Ridge or somehow being created there. What is clear is that this threat must be dealt with while we still can. Travel to Hellfire Peninsula and break up the Raging Colossus.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: The Forge Camps (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Destroy 8 Felguard Legionnaires and 8 Mo'arg Engineers.
 Felguard Legionnaire (6)
 Mo'arg Engineer (6)
desc_text: The Skyguard has lost countless flyers in missions over Nagrand's Forge Camps. The Legion is completely entrenched and our only remaining option is a ground assault. Assault Forge Camp: Fear and Hate in Nagrand and slay the Felguards operating the Fel Cannons that have claimed so many of our flyers. Destroying the Mo'arg Enginners will disrupt the Legions attempts at rebuilding new cannons and allow our bombing missions to continue.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: Outside Gruul's Lair (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 22 Bladespire Orgres.
 $BDenizen of Gruul's Lair (22)

 Bladespire Battlemage
 Bladespire Ravager
 Bladespire Chef
 Fingrom
$B

 Leokk
 Bladespire Chef
 Leokk
 Denizen of Gruul's Lair
desc_text: The Bladespire ogres worship Gruul like a god and will surely follow him into battle should he emerge from his lair. The ogres elite soldiers reside just outside of Gruul’s lair to be closer to their god and defend the entrance from any who would dare challenge him. Defeat the ogres. Prevent a potential attack and open the way to challenge Gruul when we assemble a force strong enough to defeat him!

title: Population Control: Broken Skeleton (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Travel to The Bone Wastes and cull 30 Broken Skeletons.
 Broken Skeleton (10)
desc_text: After the sundering of Draenor, most life was wiped out during collapse of the barrier between Draenor and the Twisting Nether and the resulting explosion. The wildlife that survived became sickly or corrupt, and many of Ner'zhul's portals were left permanently open, allowing all manner of dangerous beings to enter Outland and threaten our presence here.  The Broken Skeleton population is becoming a real threat. Travel to The Bone Wastes and cull 30 of them.

title: Keeping Evil At Bay: The Twilight Ridge (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Slay 5 Deathshadow Overlords and 6 Deathshadow Warlocks.
 Deathshadow Overlord (5)
 Deathshadow Warlock (6)
desc_text: Our scouts spotted an enormous structure during a routine fly over Nagrand. They were unable to scout closer but all reports indicate that structure may be a portal. We don’t yet know the intention, but they are without a doubt hostile. Travel to the Twilight Ridge and put an end to this dark work.

An entire archaeology team was lost and several townsfolk were abducted and taken to the ruins. We've been on the defensive ever since.$BTo make matters worse, the scouts we sent to rescue our people have been harpooned by the vrykul and left for dead in the forest directly north of Valgarde. Dislodge those harpoons and free our scouts!

Now I don't know about you, but I've got a wife and three kids back in Elwynn and I'll be damned if I'll go down without a fight.$BThe situation here is critical and we can use all the manpower you're able to muster. Get to the front gate and help the guards defend the city against the invading monsters!

title: Zedd's Probably Dead
obj_text: Search Wyrmskull Village for Zedd.
desc_text: To whomever finds this journal:$BThese bloodthirsty monsters have taken up residence in the ruins of Wyrmskull. What they want or why they're here is a mystery. In any case, the artifacts are not safe with those beast-men around.$BZedd and I made a new discovery while hiding out: a cipher to decode the tablets! Unfortunately Zedd and I were separated late last night. He had the cipher. Tablets were with Glorenfeld and Daegarn. Location unknown...$BFind Zedd.$B-Pulroy

title: Prisoners of Wyrmskull
obj_text:
Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port in the Howling Fjord wants you to rescue 3 Captured Valgarde Prisoners.
 $BCaptured Valgarde Prisoner Rescued (3)

 Captured Valgarde Priest
 Captured Valgarde Mage
 Captured Valgarde Warrior
$B

 Captured Valgarde Paladin
 Captured Valgarde Prisoner (PROXY)
desc_text: This battle is far from over, <name>. If our people are still alive inside that village, someone has to go and get 'em.$B<Vice Admiral Keller nods at you.>$BHead north and enter Wyrmskull Village. Once there, look for our people. If they are imprisoned you'll need to find a way to break them out.$BMaybe they'll have some more information about what it is that we're actually fighting.

title: The Human League
obj_text: Search Wyrmskull Village for Pulroy.
desc_text: We were on the brink of an archaeological breakthrough when those monsters attacked! Sadly, I was the only one to make it back to Valgarde. Now I don't know if my crew is dead or alive, but the artifacts we uncovered on that dig must be found!$BIf you're heading into Wyrmskull Village, will you keep an eye out for my team? If there's any hope of recovering that information, we must pursue it!$BSearch for Pulroy first. He was the last one I saw before I made my escape.

title: And Then There Were Two...
obj_text: Search the Utgarde Catacombs for Glorenfeld.
desc_text: There's no sign of the cipher on Zedd. After carefully searching the area you discover some writing in the dirt:$B"Glor and Dae inside catacombs. Have cipher and tablets."$BPerhaps you should head into the catacombs located just north of here and search for Glorenfeld and Daegarn. The bridge crossing the worg pit will lead you right to the tunnel leading down into the catacombs.

title: The Enigmatic Frost Nymphs
obj_text: Speak with Lurielle at the Frozen Glade.
desc_text: When we first scouted locations for the fort, we encountered hostile creatures at two of the glades here in the north. When we passed the snow-covered one directly south of the town, the dryads there watched us with interest, but did not attack.$BWe were tired and worn down by the weather. They could've easily killed several of our men, but they didn't.$BPerhaps, in reaching out to them, we might discover unexpected allies. Are you willing to travel to the Frozen Glade and make contact with them?

title: Dragonflayer Battle Plans
obj_text: Vice Admiral Keller at Valgarde Port in the Howling Fjord has asked that you bring him the Dragonflayer Battle Plans.
desc_text: While we were able to gather very little information as to the whereabouts of Ingvar, we do know that Yanis resides in a cave next to the worg pit inside Wyrmskull Village.$BIntelligence gathered from the rescued soldiers indicates that Yanis guards Dragonflayer battle plans.$BI need you to go back to Wyrmskull and recover those plans. Kill any vrykul that get in your way - including Yanis!

title: Everything Must Be Ready
obj_text: Speak with Gil Grisert at Fort Wildervar.
desc_text: When the expeditionary force moves north, Captain Adams expects everything to be ready at Fort Wildervar. The scouts and craftsmen there have been tasked with preparing the gear and rations for our men for the climb into the hills.$BThe captain's famous for his temper, so I want to send someone ahead to check on the preparations. Fort Wildervar is far to the northeast, beyond Skorn, up in the snow-covered areas near the border with Grizzly Hills. Find Gil Grisert there and make sure he is prepared.

title: To Westguard Keep!
obj_text: Take the Dragonflayer Battle Plans to Captain Adams at Westguard Keep in the Howling Fjord.
desc_text: <Vice Admiral Keller rolls up the battle plans.>$BWe've got all the information we need to keep Valgarde protected. You must take these battle plans to Westguard Keep, located on the western fjord cliff wall. Speak with the flight master assistant, Emilune Winterwind. She will put you on the back of a gryphon headed towards Westguard.$BOnce there, find Captain Adams. He's the one in charge. Adams will know what to do with these plans.

title: Out of My Element?
obj_text:
Donny at Ivald's Ruin in the Howling Fjord wants you to kill 10 Iron Rune Destroyers, 5 Iron Rune Laborers and 2 Iron Rune Sages.
 Iron Rune Destroyer slain (10)
 Iron Rune Laborer slain (5)
 Iron Rune Sage slain (2)
desc_text: Keep it down, <race>. These iron dwarves are quick on the trigger. Now don't let the activities down in the dig fool you. Those steel-skinned abominations aren't digging anything up! No sir - on the contrary - they're burying the site! For whatever whacked out reason, they don't want anyone finding this place.$BWhat kind of dwarf buries ancient relics and dig sites? I'll tell you what kind: the kind you kill with reckless abandon! Get in there and take 'em out!

title: We Call Him Steelfeather
obj_text:
Locate Steelfeather circling Fort Wildervar and use the Feathered Charm to discover his secret. Report your findings to Gil Grisert.
 Learn Steelfeather's Secret
desc_text: We see one brave hippogryph circling over the fort, then swooping down and taking prey. Jethan over there has taken a couple of shots at the creature, but his arrows bounced right off!$BWe've taken to calling this remarkable creature Steelfeather, but we can't see why he prefers the area around Fort Wildervar. Most hippogryphs are wary of people.$BResearcher Aderan has helped us fashion a charm from one of the creature's feathers. He claims it will allow the user to see through Steelfeather's eyes.

title: I'll Try Anything!
obj_text: Christopher Sloan at Fort Wildervar wants you to bring him 5 Northern Barbfish.
desc_text: I never want to see another barrel of salted fish as long as I live! Filling barrels day in and day out, and there are still more to be filled!$BI wish I hadn't used up all that bait I bought from Nat Pagle. Worked like magic, it did. Now I'm lucky if I can catch a fish an hour!$BI hear the northern barbfish make pretty good bait, but who's crazy enough to dive into a freezing cold lake and hack up the water plants in search of them? Not me... but maybe, just maybe, I can persuade you to...

title: Preying Upon the Weak
obj_text: Trapper Jethan at Fort Wildervar wants you to bring him 8 pieces of Trapped Prey.
desc_text: Glad to meet you. I've come here from the Grizzly Hills to do business with your cohorts. My people maintain a large outpost there, and you'd do well to visit it when you head north.$BI've set up traps in the woodlands and snowy areas around here. With the meat and the furs from the creatures they capture, I'll have plenty to barter with the townspeople.$BI can offer you a share of my profits if you're willing to help gather prey from the traps. Beware though, you won't be the only predator out there.

title: Camp Winterhoof
obj_text: Speak to Chieftain Ashtotem at Camp Winterhoof.
desc_text: In my travels as a courier, I've seen a number of strange denizens of the Howling Fjord, but one group stands out. From a distance, they look like tauren, but upon closer inspection, they're quite different -- sturdier and shaggier.$BI found one of their settlements far to the north, beyond Halgrind, Skorn, and the northern forests. Camp Winterhoof, it's called, and it sits in the foothills of Gjalerhorn near the border with Grizzly Hills. Make contact with them, and see if they might be of use to us.

desc_text: If we can't overcome the defenders inside Thor Modan, the iron dwarves can hold out forever. The Earthen are bravely taking on the constructs built by the sons of iron, but they cannot break into the city.$BThe tunnels narrow too quickly for my fellow giants to be of use, so our options are few. Would you be willing to venture into the city and kill the dwarf commanding the resistance?

title: Raining Down Destruction
obj_text:
Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan wants you to disrupt the iron dwarves' work by throwing boulders into the exposed area of Thor Modan.
 Iron Dwarf Operations Disrupted (5)
desc_text: eneath us is iron's ancient bastion, Thor Modan. Thousands of years ago, the stone giants tore the land asunder, collapsing part of the city and exposing much of the rest.$BEven now, the iron dwarves attempt to reclaim their old capital, but we will not permit it. My giants fill the trench with boulders and debris, hoping to seal it off and kill the servants of iron as they work. Take up the boulders you see near the trench to the northeast, and help us put an end to their efforts.

title: Find Kurun!
obj_text: Speak with Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan.
desc_text: The Earthen warrior's stone surface is covered with cracks and gouges. Although it is incapable of bleeding, you can sense that the warrior is near death.$BA low, hoarse voice escapes from the dying warrior's mouth.$B"Find... Kurun... you must find... Kurun."$BIt looks at you helplessly as you ask for any clues as to who or what Kurun might be.$B"Our... leader... he stands on the... hill overlooking Thor Modan... commands us. Please... tell him... we cannot take... the city... "

75 reputation with Darkspear Trolls

title: The Runic Prophecies
obj_text:
Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.
 First Prophecy Deciphered
 Second Prophecy Deciphered
 Third Prophecy Deciphered
desc_text: We've no time to lose! Now that we've reassembled the runic keystone -- well, most of it -- we can decipher the contents of those very same runic plates Brann was working on before he fled.$BWe have no way of knowing if he managed to read the contents of all three plates, but we'll have to assume he got enough information to determine his next destination.$BStand before each of the plates and use the keystone to determine the contents of each. Brann may be counting on us!

title: Uncovering the Tunnels
obj_text:
rugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment wants you to explore the North Building, the East Building, and the South Building of Thor Modan.
 Investigate North Building
 Investigate East Building
 Investigate South Building
desc_text: The first place we'll search for entrances to the Thor Modan tunnel system will be the outlying buildings.$BAs I left the site with my men, it looked like the iron dwarf defenders were taking refuge inside the buildings. Be careful as you explore them.$BAny tunnel entrances are likely to be toward the back of the buildings. I'm not sure what Stoutmantle thinks we're going to find down there, but I doubt the iron dwarves will make the search easy.

title: Softening the Blow
obj_text: ring Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment a cask of Howlin' Good Moonshine.
desc_text: Our best bet for moving our forces quickly to Icecrown Glacier lies with the network of tunnels beneath the ancient iron dwarf city of Thor Modan.$BBrugar Stoneshear and his Explorers' League boys aren't going to be happy, but orders are orders.$BThe news might go over better if you brought him a cask of that moonshine sold by that trapper, Hugh Glass, down at Redwood Trading Post, southeast of here along the tree line.$BMan's not right in the head, but you won't find better moonshine out here.

title: Brothers in Battle
obj_text:
Kill 10 Runic Battle Golems and return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
 Runic Battle Golem slain (10)
desc_text: I hope Gryan knows I withdrew my men from Thor Modan when the battle began. There's no way we can excavate anything until that place settles down.$BYou seem like a brave sort, though, and you have Stoutmantle's trust.$BThor Modan is just to the northeast of us and the battle still rages between our Earthen brothers and the creations of those accursed iron dwarves. Help our brethren to even the odds and I'll start figuring out how we're going to accomplish this survey of Thor Modan.

title: The Damaged Journal
obj_text: Recover 8 Missing Journal Pages, combine them with the Incomplete Journal, and return the completed journal to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: This battered, mud-stained journal has seen better days. Leafing through the pages, you discover dozens of notes, diagrams, and maps.$BThe author's handwriting seems vaguely familiar, but you're unable to place it until you discover an entry signed with the name of Brann Bronzebeard.$BThe back half of the book, containing the most recent entries, has been torn away. Pages litter the battlefield, and it will be impossible to know what Brann discovered here until the book is whole again.

title: The Fate of Orlond
obj_text: Locate Surveyor Orlond within Thor Modan.
desc_text: When we began excavating the city, I sent Surveyor Orlond to check the stability of the tunnels in Thor Modan. I didn't see him escape when we withdrew at the beginning of the battle, and I worry he may still be trapped inside the city.$BIf we're going to get an army through Thor Modan, we'll need the information he was collecting. Stoutmantle and his superiors would have my hide if the tunnels collapsed on one of their brigades!

title: The Runic Keystone
obj_text: ring 5 Runic Keystone Fragments to Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: rann's journal mentions that he used a runic keystone to illuminate the important runes on the plate he discovered. Without the keystone, the plate's contents would be little better than gibberish.$BAt the end of Brann's last entry, he describes the iron dwarf defenders seizing the keystone from him, shattering it, and dividing it among themselves. Before we can decipher the runed plate, we must hunt down the fragments. Any of the dwarves within Thor Modan or the buildings around it may carry fragments.

title: Additional Netherweave
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
75 reputation with Thunder Bluff

title: Additional Netherweave
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
75 reputation with Orgrimmar

title: Additional Netherweave
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
75 reputation with Silvermoon City

title: Additional Netherweave
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
75 reputation with Gnomeregan Exiles

title: Pounding the Iron
obj_text:
Kill any 10 Iron Dwarves defending Thor Modan and report back to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
 $BIron Dwarf Defenders Killed (10)

 Rune Reaver
$B

 Iron Rune-Shaper
desc_text: The Alliance isn't the only force opposing us in Grizzly Hills. The iron dwarves have firm control of the eastern coast, although Thor Modan, to the northeast, is besieged by stone giants.$BA skilled warrior uses an enemy's weakness against him and we would be fools to ignore the vulnerability of the iron dwarves at Thor Modan. Show the iron dwarves no mercy. Slay any and all who would stand in your way.$BThe 'sons of iron' will learn to fear the Horde.

title: The Runic Prophecies
obj_text:
Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.
 First Prophecy Deciphered
 Second Prophecy Deciphered
 Third Prophecy Deciphered
desc_text: rann's journal also contained a guide to iron dwarf symbols. I've inscribed these on a keystone which will help you to understand the words inscribed on the rune plates.$BFrom the journal entries, it seems Brann may be chasing after clues to the origins of his people. Keep your eyes open for any clues as to his destination.$BReturn to Thor Modan, northeast of here, stand before each of the plates, and use the stone to determine the contents of each. We can't allow the Alliance to find him first.

title: Steady as a Rock?
obj_text: Retreive the Portable Seismograph and use it to take stability readings in Thor Modan, then return to Brugar Stoneshear at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: Orlond's notes indicate that he brought a piece of equipment called a portable seismograph with him, but the device is nowhere to be seen.$BThe survey log shows that Orlond completed all his readings in the Thor Modan tunnel, save one labeled the 'east end of the exposed tunnel.'$BThe last entry in the log indicates Orlond tried to take refuge in the water and was attacked by subterranean threshers. They might've taken his equipment.You'll need to recover it before you can take the last reading.

title: Deciphering the Journal
obj_text: ring a sprig of Spiritsbreath to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: Vor'takh is right -- we cannot allow this opportunity to slip through our fingers.$BFortunately, I think I know of a way to translate the journal of this Brann.$BThe shamans of the Redfang furbolgs, who congregate at the Heart's Blood Shrine south of the camp, grow an herb known as spiritsbreath. An experienced mystic can use incense made from it to seek wisdom from the spirits of the ancestors.$BSeek out the shaman known as Grumbald One-Eye. He should carry the herb for his devotions to Ursoc.

title: Gavrock
obj_text: Speak with Gavrock at the Ruins of Tethys.
desc_text: Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to turn the tide of the battle for Thor Modan. This ancient city has long been a battlefield between the forces of earth and stone. I can only hope we have silenced it for the last time.$BThe iron dwarves can still use their magic to capture and enslave my brothers. Gavrock is searching for a way to free the runed giants. Look for him on a small cluster of islands, called the Ruins of Tethys, off the central part of the Eastwind Shore to the south.

title: The Damaged Journal
obj_text: Recover 8 Missing Journal Pages, combine them with the Incomplete Journal, and return the completed journal to Sage Paluna at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: This battered, mud-stained journal has seen better days. Leafing through the pages, you discover dozens of notes, diagrams, and maps in the dwarven language.$BThe only text you're able to decipher is the name of Brann Bronzebeard scrawled at the end of one of the entries.$BThe back half of the book, containing the most recent entries, has been torn away. Someone thought the notes important enough to attempt to destroy them. Perhaps gathering the missing pages from the battlefield will yield some clues.

title: Dun-da-Dun-tah!
obj_text:
Escort Harrison from Drakil'jin Ruins, then speak with Harkor at Harkor's Camp.
 $BHarrison has escorted you to safety.
desc_text: Listen, kid. This is no place for you to be playin' around.$BI'm about to make a break for it. Stick with me and I'll get you outta here.

title: Voices From the Dust
obj_text: Drakuru wants you to collect the Drakkari Tablets from the Ruins of Drakil'jin and 5 Sacred Mojo from Drakkari Oracles and Protectors there. You are then to use Drakuru's Elixir at Drakuru's Brazier at the ruins to summon his image.
desc_text: <Drakuru places the Eye of the Prophets on his brow and the Heart of the Ancients on his chest.>$BWe be close, mon, very close!$BThe Drakkari Tablets be all dat remain ta be found. Nobody be knowin' how old dey be or what dey be sayin', but with the eye and the heart Drakuru can be readin' dem. Dey lie deep inside the crypt at Drakil'jin, due east of here.$BOnce ya got the tablets, get sacred mojo from the oracles and protectors so ya can summon me there. They'd be proud to be dyin' for such a cause.

title: An Expedient Ally
obj_text: Speak with Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan.
desc_text: The old iron dwarf capital of Thor Modan, far to the northeast, is under siege by a mysterious band of stone giants and earthen.$BWhy the creations of the titans would war against each other is beyond my understanding and the Horde's interest, but there is an opportunity here to weaken a mutual enemy.$BTravel to Thor Modan and seek out this 'Kurun' who commands the giants and earthen. Make common cause with him and use his forces to crush the iron dwarves.

title: Runes of Compulsion
obj_text:
Gavrock, at the Ruins of Tethys, wants you to neutralize the four Runes of Compulsion by defeating Overseer Durval, Overseer Korgan, Overseer Lochli, and Overseer Brunon.
 Overseer Durval slain
 Overseer Korgan slain
 Overseer Lochli slain
 Overseer Brunon slain
desc_text: Even as Kurun attacks Thor Modan, the iron dwarves work their magics against our brothers. Summoning our brothers from the earth, then binding them with runes, the sons of iron force them to war against the children of stone.$BAlong the Eastwind Shore, they use runes of compulsion to send enslaved giants to the battlefields of the north.$BFind the four runes of compulsion and force their overseers to appear by defeating the rune-weavers who man each rune. Without the overseers, the runes are useless.

title: Latent Power
obj_text:
Charge the Shard of Gavrock at the First Ancient Stone, the Second Ancient Stone, and the Third Ancient Stone, then return to Gavrock at the Ruins of Tethys.
 Power Drawn from First Ancient Stone
 Power Drawn from Second Ancient Stone
 Power Drawn from Third Ancient Stone
desc_text: While the runes of compulsion are dormant, there is a chance we can release the runed giants.$BI will give you a piece of stone that has been part of me since my creation. If properly imbued, it can be used to free the bound giants.$BTwo ancient stone markers sit atop places of power between the Path of Iron and the forest's edge -- locations your people would call the intersections of ley lines. The other is on an island at the southern end of these ruins. Charge the shard at each stone and return.

title: To Dragon's Fall
obj_text: Speak with Rokhan at Dragon's Fall in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: East of here, in the heart of the Dragonblight, is a field full of nothing but dragon bones and snow. The Scourge have set up multiple camps in the central tundra and are raising frostwyrms to send against our forces at the Wrathgate. While most of these frostwyrms are easily dealt with by Rokhan and his dragon hunters, one of them is proving to be a bit problematic.$BGo northeast and seek out Rokhan at Dragon's Fall. Help him and his men put down Sarathstra and you'll be rewarded handsomely!

title: Therapy
obj_text:
Harkor at Harkor's Camp wants you to kill 10 Drakkari Protectors and 10 Drakkari Oracles outside Drakil'jin Ruins.
 Drakkari Protector slain (10)
 Drakkari Oracle slain (10)
desc_text: Trolls... me hates 'em all! <Harkor spits.>$BI once got meself captured by a band o' tha beasts... came this close ta gettin' me head shrunk!$BMe friends tell me to just move on and put it all behind me, but that just ain't sittin' right.$BWanna know what would make me feel better, <race>? Seein' a pile of their corpses so high it blots out the sun! I've got good gold to spend if ya can make that happen.

title: Sarathstra, Scourge of the North
obj_text: Speak with Rokhan to call down the frostwyrm, Sarathstra.$BKill Sarathstra and deliver Sarathstra's Frozen Heart to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: Me hunters be dead or frozen, <name>. Just you and whatever allies you bring wit ya is all da help you get. You still want to do dis? Just say da word and me call for da dragon once more.$BIf ya kill it, take da beast's frozen heart back to Agmar's Hammer and present it to Gort. He sure to reward you good, mon.

title: Free at Last
obj_text:
Use Gavrock's Runebreaker to free 4 Runed Giants, then return to Gavrock at the Ruins of Tethys.
 Runed Giants Freed (4)
desc_text: The rock shard you imbued should be powerful enough to break the runic magic binding my brothers.$BTake it with you and find the runed giants walking north along the Eastwind Shore. Unleash the power stored in the stone and observe the results.$BIf it works, the runed giants should return to their senses and stop obeying the iron dwarves. If the stone fails to work, the giants may attack in a weakened state. But, what choice do we have? If we do not try, they will remain enslaved without hope.

title: REUSE
obj_text: Speak with Captain Gryan Stoutmantle at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: The Westfall Brigade has been dispatched to the northeastern part of Grizzly Hills to secure passage for our troops. They have established a base camp to the northeast of Grizzlemaw, and to the southwest of Thor Modan.$BYou might recognize the brigade's leader, Captain Gryan Stoutmantle as an honored veteran of the war against the Scourge in Lordaeron. But the people of Westfall know him best for his decision to leave the battlefield and return home to take on the Defias.

title: Check Up on Raegar
obj_text: Speak with Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
desc_text: With all the excitement about the army trying to move through Thor Modan, I'd almost forgotten about Raegar's crew down at Prospector's Point.$BI sent Raegar and his assistants, along with a mountaineer friend, down to establish a small post near Dun Argol, at the southern end of the Eastwind Shore.$BThey were to investigate the iron dwarf presence in the southern hills, but I haven't received any reports yet. Could you check up on them if you're going down that way?

title: It Takes Guts....
obj_text: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to enter Drakil'jin Ruins and collect 5 Drakkari Canopic Jars.
desc_text: Greetings, <class>. It is kind of you to stop and listen to Kraz's tale.$BFor many years Kraz has strained to hear the spirits and do their bidding.$BRecently,  many voices have been crying to Kraz from these ruins. They seek for a peace they cannot find on their own.$BIf you would help the spirits of those who have come before, enter this crypt and collect something that once belonged to those tormented souls.

title: See You on the Other Side
obj_text:
Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to use the Drakil'jin Mallet on the gongs outside Drakil'jin Ruins. Once you have been slain, you are to enter the ruins and speak with the spirit of Gan'jo while you are dead.
 Death by Warlord Jin'arrak
desc_text: These Drakkari have met you with nothing but savage hostility. You owe them nothing. Few indeed would carry out the task that Kraz asks of you today.$BTo cleanse this place and send the spirits to their eternal rest, you must join them in death.$BThere is one inside the crypt who awaits you - on the other side. He holds the knowledge we seek, <name>.$BUse the mallet on the gongs. The spirit of he who corrupts this place will surely deliver you to the spirit world.$BKraz awaits your return.

title: Sasha's Hunt
obj_text:
Sasha wants you to kill 12 Solstice Hunters in Solstice Village.
 Solstice Hunter slain (12)
desc_text: This thing... this curse... that's affecting Silverbrook and Solstice Village... it makes beasts out of people.$BMy father tried to warn them, but they all listened to the wolfcult instead.$BThey're too far gone now, it's time to put them down... for their own sake.

title: The Perfect Plan
obj_text: ring the completed War Golem Blueprint to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
desc_text: The iron dwarves are making no secret of the fact that they're preparing for war. With their giants, golems, and lightning elementals, they'd have a technological advantage against the Westfall Brigade. If they don't find passage north in time, the irons could take them by surprise.$BWe've got to tie them up here, and I've got just the way to do it. Dun Argol is full of rune-smiths churning out war golems. They carry plans for specific pieces, so you'll need to find and assemble all the parts.

title: Drak'aguul's Mallet
obj_text: Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to slay Drak'aguul outside Drakil'jin Ruins and return with the Drakil'jin Mallet.
desc_text: Corruption....$BEven before you delivered these jars, Kraz could sense it. This corruption fills the ancient Drakkari spirits with great angst and prevents them from entering the rest they seek.$BKraz will not lie, <class>. Cleansing this place will require great sacrifice, but we shall speak of that at another time.$BThere is one among the living here who holds the key to its cleansing. Seek out Drak'aguul and return to Kraz with the mallet he carries.

title: Informing the Queen
obj_text: Deliver your Letter of Introduction to Wyrmrest Temple to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <The dragon steward pulls your letter of introduction out of his sleeve.>$BYes... yes, I think that you are ready to see the queen now.$BWhen you are ready, speak to me again and I will see to it that one of these drakes delivers you safely to the top of the temple. You will need to present your letter in person to Queen Alexstrasza.

title: Informing the Queen
obj_text: Deliver your Letter of Introduction to Wyrmrest Temple to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <The dragon steward pulls your letter of introduction out of his sleeve.>$BYes... yes, I think that you are ready to see the queen now.$BWhen you are ready, speak to me again and I will see to it that one of these drakes delivers you safely to the top of the temple. You will need to present your letter in person to Queen Alexstrasza.

title: Nice to Meat You
obj_text: Harkor at Harkor's Camp wants you to collect 10 pieces of Fibrous Worg Meat from Duskhowl Prowlers and 10 Shovelhorn Steaks from Longhoof Grazers.
desc_text: G'day to ya, <class>! Have yerself a seat by me fire, eh?$BI'd offer to share a nice hot meal, only I ain't got one. I'm stuck here waitin' on an associate, or I'd be out tryin' to remedy that situation meself.$BSay, you seem to have nuthin' but time on yer hands and there be plenty o' meat in these parts. What say ya lend a hand and round up some grub?

title: Hollowstone Mine
obj_text: Look for clues inside Hollowstone Mine northwest of the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: I've been meaning to send some of our lads to check out Hollowstone Mine.  Haven't had a chance to yet -- we've had our hands full between the Horde on the west and the iron dwarves to the east.$BIf Dumont sent you, though, the least I can do is point you in the right direction.$BYou'll find the mine entrance to the northwest, not far from here.  See if you think operations there can be salvaged.  We sure could use the additional resources until our mine in Farshire is operational again.

title: Blackout
obj_text:
Use Raegar's Explosives to destroy the Runic Power Core at Dun Argol, then report to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
 Dun Argol Power Core Destroyed
desc_text: The large hall at the top of Dun Argol houses the power source for the entire area. If you can destroy the power core, it will cripple Dun Argol for some time.$BNo power means no golems, no sentries, and no more lightning armaments.$BWhen we were sent up here, they told us these explosives were for excavation, but thanks to Iron Thane Furyhammer, the research has been scrapped. We may as well get some use out of them, though. They're the only thing we have on hand capable of destroying the power core.

title: Why Fabricate When You Can Appropriate?
obj_text: ring 8 War Golem Parts to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
desc_text: We've got the blueprints, but we can't do anything with them without parts! We don't have access to a foundry, much less materials, but there's a whole load of parts up in Dun Argol.$BYour job?$BGive them a new home.$BThey're likely to be scattered around any of the buildings where the iron rune-smiths are working, and I wouldn't blame the irons for being cranky when you try to filch their handiwork. The more parts you can bring, the better we can make this golem.

title: A Name from the Past
obj_text: Return to Captain Gryan Stoutmantle at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: It worked!  It worked!  My comrades can finally enjoy their well-earned rest...$BI'll stay here and finish the job.  We Hollowstone miners always finish the job -- we never give up!$BThat's why Arugal made an example of us.  We wouldn't fall in line, you see?  We wouldn't join his wolfcult!

title: Jin'arrak's End
obj_text:
Kraz at Harkor's Camp wants you to collect the Sacred Drakkari Offering from the Drakil'jin Ruins and use the Drakkari Spirit Dust on it. You must use the Infused Drakkari Offering at the gongs outside of Drakil'jin Ruins.
 Warlord Jin'arrak Destroyed
desc_text: It is good to see you back among the living. Many who travel the path of the dead do not return to speak of it.$BWhile you were away, a vision appeared to Kraz revealing what remains to be done.$BA sacred offering lies somewhere inside the crypt. Take this spirit dust fashioned from the remnants you collected and use it on the offering.$BThe infused offering will bring an end to the corrupted warlord and will release the many tormented souls.$BMay the spirits guide your actions, <name>.

title: Ruuna the Blind
obj_text: Speak to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp near Vordrassil Pass.
desc_text: Hey there.  I overheard what you were saying to the captain and I just want you to know...  things aren't that simple in Northrend.$BJust because someone's dead it doesn't mean they're out of the picture.$BSouthwest of here, near Vordrassil Pass, lives a blind woman who goes by the name Ruuna the Blind.  They say she speaks to the dead and has visions of the past and future.$BI haven't heard your whole story but it sounds like she'd be right up your alley.

title: Souls at Unrest
obj_text:
Petrov at Hollowstone Mine wants you to use the Miner's Lantern to burn the corpses of 8 Hollowstone Miners.
 Miner at Rest (8)
desc_text: <Petrov looks deeply disturbed, breathing heavily and shifting his gaze nervously around the mine.>$BMy comrades... we must put their souls to rest!  I kill them and kill them but.. they just come back!$BI've had an idea for a while but I just don't have the heart to do it myself.$BMaybe you can do this for me?  Take this lantern and use its oil to burn their remains so they never get up again.$BI'll answer your questions later.  Help my friends first!

title: Hour of the Worg
obj_text:
Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post wants you to go to  Bloodmoon Isle and slay Selas, Varlam, Goremaw and the Shade of Arugal.
 Varlam slain
 Selas slain
 Goremaw slain
 Shade of Arugal defeated
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: It is time, then, <name>.  Arugal must be defeated.$BGet a couple of people you can trust and head for Bloodmoon Isle.  It's just off the coast, east of here.$BWe'll hit them fast.  Take out Arugal's lieutenants -- I'll catch up with you when it's time to take out the monster himself.

title: We Have the Power
obj_text: ring Durar's Power Cell and Kathorn's Power Cell to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
desc_text: We're almost there, but the war golem won't run without power cells. From the information I was able to collect in Dun Argol before we were discovered, both Rune-Smith Durar and Rune-Smith Kathorn each create one power cell.$BWe'll need one power cell from each of the rune-smiths before our golem will work.$BYou should be able to find each rune-smith in his workshop on the central level of Dun Argol.

title: Chill Out, Mon
obj_text: Gan'jo wants you to collect the Snow of Eternal Slumber from his chest in the Drakil'jin Ruins.$BYou are to use the Snow on the Ancient Drakkari Spirits there and take their Drakkari Spirit Particles back to Kraz at Harkor's Camp.
desc_text: It be as the prophecies said, mon. A <race> <class> be comin' to set our spirits to rest. We been waitin' for a long time now!$BThe Drakkari have become a lost people, fierce and savage.$BBut here we suffer by no fault of our own, mon. This place need cleansin' and only the living can do it.$BSpeak to me when ya be ready to rejoin your body. Then take the snow from the chest near me here and put my bruddas to sleep.$BTake their remnants to your spirit guide. He be knowin' what to do next.

title: The Captive Prospectors
obj_text:
Free Prospector Gann, Prospector Torgan, and Prospector Varana, then return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
 Prospector Gann Rescued
 Prospector Torgan Rescued
 Prospector Varana Rescued
desc_text: Raegar sent a team of prospectors into Dun Argol to search for artifacts and information about the history of the settlement. Raegar's team never expected Dun Argol to be this heavily populated.$BThey're being held captive while the iron dwarves prepare for war. We haven't the men to charge in after them, and Raegar's too busy fantasizing about defeating the irons to be of much help.$BIt falls to you, <name>. Any of the irons or their servants could be carrying the keys to the cages holding our men.

title: An Intriguing Plan
obj_text: ring the completed War Golem Blueprints to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: Prospector Rokar has decided to help us. He's concocted a plan to use the iron dwarves' strength against them.$BI must admit, our new 'friend' is more insightful than I'd given him credit for. He's correct in that our numbers are too few for a direct attack.$BTravel to Dun Argol, in the snowy regions to the southeast, and capture all the parts of their war golem blueprints from the iron rune-smiths there. Bring the assembled blueprint to Rokar and we'll see if his plan has any merit.

title: The Iron Thane and His Anvil
obj_text:
Using the abilities of your War Golem, defeat Iron Thane Furyhammer, then return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
 Iron Thane Furyhammer slain
desc_text: Now that you've charged up your war golem, we're going to put all that energy to good use. Activate the golem inside Dun Argol to take control of it.$BOur  information about Dun Argol's leader, Iron Thane Furyhammer, suggests his bodyguard protects him from all harm.$BThat bodyguard is the construct he travels with, called The Anvil. Disable the construct, and his protection will disappear.$BThe thane stays in the building at the top of Dun Argol and supervises production from the bottom level.

title: Looking the Part
obj_text: ring an Overseer's Uniform to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
desc_text: If, as Prospector Varana said, only certain irons are permitted to communicate with this Loken, it'll probably be the overseers who have the privilege.$BWe have to get you in there to see what all this is about, but it won't be easy. The first step will be to get a proper uniform for you.$BThen, we'll worry about doing your makeup.$BFind one of the overseers at Dun Argol, kill him, and bring back his uniform. If you get blood on it, you'll have only yourself to blame.

title: Cultivating an Image
obj_text:
Use Kilian's Camera to record the images of 8 Iron Dwarves in Dun Argol, then return to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
 Iron Dwarf Images Captured (8)
desc_text: Now that we've got the uniform, we've got to get enough information to complete your camouflage.$BRaegar brought along this camera to document the team's finds, but I have a different use in mind. I want you to take it with you to Dun Argol and use it to capture the images of iron dwarves.$BOf course, your models aren't going to be a cooperative lot, so you may have to, err... subdue them first. Bring back the camera and the images when you're done.

title: Put on Your Best Face for Loken
obj_text:
Disguise yourself as an Iron Rune Overseer, intercept the message from Loken, then report to Mountaineer Kilian at Prospector's Point.
 Message from Loken received
desc_text: Using the images you've captured, I've created everything you need for your overseer disguise kit. You'll make a fine iron dwarf, if I do say so myself.$BTake the kit with you to Dun Argol, use it to disguise yourself, then go to the easternmost building on the broad middle tier of the city.$BThere, you should see a pedestal where the thane and overseers receive their orders from this Loken. Activate it while disguised and learn all you can from the communication.

title: The Unexpected 'Guest'
obj_text: ring 5 Mature Stag Horns to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: A recent hunting expedition brought back more than just game.$BThey encountered a wounded dwarf fleeing the iron dwarf stronghold of Dun Argol. He may have information we can use to strike at our ancient enemy, but before he's of any use to us, we must bring down his fever.$BThe horns of the silvercoat stags, who roam the nearby forest, have long been used to make healing poultices. If you can bring enough of the horns to me, we'll see if the poultice can bring our 'guest' around.

title: ... Or Maybe We Don't
obj_text:
Charge your War Golem with the energy from 10 Lightning Sentries and return to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
 Charge Level (10)
desc_text: The golem's cells have just enough power to run it at the lowest levels, but it can't power any of its combat systems.$BThe good news is that the perimeter of Dun Argol is patrolled by lightning sentries. We should be able to use their power to charge up the golem's weapon systems.$BBring the golem with you, take it close to them, it will absorb the power as the sentries die.

title: Bringing Down the Iron Thane
obj_text:
Using the abilities of your War Golem, defeat Iron Thane Furyhammer, then return to Tormak the Scarred at Camp Oneqwah.
 Iron Thane Furyhammer slain
desc_text: Now that the golem is fully charged, it can be used against the leader at Dun Argol.$BWhen I observed Iron Thane Furyhammer, he was always guarded by a personal golem that shielded him from all harm.$BThat construct called The Anvil, can be disrupted, causing him to drop the shield. Use your golem's EMP ability to do just that. You'll be able to activate and take control of your golem inside Dun Argol.$BThe thane is in the main plant at the top and supervises production from the bottom level.

title: From the Ground Up
obj_text: ring 8 War Golem Parts to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: We don't have enough time for me to forge the parts myself, but the foundries over at Dun Argol, to the southeast, are working day and night to churn out golem parts.$BI think you should go back there and pick up enough of them for me to make a golem from this blueprint.$BThey're probably scattered around any of the buildings where the iron rune-smiths are working.$BPlease hurry, <name>. That Tormak looks like he's just waiting for an excuse to carry out his threat!

title: We Have the Power
obj_text: ring Durar's Power Cell and Kathorn's Power Cell to Prospector Rokar at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: Well, we've got the shell of a golem, but that's not good enough for Tormak. He doesn't realize that these things don't just come together and miraculously start working! We're going to need power cells to animate it.$BWhen I was in Dun Argol, I noticed that Rune-Smith Durar and Rune-Smith Kathorn were the ones who manufactured the cells. We'll need one from each to power our golem.$BYou should be able to find each rune-smith in his workshop on the central level of Dun Argol.

title: Rallying the Troops
obj_text:
Use the Shard of the Earth to rally the Grizzly Hills Giants fighting in the Boulder Hills, kill any iron dwarves who oppose you, then report to Kurun on the hill overlooking Thor Modan.
 Grizzly Hills Giants Rallied (5)
 Iron Rune Avengers Slain (5)
desc_text: The sons of iron have used their runes to enthrall many of my brothers and are using them to break the siege on Thor Modan. I wish we did not have to fight them, but we have no choice.$BMy giants will not hold out long against them.$BI have imbued this earthen shard with a blessing that will aid our allies. Take it with you to the battle in the Boulder Hills to the north, and use it to reassure and fortify my brethren.$BKill any iron dwarves who would stand in your way.

title: The Bear God's Offspring
obj_text:
Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to speak to Orsonn at the Ragefang Shrine and Kodian at the Heart's Blood Shrine.
 Orsonn's Story
 Kodian's Story
desc_text: It is possible that the furbolg of Grizzly Hills have the same taint that plagued Vordrassil.  They've been involved in a deadly tribal war recently after years of peaceful coexistence.$BThe shrines that they guard to the east are home to Ursoc's offspring.$BIf the corruption has affected the furbolg, it is possible that because of their lineage, Kodian and Orsonn have remained unharmed.$BIf that's the case, find them and listen to what they have to say.

title: Cultivating an Image
obj_text:
Use Rokar's Camera to record the images of 8 Iron Dwarves in Dun Argol, then return to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
 Iron Dwarf Images Captured (8)
desc_text: Now we have to finish the job of making you as repulsive as those iron dwarves.$BThe best way to do that is to base your disguise on the ugly mugs of real iron dwarves.$BWhen Tormak's hunting party discovered that wayward prospector, they took the camera he carried. Now, I suppose, we'll get the chance to use it.$BTake it with you to Dun Argol, kill some iron dwarves, and record their likenesses in this device. Bring it back once you have enough examples.

title: In the Name of Loken
obj_text:
Speak with Hugh Glass and Gavrock about Loken, then report your findings to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqeah.
 Hugh Glass Questioned
 Gavrock Questioned
desc_text: The iron dwarves stand as one of the fiercest and most coordinated foes in Northrend. Wherever we have traveled, they have battled us with the name of Loken on their lips.$BWe must learn who this Loken is and what he seeks. The locals may be of help.$BTo the northeast, at the Redwood Trading Post, a human named Hugh Glass peddles his wares. Further east, at the Ruins of Tethys, you'll find a stone giant named Gavrock. Ask them about this Loken. They've got to know something of use.

title: The Overseer's Shadow
obj_text: ring an Overseer's Uniform to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: It sounds like this Loken is the mastermind behind the sudden preparations for war on the part of the iron dwarves.$BOnly the highest ranking irons are likely to have access to him, so we'll have to make you into an overseer to find out what's going on in there.$BI have a plan, for that, but we'll need some supplies.$BFind one of the iron rune overseers at Dun Argol, to the southeast, kill him, and bring back his uniform.

title: Children of Ursoc
obj_text:
Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to speak to Orsonn at the Rage Fang Shrine and Kodian at the Heart's Blood Shrine.
 Orsonn's Story
 Kodian's Story
desc_text: The furbolgs of Grizzly Hills carry with them a corruption of some kind, that is for sure.  Tribal war has broken out amongst them after years of peaceful coexistence.$BWhat remains to be seen is whether the bears they worship as gods have also been tainted.$BUrsoc's two children, Orsonn and Kodian, dwell in the Heart's Blood Shrine and the Rage Fang Shrine, south and southeast of Grizzlemaw.$BSee if they will speak to you regarding what has happened here.

title: Cleansing Drak'Tharon
obj_text: Drakuru wants you to use Drakuru's Elixir at his brazier inside Drak'Tharon. Using Drakuru's Elixir there will require 5 Enduring Mojo.
desc_text: The time be here at last, good friend.$BDrak'Tharon soon be cleansed of them foul undead and restored to her noble purpose. My soul will be havin' peace, and in return for your help, the keep's most valuable treasures be yours, mon!$BDa keep rises up into a sacred ziggurat. Once ya be reachin' its top, ya must summon me a final time, and I'll perform the ritual.$BAlas, mon, my summonin' will again be comin' at a cost. Ya must collect the mojo from the survivors in the keep,

title: Loken's Orders
obj_text:
Disguise yourself as an Iron Rune Overseer, intercept the message from Loken, then report to Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
 Message from Loken received
desc_text: I've created everything else you'll need for your overseer disguise kit. Try not to retch when you put it on. I took pains to make it as true to reality as possible.$BTake the kit with you southeast to Dun Argol, use it to disguise yourself, then go to the easternmost building on the broad middle tier of the city.$BThere, you should see a pedestal where the thane and overseers receive their orders from this Loken. Activate it while disguised and learn all you can from the communication.

title: Ursoc, the Bear God
obj_text:
Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to find Tur Ragepaw near Ursoc's Den and defeat Ursoc with his help.  Use the Purified Ashes of Vordrassil on Ursoc's Corpse when you've accomplished this.
 Ursoc Cleansed
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: The time has come, <name>.  Now we will learn whether our efforts will accomplish what we need or nothing at all.$BTake these ashes and seek the furbolg that Kodian told you about, Tur Ragepaw, near Ursoc's Den.  You will find the den to the north of Grizzlemaw.$BConvince Tur to aid you, for you will need all the help you can get.$BOnce you've defeated the bear god, use these ashes over his body.$BEven if his worldly form is destroyed, his spirit must be saved.

title: Destroy the Sapling
obj_text: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to take the Verdant Torch and use it to burn Vordrassil's Sapling.  Bring Vordrassil's Ashes back to Windseer Grayhorn.
desc_text: The furbolgs' work must be undone, <name>.  The best of intentions do not count for much when the result is tainted by such strong a corruption.$BThe sapling must be destroyed, for it is the source of this dark influence.  Take this torch and use it to set fire to the corrupted sapling and bring me its ashes.$BOnce cleansed, by fire, I will use what power I can to remove the taint from them.  You will need the ashes to purify Ursoc from the evil power that holds sway over him.

title: Fate and Coincidence
obj_text: Speak to Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post.
desc_text: There are two types of people in this world, <name>.  Those who believe in coincidence and those who don't.$BOn the day I lost my eyesight I was given the gift of clairvoyance.  I suppose you can guess what sort of person I am.$BEarlier today, a young woman named Sasha was granted the same vision you were.  You will want to talk to her.$BYou'll find her directly east of here at the White Pine Trading Post, on the way to Solstice Village.

title: Ursoc, the Bear God
obj_text:
Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to find Tur Ragepaw near Ursoc's Den and defeat Ursoc with his help.  Use the Purified Ashes of Vordrassil on Ursoc's Corpse when you've accomplished this.
 Ursoc cleansed
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: It is time, <name>.  Take these ashes and look for the furbolg that Kodian spoke of.  If he went to seek Ursoc, he will be near his den, north of Grizzlemaw.$BYou will need his help.  You won't be able to defeat Ursoc alone.$BOnce you've defeated Ursoc, use these ashes to purify his spirit.  Only then will we know whether our efforts have been in vain or not.

title: Neltharion's Flame
obj_text:
Use Neltharion's Flame to douse the summoning area in the back of the Maw of Neltharion. Once you get the attention of Rothin the Decaying, kill him, then return to Serinar at the front of the cave.
 Summoning Area Cleansed
 Rothin the Decaying
desc_text: With the cult's ranks thinned and some of their power stripped, it's time to strike at the source of the corruption.$BRothin the Decaying is resurrecting black dragons as magmawyrms in the back of the cave. Go to the summoning chamber and cleanse the remaining bones in the only way that will ensure that they will never be toyed with again... with flame.$BBurning the bones will surely gain Rothin's attention, see to it that he is destroyed as well.$BThe magic in this vial should see the task done.

title: Vordrassil's Seeds
obj_text: Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Grizzlemaw and obtain 8 of Vordrassil's Seeds.
desc_text: We cannot allow Vordrassil to grow again.  If the furbolg regrew it once, they can do it again.$BGo to Grizzlemaw, in central Grizzly Hills, and obtain Vordrassil's seeds.  I will make sure they're properly disposed of.

title: A Sister's Pledge
obj_text: Look for Anya in the Duskhowl Den near Solstice Village.
desc_text: Please, <name>.  I know it is Arugal you're after.  I swear on my father's memory I will help you take him down.$BBut I must beg you... Anya is completely innocent, we cannot leave her with these savages.$BHelp me rescue my sister and you'll have me at your side when you face Arugal.$BI know the den Anatoly spoke of.  We'll find it on the other side of this hill.  Let's go, my sister's in danger.

title: Out of Body Experience
obj_text:
Drink the Gossamer Potion near Ruuna's Crystal Ball and witness the Vision from the Past.
 $BVision from the Past
desc_text: Ah, you seek a vision of the past.  You're a wise <race>.$BEvery time someone drops by for a reading, they seem to always ask about the future.  When you get to be my age, you learn that scrying the past, more often than not, is more useful.$BDrink this potion and peer into my crystal ball.  Let us see what knowledge we can obtain.

title: My Enemy's Friend
obj_text:
Conqueror Krenna in Conquest Hold wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Hunters and their leader, Vladek, at the Forest's Edge Post.
 Silverbrook Hunter slain (8)
 Vladek slain
desc_text: If there is one thing I can get through your head, let it be this: the Alliance will be crushed in the Grizzly Hills.$BThere is far too much lumber, ore, game and strategic territory for us to give up on any single battlefront here.$BSo far we've been successful... but there's something that could tip the scales in our enemy's favor.$BFar to the east  of here, at the Forest Edge's Post, local trappers seek to join the Alliance.  Slaughter them before they have the chance to do so.

title: Vordrassil's Sapling
obj_text: Hierophant Thayreen in Amberpine Lodge wants you to take the Verdant Torch and use it to burn Vordrassil's Sapling.  Bring Vordrassil's Ashes back to Hierophant Thayreen.
desc_text: The druids of old seem to have had good reasons for destroying Vordrassil.  We cannot let the furbolgs regrow it.$BOn the other hand, saving Ursoc's spirit hinges on the magic contained by the sapling.$BTake this torch and use it to burn the tree.  You will find it in the middle of Grizzlemaw, inside Vordrassil's old trunk.$BBring me Vordrassil's ashes.  It is my hope that once purified by fire, we may use its magic to cleanse Ursoc's spirit of its dark taint.

title: Anatoly Will Talk
obj_text:
Sasha at the White Pine Trading Post wants you to take the Tranquilizer Dart and use it on Tatjana in Solstice Village.  Bring Tatjana back to the White Pine Trading Post.
 $BTatjana Delivered
desc_text: My sister is here somewhere, and I can't seem to get this monster to talk.$BHe doesn't seem to care about his own well-being, but I've an idea.  I knew Anatoly's wife, Tatjana, from before the wolfcult arrived -- she was a horse-handler.$BTake this tranquillizer dart.  Bring her back alive, we're going to need her if we're to have any leverage with Anatoly.$BI will help you find the person behind all this once we save my sister.

title: Ruuna's Request
obj_text: Ruuna the Blind wants you to obtain 4 handfuls of Gossamer Dust.
desc_text: I will not charge you gold for my services, for I can foresee that your actions are necessary and much hinges on what you learn today.$BI will, however, ask you to collect a reagent for me.  Obtain gossamer dust from the fern feeder moths northeast of here.  Do this and I will prepare a potion that will take you to the time and place where the events took place that you need to witness.

title: A Bear of an Appetite
obj_text: ring 6 Northern Salmon to Hugh Glass at the Redwood Trading Post.
desc_text: Thank goodness you're back, Limpy! I worried that Griselda and I were going to be all alone.$BI'm cooking up some food here for us, but Griselda'll have none of it.$BShe's fond of the fish that live off the coast of the Eastwind Shore, to the east. Can't stand them myself, but she's always been a picky eater. Six good-sized fish ought to keep her happy for a while.$BNow, run... err... limp along, Joe. Wouldn't want to keep the girl waiting, would ya?

title: Mounting Up
obj_text:
Ride 5 Highland Mustangs back to Squire Percy at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
 Highland Mustangs Returned (5)
desc_text: Cap'n Stoutmantle left most of our calvary... cavlary... uh, horsemen at the fight for Venture Bay.$BWe chose a good place to put the camp 'cause there are tons of highland mustangs running around near here and in the Boulder Hills to the northeast. The Cap'n put me in charge of capturing some of 'em.$BWill you help? I've got a stick and some string, and there are loads of wild carrots growing near the camp. Pick the carrots and use them with the stick to lure in the mustang, then ride it back here.

title: The Horse Hollerer
obj_text:
Scare 15 Highland Mustangs and return to Soulok Stormfury at Camp Oneqwah.
 Highland Mustangs Frightened (15)
desc_text: The Alliance's 'Westfall Brigade' is camped far to the north, near Thor Modan. They have foolishly divided their forces to contest our control of Venture Bay, and they have been left without cavalry.$BThey're now trying to capture and tame the wild highland mustangs that roam the area around the Westfall Brigade Encampment and Boulder Hills. We must stop them before they're able to replace their lost mounts. Take this and throw it near the horses to drive them away.

title: Ruuna the Blind
obj_text: Speak to Ruuna the Blind at Ruuna's Camp near Vordrassil Pass.
desc_text: This trapper business has the potential to be more important than we've accounted for.$BIf they're not with the Alliance, there's a good chance they're with the Scourge, which could mean trouble.$BOur previous efforts might've paid off, though.  We spotted our former captive meeting with a fortune teller of some sort before we lost track of her.$BI'm almost certain now that she will take us to their leader if we can find her again.  Find Ruuna the Blind and see what you can find out.

title: The Conquest Pit: Death Is Likely
obj_text:
Defeat Horgrenn Hellcleave inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.$B
 $BHorgrenn Hellcleave defeated
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: I'm gonna shoot straight with ya, kid.  This next contender's a murderer.$BLiterally.$BHe was to be executed last week, but he strangled the hangman with his left hand, so Krenna's guards sort of let me have him.$BFeel free to pass on this one.  I wouldn't blame ya.

title: The Conquest Pit: Final Showdown
obj_text: Defeat Krenna in the Conquest Pit and speak to Gorgonna for a reward.
desc_text: You must've really upset Krenna.  She and Gorgonna have had a spat and you're wanted in the pit immediately.$BThere are some wild rumors that it's a fight to the death!  That would be bad news for you, but great news for our business venture!$BAt any rate, you can't run away from fate... best get in there on the quick and get it over with.

title: Through Fields of Flame
obj_text:
Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through the southern pass, then kill 6 Frigid Necromancers and eliminate the source of the corruption under the shrine. Return to Vargastrasz once the task is complete.
 Frigid Necromancer slain (6)
 Ruby Corruption Cleansed
desc_text: I have one final task for you, <race>... one that should turn the tide of this fight.$BReturn to the shrine and kill the necromancers that are fueling this onslaught. With them dead, we should be able to beat these forces back and eventually retake the shrine.$BI also need you to find the source of the corruption under the shrine and put an end to it.$BI know I have asked a lot of you, but if you do this for me, we will win this battle.

title: Mystery of the Infinite
obj_text:
Chromie, at the top of Wyrmrest Temple, has asked you to travel to the Bronze Dragonshrine. Once inside, place the Hourglass of Eternity on the ground.$BProtect the hourglass for as long as it lasts and then return to her with whatever information you gain.
 $BHourglass of Eternity protected
desc_text: A time storm at the Bronze Dragonshrine to the northeast is keeping immortals from entering.$BThe Infinite Dragonflight are in a fight inside with the defenders to wrest control of the dragonshrine. We must take this opportunity to gain information.$BYou are not immortal. You can cross into the dragonshrine and use the Hourglass of Eternity. Protect the hourglass for long enough and the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight should be revealed.$BBe warned, the Infinite Dragonflight will try to stop you!

title: The Fate of the Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text: ring Dahlia Suntouch's Ruby Brooch to Krasus in the Ruling Council Chamber at Wyrmrest and inform him of Dahlia's fate.
desc_text: As you pick up the brooch, its faint glow brightens slightly.$BKrasus will want to know of Dahlia's fate. Take the brooch to him at Wyrmrest.

title: Kickin' Nass and Takin' Manes
obj_text:
Stefan in Ebon Watch wants you to use Nass to collect 10 hair samples from Withered Trolls.$BIf you lose Nass, return to Stefan to recover him.
 Hair Samples Collected (10)
desc_text: efore you meet Nass, there's something you should know.$BHe got a toxic dose of blight back in the day, and now he's deaf, blind, and mostly numb.$BIt's not all bad, though. He's virtually immune to the stuff now, which makes him perfect for certain tasks - like the one I'm about to give you.$BThere are many freshly scourged trolls nearby and we need to study the blight's effect on them. Take Nass, and this boot. When you've slain a troll, give him a good kick and he'll know to take a hair sample.

title: You Can Run, But You Can't Hide
obj_text: Stefan in Ebon Watch asked you to go to the Reliquary of Agony to collect 5 Putrid Abomination Guts from the Putrid Abominations and 5 Gooey Ghoul Drools.
desc_text: Once the Scourge have a target in their sights, they'll stop at nothing to acquire it.$BYou're doomed to a mindless existence as a walking corpse....$B<Stefan's face twists into a cruel grin.>$B... unless we can use their desires against them.$BI'll explain later. I have complex magic to prepare which requires certain material components.$BTravel due east of here to the Reliquary of Agony. Slay abominations and gather the ghoul drool you'll find there then return to me with their remnants.

title: Dark Horizon
obj_text:
Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to speak to Gorebag and take the tour of Zul'Drak.
 Tour of Zul'Drak complete
desc_text: Ahh, another supplicant answerin' da Lich King's call.$B<Drakuru sniffs you.>$BFreshly scourged, eh? Ya still be reekin' of da living!$BLong be da line of dem who seek da Lich King's blessings. Ya must rise above da masses and prove yerself worthy of wieldin' true power.$BLookin' down over Zul'Drak, I sensed potential in ya. I ordered your - invitation.$BDa rest be up ta you....$BGo an' speak ta Gorebag for a tour of Zul'Drak. Dere be much ta do if you're to be of any worth to me.

title: Reunited
obj_text:
Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to speak to Gorebag and take the tour of Zul'Drak.
 Tour of Zul'Drak complete
desc_text: <name>!$BYa musta received mah gift! Turn around, mon, lemme get a good look at ya... Ahh, ya make me proud.$BWe come such a long way, you and I, and now we be servin' da Lich King together.$BStick with me and big things be comin, mon. Big things... but first, we need to be gettin' ya caught up. So much been happenin' since I saw ya last.$BGo speak ta Gorebag for a tour of Zul'Drak. Listen for me and I'll tell ya all ya be needin' ta know.

title: Through Fields of Flame
obj_text:
Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through one of the northern or southern passes, then kill 6 Frigid Necromancers and eliminate the source of the corruption under the shrine. Return to Ceristrasz once the task is complete.
 Frigid Necromancer slain (6)
 Ruby Corruption Cleansed
desc_text: I have one final task for you, <race>... one that should turn the tide of this fight.$BReturn to the shrine and kill the necromancers that are fueling this onslaught. With them dead, we should be able to beat these forces back and eventually retake the shrine.$BI also need you to find the source of the corruption under the shrine and put an end to it.$BI know I have asked a lot of you, but if you do this for me, we will win this battle.

title: Near Miss
obj_text:
Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to take the Unliving Choker to Bloodrose Datura.
 Choker's Purpose Exposed
desc_text: It was either wisdom or luck that prevented you from wearing this choker, <race>.$BEither way, your acquiring it was no random occurance. You've been targeted by someone, or something....$BTake your choker to Bloodrose, here. Let her demonstrate the fate that nearly befell you.

title: Infiltrating Voltarus
obj_text:
Stefan wants you to use your Ensorcelled Choker to get into Voltarus and do whatever the Scourge leader there asks of you.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
 Overlord Drakuru's task complete
desc_text: y now you've probably guessed the details of my plan.$BWe're using the Scourge's interest in you against them. You're going undercover. I know it's likely a death sentence, but if we do nothing your death is a certainty.$BTravel northeast to Reliquary of Pain and stand on the platform while wearing your disguise. Once inside Voltarus, you must earn the trust of the Scourge commander.$BWhen you've completed your mission, blow this horn and I'll fly to your location to receive your report.

title: Close Call
obj_text:
Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to take the Writhing Choker to Bloodrose Datura.
 Choker's purpose exposed
desc_text: It was either wisdom or luck that prevented you from wearing this choker, <race>.$BEither way, your acquiring it was no random occurence. You've been targeted by someone, or something....$BTake your choker to Bloodrose, here. Let her demonstrate the fate that nearly befell you.

title: Feedin' Da Goolz
obj_text:
Gristlegut at the Reliquary of Agony wants you to use Bowels and Brains Bowl next to 10 Decaying Ghouls.
 Decaying Ghouls Fed (10)
desc_text: Git o'er heer, gool! Yeh, I talkin' to yoo.$BIt feedin' time now. Gotta git da grub ta all da gools!$BSpeshal grub dis time! Bowels an' brainz bowl... num, num, num.$BJus drop da bowl nexta da gool. Gud way ta make frenz.$BYoo got goolfrenz? Ha, ha, hah!

title: Darkness Calling
obj_text: Take the Writhing Choker to Stefan in Ebon Watch.
desc_text: Crafted of bone and dripping with blood, this choker is of intricate and deliberate design.$BGazing upon it overwhelms you with an ominous presence - one that compels you to wear it. You fight the urge, and resolve to bring it back to Ebon Watch.$BIf anyone can explain this, a death knight can....

title: An Invitation, of Sorts...
obj_text: Take the Unliving Choker to Stefan at Ebon Watch.
desc_text: Crafted of bone and dripping with blood, this choker is of intricate and deliberate design.$BGazing upon it overwhelms you with an ominous presence - one that compels you to wear it. You fight the urge, and resolve to bring it back to Ebon Watch.$BIf anyone can explain this, a death knight can....

title: Shimmercap Stew
obj_text: Prigmon in Granite Springs wants you to collect 5 Shimmering Snowcaps and 5 Ice Serpent Eyes from Drak'Zin Ruins and 5 Sweetroot from Zeb'Halak.
desc_text: Say, while yer here, how bout ya help ol' Prigmon with a little chore? I got a friend who can make a mean stew - one like ya never tasted before!$BThere be a few ingredients found in these parts that he be needin'. They be in ruins to the southwest and the camp just north o' here.$BWhatd'ya say, mon?

title: So Far, So Bad
obj_text:
Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to return to Drakuru and complete any tasks he has for you.$BWhile at the Reliquary of Pain, you are to use the Diluting Additive on 5 Blight Cauldrons.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
 Drakuru's task complete
 Blight Cauldrons diluted (5)
desc_text: Everything you've reported is consistent with what we know. Learning of Drakuru and earning his trust will lay the groundwork for your future missions.$BReturn to him and do as he says. Do whatever you must to appear sincere, <name>. A great deal is riding upon your performance.$BThis time I'm adding an additional assignment: While you're in the field, pour this additive into their blight cauldrons. It should neutralize the scourging agent and render the batch useless.

title: Suit Up!
obj_text: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to use the Ensorcelled Choker to apply the Scourge disguise.$BWhile in Scourge form, you are to purchase Bitter Plasma from Gristlegut.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
desc_text: There... I've created a disguise that should make you indistinguishable from the Scourge.$BYou'll be free to walk among them as long as the disguise holds. Only the blightguards will be able to see through my illusion. Watch out for them!$BAnother thing you must know is that the disguise is unstable and may drop unexpectedly, so stay alert.$BLet's test it out. Use the choker and visit the Scourge vendor just east of here. Return to me with a bottle of bitter plasma.

title: Dressing Down
obj_text: Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to use the Ensorceled Choker to apply the Scourge disguise.$BWhile in Scourge form, you are to purchase Bitter Plasma from Gristlegut.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
desc_text: There... I've created a disguise that should make you indistinguishable from the Scourge.$BYou'll be free to walk among them as long as the disguise holds. Only the blightguards will be able to see through my illusion. Watch out for them!$BAnother thing you must know is that the disguise is unstable and may drop unexpectedly, so stay alert.$BLet's test it out. Use the choker and visit the Scourge merchant just east of here. Return to me with a bottle of bitter plasma.

title: Silver Lining
obj_text: Stefan in Ebon Watch asked you to go to the Reliquary of Agony to collect 5 Putrid Abomination Guts from the Putrid Abominations and 5 Gooey Ghoul Drools.
desc_text: Once the Scourge have a target in their sights, they'll stop at nothing to acquire it.$BYou're doomed to a mindless existence as a walking corpse....$B<Stefan's face twists into a cruel grin.>$B... unless we can use their desires against them.$BI'll explain later. I have complex magic to prepare which requires certain material components.$BTravel due east of here to the land beneath the Reliquary of Agony. Slay the ghouls and abominations you'll find there and return to me with their remnants.

title: It Rolls Downhill
obj_text:
Overlord Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to use the Scepter of Suggestion on the Blight Geists and then order them to harvest 7 Blight Crystals.
 Blight Crystals collected (7)
desc_text: If ya ever gonna be worthy of da Lich King's gifts, ya must learn ta be a great leader - one who be commandin' respect!$BI got a task dat gonna refine your command skills, mon....$BSumma my minions be trained ta harvest blight crystals from da land below, but dey be lazy and slow. You gonna be in charge o' dem, mon.$BTake dis scepter and teach 'em how to get da job done. When dey be under your control, make 'em harvest dem crystals!

title: Sabotage
obj_text:
Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to perform another task for Drakuru.$BAdditionally, you are to use the Explosive Charges on 5 Scourgewagons at the  Reliquary of Pain.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
 Scourgewagons destroyed (5)
 Drakuru's task complete
 Learn Drakuru's secret
desc_text: While we're working to discover the purpose of these crystals, we need you back in Voltarus doing Drakuru's bidding.$BEvery task you perform successfully gets you closer to him, and brings us that much nearer to knowing his mind.$BWhile you're there, I have another mission for you. Drakuru's Scourgewagons pose a significant threat. We need them destroyed.$BMake your way to the wagons and activate these charges. Once they're set, get clear! The explosion will expose you if you're too close.

title: Shifting Priorities
obj_text: Scout Vor'takh wants you to travel to Zul'Drak and report to Sergeant Riannah at Light's Breach.$BMakki Wintergale in Camp Onequah will provide you transportation.
desc_text: As pressing as our needs are here, there's news from the lands to the north that cannot be ignored.$BI've just received a message from the Argent Crusade. It seems that scourge forces are gathering there and are threatening to overrun Zul'drak.$BNeedless to say, <name>, if that were to happen our struggle here would be meaningless. You must go there and aid the Crusaders in beating back the Lich King's armies.$BSpeak to Makki when you are ready to travel.

title: Fuel for the Fire
obj_text:
Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to use the Scepter of Command on Bloated Abominations and then use their abilities at the Frigid Breach to kill 60 Drakkari Skullcrushers and lure out 3 Drakkari Chieftains.$BChieftains will appear when enough Skullcrushers have been slain.
 Drakkari Skullcrushers Slain (60)
 Drakkari Chieftain Lured (3)
desc_text: It be time we start our march to Gundrak, mon.
