It be time for me ta turn ya loose on dem trolls!$BDey breached our wall and put a whole army just north of us.$BHahaha!$BDey be fuel for da fire, mon! We gunna take da chieftiains an' kill da rest! It all be part of my master plan....$BYou take dis scepter and go command my abominations. Bring 'em to da Drakkari army and kill em all! When da chieftains come, my pet Shalewing gunna snatch 'em up and bring 'em here to me.

title: Disclosure
obj_text:
Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to take the teleporter to his upper chamber.
 Drakuru's upper chamber explored
desc_text: Ya doin' well, <name>.$BYou be provin' dat I got an eye for talent! Now ya see why da Lich King gave me his blessing....$BDa time has come for me to reveal my master plan to ya, mon.$BNow you be seein' how we gunna sweep through da swarms of Drakkari trolls to take our rightful place in da great palace of Gundrak.$BTake dis scepter, mon. It be a token of my trust in ya. With it, you be able ta access my upper chamber and witness for yourself our secret weapons.

title: The Steward of Wyrmrest Temple
obj_text: Speak with Tariolstrasz at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: You've proved that you're to be trusted and more.$BYou should return to Wyrmrest Temple and speak with the steward, Tariolstrasz, once more, <name>.

title: Hazardous Materials
obj_text:
Stefan at Ebon Watch wants you to go to Voltarus and complete any tasks Drakuru has for you. While there, you are to steal 5 Harvested Blight Crystals.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
 Drakuru's task complete
desc_text: light crystals?! What could this scumbag Drakuru be up to? Clearly, he's working on something significant.$BContinue to do his bidding and perhaps once he's more familiar with you he'll reveal his plans. In the meantime, we need to have a look at these crystals.$BWhile you're in Voltarus, try to get some samples of the harvested crystals when no one's looking.$BBe alert! Handling those crystals can trigger your disguise to fail.

title: Zero Tolerance
obj_text:
Drakuru in Voltarus wants you to go to the Reliquary of Pain and use the Scepter of Empowerment on a Servant of Drakuru. You are then to use its abilities to defeat Darmuk.
 Darmuk Slain
desc_text: Ignorance! Dis be intolerable, mon! My entire batch of blight be useless!$BDat mongrel, Darmuk! He be responsible for watchin over da blight. He failed me, mon!$BDis be a good lesson for ya, <name>. Failure be like a disease dat spreads. Ya gotta catch it and kill it early, before it be killin' you!$BTake dis scepter. It make my scourged trolls stronger. Use dem ta kill Darmuk. He be lurkin' down below just to da south.$BLet dat be an example to all, mon. Don't be failin' Drakuru!

title: The Steward of Wyrmrest Temple
obj_text: Speak with Tariolstrasz at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: You've proved that you're to be trusted and more.$BYou should return to Wyrmrest Temple and speak with the steward, Tariolstrasz, once more, <name>.

title: Reallocating Resources
obj_text: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to report to Sergeant Riannah at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.$BYou may speak to Samuel Clearbook for transportation to Light's Breach.
desc_text: Listen up, <class>!$BYour days here are numbered. As much as we need capable <class>s in our ranks, there's trouble up north that makes our problems look like a mid-summer Stormwind parade.$BTurns out the Scourge are concentrating their efforts - making a big push to take over Zul'Drak. If that happens, we may as well pack it in.$BYou're free to finish any business here, but then it's off to Light's Breach with you. Speak to Samuel if you need transportation.$BDismissed.

title: DEPRICATED>>Enemy of Our Enemy
obj_text: Sergeant Riannah in Light's Breach wants you to speak with Stefan in Ebon Watch and offer your assistance.
desc_text: As much as we find working with death knights distasteful, we cannot afford to be picky about our allies here.$BWe're pinched between the Scourge and the savage Drakkari, who want nothing more than to destroy us so that they can get at one another.$BTravel west to Ebon Watch. Speak with Stefan and see if you can be of service to him.

title: Into the Breach!
obj_text: Crusader Valus at Light's Trust wants you to report to Sergeant Riannah at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: Ready yourself, <class>. I'm dispatching you to Light's Breach, northeast of here.$BI've received word that the Scourge are making a push to take over Zul'Drak.$B<Valus stares you dead in the eyes.>$BThis will not come to pass.$BSee to it that you assist in the destruction of the Scourge there. The light demands it.$BDismissed.

title: Taking a Stand
obj_text: loodrose Datura at Ebon Watch wants you to speak with Commander Falstaav at The Argent Stand.
desc_text: A few moments ago I spotted a signal flare over the treeline to the east.$BThat can only mean that things are not going smoothly for the Crusaders at Argent Stand.$BI cannot leave our post here, <race>, but you can. When time permits, make your way up to Commander Falstaav and see if there's anything you can do to lighten their burden.

title: First Things First
obj_text: Commander Kunz at Argent Stand wants you to report to Sergeant Riannah at Light's Breach.
desc_text: Listen up, <race>!$BThis entire region is full of crises. Everywhere you look you'll find those who could use your assistance.$B<Kunz looks you squarely in the eye.>$BNo one needs your help right now more than Riannah. The scourge have forced their way between us, leaving her and those she commands isolated.$BLight's Breach, where her forces are holding out, lies just southwest of here.

title: Smoke on the Horizon
obj_text: Khufu in Zim'Torga wants you to travel to Light's Breach and report to Sergeant Riannah there.$BMaaka will provide you with transportation there.
desc_text: You hear that, <race>?$BThe clamor of battle far to the west reaches us here, even over the din of our own struggle.$BThe Scourge are threatening to break through the lines of those calling themselves the Argent Crusade. Preventing this is as urgent as anything in the region.$BTravel to Light's Breach and join in their struggle. Speak to Maaka and he will provide you safe passage.

title: Wanted: Ragemane's Flipper
obj_text: Recover Ragemane's Flipper and return it to Chief Rageclaw at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: Posted by Chief Rageclaw:$BChief Rageclaw trusty lion seal, Ragemane, bite hand that feed him. Rageclaw say Ragemane no more good because of bad Drakuru trolls. Chief Rageclaw very sad to ask that Ragemane be killeded and Ragemane flipper be returned to chief as proof.$BYou find Ragemane to southeast, at Rageclaw Lake.$BChief Rageclaw sorry for bad writing. First time use one of these things; plus, Chief Rageclaw is wolvar, not person.

title: This Just In: Fire Still Hot!
obj_text:
Elder Shaman Moky at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak wants you to use the Rageclaw Fire Extinguisher to douse 15 hut fires at Rageclaw Den.$B
 Hut Fire Doused (15)
desc_text: Trolls attack Rageclaw Den and kick Rageclaw out! It get worse. Trolls now burning village! This very bad. Chief make top Rageclaw shaman, Moky, do study on fire. Results very surprising! Fire still hot and can burn things.$BWill you help Rageclaw and put fire out? Moky has special Rageclaw fire extinguisher for you. Use special fire extinguisher to put out fire at Rageclaw Den to southeast. Sometimes take many sprays to douse fire, but extinguisher always have water! Rageclaw magic strong!

title: Trolls Is Gone Crazy!
obj_text:
Chief Rageclaw at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak wants you to use the Drakuru "Lock Openers" found on various Drakuru trolls to free 8 Captured Rageclaw.
 Captured Rageclaw Freed (8)
desc_text: Drakuru... You know who this troll is? I think bad troll are controlled by the Drakuru troll. They call themself Drakuru trolls - that how I know. Now you see why I am chief of Rageclaw. Smartest of all wolvar!$BBut that not why I talk to you now. Bad troll come and kick Rageclaw out of den. Rageclaw that no run away held as prisoner in village. You go to Rageclaw Den, southeast, and free captured Rageclaw. Kill troll for lock opener. You maybe kill many troll for many lock opener.

title: Siphoning the Spirits
obj_text: Captain Arnath at Heb'Valok wants you to collect 5 Ancient Ectoplasms from the Lost Drakkari Spirits at the Pools of Zha'Jin.
desc_text: You should be happy he's coming, they said. You'll enjoy his company, they said....$BWell it's not as if I had a choice in the matter. Finklestein is the Crusade's best alchemist. I suppose I should be honored that he's chosen my post to set up shop. But ever since he's arrived, I've been relegated to collecting various alchemical ingredients.$BSay, <race>, how about you give me a hand? Just south of here are some pools that are haunted by spirits of ancient trolls. Collect their ectoplasm for me.

title: Crusader Forward Camp
obj_text: Seek out Crusader MacKellar at the Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: Crusader Dargath, Crusader MacKellar, Engineer Reed and the twins, Gerk and Burr, were sent to the Dead Fields to establish a battle front days ago. As of my last correspondence with them, they had successfully established a camp on the border of the Dead Fields, northwest of here.$BIn light of this newfound information about Drakuru and Prince Navarius I think it would be prudent to send someone to the Crusader Forward Camp post-haste.$BPack up your belongings, <name>. You must leave at once!

title: In Search Of Answers
obj_text: Search Rageclaw Den for a clue about who or what initiated the attacks against the Rageclaw Wolvar.
desc_text: These poor creatures are the only survivors.$BAccording to their chief, the Drakkari trolls and Rageclaw wolvar have been allies for thousands of years. They've been living here, alongside the trolls, for generations, completely unaware of the ever changing world around them. To the Rageclaw, a troll is a troll, so the troll attack upon their den took them by surprise.$BWe need some answers, <name>. Scour their village - southeast of here - for clues as to who or what is in charge of these attacks.

title: Orders From Drakuru
obj_text: Return the Orders From Drakuru to Crusader Lord Lantinga at Light's Breach in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: Minions be hearin' da call of your masta! Da Lich King be givin' Drakuru full control of da armies of da Scourge in Zul'Drak. We be commanded ta kill everyting.$BEVERYTING MUST DIE!$BWe be processin' all da corpses in da Dead Fields and sendin' em up ta Prince Navarius' crew in  Zeramas for Scourgin'! Notin' goes ta waste on Drakuru's watch!$BSoon we be drinkin' da blood of da prophets ta become stronger dan eva before! Zul'Drak and Gundrak gonna fall to da Scourge!

title: Defend the Stand
obj_text:
Commander Falstaav has tasked you with the destruction of any 10 Scourge in the courtyard at The Argent Stand.
 $BScourge at The Argent Stand destroyed (10)

 Rotting Abomination
 Rampaging Geist
 Scourgeheart Drakkari
 Drakkari Corpse
$B

 Sky Terror
 Flying Fiend
 Gooey Ghoul Drool
 Carrion Eater
desc_text: Despite our substantial successes in the lower third of Zul'Drak, we must still face the onslaught of the Scourge. Such is the way in this frigid hell.$BThe attacks are unrelenting, yet my men need rest. If you are willing, we could use your aid in reinforcing them.$BBelow in the courtyard you'll find no end to the fighting. Dispatch the Scourge there with all the zeal you can muster, <class>.

title: Words for Delivery
obj_text: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
desc_text: Here we go. This is the speech, <name>!$BIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes. Never has a finer speech been written!$BTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and get some transportation to High Tinker Mekkatorque!

title: Defending Wyrmrest Temple
obj_text:
Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple has asked you to slay 3 Azure Dragons, slay 5 Azure Drakes, and to destabilize the Azure Dragonshrine while riding a Wyrmrest Defender into battle.
 Azure Dragon slain (3)
 Azure Drake slain (5)
 Destabilize the Azure Dragonshrine
desc_text: Emboldened by the overabundance of magic now flowing through the Azure Dragonshrine, the blue dragonflight has dared to attack Wyrmrest Temple itself!$BI ask that you ride one of our defenders into battle to slay their dragons and drakes, and to attack the eruption of ley line energies at the dragonshrine itself in order to destabilize it.$BOutside on the east and west terraces are wyrmrest defenders. Speak with one to ride it into battle.$BWithout your help, <name>, we will surely lose.

title: Welcome to Sholazar Basin
obj_text: Follow the path to the northwest to reach the camp that Monte mentioned.
desc_text: So, where did you come from? I don't suppose that fool of an archmage sent you, too?$BYou're lucky to be in one piece, <laddie/lass>! They nearly blew you up!$BThe jungle here's a darned dangerous place, 'specially with the Venture Company about.$BGit you! Go see the boss... he'll sort you out. The camp's at the end of that path to the northwest.$BNow, git!

title: Operation: Gnomeregan
obj_text:
Help King Mekkatorque with the assault on Gnomeregan.
 Regain the Surface of Gnomeregan
desc_text: Momentarily,the multi-phased assault upon Gnomeregan will begin and Mekgineer Thermaplugg and his men will be brought to justice!  Too long has Thermaplugg festered in the depths of our home,defended by a corrupt and irradiated army.$BThe assault begins in but a moment! Be ready recruit,this fight will not be for the faint-hearted.

title: Words for Delivery
obj_text: Ride 'Thunderflash' from Steelgrill Depot to High Tinker Mekkatorque and deliver Toby's speech.
desc_text: All right,soldier. Time to prove your worth!$BTake the speech and board the flying machine "Thunderflash".  It's the fastest ship to High Tinker Mekkatorque and this speech is the only thing he's waiting on before starting Operation: Gnomeregan.$BGo! Now!

title: The Ebon Watch
obj_text: Deliver the Orders From Drakuru to Stefan Vadu at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: West of here, across the ruined roads and structures, is the death knight encampment of Ebon Watch.$B<Crusader Lord Lantinga rolls up Drakuru's orders.>$BTake these orders and deliver them to Stefan Vadu. He is the death knight in command at Ebon Watch. Let him know that the Argent Crusade will deal with Prince Navarius. They'll have to handle Drakuru.$BBe careful, <name>. The way to Ebon Watch is teeming with Scourge.

title: Troll Patrol
obj_text:
Commander Kunz at the Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their captain's orders, and then return and report to him.$BCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Captain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, and Alchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'Valok.
 Captain Brandon's Task
 Captain Rupert's Task
 Captain Grondel's Task
 Alchemist Finklestein's's Task
desc_text: Unsheathe that weapon, <race>. It's time to go on patrol!$BI've got four posts under my command and it's crucial to our success that they remain in our control. I'm ordering you to visit each of them and offer your assistance.$BYou can begin with Captain Brandon southeast of here. He'll direct you to the next post when he's finished with you.$BReport back to me once you've assisted each of my men. And remember, you'll be more richly rewarded for returning to me quickly - so double-time it!$BDismissed!

title: Argent Crusade, We Are Leaving!
obj_text:
Sergeant Stackhammer at the Altar of Sseratus wants you to speak with 10 of his Argent Soldiers and tell them to report back to him.
 Argent Soldiers told to report back to the sergeant (10)
desc_text: <The sergeant quickly reads through the orders you've handed him, a frown coming over his face.>$BLook, <lad /lass>, I'd love to just up and leave, but take a look out there. All of my people are fighting.$BTell you what, you've come this far, you think you're up to doing me a small favor? Head out there and round up my soldiers?$BTell 'em that the sergeant orders them to report back immediately. Lend them a hand if you will.

title: Troll Patrol: High Standards
obj_text:
Captain Brandon wants you to place the Argent Crusade Banner in the Drakkari Pedestals at Drak'Sotra.
 Argent Crusade Banner South
 Argent Crusade Banner North
 Argent Crusade Banner East
desc_text: Listen, <class>. This is the Argent Crusade. Our men will fight to the end and never complain no matter what the conditions.$BThat said, we've taken some heavy casualties in this campaign and we've been hitting it hard with little or no sleep for months. That all takes a toll on morale, whether we admit it or not.$BIt may not seem like much, but seeing our standard raised over the battlefield is of considerable comfort to a soldier. Take these banners and raise them at the pedestals in Drak'Sotra.

title: Planning for the Future
obj_text: Collect 12 Snowfall Glade Pups. Deliver them to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor.
desc_text: We must move decisively against the wolvar if we're to have a chance of survival. However, I worry that in our zeal, too many of them will be slain.$BThe Snowfall Glade wolvar have as much right to exist as do we. You and I will see to it that they get that chance.$BIf Elder Ko'nani hasn't asked you already, he will ask you to deal with them.  While you're upon the glade to the north, I'd like you to bag up their pups and bring them back to me.

title: Troll Patrol: Intestinal Fortitude
obj_text:
Captain Rupert in Drak'Sotra wants you to restore courage to the cowering Crusade Recruits.
 Recruit's Courage Restored (5)
desc_text: Finally, the patrol arrives!$BHere's the situation, <race>. We've lost many of our finest soldiers in this campaign and have had to call upon our recruits to fill in the gaps.$BWe've just fought one of our fiercest battles and many of the recruits were simply not prepared to face this enemy. There are more fights ahead, and I need them ready to follow orders.$BIf there's one thing I can't stomach, it's cowardice. Perhaps you can help them find the courage to continue.

title: Trouble at the Altar of Sseratus
obj_text:
Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand has asked you to investigate the main altar building at the Altar of Sseratus.
 $BMain building at the Altar of Sseratus investigated.
desc_text: There's trouble at the altar of the snake god.$BThe presence of the Scourge has weakened the land, <race>. This in turn has weakened the wild gods.$BWe know that the Drakkari are taking advantage of this to do evil things to the gods.$BI need you to be my eyes and ears. The Altar of Sseratus is at the end of the avenue to the north. Sneak around the back and get a look inside of the main altar building.$BWhatever you do, avoid the prophet at all costs!

title: Mopping Up
obj_text:
Corporal Maga at the Altar of Sseratus wants you to kill any combination of 10 Champions of Sseratus, Priests of Sseratus, or Drakkari Snake Handlers.
 $BFollowers of Sseratus slain (10)

 Drakkari Snake Handler
 Priest of Sseratus
$B

 Champion of Sseratus
desc_text: I couldn't help but overhear what you were talking to the sergeant about. That doesn't change the fact that we still have a job to do here.$BWhile you're out there, do you think you could help us to put some of those followers of Sseratus out of their misery?

title: New Orders for Sergeant Stackhammer
obj_text: Commander Kunz has asked you to deliver the New Deployment Orders to Sergeant Stackhammer at the Altar of Sseratus.
desc_text: <class>, you're here to help, right? I've got new orders for our forces that are currently deployed at the Drakkari altar to the north.$BYou can't miss it. Just head straight up the avenue. Sergeant Stackhammer shouldn't be hard to find.

title: Leave No One Behind
obj_text:
Dr. Rogers at Drak'Sotra wants you to find Crusader Lamoof, Crusader Jonathan, and Crusader Josephine. Use the Crusader's Bandage on them, and escort them safely back to him.
 Saved Crusader Jonathan
 Saved Crusader Lamoof
 Saved Crusader Josephine
desc_text: Ahh, good. They sent someone.$BListen, <race>. We need a hand here. Our forces were pushed back and we've lost Drak'Sotra to the Scourge. Where they came from is anyone's guess....$BThe point is, we need every man we can get here, and some of our best have yet to return from battle.$BI need you to enter the ruins now that the fighting has died down and find our wounded, patch them up, and bring them here to me.$BScour Drak'Sotra! They couldn't have gone far.

title: Precious Elemental Fluids
obj_text: Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand wants you to acquire 3 Precious Elemental Fluids.
desc_text: <The hexxer examines the decanter of mojo.>$BI have an idea for how to deal with the prophet of Sseratus. But first, we're going to need some things.$BThe Drak'Sotra Fields are directly to the south. Because of the stresses on the land from the Scourge and the deaths of gods, the wall between worlds has weakened and the elementals are flooding in.$BWe need the precious fluids of their lords. If you combine three links from the elementals a tether will be made, and one of their lords can be summoned.

title: Too Much of a Good Thing
obj_text:
Slay the Muddled Prophet of Sseratus and then return to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.
 Muddled Prophet of Sseratus slain
desc_text: There. I've modified the mojo. Now when the prophet drinks it, not only will he lose some of his power, his mind will also be addled by the effects of the fungus.$BAt least that's the theory.$BAs for how to get him to drink it, might I suggest you simply throw it at him? No doubt he'll catch and drink it given the arrogance that he's displayed at the altar.$BUnless you can kill him, <class>, your Argent Crusade is about to come to a terrible end.

title: Rhino Mastery: The Test
obj_text:
Kill 15 Shardhorn Rhinos and return to Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
 Shardhorn Rhino slain (15)
desc_text: No rough landing is going to stop ol' Hemet from mastering the largest game Sholazar has to offer. In the wilds northwest of the camp, the jungles are ruled by the mighty shardhorn rhino. You can prove your worth to the expedition, <lad/lass>, by showing me that you're tough enough to face down those powerful beasts.

title: Troll Patrol: Whatdya Want, a Medal?
obj_text: Captain Grondel outside the Coliseum wants you to gather 7 Drakkari Medallions from the nearby Drakkari Corpses.
desc_text:
Look at me, <race>. Do I look like I have time fer fillin' out reports?$BIt be all I can do to keep this post free o' the bloody Scourge, and they want me to mess with paperwork!$B No sense in complainin'. I need to get the commander some kinda kill count from the last skirmish.$BYou wanna be helpful? Go and get me all the medals you can find from the dead trolls around here. That'll hafta be close enough.
                Progress
You get those medals for me, <race>?$B
Completion
Well, now!$BYa saved me a fair bit o' work there <lad/lass>. I'm grateful. I'll be sure ta make mention of ya in me report.$BOff with yeh now. Finklestein'll likely be waitin fer ya a bit west o' here.$B
Rewards
The following spell will be cast on you:                 $B


Captain Grondel Kill Credit
 


$B
You will receive: 1 58  (or 3 18  if completed at level 80)                $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
5,300 experience$B

Related

title: Where in the World is Hemet Nesingwary?
obj_text: Talk to Archmage Pentarus when you're ready to leave for Sholazar Basin. When you arrive, speak with Monte Muzzleshot in the Wildgrowth Mangal of Sholazar Basin.
desc_text: When I heard that the legendary Hemet Nesingwary was setting sail for the Sholazar Basin, I offered to help fund his expedition. We know little of Sholazar,  but it's said to be a lush paradise in the midst of this frozen continent.$BHemet has agreed to send back samples of exotic plants, reagents, and crystals. There hasn't been any word from him. Monte Muzzleshot was supposed to be bringing them supplies, but he hasn't returned, either. If you'll look into it, I'll send you in my flying machine.

title: Mushroom Mixer
obj_text: Collect 10 Muddlecap Fungus and deliver them to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.
desc_text: Now what we need is something to spike the mojo with. Something that'll make it so that when the prophet drinks it, he'll become less powerful.$BDrak'Agal lies to the east. There's a mushroom there that the natives call muddlecap fungus. I think it's exactly what we need.$BBring back lots of them. When we mix them into the mojo, the mind of anyone who drinks it will become muddled.

title: Wipe That Grin Off His Face
obj_text:
Kill Foreman Swindlegrin and Meatpie and return to Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
 Foreman Swindlegrin slain
 Meatpie slain
desc_text: We must send Foreman Swindlegrin packing if we're going to shut down his mine permanently, but be careful. His bodyguard, Meatpie, is a large, mean ogre, and  isn't likely to let you see the foreman without a fight.$BThe two probably occupy a platform that would let them look out over the entire Venture Company operation at Swindlegrin's Dig.$BRemember, the dig is on the far side of the Suntouched Pillar to the northeast. Good luck, <name>.

title: Troll Patrol: The Alchemist's Apprentice
obj_text:
Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok wants you to assist him in the creation of a truth serum.$BWhen you are ready to begin, you are to speak to him and follow his instructions.
 Truth Serum Created
desc_text: Ahh, you must be the promised patrol. Your timing couldn't be better. I have urgent need of an extra pair of hands.$BWe have a Drakkari prisoner who's been sent here to undergo questioning. Before the interrogation begins, I require assistance in the creation of a truth serum.$BCreating a truth serum is tricky business, demanding keen instincts, perfect timing, and improvisation at every step.$BLet me know when you're ready, <race>. And remember, timing is everything!

title: Dreadsaber Mastery: Becoming a Predator
obj_text:
Kill 15 Dreadsabers and return to Buck Cantwell at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
 Dreadsaber slain (15)
desc_text: If you've hunted with Hemet before, you know that he's tested his skill against many large cats, but the dreadsabers here in Sholazar are different. They're able to bring down larger game than I've ever seen a cat hunt. To overcome and kill such a predator is the mark of a true hunter.$BIf you seek to prove you're up to the challenge, test yourself against the dreadsabers. They live in the wilderness surrounding the camp and south of the river.

title: Venture Co. Misadventure
obj_text:
Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp wants you to kill 15 Venture Company members. You may kill either Venture Co. Ruffians or Venture Co. Excavators.
 $BVenture Company members killed (15)

 Venture Co. Ruffian
$B

 Venture Co. Excavator
desc_text: Ever since we arrived, the Venture Company has hampered our efforts to secure our campsite and survey the area. Normally, we wouldn't care what they were up to, but they've started antagonizing our scouts and shooting down supply flights.$BWe can't allow this insult to stand. Hemet Nesingwary's expedition came here to hunt, and hunt it shall.$BGo to Swindlegrin's Dig, on the far side of the crystal pillar to the northeast, and kill any Venture Company employee you see!

title: Rhino Mastery: The Chase
obj_text: Speak to Oracle Soo-rahm at the Bones of Nozronn.
desc_text: Well, that's settled then. We'll seek out this native sage and have a word with him. He's not likely to volunteer his services, though.$BI'm told he keeps a small lean-to near the Bones of Nozronn, just across the river to the south. Seek him out, introduce yourself, and ask what he requires to help us track down this patriarch of the rhinos.

title: Have a Part, Give a Part
obj_text: ring 7 Venture Co. Spare Parts to Weslex Quickwrench at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: Great, now that we've got an engine, we're going to need an assortment of other parts to get her back in flying condition. Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.$BA good mechanic can hold his creations together with anything, but we're better off if it doesn't come to that.$BAnyway, those Venture Company dullards have plenty of spare parts for their mining equipment all over Swindlegrin's Dig on the far side of that yellow crystal pillar to the northeast. Scoop up a few and bring them back here.

title: Need an Engine, Take an Engine
obj_text: Weslex Quickwrench at the Nesingwary Base Camp wants you to bring him a Flying Machine Engine.
desc_text: She's ruined... ruined! I told that captain to be careful with such a precious cargo, but would she listen to me? No!$BWhen the ship ran aground, it damaged my flying machine, the Spirit of Gnomeregan. Now, we're left without any means to send our reports!$BThere is a chance, though, that the Venture Company's antics may work in our favor. They shot down another flying machine right about where Monte parachuted into the swamp to the east. Go there and retrieve the engine. It may be our only hope.

title: Dreadsaber Mastery: Stalking the Prey
obj_text:
uck Cantwell at the Nesingwary Base Camp wants you to identify 3 Shango Tracks from the Dreadsaber Tracks near Bittertide Lake.
 Shango Track identified (3)
desc_text: I have heard that the natives tell stories of a large dreadsaber they call Shango. I haven't seen any evidence of this Shango's existence, but my injuries have kept me from venturing outside the camp.$BIf you fancy yourself something of a tracker, you might be able to find out the truth about Shango. Debaar said she saw some large tracks on her last outing. Go north from the camp toward Bittertide Lake, and search its southern shore for the prints.

title: Gluttonous Lurkers
obj_text: Deliver 5 Basilisk Crystals to Alchemist Finklestein in the shrine at Heb'Valok.
desc_text: My master, Finklestein, is in the shrine at Heb'Valok to the northwest preparing a truth serum, and he needs basilisk crystals. Heb'Valok is on the west side of the road leading north before the Altar of Sseratus.$BThere are basilisks to the east at Drak'Agal.$BIf you grab the Zul'Drak rats and throw them at the basilisk, they will become gorged and docile after eating five. Then you'll be able to take their crystals.$BKilling the basilisk won't do you any good. That'd just break its crystals!

title: Death to the Necromagi
obj_text:
Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra has asked you to destroy 8 Hath'ar Necromagi.
 Hath'ar Necromagus slain (8)
desc_text: When the trolls brought down Kolramas, it crashed next to us to the southeast. Unfortunately the crash did not destroy all of the Scourge within.$BNow they're raising our men from the dead and using them against us!$BThis will not be allowed to continue. You will see to it that their necromagi are slaughtered! Do we understand each other?

title: Crocolisk Mastery: The Trial
obj_text:
Kill 15 Mangal Crocolisks and return to Debaar at the Nesingwary Encampment.
 Mangal Crocolisk slain (15)
desc_text: I warn you, stranger -- do not make any comments about crashing the ship. I already get enough of it from the rest of the expedition.$BIf you're looking to try your hand at hunting, though, you should test your skills against the wily mangal crocolisks. They live all along the river to the south, and in the Wildgrowth Mangal to the east. Prove you can hold your own against them and we'll talk again, hunter.

title: The Bones of Nozronn
obj_text:
Use Soo-rahm's Incense near the Bones of Nozronn, then return to Hemet Nesingwary at Nesingwary's Base Camp with the information you learned.
 Location of Farunn revealed
desc_text: ones of Nozronn, Oracle Soo-rahm sends <name> to you!$BWe have prepared incense for you. Light it and place it near Nozronn's head and you will hear his voice.$B<Confused, you tell Soo-rahm that you haven't even told him your question.>$BTrue, we not know, but mighty Nozronn does. Do not doubt. Nozronn will answer your heart's question.$BGo. Nozronn not wait long.

title: An Offering for Soo-rahm
obj_text: ring 5 Intact Cobra Fangs to Oracle Soo-rahm, near the Bones of Nozronn.
desc_text: We not know you, stranger, but we know you want something.$BWe will talk to Bones of Nozronn for you, but you must bring us offerings. We need powerful emperor cobra fangs to complete our oracle's necklace.$BGo to the Wildgrowth Mangal, northeast of our hut, find cobras and bring back best fangs. Then we make bones speak to you.

title: Lab Work
obj_text:
Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'Valok wants you to find a Muddy Mire Maggot, a Withered Batwing, an Amberseed, and some Chilled Serpent Mucus from within his laboratory.
 Muddy Mire Maggot found
 Withered Batwing found
 Amberseed found
 Chilled Serpent Mucus found
desc_text: I assume by your interruption that you wish to be numbered among those I am considering for apprenticeship.$BA worthy aspiration...$BShould I someday choose to accept your petition, I must be confident that you can find your way around my laboratory. I have many ingredients here; some plentiful, and others in short supply.$BTake your time, <class>. Find a muddy mire maggot, a withered batwing, an amberseed, and some chilled serpent mucus.$BSucceed, and I'll know to take your request seriously.

title: A Tangled Skein
obj_text:
Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra has asked you to use the Tangled Skein Thrower in order to cause the destruction of 5 Plague Sprayers.
 Plague Sprayers webbed and destroyed (5)
desc_text: There! One tangled skein thrower ready and waiting for you to take those plague sprayers down.$BYou just aim and let loose. The webbing should foul up their hover spells long enough to cause them to crash to the ground just like Kolramas.$BKind of poetic. I like that!

title: The Drakkari Do Not Need Water Elementals!
obj_text:
Sub-Lieutenant Jax at The Argent Stand has asked you to kill 10 Drakkari Water Binders.
 Drakkari Water Binder slain (10)
desc_text: Intelligence reports that ever since those water elementals appeared in the Drak'Sotra Fields, a number of Drakkari shaman have come down from the upper tiers of Zul'Drak to take control of them.$BI cannot stress enough, <sir /ma'am>, how dangerous that could prove. We do not want them to have water elementals at their disposal.$BThe commander has ordered that these Drakkari water binders are to be put to the sword. Head south when you're ready.

title: Skimmer Spinnerets
obj_text: Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra has asked you to collect 5 Intact Skimmer Spinnerets.
desc_text: Why do I always get the tough tasks to tackle?$BThe Scourge at Kolramas have plague sprayers that are getting dangerously close. You don't want to know what's going to happen if they start heading this way!$BI've got an idea for how we might bring them down, but first we're going to need something... something from their own creatures.$BThe Hath'ar skimmers can spin a very strong web that we can put to good use. Bring back some of their spinnerets.

title: Troll Patrol
obj_text:
Commander Kunz at the Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their captain's orders, and then return and report to him.$BCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Captain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, and Alchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'Valok.
 Captain Brandon's Task
 Captain Rupert's Task
 Captain Grondel's Task
 Alchemist Finklestein's Task
desc_text: Unsheathe that weapon, <race>. It's time to go on patrol!$BI've got four posts under my command and it's crucial to our success that they remain in our control. I'm ordering you to visit each of them and offer your assistance.$BYou can begin with Captain Brandon southeast of here. He'll direct you to the next post when he's finished with you.$BReport back to me once you've assisted each of my men. And remember, you'll be more richly rewarded for returning to me quickly - so double-time it!$BDismissed!

title: Malas the Corrupter
obj_text: Sergeant Moonshard at Drak'Sotra insists that you return with the Head of the Corrupter.
desc_text: <name>, gather at least one other person and head back down there!$BYou'll find the leader of Kolramas, Malas the Corrupter, gloating from atop the crashed necropolis.$BKill him and bring me his head!

title: Rhino Mastery: The Kill
obj_text: ring Farunn's Horn to Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: Now that we know where to find Farunn, all that remains is the battle against the great beast. Are you ready to take on this rhino, <name>? For all the spirit's blustering, I'm certain it was telling the truth about the beast's strength.$BWhen you're ready to face him, head north past the Suntouched Pillar and look for Farunn on the northeast shore of the Bittertide Lake. It may even venture near the Glimmering Pillar. Bring back its horn to commemorate your kill.

title: Crocolisk Mastery: The Plan
obj_text: ring 5 Sandfern fronds to Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: The mangal crocolisk is a master of the ambush, and I intend to beat the best at his game. To do that, we'll need to construct a convincing camouflage for you. We'll use plants that grow in the sandy soil of the riverbanks and lake beaches.$BThe sandfern is best for this purpose. It grows in the sandy areas near the shores of the Seabreach Flow, just to the south, Bittertide Lake and Bittertide Falls, to the north, and the edges of River's Heart, the large lake beyond the mangal to the east.

title: Troll Patrol: Done to Death
obj_text:
Captain Rupert wants you to use the Incinerating Oil on 5 Defeated Argent Footmen in Drak'Sotra.
 Argent Footman Corpse Incinerated (5)
desc_text: Trust me, <race>. I know....$BThe smell of burnt flesh has become sickening to even me, a Forsaken. Nevertheless, it is our solemn duty to ensure that our brethren never walk with the Scourge.$BPour this oil on the corpses of our fallen to ensure that we never face them on the battlefield as enemies.

title: Troll Patrol: Something for the Pain
obj_text: Captain Brandon at Drak'Sotra wants you to collect 5 Mature Water-Poppies from Drak'Sotra Fields.
desc_text: Gritty as my men are, they're still mortal.$BWounds and pain diminish their ability to perform their missions. No amount of training changes that simple fact of life.$BThankfully, one of our alchemists has developed a recipe for a salve that binds to our bandages and greatly reduces the pain our soldiers experience.$BThe salve requires a special poppy these trolls cultivate just west of here. Go to Drak'Sotra Fields and harvest some of them to keep our stockpiles from running out.

title: Dreadsaber Mastery: Ready to Pounce
obj_text: ring Shango's Pelt to Buck Cantwell at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: Shango awaits, <name>. If you have succeeded in your tracking, he will not know that you stalk him, and you will need the advantage.$BHe is supposed to be bigger, stronger, and more ferocious than the other dreadsabers of the basin. Travel north, to the western shore of Bittertide Lake and near the falls that feed it, do battle with Shango. If you succeed, return with his pelt.

title: The Blessing of Zim'Abwa
obj_text: Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand wants you to present 10 Drakkari Offerings to the statue of Zim'Abwa.
desc_text: I am heartened to see the zeal with which your Argent Crusade is dealing with the Scourge, <race>. I would like to help with your efforts.$BThe Drakkari trolls of this once-great city used to make regular offerings to their gods, but now neglect them, or worse.$BIf you were to make offerings to the gods, they would show their appreciation in return.$BZim'Abwa's statue is just to the southwest. Zim'Abwa would gladly accept your offerings of Drakkari artifacts as a sign that you are protecting Zul'Drak.

title: Troll Patrol
obj_text:
Commander Kunz at the Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their captain's orders, and then return and report to him.$BCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Captain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, and Alchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'valok.
 Captain Brandon's Task
 Captain Rupert's Task
 Captain Grondel's Task
 Alchemist Finklestein's Task
On Patrol (Provided)
desc_text: Unsheathe that weapon, <race>. It's time to go on patrol!$BI've got four posts under my command and it's crucial to our success that they remain in our control. I'm ordering you to visit each of them and offer your assistance.$BYou can begin with Captain Brandon southeast of here. He'll direct you to the next post when he's finished with you.$BReport back to me once you've assisted each of my men. And remember, you'll be more richly rewarded for returning to me quickly - so double-time it!$BDismissed!

title: Crashed Sprayer
obj_text: Specialist Cogwheel at Drak'Sotra has asked you to collect Plague Sprayer Parts.
desc_text: I know that one of those plague sprayers crashed somewhere within Drak'Sotra to the west of us.$BWhy don't you see if you can find it. I can use the parts from the sprayer to create the device that's going to bring those things down!

title: Pure Evil
obj_text: Captain Rupert has asked you to collect 10 Chunks of Saronite and deliver them to Eitrigg at The Argent Stand.
desc_text: We know that Kolramas, the crashed necropolis to the southeast, was carrying a large amount of an ore known as saronite when the trolls shot it down.$BMy scouts tell me that much of the saronite is strewn about within the innards of that thing.$BEitrigg and his friends back at The Argent Stand want a bunch of the stuff so that they can study it.$BI want you to head in there and see if you can collect enough for them.

title: Crocolisk Mastery: The Ambush
obj_text: ring Bushwhacker's Jaw to Debaar at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: The largest crocolisk in the basin, known around here as "Bushwhacker" for his ambush prowess, likes to sun himself in the shallow waters of River's Heart. It's the large lake at the basin's center, and is to the east of our camp.$BI want you to take the camouflage I've prepared and hide on the western beach of River's Heart and ambush Bushwhacker when he shows himself. Bring back his mighty jaws if you are able to overcome him.

title: Troll Patrol: Creature Comforts
obj_text: Captain Grondel at Drak'Agal wants you to bring him 20 pieces of Dead Thornwood.
desc_text: Well, it ain't glamorous, but it needs doin'.$BMy troops have been fightin' their hearts out while knee-deep in stagnant water for days on end. That just can't be good fer ya.$BWhat they need is a nice fire to dry 'em out and lighten their spirits.$BThis part of the city's soaked, but the dead roots of these thornwood trees have a way of resistin' the moisture.$BRound us up some fuel for burnin' and we'll be mighty grateful.

title: Troll Patrol: Can You Dig It?
obj_text:
Captain Brandon in Drak'Sotra wants you to use the Steel Spade on the nearby Ancient Dirt Mounds to recover the Ancient Drakkari Relic.
 Ancient Dirt Mounds Investigated (5)
desc_text: One of our troops came across an old treasure map during our last offensive. If what it shows is true, then there are priceless troll artifacts nearby.$BMy soldiers have their hands full, pressed between the Drakkari and the Scourge. I need you to follow up on this intelligence.$BTake this shovel and use it at the loose dirt mounds to the southwest. Return to me after a diligent search has been conducted.

title: Pa'Troll
obj_text:
Commander Kunz at The Argent Stand wants you to visit the four Argent Crusade posts, follow their leaders' orders, and then return and report to him.$BCaptain Brandon and Captain Rupert are posted at Drak'Sotra, Southeast of here.$BCaptain Grondel is posted in Drak'Agal, due east.$BAlchemist Finklestein is posted in Heb'Valok, to the north.
 Captain Brandon's Task
 Captain Rupert's Task
 Captain Grondel's Task
 Alchemist Finklestein's Task
desc_text: Welcome to The Argent Stand, scrub. I am Commander Kunz, but you - you can call me... Commander.$BDon't think you're going to just cruise through my region, picking which missions you're going to participate in, answering to no one.$BHere, you report to me and you follow my orders to the letter. Understood?!$BFirst, you're going to get familiar with my men and the region we're charged with clearing.$BReport to each of them and do as they ask. Return to me when your patrol is done.

title: Kick, What Kick?
obj_text:
Using the RJR Rifle, shoot the apple on top of Lucky Wilhelm's head, then speak with Drostan.
 Shot apple on Lucky Wilhelm's Head
desc_text: So you think you can shoot?$BWell, let's give it a try. Here, we'll start you out with something nice and gentle. Don't worry, it's got no kick to it at all. Remember, don't point that gun at anything you don't intend to fire at.$BNow, when you're ready, just take aim at that apple on top o' old Lucky Wilhelm's head and let 'er fly!

title: The Great Hunter's Challenge
obj_text:
Kill 60 Game Animals while you aid Hemet and his companions in their hunting. When you've killed your 60, return to Drostan at the Nesingwary Base Camp to compare numbers.
 $BGame Animals Killed (60)

 Dreadsaber
 Mangal Crocolisk
 Shardhorn Rhino
 Emperor Cobra
 Longneck Grazer
$B

 Shango
 Primordial Drake
 Shattertusk Mammoth
 Shattertusk Bull
 "Tipsy" McManus
desc_text: So y'have something of a hunter's instinct. You're not a bad shot, and Hemet hasn't driven you out, so he must be planning on including you in the hunt.$BHow'd you like to have a bit of a competition, just me and you?$BHemet and the others will ask you to help in their hunting. Along the way, you and I will count up the kills we contribute to their goals. Now, this isn't something you can win in the blink of an eye, and you'll find yourself killing many different kinds of creatures. Good luck!

title: Throwing Down
obj_text:
Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra wants you to use High Impact Grenades near 5 Nerubian Craters.
 Nerubian Tunnels Sealed (5)
desc_text: Clever...$BJust when it seemed we were getting things under control, they tunneled right underneath us and secured the shrine!$BNow we're caught between two Nerubian armies and our predicament is worsening by the minute.$BAs our first course of action, we must stop them from reinforcing. Their tunnels must be sealed.$BTake these grenades and throw them down their craters to the northwest.

title: Troll Patrol: Couldn't Care Less
obj_text:
Captain Grondel wants you to kill 7 Mossy Rampagers in Drak'Agal.
 Mossy Rampagers Slain (7)
desc_text: Of all the posts, they throw me in this one.$BThe place is flooded with putrid, stagnant water and now it's host to sewage elementals!$BI don't really know what they are or why they're here, and frankly I couldn't care less. What I do know is they're making a mess of my sector! How am I supposed to conduct any dignified military operations with those foul things roaming around?$BGet out there, <class>, and don't come back 'til you've cleared your share of 'em off of my battlefield!

title: Troll Patrol: Throwing Down
obj_text:
Captain Rupert at Drak'Sotra wants you to use High Impact Grenades near 5 Nethurbian Craters.
 Nerubian Tunnels Collapsed (5)
desc_text: Clever...$BJust when it seemed we were getting things under control, they tunneled right underneath us and secured the shrine!$BNow we're caught between two nethurbian armies and our predicament is worsening by the minute.$BAs our first course of action, we must stop them from reinforcing. Their tunnels must be sealed.$BTake these grenades and throw them down their craters to the northwest.

title: The Alchemist's Apprentice
obj_text:
Alchemist Finklestein at Heb'valok wants you to assist him in the creation of a truth serum.$BWhen you are ready to begin, you are to speak to him and follow his instructions.
 Truth Serum Created
desc_text: Ahh, you must be the promised patrol. Your timing couldn't be better. I have urgent need of an extra pair of hands.$BWe have a Drakkari prisoner who's been sent here to undergo questioning. Before the interrogation begins, I require assistance in the creation of a truth serum.$BCreating a truth serum is tricky business, demanding keen instincts, perfect timing, and improvisation at every step.$BLet me know when you're ready, <race>. And remember, timing is everything!

No amount of training changes that simple fact of life.$BThankfully, one of our alchemists has developed a recipe for a salve that binds to our bandages and greatly reduces the pain our soldiers experience.$BThe salve requires a special poppy these trolls cultivate just west of here. And remember, timing is everything!

That just can't be good fer ya.$BWhat they need is a nice fire to dry 'em out and lighten their spirits.$BThis part of the city's soaked, but the dead roots of these thornwood trees have a way of resistin' the moisture.$BRound us up some fuel for burnin' and we'll be mighty grateful.

title: Cocooned!
obj_text:
Captain Rupert wants you to open the Nerubian Cocoons in Drak'Sotra and return to him once you have freed 3 Captive Footmen.
 Freed Captive Footmen (3)
desc_text: Now that the tunnels have been sealed, our next concern is recovering those who have fallen to the enemy.$BWith any luck, several of our soldiers are still alive and relatively well inside the nerubian cocoons.$BFree them, <class>, while you still can!

title: Stocking the Shelves
obj_text: Captain Arnath in Heb'Valok asked you to collect 7 units of Fresh Spider Ichor from the Trapdoor Crawlers in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: Listen, <class>. I realize that it's a lot to ask....$BFresh spider ichor is somewhat hard to come by, even in these heavily infested regions. But Finklestein said he'd settle for no less than a vat of it, and that he needs it soon.$BI'll keep my men out in the field collecting reagents, but if the alchemist's order is going to be filled in time, they'll require some assistance.$BAs you roam the fields of Zul'Drak, keep your eyes peeled for trapdoor crawlers and bring me all of the ichor you can find.

title: Uncharted Territory (DEPRECATED)
desc_text: Not all of us in this expedition are here to hunt the biggest and rarest game.  Some of us actually have serious work to do.$BThe mere existence of this place boggles the mind -- a tropical paradise in the middle of Northrend.  I wouldn't be a scholar worthy of the name if I didn't put some effort into trying to understand this place.$BTake these

title: Engineering a Disaster
obj_text:
Help Engineer Helice escape from Swindlegrin's Dig, then speak with Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
 $BEscort Engineer Helice out of Swindlegrin's Dig
desc_text: These goblin goons and their minions have decided that they own this pillar and its crystals. I came here to explore the crystals and take samples, but they overpowered me and won't let me return to the camp.$BIf you'll help me fight our way out of here, we can teach these thugs a lesson they'll never forget!

title: The Taste Test
obj_text:
Offer a sample of Thunderbrew's Jungle Punch to Hemet Nesingwary, Hadrius Harlowe, and Tamara Wobblesprocket, then return to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
 Hemet's taste test
 Hadrius' taste test
 Tamara's taste test
desc_text: And now for the moment of truth!$B<Grimbooze chuckles.>$BI've always wanted to say that. Normally, I'd debut a new drink at a banquet, but we can't have one in the middle of the jungle.$BInstead, just take samples to a few trusted friends and return with their comments. Let's see, we'll definitely want Hemet Nesingwary's opinion, and Hadrius Harlowe's, too. They're here in camp. You'll want to head over to Lakeside Landing, near the center of the Basin and offer Tamara Wobblesprocket a taste.

title: It Could Be Anywhere!
obj_text: Look for a Golden Engagement Ring on the various creatures in Sholazar Basin.
desc_text: When I found out that Miss Boulian was helping Nesingwary with his expedition, I signed up as a deckhand immediately.  You see, I'd been meaning to marry her for months!$BI had it all planned out.  I was going to propose the very night of the shipwreck... but now the ring is gone.  I've searched everywhere!$BI know it might sound crazy, but I know the engagement ring is in the Basin.  If some Venture Company didn't steal it, maybe a wild creature ate it.  But it's here somewhere... I just know it!

title: The Part-time Hunter
obj_text: ring Pitch's Remains to Tamara Wobblesprocket at Lakeside Landing.
desc_text: When Hemet asked me to accompany Marvin out here, I hoped that I might have the opportunity to work on my own hunting skills in between repairing the flying machines and setting up the camp.$BI wanted to take down a ferocious lion named Pitch. He's said to make his home south of here, near where the Wildgrowth Mangal meets the northern face of the Skyreach Pillar. If you can find the beast, would you bring back his remains? If the rumors are true, they'd make a trophy even Hemet will respect!

title: Parachutes for the Argent Crusade
obj_text:
Commander Falstaav at The Argent Stand has asked you to equip 10 Argent Crusaders or Argent Shieldmen out in the courtyard with parachutes.
 Argent forces equipped with a parachute (10)
desc_text: Those sky terrors are destroying my men and women! Dying from falling is a horrible way to go.$B<class>, you have to get these parachutes out to them! At least then they'll have a fighting chance to survive.

title: Clipping Their Wings
obj_text: Captain Arnath in Heb'Valok has asked you to collect 7 Unblemished Bat Wings from Zul'Drak Bats.
desc_text: Ever since Finklestein's arrival, I've been relegated to collecting various ingredients for his experiments and recipes.$BI'll follow my orders as I've vowed to do, but I'm a seasoned veteran. I've taken part in dozens of conflicts. I'd much rather be on the front lines, having a more direct impact on the Crusade's outcome here.$BHelp me, <race>. Collect some bat wings for me so that I might get back to the real action sooner.

title: Still At It
obj_text: Successfully complete the distillation process and bring the completed Thunderbrew's Jungle Punch to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: Now that we've got the raw materials, I've had my assistant ready the still. He'll oversee the process, but I want you to help keep everything under control. You might be tempted to think that we just throw everything into the still and let it sit, but you're wrong.$BIngredients and heat need to be added at certain times, and the pressure regulated at others. You'll have no more than 10 seconds to react to a situation. Speak with "Tipsy" McManus when you're ready to start distilling.

title: Light Won't Grant Me Vengeance
obj_text:
Gerk at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak wants you to kill 15 Vargul.$B
 $BVargul slain (15)

 Vargul Deathwaker
 Vargul Runelord
 Vargul Slayer
$B

 SCOURGE PROXY (PHASED)
 Vargul Proxy
desc_text: They... They killed my brother.$B<Gerk fights back tears.>$BSlaughtered him like he was some sort of animal. Now they got him laid out on one of their tables on the other side of the camp, ready for their grizzly experiments. Dargath's dead too. The paladin made a heroic stand at the ruins to the northeast, but the leader of the Vargul, Algar, was too strong.$BI'm all that's left and I'll be dead soon too. I... I'm turning.$BIf the Light won't grant me vengeance, maybe you will, <class>. Kill them all.

title: Making Something Out Of Nothing
obj_text: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak has asked that you recover 10 pieces of Scourge Scrap Metal.
desc_text: Prince Navarius must be stopped. We can't let the Scourge continue to use this area as a zombie factory. If we can get the tank operational we might stand a chance. What I need right now are spare parts.$BNorthwest of here is an area called Thrym's End. The Scourge armies are using the area as a base of sorts. Spread out across the base is the wreckage from their arrival. Bits and pieces of Scourge scrap metal litter the landscape. Get that stuff to me and I'll try and put it to good use.

title: A Great Storm Approaches
obj_text: Gymer, King of Storm Giants, has asked you to find a way to release him from his cage. Speak with Engineer Reed at the Crusader Forward Camp.
desc_text: You are not like the others, little one. You do not reek of the ancient death. Perhaps you can be trusted.$BI am Gymer, king of the storm giants. I was lured here by my brother, Thiassi, now an undead servant of the Lich King. By the time I realized that his cry for help was a trap, it was too late. I am now a prisoner of the Scourge and I fear that soon I will suffer the same fate as many of the other storm giants.$BFind a way to release me from this cage and I will aid you to the best of my ability.

title: That's What Friends Are For...
obj_text:
Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp has asked that you find Crusader Dargath, Gerk and Burr.
 Crusader Dargath found
 Gerk found
 Burr found
desc_text: We were attacked by Prince Navarius and at least a dozen Scourge. I told Dargath and the twins to stay inside the tank, but they wouldn't listen. Dargath looked me in the eyes and said, "If somebody doesn't get out of this tank, they'll kill us all." He then made Reed cut the engine and charged. Most heroic thing I've ever seen.$BI heard the Prince barking orders to the monsters. Sounded like he was taking them to Thrym's End, northwest of here. We have to rescue our friends. Will you go look for them?

title: Some Make Lemonade, Some Make Liquor
obj_text: ring 1 Orange, 2 Banana Bunches, and 1 Papaya to Grimbooze Thunderbrew at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: Life's tossed me a cartload of lemons this time! When the ship ran aground, the kegs carrying my best brew burst! All we have now are a few bottles of rum, and it won't sustain a thirsty expedition!$BWe need to get some booze cooking, and fast!!$BThe trees in the Wildgrowth Mangal, to the east, seem laden with fruit, but it's too high for me to reach. Look for good, strong vines, see if you can use it to shake some of that fruit out of the trees. Bring me whatever you can find.

title: A Steak Fit for a Hunter
obj_text: ring 5 Longneck Grazer Steaks to Korg the Cleaver at the Nesingwary Base Camp.
desc_text: Sometimes, there's nothing worse than a camp full of hunters. They're all so busy taking down prey animals that the only meat I get is tough and stringy. That's hardly the kind of thing you want to come home to after a long day on the hunt.$BLucky for us, though, there is a source of tender, succulent meat nearby. To the south of the river and the camp live longneck grazers. They're a perfect source of meat for our hungry hunters. Bring me back the best cuts of meat and we'll properly toast our comrades.

title: Betrayal
obj_text: Stefan in Ebon Watch wants you to defeat Drakuru.$BIf you lose your Ensorcelled Choker, return to Stefan at Ebon Watch to get another.
desc_text: The time has come to end this charade, <name>.$BAs valuable as your information has been, we must bring Drakuru down and bring his project to an end before his freaks are unleashed.$BWe've modified your scepter for the job. When the time is right, you will be able to use it on Drakuru's Blightbloods and turn them against him. It's your only hope of defeating him.$BFight well.

title: The Storm King's Vengeance
obj_text:
Speak with Gymer to begin.$BWhile riding Gymer, destroy 100 Scourge and kill Algar the Chosen, Thrym and Prince Navarius. Report to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp should you succeed.
 $BScourge slain (100)

 Vargul Doombringer
 Vargul Blighthound
 Vargul Deathwaker
 Vargul Runelord
 Vargul Slayer
 Banshee Soulclaimer
 Vargul Plaguetalon
$B

 Reanimated Corpse
 Acolyte of Agony
 Acolyte of Pain
 Vegard the Unforgiven
 Vegard the Unforgiven
 SCOURGE PROXY (PHASED)
$B
$B
 Algar the Chosen slain
 Thrym slain
 Prince Navarius slain
desc_text: My people have been decimated by the Lich King. The Scourge now use the corpses of storm giants to create mindless flesh giants, or worse, stitched together aberrations like Thrym.$BI will stop at nothing to see them all driven from this world. We will work together to destroy the Scourge that threaten Zul'Drak.$BWe will kill them all: Navarius, Algar and Thrym!$BWhen you are ready, let me know and we will begin our destructive journey.

title: The Faceless Ones
obj_text:
Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to kill Herald Volazj and the three Forgotten Ones that accompany him in Ahn'Kahet.
 Forgotten Ones Destroyed (3)
 $BHerald Volazj Defeated

 Herald Volazj
 Herald Volazj - Heroic
$B

 Herald Volazj - Mythic
 Herald Volazj - Ascended
desc_text: In my peoples' struggle against the forces of the undead, they dug deeper as they lost ground. In desperation, they dug too deep.$BWe inadvertently exposed a tendril of the old god's will, which was made manifest in the creatures known only as the Faceless.$BIn the end, we could not fight on two fronts against such powerful enemies. Our misfortune cost us the war against the undead, and ultimately, our home.$BEnter Ahn'kahet, <class>, and cleanse our former home of these Faceless atrocities.

title: Mr. Floppy's Perilous Adventure
obj_text:
Help Emily and Mr. Floppy get back to the Westfall Brigade Encampment, then speak to Squire Walter.
 $BHelp Emily and Mr. Floppy return to the camp
desc_text: Excuse me, <Mister/Ma'am>, do you know the way back to the soldiers' camp?$BMr. Floppy and I decided to go for a walk in the woods, and my brother Walter was gonna come with us, but then he had squire things to do.$BSo Mr. Floppy and I went by ourselves, but we got lost, and there were a whole bunch of hungry wolves, but we found this tower.$BThe wolves went away, but we're still lost.$BI asked Mr. Floppy, and he doesn't know the way back. Would you help us? Please?

title: Our Only Hope
obj_text:
Speak to Gymer at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak once you have used the Jumbo Seaforium Charge to open the Scourge Enclosure that is holding him prisoner.
 Scourge Enclosure Blown Up
desc_text: What I'm about to give you is called seaforium. It is a highly volatile explosive with some unique properties. Due to its malleable nature, you will be able to fill in the hinges and cracks of the cage for maximum damage.$BReturn to your friend and use the jumbo seaforium charge to set him free.$BLet's hope he honors the bargain. He's our only hope.

title: Subject to Interpretation
obj_text: Drakuru wants you to get 5 Frozen Mojo from the Drakkari Trolls at the Ruins of Drak'Zin and then use the elixir at Drakuru's Brazier there.
desc_text: A legendary set of artifacts, lost for thousands of years, were created to make Drak'Tharon Keep impervious.$BMost think they be myth, but Drakuru knows better, mon!$BI nearly discovered where one be, but got captured while interpreting hieroglyphs. Ya gotta summon my soul back dere so I can finish readin' em!$BUse my elixir at da brazier on Drak'Zin Ruins, southwest of here. You'll hafta mix in da frozen mojo my bruddas be holdin'. I hate ta see my bruddas fall, but it be for the greater good.

title: Filling the Cages
obj_text:
Samir at Granite Springs wants you to use the Bounty Hunter's Cage on a drakkari troll that's been stunned by Budd.
 Captured Live Ice Troll
desc_text: 'Ol Budd's seen better days.$BEver since our stay in Ghostlands he's been useless to us. We've had to find ways to make it on our own, and today that means sellin' trolls to the highest bidder.$BFortunately, we've recently found a use for Budd. Something about his condition allows him to mingle with the local trolls, so we taught him a little game that's turned us a tidy profit.$BSee for yourself. Talk to Budd, take him southwest to Drak' Zin Ruins and use this cage as soon as he tags a troll.

title: Sacrifices Must be Made
obj_text: Drakuru wants you to bring the Eye of the Prophets to him at Drakuru's Brazier in Zeb'Halak.$BYou will need to collect Zim'bo's Mojo to use Drakuru's Elixir there.
desc_text: I've got it, mon!$BTo da north, on da Ziggurat at Zeb'Halak be a stone head with ruby eyes. One o' dem be da Eye of the Prophets! Bring it to the brazier there and drink my elixir.$BAgain, ya be needing some mojo for my elixir to work - dis time from da warlord, Zim'bo. He be hidin' in one of da huts in Zeb'Halak.$BIt be a shame to kill Zim'bo, mon, but he swore da blood oath to defend Drak'Tharon and he done failed. Now at least his mojo be helpin' us to reclaim Drak'Tharon.

title: Heart of the Ancients
obj_text: Drakuru wants you to go to the uppermost chamber at Blue Sky Logging Ground and find the Heart of the Ancients.
desc_text: Secrets of da ages, be revealed to me now!$B<Drakuru peers through the Eye of the Prophets.>$BAhh, great be mah destiny, <name>. You be lucky ta know me....$BThere! I be seein' it, mon. The Heart of the Ancients. Dis be too easy!$BYou gunna find da heart lyin' near da corpse of a goblin east of here. He be up in a chamber, near a river of broken trees.$BHurry, mon, before someone else be findin' it!

title: Gymer's Salvation
obj_text: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak wants you to bring him 6 Banshee Essence and 6 Diatomaceous Earth.
desc_text: Now you say that he's locked up in a 100 foot tall cage, eh?$BIf my calculations are correct, we should be able to at least weaken the hinges on the cage, giving the giant enough leeway to break out.$BIf this is going to work I'm going to need some plasticizers and stabilizers.$BBanshee essence should do nicely for the plasticizer. You can get that from the banshees in the Dead Fields, northeast of us. The stabilizer can be found on the earthragers to the southwest, near Ebon Watch.$BGet a move on!

title: Nozzlerust Defense
obj_text:
Kill 12 Wastes Diggers and 1 Wastes Taskmaster at the digs surrounding Galakrond's Rest.  Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post when the task is complete.
 Wastes Taskmaster slain
 Wastes Digger slain (12)
desc_text: You, <class>!  These undead south of us are being a constant nuisance to our work.  Go clear them out, will ya?

title: Search and Rescue
obj_text: Mack at Granite Springs wants you to go into Drak'Tharon and find out what became of Kurzel.
desc_text: Orc women... they just don't lissen - hic. Know what I mean, <race>?$BKurzel's been with us fer years. You'd think she'd get a feel fer how we do things by now. Lure the fools in fer the dangerous work, then reap the rewards when it's safe. What's so hard to understand?$BNot her though... impatient green-skin goes off and takes matters into her own hands. Probably dead by now, but I'd feel horrible if we didn't follow after her, and I'm in no shape to do it myself - hic.$BSo whatdya say, pal?

title: Funky Fungi
obj_text: You are to collect 6 Grotesque Fungus from Savage Cave Beasts in Ahn'kahet and deliver them to Kilix the Unraveler in The Pit of Narjun.
desc_text: A misshapen piece of mushroom-like fungus falls from a particularly smelly, ooze-covered patch of the cave beast's flesh. Examining it, you are violently repulsed by its overwhelming stench.$BYou wonder to yourself if this is the kind of thing that the nerubians might find appetizing. Placing the sticky organism in your pack, you determine to find out...

title: Seared Scourge
obj_text:
Mack at Granite Springs wants you to use his grog to burn 20 Famished Scourge Trolls at Drak'Tharon.
 Scourge Trolls Burned (20)
desc_text:
... gotta burn these corpshes 'fore they shtart walkin' around again.$BPoppa always said, only thing worshe than havin' to kill a troll is havin' ta kill a troll twice.$BSay,... shpeakin' of Scourge, we can't get into tha' troll keep up north 'til we get them trolls thinned out a bit.$BHow 'bout ya take shome o my grog here and put them bashtards outta their misery?
                Progress
Ya getter done, <name>?$B
Completion
Well done!$B<Mack laughs hysterically for a moment.>$BAww, come on now. That was funny....$B
Rewards
You will receive: 5 60  (or 9 96  if completed at level 80)                $B


Mark of Ascension
 


Gains
                    Upon completion of this quest you will gain: 
                    
20,750 experience$B

Related

title: Rustling Some Feathers
obj_text:
Kill 20 Harpies Northwest of Nozzlerust Post for Narf at Nozzlerust Post.
 $BColdwind Harpies (20)

 Coldwind Waste Huntress
$B

 Coldwind Witch
desc_text: Those harpies have slowed our profits long enough!  Kill them all.

title: Vial of Visions
obj_text: Drakuru at Granite Springs wants you to bring him an Imbued Vial, a Waterweed Frond, and 3 Haze Leaves.
desc_text: First things first, mon. There be some preparatory work that need doin'.$BNo tellin' how long dey gunna keep me here. Ya be needin' a powerful elixir so we can be keepin' in touch.$BLucky for you, I know just the thing! And the ingredients all be close by.$BI need a vial from the pretty little troll over there, some waterweed from the lake just north of here, and a few haze leaves found around the camp here.$BHurry now, mon, before dey be haulin' me away.

title: Stocking Up
obj_text: Gather 8 bundles of Composite Ore from the digs surrounding Galakrond's Rest and bring them to Xink at Nozzlerust Post.
desc_text: Hello hello!  The Scourge to the south are digging up some ancient dragon thing.  I could care less why they're doing it, but they're pulling cartloads of composite ore in the process.$BGo lift me a bunch of that ore.  That stuff should yield a pretty penny for all the weapons the Horde are crafting.

title: Soft Packaging
obj_text: Collect 12 Thin Animal Hides from the Jormungar Tunnelers or the Dragonbone Condors near Nozzlerust Post.  Once you've located the hides, return them to Zivlix.
desc_text: I need some new packaging for the shrapnel bombs.  All the stuff I have is too hard and the shrapnel doesn't spread when it bursts.$BWhat we need is some really thin animal hide.  Those jormungar tunnelers to the west might work... or perhaps the condors sifting through the dragon bones.  Go get me whatever you can find.

title: Stomping Grounds
obj_text:
Delve into the cavern at the north end of the Crystal Vice and kill 8 Ice Heart Jormungar Feeders for Ko'char the Unbreakable.
 Ice Heart Jormungar Feeder slain (8)
desc_text: Greetings little one.  I know not what madness has brought you to the Crystal Vice, but you are welcome in my presence.$BThese ice worms... these jormungar have taken a taste to eating my brothers.  I doubt you will find my kind friendly by any terms during this time of battle, but if you are here to help with the worms, then you have my ear.$BIf we are to take the cavern back, we must first clear the canyon of these jormungar feeders.  Join us in battle, <race>!

title: Something That Doesn't Melt
obj_text: Search the dragon bones east of Nozzlerust Post for 12 Splintered Bone Chunks.
desc_text: No no no! Those ice shards didn't work at all! They'll melt before they even do any damage. That's the last time I'll trust Narf's word on materials. This means we need something else entirely for the shrapnel.$BI know! I'm brilliant. Bone splinters.$BThere are some bones all around here that the jormungar have been gnawing on pretty thoroughly. Go check them out and see if you can find me some splintered bone that I can use.

title: Shaved Ice
obj_text: Collect 4 Ice Shard Clusters from Ice Elementals in the north and bring them to Zivlix at Nozzlerust Post.
desc_text: I've never seen you before... are you new to the Vice?  Glad to have you.  I could always use some more hands.$BYou get the materials, I'll finish my machine, then we can sell it to those commander types and all go home rich.$BI actually have most of the primary components, so I just need some of the materials for the weapon itself.  Narf said that jagged ice shards from those elementals to the north would make perfect shrapnel for my bombs - go nab some, will ya?

title: Lumber Hack
obj_text: Use Xink's Shredder Control Device to call a Shredder once you reach the Harpy Nesting Grounds in the North.  Gather 50 Bundles of Lumber from the trees in the area, and then return to Xink at Nozzlerust Post.$BShould you lose Xink's Shredder Control Device, speak to Xink at Nozzlerust Post to obtain a new one.
desc_text: Next up, we need to haul in some lumber for all the towers the Alliance are building.  There are some thin trees to the south, but the trees the Harpies are nesting in to the north look much more fit for structures.$BTake this.  When you get to the Harpy nesting area, use the control and one of my Shredders should come to you.  Gather as much lumber as it can carry.  The Harpies are sure to disagree with you chopping down their homes - just deal with them as necessary.$BHop to it!

title: Harp on This!
obj_text:
Kill the Mistress of the Coldwind and 15 Coldwind harpies in the mountains northwest of Nozzlerust Post. Return to Narf once the task is complete.$BShould you be in need of Xink's Shredder Control Device, speak to Xink at Nozzlerust Post.
 Mistress of the Coldwind slain
 $BColdwind Harpies (15)

 Coldwind Waste Huntress
$B

 Coldwind Witch
desc_text: <class>, did you see that? That's the harpy that's been leading the attack on our shipments to the gate! I've seen her in the back of Coldwind Heights before.$BThose harpies have slowed our profits long enough! Kill them all.

title: Really Big Worm
obj_text:
Enter the Ice Heart Cavern and slay Rattlebore.  If it is still in your possession, be sure to use Zort's Protective Elixir to protect you from the Jormungar's corrosive spit.$BReturn to Ko'char the Unbreakable in the Crystal Vice when the task is complete.
 Rattlebore slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: The jormungar have a spawnmother in the caverns below. We call her Rattlebore - a name that was gifted to her by an adventurer from the Plaguelands. I saw her only briefly as I was fighting off their initial onslaught - she is large enough to make even my icy bones shiver. This cavern will not be ours until she is removed from it.$BGather your friends and end this.

title: Hard to Swallow
obj_text: attle a Hulking Jormungar east of Nozzlerust Post until it opens its mouth, then throw a Potent Explosive Charge into its throat. After it explodes, collect 6 slabs of Seared Jormungar Meat off of the ground and bring them back to Xink.
desc_text: Those troops are sure to be needin' a hefty supply of food in their bellies.$BI'll let you in on a little secret that a squeamish <race> like you would never know... those jormungar worms taste just like chicken.$BGo provoke one of those giant hulking jormungar to the east.  You're not likely to be able to kill one straight out, so just toss this down its throat when it opens its mouth wide.  Bring me back as many of the slabs of meat as you can tote.

title: Wanted: Gigantaur
obj_text:
Slay Gigantaur and return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.$B
 Gigantaur slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: y decree of Overlord Agmar:$BTarget: Gigantaur$BCrime: Attacks upon the Horde; "Bein' ugly"$BStatus: Alive$BThe magnataur lord, Gigantaur, is wanted in relation to a number of attacks against Horde soldiers and installations in the Dragonblight.$BGigantaur was last seen wandering the woods and roads south by southeast of Agmar's Hammer.$BGigantaur should be considered armed and extremely dangerous. Do not engage solo!$BAll bounties are paid out by Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.

title: Apply This Twice A Day
obj_text: Offer the elixir that Zort has prepared to Ko'char the Unbreakable.
desc_text: This elixir should protect against their spit. Offer it to Ko'char for me, will you? Tell him there's plenty more where that came from if he'll return the favor.

title: Wanted: Dreadtalon
obj_text:
Slay Dreadtalon and return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.
 Dreadtalon slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: y decree of Overlord Agmar:$BTarget: Dreadtalon$BCrime: Attacks upon the Horde$BStatus: Alive$BDreadtalon is wanted for numerous attacks upon Horde caravans traveling to and from Venomspite.$BDreadtalon makes his home on a bluff overlooking the Ruby Dragonshrine, east of Agmar's Hammer. He should be approached with extreme caution. Do not engage solo!$BAll bounties are paid out by Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.

title: DEPRECATED
obj_text:
Captain Derrick at Amberpine Lodge wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Villagers and 8 Silverbrook Trappers.
 Silverbrook Villager slain (8)
 Silverbrook Trapper slain (8)
desc_text: I've heard enough, <name>.  We must make sure whatever's happening at Silverbrook doesn't spread to the rest of the continent.$BI don't care if it's the water, the altitude or an ancient troll curse that's driven these villagers murderously insane... return to Silverbrook and put an end to them.

title: Messy Business
obj_text: Collect 2 Vials of Corrosive Spit from the Jormungar by using the scraper on yourself.  Bring the vials back to Zort in the Crystal Vice when your task is complete.
desc_text: Even at first glance, the sample you brought me shows obvious signs of some kind of corrosive spit. It would be a natural assumption that the same substance these worms use to burrow through the ground has allowed them a formidable weapon against the Ice Giants.$BTake this scraper and pick a fight with some of the worms. When they spit on you, use the scraper to remove it and bring it back to me.$BGet me a couple samples - I'm going to have to use it as the base for an elixir.

title: Slim Pickings
obj_text: Collect a sample of Rockflesh from the Ice Giant corpse at the cavern entrance in the Crystal Vice, north of Zort's location. After this task is complete, return to Zort near the center of the canyon.
desc_text: Cold out here, isn't it, <race>?$BKo'char has refused to meet with me. It seems he has more pressing things on his mind - namely, the jormungar that have been attacking them from the cavern below. Maybe you can help me convince Ko'char that I'm one of the good guys.$BI saw a giant being eaten by some of the worms at the entrance to the cavern north of here... I'm still puzzled as to how the worms are killing them so easily. Bring me a sample from one of his wounds.

title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle... Again
obj_text: Speak to Captain Gryan Stoutmantle at the Westfall Brigade Encampment.
desc_text: The Westfall boys were sent east to look for a path into the northern territories.  Their secondary objective is to secure strategic resource points, so I'm sure they wouldn't mind investigating a mine.$BLook for the Westfall Brigade encampment far to the northeast and seek out Gryan Stoutmantle.  You might remember him if you ever spent any time in Westfall.  Make sure to tell him I sent you.$BHe'll be more than happy to let you claim a functioning mine for the king.

title: Worm Wrangler
obj_text: Enter the caverns in Crystal Vice and trap 3 Jormungar Spawn inside sturdy crates.  Be sure to pick the crates up after the Jormungar Spawn are trapped inside!$BBring the captured Jormungar Spawn back to Zort in the Crystal Vice.
desc_text: So be it. If the giants will not come to our aid, perhaps we can make use of these worms. There are sure to be some spawn with their brood mother in the cavern below.
