Take this box and capture 3 of their spawn and bring them to me.$BWhere diplomacy fails, enslaving is a perfectly viable alternative.

title: DEPRECATED
obj_text: ring Mikhail's Note to Cartographer Tobias at Amberpine Lodge.
desc_text: The dirt mound is, indeed, a hastily dug grave.  The body beneath is unrecognizable but you find a note that identifies that man as Mikhail.$BThe note mentions Hollowstone Mine once again.  Perhaps someone back at Amberpine Lodge might be familiar with the area.

title: Stiff Negotiations
obj_text: Locate Zort in the center of the Crystal Vice, northeast of Nozzlerust Post.
desc_text: Well it seems you were of a bit of use after all. It's not been my experience to meet many a <race> that are.$BWe don't have any more use for you here. Head into the Vice and see if my brother Zort could use a hand. He went to see if he could con the giants into laying down their lives so that we don't have to. He certainly wasn't known for having the brains in the family.

title: Reclusive Runemaster
obj_text:
Locate Dregmar Runebrand near his cave on the path to the cliffs overlooking the Mirror of the Dawn. Challenge him and uncover the name of the magnataur leader by any means necessary. Return to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest once the information is obtained.
 $BName of the Magnataur Warlord
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Dregmar Runebrand is a magnataur runemaster... a rare breed. He's generally solitary, but has been known to associate with the more powerful and influential magnataur in Dragonblight for quite some time. He will know who this new leader is.$BIt is unlikely we will gain any aid with the increasing concerns with the Scourge and the blue flight, so I need you to procure the information from Dregmar by any means necessary.$BI was told he can be found amongst the cliffs overlooking the Mirror of the Dawn.

title: Blackriver Brawl
obj_text:
Raider Captain Kronn wants you to slay 10 Alliance units or players at the Blackriver Logging Camp.
 $BAlliance in Blackriver slain (10)

 Amberpine Scout
 Conquest Hold Raider
 Valiance Commando
$B

 Warsong Raider
 Blackriver Credit
desc_text: The Venture Company abandoned operations shortly after we showed up.  Clearly they were afraid of what we were going to do to their greedy little hides.$BWith them gone, their logging camps are up for grabs.  Our war machine is a hungry beast... without renewing our supplies we won't make it to Icecrown.$BUnfortunately the Alliance seems to have the same idea and we must make sure we're the ones that prevail.  Head into the logging camp and help us fight the Alliance scum.

title: Descent into Darkness
obj_text: ring Mikhail's Journal to Lieutenant Dumont in Amberpine Lodge.
desc_text: The journal was written by a denizen of Silverbrook named Mikhail.  It details the arrival of a shadow-worshipping group called the "wolfcult."$BThe villagers were reluctant to embrace the cult at first, but sympathizers sprung up gradually among town residents.$BUnsettled by this, Mikhail sent his daughter Sasha away from Silverbrook while he attempted to reason with the other villagers.$BMikhail's last entry mentions a meeting of local town leaders to discuss unspecified events in Hollowstone Mine.

title: Wanton Warlord
obj_text: Travel to the ring of torches south of the Azure Dragonshrine and blow the Emblazoned Battle Horn. Defeat Grom'thar the Thunderbringer and bring his head back to Aurastrasza at Wyrmrest.
desc_text: There's no reason to suspect Dregmar's words are anything but true. Whether Grom'thar defeats you or is defeated by you, he can wash his hands of this.$BFollow his instructions... take the horn that you brought me earlier, travel to the ring of torches south of the Azure Dragonshrine, and blow it to announce your challenge.$BWhen Grom'thar the Thunderbringer arrives, kill him and bring me his head.

title: Vordrassil's Fall
obj_text: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Limb, Vordrassil's Heart or Vordrassil's Tears and obtain 6 Slime Samples from the Entropic Oozes.
desc_text: Long ago, powerful druids planted a tree to the northeast of here.$BIt was called Vordrassil and it was to be a world tree.  It is not known why, but after the tree was fully grown, the druids decided it needed to be destroyed.$BEver since we arrived here, the earth has spoken to me, <name>.  Its cries of pain come from the places where Vordrassil's remains fell on the ground.$BCorrupting ooze roams those places.  Bring me samples of it so we may begin to heal the land.

title: Good Troll Hunting
obj_text: Sergeant Thurkin told you to speak to Samir at Granite Springs.
desc_text: Good for nothing wretches!$BThey could have had it easy. We extended our hand in peace. All they had to do was give us passage through Drak'Tharon and we'd have let them be.$BBut no, the prideful little ice trolls decided that they wanted it rough. Now they'll be destroyed and we'll pass through their precious keep to Zul'Drak anyway.$BWe've contracted a gang to deliver us captured trolls. Talk to Samir if you want in on the action. You can find him to the northwest of here, due south of Zeb'Halek.

title: Them or Us!
obj_text:
Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to find and kill 6 Graymist Hunters in Grizzly Hills.
 Graymist Hunter slain (6)
desc_text: As if we didn't have enough to concern ourselves with....$BWith the present food crisis, we find ourselves competing for food with the local worgs. The situation is becoming more dire, and I fear that if we don't address the issue immediately we'll soon find ourselves with nothing to hunt.$BScour the forest, <race>. Kill any graymist you find. Recent reports have sighted a concentration of them on the other side of the river west of here.

title: Gray Worg Hides
obj_text: Hidetrader Jun'ik in Conquest Hold wants you to get 3 Gray Worg Hides from Graymist Hunters in the woods to the north.
desc_text: Let me tell you something, mon.  When you get put in charge of outfittin' the armies of the Horde, you go through a lot of hides!$BConqueror Krenna, the she-wolf runnin' this place, she gave me a tight deadline.  If I don't outfit her whole regiment by week's end she's gonna have me wrestling bears in the pit.$BHelp me out and I'll pay you top price.  I'll be needin' hides from graymist hunters.$BYou'll find them all around in pockets to the north, hunting stag.  Remember, mon.  Top price!

title: A Minor Substitution
obj_text: Hidetrader Jun'ik wants you to bring him 6 Grizzly Hides.
desc_text: Krenna, she be wantin' worg hides for all the outfits.  There's not gonna be enough worg hides for her army, though.  Not now, not ever.$BThose worgs -- they be skinny, mon!  Here's what we're gonna do... if you can keep a secret that is.$BEast of Voldrune there be grizzly bears as fat as an ogre.  Those large hides -- those we can use!$BHurry, <brother/sister>.  Krenna's not known for her patience.

title: Delivery to Krenna
obj_text: Take the Bundle of Hides to Krenna in Conquest Hold.
desc_text: This is it, mon.  Let's take these hides to Krenna and see if they pass the test.$BLet's hope for both our sakes Krenna doesn't notice anything.

title: Replenishing the Storehouse
obj_text: Master Woodsman Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to kill Tallhorn Stag and collect 8 Succulent Venison.
desc_text: G'day, <class>.$BThe good lieutenant here says that there's been a Horde raid on our storehouse that's left our food supply dangerously low.$BNo doubt we'll make those cretins pay, but first we need to focus our attention on restocking. My men are doing all they can, but we're going to need every able body to contribute if we're to avert a crisis.$BYou should have no trouble harvesting venison from the local stag in these parts. Happy hunting!

title: Eagle Eyes
obj_text:
Anderhol in Amberpine Lodge wants you to kill 5 Imperial Eagles and then report back to him.
 Imperial Eagle slain (5)
desc_text: Well, <name>, we've determined how the Horde was able to locate our hidden stores of food.$BIt turns out that they were binding their sight to the unsuspecting eagles that soar above the trees here. Using eagle vision, they were able to effectively spy on our every action.$BBy order of the lieutenant, we've got to hunt down these majestic birds in order to thwart our enemy.

title: Thinning the Ranks
obj_text:
Kill 12 Dragonflayer Huscarls and return to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge.
 Dragonflayer Huscarl slain (12)
desc_text: There's a flurry of activity down in Voldrune village to the south. Thane Torvald Eriksson and his huscarls are preparing for war. With most of our men in the field dealing with the Horde's treachery, Amberpine will be vulnerable.$BTravel to Voldrune, which is near the southern coast, and show those Dragonflayers we're no soft target.$BSlay as many of the huscarls as you can find. Make them think twice about taking advantage of our conflict with the Horde.

title: Jun'ik's Coverup
obj_text: ring 1 piece of Coal and 5 Simple Flour to Hidetrader Jun'ik at Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills.
desc_text: Ah, we have a small problem.  Grizzly hides... they be brown, mon!$BThink... think!$BI got it, mon!  Is like this: gray is black an' white all mixed up.  You get me some coal an' some flour, I'll grind it all up and dust the hides with it.  No one will know the better!$BBlacksmiths sell coal for smeltin' an' you can get flour from the provisioner.

title: The Darkness Beneath
obj_text:
Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears and Vordrassil's Limb and use the Geomancer's Orb in the depths beneath the surface.
 Orb used beneath Vordrassil's Heart
 Orb used beneath Vordrassil's Limb
 Orb used beneath Vordrassil's Tears
desc_text: Something... dark... happened to the tree Vordrassil.  After the druids decided to destroy it, its hollow remains grew roots deep into the ground.$BI want you to go to the three locations to the northeast where the tree's trunk shattered and go as far beneath the ground as you can.$BUse this orb once you get there to get an imprint of the energy surrounding the area.  This might shed some light on what happened to Vordrassil and why it failed to become a world tree.

title: The Thane of Voldrune
obj_text:
Use Flamebringer to defeat Thane Torvald Eriksson and report to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge.
 Thane Torvald Eriksson slain
desc_text: Now that you've captured the flame-imbued talismans and weakened Voldrune's defenses, we can strike at its leader, Thane Torvald Eriksson.$BThe thane's favorite mount is an unruly proto-drake he calls Flamebringer. It is kept bound in chains in the western part of Voldrune, but with the talismans, you should be able to control it long enough to use it against the thane.$BOnce you have Flamebringer under your control, search the tops of the towers of Voldrune for the thane and show him no mercy.

title: The Failed World Tree
obj_text: Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Vordrassil's Limb, Vordrassil's Heart or Vordrassil's Tears and obtain 6 Slime Samples from the Entropic Oozes.
desc_text: My ancestors once planted a tree in the middle of the Grizzly Hills.$BIt was called Vordrassil and it was to become a world tree.$BFor reasons long forgotten, after the tree was fully grown, they decided it needed to be destroyed.  Its giant trunk splintered at three locations in the area to the north.$BWhere the tree touched the ground, foul ooze began to crawl the earth.  Bring me slime samples so I can begin my work and the earth can be healed.

title: Shredder Repair
obj_text:
Synipus at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to bring 3 Broken-down Shredders back to him.
 Shredder Delivered (3)
desc_text: Listen, pal. Why don't ya roll up your sleeves and grab a wrench? There's work to be done! They need these shredders refurbished and sent down to Venture Bay, and they need it done yesterday....$BNo wrench? Well what good are ya then? May as well go down with the rest of the lugheads and play with the Horde!$BWhile you're there, see if you can drive some of those broken-down shredders up here for repairs. Be careful! They're in pretty bad shape.

title: DEPRECAED
obj_text: Escort the Alliance Envoy to the town of Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont at the Amberpine Lodge when you've completed this task.
desc_text: I was meant to set off for Silverbrook, northwest of here, about an hour ago.  My military escort appears to be running late.$BI'll be damned if this diplomatic mission gets sidetracked because some new recruit overslept.$BWe're negotiating a deal with the locals and timeliness is essential.  What do you say?  If you come with me, you'll be well compensated for your troubles.

title: A Dark Influence
obj_text:
Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears and Vordrassil's Limb and use the Geomancer's Orb in the depths beneath the surface.
 Orb used beneath Vordrassil's Heart
 Orb used beneath Vordrassil's Limb
 Orb used beneath Vordrassil's Tears
desc_text: When the tree Vordrassil fell, its hollow remains grew roots deep into the ground.$BI want you to go north of here to the three locations where the trunk shattered and go as far beneath the ground as you can.  You'll find them west of Grizzlemaw.$BUse this orb once you get there to get an imprint of the energy surrounding the area.  If we're to heal the land, we must first find out what caused Vordrassil to fail as a world tree all those years ago.

title: A Show of Strength
obj_text:
Kill 12 Dragonflayer Huscarls and return to Sergeant Nazgrim at Conquest Hold.
 Dragonflayer Huscarl slain (12)
desc_text: Preparations for war are underway in the vrykul village of Voldrune to the southeast. Voldrune's thane cannot field a large army, but with our forces spread thin, we are still at risk.$BWe cannot risk giving the thane and his men an opportunity to attack, so we must take the battle to them. If you are truly a <class> of the Horde, you will relish the chance to demonstrate our strength.$BCut down the huscarls and prove to this Dragonflayer clan that the Horde is not to be trifled with!

title: Secrets of the Flamebinders
obj_text: ring 3 Flame-Imbued Talismans to Woodsman Drake at Amberpine Lodge.
desc_text: Even as we attempt to fight off the Horde, the Dragonflayer tribe musters in their village of Voldrune, near the coast to the south.$BThe most powerful warriors in the village are granted flame-imbued talismans that give them the ability to control powerful, savage proto-drakes. If we can gain control of one of these drakes, perhaps we can use it to neutralize the threat posed by Voldrune.$BThe Dragonflayer flamebinders create the talismans and imbue them with power. Kill them and take the talismans.

title: Take Their Rear!
obj_text: Anderhol at Amberpine Lodge wants you to collect 8 Grizzly Flanks from the Grizzly Bears in Grizzly Hills.
desc_text: We've all been working hard and it's beginning to pay off, but we're still far from our goal. We need much more meat than we have and it's growing clear that the local stag population won't be enough by itself.$BI'm afraid we need you to turn your attention to more dangerous prey - the grizzlies that give this region its name. They're plentiful, and they're well fed from the abundant fish that swim in these streams.$BBe safe, <class>!

title: Vordrassil's Seeds
obj_text: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to go to Grizzlemaw and obtain 8 of Vordrassil's Seeds.
desc_text: We must make sure that Vordrassil is never regrown.  The furbolg must have harvested its seed.$BGo to Grizzlemaw, in central Grizzly Hills, and obtain all the seeds that you can find.  I will make sure they're properly destroyed.

title: A Possible Link
obj_text: Hierophant Thayreen at Amberpine Lodge wants you to obtain 8 Crazed Furbolg Blood from the Furbolgs at Heart's Blood Shrine and Rage Fang Shrine.
desc_text: The furbolgs that live east of here are more aggressive and bestial than the ones we're used to.  Our forces have squared off with them more than once, and the survivors always speak of a dark, slimy substance dripping from their corpses.$BTheir condition could be linked with the contaminants we found on Vordrassil's remains.$BBring me samples of the furbolgs' blood.  You will find them in the Rage Fang Shrine and the Heart's Blood Shrine, far to the east.

title: A Possible Link
obj_text: Windseer Grayhorn in Conquest Hold wants you to obtain 8 Crazed Furbolg Blood from the Furbolgs at Heart's Blood Shrine and Rage Fang Shrine.
desc_text: Not long ago we sent an expedition to the east, where it was attacked by crazed furbolgs.  One of the survivors described slaying one of them and its body expelling a dark slimy substance.$BFor thousands of years, the furbolgs in this region have been peaceful.  It is possible that there is a link to the furbolgs' behavior and the dark energy we were able to detect earlier.$BBring me samples of the furbolgs' blood.  You will find them to the east in the Rage Fang Shrine and the Heart's Blood Shrine.

title: The Flamebinders' Secrets
obj_text: ring 3 Flame-Imbued Talismans to Sergeant Nazgrim at Conquest Hold.
desc_text: Even as the Alliance cowards attack our positions, the Dragonflayer vrykul outpost of Voldrune, to the southeast, prepares for war. The vrykul are far from the strongest enemy we face here, but we must eliminate them before they can truly threaten us.$BTheir most powerful warriors are permitted to ride half-trained proto-drakes into battle. To control the beasts, their flamebinders create powerful talismans. You'll need to slay them and take the talismans if our plan is to work.

title: The Thane of Voldrune
obj_text:
Use Flamebringer to defeat Thane Torvald Eriksson and report to Sergeant Nazgrim at Conquest Hold.
 Thane Torvald Eriksson slain
desc_text: With the flame-imbued talismans, we can finally challenge the thane.$BHis favorite mount is a ferocious proto-drake called Flamebringer. It is kept bound in chains in the western part of Voldrune, but with the power of the talismans, you should be able to bend it to your will and use it against the thane.$BOnce you have Flamebringer under your control, search the tops of the towers of Voldrune for the thane and use Flamebringer to destroy him.

title: No One to Save You
obj_text:
Kill 6 Burning Depths Necrolytes and 10 Smoldering Skeletons outside of the Obsidian Dragonshrine. Return to Serinar once the task is complete.
 Burning Depths Necrolyte slain (6)
 $BSmoldering Skeleton slain (10)

 Smoldering Skeleton
$B

 Smoldering Skeleton
desc_text: We will spare no one.$BOutside, lowly necrolytes and their skeletal servants shame my land with their presence. Slaughter them all.

title: The Best of Intentions
obj_text:
Wait for Serinar to administer the disguise of a Burning Depths Necrolyte, then proceed to the back of the Maw of Neltharion to uncover what the Cult of the Damned is doing there. Return to Serinar with details regarding their purpose.
 $BUncover the Magmawyrm Resurrection Chamber
desc_text: The Cult of the Damned has not come just to extract power from dead dragons. I suspect I know what they are up to, but I need you to prove me correct.$BI will grant you the guise of this dead necrolyte. Proceed to the back of the cave and confirm their intentions for being in this sacred place. I will watch through your eyes.$BBe cautious <name>, any damage done to you is likely to break the fragile illusion.

title: Culling the Damned
obj_text:
Kill 3 Burning Depths Necromancers, 6 Smoldering Constructs, and 6 Smoldering Geist in the Maw of Neltharion, and then return to Serinar.
 Burning Depths Necromancer slain (3)
 $BSmoldering Construct slain (6)

 Smoldering Construct
$B

 Smoldering Construct
$B
$B
 Smoldering Geist slain (6)
desc_text: The cave beyond was swarming with Cult atrocities. There is only one way to deal with such creatures... you know what to do.

title: No Place to Run
obj_text:
Place a Destructive Ward at the end of the path leading out of Obsidian Dragonshrine, where the road starts to give way to snow. Protect the ward until it is fully charged, then return to Serinar.
 Destructive Ward Fully Charged
desc_text: They're drawing power from the bones of my dead brothers...$BI have no love for the cult, but I'm baffled by their audacity. There will be no mercy shown for them... not that I ever would have anyway.$BEnsure that they have no place to flee when the slaughter starts. Place a destructive ward at the end of the path leading out of the shrine... where the road starts to give way to snow. Defend it until it is fully charged.

title: Defiling the Defilers
obj_text:
Locate and stamp out 8 Necromantic Runes that have been drawn on the floor inside the Maw of Neltharion. Return to Serinar once the task is complete.
 Necromantic Rune destroyed (8)
desc_text: I sensed a large accumulation of magic in the runes that we witnessed when you were scouting the cave. I will not have you toy with extracting the magic... often the most straight forward solution is the most effective one.$BDestroy the runes... stamp them out and ensure that the Cult will not have access to whatever power that they've accumulated there.

title: Tales of Destruction
obj_text: Travel back to Wyrmrest and let Nalice know that Serinar's task is complete.
desc_text: You can leave now, <race>.$BGo tell Nalice she missed out on a good slaughter.

title: Shred the Alliance
obj_text:
Grekk at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to acquire 3 shredders and return to him with them.
 Shredder delivered (3)
desc_text: Read my lips, <class> - I need those shredders! Just as important - I need to keep them out of the hands of the Alliance!$BThey've been refurbishing the shredders and using them against our brothers in Venture Bay. Now we're going to give them a taste of their own medicine!$BYou see a shredder out there, grab it! You see one of the Alliance scum on one, kill 'em and then grab it! Once you have one, drive it back here to me and we'll get to work on it.$BDismissed!

title: Kick 'Em While They're Down
obj_text:
Sergeant Hartsman wants you to defeat 15 Horde units or players in Blue Sky Logging Grounds.
 $BHorde units eliminated (15)

 Conquest Hold Skirmisher
 Wounded Skirmisher
 Westfall Brigade Infantry
$B

 Westfall Infantry Corpse
 Wounded Westfall Infantry
 Blue Sky Kill Credit Bunny - Grizzly Hills
desc_text: It is a dark day for the Alliance. Many good men lay dead or dying here. Our only consolation is that they fought well and brought down many of the enemy with them.$BWith the bulk of our forces committed to Venture Bay we stand alone to weather this storm. The resources in this region are vital to the Alliance and may well make the difference in our struggle against the Horde. We must not fail!$BGo, <name>. Strike at them while they lick their wounds. Avenge your fallen brothers and keep our hopes alive!

title: Keep 'Em on Their Heels
obj_text:
Commander Bargok wants you to kill 15 Alliance units or players in Blue Sky Logging Ground.
 $BAlliance units eliminated (15)

 Conquest Hold Skirmisher
 Wounded Skirmisher
 Westfall Brigade Infantry
$B

 Westfall Infantry Corpse
 Wounded Westfall Infantry
 Blue Sky Kill Credit Bunny - Grizzly Hills
desc_text: We've suffered heavy casualties here, <race>.$BThe only good news is that we've given as much as we've taken. I've requested more troops, but the bulk of our forces are bogged down in Venture Bay. It looks like we're on our own for now.$BNo matter how bad it gets, we MUST stand our ground! The precious resources of this region are essential to the Horde's long-term success in Northrend.$BWe've got to keep the Alliance on their heels until help arrives. Get out there and give 'em something to think about.

title: Overwhelmed!
obj_text:
Aumana at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to use the Renewing Tourniquet on 10 Wounded Skirmishers.
 Wounded Skirmishers Healed (10)
desc_text: You there, <class>! Help me!$BWe're losing valuable lives! There are simply too many wounded for me to tend to alone. If we can't get our soldiers healed we could be run out of Grizzly Hills altogether!$BTake this tourniquet and use it on the wounded down on the battlefield.$BHurry, <name>! They're dyyying!!

title: An Exercise in Diplomacy
obj_text: Speak to Envoy Ducal in Silverbrook.
desc_text: We'd been trying to negotiate with the trappers for weeks, but we'd gotten nowhere until you found that blasted chest of theirs.$BThis should be good news to our envoy in Silverbrook.  We sent Ducal there about a week ago and his last letter indicated he'd been making little progress.$BGo to Silverbrook and aid him in his diplomatic efforts.  Take the roads heading northwest of here and you should find it after crossing a couple of bridges.

title: Close the Deal
obj_text: ring the Cedar Chest to Ivan at Aspen Grove Post.
desc_text: We have what the trappers want.  Now it's up to us to sign them up with our side.$BTake the chest to a trapper named Ivan at the Aspen Grove Post, just north of here.$BIf all goes well, we'll have local woodsmen serving as scouts for the king's army in no time.

title: A Tentative Pact
obj_text: Return to Lieutenant Dumont in Amberpine Lodge.
desc_text: Very well, <name>.  Your people kept their end of the bargain.$BTell Dumont that we'll honor the deal.

title: Down With Captain Zorna!
obj_text:
Slay Captain Zorna and report to Baron Freeman at Venture Bay.
 Captain Zorna slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: The Horde's forces are poised to break through our lines and complete their conquest of Venture Bay if we do not act. The Horde's forces in the port are commanded by Captain Zorna, near the ship on the far side of the bay.$BIf you can defeat her, the Horde's offensive will falter and we can seize the chance to capture the port. Beware, <name>, for Zorna is a fierce fighter. It may take several people to defeat her, or if you have access to a repaired shredder, you might try using it to your advantage.

title: Escape from Silverbrook
obj_text:
Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.
 Escape from Silverbrook
desc_text: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!

title: Northern Hospitality
obj_text:
Sergei at Silverbrook wants you to slay 8 Conquest Hold Marauders.
 Conquest Hold Marauder slain (8)
desc_text: It's good to meet you.  Let us celebrate our pact by partaking in some good old fashioned Horde-killing.$BYou'll find marauders from Conquest Hold just outside our town, west of here.  Why don't you head out there and hunt them like the filthy animals they are?$BLet's see if our new allies can back all their talk with some action.

title: Test of Mettle
obj_text:
Find Sergeant Bonesnap northwest of Silverbrook and pass the Test of Mettle.
 Test of Mettle
desc_text: Alright, friend.  You've done us a favor or two, but that's not the true test of a person's courage.$BAround these parts, you're not a real hunter unless you wear your prey's skin.$B<Sergei unsheathes his skinning knife and hands it to you.>$BThe leader of those motherless orcs attacking our town is called Bonesnap; you'll find him at a camp further northwest.$BThat's right.  You're going to skin the monster.

title: A Swift Response
obj_text:
Lieutenant Dumont wants you to go to Forest's Edge Post and slay Vladek and 7 Silverbrook Hunters.
 Silverbrook Hunter slain (7)
 Vladek slain
desc_text: Our response must be immediate.  Decisive.  We must teach these savages not to cross us.$BOur scouts have located what's left of the Silverbrook trappers... you know, the ones you didn't get to douse in flames.  Apparently they're blockading the road to the southeast... perhaps they're trying to box us in.$BHead to the Forest's Edge post and take care of them.  Their leader's reported to be a man named Vladek... make sure he's dealt with.

title: Wolfsbane Root
obj_text:
Katja in Silverbrook wants you to uproot 8 Wolfsbane Roots.
 Wolfsbane Root (8)
desc_text: Have you heard of the wolfsbane plant?  It is a horrible weed... it destroys our farmable crops.$BWe spent all of last week cutting them down, but the roots are beginning to sprout again.$BIt might not seem like an urgent matter, but a resurgence of the plant could be a real... disaster.  Do you think you could help us by uprooting them where you find them near the village?

title: Words of Warning
obj_text: Go to the northwestern end of Silverbrook.
desc_text: Thanks for helping me, <name>.  My name's Sasha.  Listen, I have to get the hell out of here.$BThe people that sent you here... my people... they've changed.  They're not good people anymore... and they want to turn you into one of... one of them.$BThis... 'test' they sent you on is just the beginning.$BHead to the northwestern end of Silverbrook.  You'll find something of interest to you.$BGood luck... and trust no one.

title: Keep Them at Bay!
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Horde units or players in Venture Bay and return to Lieutenant Stuart.
 $BHorde killed in Venture Bay (10)

 Conquest Hold Berserker
 Westfall Brigade Marine
 Westfall Brigade Elite
$B

 Conquest Hold Champion
 Venture Bay Kill Credit Bunny - Grizzly Hills
desc_text: We cannot permit the Horde to control Venture Bay. The port is essential to our operations in Grizzly Hills and beyond.$BCaptain Stoutmantle has taken the rest of the Westfall Brigade east in search of a passage through the mountains, so we'll have no reinforcements.$BGo into the field, <name>, and kill the Conquest Hold berserkers the Horde has sent against us. Cut them down until none remain standing. The Alliance must have this port!

title: Pieces Parts
obj_text: Pipthwack in Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to collect 4 Grooved Cogs, 3 Notched Sprockets, and 2 High Tension Springs.
desc_text: Ack! This thing's a mess!$BGoblin engineering leaves a great deal to be desired, believe you me. Just look at this! It's a wonder it ever worked to begin with.$BGive me a hand, will ya? To get this even close to operable specifications I'll need to replace a few cogs, sprockets, and springs. You should have no trouble finding them down around the sawmill.

title: Crush Captain Brightwater!
obj_text:
Slay Captain Brightwater and report to General Khazgar at Venture Bay.
 Captain Brightwater slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: With every advance, our men are met by fresh Alliance reinforcements. It's almost as though their commander anticipates my every move!$BThe time has come for good Captain Brightwater to meet his end. He commands his troops from aboard an Alliance destroyer at the far end of the bay.$BThis will be no easy fight, <name>. Take along a couple of trusted friends, or if you have a key to one of those repaired shredders, use it to disembowel Brightwater! Either way, he must fall!

title: Making Repairs
obj_text: Lurz at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to collect 4 Grooved Cogs, 3 Notched Sprockets, and 2 High Tension Springs.
desc_text: Twenty shredders by noon tomorrow!$BWho makes these schedules, anyway? No one who ever put one of these garbage cans back together, that's who....$BIf I'm going to hit my quota, I'll need a hand. Help me out and I'll share my commission with you - fair enough?$BI need cogs, sprockets and springs. They're littered across the ground down by the shredders.

title: Attack on Silverbrook
obj_text:
Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold wants you to slay 8 Silverbrook Defenders in the Silverbrook Hills.
 Silverbrook Defender slain (8)
desc_text: A few hours ago, the trappers were nothing but peasants threatening to add their number to the Alliance's.$BNow they've become something else... an uncertainty.  I do not like uncertainties.  Go to the hills outside their main town in northern Grizzly Hills, Silverbrook, and help my men crush them.

title: Local Support
obj_text: Lieutenant Dumont at Amberpine Lodge wants you to go to Evergreen Trading Post and obtain the Cedar Chest.
desc_text: We've reached a deadlock with the Horde in Grizzly Hills.  Our forces are just about evenly matched and all signs so far have pointed to a stalemate.$BUntil this morning, that is.  The local trappers have requested our help.  Apparently the Horde took something that belongs to them... a relic of some sort.$BWe get this back for them and they'll give us the edge we need.  Head to the Evergreen Trading Post, west of Conquest Hold and look for a cedar chest.

title: Keep Them at Bay
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Alliance units or players in Venture Bay and return to Centurion Kaggrum.
 $BAlliance killed in Venture Bay (10)

 Conquest Hold Berserker
 Westfall Brigade Marine
 Westfall Brigade Elite
$B

 Conquest Hold Champion
 Venture Bay Kill Credit Bunny - Grizzly Hills
desc_text: This wretched Westfall Brigade is proving a tougher opponent than we'd thought. Though few in number, they fight well and bravely, but we cannot afford to wait them out.$BConqueror Krenna's orders were to capture the port quickly. You must break the stalemate, <name>. Find the enemy's marines and slaughter them until the resistance ceases. Only then will we be able to claim ownership of the port.$BGo quickly. We don't want to keep Conqueror Krenna waiting.

title: Heated Battle
obj_text:
Aid Captain Iskandar in holding the canyons by participating in the death of 12 Frigid Ghoul Attackers, 8 Frigid Geist Attackers, and 1 Frigid Abomination Attacker.$BReturn to Ceristrasz once you have finished this task.
 Frigid Ghoul Attacker slain (12)
 Frigid Geist Attacker slain (8)
 Frigid Abomination Attacker slain
desc_text: The Scourge have overrun the shrine. The shrine's keeper, Dahlia Suntouch, is nowhere to be found. The red wyrms that fell in the shrine's defense now beset us in the form of twisted skeletal emberwyrms. The situation is dire, <race>.$BCaptain Iskandar leads a group of your kind in stemming the flow of the Scourge out of the shrine.$BGo to his aid... but please stay behind his men. The flow of Scourge is endless and I don't want to lose you in one of those scarred canyons.

title: Return to the Earth
obj_text:
Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through one of the northern or southern passes and search for Ruby Acorns.  Use the Ruby Acorns on the fallen red dragons to return their bodies to the earth.  Return to Ceristrasz once the task is complete.
 Ruby Keeper Returned to the Earth (6)
desc_text: I have another task that needs attention. I have brothers who are falling in the battle overhead and if we do not act quickly, they will only bolster the emberwyrm ranks.$BGet into the shrine through one of the other passes to the south or north... the Scourge presence should be lighter there.$BSearch the shrine for ruby acorns that have fallen from the tree and plant them near the bodies of my fallen brood. Through this, they can give new life... a proud fate for any of my kind.

title: Smoke 'Em Out
obj_text:
Use the Smoke Bomb to drive 20 Venture Company Stragglers from their buildings and then report to Stone Guard Ragetotem.
 Venture Company Stragglers smoked out (20)
desc_text: Not only is this port infested with sniveling Alliance cowards, but to make matters worse, there are still Venture Company employees holed up in some of the buildings. They're not worth the time it takes to kill and I can't spare the warriors anyway.$BMaybe we can "convince" them to make for their ship. Take this smoke bomb and use it to smoke out the stragglers from their places in the bunkhouse, sawmill, or stables. Don't get too close, though; there's no telling what diseases they're carrying.

title: Smoke 'Em Out
obj_text:
Use the Smoke Bomb to drive 20 Venture Company Stragglers from their buildings and then report to Sergeant Downey.
 Venture Company Stragglers smoked out (20)
desc_text: There are still pockets of cowardly Venture Company men holed up in some of the buildings at the center of Venture Bay. I need every man I can spare out there fighting against the Horde, but we can't allow those Venture Company stragglers to camp out in those buildings, either.$BMaybe we can "convince" them to make for their ship. Take this smoke bomb and use it to smoke out the stragglers from their places in the bunkhouse, sawmill, or stables. Don't get too close, though; they probably bite.

title: Say Hello to My Little Friend
obj_text: Prigmon wants you to bring Harkor's Ingredients to Harkor at Harkor's Camp.
desc_text: Harkor's gunna drop a gold brick when he sees these choice ingredients. All that be left is gettin' them to him.$BHe's camped out on the eastern coast near dem haunted ruins - Drakil'jin, dey be called.$BYou'll likely be makin' it there before I can finish up with these corpses... unless, ya think you'd rather try your hand at embalming?

title: Tactical Clemency
obj_text: Deliver the Letter of Amnesty to the Captured Trapper in Silverbrook Hills.
desc_text: Listen, <name>.  I need you to act with discretion and speed.$BOne of Krenna's top sergeants has captured a trapper outcast outside of Silverbrook.  Now, if things turn out the way they usually do, the prisoner is going to be executed before the day is over.$BWe can't let that happen.  You see, the prisoner matches the description of Mikhail's older daughter in his diary.$BIf we set her loose and follow her closely, she'll lead us to whoever's controlling the trappers.  Take this letter to her.

title: Gorgonna
obj_text: ring Mikhail's Journal to Gorgonna in Conquest Hold.
desc_text: This book is written in the pig-tongue the humans use.  It needs to be burned immediately.$BHand it to my sister Gorgonna and do not waste my time.

title: The Conquest Pit: Mad Furbolg Fighting
obj_text:
Defeat Torgg Thundertotem inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.$B
 $BTorgg Thundertotem defeated
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: You're not bad.  Not bad at all.$BThink you can take a furbolg?  What about one of those extra-large crazed Northrend furbolgs?$BGood, good.  Get your crew together, and head to the ring.  Let's give these folks a show... maybe we can earn some more coin while we're at it.

title: Mikhail's Journal
obj_text: ring Mikhail's Journal to Conqueror Krenna in Conquest Hold.
desc_text: From what you can gather, this journal was written by a denizen of Silverbrook named Mikhail.$BIt is written in some variant of the common human tongue.  Perhaps you should bring this back to Conqueror Krenna.

title: The Conquest Pit: Blood and Metal
obj_text:
Defeat Rustblood inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.$B
 $BRustblood defeated
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: It's nice to have a real fighter around these parts... we'd only had prisoners and caged beasts for the past few weeks.  The people get bored, ya know?$BAnyhow, your next challenge is a genuine iron golem stolen from the depths of Thor Modan... think you can swing it?

title: The Conquest Pit: Bear Wrestling!
obj_text:
Defeat Ironhide inside the Conquest Pit and speak to Bookie Vel'jen for a reward.
 $BIronhide defeated
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: So you're interested in the fights, eh?  Well, Krenna has outlawed pit-fighting for all enlisted combatants.  But you, my friend, are technically a free agent and are not included in this prohibition.$BNice loophole, eh?$BAnyway, if you're interested I can start you off with something easy, a measly bear.  I'll even let you bring friends along!

title: Blackriver Skirmish
obj_text:
Scout Captain Carter wants you to kill 10 Horde units or players in the Blackriver Logging Camp.
 $BHorde in Blackriver slain (10)

 Amberpine Scout
 Conquest Hold Raider
 Valiance Commando
$B

 Warsong Raider
 Blackriver Credit
desc_text: The Venture Company's on its way out of Grizzly Hills.  They used to run logging operations here, but things got a little too dangerous for them.$BTheir abandoned sites are up for grabs and we sure as hell can't let the Horde get their hands on them.$BThe Blackriver Logging Camp is the smallest of the three logging sites in this zone, but we still need it.  Do your part and fend off the Horde forces.  Any lumber they get here will be made into weapons to be used against us elsewhere.

title: Wanted: Kreug Oathbreaker
obj_text:
Kill Kreug Oathbreaker and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.
 Kreug Oathbreaker slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Posted by: Illusia Lune$BThe Scourge flesh giant known as Kreug Oathbreaker was responsible for the deaths of my husband, children and my dear friends, the Whisperveils. Those brave enough to take on this bounty will find Kreug in the southeastern reaches of the Carrion Fields.$BI demand justice! Kill Kreug Oathbreaker!$BIn the event that Kreug is slain, I have pooled money and items together and given them to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig to give out as a reward.$BPlease vindicate us!

title: Riding the Red Rocket
obj_text:
General Gorlok at the lighthouse in Venture Bay wants you to destroy the Alliance Lumber Boat.$BGeneral Gorlok will only be present at the lighthouse when the Horde has it in their possession.
 Destroyed Alliance Lumber Shipment
desc_text: You there, <race>! Get your lousy carcass over here!$BThe Alliance have a shipment of lumber all ready for transport just northeast of here. Since getting our hands on that wood is out of the question, there's only one thing to do - destroy it!$BThe goblin at the end of the dock here has some torpedoes all ready to go. He's got all the fuel for them on the docked goblin ship to the north.$BGet some fuel, then commandeer one of the torpedoes and ride it into their ship.$BDismissed!

title: Heated Battle
obj_text:
Aid Captain Drayzen in holding the canyons by participating in the death of 12 Frigid Ghoul Attackers, 8 Frigid Geist Attackers, and 1 Frigid Abomination Attacker.$BReturn to Vargastrasz once you have finished this task.
 Frigid Ghoul Attacker slain (12)
 Frigid Geist Attacker slain (8)
 Frigid Abomination Attacker slain
desc_text: The Scourge have overrun the shrine. The shrine's keeper, Dahlia Suntouch, is nowhere to be found. The red wyrms that fell in the shrine's defense now beset us in the form of twisted skeletal emberwyrms. The situation is dire, <race>.$BCaptain Drayzen leads a group of your kind in stemming the flow of the Scourge out of the shrine.$BGo to his aid... but please stay behind his men. The flow of Scourge is endless and I don't want to lose you in one of those scarred canyons.

title: Seeking Solvent
obj_text: Gurtor at the Venture Bay Horde base wants you to bring him a canister of Element 115.
desc_text: Gah! Not again. Another blown gasket....$BEvery time one of these goes, lubricant gums up all of the gears. Without solvent, it takes hours to clean.$BTell ya what, <race>. There's some fancy rocket fuel on the Venture Company barge in the dock there - element 115 I think they call it. That stuff makes for a great solvent.$BGet me one of those and I'll make it worth your trouble.

title: Onward to Camp Oneqwah
obj_text: Speak with Scout Vor'takh at Camp Oneqwah.
desc_text: While we build Conquest Hold, I sent Scout Vor'takh to make contact with our taunka allies in the east. They're based in Camp Oneqwah, which is in the easternmost part of Grizzly Hills, beyond Grizzlemaw.$BMake the journey there, hear Vor'takh's report and offer your assistance with anything he and the local chieftain may need. Your contributions to Conquest Hold have been exemplary and I know Vor'takh will be grateful for the assistance.

title: Report to Lord Afrasastrasz
obj_text: Speak with Lord Afrasastrasz at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: I abhor the loss of life... any life. But I will not stand idly by and allow Malygos to kill us and defile the temple!$BI have appointed Lord Afrasastrasz as the commander of Wyrmrest's defenses.$BSpeak with Torastrasza to ride a drake down to him.$BPlease lend him your aid, <name>. Your involvement with the defense of Wyrmrest will be critical to us prevailing against the blue dragonflight.

title: Wanted: High Shaman Bloodpaw
obj_text:
Kill High Shaman Bloodpaw and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.
 High Shaman Bloodpaw slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Posted by: Drolfy$BWhile out in the Eldritch Heights with my cousins, Skrotee and Brote, a vicious band of wolvar from the Bloodpaw tribe attacked us. We attempted to flee, but I fear they got Skrotee and Brote.$BI demand retribution! Is there someone brave enough to venture to the southeastern reaches of Dragonblight, to the Eldritch Heights, and kill High Shaman Bloodpaw and his cronies?$BI have given a hefty sum of gold to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig to disperse to anyone that claims this bounty!

title: Riding the Red Rocket
obj_text:
Commander Howser at the lighthouse in Venture Bay wants you to destroy the Horde lumber shipment.$BCommander Howser will only be present at the lighthouse when the Alliance has it in their possession.
 Horde Lumberboat destroyed
desc_text: Listen, <name>. This battle is as much over resources as tactical supremacy.$BI have a mission that could turn the tide in our struggle against the Horde here.$BThere are torpedoes at the end of the dock that we can use to take down the Horde's lumber ship to the northwest.$BYou'll need to get some of the fuel that's stored on the docked goblin ship just north of here, then ride one of the torpedoes into their transport!

title: Wanted: Onslaught Commander Iustus
obj_text:
Kill Onslaught Commander Iustus and return to Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight to collect your reward.$B
 Onslaught Commander Iustus slain
 $BSuggested players: 4
desc_text: Posted by: Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig$BUpon the northeastern path from Wintergarde a battalion of 7th Legion were ambushed and slain by Onslaught Commander Iustus and an army of mindless Scarlet Onslaught zealots. Such cold and calculated actions must be met with force!$BWintergarde demands justice! Seek out Onslaught Commander Iustus at Onslaught Base Camp to the northeast and end his miserable existence.$BI will hand out the reward for this bounty to any who would dare take up the task!

title: zzOLD The Fate of the Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text: ring Dahlia's Ruby Broach to Ceristrasz and inform him of her fate.

title: Cycle of Life
obj_text:
Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine has asked you to slay 5 Emerald Skytalons.
 Emerald Skytalon slain (5)
desc_text: Ysera sleeps in the Emerald Dream, watching over both the Dream and Azeroth. But a horrible nightmare has taken hold in the Dream, and now I fear that Ysera is being affected by it.$BRecently, I asked her to aid in the fight against the Scourge that are raising frostwyrms at the other dragonshrines. She misunderstood.$BInstead, she told our dragonshrine's defenders to treat those not of the green dragonflight as enemies.$BI need you to slay some of the skytalons. The shrine must regain its balance.

title: Return to the Earth
obj_text:
Enter the Ruby Dragonshrine through the southern pass and search for Ruby Acorns.  Use the Ruby Acorns on the fallen red dragons to return their bodies to the earth.  Return to Vargastrasz once the task is complete.
 Ruby Keeper Returned to the Earth (6)
desc_text: I have another task that needs attention. I have brothers who are falling in the battle overhead and if we do not act quickly, they will only bolster the emberwyrm ranks.$BGet into the shrine through the pass in the south... the Scourge presence should be lighter there.$BSearch the shrine for ruby acorns that have fallen from the tree and plant them near the bodies of my fallen brood. Through this, they can give new life... a proud fate for any of my kind.

title: The Obsidian Dragonshrine
obj_text: Travel to the Obsidian Dragonshrine Northwest of Wymrest and just West of the Wrath Gate. Locate Serinar inside of the shrine and offer him your aid.
desc_text: The Scourge come. Korialstrasz calls upon his allies in a futile attempt to save their Ruby Dragonshrine, but it seems the good graces of the red flight don't extend to saving the shrines of the other flights.$BSurprised? I'm not.$BThere is another of my brood who has left to clear our Obsidian Dragonshrine of the undead vermin that now infest it. All it would take to prove yourself more noble and righteous than Alexstrasza herself is a quick jaunt over there and a few swings of a blade.$BI'm amused.

title: Supplemental Income
obj_text: Provisioner Lorkran at Conquest Hold wants you to obtain 5 Succulent Venison from  the nearby Tallhorn Stag.
desc_text: Hail, <class>.  You'll find that here at Conquest Hold, we buy and sell what Krenna wants us to buy and sell... at the price that Krenna wants us to buy and sell.$BAll this is stifling business.  I'm hoping to make a little bit of coin on the side and feed our grunts at the same time.  Why don't you go hunt down some stag and bring me the venison?$BThey're numerous in the area, so bring me only the best meat.

title: Report to the Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text: Report to Ceristrasz on the ridge east of the Ruby Dragonshrine, west of Wyrmrest.
desc_text: We need you at the Ruby Dragonshrine.$BThe dragons are beset on all sides by the blue flight and the scourge... they're in no better a state than we are. The situation seems dire, but this affords us a rare opportunity to establish a valuable alliance.$BI secured a regiment to aid the red dragonflight against the Scourge at the Ruby Dragonshrine. If you have a fight in you, please go find Ceristrasz on the ridge east of the shrine and help him in any way that you can.

title: The Conqueror's Task
obj_text: Speak to Sergeant Nazgrim in Conquest Hold.
desc_text: The Horde is a magnificent war machine and you are nothing but a cog.$BI am in charge of securing fuel for this machine.  If I fail, the machine fails.$BLumber, ore, water... it's all here and we want it.  And so does the Alliance.$BBefore we can move against the human scum, we need to solidify our control over the western region.$BSpeak to Sergeant Nazgrim about eradicating the vrykul in Voldrune and then maybe - if you turn out to not be a complete failure - we'll send you on further tasks.

title: Report to the Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text: Report to Vargastrasz on a ridge outside of the Ruby Dragonshrine, just east of Agmar's Hammer.
desc_text: You are leaving to the Ruby Dragonshrine. This is not a request.$BThe dragons are beset on all sides by the blue flight and the scourge... they're in no better a state than we are. It is not often we are afforded the opportunity to redeem ourselves for the transgressions of our ancestors.$BI have secured a regiment to aid the red dragonflight against the Scourge at the Ruby Dragonshrine. Join them and crush the Scourge beneath your boots!$BFor the Horde!

title: Eyes Above
obj_text:
Windseer Grayhorn wants you to use the Silver Feather on 6 Imperial Eagles in Grizzly Hills.
 Imperial Eagle's sight bound (6)
desc_text: I've been asked to lend my support to our efforts against the Alliance.  At the moment our military forces are about evenly matched and we're looking for ways to find an edge.$BThe imperial eagles that fly over the mountains and trees in this area would make excellent scouts for us.  Take this silver feather and use it to bind my sight to that of them.$BBeing able to see our enemy's movements will grant us the strategic advantage we need.  You'll find abundant eagles in the mountains to the east.

title: That Which Creates Can Also Destroy
obj_text:
Lord Itharius at the top of Wyrmrest Temple has asked you to destroy a Weakened Reanimated Frost Wyrm, Weakened Turgid the Vile, and Weakened Overseer Deathgaze.
 Weakened Reanimated Frost Wyrm slain
 Weakened Turgid the Vile slain
 Weakened Overseer Deathgaze slain
desc_text: Since we only have three seeds, we must put them to the best possible use.$BYour targets are one of the reanimated frost wyrms circling to the north near Galakrond's Rest, Turgid the Vile in the ruined barracks at the Carrion Fields to the east, and Overseer Deathgaze at Jintha'kalar far to the northeast.$BWhile the seeds would outright destroy one of the lesser Scourge, they will greatly weaken these three. Enough so, in fact, that you should be able to handle them on your own.

title: Seeds of the Lashers
obj_text: Lord Itharius at the top of Wyrmrest Temple has asked you to return with 3 Lasher Seeds.
desc_text: We need more weapons in the fight against the Scourge. The natural properties of the Emerald Dragonshrine to the southeast may be the answer.$BAny unliving creature, save those that Sylvanas has redeemed, that steps foot in the dragonshrine falls to dust.$BI want to test a theory, and I want you to be my instrument in doing so, young <race>. Go to the Emerald Dragonshrine and take the seeds from the emerald lashers therein.

title: The Plume of Alystros
obj_text: Nishera the Garden Keeper at the Emerald Dragonshrine has asked you to acquire The Plume of Alystros.
desc_text: I can feel that the shrine is not completely back in balance. The verdant keeper has been angered by our actions, and I sense that he will not listen to reason.$BAlystros is an immense skytalon who perches at the south end of the Emerald Dragonshrine. It is he who is in charge of the dragonshrine's aerial defenses. I fear that we will have to deal with him.$BTake these skytalon molts and place them on the ground where he can see them. He will come. Bring me his plume.

title: Return to Sender
obj_text: Follow the ridge to the east and deliver the pack of explosives to Xink at Nozzlerust Post in northern Dragonblight.
desc_text: Upon closer examination, the goblin appears to have been running a pack full of explosives across the wastes for delivery. The harpy feathers half-buried in the snow nearby suggest how he met his ill fate.$BIt appears that the goblin was bringing the explosives towards the Wrath Gate from somewhere to the east. It seems most prudent to follow the ridge back to the east and inform the sender of their runner's fate.

title: Scourgekabob
obj_text:
Prigmon at Granite Springs wants you to bring a Mummified Troll Carcass to Mack Fearsen and place it in the fire.
 Mummified Carcass Burned
desc_text: Ugh.$BWrappin' up these unfortunate trolls be makin' my heart ache, but not so much as my back!$BHelp ol' Prigmon out and haul one of these carcasses over to Mack.$BIf we don't burn 'em they be walkin' again in no time.

title: To Conquest Hold, But Be Careful!
obj_text: Present yourself to Conqueror Krenna at Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills.
desc_text: I've received a request for help from our base in the Grizzly Hills. I'm sending you to see Conqueror Krenna.$B<The high executor waves a sheaf of parchment in the air as if he could care less what is written on it.>$BShe's attempting to secure all of the natural resources or somesuch. Just watch your back around her. The word is that she's aggressive even for an orc.$BFollow the road east and then southeast. Cross the bridge at the Dragonspine Tributary and go east from the Evergreen Trading Post.

title: The High Executor Needs You
obj_text: Speak with High Executor Wroth at Venomspite in Dragonblight.
desc_text: It's a good thing that I intercepted this request from High Executor Wroth before it got to Overlord Agmar. What is Wroth thinking?$B<The sergeant rips up the letter that he's holding.>$B<class>, go see what it is that the high executor wants.$BFollow the road east and pass through The Dragon Wastes. You'll find a path leading up out of the wastes on the southeast side, and the Forsaken town, Venomspite, will stand before you on the south side of the mountain.

title: Audience With The Dragon Queen
obj_text: Seek out Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Our assault against Angrathar has staggered the Scourge, but they remain unrelenting. From overhead they send their frost wyrms to strafe the field of battle, making an advance upon the gate itself impossible. The frost wyrm attacks must be stopped, but before we defile the bones of ancient dragons, we must gain permission from their queen.$BTravel southeast to Wyrmrest Temple and seek out Queen Alexstrasza. Tell her what we must do and ask her for guidance.$BGo now, <name>!

title: Audience With The Dragon Queen
obj_text: Seek out Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Though I know you hunger to destroy the Scourge that stand before us at the Wrath Gate, we must first deal with the threat that looms overhead. Until the strafing assaults of the frost wyrms are halted, we cannot move forward.$BBut before we assault the dying grounds of dragons, we must first be granted permission. Venture now to the hallowed halls of dragonkind: Wyrmrest Temple. Once there, seek out Queen Alexstrasza.$BRide now, <name>! Southeast, to Wyrmrest!

title: Galakrond and the Scourge
obj_text: Speak with Torastrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
desc_text: Atop the Wicked Coil, the Grand Necrolord of the Scourge, Antiok, sits upon the shoulders of the reconstructed storm giant lord, Thiassi. From there he commands the armies of undead to work day and night to unearth Galakrond's massive bones. Should they succeed in raising Galakrond, all of your efforts will have been for naught.$BWhile I cannot call down the full fury of the Red Dragonflight to assist you in your journey, I will grant you my blessing. Go now and speak with my majordomo, Torastrasza.

title: Return To Angrathar
obj_text: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon at Fordragon Hold and tell him of your victory over the Scourge.
desc_text: With Antiok slain and the scythe in our possession, the frost wyrm assaults upon your forces at Angrathar will halt. The wyrms that remain in the Dragonblight will be hunted and destroyed, their bones returning to the earth.$BThe time to make your final stand is now, <name>. Return to Fordragon Hold and notify Highlord Fordragon.

title: The Cleansing Of Jintha'kalar
obj_text:
Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight has asked you to slay 15 Jintha'kalar Scourge.
 $BJintha'kalar Scourge Slain (15)

 Decrepit Necromancer
 Battered Drakkari Berserker
 Reanimated Drakkari Tribesman
$B

 Hulking Atrocity
 Tormented Drakkari
 Jintha'kalar Scourge (PROXY DO NOT SPAWN)
desc_text: We wrested this ancient Drakkari temple from a swarm of invading Scourge. Not more than one-hundred paces from where we stand is the ruined city of Jintha'kalar. Scourge necromancers run amok, turning the living Drakkari trolls that remain into servants of the Lich King.$BAll are now lost to the Light. All must be purged.$B<Valus looks upon you sternly.>$BAll.

title: Return To Angrathar
obj_text: Speak with Saurfang the Younger at the Kor'kron Vangaurd and tell him of your victory over the Scourge.
desc_text: With Antiok slain and the scythe in our possession, the frost wyrm assaults upon your forces at Angrathar will halt. The wyrms that remain in the Dragonblight will be hunted and destroyed, their bones returning to the earth.$BThe time to make your final stand is now, <name>. Return to the Kor'kron Vanguard and notify Saurfang the Younger.

title: The Call Of The Crusade
obj_text: Report to Crusader Valus at Light's Trust in Dragonblight.
desc_text: <class>! The Argent Crusade is looking for able bodied soldiers that are willing to set aside their differences and join forces to battle the forces of the Lich King. Will you take up our cause?$BShould you be interested, venture north to Light's Trust and speak with Crusader Valus.$BYou will find Light's Trust amidst the ruins of the sacked troll city of Jintha'kalar - bordering Zul'Drak.$BFarewell.

title: Herald of War
obj_text: Report to Thrall at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: The Warchief needs you, champion. Orgrimmar is in a state of martial law. All merchants and services have been shut down as the Warchief prepares for an unavoidable conflict.$BI cannot tell you much more - not now. Not in this place.$BThe Warchief commands that our strongest champions report to his throne room. Go now, <name>! Take the portal back to Orgrimmar and seek out Thrall.

title: Learning to Leave and Return: the Magical Way
obj_text:
Archmage Celindra at The Violet Gate in Dalaran wants you to use the Teleport to Violet Stand Crystal and the Teleport to Dalaran Crystal.
 Teleport to Violet Stand Crystal used
 Teleport to Dalaran Crystal used
desc_text: Just in case you don't already know, you can use the crystal on the platform behind me to teleport to the Violet Stand in Crystalsong Forest beneath Dalaran.$BCorrespondingly, you can use the crystal at the stand below to return to the chamber above me.$BI would like for you to do this now.

title: My Heart is in Your Hands
obj_text: Drakuru wants you to bring the Heart of the Ancients to him at Drak'atal Passage.$BYou will need to collect 5 Desperate Mojo to use the elixir there.
desc_text: <Drakuru's voice fills your mind.>$BHey, mon! Dis eye of da prophets be great! I been usin' it to watch ya and I see ya got da heart now! Not bad....$BNow ya just gotta bring it to my brazier at Drak'atal Passage, a short walk east of ya.$BYa must drink my elixir at da pedestal to summon me there. This time, ya need ta mix in some desperate mojo from the defenders there for it ta be workin'.

title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
obj_text: Deliver the Kirin Tor Signet to Archmage Celindra at The Violet Gate in Dalaran.
desc_text: Hello, <name>. You may or may not be aware that we Kirin Tor moved our city here to Northrend.$BNo longer does Dalaran sit under its protective dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Now the city magically floats above the Crystalsong Forest.$BWe believe you to be ready for your journey to the city. Speak with me again and I will cast a spell of teleportation to transport you there.$BWhen you arrive, seek out Archmage Celindra and give her my signet as proof that we spoke.

title: Don't Forget the Eggs!
obj_text:
Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to enter Azjol-Nerub and destroy 6 Nerubian Scourge Eggs.
 Nerubian Scourge Eggs Destroyed (6)
desc_text: Throughout Azjol-Nerub, the scourged nerubians carefully nurture eggs that will soon hatch, providing them even greater numbers.$BIt would do little good for the caverns to be cleansed of the undead that stain them if these fouled eggs were left to hatch and take their place.$BAs you  explore the expanse that was once Azjol-Nerub, be sure to clear our ancient home of any scourge eggs you find.

title: A Life Without Regret
obj_text: Take the portal to Undercity located in Grommash Hold and report to Vol'jin.
desc_text: On the day of my death I wish to be able to say that I lived a life without regret. Those who mourn my passing will know that I was a Warchief who made decisions that best served his people.$BBut this betrayal by Varimathras and Putress... All that we have worked for is for nothing.$B<Thrall's chest heaves with a heavy sigh.>$BJustice must be served.$BPortals to Undercity will be active momentarily. Vol'jin will be waiting for you. I will meet you there soon. Together we will make it right, <name>.

title: The Battle For The Undercity
obj_text: Assist Thrall and Sylvanas in retaking the Undercity for the Horde.$BReport to Thrall should you succeed.
desc_text: The entirety of the Undercity is controlled by Varimathras. Our soldiers stand ready, waiting for the Warchief to give the attack orders.$BHelp the Horde take back the Undercity and earn your place among our greatest champions! Should you survive the assault, report to Thrall.$BCheck in with the Warchief when you are ready to begin.

title: On Ruby Wings
obj_text:
Destroy 30 Wastes Scavengers and recover the Scythe of Antiok. Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple should you complete this task.
 Wastes Scavenger slain (30)
desc_text: Use this beacon to signal a Wyrmrest vanquisher. Climb upon its back and fly north to Galakrond's Rest. Once there, command the dragon to destroy the Scourge scavengers that work to unearth Galakrond. Once the area has been cleansed, fly to the Wicked Coil, overlooking Galakrond's Rest, to destroy Grand Necrolord Antiok and recover the scythe that he uses to control the wyrms.$BDo this and return to Queen Alexstrasza for a hero's reward!$B<name>, beware the rotting storm giants that wander the area!

title: Head Games
obj_text: Kurzel wants you to use Kurzel's Blouse Scrap at the corpse of Novos the Summoner, then take the Ichor-Stained Cloth to Mack.
desc_text: Too lazy for their own good.... Wait! I know how to teach 'em!$B<Kurzel rips a long strip of material from her blouse and hands it to you.>$BHere, <race>, take this. Dip it in the remains of that annoying lich over there and return it to Mack back at the camp.$BOnce the boys have stewed in their guilt for a while I'll show up and let them off the hook.$BThey'll learn not to let a lady wander off alone!

title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
obj_text: Deliver the Kirin Tor Signet to Archmage Celindra at the Violet Gate in Dalaran.
desc_text: Hello, <name>. You may or may not be aware that we Kirin Tor moved our city here to Northrend.$BNo longer does Dalaran sit under its protective dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Now the city magically floats above the Crystalsong Forest.$BWe believe you to be ready for your journey to the city. Speak with me again and I will cast a spell of teleportation to transport you there.$BWhen you arrive, seek out Archmage Celindra and give her my signet as proof that we spoke.

title: The Magical Kingdom of Dalaran
obj_text: Deliver the Kirin Tor Signet to Archmage Celindra at The Violet Gate in Dalaran.
desc_text: Hello, <name>. You may or may not be aware that we Kirin Tor moved our city here to Northrend.$BNo longer does Dalaran sit under its protective dome on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Now the city magically floats above the Crystalsong Forest.$BWe believe you to be ready for your journey to the city. Speak with me again and I will cast a spell of teleportation to transport you there.$BWhen you arrive, seek out Archmage Celindra and give her my signet as proof that we spoke.

title: Darkness Stirs
obj_text: Gather Saurfang's Battle Armor from the field of battle and return it to High Overlord Saurfang at Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra.
desc_text: Darkness stirs, <name>. A tragic event has transpired that none but the Timeless One could have foreseen. Soon your people will be gripped by anger and hatred. War is on the horizon.$BThe red dragonflight has done all that it can. What happens next is in the hands of the mortal races of Azeroth.$BRegrettably, your journey begins with anguish. A father has lost a child today. You must bear the grim news. Gather the armaments of Saurfang and return them to the elder Saurfang.

title: Death to the Traitor King
obj_text: Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun has tasked you with defeating Anub'arak in Azjol-Nerub. You are to return to Kilix with Anub'arak's Broken Husk.
desc_text: Anub'arak, the traitor king, makes his home in the once proud underland of Azjol-Nerub.$BSince his betrayal, he has twisted and perverted our homeland into the wretched squalor it is today. He rules over an army of undead nerubians who, like their leader, have pledged themselves to serving the Lich King.$BBring an end to the traitor king's reign, <class>. You will be doing a great service to both of our peoples.$BIf you manage to succeed where all others have failed, bring me the husk of Anub'arak.

title: Fate, Up Against Your Will
obj_text: Assist Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Orgrimmar. Speak to the Warchief of the Horde, Thrall, at Orgrimmar on the continent of Kalimdor.
desc_text: At the behest of Lady Proudmoore, I will allow a diplomatic mission to Orgrimmar to question the Horde's Warchief, Thrall. You will assist her in this journey and keep her safe from harm. Return to me with news from Orgrimmar.$BSpeak to Jaina when you are ready to leave.

title: The Battle For The Undercity
obj_text:
Assist King Varian Wrynn and Lady Jaina Proudmoore in bringing Grand Apothecary Putress to justice! Report to King Varian Wrynn should you succeed.
 $BAssist King Varian Wrynn
desc_text: Deep inside the bowels of the Undercity hides the assassin responsible for the deaths of Bolvar and our brave soldiers at the Wrath Gate.$BVarian has brought the full might of the Alliance with him to assist in the take down. Join him and Lady Proudmoore in the manhunt and earn your place among the greatest champions of the Alliance!$BSpeak to King Varian Wrynn when you are ready.

title: Escape from Silverbrook
obj_text:
Open the Wooden Cage and help the Freed Alliance Scout escape from Silverbrook.  Report to Lieutenant Dumont when you reach Amberpine Lodge.
 Escape from Silverbrook
desc_text: You... you're not one of them?  Quick!  Let me out!$BWe have to get to Amberpine Lodge immediately!  Once Lieutenant Dumont finds out who these people really are, this town will be reduced to rubble!

title: Reborn From The Ashes
obj_text: Gather Fordragon's Shield from the field of battle at Angrathar the Wrath Gate and return it to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
desc_text: Our fate is emblazoned upon our souls at birth. Bolvar's fall, while tragic, was unavoidable.$BAll that you can do now is honor your hero, <name>. Collect Bolvar's shield from the field of battle and return it to your king. When you present the shield to Varian, tell him this: "All is not lost. From the ashes of the fallen will rise a force that will unite nations and purge the evil from this world."$BHe mustn't lose faith. Go now, <name>. Your people need a hero. They need you.

title: The Killing Time
obj_text: Use the Portal to the Undercity inside Stormwind Keep to teleport to the Undercity. Report to Broll Bearmantle when you arrive at your destination.
desc_text: I sent Broll and Valeera to the Undercity before you left for Orgrimmar. In fact, they're now stationed outside the sewer entrance to the ruins, awaiting orders.$BLady Proudmoore will open a portal to our forces outside the Undercity. Go there and report to Broll. Jaina and I will be close behind.

title: A Royal Coup
obj_text: Use the portal in Grommash Hold to return to Stormwind Keep and deliver Thrall's message to King Varian Wrynn.
desc_text: Your champion, Bolvar, died in defense of our world. The Horde is saddened by the loss of such a great hero, but the Horde was not responsible for the cowardly attacks made by Putress at the Wrath Gate. We have also lost mighty heroes because of this betrayal.$BTell your king that we will do everything in our power to bring the perpetrators of this cowardly act to justice. We will do all that we can to avoid conflict with the Alliance, but we will not hesitate to defend ourselves if provoked.

title: Wrath of the Lich King Random 70-79 (1st) [Random Wrath of the Lich King Dungeon]
Seeking Solvent
obj_text: arblefink at the Alliance base in Venture Bay wants you to bring him a canister of Element 115.
desc_text: Gah! Not again. Another blown gasket....$BEvery time one of these goes, lubricant gums up all of the gears. Without solvent, it takes hours to clean.$BTell ya what, <race>. There's some fancy rocket fuel on the Venture Company barge in the dock there - element 115 I think they call it. That stuff makes for a great solvent.$BGet me one of those and I'll make it worth your trouble.

title: The Activation Rune
obj_text: Obtain the Omega Rune inside the Shaper's Terrace and bring it to The Etymidian.
desc_text: This colossal being appears to be inactive.  You notice an empty rune-shaped slot on its chest.$BPerhaps you might be able to find the missing rune inside the nearby overlook.

title: Kartak's Rampage
obj_text:
ring a pure sample of Oracle Blood to the Altar of Kartak to summon Kartak. With the aid of Kartak's shared powers, slaughter 50 of the nearby Sparktouched Gorlocs for Shaman Jakjek in Kartak's Hold.
 $BSparktouched Gorloc slain (50)

 Sparktouched Oracle
$B

 Sparktouched Warrior
desc_text: You the great Lich Hunter, eh? Good to have such strong Frenzyheart ally for battle. Maybe you strong enough to call Kartak even.$BBig battle at Kartak's Hold to southwest.  Go kill spark big-tongues until you get good bit of Oracle Blood. Bring blood to altar in Kartak's Hold to call Kartak for delicious feast of big-tongue.$BKartak take your body if you worthy... with Kartak's powers, you slaughter more big-tongues than even best dreams.$BGo kill lots, hunter!

title: Wrath of the Lich King Random 70-79 (1st) [Random Wrath of the Lich King Dungeon]
A Timeworn Coffer
obj_text: Obtain a Huge Stone Key from the nearby Sholazar Guardians and bring it to the Timeworn Coffer at the Maker's Overlook.
desc_text: The stone coffer appears to be locked.  It appears that a key fits inside a large stone keyhole.$BPerhaps one of the guardians in the vicinity has this key in its possession.

title: Cultist Incursion
obj_text: Speak to the Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids.
desc_text: <It appears the Avatar of Freya was right.  The undead were not able to enter Sholazar Basin before the Lifeblood Pillar was brought down -- they used their living agents from the Cult of the Damned instead.>$B<You'd best warn her about the Lich King's living agents within Sholazar Basin.>

title: Convocation at Zol'Heb
obj_text:
Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to slay the Prophet of Akali.
 Prophet of Akali slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: You and your friends must take this instrument of convocation - of summoning - to Zol'Heb just south of Gundrak.$BTherein you will find a circle of power. Use the convocation to force the prophet of Akali to appear.$BMy heart goes out to you, <name>. We have been through much together, and you have done all that you can to not only save my life, but those of the other gods the Drakkari have destroyed.$BBut I fear this time we may not see each other again until the afterlife.

title: Mastery of the Crystals
obj_text:
Retrieve the crystal defenses at Sparktouched Haven and use them to kill 50 of the nearby Frenzyheart wolvar. When these tasks are complete, return to Lightningcaller Soo-met in Sparktouched Haven.
 $BFrenzyheart Attacker (50)

 Frenzyheart Hunter
$B

 Frenzyheart Ravager
desc_text: Sparktouched are still being attacked by puppy-men... we think they maybe not stop if we not make them stop. We have secret weapon though... we sent it out to Soo-met so he can use to protect all Oracles.$BSecret weapon is from Great Ones themselves... extra shiny crystals found inside sacred Great One temples. Be very careful... no break them.$BCrystals are in chest near shrine at Sparktouched Haven, in far southwest. You go use crystals to help Soo-met beat the puppy-men.

title: The Etymidian
obj_text: Go through the Waygate in the southern end of Sholazar Basin and look for the weapon known as the Etymidian on the other side.
desc_text: It is time, <name>.  The Waygate has been activated for the first time in seven centuries.  Use it to travel to where our final hope lies.$BLet us put an end to those who would seek to bring the taint of undeath to this pristine land.  Let us unleash the Etymidian.

title: Will of the Titans
obj_text:
Obtain a Tainted Crystal from the wolvar near Sparktouched Haven and bring it to the Great Lightning Stone to call Soo-holu. With the aid of Soo-holu's shared powers, kill 50 of the nearby Frenzyheart wolvar, then return to Lightningcaller Soo-met near the Great Lightning Stone.
 $BFrenzyheart Attacker slain (50)

 Frenzyheart Hunter
$B

 Frenzyheart Ravager
desc_text: Puppy-men been attacking Sparktouched... we need fight or they just attack other Oracles too.$BYou been good friend to us, so maybe we allow you special honor. Great Ones left protector long time ago for shrines... it here still, but it not know something wrong til shrines messed with.$BPuppy-men down there have bad crystals for making trouble... bring a bad crystal to Lightning Shrine so Soo-holu know to help.$BDon't be scared if Soo-holu take your body... he very powerful, so he keep you safe.

title: Reclamation
obj_text:
Go to the Avalanche in Sholazar Basin and use the Omega Rune to deploy Etymidian.  Use him to slay 200 Scourge Minions, Bythius the Flesh-Shaper, Urgreth of the Thousand Tombs and Hailscorn.$BSpeak to the Avatar of Freya in Sholazar Basin when you've completed this task.
 $BScourge Minions destroyed (200)

 Snowblind Ghoul
 Frostbitten Corpse
$B

 Risen Reaver
 Glacial Breach Scourge Credit
$B
$B
 Bythius the Flesh-Shaper slain
 Urgreth of the Thousand Tombs slain
 Hailscorn slain
desc_text: It is time, <name>.  The Etymidian is one of the most destructive forces ever created by the titans and I am loathe to unleash him in my lands.$BThere is little choice, however.  Our enemies have forced my hand and the fury of the titans will cleanse all.

title: Secret Strength of the Frenzyheart
obj_text:
Using the secret Frenzyheart drink, slaughter 30 of the Sparktouched Gorlocs around Kartak's Hold.
 $BSparktouched Gorloc (30)

 Sparktouched Oracle
$B

 Sparktouched Warrior
desc_text: attle still going at Kartak hold... I think it time for you to learn big secret of Frenzyheart.$BWe have berries we keep from other lands we came from... they not so special on their own, but mix them with drunk drinks and they make Frenzyheart super strong. You a Frenzyheart now... it time you get to be strong too.$BI give some drink, then you be super strong and you go smash all the spark big-tongues.

title: Tools of War
obj_text:
Retrieve some of Zepik's traps from his stash in Kartak's Hold.  Using the traps, slaughter 50 of the nearby Sparktouched Gorlocs, and then return to Shaman Jakjek in Kartak's Hold.
 $BSparktouched Gorloc (50)

 Sparktouched Oracle
$B

 Sparktouched Warrior
desc_text: Zepik tell me that you maybe the best gorloc hunter he met... other than Zepik. Still big battle to southwest - you go help.$BZepik keeps some of biggest, baddest traps in his stash at Kartak's Hold... told Vekgar to use them for battle, so you use them too. Go pick out any traps you want and kill lots of big-tongues.$BLots and lots!

title: Know No Fear
obj_text:
Ricket at K3 wants you to kill 6 Garm Watchers and 8 Snowblind Devotees.
 $BGarm Watcher slain (6)

 Garm Watcher
$B

 Garm Watcher
$B
$B
 $BSnowblind Devotee slain (8)

 Snowblind Devotee
$B

 Snowblind Devotee
desc_text: Now that we have the teleporter open, my plan is quite complex... it has several facets and will take impeccable coordination. And there are supplies to be gathered! And troops to recruit! Likely, weeks of hard labor as well!$BHahah, I had you going there for a moment, didn't I? You've got this, kid. Hop through the teleporter and take the fight to them! Our sappers will back you up... they won't have anywhere to run.

title: Clean Up
obj_text: Jeer Sparksocket at K3 would like 10 pieces of Charred Wreckage.
desc_text: To the point... Ricket's asked me to put together some stronger land mines, but I'm running low on parts.$BJust west of town, you'll find the remains of our last rocket sled... Ricket got a little excited when she was fueling it, but I probably should have thought to not put the nozzle right over the exhaust.
