Live and learn, eh?$BThere should be a good stock of spare parts scattered around the destroyed sled... why don't you go ahead and chase off those scavengers and nab me some of that wreckage?

title: Force of Nature
obj_text: Travel to the Blight Line, between Rainspeaker Rapids and the Lost Lands in Sholazar Basin and seek the Avatar of Freya.
desc_text: I'm not sure about what I saw while flying to the northeast, but to me it looked like a gigantic woman kicking some Scourge butt.$BI'd heard the professor talk about a certain "lifewarden"  appointed by the titans to look over Sholazar.  I might not be a titan historian, but it sounds like she fits the bill.$BI also know that if the Scourge cross the border between the Lost Lands and the rest of Sholazar, our expedition's as good as dead.  What do you say you go look for her and lend a hand?

title: Back Through the Waygate
obj_text: ring the Omega Rune to the Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids in Sholazar Basin.
desc_text: You speak the truth, <race>.  I can sense the very essence of Sholazar Basin begin to fray by the blight of undeath even as we speak.$BI've bound my being into the rune, <race>.  Deliver it to she who sent you here -- for only her power can grant me passage to her lands.

title: Expressions of Gratitude
obj_text: [PLACEHOLDER] Use mini-plane to kamakazi on the gnoll leader.

title: Demolitionist Extraordinaire
obj_text: Return to Ricket at K3.
desc_text: You've got some swift feet on you sonny! Thanks for lending a hand with those explosives... I've been waiting to give that invention a good test run for a while!$BGo ahead and tell Ricket we should be covered on the magnataur front now... my sappers will clean up any of the remaining baddies.$BThanks again!

title: Opening the Backdoor
obj_text:
Ricket at K3 would like you to locate the Transporter Power Cell and use it to activate the Transportation Pad at Garm's Rise.
 $BGarm Teleporter Activated
desc_text: The sapper squad is ready. That means it's fun time, my dear!$BThere's only one thing holding us up from our full-scale assault on Garm! I sent a runner to set a teleporter up behind Garm--successfully I might add--and he returned to get the power cell it needs to function. It isn't working yet... which means the power cell didn't get there.$BI need you to look just on the other side of Garm's Bane for the power cell. When you find it, bring it farther east to Garm's Rise and activate the teleporter.

title: A Flawless Plan
obj_text:
Gino at Garm's Rise wants you to plant the Hardpacked Explosive Bundle near Frostgut's Altar, kill Tormar Frostgut, and then escape the cave before it collapses on you.
 Place Explosive Bundle
 Tormar Frostgut slain
desc_text: Hey there! Joining us for the assault I assume?$BI've got a special task for you... we're going to bring the whole cave down on their heads! Towards the back of their cave, you should find Frostgut's Altar.  Sneak up and plant this hardpacked explosive bundle somewhere close to it.$BOnce the charge is placed, stick around just long enough to make sure Frostgut bites it, then get out quickly! There's no knowing how long the cave will last once that thing goes off!

title: Moving In
obj_text:
Tore Rumblewrench outside of Crystalweb Cavern wants you to kill 12 Crystalweb Spiders.
 $BCrystalweb Spiders slain (12)

 Crystalweb Weaver
 Icetip Crawler
$B

 Crystalweb Spitter
desc_text: Hiya! The name's Tore. I  head up the mining operation here at K3... or I will shortly anyway!$BThis here cave is full of creepy-crawlies. I think we could do with a few less spiders before we move in - what'd you think?

title: Slightly Unstable
obj_text: Deliver Jeer's Improved Land Mines to Ricket in K3.
desc_text: Looking good!$BNo, not you - my new mines. You're just a little full of yourself, aren't you? I, on the other hand, am absolutely brilliant! My intellect cannot be matched.$BWhat were we talking about? Oh yes, my new mines! New and improved... ready for whatever devious use Ricket has concocted.$BBe a <good lad/doll> and go hand them off to Ricket, will you? She's right over there... it should be quite the epic journey, I'm sure. Be careful though, she's a little loopy.

title: Just Around the Corner
obj_text: Jeer Sparksocket at K3 would like Sparksocket's Tools retrieved from his minefield.
desc_text: last it! Where are my tools? I had them here just a moment ago.$BOh! I probably forgot them when I was setting up that minefield in the west. That's mildly inconvenient. I'd be quite appreciative if you could go get them for me. You'll need to watch your step though... you should be able to use the same path that I did to get out.$BOh, and don't try to fly in... I had the presence of mind to set up turrets to shoot down anything that might fly, and they aren't very discerning in who they target.

title: Reclaimed Rations
obj_text: Ricket at K3 wants you to repossess 16 Dried Gnoll Rations from the nearby Savage Hill Gnolls.
desc_text: Hey hey! You're a new face! Care to lend Ricket a hand?$BWe have a somewhat unexpected problem - food shortage. I know, I know... we should have seen that coming, but you don't get it. We tend to have somewhat of a quick turn-around here with our sapper squad and all, so usually we don't have to worry about long term eats. Good old K3's gotten popular though.$BConvenient solution? There are gnoll camps to the west and some gnolls scattered, scavenging as gnolls do. Care to go nab some of their rations?

title: Ample Inspiration
obj_text: Ricket at K3 wants you to retrieve a U.D.E.D, use it to blow up a mammoth, and retrieve 8 Hearty Mammoth Meat.
desc_text: Wow! That stuff is nasty. Not to account for gnoll taste or anything, but I figured whatever they had would at least be... edible?$BLet's get more creative.$BTore's got an explosive dispenser north of town... not far from the big cavern entrance, can't miss it. I'm sure she intends them for mining purposes of some sort, but I've got a better idea.$BGrab one of those things and rush it to one of the nearby mammoths... most of them are to the west. Collect the meat, bring it back.

title: Not Rain, Nor Snow, Nor Exploding Plane
obj_text: [PLACEHOLDER] Test cold-weather bomber on giant.

title: Bitter Departure
obj_text:
Escort the Injured Goblin Miner out of Crystalweb Cavern and then speak to Ricket at K3.
 $BEscort the Injured Goblin Miner to K3.
desc_text: Oi - thank you! I thought for sure I'd just be a spider snack. Perhaps I'm speaking a bit soon though - let's get the heck out of here!$BLet me know as soon as you're ready to go... make it quick.

title: Leave No Goblin Behind
obj_text: Find the entrance to the Forlorn Mine in northern Sifreldar Village and look for clues for Zeev Fizzlespark's whereabouts.
desc_text: All of our boys are back... thanks to you, <name>!  Well... all but one.$BMy brother Zeev is still up there according to the others.  Apparently they have some sort of mine where they make their prisoners work.  Go in there and see if you can find out anything.

title: Overstock
obj_text:
Ricket at K3 wants you to use Improved Land Mines at Garm's Bane to fend off the attackers from Garm. Both Garm Invaders and Snowblind Followers will count towards this goal.
 $BGarm Invader slain (12)

 Garm Invader
$B

 Snowblind Follower
desc_text: Hey there again! You didn't run off like all the other adventurers did? Well, you're just a peach, aren't ya? I was beginning to think I smelled funny or something!$BWe could still use a bit of a hand around here, and you have just the right experience.  Remember those magnataur? Well apparently the cave didn't completely collapse... there are still quite a few left. So much for Gino taking care of them, eh?$BFortunately, Jeer made way more than enough mines. You've got this!

title: Power of the Great Ones
obj_text:
Charge the Dormant Polished Crystal at the exposed Lifeblood Pillar. Travel to Sparktouched Haven and use the power the crystal bestows to slaughter 30 of the nearby Frenzyheart wolvar, and then speak to Lightningcaller Soo-met in Sparktouched Haven.
 $BFrenzyheart Attacker (30)

 Frenzyheart Hunter
$B

 Frenzyheart Ravager
desc_text: We need to do something to stop puppy-men attacking Sparktouched Haven. Jaloot brought me very special crystal that he found in River's Heart... we seen only one like it before.$BThe crystal not have power now, but the opened up lifeblood pillar should have energy to recharge it if you just bring it close. Once the crystal is charged, go to Sparktouched Haven in far southwest and let the crystal's energy make you big and strong.$BThen it time to kick some puppy-men butt.

title: Only Partly Forgotten
obj_text: An Injured Goblin Miner in Crystalweb Cavern wants you to bring back an Icetip Venom Sac from an Icetip Crawler.
desc_text: Oi... it's like there's a propeller in my stomach.$BI think I can walk, but I got something nasty in my system when I got bit by something in the back of the cave. It was bigger than the other spiders... and brightly colored.$BRicket can probably make me an antidote, but she'd need the venom sac from whatever bit me. Would you mind finding it for me? I don't think Tore's coming.$BI'll just pretend I'm dead here and hopefully they'll leave me alone.

title: Expression of Gratitude
obj_text:
Ricket at K3 wants you to kill Gnarlhide.
 Gnarlhide slain
desc_text: I know just the job for an eager newcomer! We've got a gnoll problem. You might even call it a gnoll infestation! Pesky things. They keep creeping up more and more, and now they're on our doorstep, stealing our parts! Inconceivable.$BIt all begins and ends with their uppity leader, Gnarlhide. I want you to see to that "ends" part. Go pay him a visit at his camp all the way to the west, in Snowblind Hills.$BAnd when I say "pay him a visit," that's a euphemism for "kill him painfully." Kay? Kay!

title: Tore's Got the Goods
obj_text: [PLACEHOLDER] Report to Tore

title: Luxurious Getaway!
obj_text: Speak to Jeer Sparksocket at K3 in the Storm Peaks.
desc_text: Hey there, pal!$BDo you like excitement and explosions?! Who doesn't? I know just the place for you. Down at luxurious K3, they're always making innovative inventions and finding all-new ways to make things blow up! Sounds thrilling, doesn't it? If you want to be part of the fun, head on down today and speak to Jeer Sparksocket!$BMandatory disclaimer: manual labor may be required to partake in previously indicated "excitement."

title: When All Else Fails
obj_text: Speak to Ricket to make use of Ricket's D16 Propelled Delivery Device to enter further into Storm Peaks.
desc_text: So...  so I don't think we're going to be getting a good foothold in those mountains.$BTrust me, I'm not one to give up easily... but between freezing engines, nasty vrykul women, territorial dragon want-to-bes and the half a dozen other nasties settled in the area, this just ain't happening.$BDon't let that dissuade you though! Just because we can't get a foothold doesn't mean we won't get you there... one-way trips are pretty simple when you get down to it.$B<Ricket nods at some nearby rockets.>

title: All Grown Up
obj_text:
[PLACEHOLDER] Test Grown Up Jormungar on Giant
 $BGarm Watcher slain (6)

 Garm Watcher
$B

 Garm Watcher
$B
$B
 $BSnowblind Devotee slain (8)

 Snowblind Devotee
$B

 Snowblind Devotee

title: Ore Repossession
obj_text: Tore Rumblewrench outside of Crystalweb Cavern would like you to retrieve 5 samples of Impure Saronite Ore.
desc_text: We're moving in!$BThere were some snobolds here when we arrived... their mining operation seems to have met some unfortunate happenings though. Doesn't much matter - we were taking over soon anyway.$BI sent some of our miners in there to get me some ore samples that I can use to calibrate our machines for processing, but they haven't come back.$BMind going in there and nabbing some samples for me in their stead? The snobolds probably have some on them, though I'd expect most of them are dead by now.

title: Missing Scouts
obj_text:
Glorthal in Frosthold has requested a search of the Bor's Breath valley and Bor's Fall for any sign of the missing Frostborn Scouts.
 $BLocate Missing Scout
desc_text: There is something that I could use a hand with now that I have you.$BWe have a few scouts that are extremely late in returning. The peaks are harsh... but these boys know what they're doing.$BHead to the east... along the Bor's Breath valley and near Bor's Fall... they should be out that direction. If you find any sign of one of them, bring me back news immediately. We have a few enemies in the area - if any of them are getting a bit uppity, the more warning the better.

title: Offering Thanks
obj_text: ring the crate of medical supplies to Glorthal Stiffbeard in Frosthold.
desc_text: Ah! Thanks for coming up here, <lad/lass>.$BJudging by your wide eyes and shivering hands, I'd venture a guess that you're somewhat new. Sounds like it would be good for you to meet our gracious hosts then!$BWe've got some extra medical supplies... to be honest, we weren't expecting to have such a comfortable setup. Go ahead and give this crate to Glorthal over there, and lend them a hand if you would too. We don't want them to think we're ungrateful for how welcoming they've been.

title: Stemming the Aggressors
obj_text:
Glorthal Stiffbeard at Frosthold wants you to kill 8 Frostfeather Screechers and 8 Frostfeather Witches.
 Frostfeather Screecher slain (8)
 Frostfeather Witch slain (8)
desc_text: Damn harpies. We've beat that bunch into submission more times than I can remember... and they stay quiet for a time after each bout. This time, I'd thought that maybe it sunk in.$BApparently not.$BTheir memory may be a bit short, but if their numbers are thinned enough, they'll keep to themselves. Head into the valleys in the north and east and clear out a fair chunk of them for me, will ya?

title: Loyal Companions
obj_text:
Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold wants you to obtain 8 slabs of Fresh Ice Rhino Meat and use them to feed the Stormcrest Eagles above town.
 Stormcrest Eagles fed (8)
desc_text: Fresh blood! Good to meet ya! I've got some work if you've got some time.$BOff to the east are the Foot Steppes... pretty hard land, but there's quite a group of rhino that graze there. Our birds have a taste for that rhino meat, but it's always a bit dangerous for them to go hunting with all of the proto-drakes that nest around there.$BIf you're keen, head over that way and get some rhino meat, bring it back to the peaks above here, and then use it to feed some of the eagles that nest there.

title: Sirana Iceshriek
obj_text:
Glorthal Stiffbeard at Frosthold wants you to kill Sirana Iceshriek.
 Sirana Iceshriek slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: This Sirana Iceshriek sounds like the one that's spurring the harpies to be more aggressive. If we kill her, I suspect their attacks won't last long afterwards.$BOne of our stormriders claims to have spotted her circling the peak directly northwest of here.  Go find the wench and put her down. Let's see this done.

title: The Champion of Anguish
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Vladof the Butcher! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BVladof the Butcher Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: This is the end, my friend! Your last opponent is going to be your greatest challenge. He's a vrykul champion from the steppes of Icecrown and he's out for blood! Defeat him and you'll be crowned the champion of the Amphitheater of Anguish! This fight is going to make us both rich!$BLet me know when you're ready and we'll start.

title: Pushed Too Far
obj_text:
Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold wants you to ride with a Stormcrest Eagle and kill 16 Stormpeak Wyrms in the Foot Steppes.
 Stormpeak Wyrm slain (16)
desc_text: You were there with Loken, weren't you? The iron dwarves captured Veranus, the brood mother of the proto-drakes. The drakes don't seem even a little bit happy about the situation... they've gotten very aggressive.$BThey've pushed into stormcrest territory and the eagles have taken to an all out fight with them. It's time to return the favor. We're riding to the Foot Steppes and slaughtering them there.$BKing Stormheart left this hammer to me - make good use and see to it that I get it back.

title: Baby Stealers
obj_text: Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold would like you to bring back 15 Stormcrest Eagle Eggs.
desc_text: A few weeks ago, if you looked up, you'd see dozens of those beautiful eagles soaring the skies. Now, only a few if any. They've taken to staying with their nests nearly all the time now because the harpies have been stealing their eggs.$BThe harpies have grown a taste for eagle flesh, it seems... the sick wretches are caring for the eggs long enough to feast on the hatchlings. Go into the valleys to the north or the east and find the eggs... bring them back here, and I'll take them back to the nests.

title: Scourge Tactics
obj_text:
Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you free 8 Webbed Crusaders.
 Webbed Crusader Freed (8)
desc_text: We had the element of surprise on our side! We blew a hole in the side of the mountain and charged into Scourgeholme. Scourge opposition was fierce and it wasn't long until we were overwhelmed. We fell back to the valley and began raining artillery down on the Scourge that followed. This held them back for awhile until... Those monsters began using crusaders as living shields. We had to stop shelling for fear of killing our own soldiers.$BFree our crusaders trapped on the field outside the base, <class>!

title: Defending The Vanguard
obj_text:
Crusader Lord Dalfors at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you kill 15 Forgotten Depths Nerubians.
 $BForgotten Depths Nerubians slain (15)

 Forgotten Depths Ambusher
 Forgotten Depths Acolyte
 Carrion Fleshstripper
$B

 Forgotten Depths Slayer
 Forgotten Depths Proxy
desc_text: We can't keep this pace up, <lad/lass>. Once the breach was blown, the floodgates opened up. The Scourge have been pourin' through ever since with no end in sight!$BWe need every able bodied man and woman to help keep the tide of evil at bay. Get out there and do yer share, friend. Kill as many of those monsters as ye can!

title: Honor Above All Else
obj_text: Report to Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
desc_text: Long has been the path to our salvation, young <class>. We have fought across continents, worlds even, to reach this point. Now we face our greatest challenge: the destruction of the Lich King and his Scourge.$BAlas, we fight this battle divided. The Horde and Alliance are in the throes of war and will lend us no support. We must remain unyielding in our cause! For what choice have we to do otherwise?$BDo you join the cause? Lend us your strength, <class>! My commander, Entari, awaits you at his post.

title: Ancient Relics
obj_text: Return 10 Relics of Ulduar to Olut Alegut at the Grom'arsh Crash-site.
desc_text: Welcome to the peaks.$BI have a simple request before you head off on whatever grand jaunt you have planned. There are relics and treasures of ancient Ulduar scattered through these mountains. Most are likely in possession of the various sentient races.$BReturn any that you find to me, and I will reward you in kind. Perhaps I'll even let you partake on my many potent ales.

title: Ancient Relics
obj_text: Return 10 Relics of Ulduar to Rork Sharpchin in Frosthold.
desc_text: Why hello thar!$BBefore you be headin' off to do your grand questin' and adventure, might I beg a wee favor of ya, <lad/lass>?$BThese mountains be packed full'a precious relics and baubles... this place be a dream come true for tha league. I'd be much obliged if ya could bring any such treasures you stumble upon back ta me. You can even share in me ale for tha trouble! Trust me <lad/lass>, that's a rich deal!

title: Into The Wild Green Yonder
obj_text:
Rescue 3 Captured Argent Crusaders from Scourgeholme and drop them off at the Vanguard Infirmary at the center of the Argent Vanguard. Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring should you succeed.
 Captured Crusader Rescued (3)
desc_text: We will do all that we can to assist you, <name>. The proto-brood have volunteered to fly you across the Breach and into Scourgeholme. Rescue any captured Argent Crusaders that you find. Return them immediately to the Vanguard Infirmary, located at the center of this base.$BChoose one of the Argent Skytalons in the pen behind me and go!$BScourgeholme is located northwest, across the Valley of Echoes, through the great Breach.

title: If There Are Survivors...
obj_text: Speak with Penumbrius at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
desc_text: Across the Valley of Echoes, west of here, and through the Breach, is the first Scourge encampment in Icecrown known as Scourgeholme. We fought a good fight at Scourgeholme and killed many Scourge, but in the end we were forced to retreat. Many soldiers were left behind - their fate unknown.$BIf there are survivors, we must attempt a rescue. Directly down this southeastern path is Penumbrius, ally of the bronze dragonflight and caretaker of the proto-brood. Seek him out and ask for his assistance.

title: The Last Line Of Defense
obj_text:
Use an Argent Cannon to destroy 100 Scourge attackers. You must also kill 3 Frostbrood Destroyers.$BReturn to Siegemaster Fezzik should you succeed.
 $BScourge Attackers slain (100)

 Frostbrood Destroyer
 Forgotten Depths Slayer
$B

 Scourge Proxy Chapter II
$B
$B
 Frostbrood Destroyer slain (3)
desc_text: I've triggered the base's defenses, <class>! Atop each of the Vanguard's four towers is a retractable Argent Crusade cannon, blessed by Father Gustav himself. You'll need to fly up to one of those towers and man a cannon. Use it to destroy the Scourge onslaught that the Lich King has deployed.$BJust one warning, the Scourge will undoubtedly send their frost wyrms to lay siege to the towers. Shoot them out of the sky! If they destroy the walls and towers of this base, we're done for!

title: Curing The Incurable
obj_text: Father Gustav at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you bring him 10 Forgotten Depths Venom Sacs.
desc_text: The number of injured soldiers rises with each passing day. They are being stricken by some type of toxin that we have never before seen. Whatever it is that these Nerubians hold within their venom glands is lethal and incurable! So far we've only been able to slow down the poison flowing through the victim's bodies. We must devise a cure!$BVenture northwest to the valley outside of the Vanguard and slay the Forgotten Depths Nerubians. Recover their venom glands and bring them to me.

title: A Cold Front Approaches
obj_text: Report to Siegemaster Fezzik at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
desc_text: The chill of death stirs in the west, threatening to freeze our hearts and souls to this wasteland and bind us to its dark master. We will stand and we will fight!$BThe preparations have begun. Report to Siegemaster Fezzik at the front gate for your assignment.

title: When All Else Fails
obj_text: Speak to Ricket to make use of Ricket's D16 Propelled Delivery Device to enter further into Storm Peaks.
desc_text: So...  so I don't think we're going to be getting a good foothold in those mountains.$BTrust me, I'm not one to give up easily... but between freezing engines, nasty vrykul women, territorial dragon want-to-bes and the half a dozen other nasties settled in the area, this just ain't happening.$BDon't let that dissuade you though! Just because we can't get a foothold doesn't mean we won't get you there... one-way trips are pretty simple when you get down to it.$B<Ricket nods at some nearby rockets.>

title: Unfinished Business
obj_text: Har'koa wants you to speak with Tol'mar at Dubra'jin.
desc_text: While it is true that the Prophet of Akali will trouble this world no more, there yet remains work to be done.$BThe greater part of Akali's blood has empowered another, and it is in him that the true danger lies.$BQuickly, <name>, make your way north of Gundrak to Dubra'Jin and speak with Tol'mar. He will be able to direct you further in this cause.

title: Just Checkin'
obj_text: To'kini wants you to speak to Bah'kini at Dubra'Jin.
desc_text: There have been fearsome sounds echoing from Gundrak. They have been increasing in volume and frequency of late.$BMy long-time student is currently recording events from her post just west of Gundrak. Perhaps you could find the time to check in on her for me?

title: Once More Unto The Breach, Hero
obj_text: Report to the Ebon Watcher in the Valley of Echoes just outside the Breach.
desc_text: The Vanguard is secure, ally. We have reclaimed the Valley of Echoes and taken down the web walls blocking entry to the Breach. Now is the time to strike at Scourgeholme and establish our presence inside Icecrown. The battlefront moves on!$BI have asked the Ebon Watcher for his assistance with our assault upon Scourgeholme. His intimate knowledge of the Scourge will be invaluable in our effort.$BGo now and report to him at the tent outside of the Breach, northwest of here.

title: Once More Unto The Breach, Hero
obj_text: Report to the Ebon Watcher in the Valley of Echoes just outside the Breach.
desc_text: The Vanguard is secure, ally. We have reclaimed the Valley of Echoes and taken down the web walls blocking entry to the Breach. Now is the time to strike at Scourgeholme and establish our presence inside Icecrown. The battlefront moves on!$BI have asked the Ebon Watcher for his assistance with our assault upon Scourgeholme. His intimate knowledge of the Scourge will be invaluable in our effort.$BGo now and report to him at the tent outside of the Breach, northwest of here.

title: The Restless Dead
obj_text: Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to use Holy Water on the corpses of Reanimated Crusaders to free 10 restless souls.
desc_text: Not all of our soldiers made it out of Scourgeholme. Many were slain and turned into twisted reflections of their former selves. Such is the way of the Scourge. For those damned souls, there is no eternal peace. We must provide their souls rest.$BTravel through the Breach into Scourgeholme and slay the skeletal reanimated crusaders. Sprinkle this holy water on their bones so that their spirits may be freed.

title: Halls of Stone
obj_text:
rann Bronzebeard wants you to accompany him as he uncovers the secrets that lie in the Halls of Stone.
 $BBrann's Exploration complete

 Sjonnir The Ironshaper
 Sjonnir The Ironshaper - Heroic
$B

 Sjonnir The Ironshaper - Mythic
 Sjonnir The Ironshaper - Ascended
desc_text: Well now, I'm surprised to see other adventurers in a place such as this! It so happens that I could use a bit o' company for what lies ahead.$BIf my research on these halls is accurate, there be monumental discoveries to be made here!$BAssumin' I can count on ya to watch my back, you're welcome to tag along. So, what'dya say, <class>? Care ta join me?

title: For Posterity
obj_text: Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin wants you to enter Gundrak and collect 6 Drakkari History Tablets.
desc_text: Gundrak be doomed, mon.$BHistory be repeatin' itself before our eyes. When trolls be turnin' on their own gods, the end be certain. It just be a matter of time.$BPerhaps if we can record the events clearly, we might prevent future generations from traveling down da same path.$BIf you be havin' the courage, enter Gundrak and search for clues to what brought the Drakkari Empire to such an end as dis.

title: The Purging Of Scourgeholme
obj_text:
The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to kill 3 Forgotten Depths High Priests, 3 Forgotten Depths Underkings, and 8 Reanimated Crusaders.
 Forgotten Depths High Priest slain (3)
 Forgotten Depths Underking slain (3)
 Reanimated Crusader slain (8)
desc_text: The Scourge have sent their armies at the Argent Crusade and have been repelled. What they do now is called a 'slash and burn.' All prisoners that they hold at Scourgeholme will be executed and raised as servants of the Lich King.$BUndoubtedly the Argent Crusade will request that you give their soldiers a proper farewell. I'll ask no such thing of you. To succeed we must kill Scourge indiscriminately.$BVenture to Scourgeholme, northwest through the Breach, and lay waste to all that stand in your way.

title: One of a Kind
obj_text: Chronicler Bah'Kini at Dubra'Jin wants you to enter Gundrak and recover a piece of the Drakkari Colossus.
desc_text: Lissen, mon.$BAt first glance, it be lookin' like da same old story here - trolls tappin' into forbidden powah by destroyin' da very beings dey should be worshippin'.$BWhile dis be true, dere be somethin' special about dese Drakkari. If what I learned be true, den inside Gundrak dere be a special golem - one like nuthin' created before!$BYa want adventure, mon? Go inside Gundrak and bring me back a piece from dat golem ta study.

title: Make Their Ears Bleed
obj_text: Eliminate 9 renegade spies of The Horde.
desc_text: The Horde has ears in this city. Ears that hear the same outrage you feel.$BThey know the lion of the Alliance is waking from its long slumber.$BThey may not have learned anything they didn’t suspect, but they’ve overstayed their welcome all the same.$BCare for a little action?$BCut down that meddling filth. You’ll see how easy it is to raise your weapon against monsters who long ago cast off their humanity.

title: Reaction to History
obj_text: Listen to those witnessing the disaster at the Stormwind docks.
desc_text: Pardon my manners—my name is Valdior.$BI assume you've already seen the burned ship. It was returning from the Azzar Archipelago when the Horde struck;$Banother insult in a long list of provocations.$BThese are the first tremors of the war to come. A war the Alliance cannot afford to fight without soldiers like you.$BWe do have a plan, of course… but before I share any details, I’d like you to take a moment: walk the docks, talk to the people. You’ll see that the mood in the streets matches the urgency that brought you here.

title: Judgment Day Comes!
obj_text: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
desc_text: We cannot defeat the Lich King on our own. Divided we shall all fall!$BI implore you to answer the call, <brother/sister>. The Argent Crusade accepts all who would volunteer to aid in the war effort. Highlord Tirion Fordring himself awaits you at the Argent Vanguard! Get upon your mount and fly to the southeastern reaches of Icecrown. It is there that you will find Lord Fordring and the soldiers of the Argent Crusade.$BGo now, <class>, for judgment day comes!

title: Judgment Day Comes!
obj_text: Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
desc_text: We cannot defeat the Lich King on our own. Divided we shall all fall!$BI implore you answer the call, <brother/sister>. The Argent Crusade accepts all that would volunteer to aid in the war effort. Highlord Tirion Fordring himself awaits you at the Argent Vanguard! Get upon your mount and fly to the southeastern reaches of Icecrown. It is there that you will find Lord Fordring and the soldiers of the Argent Crusade.$BGo now, <class>, for judgment day comes!

title: Zalazane's Fall
obj_text:
Help Vol'jin take back the Echo Isles and kill Zalazane.
 Zalazane Killed
desc_text: De time for battle is now!  We'd be headin' ova to da islands soon,so you'd betta be ready.$BZalazane doesn't have much time left.

title: A letter in your pocket
obj_text: Find the sender at the Stormwind Docks.
desc_text: <You feel a tug at your pocket. Someone has slipped in a folded, unsigned handwritten letter.>$BBe discreet.$BYour service in the war against the Lich King has not been forgotten. For that, and for countless other merits, you’ve been chosen for a mission of the highest secrecy.$BThe ten years of peace since Arthas fell are coming to an end. War with the Horde is inevitable, but that doesn’t mean we need to fight it in plain sight.$BMake your way to the Stormwind Docks and speak with Valdior. He’ll bring you up to speed on the operation.$BFor the safety of the realm.

title: Spreading Happiness
obj_text: Get a empty crate and gather 6 bottles of Azzar alcohol. Then, deliver bottles to the guards in the Stormwind Sewers. Deliver bottles of Azzar's Alcohol to the Stormwind Sewers guards.
desc_text: <John Gunwhiz grabs a bottle and squints at the label, reading aloud:>$B"Wiltedsong Ambrosia. Pure Azzar Elixir." Aha. "Happiness, one sip away." Perfect.$B<His eyelids lift as he spots the image of a scantily clad elf on the worn label.>$BAldara sure knows how to sell a drink.$B<With a fierce twist he opens a bottle. The sharp aroma of the liquor hits your nose before he corks it shut again.>$BThat’s strong enough to keep the guards happy. Here, take the bottles. Valdior will be waiting for you inside, down in the sewers.

title: Unraveling the Embroidery
obj_text: Contact Mara in the Sewers.
desc_text: Welcome to the sewers, <name>. Looking for answers? A promise is a promise:$BI’ve been tasked with putting together the crew of a small corsair fleet. Our destination is the same cursed archipelago the ship you looted came from:$BAzzar.$BThat’s as much as I can tell you—unless I want to lose my tongue. If you want the details of the operation, you’ll need to impress Mara Crimson-Edged.$BLet’s just say she likes to judge new recruits personally. And fair warning—she’s a harsh judge.

title: Rather Meager Information
obj_text: Obtain the necessary information from the sewer vagabonds.
desc_text: So... Feeling useful?$BYeah, I’ve got something you can handle.$BAs you’ve probably guessed, it’s no coincidence the docks are crawling with spies. Someone tipped them off. And we know that someone is down here.$BOne way or another, the sewer-rats always know what’s happening in this reeking maze.$BLean on them.$BIntimidate as many as it takes until one cracks and gives us what we need. You’re not too delicate for that kind of work, are you?

title: Keep It Quiet
obj_text: Eliminate 7 Stockade Fugitives in the Sewers.
desc_text: A few years ago, a group of prisoners from the Stormwind dungeons managed to dig a tunnel out, only to find themselves in a place even more miserable than their cells.$BThe makeshift shelter they built down there still houses a fair number of fugitives. Friends of Jaszir, some of them.$BI suspect he may have shared sensitive intel with them... just in case we caught on.$BYou can guess what comes next, right?$BWe need to send a message. Loud and clear.$BThe world won’t bat an eye if you kill a few sewer rats, <name>.

title: Drink Opens Doors
obj_text: Sneak into the ship's hold.
desc_text: <name>, have you ever had the pleasure of visiting Stormwind's sewers? I doubt it; you smell far too clean.$BI'll fill you in on the details once we're inside.$BOf course, ever since the last... incident, the harbor and sewer guards have been unusually watchful. But there's always ways to earn their... cooperation, let's say.$BWant a hint? The ship that docked yesterday brought in a fine shipment of the best liquor from the Azzar Archipelago. Find John Gunwhiz, he'll know how to slip into the hold without drawing attention. Get your hands on a crate of bottles, enough to soften up the guards' resolve.

title: The Scourgestone
obj_text: The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to bring him 15 Scourgestones.
desc_text: A Scourgestone is an item given to all Scourge upon birth or creation. It provides certain benefits to the holder, but more importantly it allows Scourge leaders visibility into the location and movement of all of their units.$BWith enough Scourgestones, I might be able to track the movement of other Scourge units across Icecrown.$BAs you slaughter Scourge in Scourgeholme, gather all of the Scourgestones that you find. Return to me when your bags are full.

title: Against What We Fight
obj_text: Listen to the reasons behind the operation.
desc_text: We are The Shade, an elite arm of the SI:7. We handle the Alliance’s most delicate—and dirtiest—work. The things that can’t be done in the light.$BWhat’s happening now—the offshore strike mission, led by Valdior—follows that exact philosophy. A sudden, decisive blow against the Horde.$BBut before you step into the storm, you need to understand why we’re doing this… and what it’ll cost.$BListen closely.

title: May the Shadow Embrace You
obj_text: Present yourself to Valdior.
desc_text: Looks like the higher-ups were right about you. You did well.$BYou’ve earned the right to meet the rest of my division. They’ll give you the full breakdown of the operation.$BFind Valdior at the tavern. Tell him Crimson-Edged has given her blessing.

title: The Talking Head
obj_text: Kill the former member Jaszir and bring his head to Mara.
desc_text: Jaszir’s not the first double agent the SI:7 has worked with, and not the first who thought he could play us without paying the price.$BWhatever the Horde gave him—gold, promises, favors—it won’t mean a thing once you’ve delivered our justice.$BYou’ll find him at the Fugitive’s Stockade.$BBring me his head.

title: In Search of the Mage
obj_text: Search for Alaric in the Stormwind Sewers.
desc_text: Congratulations, it’s official: you’ve just filled the last open spot on the Defiance’s crew bound for Azzar.$BHowever... before we set sail, there are a few loose ends to tie up.$BMy loyal associate Alaric—a high elf of considerable magical repute—was supposed to take care of a certain... financial matter down in the sewers. You understand, of course, this operation doesn’t fund itself, and some debts need collecting.$BUnfortunately, I haven’t heard from him. Would you be so kind as to make sure everything’s in order?

title: Study the Noble's Death
obj_text: Eradicate the threat in the Sewers' Crypts and uncover its origin.
desc_text: <Alaric’s arcane projection flickers briefly, as if stunned by disbelief.>$BSilverbrook? No... no, this can’t be. How can I be so unlucky?$B<The image dims slightly.>$BFocus, Alaric.$BWhoever did this could jeopardize the entire operation. Yes. We need to investigate the crypts. Find out what happened. Deal with the threat.$BWell... “we” might be a stretch. You should do it. You’re already down there—at least, in the flesh. Once you find anything, come straight back to me.

title: Reading Someone Else’s Diary
obj_text: Search for and collect documents that may affect the plan.
desc_text: Maybe Jaszir was bolder than I gave him credit for, but smarter? Not a chance. He must’ve left some kind of trail pointing to his contact in the Horde.$BSearch for any documents that might shed light on what he knew. I need to know how deep his knowledge went… and how much he gave away.$BFind his journal, or anything tied to him, and bring it to me.

title: My Right Hand
obj_text: Look for Lahud in the Sewers of Stormwind.
desc_text: My right-hand man is a gnome named Lahud. And while I’d trust him with my life...$BWell, let’s keep this between us—he has the occasional... radioactive episode. Leaves him a little dazed.$BFor this mission, I put him in charge of gathering, managing, and transporting our weapons stockpile. You can imagine—we’re not storming the Horde empty-handed.$BWould you mind checking in on Lahud? Make sure everything’s still on track?

title: Report to Cereza
obj_text: Report Eldryn's findings to Cereza.
desc_text: Cereza’s sharp instincts—and your swift action—have spared the sewers from the blight. But as I said, when I communed with the tree’s essence... I sensed something troubling.$BThis isn’t the only tree that’s tasted the Forsaken’s poison.$BIf there’s another infection spreading through the city, I must track its source before it blooms.$BShare these findings with Cereza. She’ll be eager to hear what we’ve learned.

title: Analyze the Sample
obj_text: Apply the water sample to the roots of the Arcane tree.
desc_text: <Eldryn studies the vial carefully. With a slight nod, he gestures for you to follow.>$BThe roots breaching these walls belong to a tree infused with Arcane essence. All trees house a spirit, a mind of sorts—but this one… this one listens more sharply than most.$BWhile I commune with its roots, I want you to apply small drops of the contaminated water to them.$BThe spirit will sense the corruption—and weigh the cost of the blight.

title: A Duty Fulfilled
obj_text: Talk to Cereza.
desc_text: The Defiance’s weapons are in transit, Cereza’s order is in motion... <Lahud scratches his large green head.> I think that wraps up my to-do list!$BI owe you a thanks, so... yeah. Thanks!$BI’ll meet up with the others at the docks and give them the update. Would you mind letting Cereza know her favor’s in Durgan Bulletsmith’s hands now?

title: To the Docks!
obj_text: Exit the sewers through the lower pipe and contact John 'Gunwhiz' at the Stormwind docks.
desc_text: I... didn’t see an attack of this scale coming.$BYou’ve done us a great service down here, <name>. But we can’t set sail just yet—not until we tie up a few loose ends.$BAnd by “tie” I mean find a rope and hang what’s left of our enemies.$BI’ll make sure no Forsaken are left lurking in the sewers. You, head to the docks through the lower pipe and speak to John ‘Gunwhiz’, the Gilnean mercenary leading our strike force within the Defiance crew.$BYou’ll find he and his men are more than eager to act.

title: Natural Revenge
obj_text: Eradicate the toxicity of the blight reservoirs and slay the Necromancer Venthral.
desc_text: My people remember the worgen curse with bitterness. In Gilneas, we did everything we could to contain it, to calm the fury, but...$B<A flicker of fear darkens the druid’s gaze. He dreads the worgen nearly as much as the Forsaken.>$BYou’re heading for the Horde’s camp, aren’t you? <A sudden spark of resolve ignites in his eyes>. Then I’m coming with you. My magic can counteract the blight’s toxicity.$BBesides...$BNature has its own score to settle with the necromancer.

title: Smuggle the Cargo
obj_text: Place the armament in the sealed crates in the dock room in the sewers and throw them into the canal.
desc_text: Hauling weapons across the docks in broad daylight would be pushing our luck. We want this quiet.$BHere’s the plan: stash the Bulletsmith armament in the sealed crates stored in the dock chamber down here in the sewers, and toss them into the canal. The current will carry them out through the drainage tunnel.$BThe Defiance’s dockhands are waiting on the other side to discreetly load them onto the ship.$BOnce it’s done, let the gnome know everything went smoothly.

title: The Cat Got His Tongue
obj_text: Get Cockroach Juice, Calcium-Rich Viscosity, and Infected Gnome Nail. Then, get Cereza’s potion.
desc_text: So... you’ve met this chatterbox of an elf? I see.$BPoor thing’s been hit with a silence spell. I might be able to reverse it and lift the curse, but I’ll need three semi-magical components to extract their essence and brew a proper antidote.$BFortunately for us, they can all be found right here in the sewers.$BBring me: Cockroach juice, Calcium-rich ooze and one infected gnome toenail.

title: Curiosity killed the cat
obj_text: Eliminate seven Alliance spies in the Fountain District, in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: A lot is at stake. Before I can give you any details on who wrote to you or where to find them, we need to make sure that no uninvited guests crash the party.$BI’ve already taken care of a few spies myself, but there are still Alliance agents lurking down here in the Spring District. Or at least, that’s what they confessed while I was pulling out their nails...$B<Caindres gives a sinister half-smile.>$BFind the spies and take care of them, will you?

title: Brewing War
obj_text: Notify Valdior at the Stormwind port when you are ready to depart.
desc_text: Everything’s ready.$BWe’ve cleansed the sewers of Forsaken rot, ruined the necromancer’s plot, and saved Stormwind from drowning in poison.$BBut that... That was just the prologue. The true challenge awaits us at sea.$BThe crew is assembled. The wind is with us. And The Liberty is eager to sail.$BLet me know when you’re ready, <name>...$BIt’s time to shift the course of Alliance history.

title: Debts and Duties
obj_text: Collect the rent payments from all the tenants and settle the debt with the noble.
desc_text: <Alaric writhes in his chair, clutching his stomach with a grimace of pain.>$BCereza’s potion has utterly wrecked my stomach...$BI’m not sure if Valdior mentioned what I was working on, but before the old crone snatched my voice, I was headed to collect back rent from the Dry Dwellings and repay a noble named Silverbrook, who’s waiting near the crypt entrance.$BIn my current state, I’m... less than reliable. Would you mind handling it for me?

title: The Request From the Sewers
obj_text: Wake up the workers by offering them whatever they ask for. Then, bring a coffee to Durgan.
desc_text: The old cat wants weapons. And the parts you brought? More than enough to cover the order.$BI’ll get started right away.$BThing is... the assembly line’s dragging its feet. Not sure what’s gotten into those layabouts down there, but if we want this shipment done on time, they’d better get their act together.$BHead down to the floor and get them moving. A snack, a pep talk... or a good kick in the pants—whatever works.$BOh, and when you’re done, grab me a coffee from the table, will you? I need a little boost too.

title: The Hunt on the Beach
obj_text: Eliminate the members of the Horde, burn the boats, and deal with the operations leader at the Horde camp on the beach.
desc_text: Turns out the druid’s instincts and my men’s noses make a good team. We’ve just found the Horde’s base.$BStill, you can be of use. The enemy’s camped out to the south—follow the shoreline along the base of the cliffs and you’ll find them soon enough.$BMy boys are already on the move, ready as ever. Just stay out of their way, and they’ll welcome your help.$BOrders are simple: Kill. Burn. Smash. Decapitate.

title: Valuable Junk
obj_text: Collect 15 Valuable Scraps from the tram graveyard and deliver them to Durgan Bulletsmith in the Stormwind Sewers.
desc_text: I was headed to the Bulletsmith Factory to pick up the crew’s weaponry when Cereza stopped me.$BAnd, well... Lahud never says no to Cereza. No, no. She’s done a lot for us.$BCould you help me gather some quality scrap from the tram graveyard? She asked me to bring it to Durgan along with this note.$BProblem is... the place is crawling with scavengers. And to top it off, I think the radiation’s cooking my brain like an egg...

title: Our glorious purpose
obj_text: Listen to the storyteller.
desc_text: My name is Kagtha.$B<The orc lifts her hand from her lap and places a pistol on the table. You realize she’s had it trained on you from the start.>$BI belong to the Shattered Hand—about as close as the Horde gets to having an intelligence service. Or just plain intelligence, for that matter.$BYou want to know why you’re here, don’t you? Good, sit down. We were just about to listen the storyteller’s tale.

title: Unorthodox summon
obj_text: Use the elevator in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar, and show the letter to the Forsaken named Caindres, stationed at the Spring in the Orgrimmar Depths.
desc_text: <You feel a tug in your pocket. Someone has slipped in a folded, unsigned handwritten letter.>$BThrom-Ka, comrade. You can call me ‘Dagger.’ It’s too early to reveal my real name. Over the past few months, the Alliance has deployed so many spies that one more and we’d have to swat them away like flies. No precaution is too much.$BI’ve got a man stationed at the Spring, below the Cleft of Shadow. You’ll spot him right away. He’s a Deathstalker. You know the type: serious, reliable. He’ll show you how to find me… if you’ve got the guts for it.$BHurry, and make sure you’re not being followed.

title: Grim allies
obj_text: Find Armhul in the Gorge district, next to the shack by the bridge.
desc_text: If there was any doubt left, you just put it to rest: you handle yourself well in a fight. More than well, actually.$BWhile I clean up this mess, I want you to meet one of the most committed warriors we have: Armhul of the Grimtotem. Take my seal. Show it to him when you approach.$BYou’ll find him in the Gorge, across the river, near the bridge outpost.

title: Discretion advised
obj_text: Speak with the mysterious contact at the Shaded Echo Tavern in the Spring District, in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: In my field, actions speak louder than words. What do you think your work says about you?$BCold efficiency: the virtue of an assassin.$BDispassionate obedience: the virtue of a soldier.$BAnd just enough curiosity to receive an anonymous letter and show up.$BDo you want to meet “Dagger”? Do you want to know why they summoned you and what they want from you? Go to the Shaded Echo Tavern. The table at the back, near the bar. They’ll ask you: "How many beers have I had?" The answer is: "None."$BLeave, and keep a low profile.

title: Sowing Doubts
obj_text: Deliver 5 fake orders in the Spring District, in the Depths of Orgrimmar, to confuse the Alliance spies.
desc_text: If killing them were enough, we’d have put an end to this problem long ago. But for every spy we get rid of, the Alliance sends two more.$BHere.$B<Caindres hands you a bundle of letters.>$BThey contain false orders, some contradictory, and if I recall correctly, even a cooking recipe or two. Our cause benefits more from spreading misinformation than from spilling blood. If Stormwind’s spies intercept any of these letters… they’ll be writing some delightfully confusing reports.

title: Enemy confessions
obj_text:
eat the Alliance spy until he confesses everything he knows.
 Confession extracted
desc_text: Have you ever heard of the goblin city of Azzar? In the last two years, it’s become the largest port in the Great Sea.$BWhoever takes control of the island will have the power to strike the first blow in the war that’s about to break out. My mission is to make sure the winds blow in our favor. That’s why the Alliance is trying to sabotage us.$BYou’re capable, but do you have the stomach for war?$BMy men just captured the leader of the Alliance spies. Show me you’re not too soft to torture a defenseless man. Get a confession out of him.

title: Discordant voices
obj_text: Ask locals in the Cauldron district, in the Depths of Orgrimmar, about the dark ranger Lenara.
desc_text: Thrall is naive. If he found out what we’re up to, our heads would roll. Luckily, we have powerful—and bold—patrons.$BAre you surprised that the Banshee Queen is the first to show interest in spilling blood? A'ke no wachi.$BThere’s one thing, however, that has me deeply concerned. I’ve been waiting all day to meet with one of her dark rangers, a woman named Lenara. She was supposed to arrive with a shipment of weapons and supplies for the cause. If they’ve caught her, if they’ve exposed her… Well, I’m next in line.$BI can’t leave my post here just yet. Could you go investigate what happened?

title: An abominable friend
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Patriarchs’ Enlightened and free 4 Forsaken Patients in the Patriarchs' Grotto.
 Forsaken Patients freed (4)
desc_text: Fools think can cure Forsaken friends, but there’s nothing to cure—Forsaken friends not sick!$BYou free friends! And if enemies want medicine… I have medicine for them!$B<Bruise rummages through his own guts and hands you something that looks like a greasy, pulsating liver.>$BBruise’s medicine! You use it to kill enemies!

title: Turn the other cheek
obj_text: Go to Vil the Squint’s Den, at the far end of the Cauldron district, in the Depths of Orgrimmar, and slip the sedative into the drinks of the Horde soldiers.
desc_text: This morning, a group of soldiers from Grommash Hold showed up at Vil the Squint’s Den—you know, the type who think fixing one problem equals fixing the whole world.$BI want you to take advantage of their drunken stupor and slip this sedative into their drinks. It should knock them out for the next twenty-four hours and prevent them from interfering with our plans.$BThe sorceress Selara Coldshadow is hiding out in the upper level of the Den. She’ll fill you in on all the details. When you’re done, look for a red-crested troll who goes by the name Chazili.

title: The pacified ones
obj_text: Speak with Lucranta at Lucranta's Den in the Depths of Orgrimmar, and secure the pacified ones.
desc_text: Dere be tings ‘bout dis mission I agree wit, and tings I don’t. Da pacified ones? Dey one o’ da tings I don’t like. Dey give me da creeps…$BYa know what I mean? Mind slaves. Dat Forsaken brainwashes ‘em and sells ‘em like puppets.$BArmhul told me ta take da Alliance spies we captured to her. Five poor fools. Dey should be ready by now, but me… I ain’t got da stomach ta go get ‘em. Can’t even look ‘em in da eyes.$BCan ya go talk ta da Forsaken an’ finish da job?

title: The missing shipment
obj_text: Use the central elevator in the Cauldron District, in the Depths of Orgrimmar.$BRetrieve the stolen supplies from the UnderMarket.
desc_text: My men and I came in through the docks gate with two carts packed to the brim with supplies. I suspect one of your own tipped off the syndicates—because they were waiting for us.$BWe salvaged what we could; the rest was taken by their thugs. The audacity! It didn’t take them five minutes to put it up for sale on the UnderMarket.$BSince Armhul sent you… think you could help us recover the stolen supplies? My green friend and I have a little conversation to finish here.

title: The Armed Defiance
obj_text: Pick up the armament, destroy the order forms, and when you're done, sign Durgan's document.
desc_text: The weaponry for The Defiance crew? Hot off the line—ready to go.$BPick up your shipment at the factory: shotguns, ammo, powder, explosives… You know the drill.$BThen burn the order slips on the accountants’ desks. Can’t have anyone finding out an Alliance op is using unclassified weaponry, right?$BJust scribble your name here when you’re done. <Durgan’s thick index finger jabs a document on the table.>$BAnd last thing—report straight to your mole. The girl running the smuggling route.

title: The Selection
obj_text: Administer the potions to five pacified ones in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: Very well, just give me a moment and…$B<The Forsaken steps away from the cauldron just as the ingredients erupt into a dazzling cloud of colors.>$BWhat… a marvel. The potion is ready. Once they drink it, the pacified will be yours—body and soul.$BI won’t lie to you; perfecting this recipe was a headache. Most of my regular clients are after… let’s say, a different kind of service—more “elven,” if you catch my drift.$BBut I did it! My potion alters brain chemistry beyond anything my so-called colleagues in Lordaeron ever thought possible. <She cackles, proud, before her expression twists into something more sinister.> They say the one who laughs last, laughs best.$BTake the potion from the table and administer it. Come on, I want to see how they react.

title: The Dark Lady's Arrangement
obj_text: Inform Kagtha of the forsaken allies' status.
desc_text: I believe your superiors will appreciate knowing that our agreement is still in place. We’ll deliver the remaining supplies and join the rest of the group when the ships set sail for Azzar.$BIf the Alliance takes control of that island… Lordaeron will be cut off not just by land, but by sea as well. With the Warchief’s indecision, they’ll hunt us down like rats.

title: The serpent of the Deep
obj_text: Speak with Duchess in the Timber Crown, in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: Da boss is waitin' for ya.$BLeft down the hall, up the stairs to the very top. Duchess at the peak.$BDon't waste any more of my time.

title: The last vacancy
obj_text: Return to Kagtha and report Ardayn’s availability.
desc_text: So, the Shattered Hand requires my services.$B<Ardayn raises a hand to his chin in what is meant to pass as a thoughtful gesture. Despite his sunken cheeks and the bags under his eyes, the scoundrel still retains his charm.>$BEven if your superiors would accept 'no' for an answer, I’ve got no savings to fall back on when I get out of here. And after my… <he pauses for a moment, searching for the right word> disagreements with Duchess, the smartest move would probably be to bid Orgrimmar farewell for a while.

title: Pest control
obj_text:
Exterminate 10 bats using the harpoons in the Lignary Crown , located in Orgrimmar’s Depths.
 $BBats exterminated using the harpoons. (10)

 Bat of the Depths
$B

 Bat of the Depths
desc_text: I’m afraid we have a bit of a problem—Ardayn is currently serving time in the dungeon.$BA rather embarrassing incident, you see. I caught him with the food taster… tasting what he most certainly shouldn’t have! Now who’s going to test my meals to make sure no one’s trying to poison me?$BBut perhaps you and I can come to an arrangement.$BIt just so happens that I have a little pest control issue. When I set up shop here, I had no idea how many bats were napping in these rafters. Dust off the harpoons, take out a few of the flappers for me and… who knows… maybe Ardayn’ll make it out of this in one piece.

title: Patriarchs’ Compassion
obj_text: Find and help Bruise kill five thugs in the Cauldron, in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: <Scattered notes from a research journal, likely part of a much larger study beyond these brief pages.>$B<The sketches depict human figures in various stages of decomposition. Beneath their flesh, something resembling veins appears to form a closed circuit linking body and soul.>$B<The annotations intertwine Tauren druidic principles, Orcish shamanic knowledge, Troll voodoo superstitions, and even elusive concepts such as the Pandaren Chi.>$B<Perhaps, if you gather more pages of this journal, you may uncover what the Patriarchal Enlightened are truly after.>

title: Fatal loves
obj_text:
Use the key to open Ardayn’s cage in the Timber Crown, in the Depths of Orgrimmar, and untie him.
 Ardayn untied
desc_text: I may be frivolous, even complacent at times, but above all, I am a woman of my word. Take this.$B<Duchess snaps her fingers, and the key to Ardayn’s cage magically appears in your pocket.>$BGet him out of here. Tell him he better not dare come back. Honesty is my policy... but so is holding a grudge.

title: Searching for our man
obj_text:
Investigate Glotka’s room at the Cauldron district inn in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
 Neighbour interviewed
desc_text: We might have stumbled into a problem. A big, bloody one.$BOne of the three merchants I sealed the deal with for the ships has gone missing. Glotka. He was supposed to meet me two damn hours ago to sign the papers. Have you seen him? 'Cause I sure haven’t.$BI fear the worst. Another backstab from the Alliance. But I need to be sure.$BGlotka rents a room on the top floor of this inn. Can you go up and take a look? I can’t have anyone seeing me snooping around, or they’ll try to profit off our desperation.

title: Glotka’s commitment
obj_text: Return to Kagtha and report on Glotka’s whereabouts and his willingness to close the deal.
desc_text: I thank you for freeing me. Still... this doesn't feel right. These soldiers were just following orders. I hope... you didn’t kill them.$B<A shrug from Glotka shows his discouragement. It’s not the reaction you'd expect from someone you just rescued from a prison cell.>$BKagtha will want to know I’m still willing to sign the papers. After this, I don’t have many other options. You go ahead. I need a moment to pull myself together...

title: Dark benefactors
obj_text: Explore the tunnel that leads to Orgrimmar’s docks and use the elevator.$BSpeak with Armhul at the docks.
desc_text: Gakarah ma. It was a good move sending you that letter. Thanks to you, we have everything we need. Our superiors will be pleased.$BPerhaps the time has come for you to meet them. I still have work to do down here, especially with what we've just uncovered. You, on the other hand, could use some fresh air.$BGo to the docks. Look for Armhul among the rocks. Tell him that, on my end, things are almost ready.

title: Covering our tracks
desc_text: The short-sighted fools at Grommash Hold managed to track the SI:7 spies to a coastal cave, just south of here. Our contacts say Garrosh is mobilizing a Kor'kron strike team to take them out.$BThanks to the little chat you had with that prisoner at the inn, we know SI:7 has picked up a few details about our operation. That kind of knowledge needs to die with them.$BLuckily, Caindres thinks he’s found a way into the cave that'll let us wipe out the Alliance spies without the Kor'kron ever seeing us. Take these explosives to him, and help him carve a path through the cave straight to the enemy commander’s throat.

title: The threshold of Justice
obj_text: Speak with Kagtha at the docks of Orgrimmar’s port.
desc_text: Everything is ready. Our people have taken control of the docks. I’m afraid we don’t have much time before we start raising suspicions. We must act quickly.$BI’ll stay behind to make sure we don’t leave any loose ends. You go speak with Kagtha. She’s waiting for you aboard Glotka’s ship.$BIf we don’t meet again... <the tauren leans forward and looks at you intensely>. May the spirits guide you on the Azzar Archipelago.

title: The turning point
obj_text: One
desc_text: We have everything we needed. Even more than I had anticipated. Enough to sink those bastards out at sea, without a word!$BThey want to take the city of Azzar? I’ll enjoy watching them try, as we sink the ships they send to the archipelago, one by one.$BOur diplomats in Azzar just need time. Sooner or later, the goblins of the Oilgauge cartel will follow the lead of the Bilgewater cartel and join the Horde.$BLet me know when you’re ready, <name>. We’ll set sail once night falls.

title: The prize mage
obj_text:
Show Kagtha’s seal in the headquarters of the Darts and ask for an audience with Duchess.
 Seal shown
desc_text: There's just one spot left to fill.$BYou see... One of the mercenary mages I hired for the mission just lost his head. Literally. Courtesy of the Alliance.$BBut no big deal, I’ve got another candidate in mind: Arcanist Ardayn. Heard of him? The guy’s a cocky show-off, but damn, he's good at what he does. We just need to get his lady to loosen his leash enough for him to tag along on this mission.$BHead over to the Darts' headquarters. Flash my seal and ask to see Duchess. With any luck, she'll be willing to play ball.

title: Emboldened Foes
desc_text: No time to waste!$BStick close and get ready to fight. If the Alliance thought they could catch us with our pants down…$BWell, red is the color of the Horde. And this inn was long overdue for a fresh coat of paint.

title: The silence of corpses
obj_text: Kill ten Alliance spies in the Oshu’gol Caverns.
desc_text: The math is simple.$BSI:7 has learned too much about our plans.$BNot a single one can be allowed to live. If the Kor'kron capture even one spy who knows the barest detail, a bit of questioning is all it’ll take for the Warchief and his inner circle to figure out what we’re up to.$BCaindres will help you finish them off. Fitting, isn’t it? That the one who brought you into this is the one who’ll help you end it.

title: Saving the Boss
obj_text: Defeat the guards in the Underroof, in the Depths of Orgrimmar, to retrieve the key and free Glotka.
desc_text: I’ve been keeping an eye on you. Your superiors have gone to great lengths to cover their tracks, but a chain is only as strong as its weakest link. And Glotka is the kind of man who’s always dragging his past behind.$BI can tell you where they took him. But I want something in return: guarantee me a spot on the ship when you set sail for Azzar.$B<Zavlor extends a disfigured hand. After hesitating for a moment, you shake it, sealing the deal.>$BAlright, I’ll hold you to that. The soldiers took Glotka to the dungeons in Underroof. Of course… you’ll have to defeat the guards to get the key that opens his cage.

title: Death by defenestration
obj_text:
Execute the captured Alliance spy by throwing him into the abyss.
 Spy defenestrated
desc_text: Not so fast.$BThere’s one more matter I wish to settle. A symbolic gesture, really; a trifle, but one of great personal importance.$BEver since Kagtha started scheming… whatever it is she's scheming, the Depths of Orgrimmar have been crawling with Alliance spies. Turns out one of them followed you all the way here.$BThe nerve! Don’t worry, my men already have him in custody.$BWould you do the honors and carry out the execution in my name? My sentence is death by defenestration.

title: They Took Our Men!
obj_text:
Gretchen Fizzlespark wants you to go to Sifreldar Village and rescue 5 Goblin Prisoners.
 Goblin Prisoner freed (5)
desc_text: You have to help us!  We were in the middle of an expedition into the mountains to set up a transmission tower when we were attacked.$BThey looked like vrykul, except their skin was blue and layered with frost.... and they were all female!  They took all the men in the expedition and let us women go.  Please, <name>!  We think they're being held in Sifreldar, the village overlooking K3.

title: Those who got lost
obj_text:
Find traces of the missing Forsaken and use Barguist to track them down.
 Missing warriors located
desc_text: The ambush cost me a handful of good warriors. A few met their true death. Others were lost in the chaos, and we still haven’t found them.$B<Lenara’s red eyes burn like cruel gemstones. The heel of her boot presses down on the orc’s hand, bones crunching beneath the weight.>$BI want you to find my men. Barguist, our hound, will help you track them down. Don’t worry—the undead state hasn’t dulled his sense of smell. Just give him a trail to follow.$BMake sure my warriors return to me in one piece—figuratively speaking, of course.

title: Nothing but an apothecary, after all
obj_text: Obtain the ingredients Lucranta needs to brew the pacification potion at the market in the Cauldron district, in the Depths of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You see, the noble art of pacification lies at the crossroads of alchemy, psychology, and magic. If even one of these three pillars fails, the results can be… unexpectedly violent.$BI’ve nearly finished with the five humans the troll brought me, but complications have arisen. Their loyalty to the Alliance is unshakable—I’ve had to administer every last drop of ego-phagic potion I had, and still, they resist obedience!$BI need to concoct something stronger, but I’m missing key ingredients…$BI’ve written everything I need on this list, including the code for the bank clerk. If you need any further directions, you know where to find me.

title: He said, she said
obj_text:
Kill Field Commander Dirken and plant the incriminating documents in his chest.
 Field Commander Dirken slain
desc_text: As we speak, five Alliance spies are on their way to set Razor Hill on fire.$BWhat? No, you’re not going after them. You’re handling this. Here.$B<Selara places a stack of scrolls and letters into your hand.>$BThese documents link the Alliance directly to the coming fire. I want you to plant them in the spy leader’s chest, deep inside the cave.$BBy the time the Kor'kron find them, it'll be far too late to stop anything. Just the way we want it.

title: The Crone's Bargain
obj_text: Lok'lira the Crone inside the Forlorn Mine wants you to retrieve the Runes of the Yrkvinn from Overseer Syra.
desc_text: Yes, it must be the green-skinned prisoner you're after...  We might be able to help each other.$BYou're not going to get the goblin out of here by force.  Not alive, anyway.$BAmong my people I am known as a Yrkvinn, a practitioner of illusions.  As you can see, the Hyldnir have made me their prisoner.$BIf I had my runes, I could make you go unnoticed among them.  Further inside, patrolling the mines, you'll find an overseer named Syra.  She has my runes.  Retrieve them and we'll talk some more.

title: Mildred the Cruel
obj_text: Speak to Mildred the Cruel inside the Forlorn Mine.
desc_text: Our deal is made then, <name>.  You help me get out of these chains and I'll help you find your little green friend.$BThe Hyldnir who runs this mine is known as Mildred the Cruel -- and with good reason.$BTell her you've been sent to lend a hand with the mines.  Do whatever she asks until she trusts you with the keys to my shackles.

title: Examples to be Made
obj_text:
Mildred the Cruel at the Forlorn Mine wants you to slay Garhal.
 Garhal slain
desc_text: For every action there is an opposite reaction, sister.  In the case of us applying pressure on the males, this has meant newly spread rumors of insurrection.$BThe bearded pig behind this rabble-rousing is called Garhal.  Put an end to him... and make sure the other males see his demise.  They must learn that insubordination will not be tolerated.

title: Equipment Recovery
obj_text: Gretchen Fizzlespark wants you to obtain 8 pieces of K3 Equipment in Sifreldar Village north of K3.
desc_text: Please, <name>.  When the Hyldnir took our men, they also took all our equipment.  Of course, it's more important that we get our boys back, but if you run into any of our equipment, I'd really appreciate it if you brought it back to us.$BYou'll find their village just above us, to the north.

title: Discipline
obj_text:
Mildred the Cruel at the Forlorn Mine wants you to use the Disciplining Rod on 6 Exhausted Vrykul.
 Exhausted Vrykul Disciplined (6)
desc_text: Let's start you off with something straightforward.  The male vrykul that work the mines for us do so against their will... purely out of fear of our blades.$BOnce in a while, one of them will lose their motivation.  Find any uncooperative vrykul and put them in their place.$BTake this disciplining rod.  You'll want to inflict pain, not death.  Well, most of the time anyway.

title: A Change of Scenery
obj_text: Reconvene with Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.
desc_text: Excellent.  There's an exit in the eastern end of the mine that leads to Brunnhildar Village.  Follow it and I'll meet you there.$BWe must not be seen together so no one suspects you of aiding me.  I'll use my magic to disguise my appearance.  Do not worry, <race> -- we'll find your friend in no time.

title: A Certain Prisoner
obj_text: Take Mildred's Key to Lok'lira the Crone in the Forlorn Mine.
desc_text: You are without mercy.  You will do well around these parts.$BI have another task to ask of you.  There is a female vrykul prisoner that's become more of a liability than I had anticipated.$BShe had the gall to claim the right to take part in the Hyldsmeet, our sacred competition of strength and fighting prowess.$BHere's the key to her shackles.  Make it as painless as possible.  She's a female after all, even if not one of us.

title: Prepare for Glory
obj_text: Speak to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.
desc_text: This is it then.  I'll take care of your bear now, you won't be needing her.  The great Drakkensryd will be your next challenge.$BSay goodbye to your friends and leave your affairs in order, for you will return victorious... or you won't return at all.

title: Orgrim's Hammer
obj_text: Seek out Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer flying above Icecrown.
desc_text: The Argent Crusade pulled my ravaged body from the Broken Front. What a glorious battle, <race>. My axe sang as it cut down Alliance filth and Scourge alike.$BMy time is over. It will be a good death. Carry a message for me, soldier.$BOur base flies out of reach of Scourge - overhead between Mord'rethar and Aldur'thar. It is called "Orgrim's Hammer."$B<Hork futilely attempts to salute.>$BFly high and avoid the Alliance juggernaut, Skybreaker. Tell Korm... tell him I died... fighting... For the Horde.

title: The Air Stands Still
obj_text:
The Ebon Watcher at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to kill Salranax the Flesh Render, Underking Talonox and High Priest Yath'amon.
 Salranax the Flesh Render slain
 Underking Talonox slain
 High Priest Yath'amon slain
desc_text: You must defeat the lords of Scourgeholme if this place is to be free of the Scourge's grasp.$BSalranax the Flesh Render lords over the temple on the first tier of Scourgeholme. Nearby Salranax you'll find High Priest Yath'amon preaching at the spirit tower on the second tier. Underking Talonox holds court at the Pit of Fiends, up the high road.$BThese are formidable opponents and must be approached with caution. Use this war horn should you require aid. The death knights of Acherus will come.

title: Into The Frozen Heart Of Northrend
obj_text: Deliver Father Gustav's Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
desc_text: Silas and Spitzpatrick have signed off on the materials and fuel needed to begin construction of Justice Keep. Thanks to you and the Ebon Blade the Scourge presence within Scourgeholme has been decimated and their lieutenants have been defeated.$BI have chosen the site at which we will break ground, but first you must deliver my report to Highlord Tirion Fordring. We will begin our march into Icecrown on his command.

title: The Skybreaker
obj_text: Seek out High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker flying above Icecrown.
desc_text: We were neck deep in Scourge and Horde. The screams of the dying covered that field. It was torturous... unrelenting!$BAt some point my body gave out. I fell, only to be awoken by the Argent Crusade. They pulled me out of the Broken Front and brought me here. I'm not going to make it. Grant a dying soldier one last wish, <race>? Our base, the Skybreaker, flies high above Icecrown. It is there that you'll find my commanding officer, High Captain Bartlett. Tell him that I died a soldier of the Alliance.

title: It Could Kill Us All
obj_text: Crusade Engineer Spitzpatrick at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to retrieve 8 pieces of Crystallized Energy.
desc_text: Southeast of here, at the eastern reaches of Crystalsong Forest, is an area known as the Unbound Thicket. Within that thicket creeps all manner of life. One thing all of the affected creatures of the thicket share in common is their affinity for magical energy. Each of them holds pure, crystallized energy. Enough to kill us all should it ever destabilize!$BTravel to the Unbound Thicket and kill its denizens for crystallized energy. We need fuel and they need to die. We call that a "win-win."

title: Emergency Measures
obj_text: loodguard Lorga wants you to go to the Gimorak's Den to the east and obtain 6 Worg Furs.
desc_text: The cold in these mountains is brutal.  We have a day or two before we burn up all the wood from the wreckage.$BWe spotted worgs inside a cave directly east of here.  I need you to find the cave and obtain some furs.  It might not sound like much, but it might be the difference between freezing to death and living another day.$BWorgs don't hunt alone, so I'm giving you a flare.  It should buy you some time if you find yourself outnumbered.

title: Maintaining Discipline
obj_text:
Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Disciplining Rod on 6 Exhausted Vrykul inside the Forlorn Mine.
 Exhausted Vrykul Disciplined (6)
desc_text: You've succeeded where others have failed.  Yet you cannot rest on your laurels.$BYou must show others what strength and commitment really mean.$BThe male insubordinates inside the Forlorn Mine need to be disciplined once again.  Show them sister... show them what it means to disobey us.

title: The Ape Hunter's Slave
obj_text:
Kill 8 Hardknuckle Foragers and 6 Hardknuckle Chargers for High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$BIf you lose Goregek's Shackles, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
 Hardknuckle Forager slain (8)
 Hardknuckle Charger slain (6)
Forceitem Goregek (Provided)
desc_text: You think you so great hunter, eh? You no Frenzyheart, you not know of hunt.$BGoregek is great ape hunter. He slay so many ape you can't count on claws.$BYou go with Goregek and hunt hardknuckles to east. You the slave, <race>. You do what Goregek tell you.

title: Playing Along
obj_text: Report to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill as the new "slave."
desc_text: My kill! You take my kill!$B<Gekgek taunts you with his spear.>$BYou dumb, <race>. Now you owe Gekgek! You be Frenzyheart slave. You slay many more beasts for Frenzyheart.$BYou go Frenzyheart Hill to northeast - you tell High-Shaman Rakjak you the new slave.$BGo, <race>! Go or I taunt you a second time!$B<Gekgek waves his spear around menacingly.>

title: The Wasp Hunter's Apprentice
obj_text:
Kill 6 Sapphire Hive Wasps and 9 Sapphire Hive Drones for High-Shaman Rakjak in Frenzyheart Hill.$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
 Sapphire Hive Wasp slain (6)
 Sapphire Hive Drone slain (9)
desc_text: Rakjak not dumb. Maybe you good at killing things. Maybe Frenzyheart can make you into real hunter.$BDajik hunts giant wasp things better than all wolvar. Go with Dajik to Sapphire Hive to southeast or to river in south and learn the hunt.

title: Tormenting the Softknuckles
obj_text:
Goregek has given you a Softknuckle Poker for use on Softknuckles to draw the Hardknuckle Matriarch out of hiding. Slay the Hardknuckle Matriarch and report her death to High-Shaman Rajak at Frenzyheart Hill.$BIf you lose Goregek's Shackles, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
 Hardknuckle Matriarch slain
desc_text: Slave thing!$BRakjak want me to babysit you while I kill hardknuckles. I feeling generous today, so I let you kill some too, but don't get in Goregek's way!$BRakjak not know yet, but Goregek has eye on big bad hardknuckle mama. We go to Hardknuckle Clearing to east and poke softknuckles with poker and she sure to come yelling!$B<Goregek rubs his hands together gleefully.>

title: The Stone That Started A Revolution
obj_text: Crusade Architect Silas at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown wants you to retrieve 10 Trunks of Crystalline Heartwood and 10 pieces of Ancient Elven Masonry.
desc_text: You may look at Scourgeholme now and see a rancid pit of decay, but one day it will be a place of glory and honor. Highlord Fordring has deemed it "Justice Keep."$BAlas, even an impregnable fortress like Icecrown Citadel began with but a single stone. So begins our search for the stone to start a revolution.$BTravel to Crystalsong, south of here, and seek out the Unbound Thicket in the east. Once there gather crystalline heartwood from the thicket floor and elven masonry from the Ruins of Shandaral.

title: A Rough Ride
obj_text:
Ride the captive crocolisk to Mistwhisper Refuge and then speak to Zepik for further instructions.$BIf you lose Zepik's Hunting Horn, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
 $BTravel to Mistwhisper Refuge.
desc_text: Zepik is best hunter of the Frenzyheart. Zepik hunts big-tongues... ugly things near swamps that try to steal all stuff they can find.$BZepik going on long trek to break big-tongue shrine and try to scare them away. We no want big-tongues in this land anymore.$BThere a crocolisk chained on northeast side of hill, next to tree - go with Zepik and do what Zepik tell you.

title: The Mist Isn't Listening
obj_text:
Zepik wants you to kill 12 Mistwhisper Gorlocs.$BIf you lose Zepik's Hunting Horn, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
 $BMistwhisper Gorloc (12)

 Mistwhisper Oracle
$B

 Mistwhisper Warrior
