desc_text: Gorillas and wasps are boring! Big-tongues the only thing fun to hunt.$BWhile we mess up rain shrine, we kill lots of mist big-tongues. That sure to make them not want to come back to village thing.$B<Zepik nods to himself confidently.>

title: Hoofing It
obj_text: Find your way back to Frenzyheart Hill and speak to High-Shaman Rakjak.
desc_text: Okay, we done! Time to go back. No crocolisk to ride this time though.$BIf we go east and stay near ridge, it should lead all the way back near hill.$BNeed to be careful not to go far below ridge though or we might go right into big-tongue tree village thing. Zepik not think they like us right now.

title: Powering the Waygate - The Maker's Perch
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to go to the Maker's Perch and use the Activation Switch Gamma.
 Activation Switch Gamma
desc_text: It is time then.  Let us activate the waygate.$BYou will find the first switch inside the Maker's Perch in the western edge of the basin.$BBeware, <name>.  The titans used the perch to watch over their creations.  Many of their stone servants still guard the place.

title: Just Following Orders
obj_text:
Locate an Injured Rainspeaker Oracle for High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$B
 Locate Injured Rainspeaker Oracle
desc_text: Okay <guy/lady>, Rakjak have very important job. You go capture injured big-tongue that tracker spotted at river to north.$BNot bring hunter this time because they maybe want to just kill it. I want to hide it so that I can poke it and make it tell me things.$BGo you and bring me big-tongue prize thing.

title: Lightning Definitely Strikes Twice
obj_text:
Zepik wants you to smash the Skyreach Crystal Clusters in front of the Mistwhisper weather shrine.$BIf you lose Zepik's Hunting Horn, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
 $BSabotage the Mistwhisper Weather Shrine
desc_text: Okay, the crystal things...$BThe big-tongues use the crystals to power their rain shrines. Zepik not know quite how it works, but Zepik does know that if they use wrong crystals, the clouds and the rain go crazy!$BZepik tried to sneak in at one of their other rain shrines, but it not go so well. It sure to go much better with two!$BTake crystals, place at big stone pillar shrine thing, then smash them to release power. Zepik not sure what will happen, so might want to step back after.

title: The Underground Menace
obj_text: Locate Serfex under the sands of the southern river, slay him, and bring his claw to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
desc_text: Lion killer, chicken chaser, new Frenzyheart slave...$BI know you no want to stay slave, so I tell you what to do. Show you better than the other Frenzyheart hunters and then Rakjak respect you.$BUnder sands of south river there a beast that kills wasp, apes, and even wolvar. He called Serfex. You bring claw of Serfex to Rakjak and maybe he release you from slaveness.$BHope Dajik teaching you good so Serfex be easy stuff.

title: The Sapphire Queen
obj_text: ring the Stinger of the Sapphire Queen to High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill.$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
desc_text: ristlepine can be dangerous, but most stay far away from wolvar. Wasps on other hand not fear the Frenzyheart... they even kill some of our hunters.$BI know Rakjak want wasp queen dead, but no wolvar want to go into her hive. You go kill wasp queen in Sapphire Hive to southeast and get stinger for Rakjak. Me bet Rakjak like that.

title: Flown the Coop!
obj_text: Capture 12 Chicken Escapees for Elder Harkek.$BIf you lose Dajik's Worn Chalk, speak to Elder Harkek in Frenzyheart Hill.
desc_text: Dumb Goregek stumble into chicken house and let all the chickens go!$BThey all around hill - go get chickens back!$B<Elder Harkek shoos you away.>

title: Mischief in the Making
obj_text: High-Shaman Rakjak at Frenzyheart Hill wants 8 Skyreach Crystal Clusters.
desc_text: You good hunter, but Frenzyheart can make you stronger. Harkek think maybe you ready for something more important.$BBefore Rakjak send you on important mission, you need gather things for Rakjak. All along river to south are blue crystals. Rakjak need lots of blue crystals.$BYou go get crystals now.

title: An Issue of Trust
obj_text:
Obtain Freya's trust by destroying 6 Blighted Corpses and 10 Bonescythe Ravagers in the Lost Lands.
 $BBlighted Corpse slain (6)

 Blighted Corpse
$B

 Blighted Corpse
$B
$B
 Bonescythe Ravager slain (10)
desc_text: This should never have happened.  The forces of undeath storm the very cradle of life!$BIf you're not here to destroy the minions of the Lich King, then leave at once.  Do not incur my wrath by distracting me from my duties.

title: Fortunate Misunderstandings
obj_text:
Escort the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle to Rainspaker Canopy and speak to High-Oracle Soo-say.
 $BEscort the Injured Rainspeaker Oracle to Rainspaker Canopy
desc_text: I sorry! I not mean to get you in trouble!$B<The injured oracle stares at you blankly for a long while.>$BYou save me! We thank you. We going to go back to village now. You come too... you can stay with us! Puppy-men kind of mean anyway.$BLet me know when you ready to go, okay?

title: Make the Bad Snake Go Away
obj_text:
High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to kill Venomtip and 10 Emperor Cobras.$BIf you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
 Emperor Cobra slain (10)
 Venomtip slain
Forceitem Lafoo (Provided)
desc_text: We were here long before the puppy-men came. This is very sacred place - we will not leave.$BYou seem like maybe you good, but we have Lafoo stay with you just in case. You understand we think.$BThere snakes thing that keeps trying to eat our hatchlings. Go with Lafoo and make them stop, okay? Especially big one near waterfall to northeast.

title: The Crusaders' Pinnacle
obj_text: Seek out Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.
desc_text: Stand proud in knowing that it was you who helped establish the Argent Crusade inside the walls of Icecrown, <name>. The Crusaders' Pinnacle now stands in direct defiance of the Lich King and his twisted minions.$BHighlord Fordring and the crusaders who survived await your arrival at Crusaders' Pinnacle. Travel once more through the Breach and seek out the highlord!

title: Back So Soon?
obj_text:
Travel to Mistwhisper Refuge and speak to Mistcaller Soo-gan.$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
Forceitem Jaloot (Provided)
desc_text: <High-Oracle Soo-say stares at your forehead for a while before speaking.>$BSoo-gan ask for help. We think they might have been attacked by puppy-men again.$BWe sending you and Jaloot to help... follow west river up to Mistwhisper Refuge. Do what Soo-gan says... hit the puppy-men on the nose if they being mean, they don't like that.$B<High-Oracle Soo-say goes back to staring at your forehead as you leave.>

title: Gods like Shiny Things
obj_text: Collect 6 of the treasures that Lafoo digs up and bring them to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.$BIf you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
desc_text: Soo-say said we go with you. You be nice, okay?$BOoh, ooh! We know! We can make Soo-say happy if we bring back more offerings for shrine! We not need to go far, there's always stuffs to dig up around village... just look for sparkles in dirt!$BLet's go! Let's go! More offerings for shrine!

title: Making Peace
obj_text:
High-Oracle Soo-say at Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to give a peace offering to Shaman Vekjik and then return with his response.$BIf you lose Lafoo's Bug Bag, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
 $BExtend Peace Offering to Shaman Vekjik
desc_text: We have great idea. You were friends with puppy-men, they maybe listen to you.$BWe want you to go give offering to Shaman Vekjik. He southwest where river turns into waterfall.  Tell puppy-man we no want fight. Tell him we play nice.$BYou good <race>. We trust you do this right.

title: The Mosswalker Savior
obj_text:
Moodle wants you to rescue 6 of the Mosswalker Victims in Mosswalker Village, though some of them may no longer be alive to save.$BIf you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
 Mosswalker Victims Rescued (6)
desc_text: There's some small chance that the Mosswalkers are not all dead yet... and at the very least, they deserve to not be butchered like this.$BLet's find some revenge for this slaughter and see if there are any to be saved in the process.

title: Forced Hand
obj_text:
Kill 8 Frenzyheart Spearbearers and 6 Frenzyheart Scavengers for Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge.$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
 Frenzyheart Spearbearer slain (8)
 Frenzyheart Scavenger slain (6)
desc_text: We try to be nice to puppy-men ever since they came, but they nothing but mean.$BWe okay with them being dumb - they not do much harm. Now they mess with sacred shrines though. Sacred shrines not for messing with. The Great Stones are here from all the way back when the Great Ones made us.$BWe wouldn't know what to do if the Great Mist Stone were hurt. Go to their camp to north... make puppy-men stop and not come back!

title: Home Time!
obj_text: Return to Rainspeaker Canopy.
desc_text: You're a good dryskin. Mistwhisper safe, treasure safe, and puppy-men sure to leave us alone now.$BYou go back to Rainspeaker Canopy and tell Soo-say you done good.

title: The Angry Gorloc
obj_text:
Travel to Mosswalker Village and speak to Moodle once you've arrived.$BIf you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
 $BTravel to Mosswalker Village.
Forceitem Moodle (Provided)
desc_text: I not think you be back in time to go out again, but I wrong. I sending Moodle to nearby Mosswalker friends to bop silly Mosswalkers for not coming see shrine. Their village is east, up ridge, northeast of broken pillar.$BYou go with Moodle! He extra smart Rainspeaker... you listen to him good-like.

title: Lifeblood of the Mosswalker Shrine
obj_text: Moodle wants you to collect 10 Lifeblood Shards, but stay away from the cave inside of the pillar itself.$BIf you lose Moodle's Stress Ball, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
desc_text: I've always suspected that the pillars have been the main reason for our weather and seclusion from the undead... this confirms it a bit.$BNot terribly long ago, there was a sound of a great explosion when the Lifeblood Pillar fell. The weather changed for the mosswalkers almost immediately... it began to snow, something we never see.$BThey were able to stop the snow by bringing more lifeblood crystals to the Great Moss Stone. Perhaps if we can do the same, it will help ward off the undead as well.

title: In Search of Bigger Game
obj_text:
Talk to at .
                Description
Well, <name>, you've been an enormous asset to the expedition so far. Debaar, Buck, and I couldn't have have assembled such an amazing collection of trophies without you.$BBut, I hear there are even fiercer monsters in other parts of the basin. I've sent a search party up north to get an idea of what other beasts await us.$BI'd like you to meet up with them and see what they've found. Head north, beyond Bittertide Lake and search for the encampment.
                Related

title: A Hero's Burden
obj_text:
Kill Artruis the Heartless.$BWhile securing the aid of friends is highly recommended, Moodle will not be able to accompany you on this task.
 Artruis the Heartless slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Perhaps the crystals will ward off the undead gradually, but there is one more thing that must be done.$BWe need to find the leader of these undead and kill him to ensure there's no one to push the wretches back upon us. If my suspicions are correct, he will be somewhere inside the fallen pillar... the Sundered Shard.$BThe corpses being dragged there would suggest as much anyway.$BI'll place the shards and bring the news to Soo-say... you will need to find other help in the meantime.

title: The Lost Mistwhisper Treasure
obj_text:
Kill Warlord Tartek and retrieve the Mistwhisper Treasure for Mistcaller Soo-gan at Mistwhisper Refuge.$BIf you lose Jaloot's Favorite Crystal, speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy.
 Warlord Tartek slain
desc_text: So some puppy-men come and smash blue crystals at Great Mist Stone! Lots of rain and lightning and badness... blue is wrong crystal for Great Mist Stone! Dumb puppy-men.$BAfter lightning, puppy-men stole big treasure we found in the sea-lake. We need treasure back to give to Great Mist Stone! Mist Stone is angry after what the puppy-men did!$BOne who took it named Tarter... no, Tiktak... no, no... Tartek. That it, Tartek! He went to the camp thing to north. Go get treasure back!

title: In Search of Bigger Game
obj_text: Speak with Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost in Sholazar Basin.
desc_text: Well, <name>, you've certainly proven your mettle as a hunter of all kinds of game animals -- rhinos, cats, and crocolisks. For some members of the expedition, these creatures are sufficient to test their hunting skills, but others, like myself, crave larger challenges.$BDorian Drakestalker went north, across Bittertide Lake and established a camp there. He's heard rumors of gigantic primordial drakes. Just imagine what a quarry they would be! Go check up on Dorian and see if he's had any luck.

title: The Fallen Pillar
obj_text: Travel to the Lifeblood Pillar and look for clues to its destruction.
desc_text: The titans shaped entire life forms here, fostering their unfettered growth.$BThe five crystal pillars that surround the basin emanate pure lifeforce.  The Scourge should've never been able to penetrate the basin, but one of the pillars was destroyed.$BGo to the Lifeblood Pillar and see if you can find out what happened.  No undead would've been able to approach the pillar, so keep your eyes out for living intruders.  You'll find what remains of the pillar directly south of here.

title: Sharpening Your Talons
obj_text:
Kill 6 Primordial Drakes and then speak with Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
 Primordial Drake slain (6)
desc_text: The primordial drakes occupy most of the area to the north and east, and I can feel the heat of their breath even at this distance. Before we can challenge the mightiest among the drakes, we must test our skills against the lesser creatures.$BStill, don't let your guard down; any one of these beasts can devour a man whole. Once you've familiarized yourself with the combat tactics of these drakes, return and I will tell you our next step.

title: Powering the Waygate - The Maker's Overlook
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya wants you to head to the Maker's Overlook in eastern Sholazar Basin and use the Activation Switch Theta.
 Activation Switch Theta
desc_text: We cannot stop now, <race>.  You've triggered the first switch, but one remains.$BThe titans constructed a second vantage point where they oversaw their creations.  You'll find it to the east, high in the mountains.$BPull the activation switch theta inside the overlook and the waygate will open.

title: Exterminate the Intruders
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to go to the Death's Hand Encampment to the northwest and slay 8 Cultist Infiltrators.
 Cultist Infiltrator slain (8)
desc_text: I am an embodiment of but one aspect of Freya, daughter of the titans.  I am the Lifewarden -- I was left here to protect this land against the threat of the Scourge.$BI never anticipated the Lich King would send willing living servants to do his work.$BI could easily crush these cultists myself, but I am all that stands between the undead armies and the rest of the basin.  Go, <name>.  Deliver my wrath to these insolent trespassers.

title: Post-partum Aggression
obj_text:
Kill Broodmother Slivina and return to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
 Broodmother Slivina slain
desc_text: roodmother Slivina's likely to be a snarling ball of teeth, spikes, and talons. You've gone and stolen her children away and no mother takes kindly to that.$B'Tis true they hatched from eggs, but she loves the little beasts no less than your mother loves you.$BShe'll be desperate and fierce in equal measures, everything Hemet loves in a target. You and he, along with that mammoth, should be a match for her.$BShe's on her perch at the northern edge of the Savage Thicket and hungers for revenge.

title: A Mammoth Undertaking
obj_text:
ring a Shattertusk Mammoth to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost.
 Shattertusk Mammoth Delivered
desc_text: efore you go off challenging Broodmother Slivina, Dorian thought it might be a good idea for you and Hemet to coordinate your efforts by riding into battle on the back of a mammoth.$BThe area around the camp is full of them. Just take this bridle and skip it over the head of a shattertusk mammoth. Be careful of the bulls, though. They won't tolerate the harness at all. Bring the mammoth back here when you've found a suitable one.

title: Returned Sevenfold
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya wants you defeat Thalgran Blightbringer by using Freya's Ward to reflect his Deathbolts back to him sevenfold.
 Thalgran Blightbringer slain
desc_text: The agents of the Lich King have foolishly trespassed upon these lands where the power of life rules supreme.  All harm they inflict will be returned to them sevenfold.$BThe monster directly responsible for corrupting the land is known as Thalgran Blightbringer; you will find him just to the north of here.  Take this ward and use it to reflect the power of death upon him.  Show the Scourge that the power of life prevails above all.

title: Securing the Bait
obj_text: ring 6 Primordial Hatchlings to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
desc_text: We're not likely to get Broodmother Slivina's attention waving our arms around like fools, but if we're smart, we can bait her into fighting us. We'll also secure more, uh, fodder for my little project.$B<Dorian glances over at Zootfizzle.>$BBut don't worry about that for now. Just look for the primordial drake eggs in the area east and northeast of the camp. Burst them open and scoop up the hatchlings that come out. When the broodmother realizes what we've done, she'll have no choice but to face us.

title: The Blessing of Zim'Torga
obj_text: Witch Doctor Khufu wants you to present 10 Drakkari Offerings to the statue of Zim'Torga.
desc_text: Hexxer Ubungo probably told you about making offerings to the gods of Zul'Drak. Zim'Abwa is not the only god that stands forgotten by the Drakkari.$BWe have taken refuge within the presence of Zim'Torga, the Mother of Prosperity. As with Zim'Abwa, if you were to give offerings of the Drakkari to her, she is sure to give you her blessing.

title: Freya's Pact
obj_text:
Listen to what the Avatar of Freya has to say.
 Freya's Pact
desc_text: The cultists have been taken care of, but the Scourge's invasion has not slowed down.  The situation is becoming desperate, <name>.$BThere exists a last resort.  Before I reveal any more, however, I must be sure I have your absolute trust.

title: The Lifewarden's Wrath
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya at the Rainspeaker Rapids wants you to use Freya's Horn atop of the Glimmering Pillar.
 The Lifewarden's Wrath
desc_text: We were not quick enough, <name>.  The cultist scum have arrived at the Glimmering Pillar and are making preparations to destroy it, I can sense them.$BWe don't have much time.  Blow upon this horn atop the Glimmering Pillar to channel my power through the crystal.$BWe shall show this scum to not trifle with the titans' creations.

title: To the Witch Doctor
obj_text: Speak with Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.
desc_text: We Zandalari could use your help, <name>. We must put an end to what the Drakkari are doing to their gods!$BTo the northeast, up the great steps that lead to the next tier of Zul'Drak, lies Zim'Torga. It is the home to another of the god statues and a refuge that my people are desparately attempting to defend.$BI would like for you to travel there and speak to Witch Doctor Khufu. Be warned though, the place is under constant attack from the Drakkari.

title: Breaking Through Jin'Alai
obj_text:
Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga has asked you to disturb the Blue Cauldron, Green Cauldron, Purple Cauldron, and Red Cauldron.
 Blue Cauldron disturbed
 Green Cauldron disturbed
 Purple Cauldron disturbed
 Red Cauldron disturbed
desc_text: I have been trying to commune with the gods. However, the medicine men at the Pools of Jin'Alai are performing rituals that are interfering with my attempts.$BIt is imperative that we break through their obtrusion. If you were to head southwest into the pools area, I am certain that you would come across the cauldrons they are using for their magic.$BDisturb each of the cauldrons to bring down their ritual that is blocking me.

title: To Speak With Har'koa
obj_text: Speak with Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa.
desc_text: The gods have spoken, <name>. We now know what you must do.$BYou must now go to the Altar of Har'koa to the southeast and speak with the leopard goddess.

title: Sealing the Rifts
obj_text:
Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga has asked you to seal 7 Elemental Rifts.
 Elemental Rifts sealed (7)
desc_text: Dagoda gonna be sendin' you northwest to Drak'Mabwa to get her more stuff for her defenders if she didn't already.$BWhile you up there, Ahunae be wantin' you to destroy the rifts those elementals pourin' out of. The last thing we needin' is for them to attack us!$BJust watch out, more of those frozen earth'll show up when you try to seal the rifts.

title: But First My Offspring
obj_text:
Har'koa has asked you to use her whisker on the corpses of her children to free and resurrect them. Return to her at the Altar of Har'koa when you are done.
 Cursed Offspring of Har'koa resurrected (7)
desc_text: I am the last of the gods to be subdued, so we must first attempt to free the others. Bound by the magics of my subduers, I am unable to discern their fates.$BBut first, I would ask that you do me a kindness. Already the Drakkari turn my magic against me. They have transformed my offspring into monstrosities.$BTake one of my whiskers. Slay my tortured children and use the magic of it to release them from their nightmare, and bring them back to life.

title: Relics of the Snow Leopard Goddess
obj_text: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga wants you to recover 10 Har'koan Relics.
desc_text: I overheard that you are going to see to the well-being of Har'koa. Good luck to you.$BI am wondering if while you are in the vicinity of the altar, you would be willing to recover their relics? I do not require many, and it is only a short trip to the southeast.$BWhat do you say?

title: Spirit of Rhunok
obj_text: Speak with the Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok.
desc_text: My feelings tell me that Rhunok doesn't have much time.$BI can tell that the arctic bear god's spirit has already separated from his weakened body. It is his spirit with which you must commune.$BHis altar lies to the northwest beyond Drak'Mabwa.

title: The Frozen Earth
obj_text: Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga wants you to collect 7 Essence of the Frozen Earth.
desc_text: We captured these elementals from nearby, and I have plenty of defenders now. But, it takes a great deal of power to make them strong enough to stand up to our enemies.$BThe frozen earth at Drak'Mabwa to the northwest have what I need to maintain our defenses. I'll need more of their essence if I'm to keep this up.

title: The Leaders at Jin'Alai
obj_text: Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga has asked you to retrieve the Treasure of Kutube'sa, the Treasure of Gawanil, and the Treasure of Chulo the Mad.
desc_text: You thinkin' what Ahunae thinkin', mon?$BSome of the Drakkari trolls have gathered at the Pools of Jin'Alai to the southwest. We be needin' to draw out their leaders, and Ahunae knows just how you be doin' it, too!$BGo in there and kill those trolls. When you kill enough, their leaders show up.$BWhen they show up next to their totems, you make sure to be gettin' the treasure of Kutube'sa, Gawanil, and Chulo the Mad, mon.

title: An End to the Suffering
obj_text:
The Spirit of Rhunok has asked you to use the Tormentor's Incense to awaken his body. You are then to slay Rhunok using the power that his spirit has imbued you with.$BIf for some reason you lose the Mojo of Rhunok aura, you can return to the Spirit of Rhunok to have it reapplied.
 Rhunok slain
An End to the Suffering: Quest Accept/Gossip Option (Provided)
desc_text: My body is too far gone now, <name>. It is only a matter of time before a new prophet is elevated and finishes what the other began.$BI am going to imbue you with the last of my power. The tormentor inside the altar building carries incense, which will awaken my body and make it vulnerable.$BUse the incense and do me the kindness of putting an end to my suffering.$BI apologize if I fight back. Even for me, the will to survive is strong.

title: My Prophet, My Enemy
obj_text: The Spirit of Rhunok at the Altar of Rhunok has asked you to acquire his Arctic Bear God Mojo.
desc_text: My prophet absorbed too much of my power too quickly, and subsequently killed himself. You can see the results at the water-filled crater to the south in Drak'Mabwa.$BMy former priests have already resurrected him so that he can finish the job. They're channeling my power back into him, and it will not be long now before he reawakens.$BYou must put an end to him and return with my mojo before it is too late.

title: Plundering Their Own
obj_text: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga wants you to recover 7 Rhunokian Artifacts.
desc_text: There is another altar nearby where there are artifacts to be saved.$BIt is said that the Drakkari at the Altar of Rhunok to the northwest, beyond the broken tundra of Drak'Mabwa, have already plundered their own holy site.$B<class>, I would be appreciative if you could rescue those artifacts from their undeserving hands.

title: Back to Har'koa
obj_text: Speak with Har'koa at the Altar of Har'koa.
desc_text: And now it is time for you to return to the leopard goddess. Somehow I sense that she has other plans for you.$BTell her that no matter what, we are eternal.

title: Lakeside Landing
obj_text: Speak with Tamara Wobblesprocket at Lakeside Landing.
desc_text: When the trouble with the Venture Company started, I asked Marvin Wobblesprocket and his wife, Tamara, to take their flying machines east to River's Heart. I asked them to setup a small camp there so that we could use them as a relay to fly in supplies and survey the area.$BThey should have arrived by now and started setting up. River's Heart is near the center of the basin where the rivers converge. Search for Lakeshore Landing on the northeast shore. Marvin mentioned it would be the best spot.

title: I Sense a Disturbance
obj_text:
Har'koa has asked you to determine what has happened to Quetz'lun. Speak to her to be able to ride one of her children stealthily into the Altar of Quetz'lun.$BReturn to her at the Altar of Har'koa once you have done so.
 $BQuetz'lun's fate revealed.
desc_text: There's something wrong with Quetz'lun, the wind serpent goddess. What it is exactly I cannot sense, but I do know that her altar has been overrun with powerful creatures.$BI'm going to send you there on the back of one of my children, which you saved. The two of you will move swiftly and with great stealth to uncover what has become of Quetz'lun.$BMy child will see you safely back to me. Just keep your eyes open.$BWhen you are ready, ask and I will call one of my kittens for you.

title: Weapons of Destruction
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya wants you to go to the Death's Hand Encampment to the northwest and destroy 4 Unstable Explosives.
 Unstable Explosives destroyed (4)
desc_text: The Lich King's lackeys have dared to bring weapons of destruction into my domain.  I will not stand for this.$BGo to their outpost to the north and destroy the weapons they would use against the land.  We cannot let the Scourge taint another inch of these sacred lands.

title: Scalps!
obj_text:
Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga wants you to use Ahunae's Knife to scalp 10 Heb'Drakkar trolls.$BThe scalper reminds you that you should loot them first.
 Heb'Drakkar trolls scalped (10)
desc_text: I thinkin' it be time to do some scalpin', mon!$BThe trolls at Heb'Drakkar to the northeast should do nicely. With their fancy bats and attackin' us, they got it comin'!$BAhunae even give you his own knife so that you do the job right.

title: Foundation for Revenge
obj_text:
Quetz'lun's Spirit has tasked you with the destruction of 12 trolls, either Quetz'lun Worshippers or Serpent-Touched Berserkers, near her Soul Fonts.$BOnly after you have accomplished this should you return to her at the Altar of Quetz'lun.
 Trolls killed near a Soul Font (12)
desc_text: I have something special planned for my favorite high priests. But first you get to prove yourself in laying the foundation for my revenge.$BYou do still want to live, yes?$BAs you have seen, my devotees are enjoying their stay here, but now it's time for them to make final restitution.$BDo me the smallest of favors if you would, <name>. Lure them near my soul fonts and then put an end to their existences.$BThey taste so delicious, and their sacrifice will not go in vain, I can assure you.

title: Preparations for the Underworld
obj_text: Har'koa wants you to collect 8 Sacred Adornments. Deliver them to her at the Altar of Har'koa.
desc_text: Quetz'lun may be dead, but I can still feel her spirit lingering in the underworld at the altar. We have to find a way to get you to her.$BLuckily for us, I just happen to have a supply of former supplicants at hand who are no longer in need of their sacred adornments. Both my subduers and claws are likely to still be wearing them.$BBring the adornments to me and I'll draw upon their energy to enable you to cross over into Quetz'lun's underworld nightmare.

title: Reconnaissance Flight
obj_text:
Help Pilot Vic complete the Reconnaissance Flight.
 $BReconnaissance Flight
desc_text: It's about time we had planes up and running in this place.  The professor's been asking me to check out a strange weather pattern coming from the northeast.$BThing is, I'm going to need a co-pilot if we're going into uncharted territory.  No way in hell I'm heading out there alone.$BWhat do you say, <tough-guy /hotshot>?  You might learn a thing or two.  And once you learn to deal with the northern winds... you can pretty much fly anywhere.

title: Bringing Down Heb'Jin
obj_text:
Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga wants you to kill Heb'Jin.
 Heb'Jin slain
desc_text: <Dagoda looks at Ahunae and sighs.>$BYou want to really deal with Heb'Drakkar? Collecting scalps isn't going to get the job done. You have to take out their leader, Heb'Jin.$BThe problem is, he's up on the bat rookery goading his forces on.$BBang his drum and I guarantee that he'll fly down. That's when you kill him.$BYou can take this net we got from one of his headhunters. Use it to trap his bat when he lands. That way you won't have to fight both of them.

title: Seek the Wind Serpent Goddess
obj_text: Seek Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun.
desc_text: You are prepared, but I'm not certain that you're ready for what is to come.$BWhen you cross back over into Quetz'lun's altar area, you will enter the realm of the dead. From what I can feel of it, it's not going to be pleasant.$BTry not to be distracted by what you see in there. Simply head for the altar building and seek out Quetz'lun's Spirit.

title: My Pet Roc
obj_text: ring 7 Roc Eggs to Zootfizzle at Dorian's Outpost.
desc_text: Dorian's had me training and feeding the baby drakes he captures, and it has gotten me thinking. I want a pet of my own!$BNo, not a juvenile drake. I don't want a pet capable of biting my hand off!$BHowever, in the Bonefields to the northeast of the camp, beyond the area dominated by the drakes, there's a large population of goretalon rocs. The grown ones are beyond hope of domesticating, but if you bring me the eggs from their nests, I can raise them from the time they hatch.

title: The Blessing of Zim'Rhuk
obj_text: Witch Doctor Khufu wants you to present 10 Drakkari Offerings to the statue of Zim'Rhuk.
desc_text: There is another god of Zul'Drak that is being neglected.$BZim'Rhuk's statue lies directly to the north. Known as "The Wise One", Zim'Rhuk is also known to be very protective of his domain. He maintains guardians that deal harshly with anyone that does not have the wits to slip past them.$BAvoid the guardians and give the Drakkari offerings to Zim'Rhuk so that you will benefit from his blessing.

title: Hell Hath a Fury
obj_text:
Quetz'lun's Spirit at the Altar of Quetz'lun wants you to use Quetz'lun's Hexxing Stick upon High Priest Mu'funu, High Priestess Tua-Tua, and High Priest Hawinni. Once you have done this, slay them.
 High Priest Mu'funu hexed at death
 High Priestess Tua-Tua hexed at death
 High Priest Hawinni hexed at death
desc_text: It is now time for you to punish my three high priests: Mu'funu, Tua-Tua, and Hawinni. You'll find them spread around the altar grounds.$BTake this hexxing stick. I've empowered it with my rage and indignation. I'm sure that it will prove potent.$BJust use it and proceed to destroy them. The hex will take care of the rest.$B<Quetz'lun displays a toothy grin.>$BSucceed and I may let you go. Fail and die.

title: Setting the Stage
obj_text: Quetz'lun's Spirit has demanded that you collect 10 Underworld Power Fragments. Return to her at the Altar of Quetz'lun only when you have done so.
desc_text: I will give you a chance at continued existence.$BThere are fragments of the power that fueled my curse scattered about the altar grounds. It is my desire that you collect some of them for me. Not so many that the curse will be lifted, but enough that I will be able to eventually make use of them to exact revenge upon my prophet.$BGo, insect. Run and do my bidding before I change my mind about letting you live.

title: Return of the Lich Hunter
obj_text: Return to Frenzyheart Hill and speak to Elder Harkek.
desc_text: Okay, I going back to Frenzyheart Hill to make sure all Frenzyheart know what you done for wolvar and for Zepik. You great hunter and they dumb to think you not.$BGo back to hill and talk to Elder Harkek... I make sure he knows you not traitor before any other Frenzyheart.$BThank you, Lich Hunter.

title: Aerial Surveillance
obj_text: Professor Calvert wants you to take the flight to Lakeside Landing and speak with Pilot Vic there.
desc_text: You did a good job helping Wes with getting that flying machine back up and running.$BIf you'd like to help us further, there is an unusual weather pattern coming in from the northeast.  I have a pilot ready to work for me, but I'm afraid he needs a copilot.$BIf you think you're up to it, you can take the flight to Lakeside Landing.  Tell Vic I sent you.

title: Return of the Friendly Dryskin
obj_text: Return to Rainspeaker Canopy and speak to High-Oracle Soo-say.
desc_text: Yay! Soo-say probably worrying about us! Maybe you go back to town and tell him everything okay? Yeah, go tell Soo-say.$BI going grab shiny ball thing from dead lich guy - I meet you there! Go go! I meet you there!

title: You Reap What You Sow
obj_text:
Slay the Drained Prophet of Quetz'lun and then inform Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.
 Drained Prophet of Quetz'lun slain
desc_text: This is what it has come down to... revenge.$B<Har'koa sighs.>$BTake this ritual kit and enact it near Quetz'lun's corpse upon her altar. If everything works properly, her spirit should be drawn into the material world where she will be able to reclaim her power from the prophet.$BThe rest will be up to you, <name>. You must slay the prophet in his drained state.

title: One Last Thing
obj_text: Deliver the Underworld Power Fragments to Har'koa and beseech her for a portion of her spirit. You will still find her at the Altar of Har'koa.
desc_text: There is one last thing that is needed to enact the final revenge against my prophet. The power fragments you collected must be imbued with a portion of a living gods' spirit. You're going to need to beseech Har'koa for some of hers.$BOnce you've done that, when you return here, you will not come to the underworld. Instead, you will return to the physical world of my altar. My children and guardians will no longer attack you, and you'll be able to get to my prophet without having to worry about them.

title: Burning to Help
obj_text:
Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost wants you to take 5 Hydra Sputum Samples and kill 5 Bittertide Hydra.
 Sputum Samples Collected (5)
 Bittertide Hydra slain (5)
desc_text: There's no more caustic material in all of the basin than bittertide hydra sputum. I've got special containers to collect just such a thing for Archmage Pentarus' studies. Now all I need is a brave, um... collector.$BYou look like a hardy, adventurous <class>. How'd you like to make a bit of money and aid Dalaran's cause at the same time?$BAll you need to do is take this container with you to Bittertide Lake, to the southwest. Engage the hydra and use the container to sample the sputum they shower you with.

title: Reagent Agent
obj_text: ring 5 Twisted Roc Claws to Colvin Norrington at Dorian's Outpost.
desc_text: That Archmage Pentarus, back in Dalaran, will be expecting us to return with all kinds of reagents and talismans. It seems the locals are fond of animal parts. Twisted claws from the goretalon rocs are among their favorite.$BIt's not my place to say whether the rumors are true or not, but I've a feeling there's something here.$BThe rocs live in the Bonefields off to the northeast, where they feed on the corpses of old mammoths. Will you help me gather talons for the archmage's research?

title: Blood of a Dead God
obj_text: Har'koa has asked you to collect 7 Blood of Mam'toth. Return them to her at the Altar of Har'koa.
desc_text: Mam'toth, the god of the mammoths, destroyed himself, and took much of his temple with him, rather than allowing his trolls to gain his power.$BIf I'm to sacrifice a portion of my spirit, I will need something with which to bolster myself.$BMam'toth left behind an enormous crater to the northeast, just north of the Altar of Quetz'lun. Within the crater his blood yet lives.$BBring it to me.

title: Enchanted Tiki Warriors
obj_text:
Element-Tamer Dagoda at Zim'Torga has asked you to destroy 12 Enchanted Tiki Warriors.
 Enchanted Tiki Warriors destroyed (12)
desc_text: I know that you're headed up to the Zol'Maz Stronghold to the northeast, <class>. While you're there, I need you to deal with the warlord's special guardians.$BThe enchanted tiki warriors, as they're called, represent a very real threat. If the Drakkari were to mass produce them, we'd quickly be overrun.$BLet's you and I demonstrate that they're not worth the effort to create, shall we?

title: Appeasing the Great Rain Stone
obj_text: High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to take a companion to dig up and collect 6 Shiny Treasures.$BBe sure to speak to High-Oracle Soo-say in Rainspeaker Canopy about securing the aid of one of your previous companions.
desc_text: Since mosswalker been attacked I worried maybe we not good to Great Rain Stone... we maybe too greedy. We need more treasures to offer!$BYou good at finding shinies last time... maybe you go look more around village for shinies? You maybe need one of good Rainspeakers for help. Just tell us who.

title: An Embarassing Incident
obj_text: Look for Vic's Keys inside the lake at River's Heart.
desc_text: There's one little problem we have to solve before we head out.  You see, I can't seem to find the keys to my flying machine.$BI've looked pretty much everywhere for them... maybe you can give me a hand.  Only place I haven't looked yet is inside the lake.$BI'll even give you my very own air tank.  It's almost empty, but it's got a couple of hits left.

title: Chicken Party!
obj_text: Capture 12 Chicken Escapees for Elder Harkek at Frenzyheart Hill.
desc_text: I bet you not guess what happen again.$BNope, not Goregek or chickens.$BOkay, I lie. Goregek let chickens out again. Dumb Goregek and rumbly belly.$BLet me know if you need help from any of the hunters... they around here somewhere.

title: Hexed Caches
obj_text: Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga has asked you to acquire 12 Zol'Maz Stronghold Caches.
desc_text: Pardon me, <name>. I'm given to understand that you might be heading northeast up to the Zol'Maz Stronghold. Such a trip presents a great opportunity for us to conclude our Drakkari goods gathering.$BAs I have come to know, the Drakkari warlord is extremely paranoid. He's had all of his caches at the stronghold hexed with dire magic. Rumor has it that his tiki warriors carry the cure, but who can say?$BIf you could find the time to acquire some of those goods, I would be most appreciative.

title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Yggdras!
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Yggdras! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BYggdras Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand. These trolls are dirtier than ogres; but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Zul'Drak, pal.$BYou're new to this racket, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?

title: Rampage
obj_text:
Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to free Akali and then to inform Witch Doctor Khufu at Zim'Torga.
 $BAkali unfettered from his chains.
desc_text: <name>, there is no time left. You must take the key and use it to unlock Akali.$BHe is being held in the courtyard in front of Gundrak, the capital of Zul'Drak. Akali's chains are secured by four anchor points. You must unlock each of them to set the rhino god free.$BGundrak is teeming with ice trolls. However, I believe that if you're careful, you should be able to slip in without too much danger.$BOnce you're done, please inform the witch doctor.

title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Magnataur!
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Stinkbeard! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BStinkbeard Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: This next match is a doozy, buddy! Apparently some magnataur from the Dragonblight wants a piece of the action. You ever fought one of those before? All I can tell you is to aim high!$BWe'll get this party started when you give me the word.

title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Tuskarrmageddon!
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Orinoko Tuskbreaker! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BOrinoko Tuskbreaker Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: This next one's fightin' from a dark place, kid. The kind of dark that can only happen when you've been on the flip-side. He's hungry and willing to do whatever it takes to win. Watch yourself! I've heard he wrestles yetis for exercise!$BWe'll start when you're ready.

title: Salvaging Life's Strength
obj_text:
The Avatar of Freya wants you to go to the Sundered Shard to the southeast and use the Lifeforce Gem on 8 destroyed Lifeblood Elementals.
 Lifeblood Energy Recovered (8)
desc_text: The Lifeblood Pillar was toppled over with great force, sending the very earth into an upheaval.$BThe elementals that wander the sundered shard carry with them the very life essence that gave the pillar its strength.  I cannot allow this energy to be wasted, for only four pillars remain.$BHead to the sundered shard, to the southeast, and seek the lifeblood elementals.$BUse this gem on their remains to recover their rampant energy.  We'll need the energy to heal the land when all this is over.

title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: From Beyond!
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat one of the elemental lords! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BElemental Lord Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: I'm not gonna lie to you, pal. You might be overmatched here. This next one is a being from the elemental planes! I don't even know what's gonna show up in that arena!$BIf you think you're up to it, get in there and give 'em hell!

title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Korrak the Bloodrager!
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Korrak the Bloodrager! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BKorrak the Bloodrager Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: You're not gonna believe this, pal. Your next fight is against Korrak the Bloodrager! Looks like the Drakkari trolls are pulling a power play! And let me tell you, buddy, he's been sippin' the animal god juice. He's good and ready to pound you into the ground.$BAre you ready?

title: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Yggdras!
obj_text:
Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Yggdras! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.
 $BYggdras Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: I was wondering when you'd show up, <name>! Having a past champion of the Ring of Blood here will be a huge draw! We're gonna be rich, buddy! RICH!$BAnyway, this dump is Zul'Drak. All the ice trolls seem to use it as a toilet. I dunno, the whole place is off its rocker if you ask me! Who cares, though, right? We're here to make some gold!$BYou know the drill, <name>. When you're ready let me know and we'll get this show on the road!

title: Looking for Survivors
obj_text:
Help Zak Wobblesprocket complete the Test Flight.
 $BTest Flight
desc_text: Gretchen Fizzlespark wants to use my flying machine to look for survivors from her expedition.  Apparently she thinks they're being held prisoner in the village to the north.$BThe only problem is I don't have a co-pilot.  If you're willing to take it on, I'd be more than happy to teach you a move or two.$BWhat do you say, <name>?  Deal?

title: ZZOLDLost: Widget
obj_text: Repair the whatsit and return it to Timothy Jones at the Jewelcrafting shop in Dalaran.
desc_text: Attached to the bottom of the widget is an invoice that indicates the owner is "Timothy Jones - Jewelershop Name, District Name" in Dalaran.   Perhaps if you fixed it and returned it to him, he would have a reward for you.

title: Discretion is Key
obj_text: Rhonin wants you to go to the Violet Hold in Dalaran and speak with Warden Alturas.
desc_text: Listen to me, <race>.$BIt's just been brought to my attention that there's been an incident at the Violet Hold. It would appear that the blues are launching a full scale invasion of Dalaran!$BI need you to get to the prison and speak with Warden Alturas at once. He'll give you the details.$BThat is not all. I need this handled with utmost discretion. We mustn't alarm the citizens of Dalaran if it can possibly be avoided. Do I make myself clear?$BVery well. Now, go!

title: Aerial Surveillance
obj_text: Professor Calvert wants you to take the flight to Lakeside Landing and speak with Pilot Vic there.
desc_text: You did a good job helping Wes with getting that flying machine back up and running.$BIf you'd like to help us further, there is an unusual weather pattern coming in from the northwest.  I have a pilot ready to work for me, but I'm afraid he needs a copilot.$BIf you think you're up to it, you can take the flight to Lakeside Landing.  Tell Vic I sent you.

title: The Champion's Call!
obj_text: Seek out Gurgthock at the Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.
desc_text: Pfft, what happens down here ain't fightin'. It's a couple of guys dancin' around a flag.$BYou lookin' for some real action, buddy? 'Cause if you are I got the hottest ticket in town.$BEver heard of Gurgthock and Wodin? Goblin and troll who ran the Ring of Blood back in Outland? Well they're here in Northrend and they've started up a whole new fight club over in Zul'Drak. If you're interested go to Zul'Drak, east of Crystalsong. They're at the big arena in the center. Tell 'em Shifty sent ya!

title: The Gods Have Spoken
obj_text: Deliver the Unblemished Heart of the Guardian and the Gusty Essence of the Warden to Har'koa at Zim'Torga.
desc_text: The gods have spoken and we must heed their wisdom.$BGather friends to your side, <name>. Take them north to Zim'Rhuk to destroy guardians there until they yield the unblemished heart. Take them east to the Altar of Quetz'lun and disrupt the altar wardens until you recover their gusty essence.$BDeliver both to Har'koa and she will combine them into that which will compel late Akali's prophet to appear.

title: Tails Up
obj_text:
Chronicler To'kini at Zim'Torga wants you to use To'kini's Blowgun on Frost Leopards and Icepaw Bears. Return to him with 3 females of each.
 Female Frost Leopards recovered (3)
 Female Icepaw Bears recovered (3)
desc_text: Along with the Drakkari artifacts, I'm interested in returning to Zandalar with some of the Zul'Drak wildlife. I have males of both the frost leopards and icepaw bears, but I need females!$BToo bad that my trapper was killed in a most unfortunate accident. Perhaps you would be willing to fill in for him?$BPut the leopards and bears to sleep with this blowgun then lift their tails and return with some females if you would be so kind. They can be found near the Altars of Rhunok, Quetz'lun, and Har'koa.

title: Song of Wind and Water
obj_text:
Soo-nee wants you to use the Tempest Drums at the Stormwright's Shelf and help Haiphoon devour 3 Storm Revenants and 3 Aqueous Spirits.
 Aqueous Spirit devoured (3)
 Storm Revenant devoured (3)
desc_text: Listen to storm, yes?  The Stormwright's Shelf echoes with ancient song.... the Song of Wind and Water.$BThe great tempest devours the sons of typhoons and storms.  Take this drum and play his song... play Haiphoon's song.$BHelp him feed on wind and water so tempest can continue.

title: Containment
obj_text:
Warden Alturas wants you to enter the Violet Hold and put and end to the blue dragon invasion force. You are to report back to him once Cyanigosa is slain.
 $BCyanigosa Slain

 Cyanigosa
 Cyanigosa - Heroic
$B

 Cyanigosa - Mythic
desc_text: Here is the prison key.$BMy men and I will stay here as a last line of defense in the event that you are unable to overcome the assault.$BBe sure to speak with Lieutenant Sinclari. She'll provide you with access to the prison's defenses.$BHurry, <race>. There is little time. The few I left inside won't last long without your help. Report back to me once the invasion forces have been successfully dealt with.

title: Eggs for Dubra'Jin
obj_text: Ha'wana at Dubra'Jin needs you to collect 12 Gundrak Raptor Eggs.
desc_text: How ya doin', mon? Thinkin' ya might be helpin' me out? Bah'Kini be needin' lots o' the raptor eggs to be sacrificin' to Dubra'Jin.$BHow ya thinkin' we not be overrun yet by the Drakkari? Dubra'Jin be lendin' us his aid!$BWe need ya to gather up the raptor eggs from around the trees outside here in Gundrak. Sometimes the raptors carry 'em to keep 'em warm, too.

title: Everfrost
obj_text: You are to return to Dun Niffelem and ask Calder about the piece of Everfrost.
desc_text: This piece of ice has been submitted to immense pressures and exposed to natural magics from deep beneath the world's surface. In combination, these effects have yielded an ice that will never melt.$BKnowing little of these things, you resolve to bring the sample back to Dun Niffelem. Someone there is bound to be familiar with its properties.

title: Rejek: First Blood
obj_text:
lood Rejek's Blade on the corpses of a Sapphire Hive Wasp, a Hardknuckle Charger, and 3 members of the Mistwhisper Tribe. You may blood the sword on either Mistwhisper Oracles or Mistwhisper Warriors. Return to Rejek at Frenzyheart Hill when your task is complete.
 Blade blooded on Sapphire Hive Wasp
 Blade blooded on Hardknuckle Charger
 Blade Blooded on Mistwhisper members (3)
desc_text: Rejek just became youngest warrior in all of Frenzyheart tribe. Father gave Rejek a mighty sword to defeat Frenzyheart enemies, but old tradition say sword need to be blooded first. Older warrior usually do that. You do this honor for Rejek?$BTake blade, put in corpses of all Frenzyheart foes: wasps and hardknuckles to southwest, and the big-tongues. Maybe blood blade on Mistwhispers, far to northwest near Bittertide Lake.

title: To the Rise with all Due Haste!
obj_text: Report to Lord-Commander Arete at Death's Rise in Icecrown.
desc_text: Some would say that our most critical mission lies not with the Lich King, but with the utter destruction of the Scarlet Onslaught. I would say that is foolish, but who am I to judge?$BDeath's Rise is far to the southwest, overlooking the sea along the cliff wall. There you will find Lord-Commander Arete personally overseeing the Onslaught's destruction himself.$B<The baron clears his throat.>$BDo see to it that you report to him with all due haste. He asked for you personally.

title: A Cleansing Song
obj_text:
Soo-nee, at the Rainspeaker Canopy, wants you to play the Cleansing Chime at Bittertide Lake, Wintergrasp River and River's Heart and slay the evil spirits that plague the waters there.
 Spirit of Atha slain
 Spirit of Ha-Khalan slain
 Spirit of Koosu slain
desc_text: Earth in Sholazar is pure.  The pillars have protected the land for centuries.$BWater, not as pure, it comes from outside Sholazar.... from oceans, from lakes, from rivers.  Water sometimes bring bad spirits - need to be cleansed.$BYou take this chime and play at Bittertide Lake, Wintergrasp River and River's Heart.  It make bad spirit angry... and then you must kill it.

title: The Heartblood's Strength
obj_text: ring a vial of Suntouched Heartblood to Rejek at Frenzyheart Hill.
desc_text: One day, Rejek will be mighty warrior. Blood and skyfire will make Rejek strong. You see soon.$BRejek give you vial, you take to very top of Suntouched Pillar, far to west. Put waters there in vial.$BThen go to north edge of basin, to ledge north of Bonefields. You find and kill goretalon matriarch. Take heartblood.$BYou combine heartblood and water, bring to Rejek. Rejek drink, make strong.

title: Song of Reflection
obj_text:
Soo-nee at Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to use the Didgeridoo of Contemplation at the top of the Glimmering Pillar, the Suntouched Pillar, the Mosslight Pillar and the Skyreach Pillar.
 Contemplation at Glimmering Pillar
 Contemplation at Mosslight Pillar
 Contemplation at Skyreach Pillar
 Contemplation at Suntouched Pillar
desc_text: Of course you not as smart as gorloc!  You just simple <race>.$BYou not without hope, though!  You show you can learn.  Maybe crystals make you smart like crystals make us smart!$BI teach you to play song to clear your mind.  You play song by crystals then crystals make your mind better... not as good as gorloc's but better than you have now.  Lifeblood Pillar is broken, but other pillars still good!

title: Song of Fecundity
obj_text:
Soo-nee at Rainspeaker Canopy wants you to go to the Stormwright's Shelf, northwest of the Maker's Perch, and play the Horn of Fecundity near 8 piles Soaked Fertile Dirt.
 Song of Fecundity played (8)
desc_text: The storm is a destructive force.  Storm burns trees.  Storm floods houses.$BBut storm can also be life force if you know right song.  In Stormwright Shelf, above Maker's Perch, you can find small dirt mounds.  They very fertile -- they carry inside a strong seed.  All they wait for is the right song.$BYou take this horn and play song for them.

title: The Key of Warlord Zol'Maz
obj_text: Har'koa at Zim'Torga has asked you to acquire the Key of Warlord Zol'Maz.
desc_text: <name>, we need a key to unlock the chains of the rhino god, Akali. Even now he is being prepared for the slaughter.$BThe Drakkari warlord, Zol'Maz, carries the key. Hearing of your exploits, he has secluded himself and his family at their stronghold up the steps to the northeast.$BThe warlord is strong and you will need help. If you were to combine the tiki, sword and incantation of his family members, you would be able to summon such help as you challenge him before his home's gate.

title: The Story Thus Far...
obj_text:
Listen to Lord-Commander Arete's tale at Death's Rise.
 $BLord-Commander Arete's tale listened to.
desc_text: We have much to do, but first I believe a short refresher is in order.$BWe death knights have a colorful past with our Scarlet friends who idiotically rest comfortably in the harbor below us to the northwest.$BWhen you are ready for an earful, speak with me again and I shall provide enlightenment.

title: A Hero's Headgear
obj_text: Get Venture Co. Explosives from any of the Venture Company units at Swindlegrin's Dig and use them to obtain a Stormwatcher's Head. Bring the Stomwatcher's Head to Rejek at Frenzyheart Hill.
desc_text: Rejek hears tales of giant metal men on faraway Stormwright's Shelf. Far to northwest, outside basin's lip, you will find it.$BImagine Rejek using heads of giant metal men as helmet. Make Rejek unstoppable! Make Rejek mighty!$BYou get for Rejek, but metal head might not come off metal body easy. Maybe steal bombs from little green men and their friends at Swindlegrin's Dig near Suntouched Pillar? Use bombs to get head off metal body, then bring to Rejek.

title: You'll Need a Gryphon
obj_text:
Deliver an Onslaught Gryphon to Uzo Deathcaller at Death's Rise.
 Onslaught Gryphon delivered to Uzo Deathcaller
desc_text: What could be more fitting than to take one of their own gryphons to use against them? Go to Onslaught Harbor and take the reins to one of their gryphons from the dead clutches of its rider.$BReturn with the gryphon, delivering it to Uzo Deathcaller. He will see to its proper transformation and provide you with further instructions.

title: From Their Corpses, Rise!
obj_text:
Setaal Darkmender at Death's Rise has given you the Darkmender's Tincture. Apply it to the corpses of 10 of any of the Scarlet Onslaught units found at Onslaught Harbor.
 Scarlet Onslaught corpse transformed (10)
desc_text: How kind... how generous our lord-commander is. Where he is flowers and sunshine, I am filled only with hatred.$BIt is not enough to end their miserable lives... I want them humiliated... debased!$BWhat could be more unspeakable than to be turned into that which you hate? To dedicate your existence to eradicating a thing, and then in the end to become it?$BHow sad.$BTake this tincture northwest to Onslaught Harbor. Apply it to their still corpses and watch what happens, but avoid the cathedral.

title: Blood in the Water
obj_text:
Lord-Commander Arete at Death's Rise wants you to fill the Gore Bladder with the blood of 10 Ravenous Jaws.
 Blood collected from Ravenous Jaws (10)
desc_text: The forces at Onslaught Harbor are heavily reinforced by gryphon riders. You need a mount that will enable you to put them down. But first, we need the components for the ritual that is going to make it all happen.$BA great deal of blood is necessary for the ritual to be undertaken.$B<The lord-commander points down and to the northwest.>$BThere is a readily available supply down there in the harbor... sharks. Do not return to me until you've filled this bladder with their blood.

title: No Fly Zone
obj_text:
Uzo Deathcaller at Death's Rise wants you to kill 10 Onslaught Gryphon Riders.
 Onslaught Gryphon Rider slain (10)
desc_text: Now that you got your bone gryphon, I wantcha to take it back down there everyday and make a no fly zone over Onslaught Harbor.$BI gotta admit, mon, I don't really care if you use the bone gryphon to kill them gryphon riders or not. But I'm guessin' that if you do, you'll find it much easier to get to 'em.$BBesides, it's got lots of neat tricks you can use.

title: Intelligence Gathering
obj_text: Aurochs Grimbane at Death's Rise wants you to collect 5 Onslaught Intel Documents.
desc_text: I need to know what the Scarlet Onslaught is planning today. You will be my instrument in this task.$BFly to Onslaught Harbor and rifle through their baggage trunks for documents. The trunks will be locked, so you'll have to take the keys from the Scarlet Onslaught members by whatever means.

title: In Strict Confidence
obj_text:
Lord-Commander Arete at Death's Rise wants you to beat information out of Captains Welsington and Hartford.
 Captain Welsington beaten for information and killed
 Captain Hartford beaten for information and killed
desc_text: If anyone knows where the admiral is, then surely it must be his captains on the ships in Onslaught Harbor.$B<The lord-commander rubs his hands together.>$BWelsington and Hartford are their names if memory serves. Go beat the information out of them and then end their miserable lives.$BI want to know where the grand admiral is hidden!

title: Going Bearback
obj_text:
rijana at Brunnhildar Village wants you to mount Icefang and shoot 7 Frostworgs and 15 Frost Giants in the Valley of Ancient Winters.
 Frostworgs Burned (7)
 Frost Giants Burned (15)
desc_text: The test awaits, woman!$BDo you have the heart of a warrior queen? Or that of a sniveling seamstress?$BOne taste of war and you'll know the answer.$BYou might lie to your mother, your sisters, and even yourself, but the battlefield always exposes one's true nature.$BWhen you've made your preparations, mount Icefang and ride into battle. From her back, you must rain down a shower of death upon our enemy.

title: The Grand (Admiral's) Plan
obj_text: Deliver the Note from the Grand Admiral to Lord-Commander Arete at Death's Rise.
desc_text: At first this note looks like any of the other intel that you've been looking for. However, a quick perusal of its contents disabuses you of this notion.$BThe letter conveys that Grand Admiral Westwind is present somewhere on the island, but that he is keeping himself secluded for now. He speaks of a glorious day that is coming soon in which the Scarlet Onslaught will wash over first the Lich King and then the rest of world to finally bring order to Azeroth.$BThe lord-commander will want to see this!

title: The Battle For Crusaders' Pinnacle
obj_text:
Venture to Crusaders' Pinnacle and use the Blessed Banner of the Crusade atop the Pile of Crusader Skulls. Defend the banner against Scourge attack until the land atop the pinnacle is sanctified and then return to Father Gustav at the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.
 $BBattle for Crusaders' Pinnacle
desc_text: <Highlord Fordring holds a banner of the Argent Crusade.>$BThis banner is like no other, <name>. It carries with it a powerful blessing, able to sanctify large tracts of blighted land.$BYou must take it northwest, through the Breach, to an area the Scourge have mockingly named Crusaders' Pinnacle. Plant the banner atop the skulls of our fallen brethren at Crusaders' Pinnacle and defend it against attack. Once the land is sanctified, return to Father Gustav.$BGo now, <name>. Hold no fear in your heart.

title: Cold Hearted
obj_text:
rijana, just east of Brunnhildar Village, wants you to fly to Dun Niffelem, then free 3 Captured Proto-Drakes and rescue 9 Brunnhildar Prisoners.
 Rescued Brunnhildar Prisoners (9)
 Freed Proto-Drakes (3)
desc_text: To be slain honorably on the field of battle brings us all glory. To be frozen in a block of ice and endlessly taunted does not....$BYou are to fly to the frost giant city of Dun Niffelem, just east of the Valley of Ancient Winters, and liberate a captive proto-drake. With her, you will be able to free our sisters from their frozen bonds and carry three of them safely home.$BBeware the giants' clubs, sister, lest you find yourself numbered among the captives.

title: The Admiral Revealed
obj_text:
Lord-Commander Arete wants you to deal with Grand Admiral Westwind. Return to the lord-commander upon Death's Rise after you have done so.
 Grand Admiral Westwind dealt with
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: When High General Abbendis was confronted at New Hearthglen, the grand admiral protected himself within an impenetrable sphere of magic before making his escape.$BI am particularly adept at nullifying magic.$BTake this to use against him inside The Hidden Hollow when he puts the sphere up. I wish that I could be there to see the look on his face when you do it.$BDeal with him.

title: The Drakkensryd
obj_text:
Use the Hyldnir Harpoon to defeat 10 Hyldsmeet Drakeriders at the Temple of Storms.  Use the Hyldnir Harpoon on a Column Ornament to exit the Drakkensryd and speak to Thorim when you've succeeded.
 Hyldsmeet Drakerider Defeated (10)
desc_text: This is it.  You've passed all the tests of the Hyldsmeet... all but one.  You've risen among our sisters' best and fiercest.$BThe final test is at hand.  The Drakkensryd - the true test of a Hyldnir's worth and warrior spirit.  It'll be you, your riding drake, a chained harpoon and a score of your sisters vying for dominance.$BShow no quarter.  None will be expected.

title: The Prototype Console
obj_text: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
desc_text: Designation SCRAP-E.$BDirective: Maintain consoles and databases of Inventor's Library in Keeper Mimir's absences.$BTime since last maintenance cycle: 489 days.$BStatus of schematic data: unknown.$BCurrent tasks: Repair prototype console.

title: Second Chances
obj_text:
Kill Archbishop Landgren and then summon Arete's Gate in the presence of his corpse. Speak with Lord-Commander Arete inside The Crimson Cathedral once he's completed his questioning of the archbishop's spirit.
 Archbishop Landgren slain
 Arete's Gate summoned
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: I'd heard they have an archbishop in their cathedral, but I had no idea that they'd resurrected and promoted Landgren! The Crimson Cathedral is heavily guarded with only one entrance, so you'll need help.$BWe still need to know where the grand admiral is, but this time we're not taking any chances!$BTake this device. It can be used to summon a gate for me to step through once you've killed the archbishop.$BI'll have my answers directly from his compelled soul! We will find Grand Admiral Westwind!

title: If He Cannot Be Turned
obj_text:
Defeat General Lightsbane and then report your success back to Koltira Deathweaver aboard the gunship, Orgrim's Hammer.
 General Lightsbane slain
desc_text: Death knights, such as General Lightsbane, are held on too tight of a leash to be able to be turned from the Lich King's will except under the most extraordinary circumstances.$BThe general keeps himself within the vault overseeing the creation of new weapons. Disturb one of his weapon racks at the northern forge and I assure you, he will come. I'll send Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper in to help you.$BIf we are to finally own The Shadow Vault, General Lightsbane must fall!

title: Wooly Justice
obj_text:
Scalper Ahunae at Zim'Torga wants you to use the Medallion of Mam'toth to calm and ride an Enraged Mammoth. You are then to trample 12 Mam'toth Disciples to death.
 Mam'toth Disciples trampled to death (12)
desc_text: Ahunae hear about your trip to Mam'toth Crater, mon. The children of Mam'toth are enraged and cry out for justice!$BFollow the avenue northeast up the steps to the next tier of Zul'Drak. On your right you will find what's left of the Altar of Mam'toth.$BWhen you get there, flash this Medallion of Mam'toth in front of the eyes of one of the enraged mammoths. It'll calm down for a little while, letting you hop on its back.$BRide it around, trampling all of the Mam'toth disciples that you can find!

title: The Shadow Vault
obj_text: Report back to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
desc_text: It sounds like you did extremely well. And you secured three very important allies for the Knights of the Ebon Blade in the process.$B<Koltira gazes down at the map on the floor.>$BYou should head back. By now, Baron Sliver and the other death knights will be fighting tooth and nail to hold The Shadow Vault against the might of the Scourge.$BI'm sure they'll need your help.

title: Free Your Mind
obj_text:
aron Sliver at the Shadow Vault wants you to use the Sovereign Rod on the corpses of Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper.
 Vile turned
 Lady Nightswood turned
 The Leaper turned
desc_text: Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper would make excellent weapons in the fight against the Lich King if they can be broken from his will. That is what the Sovereign Rod is for.$BYou'll find them on the ledges to the east and west of the vault, as well as on the mid-tier of the vault above us. The rod is to be used upon the corpses of the three.$BFly now. We will have them as our own!

title: Sniffing Out the Perpetrator
obj_text:
Mount Frostbite and ride her to the source of the scent from Brann's note. Then, recover Brann's Communicator and use it to make contact with Brann Bronzebeard.
 Track scent to its source
 Tracker Thulin slain
desc_text: oktar can have his way this time, but I'll expect him to make it up to me. Don't look at me like that. Boktar may be in command, but no one tells a hunter what to do.$B'Put that beast away,' he says. 'Make it stop growling.'$BAll of a sudden he changes his mind when it suits him. Next time he complains, Frostbite'll just nip him a bit. Don't worry, she'll do an admirable job tracking your prey. After she locates her target, you're on your own to deal with iron dwarves, or Brann, or whatever you find.

title: Kill Credit Test
obj_text:
/wave at Kill Credit Test
 Working
desc_text: /wave at me and I'll assign 'kill credit to player' to you.

title: The Nose Knows
obj_text: Speak with Khaliisi at the foot of the mountain east of the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
desc_text: In order to track down Brann, we're going to need a creature with a keen sense of smell and a good tracking ability. There weren't any hounds on the zeppelin, but I think I have a substitute.$BAfter the crash, I sent Khaliisi down the east face of the mountain to start hunting for food. Her cat, Frostbite, excels at tracking prey in the snow. Tell her that she'll have to part with her companion for a while, at least. She can hunt on her own, but we have no other way of catching up to Brann Bronzebeard.

title: It's All Fun and Games
obj_text:
Destroy The Ocular and then report to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
 The Ocular has been destroyed
desc_text: The Knights of the Ebon Blade want to take the Scourge base known as The Shadow Vault to the northwest. I have a contact in their group who has asked for help.$BThe first step is to blind the Lich King. He's using a device known as The Ocular to watch the area, which floats above the vault's spires.$BOur goblins have created something for you to use against it. After the 'eye' has been destroyed, find Baron Sliver on the vault grounds. He's pretending to still be under the Lich King's will.

title: The Missing Bronzebeard
obj_text: Retrieve the Burlap-Wrapped Note from Brann's camp and return it to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
desc_text: efore we left, I received the file Scout Vor'takh compiled on this Brann Bronzebeard. There can be no doubt that Brann was headed for the Storm Peaks from his journal entries and findings in Grizzly Hills. Before we crashed, I caught sight of a campsite south of here, across the Foot Steppes, and overlooking the frozen Bor's Breath River.$BIf Brann isn't there, search the camp and its environs for any clues as to where that blasted dwarf might've gone. Bring back anything you find.

title: Strength of the Tempest
obj_text: Gather 3 Essences of the Monsoon and 3 Essences of the Storm and take them to the Shrine of the Tempest. Return to Rejek at Frenzyheart Hill with the True Power of the Tempest.
desc_text: Silly big-tongues think singing to the clouds give them power. Rejek show big-tongues how to get power by taking it!$BFar to northwest, there is large, flat area the big-tongues call 'Stormwright's Shelf.' Rejek is sure you can only get there by flying like bird.$BOn this shelf, Rejek has heard of mighty forces of wind and water. Kill them for their badness, then take it to the big-tongue 'Shrine of the Tempest' at shelf's western side. Rejek will await your return with ultimate power.

title: Speak Orcish, Man!
obj_text: Speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
desc_text: <Brann begins gesticulating wildly and rambling in his native language.>$BRuk MogOth red a mogoth ta eft Thros-garE Haldir.$BKha gor ruk khaz ta ke ruk hrim eft thros-am-kha ruk kost-um havar go kost.$BA modoss hine ruk bergum eft thros-am-kha ga eft Haldir ke loch Thon we lo gefrunon ta mitta.$BGar Ruk dagUm loch angor-magi ta har ruk!$B<After a few moments, you realize the conversation is going nowhere. Perhaps the shaman, Moteha Windborn, at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site will know what to do.>

title: Making a Harness
obj_text: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to obtain 3 Icemane Yeti Hides.
desc_text: So you want to ride?  Well, if you've made it this far someone must think you've got a shot at the Hyldsmeet.$BFirst things first; we'll have to make you a harness.$BIn the cliffs to the south, you'll find scattered groups of yeti.  Their hides are tough and just the right thickness.  Bring me some and we'll get you started on the path of the bear-rider.

title: Aberrations
obj_text:
Thyra Kvinnshal in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and obtain Vials of Frost Oil from the Valkyrion Aspirants.  Use the Vials of Frost Oil to destroy 30 Plagued Proto-Drake Eggs.
 Plagued Proto-Drake Egg (30)
desc_text: The Lich King sent emissaries to us on three different occasions.  All three were promptly dismembered.$BOur sisters in Valkyrion were not as dedicated to our traditions and accepted the Scourge's advances.  Now instead of capturing their drakes from the wild, they raise them from the blight and filth that the Scourge wallow in.$BTake the frost oil that the Valkyrion Hyldnir carry on them and use it to freeze any blighted eggs you find.  Rumors speak of a fetid pool of blight where the eggs are kept.

title: Mending Fences
obj_text:
Thorim at the Temple of Storms wants you to Kill Fjorn and 5 Stormforged Iron Giants at Fjorn's Anvil, east of Dun Niffelem.$BUsing Thorim's Charm of Earth will summon his Earthen to fight by your side. The charm requires a Granite Boulder from nearby Fjorn's Anvil.
 Fjorn slain
 Stormforged Iron Giants slain (5)
desc_text: If I hope to wrest control of the Temple of the Makers from my brother, I must make amends with my old allies.$BPerhaps by eliminating a common enemy, we may at least take a step towards renewing my friendship with the frost giants.$BFjorn has besieged Dun Niffelem with giants of iron. You must defeat him at Fjorn's Anvil, far to the east of here, and weaken his forces sufficiently for the Sons of Hodir to emerge victorious.$BTake this charm, <name>. Use it to summon my earthen to your aid.

title: Speaking with the Wind's Voice
obj_text: ring 5 Voices of the Wind to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
desc_text: I suppose we shouldn't have expected to find Brann so easily, not with our luck. If we can make sense of what Brann is saying, you can persuade him to give up his location.$BThe power of the wind is strong in these mountains, and it may prove a great boon to us. A knowledgeable shaman can hear the sound of all the world's tongues on the wind.$BTo the northwest, on the Snowdrift Plains, you will find beings made of wind, the stormriders. Capture their voices and bring them to me.

title: Catching up with Brann
obj_text:
Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and speak with him, then speak to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
 Speak with Brann
desc_text: What are you waiting for? The language barrier has been broken, thanks to Moteha. Contact Brann Bronzebeard and find out anything you can about where he's hiding and what he's chasing after.$BMaybe we can still salvage something from this disaster.

title: Forging an Alliance
obj_text:
You are to go to Dun Niffelem and ask King Jokkum to allow Thorim's armor to be reforged. After completing Jokkum's task, you are to speak with Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.
 Fjorn's Anvil Brought to Dun Niffelem
desc_text: <Thorim, for the first time since your meeting him, smiles.>$BThis is all beginning to have the smell of fate's hand, <race>.$BYour discovery is what remains of my armor, long ago cast off in a fit of grief and left to the elements. Only the sons of Hodir are capable of its reforging, for they are its original creators.$BPerhaps you've done enough to soften their hatred of me. Seek out their king, Jokkum, if he still breathes.$BFind your way into his good graces and plead for his assistance.

title: Pieces of the Puzzle
obj_text: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and find out what to do next.
desc_text: We've seen the iron dwarves and their constructs making war on the creatures of stone that Brann calls the earthen, along with their giant allies. Contact him and aid him in any way you can, and remember that anything we can learn from his search may aid us in fighting against the iron dwarves and their master.

title: Data Mining
obj_text:
Use the Inventor's Disk to retrieve 7 pieces of Hidden Data from the Databanks.
 Hidden Data gathered (7)
desc_text: That disk you assembled... it's blank! Keeper Mimir, the tinker who built this library, must've hidden the information elsewhere. Look around the Inventor's Library; do you see any databanks there?$BThat might be the disk's purpose. Try using it near some of those databanks. Perhaps it's set to retrieve and store information from them. After you've tried your hand at that, contact me again and let me know what you've found. Meanwhile, I'll be trying to track down the other half of the archive key.

title: The Earthen of Ulduar
obj_text: Speak with Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
desc_text: The earthen who once inhabited, built, and maintained Ulduar were ousted from their home when Loken took over the city. Since then, his iron dwarf followers have relentlessly attacked the exiles.$BThey have taken refuge in an old titan building, which they now call Bouldercrag's Refuge, on the face of a mountain west of the Inventor's Library. Bouldercrag and his brethren fight to keep the irons from overrunning their haven, but they cannot hold their ground long. Find and help them, <name>.

title: Fighting Back
obj_text:
ouldercrag the Rockshaper wants you to slay 10 Stormforged Attackers and return to him at Bouldercrag's Refuge. You may kill either Stormforged Raiders or Stormforged Reavers.
 $BStormforged Attacker slain (10)

 Stormforged Reaver
$B

 Stormforged Raider
desc_text: The refuge's defenders have done their best to blunt the iron dwarves' attacks, but we keep losing ground inch by inch. My men are hardy, but not tireless. Without reinforcements, it's only a matter of time until we will be overrun.$BWould you lend your skills to the refuge's defense?
