It would greatly improve the morale of the defenders and give them -- and me -- hope of mounting a counterattack.$BKill any of the stormforged or their creations you encounter outside the refuge.

title: The Refiner's Fire
obj_text: You must collect 10 Furious Sparks from the Seething Revenants at Frostfield Lake and then use the anvil at Fjorn's Anvil.
desc_text: eneath its porous exterior, this hunk of metal gleams with a mysterious quality.$BYou feel it would only be prudent to burn off the slag at Fjorn's Anvil.$BAs you ponder where in this frozen waste you might find something hot enough for the job, a fire revenant crosses your path...

title: Norgannon's Shell
obj_text: Recover Norgannon's Shell from Archivist Mechaton.
desc_text: Charging inventor's disk.$BDisk charging completed.$BPreparing emergency protocol gamma.$BEmergency protocol loaded. Please use the charged disk to activate the guardian of Norgannon's shell, Archivist Mechaton. The archivist will release the shell once your identity has been verified.$BPlease have a pleasant millennium.

title: Relief for the Fallen
obj_text:
Use the Telluric Poultice to heal 8 Fallen Earthen Defenders, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 Fallen Earthen Defenders healed (8)
desc_text: The refuge's defenders fight bravely, but they cannot keep up with the iron onslaught.$BWith the earth you collected, I can make bandages to help heal the wounds of some of the fallen. The more defenders we can patch up, the longer we'll last out there.$BTake these poultices and use them to heal the wounds of the fallen defenders outside the refuge. Get as many back into the battle as possible, <name>. Every casualty is one too many.

title: Off With Their Black Wings
obj_text:
Iva the Vengeful in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and slay 12 Nascent Val'kyr.
 Nascent Val'kyr slain (12)
desc_text: Traitors.  We Hyldnir have little love for them.$BThe dwellers of Valkyrion have gone unpunished for far too long.  While we remained loyal to Thorim, they became the Lich King's lapdogs!$BThey call the ones who receive his gift val'kyr.  They fly on feathered wings, like the harpies they are.$BYou will find Valkyrion far to the northwest, beyond the Temple of Storms.  Slay these winged she-wolves, sister.  Slay them and I will reward you with one of my most prized possessions.

title: Let the Baron Know
obj_text: Speak with Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
desc_text: The most important thing that you can do right now is to return to The Shadow Vault and let Baron Sliver know that I've failed.$BYou see, I wasn't the only one captured by these vrykul devils. My entire contingent of death knights was also taken.$BI should have seen the trap before it was sprung, but there's no use crying over spilled milk now is there?$BGo on before you get captured, too! I'll see you back at the vault.

title: The Duke
obj_text: Speak with Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault.
desc_text: We need you focused, <name>. We're barely holding The Shadow Vault as it is. As you can see, we've greatly angered the Lich King.$B<The baron chuckles.>$BI need you to speak with Duke Lankral. He's in charge here now. You'll find him inside the vault building proper.$BWere I you, I would not keep him waiting.

title: Slaves of the Stormforged
obj_text:
ouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to free 6 Captive Mechagnomes and kill 3 Stormforged Taskmasters.
 Attempt to free Captive Mechagnome (6)
 Stormforged Taskmaster slain (3)
desc_text: To the southwest, on the western side of the Snowdrift Plains, the iron dwarves have dug a mine into the hillside. There, they use captive mechagnomes, servants of Keeper Mimir, to mine ore.$BI don't know where these mechagnomes came from, nor what they would do with their freedom, but perhaps we can win their help.$BGo to the Frozen Mine, <name>, and set these creatures free from their bondage. Ask if they would fight alongside us against iron dwarf tyranny.

title: Honor Challenge
obj_text:
Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault has asked you to use the Challenge Flag to challenge and defeat 6 Mjordin Combatants.
 Mjordin Combatants challenged and defeated (6)
desc_text: The first step we're going to take is at a place in Jotunheim called the Savage Ledge. It's just over the mountains to the west.$BOn the ledge the vrykul warriors are always sparring, being instructed in the finer arts of battle by their thane's men.$BI want you to take this flag and issue a challenge to a number of them. Let's demoralize them with the 'mere' skills of a <race>, shall we?$B<The duke grins, his rotting teeth flashing in the dim light of the vault.>

title: Shadow Vault Decree
obj_text:
Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault has ordered you to read the Shadow Vault Decree in the presence of Thane Ufrang the Mighty, and then to slay him.
 Thane Ufrang the Mighty slain
desc_text: Thane Ufrang the Mighty sits within his hall overlooking the Savage Ledge. I've studied him. The thane is a patient vrykul, with a head for strategy and warfare. He's also shown a penchant for biding his time and not wanting to overplay his hand in the ongoing battle.$BI need him dead!$BI've written a decree. Stand before the thane and read it aloud.$B<The duke arches his eyebrow in amusement.>$BIt should... unnerve him at the least.

title: Valkyrion Must Burn
obj_text:
Use the Valkyrion Harpoon Guns to burn 6 Dry Haystacks.
 Fires Started (6)
desc_text: The crate is filled with incendiary harpoons.  You recall seeing harpoon guns and dry stacks of hay outside.$BPerhaps Iva will appreciate the extra effort and reward you appropriately.

title: The Gifts of Loken
obj_text:
Destroy Loken's Fury, Loken's Power, and Loken's Favor, and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 Loken's Fury destroyed
 Loken's Power destroyed
 Loken's Favor destroyed
desc_text: The one who commands the stormforged iron dwarves is called Runeseer Valduran. Although I have never seen them, it is said that his master, Keeper Loken, who took over Ulduar, has given Valduran powerful titan artifacts.$BIt could explain the strength and ferocity my men see in the stormforged warriors.$BValduran's base, Nidavelir, lies to the southwest, across the Snowdrift Plains. Go there, <name>, and neutralize his power. Destroy these gifts of Loken's and help us to sap the strength of his followers.

title: You Can't Miss Him
obj_text: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to find Njormeld at Fjorn's Anvil.
desc_text: <Jokkum listens patiently to your request, then ponders it carefully before responding.>$BSo it is you we have to thank for Fjorn's demise?$BWhile it's true that you have aided us in our time of need, there is still much that must be done to repair our relations with Thorim.$BFor now, I shall allow Njormeld to reforge the armor we gifted to the Stormlord so many ages ago. Consider it payment for your assistance against Fjorn.$BNjormeld was sent to recover Fjorn's anvil. You should find him there.

title: Eliminate the Competition
obj_text:
The Leaper at The Shadow Vault wants you to duel and defeat Sigrid Iceborn, Efrem the Faithful, Onu'zun and Tinky Wickwhistle.
 Sigrid Iceborn defeated
 Efrem the Faithful defeated
 Onu'zun defeated
 Tinky Wickwhistle defeated
desc_text: Mrrfrmrfrrmrrr...$B<The Leaper clears his throat.>$BSorry about that. It can sometimes be hard to understand what I'm saying. You know how it is.$BI wanted to make sure that if you find yourself at the Savage Ledge, over the mountains to the west, that you make sure to eliminate the competition there.$BSpecifically, I'd like you to challenge to duels and humiliate Sigrid Iceborn, Efrem the Faithful, Onu'zun, and Tinky Wickwhistle in front of the vrykul.

title: A Spark of Hope
obj_text: You are to bring the Refined Gleaming Ore to Thorim in the Temple of Storms.
desc_text: Clearly, this is more than an ordinary hunk of metal.$BUnlike any ore you're familiar with, it is hard but not brittle, far lighter than it looks, and glows even when cool.$BLooking closer, you can make out one of Thorim's runes shining beneath the surface....

title: Get the Key
obj_text: Vaelen the Flayed at Ufrang's Hall has asked you to retrieve the Key to Vaelen's Chains.
desc_text: <class>, the key to my shackles is hanging around the neck of Instructor Hroegar outside.$BPerhaps you could retrieve it by separating his head from his shoulders?

title: Yulda's Folly
obj_text:
Iva the Vengeful at Brunnhildar Village wants you to slay Yulda the Stormspeaker in Valkyrion.
 Yulda the Stormspeaker slain
desc_text: The witch that started it all, Yulda the Stormspeaker came to our very village.  She dared to insult our noble traditions and spouted the Lich King's venomous promises of power.$BShe ought to have left with a sword through her, but her magic was strong and she managed to escape.$BSeek her in Valkyrion inside the largest dwelling and show her that we are not to be trifled with.

title: Is That Your Goblin?
obj_text:
Challenge Agnetta Tyrsdottar in order to save Zeev Fizzlespark.  Return to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village after you've succeeded.
 Agnetta Tyrsdottar slain
desc_text: I trust that's the green little one you've been looking for.  If I were you I'd step in before that Hyldnir splits him in half.$BYou've arrived in the middle of the Hyldsmeet, so all challenges must be accepted by participants.  There's nothing to stop you from taking your green friend's place.

title: You'll Need a Bear
obj_text: Speak to Brijana outside Brunnhildar Village.
desc_text: You've succeeded in the first rounds of the Hyldsmeet.  To advance further, you're going to need a warbear of your own.$BUnfortunately, the Hyldnir don't give them out to just anyone.  You'll have to emerge victorious from true battle, not just gladiatorial combat.$BThe Hyldnir of Brunnhildar are currently involved in a feud against the Sons of Hodir, Thorim's former allies.  Speak to Brijana just outside the village and see how you can help them and prove yourself in the process.

title: Battling the Elements
obj_text:
Njormeld wants you to accompany Snorri to Fjorn's anvil and help him kill 10 Seething Revenants.
 Seething Revenants slain (10)
desc_text: Snorri was once the pride of our nation. A mighty warrior, many an enemy fell to his club.$BWe honor him, though he's no longer what he once was. Age has taken its toll, dulling his senses and sapping his strength. Still, he remains as proud as ever, never missing an opportunity to join a battle.$BSpeaking of battle, we're cooling Fjorn's anvil so it can be taken home. The remaining fire revenants are putting up some resistance. Help Snorri relive his glory days, <race>. Guide him against this enemy.

title: The Hyldsmeet
obj_text:
Listen to Lok'lira the Crone's proposal.
 Listen to Lok'lira's proposal
desc_text: Whether you've noticed or not, by defeating your first Hyldnir in hand-to-hand combat, you've entered the Hyldsmeet -- the great competition of Hyldnir against Hyldnir to determine who will rule by Thorim's side.$BThe Hyldsmeet is the reason why I was imprisoned, for I sought to partake in the competition but was far too old and frail to be a match for the Hyldnir.$BIf you're willing to listen, I've a proposal for you.

title: Taking on All Challengers
obj_text:
Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village wants you to defeat 6 Victorious Challengers.
 Victorious Challenger slain (6)
desc_text: Let's get you started.  The good news is that by defeating Agnetta, you've earned yourself a spot in the next round of matches.$BThe bad news is that all your opponents will also have defeated someone in the first round.  Do not expect pushovers.

title: The Dark Ore
obj_text: ring 5 Ore Samples to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
desc_text: At the Frozen Mine in the western part of the Snowdrift Plains, the stormforged iron dwarves have constructed a mine manned by slaves.$BIt's well behind the lines, so we haven't been able to find out much about what's going on there, but my scouts have reported seeing them remove cartloads of dark, sickly looking ore.

title: Rare Earth
obj_text: Use the Earthen Mining Pick to mine 7 clumps of Enchanted Earth. Bring the earth and 5 Frostweave Cloth to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
desc_text: It seems so long ago that these hammers pounded and hewed stone instead of iron. Our expulsion from Ulduar saw the weakest of us dead and the strongest of our craftsmen reborn as warriors.$BAs the irons beat us back, even the strongest find themselves failing.$BWe can do little for the wounded, save when we have a stock of enchanted earth. We used to mine it from the deposits on the sheer cliff face to the northwest, but the constant battle has prevented us from replenishing our stock. Would you help?

title: A Monument to the Fallen
obj_text: King Jokkum wants you to bring Hodir's Horn Fragments to Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.
desc_text: ring these fragments to Njormeld. He will use the pieces of that sacred relic in the construction of a mighty monument.$BMay it soothe the pains and heal the scars my people have borne these many years.$BMay its presence help to bring about a new age that sees us once again in glorious battle at Thorim's side.$BGo now, <class>. Njormeld awaits you.

title: Facing the Storm
obj_text:
ruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to kill 10 Nidavelir Stormforged. You may kill Stormforged Champions, Stormforged Magi, or Stormforged War Golems.
 $BNidavelir Stormforged slain (10)

 Stormforged Champion
 Stormforged Magus
$B

 Stormforged War Golem
 Bruor Ironbane
desc_text: Like Bouldercrag, I once served the keepers as a craftsman in Ulduar, but with Loken's betrayal, I turned my hammer toward our new foes.$BWhen we could spare the men, I led raids on Nidavelir to relieve the pressure on our defenders, but our lines are near collapse.$BYou've proven yourself a capable combatant and a staunch ally. Perhaps you'd be willing to take up our banner and take the fight to Nidavelir, the iron dwarf stronghold to the southwest, across the Snowdrift Plains.

title: In Memoriam
obj_text: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 8 Horn Fragments from Thunderfall.
desc_text: Surely Thorim has told you of the tragedy that divides us.$BIt was in Thunderfall, northeast of here, that these events unfolded. The frozen fossils there are a reminder of that dark day, as are the spirits that haunt that place.$BIf my people are to forgive Thorim, something must take the place of those images. A memorial must be constructed to bring our hearts peace.$BGo there, <race>. Collect the fragments of Hodir's Horn that was shattered that day.

title: Blowing Hodir's Horn
obj_text:
You are to defeat 5 Niffelem Forefathers and 5 Restless Frostborn at Thunderfall. You are then to blow Hodir's Horn over their corpses, then return to Hodir's Horn in Dun Niffelem.
 Niffelem Forefather freed (5)
 Restless Frostborn freed (5)
desc_text: You have done a great service to the giants of Dun Niffelem. Without your aid, this monument would not exist.$BAs you silently ponder its significance, feelings begin to flood your heart. The feelings fill your mind with thoughts and images... as well as a sense of urgency.$BThe sensations fade and leave you with a knowledge of what you must do. The restless spirits at Thunderfall must be put to rest.$BAs you set off, you find that your hands have been filled with an ethereal horn.

title: I Have an Idea, But First...
obj_text: aron Sliver at The Shadow Vault has asked you to collect a Cultist Rod, an Abomination Hook, a Geist Rope, and 5 Scourge Essences.
desc_text: When I was in the - ahem - employ of the Lich King, we would often use a device known as a sovereign rod to keep some of the more intelligent Scourge in line.$BI require that you assist me in the construction of a new one.$BLuckily for you, all of the necessary components are at hand: a cultist rod, an abomination hook, a geist rope, and a handful of Scourge essences.$BThis should not be difficult, <class>.

title: Ebon Blade Prisoners
obj_text:
Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault wants you to free 8 Ebon Blade Prisoners. They can be found in the cages throughout the greater Jotunheim region.
 Ebon Blade Prisoners set free (8)
desc_text: Now that I'm back, I'm certain that the baron will want me to recover my men. I can see that we're barely hanging on here. The Lich King's forces are about to break through and we won't be able to hold without my captured death knights.$BCan you assist me once more, <name>?$BGo back to Jotunheim and let them out of those cages. Break the damn locks, I don't care what you have to do. The vrykul likely have the keys.$BJust get my men free!

title: The Armor's Secrets
obj_text:
Take the Dark Armor Plate to Mimir's Workshop and ask Attendant Tock to examine it. When you're finished, return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 Armor plate investigated
desc_text: The presence of that armor plate is disorienting, but we need to find out all we can from it. It could be part of one of Valduran's schemes.$BHe's dedicated an extraordinary amount of effort to mining, refining, smithing, and testing this metal.$BTo the east, along the northern mountain face, is a building called Mimir's Workshop. It hasn't been used in quite some time, but if we're lucky, some of its attendants are still functional. Take your armor plate there and learn what you can from it.

title: Hot and Cold
obj_text: You are to go to Frostfield Lake, kill the Brittle Revenants there and use the Essence of Ice on the Smoldering Scraps at Fjorn's Anvil. You are then to collect 6 of the Frozen Iron scraps and return to Fjorn's Anvil in Dun Niffelem.
desc_text: As you stare at the anvil you relive your recent accomplishments, particularly those which brought this artifact to rest here.$BIt suddenly occurs to you that more remains to be done. To the east, smoldering scraps clutter the landscape - shrapnel from the battle fought there.$BIf they could be cooled and gathered somehow, the frost giants would have an abundant supply of metal and the region would be cleared of these remnants of war.

title: Crush Dem Vrykuls!
obj_text:
Vile at The Shadow Vault wants you to slay any 15 vrykul in the greater Jotunheim region.
 $BJotunheim vrykul slain (15)

 Instructor Hroegar
 Thane Ufrang the Mighty
 Mjordin Combatant
 Njorndar Spear-Sister
 Valhalas Vargul
 Apprentice Osterkilgr
 Thane Illskar
$B

 Volgur
 Brita
 Mjordin Water Magus
 Jotunheim Sleep-Watcher
 Kul'galar Oracle
 Jotunheim Warrior
desc_text: Dem vrykuls at the Jotunheim needs to be crushed!$B<name> crush dems good!

title: Armor of Darkness
obj_text: ring 4 Dark Armor Samples to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
desc_text: This armor plate is thick and oversized compared to the rest of the golem's defenses. A quick examination of the golem's corpse reveals that this heavier plate seems to have been bolted on as an afterthought or a crude upgrade.$BWhy would the iron dwarves have added this redundant and mismatched armor to their war golems?$BPerhaps Bruor Ironbane would know if he had the chance to examine several of these plates from stormforged war golems.

title: Valduran the Stormborn
obj_text:
Use Bouldercrag's War Horn when you have found Valduran the Stormborn. Defeat Valduran the Stormborn and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 Valduran the Stormborn slain
desc_text: We have no choice, <name>. What you learned in Mimir's Workshop means that we must act before Valduran can complete and unleash his new weapon.$BEven now, the refuge's defenders fight to buy us time to deal with Valduran the Stormborn.$BYou must go to Nidavelir, across the Snowdrift Plains to the southwest, and then find and face Valduran. But you will not be alone. Bring this war horn with you and sound it as you prepare to face the leader of our enemies. Bruor and I will aid you in this battle.

title: Destroy the Forges!
obj_text:
Destroy the North Lightning Forge, the Central Lightning Forge, and the South Lightning Forge with Bouldercrag's Bombs, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 North Lightning Forge damaged
 Central Lightning Forge damaged
 South Lightning Forge damaged
desc_text: In my folly, I'd thought Valduran's project at Narvir's Cradle, a large construction area to the south, no more than a grotesque monument to "Keeper" Loken's cruelty.$BNow we know the truth, that it was meant to be used as a weapon against us and our allies. We must not allow this iron colossus to reach completion, <name>, for it will mean the end of the refuge.$BGo to Narvir's Cradle, find the lightning forges the stormforged artisans use, and sabotage them.

title: Hit Them Where it Hurts
obj_text:
Kill 10 Stormforged Artificers and return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 Stormforged Artificer slain (10)
desc_text: ouldercrag's got a good plan to stymie the efforts of the iron dwarves at Narvir's Cradle, and I've got an idea of my own. Work on the iron colossus will come to a halt without any artisans.$BNarvir's Cradle is on the south side of the hill sheltering Bouldercrag's Refuge. Go there and slay any stormforged artificers in your path. They may be no different from what we once were, but they build a weapon that threatens us all.

title: The Last of Her Kind
obj_text:
Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to rescue an Icemaw Matriarch in the Hibernal Cavern.
 Icemaw Matriarch Rescued
desc_text: For as long as I can remember, we've obtained our best bears from the Hibernal Cave to the east.$BThose times might finally be gone.  The cave has been overrun by ravenous jormungar and the wild bears are all but extinct.$BIf you were to find a surviving matriarch, however, I would guarantee you that she would fight better than any of these bears born in captivity.$BTake this harness to the Hibernal Cave and rescue a surviving matriarch.  Good luck finding one.

title: The Slithering Darkness
obj_text:
Astrid Bjornrittar wants you to slay 8 Ravenous Jormungar in the Hibernal Cavern east of Brunnhildar Village.
 $BRavenous Jormungar slain (8)

 Ravenous Jormungar
$B

 Ravenous Jormungar
desc_text: The vile jormungar have taken over most of the Hibernal Cavern.  They are despicable beings... children of Loken, Thorim's scumsucker of a brother.$BAs Thorim's servants we owe it to ourselves to kill these scum where we find them.  You'll find the cavern just east of here, outside the village.

title: Mounting Hodir's Helm
obj_text:
Njormeld wants you to fly to the tip of the northern ice spike in Dun Niffelem and use the Tablets of Pronouncement.
 Hodir's Helm Mounted
desc_text: The helm is forged.$BYour efforts have not gone unnoticed, small one. Though there remains much to do, we sons of Hodir are grateful for your accomplishments.$BIn return, I offer you the opportunity to present Hodir's helm to our king and our brethren.$BFly to the sparkling tip of the small ice spike in front of me and read to our people from this tablet.$BEnjoy the privilege, <class>. Never before has an outsider been given such an honor!

title: Leave Our Mark
obj_text:
aron Sliver at The Shadow Vault wishes you to plant 15 Ebon Blade Banners near the corpses of vrykul found within the greater Jotunheim region.
 Ebon Blade Banner planted near vrykul corpse (15)
desc_text: We must attack the vrykul of Jotunheim on many levels. Brute force, of course, is good, but I prefer a more cerebral approach.$BI want you to demoralize them.$BMy men here have forged a number of banners for you. I would like for you to take and plant them near the corpses of fallen vrykul.$BLet the banners serve as a constant reminder to them that they face a more immediate threat than the wrath of the Lich King.

title: The Heart of the Storm
obj_text:
ouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to travel to Uldis and try to prevent Overseer Narvir from obtaining the Heart of the Storm.
 Attempt to secure the Heart of the Storm
desc_text: According to the documents you captured at Narvir's Cradle, the iron colossus is complete except for one key component -- the Heart of the Storm.$BWithout it, the iron colossus' weapons would be much weaker than the design predicts. If we can deny Overseer Narvir the heart, we could defeat the colossus!$BNotes on the documents you found say that the heart is in Uldis, a titan facility far to the south. Its entrance is on the south side of a tall mountain overlooking the Bor's Breath River.

title: Forging a Head
obj_text: Njormeld in Dun Niffelem needs you to use the Diamond Tipped Pick on the Dead Iron Giants at Frostfield Lake and return to him when you have collected 8 Stormforged Eyes.
desc_text: Greetings, <race>.$BI have a task that King Jokkum felt you would be suited for, assuming you still strive to gain favor with our people.$BI have developed plans for another artifact, one that will grant Hodir's blessing of protection to our stronghold. I have nearly all that I require for its construction. All that remains to collect are the very eyes of our fallen enemies.$BTake this tool, and gather the eyes from the iron giant corpses that litter our fields.

title: The Bone Witch
obj_text: Speak with The Bone Witch within the cave at Njorndar Village.
desc_text: You remember Lady Nightswood, don't you? She certainly remembers you. She's the forlorn and very angry banshee that you 'saved' when you also broke Vile and myself out from under the Lich King's dominion.$BThe lady has gone into Jotunheim and possessed their bone witch. She intends to wreak havoc upon the vrykul from within.$BShe has asked that you seek her out. You'll find her in the cave on the south side of Njorndar Village to the southwest within Jotunheim.

title: Spy Hunter
obj_text:
You must defeat 3 Stormforged Spies in the Valley of Ancient Winters.$BUsing the Ethereal Worg's Fang at the Corpse of the Fallen Worg will summon an Ethereal Frostworg, which will expose hidden enemies. You are to return to the Frostworg Denmother in Dun Niffelem when the valley has been cleansed of spies.
 Stormforged Infiltrators Slain (3)
desc_text: The rapport you've developed with the inhabitants of Dun Niffelem has yielded some unexpected discoveries.$BFor example, you somehow find yourself able to understand the denmother's guttural growls and sharp quips - at least you think you do.$BIt would seem that she senses danger outside the stronghold and wants you to do something about it.$BWith her forepaw, she removes the chain from around her neck and lets it drop at your feet. As you pick it up you notice an aged fang attached to it....

title: The Warm-Up
obj_text:
Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch to defeat Kirgaraak.
 Kirgaraak Defeated
desc_text: You've been very fortunate, sister.  This is a matriarch the likes of which hasn't been seen in years.$BA good bear won't do you much good without the skill to ride it.$BI'm going to have you practice some moves on Kirgaraak.  He's the largest yeti we've ever managed to capture so be careful.  Don't be afraid to walk away if he gives you a beating... there's a reason why we keep him chained.

title: Into the Pit
obj_text:
Astrid Bjornrittar, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.
 Hyldsmeet Warbear slain (6)
desc_text: esting a tethered opponent is one thing.  Fighting other bear riders on equal footing is another.$BHead into the Pit of the Fang and use what you've learned to defeat your opponents.  Good luck, sister.$BGlory awaits, should you succeed.

title: Krolmir, Hammer of Storms
obj_text:
Thorim wants you to talk to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem and discover what he knows of Krolmir.
 Krolmir's Fate Discovered
 The Sons of Hodir (Friendly)
desc_text: One task remains before I can reclaim my home at the Terrace of the Makers.$BKrolmir must be found.$BOn that fateful day, I threw it to the earth with all the power and rage I possessed. A mighty explosion followed.$BI've thought it lost for these many years, but now I must be certain.$BReturn to King Jokkum and discover what, if anything, he knows of my hammer's fate.

title: The Iron Colossus
obj_text:
Use a Tamed Jormungar to defeat the Iron Colossus and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
 Iron Colossus slain
desc_text: We have failed to prevent the completion of the iron colossus, <name>, which means we have no choice but to face it in battle.$BBruor has devised a plan to exploit the colossus' only weakness.$BNo matter how tough the colossus' armor is, it is still vulnerable to a jormungar's acid. Take control of one using the orbs along the northern edge of the Snowdrift Plains, then use it to fight the Iron Colossus on the Snowdrift Plains. If you need help controlling the creature, speak to one of the nearby handlers.

title: The Witness and the Hero
obj_text:
Xarantaur, at Camp Tunka'lo, wants you to read the First History Scroll, the Second History Scroll, and the Third History Scroll.
 Read First History Scroll
 Read Second History Scroll
 Read Third History Scroll
desc_text: When I began my travels in Northrend, I visited the Borean Tundra and met the taunka for the first time. There, Wind Tamer Barah told me the tale of Stormhoof and his battle against the North Wind, their people's ancient enemy.$BI set out for the Storm Peaks to learn more of this hero, but strangely, the people of Tunka'lo seem to know nothing of him.$BPerhaps the camp's own records will give us greater insight. Find and read the history scrolls kept throughout the camp, then tell me what you learned.

title: Thrusting Hodir's Spear
obj_text:
You are to use Hodir's Spear to challenge a Wild Wyrm in the Valley of Ancient Winters. Once in its grip, you are to fight to the death.
 Wild Wyrm Slain
desc_text: Hodir's Spear is an icon of great prowess in battle.$BIts mere presence instills a deep hunger for glory in all who enter Dun Niffelem. In fact, simply being near it has compelled you to test your own abilities.$BScanning the horizon, your vision locks on a wild wyrm as it flies nearby.$BIt is decided. Of you and he, only one shall see the next sunrise....

title: The Earthen Oath
obj_text:
Thorim, at the Terrace of the Makers, wants you to use the Horn of the Peaks and call on the Earthen to defeat 20 Iron Dwarves and 7 Iron Sentinels.
 Iron Sentinel slain (7)
 Iron Dwarf Assailant slain (20)
desc_text: For years I neglected my duties, giving into defeat and self-pity.$BNot the brave earthen, however.  Their oath to protect these grounds with their lives has gone unbroken.$BEven now, they fight the corruption of iron with selflessness, waiting for the moment in which the tides turn.$BThat moment has arrived.  We must rally what remains of the earthen defenders and lead them into a glorious victory.  Sound the Horn of the Peaks to call them to your side and take back the Terrace of the Makers.

title: A Colossal Threat
obj_text: Retrieve the Colossus Attack Specs and Colossus Defense Specs and bring them to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
desc_text: You've done an excellent job of delaying the work on the iron colossus, but I fear we've only made the stormforged more determined to complete the weapon.$BEven now, they're bringing in new laborers and the overseers push them to the limit. We may not be able to keep them from bringing the colossus online, after all. Return to Narvir's Cradle, to the south and find the documents detailing the colossus' offensive and defensive abilities. They should be near the tents and forges on the bottom level.

title: Loken's Lackeys
obj_text:
Thorim wants you to slay Eisenfaust inside the Hall of the Shaper and Halefnir the Windborn and Duronn the Runeforged in the Terrace of the Makers.
 Eisenfaust slain
 Halefnir the Windborn slain
 Duronn the Runewrought slain
desc_text: The attack on the Terrace of the Makers was not a half-hearted move on my brother's behalf.  He sent a legion of iron dwarves and some of his most powerful lieutenants.$BUse the Horn of the Peaks to call the earthen to your side and defeat Loken's servants.$BYou'll find the giant, Eisenfaust, inside the Hall of the Shaper to the north.  You'll find the others deeper inside the Terrace of the Makers, beyond the stairs to the northwest.

title: A New Beginning
obj_text: Njormeld wants you to take the Reforged Armor to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.
desc_text: It remains uncertain whether or not our people can ever rekindle the affection we once held for Thorim.$BMay this armor, if nothing else, remind him of the days when we stood together in honor, invincible.

title: Jormuttar is Soo Fat...
obj_text:
King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to slay Jormuttar in Hibernal Cavern.
 Jormuttar slain
desc_text: I have an opportunity that will help you to gain approval with my people, provided you prevail.$BThe jormungar are a nuisance best dealt with quickly. If given any quarter, they breed like hares and spread like fire.$BThey have appeared southwest of here, in the Hibernal Cavern. If their spawnmother is not slain soon, they will gain a foothold in our region.$BShe cannot refuse food. Take this knife and get the flank of a bear corpse from their cave. Place it near her crater and kill her as she feeds.

title: Memories of Stormhoof
obj_text:
Speak with Chieftain Swiftspear in Frostfloe Deep, then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
 Ask Chieftain Swiftspear about his memories
desc_text: When the bronze dragonflight gifted me with immortality and set me on the path of the witness, Nozdormu entrusted me with the Lorehammer.$BThe hammer's reaction to your findings means that time has gone awry here and it is our duty to restore the true timeline.$BWe must find it. To the northwest is Frostfloe Deep, ancient burial cave of the warriors of Tunka'lo. Seek out the spirit of Chieftain Swiftspear, Stormhoof's brother. Ask him what he remembers of his brother's battle against the North Wind.

title: Polishing the Helm
obj_text: You are to enter Hibernal Cavern west of Dun Niffelem and collect 5 units of Viscous Oil from the Viscous Oils there.$BYou are then to return to Dun Niffelem and apply the oil to Hodir's Helm.
desc_text: As you draw near the helm, you notice that the frigid environment is already taking its toll on the artifact's surface. What is now just a thin layer of ice will surely grow to envelop it entirely.$BNot about to let your hard efforts go to waste, you resolve to scour the region in search of a solution.$BJust as you set off, the eyes of the helm flash and an image of the nearby Hibernal Cavern enters your mind.

title: Deep in the Bowels of The Underhalls
obj_text:
The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has asked you to beat information out of Apprentice Osterkilgr concerning what Dr. Terrible is truly up to.$BYou are then to slay the apprentice.
 Information beaten out of Apprentice Osterkilgr
 Apprentice Osterkilgr slain
desc_text: Deep in the bowels of The Underhalls to the northeast, a mad scientist known as Dr. Terrible is up to something befitting his name.$BThe doctor has been given dispensation by the Lich King to perform experiments upon the vargul -- the vrykul who fall in battle and are found unworthy, and then turned into Scourge.$BWe must put an end to his work, but my auguries have been unable to find him. He does, however, have an assistant.$BBeat the information out of his apprentice, and then dispose of the body.

title: Raising Hodir's Spear
obj_text: Lorekeeper Randvir in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 3 Everfrost Shards from the depths of Hibernal Cavern and 3 Stoic Mammoth Hides from the Stoic Mammoths in the Valley of Ancient Winters.
desc_text: The time has come, little <class>. The stars have foretold of this day.$BI have received a vision from mighty Hodir himself, revealing the secret to the creation of a great artifact.$BWe must obey! Were we to fail in receiving this gift, doom would surely follow.$BI call upon you to assist me in this sacred undertaking.$BGo across the valley, deep into the Hibernal Cavern and gather everfrost shards from the icy crater there, then collect hides from the mammoths outside the cavern.

title: Distortions in Time
obj_text:
Use the Chieftain's Totem to close 4 Frostfloe Rifts, then bring the totem to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
 Frostfloe Rifts closed (4)
desc_text: This, the tomb of Tunka'lo's warriors, is supposed to be a serene place, free from the terror of the elements.$BFrostfloe Deep has been invaded by a strange force, one that disturbs the spirits of the fallen and blurs my memories of my own life.$BIt's as though our deeds and memories are being erased from history.$BIn life, this totem was a symbol of my authority. It is the last true link I have to this world. Take it, use it to restore calm to the tomb, and then return it to Camp Tunka'lo.

title: The Reckoning
obj_text:
Meet Thorim near the Temple of Wisdom.  Report the outcome of the fight to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem.
 $BWitness the Reckoning
desc_text: Loken killed my wife, turned my followers and me against each other.  He took away everything I had, but today... that changes.$BToday we reclaim our sacred grounds.  Today... Loken dies.$BMeet me on the bridge near the Temple of Wisdom, just southwest of Ulduar.  I will finish this one way or the other.$BI need you there as a witness.  You will not aid me -- this is personal.$BAfter it's done, send word to Jokkum, King of the Frost Giants.  He's a good friend and will know what to do.

title: Where Time Went Wrong
obj_text:
Use the Lorehammer on Taunka Relics to attune it to the time of Stormhoof. Once it has been attuned to 6 relics from the time of Stormhoof, return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
 Lorehammer attuned to Stormhoof's time (6)
desc_text: The Lorehammer can help us correct the damage to the timeline, but only if we can discover where the history was originally corrupted.$BFrom Chieftain Swiftspear and your findings at Frostfloe Deep, we know that the change happened around the time of Stormhoof's death.$BNow, you must go to the Howling Hollow, north of the camp, and inspect the gravesites the North Wind's minions have already destroyed. The Lorehammer will react to artifacts from Stormhoof's era and attune itself to the proper time.

title: Feeding Arngrim
obj_text:
You are to feed Arngrim 5 Disembodied Jormungar, then return to Arngrim's frozen image in Dun Niffelem.$BYou must go to the Valley of Ancient Winters and use Arngrim's Tooth on the Roaming Jormungar there. Once they have become disembodied, you must fight them until they are weakened.
 Arngrim's spirit fed (5)
desc_text: Arngrim's hunger was legendary.$BEven in death, his expression is one of famished yearning. You find that just looking at him is making your stomach growl.$BIt is said that throughout his life he was never truly sated, and that there was absolutely nothing he wouldn't eat. You wonder to yourself if there might be a way to feed the old king.$BNo sooner does the thought enter your mind than one of the massive frozen teeth falls from Arngrim's head, bounces off of his beard and lands in your hand.

title: The Missing Tracker
obj_text: Look for Tracker Val'zij inside Gimorak's Den, southeast of the Grom'arsh Crash Site.
desc_text: I can't in good conscience send you to the worg cave without warning you that the previous person we sent there hasn't returned.$BWe're prepared for the worst, but perhaps there's a chance that he's alive.  We'd appreciate it if you helped him return -- Tracker Val'zij is one of the only hunters we have.

title: Territorial Trespass
obj_text:
Place the Stolen Proto-Dragon Eggs on top of the Broodmother's Nest and return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.
 Veranus Lured
desc_text: Veranus is proud like no other beast I've known.  She still keeps her old nest and makes sure none of the younger proto-drakes takes it over.$BTake the eggs you've collected and place them on her nest.  You'll find it atop a small peak, directly southeast of here.$BI should be able to get control of her before she kills you in a fit of rage.  Hopefully.

title: The Sum is Greater than the Parts
obj_text:
Mount and take control of Nergeld. Defend it from the denizens of the Hall of Horrors until Dr. Terrible shows himself.$BUse Nergeld to slay the doctor, and then return to The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village.
 Dr. Terrible slain
desc_text: Opening the tome, you notice all manner of disgusting illustrations concerning the construction of what the doctor refers to as "the ultimate weapon"!$BClearly the prototype, Nergeld, is the massive flesh giant standing still at the end of the nearby Hall of Horrors.$BIf an army of those things were to be constructed, then it would mean doom. The only way to ensure that doesn't happen is to slay Dr. Terrible!$BPerhaps if you were to take control of the construct, the doctor would reveal himself?

title: Veranus
obj_text: Thorim, at the Temple of Storms, wants you to obtain 5 Small Proto-Drake Eggs from the peaks near Brunnhildar Village.
desc_text: If I'm to launch an attack against my brother's army, I'm going to need some way to get around.$BI released my riding drake back into the wild years ago.  Veranus was magnificent.  The leader of her own brood -- to whom she has now returned.$BFinding her will be hard, but perhaps there's a way.  She keeps her old empty nest out of pure pride.  She's a broodmother in name only, for she is beyond the age of breeding.$BBring me small eggs from the other nests near Brunnhildar.  I think I've an idea.

title: There's Always Time for Revenge
obj_text:
Tracker Val'zij wants you to slay Gimorak inside Gimorak's Den.
 Gimorak slain
desc_text: I should manage for now, <name>.  There is one favor I'd like to ask, though.$BI would never had fallen to one of these worms, but my wind serpent, Heesha, was killed by the meanest worg I've seen in some time.$BDon't worry about me now, I'll feel better when that worg is breathing no more.  You should find him deeper in the cave.

title: The Hero's Arms
obj_text: Recover Stormhoof's Spear and Stormhoof's Mail and return them to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
desc_text: Not all of the camp's records have yet been corrupted. My staff has helped me to find those records which reflect the true timeline.$BThey agree that Stormhoof was given a burial of honor among the village elders on the bottom level of the Howling Hollow, to the north.$BMost of the graves there have already been destroyed, their contents taken as trophies by the North Wind's subjects. Go to the hollow and see if you can recover Stormhoof's spear and armor from the scions of storm who have claimed them.

title: Changing the Wind's Course
obj_text:
Use the Lorehammer to travel back in time and face the North Wind as Stormhoof. When Stormhoof falls and drops the Horn of Elemental Fury, use it to finish off the North Wind, and then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
 True timeline restored
desc_text: At last, we have all that we need to right the wrongs of the North Wind and its followers. You have attuned the Lorehammer to Stormhoof's time and his persona.$BTake the hammer again, head to the Temple of Life in the plains to the northwest. Use the hammer to assume the role of Stormhoof. Face the North Wind as Stormhoof, but realize that for the timeline to be restored, Stormhoof must die as the North Wind weakens.$BThen, you must find and use the Horn of Elemental Fury to destroy the North Wind.

title: Shoot 'Em Up
obj_text:
The Leaper at The Shadow Vault wants you to use a Jotunheim Rapid-Fire Harpoon to shoot down 15 Jotunheim Proto-Drakes and their riders.
 Jotunheim Proto-Drakes & their riders shot down (15)
desc_text: Jotunheim has aerial defenses, both in terms of proto-drake riders and harpoon guns. They've concentrated these on their northern and western facings where they are most vulnerable.$BLet's use their defenses against them!$B<The Leaper pierces you with his single eye and cackles maniacally.>$BTake control of a harpoon gun on the platforms that overhang the cliffs on either side of Valhalas to the southwest. Take out the proto-drakes and their riders. Shoot 'em up!

title: Lok'lira's Parting Gift
obj_text: Speak to Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village.
desc_text: You've been a great ally, <name>.  Now comes your true test.  You will need skill, courage and a little luck.$B<Lok'lira attaches a thin strand of hair to yours.>$BYou cannot fail now sister.  Speak to Gretta the Arbiter.  She'll see you on your way.

title: Deemed Worthy
obj_text: rijana wants you to go to Brunnhildar Village and speak with Astrid Bjornrittar.
desc_text: You have succeeded where many have failed, sister. Whether it be by strength and courage or mere luck remains to be seen.$BGo back to the village and seek out Astrid Bjornrittar. Tell her of your accomplishments. But be warned. She is not easily impressed.

title: Revenge for the Vargul
obj_text:
ethod Feigr in The Underhalls wants you to throw down his sword to challenge Thane Illskar and then kill him in The Circle of Suffering.
 Challenge issued using Bethod's Sword
 Thane Illskar slain
desc_text: I've been praying to The Lady of the Sword for one to come and strike down my enemy. Thane Illskar must pay for what he did to me!$BI was the champion of Thane Ufrang the Mighty. During my fight for ascendance in Valhalas, Illskar sabotaged me with dark magic, causing me to lose and be reduced to this.$BThe thane and his champions can be found below in The Circle of Suffering. Challenge him on my behalf. Defeat him.$BMake him know the suffering that I know!

title: The Keeper's Favor
obj_text: Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle has requested that you secure passage from Arch Druid Lilliandra and speak to Keeper Remulos in Moonglade.
desc_text: There are those of this world that tap into power unrestricted by the bounds of our mortal frames - powers of restoration, powers of life, and powers of light.  And Bridenbrad, this is no ordinary man... his valor and devotion shine through. We can only hope that one of these beings will intervene and bring this hero back from a fate worse than death.$BGo now and speak to Arch Druid Lilliandra in the Argent Vanguard... request passage to Moonglade and seek the aid of Keeper Remulos.

title: A Tale of Valor
obj_text: Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle has requested that you locate the hero, Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil, in northeast Icecrown.  His fire pit will likely be the most obvious indication of his location from the air.
desc_text: Perhaps you've heard the praises for our missing hero?$BCrusader Bridenbrad was in the Broken Front aiding the attack against the Scourge when the undead army came down upon them. The many men of that allied force scattered, but Bridenbrad alone returned and dragged more than a dozen men to safety, one by one through the carnage.$B<class>, he has not returned since. He was spotted heading to the far northeast, towards the Silent Vigil. Bring him back to me that I might honor him for his valor.

title: A Hero Remains
obj_text: ring news of Crusader Bridenbrad's fate to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle.
desc_text: I know why you've come... they've sent you to bring me back, but that cannot happen. I carry the plague of undeath, <class>, and I'll not share my fate with those near me. No, I shall stay here.$BMy only regret lies in what I may become when death grips me. I do not fear death itself, but I loathe to consider serving the traitor, Arthas.$BLeave me... and see to it that no one else comes looking. You would do me a great disservice if you were to expose anyone to the plague that I carry.

title: Vile Like Fire!
obj_text:
Vile at The Shadow Vault wants you to steal a Njorndar Proto-Drake and use it to set fire to 8 vrykul buildings in the greater Jotunheim region.$BBalargarde Fortress, due to its nature, cannot be set ablaze.
 Vrykul buildings set ablaze (8)
desc_text: Vile like fire! Vile like proto-drakes!$B<The abomination claps its hands excitedly.>$BLittle <name> go to Jotunheim and steal a pretty proto-drake in Njorndar Village. Make proto-drake make pretty fires on Jotunheim buildings!

title: Cave Medicine
obj_text: Tracker Val'zij, at Gimorak's Den, wants you to obtain 1 Jormungar Toxin Gland and 8 Cave Mushrooms.
desc_text: It's good to see a friendly face.  Might be the last one I see.$BOne of those jormungar stung me with some sort of toxin before I managed to get away.  I can feel my whole body getting numb, mon.$BI'm going to need a toxin gland to make an antidote.  I will also need some of the cave mushrooms that grow here... they'll slow the toxin down.$BHurry, please.  I don't have much time.

title: Time Yet Remains
obj_text: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle with news of Emerald Acorn's effects.
desc_text: I feel refreshed... renewed... but the plague still grips me. Not to worry, I am still eternally grateful that you went to such lengths for me, a complete stranger. If nothing else, you've bought me a few more precious hours not plaguing the world as a hideous undead.$BThank you, <class>. Please extend my thanks to Tirion as well, and let him know that it has been an honor to serve beside him.

title: The Touch of an Aspect
obj_text: Request the aid of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: The dragon-queen, Alexstrasza, possesses magics over all life. In the past, she has used great fire to incinerate undead and rebirth fresh new life in their place. Perhaps her powers might be able to save our Bridenbrad as well.$BAlexstrasza makes her home at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight - please go to her and humbly request her aid on my behalf.

title: Hope Yet Remains
obj_text: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle with news of the effects of the Breath of Alexstrasza.
desc_text: <Bridenbrad raises a hand to you as he catches his breath.>$BIt was nearly as painful as it looked, but it was as if I could feel some of the corruption being burnt away from within my body. It seems the plague is not so readily bested though.$B<class>, thank you for everything that you have done. Your selfless actions have renewed my hope that there is yet great good left within this world - I can depart without fear that darkness will prevail in my absence.$BGo now, go with no regrets.

title: The Will of the Naaru
obj_text: Request the aid of A'dal at Shattrath City in Terokkar Forest.
desc_text: I appreciate everything that you have done for us, <name>. I have one last errand for you... one last gleaming hope for a paladin who deserves any salvation that we can extend.$BGo now to Shattrath and speak to the naaru, A'dal. He has long been a beacon of light and powerful ally to devout paladins. Impart Bridenbrad's story and seek any aid that he might have to offer.$BI cannot impress how important it is that you move quickly - I fear our crusader does not have much more time in this world.

title: The Boon of Remulos
obj_text: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown with the Emerald Acorn.
desc_text: I shall open a portal to take you back to the druid that brought you here. You and your crusader have my well wishes. I hope that this acorn is able to purify your crusader and save him from the wretched fate of the plague.$BFarewell, <race>.

title: Hope Within the Emerald Nightmare
obj_text: Keeper Remulos at Moonglade has instructed you to enter the emerald dream and recover 3 Emerald Acorns.$BLeave the vicinity of the Shrine of Remulos to return to Azeroth.
desc_text: What we need exists only in the emerald dream... acorns that are infused with a powerful restorative magic. Many places in this sacred glade are closely tied with the dream, and my shrine is among them.$BI will send you into the dream to recover some of these acorns. Be prepared though <class>, for this method of entering the dream is dangerous, and it is very likely you will be beset by nightmares.$BRecover a few acorns quickly, and then depart from my shrine or pinch yourself to return to our world.

title: The Boon of Alexstrasza
obj_text: ring the Breath of Alexstrasza to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown.
desc_text: You must understand, young <race>, that cleansing the body in favor of life anew is something well within my grasp... removing the plague of undeath without affecting the body, however, is beyond the scope of the powers that I control.$BIf this Bridenbrad is the beacon of light that you profess him to be, perhaps he will endure such a cleansing and thrive, but I cannot state with confidence that this is the salvation that you seek. Take it and go with all of my blessings.

title: The Boon of A'dal
obj_text: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown.
desc_text: I am pleased that you have come to me, <name>. I know of Crusader Bridenbrad, and of your travels in hope of saving him. Bridenbrad's valor has sparked remarkable selflessness in you, and this is a miracle unto itself.$BThe Light will take care of its own. I will extend my blessing to Bridenbrad and he shall not endure the corruption of undeath. I shall return you to Dalaran, and you shall return to him. Know that I remain with you.

title: Vandalizing Jotunheim
obj_text:
Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault wants you to burn 10 Vrykul Banners.
 Vrykul banners burned (10)
desc_text: Let us see if we can further weaken the resolve of the vrykul, <name>.$BEach day I wish you to travel to Jotunheim and put their banners to the torch. It may seem a trivial thing, but to see their ancestral home vandalized on a daily basis will demoralize them more than any physical punishment you can inflict.$BAt least... it can't hurt.

title: Dahlia's Tears
obj_text: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple has requested that you recover Dahlia's Tears from soil freshly cleansed by a Ruby Keeper's flames.
desc_text: In this dark time, I'll not be the one to abandon a champion of the Light.$BWe will need something sacred for this to have a hope of saving your Bridenbrad... a remnant of a devout being that fell victim to this very same plague.$BGo now to the sacred soil of the passages outside my Ruby Dragonshrine where the battle is joined. As my Ruby Keepers fly down and set flame to the ground beneath undead feet, you will witness new life grow forth. Among that life are Dahlia's Tears - bring them to me.

title: Vaelen Has Returned
obj_text: Speak with Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault.
desc_text: I just saw that incompetent fool, Vaelen the Flayed, sneak into the vault building.$BGo see to it that he rectifies his mistake and returns my death knights to me!

title: Light Within the Darkness
obj_text: ring Crusader Bridenbrad's Tabard to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle.
desc_text: <Crusader Bridenbrad's tabard rests in the bottom of the chest, shifting slightly as the howling wind finds its way in.>$BTirion will desire this last remnant of the great crusader.

title: The Art of Being a Water Terror
obj_text:
The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village wants you to possess a Water Terror and use it to slay 10 vrykul in the greater Jotunheim region.$BQualifying vrykul are Jotunheim Sleep-Watchers, Jotunheim Warriors, Mjordin Water Magi, Njorndar Spear-Sisters, and Valhalas Vargul.
 Jotunheim vrykul slain while possessing a Water Terror (10)
desc_text: The water lock outside my cave is teeming with elementals that the vrykul magi have yet to tame. I am going to teach you a trick for possessing these creatures for a short time, and you will use them to wreak havoc upon Jotunheim!$B<The banshee-infested vrykul draws magic in the air and touches a large finger to your forehead.>$BGo now and open the gate to the lock. A water terror will rush out and you will possess it to destroy our enemies!

title: Diametrically Opposed
obj_text:
King Jokkum at Dun Niffelem wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and defeat Volkhan.
 Volkhan Defeated
desc_text: I shall speak plainly to you, little <race>. My people have not been the same since our ties with Thorim were severed.$BAs their leader, I wish nothing more than for their hearts to be mended and our friendship with the Stormlord to be renewed. In your defeat of Fjorn, a step has been taken down that path. I would have you bring us a step further...$BIn the Halls of Lightning, one even greater than Fjorn sits in opposition to our existence. Volkhan will not rest until either he, or we, are no more.

title: Reading the Bones
obj_text: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has instructed you to collect 15 Vrykul Bones.
desc_text: One of the benefits of possessing this creature is that I have access to all of her powers. As a bone witch and rune reader, she has the power to throw the bones and determine one's fate.$B<The Bone Witch smirks.>$BLucky for you and I that I have it within my power to influence those readings.$BBring me the bones of the vrykul that you kill here in Jotunheim and I will toss them to allow you to determine your own fate.

title: Destroying the Altars
obj_text:
Kill Master Summoner Zarod and use his Summoning Stave to destroy the First, Second, Third, and Fourth Summoning Altars. When you've completed this task, report to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
 First Summoning Altar destroyed
 Second Summoning Altar destroyed
 Third Summoning Altar destroyed
 Fourth Summoning Altar destroyed
desc_text: So they're summoning in their workers and warriors at those altars?$BThey'll need to be the first thing to go. The master summoner should have a staff which allows him to activate the portal. If you kill the master summoner and take the staff, you can use it to overload the summoning portal and destroy its altar.$BDo this at all four of the altars and return to me once they've been destroyed.

title: Where Are They Coming From?
obj_text:
Investigate a Summoning Altar in the eastern part of the Fleshwerks, then report back to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
 Summoning Altar investigated
desc_text: The Lich King's tireless minions labor away night and day to assemble scores of abominations and flesh giants down there in the Fleshwerks.$BYet, that is not enough. More and more skeletal constructors keep appearing to increase the pace of work.$BIf we do not discover where they're coming from and how they're able to work so quickly, we'll be overrun before we can act in force. Search to the southeast and see if you can find the source of these skeletons.

title: Through the Eye
obj_text:
The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has tasked you with using the Eye of the Lich King to gain information.
 Information gained for The Bone Witch
desc_text: We must use the Lich King's tools against him if we are to decide our next step.$BOver the mountain to the southwest lies Kul'galar Keep. Within it reside the oracles of Jotunheim who receive orders from their master and scry upon others through the Eye of the Lich King.$BIt is the eye that you must fight your way to. While it cannot be used to pierce the veil within Icecrown Citadel, you should be able to use it to discern something of value so that we will know how best to proceed.

title: Sibling Rivalry
obj_text:
Thorim wants you to listen to his story.
 Thorim's History Heard
desc_text: Sif? Is it truly you?$BNo? A <race>? But for a moment....$BEnough of this! The visions of my Sif have tormented me for far too long. It is time for me to avenge her, and to bring honor to her memory.$BMy brother must pay!

title: The Struggle Persists
obj_text: Raelorasz wants you to enter the Oculus and rescue Belgaristrasz  and his companions.
desc_text: The battle goes on, <name>. Somehow we have managed to avoid detection and continue our attempts to frustrate Malygos' schemes. This, though, is where the good news ends and the bad begins.$BOur best efforts have had little or no effect. Malygos and his underlings grow stronger in power with each passing day. And now, our latest assault team has been captured and is being held in the Oculus.$BWe must attempt a rescue! Belgaristrasz and his companions are invaluable to our cause. Can we count on you, <name>?

title: Whatever it Takes!
obj_text: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to enter the Halls of Lightning and defeat Loken. You are then to return to King Jokkum with Loken's Tongue.
desc_text: One way or another, Loken shall fall.$BIf I have to rip him limb from limb myself, he soon shall pay for his wretched deeds.$BShould you meet with him before I do, the honor and glory of his defeat shall be yours.$BReturn to me with his lying tongue, and earn my blessing and gratitude.

title: Death's Gaze
obj_text:
Use the Death's Gaze Orb to place orbs on the Abomination Lab Orb Stand, the Flesh Giant Lab Orb Stand, and the Cauldron Area Orb Stand, then return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
 Orb placed in abomination lab
 Orb placed in flesh giant lab
 Orb placed in cauldron area
desc_text: The Fleshwerks is a vast operation, and it will be difficult to keep an eye on all that transpires there. Fortunately, I have a plan.$B<Arly produces an orb from the folds of her cloak and shows it to you.>$BThis is a death's gaze orb. With it, we can observe the Scourge's actions and decide how best to strike.$BPlace these orbs on the stands at three crucial areas -- the abomination lab and the flesh giant lab to the southwest, along with the area surrounding the green cauldron far to the west.

title: Blackwatch
obj_text: Speak to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch in Icecrown.
desc_text: The Scourge has a large facility called the Fleshwerks, dedicated to producing abominations and flesh giants. If we can shut it down, we can deprive the Lich King of a large component of his armies.$BI've sent Darkrider Arly to the area. She has a small base, Blackwatch, on a ridge overlooking the Fleshwerks and to the west of Corp'rethar. I'm told the Argent Crusade is sending someone to coordinate their efforts there, but the darkrider will know what to do. Find and assist her.

title: Mage-Lord Urom
obj_text:
elgaristrasz wants you to defeat Mage-Lord Urom in the Oculus.
 Mage-Lord Urom Defeated
desc_text: Only one obstacle stands between us and our ultimate goal here, <class>. His name is Urom.$BAbove us, guarding the third ring, he awaits us. Beware his powerful conjurings, friend. He is a frightful opponent, certain to challenge your prowess.$BBring him down. Make him pay for his treacherous allegiance to the enemy!

title: A Unified Front
obj_text:
elgaristrasz wants you to destroy 10 Centrifuge Constructs to bring down Varos' shield. You then must defeat Varos Cloudstrider.
 Centrifuge Constructs Destroyed (10)
 Varos Cloudstrider Defeated
desc_text: Please accept our gratitude, <race>.$BYou and your friends have succeeded where we had failed - you have bested Drakos. From here, however, it will take our combined efforts to proceed.$BAbove us, Varos hides behind an impenetrable shield. To reach him, you must defeat the Centrifuge Constructs that power his shield. That is where my friends and I come in....$BWe each can provide you with drakes from our respective flights. Only with the help of these drakes will you be able to expose Varos.

title: Vengeance Be Mine!
obj_text:
rigg in Utgarde Pinnacle wants you to kill King Ymiron.
 $BKing Ymiron Slain

 King Ymiron
 King Ymiron - Heroic
$B

 King Ymiron - Mythic
 King Ymiron - Ascended
desc_text: Och! They cannae be blamed, <lad/lass>. Who'da done different?$BThey hurled themselves at them piles o' gold - thought they'd hit the mother lode, they did. Aye... But look at 'em now. Mindless servants unable to pick up a single doubloon.$BOnly luck spared me from the same fate. In the scurry I got knocked down - was a wee bit tipsy to begin with. Looked up ta see the first of 'em turn...$BBe a good <lad/lass> and find the one in charge here and teach 'em not ta be cursin' me mates.

title: A Wing and a Prayer
obj_text:
elgaristrasz wants you to kill Eregos in the Oculus and then report to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Coldarra.
 $BLey-Guardian Eregos Defeated

 Ley-Guardian Eregos
 Ley-Guardian Eregos - Heroic
$B

 Ley-Guardian Eregos - Mythic
 Ley-Guardian Eregos - Ascended
desc_text: The time has come to face Eregos, friend.$BHe is cunning and strong. One of Malygos' most trusted minions, he draws strength from the energies he is charged with defending - sipping from the well of the great aspect himself.$BThis shall not be easy....$BHowever, defeating the Mage-Lord has allowed us to unlock the full power of our drakes. Their skills shall be at your command. Use them wisely and Eregos shall surely fall.$BShould you succeed, return to Raelorasz and inform him of our victory.

title: The Terrace of the Makers
obj_text: Find Thorim at the southeastern edge of the Terrace of the Makers, just northwest of Dun Niffelem.
desc_text: It is time, <name>.  I am prepared to face Loken now.$BLet us make our way to the Terrace of the Makers and face my brother's forces.  The fool will regret ever crossing me.

title: Spill Their Blood
obj_text:
Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy 5 vats of Embalming Fluid and 5 Blood Orbs.
 Blood Orbs shattered (5)
 Vats of Embalming Fluid destroyed (5)
desc_text: The Scourge cannot create their flesh monsters without blood and embalming fluid to preserve the parts and keep them functioning. If we can deny them these materials, their army will fall apart and we can easily destroy their creations.$BThroughout the labs where the flesh giants and abominations are cobbled together, you will find vats of embalming fluid and large orbs filled with blood. Destroy these, and bring death to any who would stop you!

title: Not-So-Honorable Combat
obj_text:
The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village wants you to defeat Iskalder upon Battlescar Spire.
 Iskalder defeated in battle
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Atop the tallest peak to the southwest overlooking Jotunheim is Battlescar Spire. It is a place of reverence for the vrykul, second only to Valhalas in terms of where they prefer to do honorable combat.$BWe shall visit not-so-honorable combat upon it.$BGather your companions and fly to the spire. When you are ready, light the signal fire and I will appear within the body of Iskalder.$BWe will fight, you will win, and Vardmadra is sure to come to witness the battle!

title: Banshee's Revenge
obj_text:
The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village has asked you to exact her revenge by challenging and defeating Overthane Balargarde.
 Overthane Balargarde slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: The time has come, <name>. You and your friends must challenge the lord of Balargarde Fortress, the master of Jotunheim, Overthane Balargarde.$BAtop the fortress, which is on the southwestern edge of Jotunheim, you will find a horn. Blow into it. Allow your challenge to resound throughout the steadfast.$BBalargarde will have no choice but to face you. And I... excuse me, Vardmadra will be there to adjudicate the challenge.$B<The banshee-possessed vrykul lets out a bellowing cackle.>

title: New Recruit
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering has requested that you bring a subdued Lithe Stalker to the top of the rocks northeast of the Rise of Suffering.
 Subdued Lithe Stalker Returned
desc_text: First things first. I saw some Lithe Stalkers on the ramparts just east of us. They used to serve us before we broke with Arthas, and they're about as perfect a scout as you can get... with a little prodding from an eye of dominion.$BFly up, find one of the stalkers, beat it down a bit, and then use this Sigil of the Ebon Blade to command its obedience. It will recognize the sigil, guaranteed. Lead it back to the top of the rocks northeast of here and it will find its way to me.

title: Jagged Shards
obj_text: ring 10 Jagged Shards to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch.
desc_text: You pulled this jagged, dark brittle shard from the body of a ghoul. The metal blade lacks a smooth edge, suggesting it was forged by an unskilled hand, or was broken from a larger piece.$BYou recall seeing similar shards embedded in the bodies of all the ghouls you've encountered at the Fleshwerks, leading you to wonder why their creators bothered to include the metal at all. Perhaps Crusader Olakin Sainrith would have some insight if you brought him the shards from several ghouls.

title: Find the Ancient Hero
obj_text:
The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village wants you to return with Iskalder.
 Iskalder delivered to The Bone Witch
desc_text: Quickly, <name>, head southwest to the Halls of the Ancestors!$BWithin you will find slumbering mjordin. Wake them until you find Iskalder. When you do, use this amulet upon him and bring him back to me.$BNow go. There is no time to waste!

title: The Vile Hold
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering has requested that you use a Lithe Stalker to scout out Malykriss.
 Altar of Sacrifice explored
 Blood Forge explored
 Icy Lookout explored
 Runeworks explored
desc_text: We need to know what we're up against.$BUse the eye of dominion to assume control of a lithe stalker and scout out the area. There are a few spots in particular I saw when flying in that I want you to get a closer look at: the overlook in the northeast, the work area in the southeast, the large forge near the center, and the ritual area in the southwest.$BThe stalker can leap far and won't be hurt by large falls - use that to your advantage to get up and down from those ramparts.

title: Killing Two Scourge With One Skeleton
obj_text:
Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy 3 Chained Abominations with Burning Skeletons.
 Chained Abominations burned (3)
desc_text: The workers in the Fleshwerks abomination lab have already completed a number of their creations. For now, the creatures are chained to the pillars around the edge of the lab, but if we do not act, they will march with the Lich King's armies.$BGrasping arms reach out of the bone piles spread throughout the Fleshwerks. These arms belong to skeletons enchanted with the power of fire. Find and free these skeletons, then take them near the completed abominations and watch the show!

title: Generosity Abounds
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning wants you to use the Lithe Stalker's Iron Chain to drag Scourge Bombs to 4 Lumbering Atrocities inside Malykriss.
 Scourge Bomb gift delivered (4)
desc_text: We need to cause some disruption... anything to bring those death knights away from their leaders. If we lay waste to their minions below, I suspect they'll have to devote more attention to keeping a close eye on operations.$BAbominations are easy prey - slow, predictable, and most importantly, stupid. Take advantage of their trust of the stalkers to drag them some of the Scourge bombs scattered throughout the construction area. You'll be able light the bombs far before they figure out what's going on.

title: Matchmaker
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker to throw rocks at Umbral Brutes as they near lesser undead in Malykriss. Return after you've started 5 fights.
 Worker fight started (5)
desc_text: The major difference between vargul and lesser undead minions is that vargul still possess enough of their minds to despise being used for labor. Never will a vargul be pleased to be working aside skeletons or ghouls.$BLets take advantage of this inevitable animosity and start some fights between the umbral brutes and the other undead in Malykriss. That should serve to slow production and bring the death knights down to babysit.$BShould be simple - throw rocks at the brutes as they near lesser undead.

title: A Royal Escort
obj_text:
Chromie has asked you to accompany Arthas in the Culling of Stratholme. You are to speak with her again after Mal'Ganis is defeated.
 Mal'Ganis Defeated
desc_text: The Infinite Dragonflight are not likely to give up so easily. I cannot be certain of what they're up to, but something tells me we haven't seen the last of them today.$BIn just a moment, Arthas will face a desperate dilemma, and make a momentous decision.$BDon't lose focus now, <name>. I needn't remind you how much is at stake. I must call upon you to accompany the prince in his culling of Stratholme.$BArthas must make it through Stratholme alive and you must see to it that he defeats Mal'Ganis!

title: A Visit to the Doctor
obj_text:
Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch wants you to destroy the Metal Stake imprisoning Patches in the Sanctum of Reanimation and help him get his revenge on Doctor Sabnok.
 Help Patches kill Doctor Sabnok
 Patches freed
desc_text: So they've been embedding these ghouls with broken shards of saronite down in the Sanctum of Reanimation? We must put a stop to this, before these ghouls can be deployed against our troops.$BFind the entrance to the Sanctum of Reanimation in the flesh giant lab area of the Fleshwerks. There, the ghoul mastermind, Doctor Sabnok, keeps the most fearsome of his creations, Patches. Free Patches from his chains and help him take his revenge on the doctor. Let his own creation be his undoing.

title: Vereth the Cunning
obj_text: Report to Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering in Icecrown.
desc_text: I've already heard some rumors regarding Malykriss and Arthas's new death knight order, but I assumed it nothing more than filling the void. These numbers suggest he's trying to take it up a notch though.$BWe dispatched one of our best to Malykriss not long ago - Vereth the Cunning. You should be able to find him on the Rise of Suffering, just west of Malykriss, and inside the Court of Bones.$BTry not to draw too much attention on your way in.

title: Dispelling Illusions
obj_text:
Chromie wants you to use the Arcane Disruptor on the suspicious crates in Stratholme Past, then speak to her near the entrance to Stratholme.
 Plagued Grain Crates Dispelled
desc_text: Always meddling...$BThe Infinite Dragonflight seek to disrupt history as we have come to know it by deceiving Prince Arthas.$BIf they can convince him that none of the grain here carries the plague, then he'll never have to make the fateful decision to cull Stratholme.$BThis must not come to pass.$BUse this Arcane Disruptor on any suspicious crates of grain you find to reveal them for what they are. Meet me near Stratholme's entrance, north of this place, when the work is done.

title: Stunning View
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning at the Rise of Suffering wants you to use a Lithe Stalker's heave ability to destroy 12 sleeping Iceskin Sentries.
 Iceskin Sentry destroyed (12)
desc_text: Gargoyles make effective scouts and can be deadly if left to rain attacks from the air, but they have a very obvious weakness. Most of them have to go through long periods resting as stone to maintain the energy they need to carry their heavy bodies through the air.$BAs I peered through the eye you were using, I noticed dozens of iceskin sentries resting on the eastern and southern walls inside. Use the stalker to leap up to their ledges and devastate them while they sleep.

title: The Rider of the Unholy
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering wants you to kill Rokir, the Rider of the Unholy.
 Rokir slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: It's time that we start cutting off the heads of the beast.$BI served beside Rokir for quite some time. He knows the unholy arts better than most any other death knight I've met and he's equally as ruthless.$BRokir's strengths are most apparent when you are fighting him on his own ground. Sadly, we don't have much option in those regards, but stay on your feet to avoid his undead minions and you should come out victorious.$BBe nimble, <class>, and do not take him lightly.

title: The Runesmiths of Malykriss
obj_text: ring 5 Runed Saronite Plates to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch.
desc_text: Those shards you recovered can only have come from one place, Malykriss. It's the seat of the Lich King's metalworking operations, to the east of Corp'rethar.$BWhat's puzzling is that metal isn't needed to stitch together abominations or flesh giants, or to summon skeletal servants. Find the skeletal runesmiths working on the bottom level of Malykriss and capture the plates they're working on. We need to find out why this metal is finding its way to the Fleshwerks.

title: The Rider of Frost
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering wants you to kill Sapph, the Rider of Frost.
 Sapph slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Sapph... Sapph's a death knight like no other. She'll shower you with sweet words and you'll swear that she has no evil within her heart, and then she'll run you through without even breaking her smile.$BI have no fear that you'll be able to best Sapph, but do not grow overconfident. Her strength lies in lulling her victims into a false ease, shortly before shattering them with a fierce barrage of frost attacks.$BDo not let your guard down, and do not underestimate her.

title: Junk in My Trunk
obj_text: rigg in Utgarde Pinnacle wants you to find 5 Untarnished Silver Bars, 3 Shiny Baubles, 2 Golden Goblets, and a Jade Statue.
desc_text: Just look at it! Me trunk never been so empty. Shoulda been filled ten times over by now!$BMe mates jumped at the sight o' all that booty, and now look at 'em! Rattlin' bones, they be!$BIt be like me mammy use 'ta tell me - only thing worse than no treasure be cursed treasure.$BSay, thar be plenty o' loot farther in, an' not the cursed kind I'll wager. These sots not be needin' it - it just be junk ta them.$BFetch it fer me an' I'll be rewardin' ya handsomely, matey.

title: Parting Gifts
obj_text:
Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault wants you to use an Eye of Dominion to take control of a captured Eidolon Watcher.
 $BSeize Control of an Eidolon Watcher
desc_text: Look what we have here... eyes of dominion. The Cult normally goes to great lengths to keep these things safe, but I suppose their options for retreat are few when we're slaughtering them in their own home.$BThe eyes allow a being of any relative power to control an undead minion's actions precisely. As you can imagine, this can be extremely useful when it comes to your typical clumsy ghoul or skeleton.$BCare to try your hand at it? Use one of the eyes to control a captured shade.

title: The Fate of Bloodbane
obj_text:
Vereth on the Rise of Suffering has dispatched you to kill Orbaz Bloodbane.
 Orbaz Bloodbane slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: With the riders of the Host of Suffering dead, now is the time to put an end to their true leader: Orbaz Bloodbane.$BMograine caught up with me while you were off and told me that he found where Orbaz is hiding. Under Icecrown Citadel itself, there is an immense pit - you will find Orbaz just outside its lip.$BSome of the Ebon Blade's strongest agents have already been dispatched - gather aid and join the fight. It is time for Bloodbane to die.

title: The Rider of Blood
obj_text:
Vereth the Cunning on the Rise of Suffering wants you to kill Baelok, the Rider of Blood.
 Baelok slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: aelok is one of the few vrykul that I've ever seen rise through the ranks, and that was mostly accomplished through sheer brutality. If your competition ends up dead, there's far less to compete against.$BWhen you join battle with him, spread out from your companions and keep your distance as much as you reasonably can.
