He will not hesitate to steal your life force for himself, so you will need to hinder his ability to do so as much as possible.$BYou have my confidence. See to it that he dies.

title: An Undead's Best Friend
obj_text:
Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault wants you to use the Eidolon Watcher to feed 18 Hungering Plaguehounds.
 Hungering Plaguehounds fed (18)
desc_text: As is usual practice, the undead at the saronite quarry to the southwest starve plaguehounds to keep them extra aggressive. Use the shade to get up close and feed some of those hounds and I promise you they'll be content to leave you alone, if not side with the hand that fed them.$BDon't get too close to those things until you've fed them though. Their noses don't fall victim to your shade's elusiveness.

title: Honor is for the Weak
obj_text:
Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault would like you to assassinate 20 Restless Lookouts.
 Restless Lookouts assassinated (20)
desc_text: Ghouls are fragile things when it comes down to it, and the lookouts at the saronite quarry down the path to the southwest are no exception. Using one of the shades, I have no doubt that you can sneak up and put down their lookouts without making a sound.$BClear out as many lookouts as you can reach in a reasonable amount of time... we'll want their ranks thinned for our assault to come.

title: From Whence They Came
obj_text:
Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault has sent you to banish 10 Scourge Containment Crystals.
 Banished Scourge Crystals (10)
desc_text: My main concern is the saronite quarry down the path to the southwest. They are pulling up immense amounts of ore from that quarry and I'd like to know what they're building with it. To that end, we'll start by weakening their defenses.$BI noticed a series of crystals scattered throughout the base and I assume they are defensive structures of some sort, not unlike ziggurats. Use the eidolon watcher to destroy any of those crystals that you find.

title: Amidst the Confusion
desc_text: We got our hands on quite a few workers. They should do nicely.$BI want you to use an eye to bring one of these workers back into the quarry. With the entire camp in disarray, there's no way they'll be able to distinguish you from any of the other workers that were scattered by the assault.$BFind whoever is in charge of the operation and get to work. With any luck, we'll find out where that Saronite is being shipped off to pretty quickly. I'll watch over your shoulder through the eye.

title: I'm Smelting... Smelting!
obj_text: Use the Bag of Jagged Shards near one of the bottom level Malykriss furnaces. Return to Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch with the Smelted Metal Bar.
desc_text: <Olakin turns one of the shards over in an armored fist.>$BThese could pierce armor with enough force. We have to find out what they're made of and what the Lich King intends to do with them.$BTo the east, nestled next to Icecrown Citadel itself, lies Malykriss. From the few reports we have, it's full of smelting and smithing equipment. Bring these shards there, and smelt them in one of the open furnaces on the bottom level of Malykriss. Once the metal has been reformed, we can identify it.

title: Seeds of Chaos
obj_text:
Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault has dispatched you to slaughter 80 undead in the Weeping Quarry. Speak to him to secure a skeletal gryphon for the assault.
 $BWeeping Quarry Undead slaughtered (80)

 Restless Lookout
$B

 Risen Laborer
desc_text: Effective tool, is it not? Excellent job weakening their defenses, <class>. Now we can push the main assault.$BThe plan here is straight-foward - we're looking to destroy anything moving, and get in there and steal some information amidst the confusion.$BLet me know when you're ready and I'll set you up with a skeletal gryphon.

title: Slay them all!
obj_text:
Commander Dardosh in Wintergrasp wants you to slay 10 members of the Alliance.
 Alliance members slain (10)
desc_text: Welcome to the Wintergrasp, <name>. Warlord Garrosh demands one thing: Slay them all!$BReturn to me when ten of the strongest members of the Alliance are dead.

title: Victory in Wintergrasp
obj_text:
Win a Wintergrasp battleground match and return to Tactical Officer Kilrath in Wintergrasp. You must have participated in the battle to gain credit for the victory.
 $BVictory in Lake Wintergrasp
desc_text: While Dardosh might be content with slaying our foes, it is of the utmost importance that we control Wintergrasp Fortress. Do whatever it takes to ensure Wintergrasp is ours.$BHowever, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.

title: Slay them all!
obj_text:
Commander Dardosh in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to slay 10 members of the Alliance.
 Alliance members slain (10)
desc_text: Welcome to the Wintergrasp Fortress, <name>. Warlord Garrosh demands one thing: Slay them all!$BReturn to me when ten of the strongest members of the Alliance are dead.

title: Stop the Siege
obj_text:
Lieutenant Murp in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to destroy 3 Alliance siege machines.
 Alliance Siege Devices destroyed (3)
desc_text: I hears dem! The Alliance come soon. Destroy three Alliance siege devices and come back to Murp.

title: All Things in Good Time
obj_text:
Kilix the Unraveler in the Pit of Narjun wants you to obtain an Ahn'kahar Watcher's Corpse and place it upon the Ahn'kahet Brazier in Ahn'kahet.$BThis quest can only be completed on Heroic Difficulty.
 Ahn'kahar Watcher Corpse Burned
desc_text: Ahn'kahet, from whence we came...$BOne day, I dream, we shall overcome the death and darkness that hold our ancient home in their grip. To that end, I have a plan to weaken the resolve of our enemies.$BTheir precious Watchers must burn!$BTake their corpses and place them upon the brazier deep within the city. The scent of their burnt remains will linger in the air, reminding our enemy of their weakness.$BBe mindful, <class>! Their undead corpses are most fragile and will deteriorate rapidly.

title: Warding the Walls
obj_text: Hoodoo Master Fu'jin at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Enchanted Alliance Breastplates at the Glacial Falls.
desc_text: Hey 'mon. This place be givin' me dah heebie jeebies, don't cha know?$BWay too many spirits haunting dis place. I want ta be placing hoodoo wards up, but I be needin' some souls, mon. Not any soul though, only da soul of a strong warrior could do da job.$BThe Glacial Falls in east Wintergrasp be havin' dem special properties to extract da soul. Slay the Alliance there, mebbe they be havin' the stuff we need.$BBring back da armor of the slain. If there be no Alliance maybe da elementals got 'em, mon.

title: Healing with Roses
obj_text: Primalist Mulfort wants you to retrieve 10 Alliance Herb Pouches from Alliance players at the Steppe of Life.
desc_text: etween the battles, one might almost believe that there was hope for peace in this land. Sadly, that is not to be our fate.$BTravel to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp. I have need of the roses that grow there for salve to treat the wounded.$BSadly, the rose has become scarce due to the Alliance harvesting it too rapidly. Slay them on the Steppe of Life and retrieve their herb pouches from the bodies.$BIf that fails, perhaps a lasher or two might have one.

title: Fueling the Demolishers
obj_text: Siegesmith Stronghoof at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Alliance players in the Cauldron of Flames.
desc_text: Lok'tar, <name>! While the battle may be over, we must prepare for the Alliance's next assault! Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in south eastern Wintergrasp and retrieve ten eternal embers.$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolishers and Siege Engines.$BWe've heard reports of Alliance pigs collecting the embers all day. Slay them and take their embers! If they have already abandoned the area, then be prepared to fight the fire elementals there until you find some!

title: Amidst the Confusion
obj_text: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault has requested a Weeping Quarry Document, a Weeping Quarry Ledger, a Weeping Quarry Map, and a Weeping Quarry Schedule.
desc_text: Shutting down their operation is just half of the plan. The other important goal here is to find out where all that saronite is being sent. We know of a few places it's been ending up, but the amount they're pulling out suggests to me that there's a bigger project in the works.$BOnce you're inside the quarry, get your hands on any of their documents that you can find. If you're assaulting the place with one of the gryphons, you can drop down from it as soon as the wetwork is done.

title: Jinxing the Walls
obj_text: Hoodoo Master Fu'jin in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Enchanted Alliance Breastplates from Alliance players at the Glacial Falls.
desc_text: Hey 'mon. See dem Alliance sitting comfy in their keep?$BI think they be a bit too comfy, ya? I want ta be jinxing the place, but I be needin' some souls, mon. Not any soul though, only da soul of a strong warrior could do da job.$BThe Glacial Falls in east Wintergrasp be havin' dem special properties to extract da soul. Slay the Alliance there, they be havin' the stuff we need.$BBring back da armor of the slain. If there be no Alliance maybe da elementals got 'em, mon.

title: Battle at Valhalas: Khit'rix the Dark Master
obj_text:
Geirrvif at Valhalas has challenged you to defeat Khit'rix the Dark Master.$BShould you succeed, speak with Gjonner the Merciless overlooking the southern lip of Valhalas.
 $BKhit'rix the Dark Master Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: A variety of beings travel the world to prove themselves within Valhalas. Some even come from under the world.$BKhit'rix the Dark Master is one such.$BHailing from deep within the ground where insanity reigns, Khit'rix has asked for someone exotic to face in the ring. You will do.$BDare you face this Nerubian nightmare, <race>?

title: Battle at Valhalas: The Return of Sigrid Iceborn
obj_text:
Geirrvif at Valhalas has challenged you to defeat Sigrid Iceborn.$BShould you succeed, speak with Gjonner the Merciless overlooking the southern lip of Valhalas.
 $BSigrid Iceborn Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: An old foe of yours has returned: Sigrid Iceborn. Perhaps you remember besting her in a duel upon the Savage Ledge?$BNo matter, she certainly remembers you. She's insisting upon a chance to prove herself once more.$BPersonally, I think it's more a chance for revenge, but that too can be useful in this place.$BI leave it up to you, <name>. Will you face Sigrid Iceborn once more?

title: By Fire Be Purged
obj_text:
Crusader Olakin Sainrith at Blackwatch wants you to burn 7 Festering Corpses using Olakin's Torch.
 Festering Corpse burned (7)
desc_text: The Scourge uses our own fallen against us, by raising them as ghouls or skeletons, or by dismembering their corpses and using the parts to make abominations. This must stop!$BThe dead are heroes who fell in defense of all the living, and they cannot be confined to so grisly a fate. Moreover, we cannot afford to face them again on the field, used as weapons against us. Take this torch with you to the Fleshwerks, and burn any of the corpses you find in the Sanctum of Reanimation or the abomination lab.

title: Battle at Valhalas: Fallen Heroes
obj_text:
Geirrvif at Valhalas has challenged you to, in a single combat, defeat all six of the fallen heroes: Eldreth, Geness Half-Soul, Jhadras, Masud, Rith, and Talla.$BShould you succeed, speak with Gjonner the Merciless overlooking the southern lip of Valhalas.
 $BFallen Heroes Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: If you believe yourself ready to begin then I have just the match for you to cut your teeth on.$BAnother group of outsiders thought themselves prepared for the rigors of Valhalas. They had much hubris, but in the end they fell like all of the others.$BIf you think yourselves so different -- if you think that you have the skill and experience to fight here amongst such storied warriors -- then please accept the challenge.

title: Battle at Valhalas
obj_text: Speak with Geirrvif in Valhalas.
desc_text: I see and hear many things, <name>, and something very important has happened since your defeat of Overthane Balargarde: you are wanted for battle in Valhalas!$BYou will find the battle pit to the north. Go now with your friends and speak with Geirrvif the val'kyr. The challengers that she will offer you within Valhalas are sure to require their help.$BGood luck.

title: Bones and Arrows
obj_text: Lieutenant Vieron Blazefeather at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Alliance players in the Forest of Shadows.
desc_text: Why would they set me to the task of arming our archers? I was a poet, not a ranger! Well, no use complaining. <name>, I am in need of dragon bone for our arrowheads.$BTravel to the Forest of Shadows on the western side of Wintergrasp. Ever since the last skirmish, the Alliance have been scavenging dragon bones in the area. Slay them and take the bones.$BIf that fails, you might be lucky and get one from the spirits in the area. I hear they love to impale their living victims on the bones as they die.

title: Battle at Valhalas: Final Challenge
obj_text:
Geirrvif at Valhalas has challenged you to defeat Prince Sandoval.$BShould you succeed, speak with Gjonner the Merciless overlooking the southern lip of Valhalas.
 $BPrince Sandoval Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: I'm afraid that your success is going to be your undoing, <name>.$B<If the val'kyr could turn more white, she would.>$BWord of your success in Valhalas has reached deep into Icecrown Citadel, stirring one whom you have no desire to meet.$BPrince Sandoval himself is on his way at this very moment. Gjonner warned you that you should run and I cannot disagree.$BWhat will you do? He's on his way. Will you face the blood prince in final battle?

title: Battle at Valhalas: Thane Deathblow
obj_text:
Geirrvif at Valhalas has challenged you to defeat Thane Banahogg, the Deathblow.$BShould you succeed, speak with Gjonner the Merciless overlooking the southern lip of Valhalas.
 $BThane Banahogg Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Your skills have not gone unnoticed by the vrykul of Jotunheim, <name>. Thane Banahogg has taken a personal interest in you and has insisted that he be your next match.$BIf you thought Carnage was bad, then you might want to go home now. Thane Banahogg's nickname is The Deathblow. I think you can guess how he earned it.$BDo you accept the thane's challenge?

title: Battle at Valhalas: Carnage!
obj_text:
Geirrvif at Valhalas has challenged you to defeat Carnage.$BShould you succeed, speak with Gjonner the Merciless overlooking the southern lip of Valhalas.
 $BCarnage Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: You've been successful up to this point, <name>, but what you must face to continue to battle within Valhalas is a gigantic horror beyond imagining.$BI must warn you to turn away now. Carnage is a mountain of flesh constructed by the Lich King's most fiendish minds.$BI do not see how you and your friends will defeat it. However, the choice is yours.

title: Bones and Arrows
obj_text: Lieutenant Vieron Blazefeather in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Alliance players at the Forest of Shadows.
desc_text: Why would they set me to the task of arming our archers? I was a poet, not a ranger! Well, no use complaining. <name>, I am in need of dragon bone for our arrowheads.$BTravel to the Forest of Shadows on the western side of Wintergrasp. Ever since the last skirmish, the Alliance have been scavenging dragon bones in the area. Slay them and take the bones.$BIf that fails, you might be lucky and get one from the spirits in the area. I hear they love to impale their living victims on the bones as they die.

title: Healing with Roses
obj_text: Primalist Mulfort in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Alliance Herb Pouches from Alliance players at the Steppe of Life.
desc_text: So many of our braves were lost during the battle, but even more shall die if left untreated.$BTravel to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp. I have need of the roses that grow there for salve to treat the wounded.$BSadly, the rose has become scarce due to the Alliance harvesting it too rapidly. Slay them on the Steppe of Life and retrieve their herb pouches from the bodies.$BIf that fails, perhaps a lasher or two might be in bloom.

title: Fueling the Demolishers
obj_text: Siegesmith Stronghoof in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Alliance players at the Cauldron of Flames.
desc_text: Lok'tar, <name>! While the battle may have subsided, we must prepare to retake the fortress! Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in south eastern Wintergrasp and retrieve ten eternal embers.$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolishers and Siege Engines.$BWe've heard reports of Alliance pigs collecting the embers all day. Slay them and take their embers! If they have already abandoned the area, then be prepared to fight the fire elementals there until you find some!

title: The Broken Front
obj_text:
Korm Blackscar on Orgrim's Hammer wants you to go to The Broken Front and question a Dying Berserker to discover what happened there.
 Dying Berserker Questioned
desc_text: What battle?! Those troops were on a recon mission!$BAnd what's this talk of Alliance - you're sure he said Alliance?$BListen to me, <name>! I need to know what's going on and I need to know NOW!$BGet yourself down there and get me some answers! Scour the battlefield and look for survivors - clues - anything!

title: I'm Not Dead Yet!
obj_text:
Escort Father Kamaros to safety and then report to Brother Keltan aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
 $BEscort Father Kamaros to safety
desc_text: The Light smiles upon me. I have not yet died in this living nightmare, but the Scourge will kill me and tear my body apart for use in their 'work' here if I cannot escape.$BI cannot make it on my own, <class>, but with your help, I may yet live to fight the Scourge again.$BWill you help me make my escape before the Scourge's butchers come to finish me off?

title: Defend the Siege
obj_text:
Lieutenant Murp in Wintergrasp wants you to defend or pilot a siege vehicle while they destroy three Alliance structures.$BSiege devices can be built by ranked Horde players at the Goblin Workshops.
 Horde Siege Vehicles Defended (3)
desc_text: Dem Alliance won't be long to hold that keep. Murp would smash walls, but Murp has to stay in camp. Murp wish he could smash Alliance who want to hurt Horde demolishers.$BYou, <name>! You go in Murp's place. Protect 3 siege vehicles while they smash Alliance buildings. Alliance not expect you to defend demolisher. Show Alliance how smart Murp is!

title: Putting Olakin Back Together Again
obj_text:
Obtain a Spool of Thread and the Doctor's Cleaver, then take them to the Sanctum of Reanimation Slab and use Olakin's remains to attempt to reanimate the crusader. Return to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch when this task is complete.
 Crusader Olakin Sainrith revived
desc_text: We can't afford to waste any time putting Olakin back together. Fortunately, the Scourge has provided a perfect place for you to stitch him back together.$BNear the Fleshwerks' flesh giant lab is the Sanctum of Reanimation. Search the area for a spool of thread and the doctor's cleaver. Then, take Olakin's remains to the large slab in the middle of the sanctum and get to work.

title: Avenge Me!
obj_text:
A Dying Berserker has asked that you slay 5 Dying Soldiers at the Broken Front. Report to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar on Orgrim's Hammer when it is done.
 Dying Alliance Soldiers Slain (5)
desc_text: I hear them, <brother/sister>....$BThe moans of the wounded Alliance... they taunt me...$BFinish what we have begun here, <class>. Show no mercy... let none of them survive.$BFor... the Horde...

title: Army of the Damned
obj_text:
Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp wants you to raise an army of 100 Ghoulish Minions.
 Ghoulish Minion Raised (100)
desc_text: You probably think you're quite strong -- fighting these undead and crushing their bones beneath your war machines.$BThat is nothing compared to the strength it took to create them.$BI saw the prince do it himself.  I can show you how it happened... if you'd like.

title: The Flesh Giant Champion
obj_text:
Speak with Margrave Dhakar at the western end of the Fleshworks to engage Morbidus. After you have defeated Morbidus, report to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
 Morbidus slain
desc_text: You've done well in destroying the Fleshwerks and slaughtering the Lich King's servants. Now, all that remains is to defeat the Fleshwerks' greatest accomplishment -- the flesh giant known as Morbidus.$BIt will not be an easy fight, but the Shadow Vault has dispatched Margrave Dhakar with some reinforcements. Meet up with him at the highest point at the western end of the Fleshwerks. Tell him when you're ready to begin the attack and he'll order his forces into battle.

title: Poke and Prod
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to go the Broken Front and defeat 5 Hulking Abominations, 5 Malefic Necromancers, and 5 Shadow Adepts.
 Hulking Abominations Slain (5)
 Malefic Necromancers Slain (5)
 Shadow Adepts Slain (5)
desc_text: While your commander has his focus diluted by his loathing of your Alliance rivals, you can depend on me to direct my attention squarely on the real enemy here - the Lich King and his minions.$BIn order to hold any hope of conquering him at the citadel, your people must take and hold each gate.$BFor now, let us focus on the first. Return to the front and prod their defenses. Look for any sign of weakness that we might exploit.$BI'll await your report, <class>.

title: Make Them Pay!
obj_text:
Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar wants you to kill 15 Alliance Players in Icecrown.
 $BPlayers slain (15)
desc_text: The time has come!$BToo long have we suffered the company of the self-righteous Alliance! Too long have we stayed our hand from cleansing our world of the weak and the desperate.$BNow, we bring an end to our humiliation! Now, we show them the true meaning of fear! Now, we bring honor to the Horde!$BHere, at Icecrown, we break the Alliance!$BGo, <class>. Hunt them down. Break them. Take their will to live!

title: Good For Something?
obj_text: Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar wants you to speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
desc_text: Goblins! Hyper little busy-bodies...$BListen, <name>. Copperclaw, our resident engineer, is insisting that he's got something useful to show me.$BI'm in no mood to endure his squeaky nagging. The last time I acknowledged him, he chirped on for an hour straight. It was all I could do to keep from drop-kicking him into Sindragosa's Fall!$BYou go in my place and humor him. Let me know if indeed he's on to anything.

title: Timear Foresees Centrifuge Constructs in your Future!
obj_text:
Archmage Timear in Dalaran has foreseen that you must destroy 10 Centrifuge Constructs.
 Centrifuge Construct slain (10)
desc_text: It is into the Oculus floating above Coldarra that you must travel, <name>.$BI have foreseen a situation in which you must destroy the centrifuge constructs therein. I can assure you that if you do not first eliminate these magical creations, you and your friends will fail.$BThus I have seen, thus you must do.

title: Volatility
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Copperclaw wants you to use Copperclaw's Volatile Oil at the Broken Front to attract 3 Frostbrood Skytalons.$BTo use the oil, you must collect a Pile of Bones, an Abandoned Helm, and Abandoned Armor from the battlefield there.
 Field Tests Conducted (3)
desc_text: Where to begin... well, you must know that as chief engineer of this vessel I have access to all of the intelligence reports - yes, yes, it's true, and I've recently taken a particular interest in the frostwyrms you reported seeing to the south, and I do believe I've developed a plan that just might work against them... now it'll take a little legwork on your part, but essentially, you build a dummy out of armor and coat it with a splash of this solution, then run for cover!$B...You still here, <race>?

title: Timear Foresees Ymirjar Berserkers in your Future!
obj_text:
Archmage Timear in Dalaran wants you to slay 7 Ymirjar Berserkers.
 Ymirjar Berserker slain (7)
desc_text: King Ymiron's champions stand between you and victory in the not-too-distant future.$BYou will travel to the fortress known as Utgarde Pinnacle nestled deep within the woods of the Howling Fjord. I cannot stress how important it is that you and your traveling companions deal with the Ymirjar berserkers therein.$BFailure to do so may very well doom you, <name>!

title: He's Gone to Pieces
obj_text: Recover Olakin's Torso, Olakin's Legs, Olakin's Left Arm, and Olakin's Right Arm and bring them to Darkrider Arly at Blackwatch.
desc_text: With the abduction of Crusader Olakin, the Argent Crusade's forces will have no commander in the final assault on the Fleshwerks. While one crusader is the same as any other to me, the argents won't see it that way.$BI hate to see us waste time chasing after this, but I have no choice. Our gallant crusader has likely been dismembered by now, and his remains used to construct abominations. Go down into the Fleshwerks, kill the corpulent horrors fighting our forces, and recover Olakin's body parts.

title: Timear Foresees Infinite Agents in your Future!
obj_text:
Archmage Timear in Dalaran has foreseen that you must slay 4 Infinite Agents.
 Infinite Agent slain (4)
desc_text: The timeline is in danger from the Infinite dragonflight. Without your intervention, all of time will unravel!$BYou must travel to a point in time known as the Culling of Stratholme within the Caverns of Time.$BIt gives me a migraine just to attempt to see into all of the possible pasts, but I do know that it is crucial for you to kill the Infinite agents.$BOnly by slaying them will the true past be preserved and the present and future kept from being undone forever!

title: Timear Foresees Titanium Vanguards in your Future!
obj_text:
Archmage Timear in Dalaran has foreseen that you must slay 7 Titanium Vanguards.
 Titanium Vanguard slain (7)
desc_text: The entirety of Azeroth is in peril. The mad god Loken has it within his power to put an end to everything!$BWithin the Terrestrial Watchtower at the Halls of Lightning, the titanium vanguards stand poised to execute Loken's dread will upon countless unknowing victims.$BI have looked into the future, <name>. You are the one to see that this does not come to pass!

title: Proof of Demise: King Ymiron
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Locket of the Deceased Queen.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: King Ymiron of Utgarde Pinnacle is the favored vrykul of the Lich King. That alone is reason enough to put an end to him.$BBut should he blow the horns and call for all of the leaders of the ymirjar and mjordin alike, the vrykul will become a force more powerful than any other within the Scourge!$BIt is up to you, <name>, to see to it that this does not come to pass. Bring me the locket from around his neck so that I will know that Ymiron no longer poses a threat.

title: Proof of Demise: Ley-Guardian Eregos
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Ley Line Tuner.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: The Nexus War rages on and we must do something to turn the tide! Are you willing to fly into the heart of the battle, <name>?$BLey-Guardian Eregos is the protector of the conduit through which Malygos is funneling the magical power of Azeroth's ley lines. If he can be slain it will be a great blow to the enemy.$BPlease bring me one of his ley line tuners so that we might study it.

title: Proof of Demise: The Prophet Tharon'ja
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Prophet's Enchanted Tiki.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: Drak'Tharon Keep once stood as a proud bastion of the Drakkari nation. Now it is nothing more than a stepping stone for the Lich King in his fight to put an end to Zul'Drak and steal the powers of the troll gods.$BBut if we were to eliminate their leader, the Prophet Tharon'ja, perhaps we could stop the flow of Scourge troll reinforcements. At the very least this would give the Argent Crusade in Zul'Drak one less thing to worry about.$BReturn to me with his tiki so I will know the prophet is slain.

title: Opportunity
obj_text: Speak to Sergeant Kregga below Icecrown Citadel.
desc_text: We recently came upon schematics that indicate a weakness in Icecrown Citadel.  An opening in its defenses, both figuratively and literally.$BThe captured diagrams show an orifice leading several hundred feet into the ground.  We're unsure of its purpose, but our scouting has revealed it to be of high importance to the Scourge.$BSpeak to Sergeant Kregga below Icecrown Citadel, she's leading the attack on the site.

title: Proof of Demise: Ingvar the Plunderer
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Axe of the Plunderer.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: I need you to assemble a group and lead them into Utgarde Keep. Therein, you are to find and slay Ingvar the Plunderer before he can lead his vrykul forces to sack the nearby Alliance and Horde towns.$BI require his axe as proof that he has been dealt with. It's not that I don't trust you. It's simply prudent to be certain that the deed has been done.

title: Establishing Superiority
obj_text:
Sergeant Kregga at Icecrown Citadel wants you to slay 10 Hulking Horrors.
 Hulking Horror slain (10)
desc_text: We've one shot at dealing some damage to this place -- let's make sure we get it right.$BWe've acquired potent, Scourge-made, saronite bombs.  But we must secure this area before we can set them off.$BWe're going to need to get the Scourge defenses under control quickly, before reinforcements arrive.$BHelp my men out and come back when you're ready for some fireworks.

title: Proof of Demise: Anub'arak
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Idle Crown of Anub'arak.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: The Scourged nerubians are a plague upon our forces.$BWhile we are safe from them here, floating above the world, when we set foot upon the land below, it is always with the thought that the undead nerubians could burrow up from the depths of Azjol-Nerub and attack.$BIt's in the best interests of everyone if they are thrown into a state of disarray. Kill their former king, and major-domo to the Lich King, the crypt lord, Anub'arak.$BPlease bring me his crown... not that he wears it any longer.

title: Proof of Demise: Keristrasza
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with Keristrasza's Broken Heart.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: Are you familiar with the story of Keristrasza?$BHow she was instrumental in the slaying of Saragosa, the mate of Malygos? How, in turn, he took Keristrasza as his consort, freezing her within a block of ice?$BWe have become aware that Malygos has been using his magic to break her will. This has driven her insane.$B<name>, you must go into the Nexus in Coldarra and put an end to her before she can be fully turned.$BThough it saddens me, I must insist that you bring me her heart as proof.

title: Blow it Up!
obj_text: Go to the nearby Saronite Bomb Stack to light the fuse.
desc_text: This is probably as under-control as this situation is going to get.  Let's do this, <name>.$BI need someone to light the fuse on those bombs and it looks like you're the one to do it.

title: Takes One to Know One
obj_text: Sky-Reaver Korm wants you to speak to Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer.
desc_text: While we should never miss an opportunity to strike out against the Alliance, we mustn't forget about the Scourge.$BWe won't have the numbers here to make a proper assault in the glacier for weeks, but that won't keep us from learning all we can know about their defenses.$BI have asked our resident death knight to advise you in this effort. After all, who better knows this enemy than they?$BAllow me to introduce Koltira Deathweaver.

title: A Short Fuse
obj_text: Look for clues wherever the fall takes you.
desc_text: As you light the fuse, you notice that it is consumed by fire far quicker than you would expect.$BThe bombs are about to go off and your best chance at surviving is to lean towards the pit and hope the fall doesn't kill you.

title: Proof of Demise: Mal'Ganis
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Artifact from the Nathrezim Homeworld.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: <name>, a friend within the bronze dragonflight has given me information that we must exploit.$BThe mysterious beings of the Burning Legion called the dreadlords are also known racially as the Nathrezim. Little is known of their homeworld and even that is rumor.$BHowever, it is known that Mal'Ganis of the past has made a critical error: he left behind an artifact from his homeworld!$BThrough the Caverns of Time, you must travel back to the time known as the Culling of Stratholme. Recover the artifact.

title: A Voice in the Dark
obj_text: Investigate the nearby voice in Naz'anak, the Forgotten Depths.
desc_text: The object is not a crystal at all, but some form of organ, encased in ice.$BAs you touch it, your hand reels in horrible pain.  You feel as if your hand has been cut, yet there is no visible wound.$BAs you collect your thoughts, you hear a young boy's voice nearby.$B"You really shouldn't have done that."

title: Proof of Demise: Loken
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Celestial Ruby Ring.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: Within the Halls of Lightning, Loken is poised to put an end to our world. Need I say more, <name>?$BHe sits there listening to the mad whisperings of the Old God trapped beneath Northrend. You and your friends must travel to the Storm Peaks immediately!$BConfront Loken within the Terrestrial Watchtower and stop him before it is too late! Bring me his ruby ring so that I will know we are safe once more.

title: Proof of Demise: Gal'darah
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Mojo Remnant of Akali.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: The Drakkari prophets of Zul'Drak have done the unthinkable: they've slain most of their gods to absorb their powers! The most dangerous of all is the High Prophet of Akali, Gal'darah.$BSequestered within the bowels of Gundrak, Gal'darah has absorbed almost all of the mojo from slain Akali and now stands poised to erupt with his followers from the city. If we do not kill him now, we will be awash in a sea of madness and unthinkable power!$BHurry, <name>, bring me what's left of Akali's mojo.

title: Volatility
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Copperclaw wants you to use Copperclaw's Volatile Oil at the Broken Front to attract 3 Frostbrood Skytalons.$BTo use the oil, you must collect a Pile of Bones, an Abandoned Helm, and Abandoned Armor from the battlefield there.
 Field Tests Conducted (3)
desc_text: Wahooo! It works! Not that I had any doubts in my supernatural ingenuity, only that I wasn't quite sure what kind of explosion to expect - let's just say I'm glad to see that you didn't get your eyebrows singed off. So now I just need to show ol' Korm how ya thaw out one 'a them wyrms. He'll hafta promote me to... to... to whatever comes after Chief Engineer! Here, you take another batch of the stuff and head back out to the front and I'll go get Korm...$BWell? Move out!

title: Proof of Demise: Sjonnir The Ironshaper
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Curse of Flesh Disc.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: Little is understood about the condition known as the Curse of Flesh. However, there is information to be had within the Halls of Stone.$BSjonnir The Ironshaper seems to know a great deal with regard to the curse. We have it on good authority that he is carrying a Titan disc of information upon him that could answer all of our questions.$BRetrieve this disc for me, <name>, so that we may learn.

title: Proof of Demise: Cyanigosa
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Head of Cyanigosa.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: We're being invaded! The blue dragonflight has teleported into the Violet Hold and they're planning on breaking out from there into the rest of Dalaran!$BThere have already been reports of prisoners inadvertently being freed by their actions. It wouldn't surprise me if they're purposefully letting some of them free.$B<name>, can you assemble your team quickly and get in there? Cyanigosa is the leader of their invasion force. Bring me her head!

title: That's Abominable!
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
 Icy Ghouls Exploded (15)
 Vicious Geists Exploded (15)
 Risen Alliance Soldiers Exploded (15)
desc_text: Abominations...$BThey can be a very capable enemy. I've seen them turn the tide of battle more than once. What few realize, is that they can also be very capable friends.$BThey are not deep thinkers. If you know the secrets of their creation, you can issue them basic orders that they will not question.$BFortunately for you, I know these secrets.$BThis kit will reanimate the remains of the abominations you defeat. Take it, and learn to use them against the Scourge on the death gate.

title: Coprous the Defiled
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to kill Coprous the Defiled at Mord'rethar.
 Coprous the Defiled Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Reports of a powerful zombie at the death gate have reached my ears, <class>.$BWe cannot allow a potential threat such as this to go unchallenged. Any information you are able to glean from engaging it will be better than what we know now.$BGo to the western chamber of the gate and find this creature. Fight him, and find a weakness we might exploit.

title: That's Abominable!
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
 Icy Ghouls Exploded (15)
 Vicious Geists Exploded (15)
 Risen Alliance Soldiers Exploded (15)
desc_text: You know what to do, <class>.$BTake this kit and use the guts from their abominations to create one of your own, then command it to attack the enemy forces at the gate.$BYou would do well to refine this tactic for when we make our assault on the gate.

title: The Core's Keeper
obj_text: Obtain Norgannon's Core.
desc_text: Prospector Soren's notes say that Norgannon's Core is in the keeping of a sentinel named Athan, one of Mimir's creations.$BSoren says the vault where Athan resides is called "Loken's Bargain" these days.$BLoken, eh? The earthen have mentioned him.$BThe vault is said to be southwest of the ruined Explorers' League camp, with a round entrance on a mountainside overlooking the Valley of Ancient Winters.$BFind this Athan and get the core from him, but I wouldn't be surprised if you were in for a fight.

title: Time to Hide
obj_text: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.
desc_text: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!

title: Against the Giants
obj_text: Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer wants you to bring him 5 Pustulant Spines from the Pustulant Horrors on Mord'rethar.
desc_text: While it's going to be crucial to defeat the Scourge on the ground, we mustn't neglect the gate itself.$BThe flesh giants on the ramparts are capable of hurling massive boulders and chunks of ice, inflicting devastating damage to enemy infantry below.$BMuster a force and defeat these giants. We need to know just what we're up against in terms of their strength.$BOh... and bring me their spines. If memory serves, there's a little trick I can share with you.

title: Basic Chemistry
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a plague cauldron at Mord'rethar.
 Plague Cauldron Neutralized
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: <Koltira takes the pustulant spines and drains their fluid into a flask.>$BA little-known quality of the flesh giants...$BTheir spinal fluid interacts with the plague in a very interesting way, turning it into a corrosive acid.$BPoured from the towering ramparts, acid may not be a welcome sight to the troops below, but at least the victims won't rise up and add to the enemy's numbers.$BPour the contents of this flask into one of the plague cauldrons in the western chamber of the death gate.

title: Going After the Core
obj_text: Find Prospector Khrona's Notes and Prospector Soren's Maps at Brann's Base-Camp.
desc_text: With Norgannon's Shell in hand, only half of the archive key remains to be found. Luckily, I've had the Explorers' League hard at work chasing down leads about the whereabouts of Norgannon's Core.$BFar to the southeast of the Inventor's Library, on the slopes to the north of Dun Niffelem, is a camp bearing my name. The Explorers' League representatives seeking the second half of the key are based there. Bring me the maps and the notes they've made and we should be able to track down the other key half.

title: Neutralizing the Plague
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a blight cauldron at Mord'rethar.$BYou can create Pustulant Spinal Fluid by using a Giant Spine collected from a Pustulant Horror.
 Plague Cauldron Neutralized
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: You no longer need my assistance in neutralizing the enemy's plague cauldrons, <race>.$BHunt down the flesh giants at the death gate and use the fluid from their spines to render batches of the plague ineffective.$BYou are striking at the heart of the enemy's strategy. This is an important mission - vital to our cause, and should be carried out whenever time permits.$BRemember, the giants and the plague cauldrons can be found on Mord'rethar.

title: Return to the Surface
obj_text: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
desc_text: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.

title: Forging the Keystone
obj_text:
rann Bronzebeard wants you to meet him at the Temple of Invention and help him combine Norgannon's Shell and Norgannon's Core. Once you have helped Brann, report back to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
 Help Brann create the keystone
desc_text: Aha! Here it is: the Temple of Invention, the seat of Keeper Mimir himself! Of course, that's where one would go to join the two parts of the key.$BAccording to the prospector's notes, the Temple of Invention is one of the highest points on the western side of the Terrace of the Makers. That means it should be roughly east of your Grom'arsh Crash Site.$BI'll meet you at the temple and we'll combine the parts together.

title: Get to Ymirheim!
obj_text: Speak with Blast Thunderbomb in Ymirheim.
desc_text: You need to get down to Ymirheim, that big frost vrykul town in the middle of Icecrown.$BOur boy, Blast Thunderbomb, is down there on the west side of town representing the Warsong Offensive in a competition against the Alliance. It's his jumpbot versus theirs in a king of the mountain contest!$BDon't let us down, <name>. Goblin engineering pride is on the line! Besides, all the boys here in the hold are counting on you.$BThat and we've got money riding on it that you can kick those cowards in the pants!

title: Slaves to Saronite
obj_text:
rother Keltan aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to rescue 10 Saronite Mine Slaves.
 Saronite Mine Slave rescued (10)
desc_text: Our people are being captured and put to work as slaves in the saronite mines of Ymirheim, the vrykul stronghold in the middle of Icecrown. The Lich King has them mining that unholy ore day and night.$BI made a promise to Highlord Fordring that we would get those wretches out of there alive, and that's exactly what we will do.$BUnfortunately, I've been ordered to stay on this gunship and serve as an ambassador to the Warsong Offensive. Will you please rescue them in my stead, <name>?

title: Proof of Demise: Herald Volazj
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with the Faceless One's Withered Brain.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: The nerubians of Ahn'kahet dug too deep during their attempt to escape the invasion of the Scourge. They got too close to the Old God under Northrend.$BRousing its awareness, the Old God sent its insane creatures against them, and the nerubians were caught between the proverbial rock and a hard place.$BThe leader of the Old Gods' forces, Herald Volazj is one of the nightmarish beings known as The Faceless. Put an end to him and bring me his withered brain.$BJust please, try to keep your sanity.

title: King of the Mountain
obj_text:
last Thunderbomb in Ymirheim wants you to use his Thunderbomb's Jumpbot to plant the Horde Battle Standard in the skulls at the top of the mountain.
 Horde Battle Standard planted
desc_text: Yo, <name>, I need you to get my jumpbot to the top of this mountain to the southeast, like yesterday!$BThat girly, self-righteous Frazzle Geargrinder thinks that her jumpbot's better than mine. Hah! We're in a race to see who's gonna be king of the mountain!$BOnce you jump up there, plant our battle standard in the pile of bones and show everyone that the Horde, and my mad engineering skills, are the best!

title: Do Your Worst
obj_text:
Use the Refurbished Demolisher to destroy 150 Decomposed Ghouls, 20 Frostskull Mages and 2 Bone Giants in the Valley of Lost Hope.  Speak to Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp when you've completed this task.
 Decomposed Ghoul slain (150)
 Frostskull Magus slain (20)
 Bone Giant slain (2)
desc_text: You're going to use this machine against the Scourge?  You're not going to win against them like that.$BYou can destroy hundreds... even thousands of them.  But you won't win.  Not out here.$BWhen you're done playing with your machine, meet me to the north.  There is an old army encampment.  What I will show you will teach you a little bit about who you're up against.

title: Field Repairs
obj_text: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to collect 5 Demolisher Parts from the Scavenging Geists in the Valley of Lost Hope and take them to the Wrecked Demolisher.
desc_text: The Scourge is still reeling from our attack, <name>.  Now is the time to capitalize on our momentum.$BThe strategically important valley below us is wide open.  We've located a disassembled demolisher vehicle in what we believe is working condition in the southeastern corner of the Valley of Lost Hope area.$BIf you can get the remaining parts from the Scourge scavengers, you should be able to get it running again.  A single working demolisher can wreak havoc on the enemy's ground units.

title: Assault by Ground
obj_text:
Escort the Kor'kron troops to the gates of Ymirheim. Return to Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim for compensation after the task is complete.
 Horde troops escorted to Ymirheim (4)
desc_text: Greetings <class>.$BOur troops have been attempting to storm Ymirheim for some time, but these vrykul are far more vicious than any we've faced before. They've been ambushing us repeatedly as we try to make it up the pass, and we've lost a lot of men.$BIf you want to lend yourself to the battle and help get my squad to the gates of Ymirheim safely, we will gladly reward you for your efforts. Once at the gates, we'll dig in and wait for reinforcements to catch up to us.

title: The Guardians of Corp'rethar
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to kill 5 Harbingers of Horror and 5 Corp'rethar Guardians.
 Harbinger of Horror slain (5)
 Corp'rethar Guardian slain (5)
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Corp'rethar, called the Horror Gate. It is the last barrier between us and the Icecrown Citadel. It waits to the south of the Ironwall Rampart, beyond the glacier and the Conflagration. By the time our troops reach it, they will be exhausted and worse.$BWe must weaken its defenses, or our army's strength will break upon its walls.$BIts battlements are manned by some of the Lich King's fiercest and most zealous servants. Do all you can to destroy these guardians and hope it is enough.

title: Bloodspattered Banners
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to kill 5 Scourge Banner-Bearers, 5 Scourge Converters, and 20 Converted Heroes.
 Scourge Banner-Bearer slain (5)
 Converted Hero slain (20)
 Scourge Converter slain (5)
desc_text: In the Valley of Fallen Heroes and Icecrown Glacier, to the west of Aldur'thar, the Scourge seeks to use the fallen against us. Scourge lieutenants have woken the valley's dead and imbued them with fearsome strength and fervor. The banners carried by the Scourge leaders in the glacier area are the source of these powers. Kill the banner-bearers, and you will weaken the converted heroes they lead.$BIt falls to you to rid us of this obstacle, and thin the resistance before the main body can advance.

title: Assault by Air
obj_text:
Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim has ordered you to use the Kor'kron Suppression Turret to keep the Kor'kron Troop Transport alive long enough to make all of its drops.
 Kor'kron Infiltrators dropped (4)
desc_text: Alright scrub, I've got something to keep you from being a complete waste.$BA unit of highly trained infiltrators is ready to be dropped inside of Ymirheim. The vrykul inside have automated spear guns that have been ripping our transports to shreds, so we had the engineers on Orgrim's Hammer whip us up a suppression turret.$BYou're the gunner. Launch rounds at their spear guns to obscure their vision and clog their gears. See to it that my men all make their drops and the transport stays in one piece.

title: The Ironwall Rampart
obj_text:
Defeat Grimkor the Wicked and return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
 Grimkor the Wicked slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: The Ironwall Rampart overlooks the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar. The rampart dominates the fields below on all sides. We will not be able to advance if the rampart cannot be taken, but it is held by Grimkor the Wicked and his Cult of the Damned disciples.$BIf you can weaken Grimkor, our forces know what to expect as we advance. Take this rune of distortion. Unleashing its power near Grimkor's orb at the end of the rampart should be enough to get the necromancer's attention.

title: Raise the Barricades
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to construct 8 Barricades using your Barricade Construction Kit.
 Barricades constructed (8)
desc_text: When our forces begin to move beyond Aldur'thar, they will be vulnerable to attack from the Ironwall Rampart and the broad glacier below.$BWe have neither the time nor the materials to build fortifications, but we can put up some barricades to shield our men from fire and break up Scourge charges.$BTake this barricade kit to the Valley of Fallen Heroes, on the west side of Aldur'thar. Locate the markers I've placed there and use this kit to construct your barricades there.

title: Darkmoon Chaos Deck
obj_text: Return the Chaos Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
desc_text: Now that you have gathered all of the Chaos cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.

title: Blinding the Eyes in the Sky
obj_text:
Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
 Skybreaker Recon Fighters shot down (6)
desc_text: The Alliance has somehow managed to field a squadron of recon vehicles over the Valley of Fallen Heroes and Icecrown Glacier, the broad areas west of Aldur'thar.$BThey cannot be permitted to take the lead in this fight. Chief Engineer Copperclaw has supplied me with the perfect weapon to deal with this threat -- he calls his new missile the SGM-3. I have his assurances that it will take out the Alliance flying machines in a single hit. Go and use this weapon to give us the upper hand.

title: Blood of the Chosen
obj_text:
Warbringer Davos Rioht on Orgrim's Hammer has sent you to kill 20 vrykul in Ymirheim.
 $BYmirheim Vrykul slain (20)

 Blight Falconer
 Ymirjar Element Shaper
 Foreman Thaldrin
$B

 Ymirheim Defender
 VEHICLE TEST - ANIM  BONE MANIPULATOR
 Ymirheim Chosen Warrior
desc_text: Those vrykul that have gained the favor of the Lich King call themselves the Ymirjar. They inhabit a city in the center of Icecrown. We have a lot of preparations to make before we assault Icecrown Citadel, and the one that stands before us now is routing these so-called "Chosen" of the Lich King.$BGo to their city, Ymirheim, and slaughter them in their home. Let there be no questions as to who the stronger combatants are here.

title: Darkmoon Prisms Deck
obj_text: Return the Prisms Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
desc_text: Now that you have gathered all of the Prism cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.

title: Mind Tricks
obj_text: Darkspeaker R'khem in the Saronite Mines wants you to recover the Foreman's Key to his chains.
desc_text: <The creature speaks directly into your mind, its thoughts painful and strange.>$B<race>-thing, I am in need of your assistance. Like your enslaved friends, I am a victim of the Lich King's ymirjar and their avarice. When I rose from below to investigate the noises coming from this cavern they captured and chained me.$BWill you please help me? The foreman of these mines holds the key to my chains. Kill him!$B<You can feel a pushing against your mind as if the creature is trying to coerce you.>

title: Keeping the Alliance Blind
obj_text:
Use the SGM-3 to destroy 6 Skybreaker Recon Fighters, then report back to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
 Skybreaker Recon Fighters shot down (6)
desc_text: The Alliance is tenacious, I'll give them that, but it'll take more than that to stop us. Take this SGM-3 with you and shoot down the Skybreaker's recon fighters once again.$BI doubt the message will get through their thick skulls, but there are enough missiles to keep trying to get our point across. Go and find their fighters flying above the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar, and don't come back until you've made wreckage of them.

title: Before the Gate of Horror
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to use the Volatile Acid to dissolve the remains of 6 Skeletal Reavers.
 Skeletal Reaver bones dissolved (6)
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: The Conflagration, the ground before Corp'rethar, south of the Ironwall Rampart, is where the Lich King's elite soldiers have formed up to defend the citadel.$BLed by a contingent of death knights, a legion of skeletal reavers bars the way. I fear that even when these reavers fall, the Scourge will simply reconstitute them and send them back at us.$BI've come up with a plan to stop this, but I have no way of knowing if it will work. Take this solution and use it to dissolve the remains of the reavers.

title: Futility
obj_text: Return to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
desc_text: Do you see now?  Sending your men against the prince's armies just swells their numbers.$BI don't expect you to understand... you'll probably just end up like the others.  You'd best return to whoever sent you.  They might be worried.

title: Cradle of the Frostbrood
obj_text:
Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to slay 5 Wyrm Reanimators, 8 Cultist Corrupters and 3 Vrykul Necrolords at Sindragosa's Fall.
 Wyrm Reanimator slain (5)
 Cultist Corrupter slain (8)
 Vrykul Necrolord slain (3)
desc_text: We need to keep our momentum going.  Let's not give the Scourge forces any respite.$BSindragosa's Fall lies east just beyond the Valley of Lost Hope.  The Cult of the Damned operate there, under close supervision of the Lich King's undead vrykul lackeys.$BIt is a place of great power, possibly a blue dragonflight graveyard.  The feared frostbrood are raised there from the bones of blue dragons.$BAn attack there would have great impact on the enemy's access to frost wyrms.  Are you up to it, <name>?

title: Darkmoon Nobles Deck
obj_text: Return the Nobles Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
desc_text: Now that you have gathered all of the Nobles cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.

title: Sneak Preview
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to fly down to the gate of desolation, visiting the south, central, north, and northwest regions of the gate.
 Aldur'thar South Visited
 Aldur'thar Central Visited
 Aldur'thar North Visited
 Aldur'thar Northwest Visited
desc_text: Progress is being made. We have a promising array of tactics that should gain us control of the death gate. There will doubtlessly be many casualties, but in the end,  we should be able to prevail - barring any interference from the Alliance.$BOur next focus will be Aldur'thar, the gate of desolation. Fly down and become familiar with it and with the enemies posted there.$BWhen you return, I will have your missions prepared.

title: Drag and Drop
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
 Dark Subjugator dragged and dropped (3)
desc_text: The Cult of the Damned hold the gate of desolation, eh? No surprise there.$BTime to have a little fun. At the southern end of the gate, you mentioned there were new cultists being trained. They're almost certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$BThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$BKill the fools until you find one, <class>, then use it on a subjugator.

title: Mystery of the Infinite, Redux
obj_text:
Chromie, at the top of Wyrmrest Temple, has asked you to travel once more to the Bronze Dragonshrine.$BOnce inside, place the Hourglass of Eternity on the ground and help your Past Self to protect it from the forces of the Infinite Dragonflight.
 $BHourglass of Eternity protected from the Infinite Dragonflight.
desc_text: There you are! Or, were we just talking?$B<Chromie muses over the temporal possibilities.>$BAnyway, the Infinites are after you! Well, not you per-se. Rather, they're after the past version of you that defended the Hourglass of Eternity. You remember, right?$BThat was you back then, except it's you now too. Wait, that's not important. What is important is that you head back to the Bronze Dragonshrine and defend yourself and the hourglass from their attacks before you get erased from history!

title: Darkmoon Undeath Deck
obj_text: Return the Undeath Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
desc_text: Now that you have gathered all of the Undeath cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.

title: Drag and Drop
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
 Dark Subjugator dragged and dropped (3)
desc_text: Looks like those initiates are increasing in number again. You know what to do...$BAt the southern portion of the gate, the new cultists are being trained. They're certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$BThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$BSlay the fools until you find some, then use them on the subjugators there.

title: Chain of Command
obj_text:
Koltira aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to go to Aldur'thar and defeat Overseer Faedris, Overseer Savryn, Overseer Veraj, and Overseer Jhaeqon.
 Overseer Faedris Killed
 Overseer Jhaeqon Killed
 Overseer Veraj Killed
 Overseer Savryn Killed
desc_text: ased on your report, and my knowledge of the Cult, they have an overseer managing the operation of each encampment on the gate.$BWhile taking their leaders down will only be a temporary setback, it will at least slow them down and keep them off-balance. And that, <race>, is a worthy enough goal for now.$BSeek out these overseers and return to me when they have been dispatched.

title: Cannot Reproduce
obj_text:
Koltira aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to use the Partitioned Flask at each of the 3 Cultists' Cauldrons at Aldur'thar, then bring it to Chief Engineer Copperclaw.
 Blue Sample Collected
 Green Sample Collected
 Dark Sample Collected
desc_text: I smell their cauldrons from here, but that's not plague they're cooking.$BPledges to the cult are forced to drink a concoction that steals their will and enslaves them forever to the Lich King.$BSome say the potion contains the twisted soul of a being who was tormented before being mercilessly slaughtered, but I've never been able to reproduce it...$BFill this flask with a sample from each of the three cauldrons in the northwest region of the gate and bring it to Chief Engineer Copperclaw.

title: Retest Now
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Copperclaw aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to throw a Writhing Mass into a cauldron at Aldur'thar.
 Writhing Mass Banished
desc_text: This should do the trick!$BThose twisted hooligans are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then I say we help 'em out a bit!$BTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... Its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence once you've defeated them.$BWhen you've collected a bunch of essences, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls into any of their cauldrons.$BLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!

title: The Hunter and the Prince
obj_text:
Matthias Lehner in the Court of Bones wants you to look for a Bloodstained Stone and complete the Prince's Destiny.
 The Prince's Destiny
desc_text: efore the prince became a king, he fought many battles... but only one where he came close to dying.$BIt was fought right here.  After you let me show you what happened, you'll understand everything.$BFind a bloodstained stone and pick it up from the floor.  You'll see what happened.

title: Retest Now
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Copperclaw aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to throw a Writhing Mass into a cauldron at Aldur'thar.
 Writhing Mass Banished
desc_text: Those twisted cultists are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then let's help 'em out a bit!$BTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... I'm almost positive that its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence.$BOnce you've collected a bunch of 'em, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls in one of their cauldrons.$BLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!

title: Not a Bug
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
 Dark Messenger summoned
desc_text: Alright, <friend/missy>, time to plant a bug.$BRelax, it's not a bug exactly, but it'll serve our purposes.$BIn the northern portion of Aldur'thar, the cult's void summoners enslave demonic minions. Use this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of these enslaved minions, and then use the cultists' summoning crystal to bring our little spy into being.$BUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.

title: Shatter the Shards
obj_text: ring the Broken Shard of Horror, the Broken Shard of Despair, and the Broken Shard of Suffering to Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
desc_text: Atop the battlements of Corp'rethar, the Lich King's minions have erected three crystals, the shards of horror, despair, and suffering. Should our men reach the walls of Corp'rethar, he will unleash these weapons on our army.$BIn full effect, the crystals will afflict the minds of our men with paralyzing pain and fear. Then, the Scourge will be able to slaughter them at will.$BFind these shards, destroy them, and bring me their broken remains. We cannot allow the Lich King to deploy these weapons!

title: Where Dragons Fell
obj_text: Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall wants you to obtain 6 Whelp Bone Dusts.
desc_text: A whole brood of blue dragons fell here.  And now, one by one, they're being raised by his servants.$BHe raised the biggest of them all himself.  Bring me some bone dust from the whelps and I'll show you exactly how he did it.

title: Time for Answers
obj_text: Speak to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones.
desc_text: You have a lot of questions, <name>.  You're the only one who can see me because you touched something that once belonged to him... don't you remember?$BYou don't know what it is?  Well I can't just tell you... that would make him really mad.  He's not just a prince anymore... he's the king!$BMeet me at the Court of Bones, north of Icecrown Citadel and you can see for yourself.

title: Knowledge is a Terrible Burden
obj_text: Report back to Koltira aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
desc_text: Now you know what you're up against, <name>.  An opponent who no longer knows pain... remorse... or humanity.  An opponent who will do anything to get what he wants.$BThe heart was his weakness and now he knows you've found it.$BIf you're going to go back for it, you'd best bring help.  He will not leave it unguarded again.

title: Argent Aid
obj_text: Speak to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Crusader's Pinnacle.
desc_text: There were rumors about the events you speak of among the death knights.  I always expected the story to be more... symbolic.$BWe must warn others, but we must be discreet.  As soon as the Lich King knows we're making our move, he'll move the location of the heart -- we'll never get a chance like this again.$BThe Horde and the Alliance have been infiltrated by the Cult of the Damned before.  The Ebon Blade operates too close to the Scourge.$BWe have to speak to Tirion Fordring and his Argent Crusade.

title: Tirion's Gambit
obj_text:
Tirion Fordring, at the Crusader's Pinnacle, wants you to obtain and wear a Cultist Acolyte's Hood and meet him at the entrance of the Cathedral of Darkness, northwest of Icecrown Citadel.
 Tirion's Gambit
desc_text: Just this morning, my scouts informed me of a Cult of the Damned procession leaving from Icecrown Citadel to the Cathedral of Darkness, bearing an artifact.$BAnd now I learn that it might be Arthas's own heart... a thing containing the last bit of his remaining humanity.$BThis is a sign of the Light.  As long as such an artifact exists, there is a chance that Arthas Menethil can become a man again!$BMeet me at the cathedral's entrance.  Be sure to bring a cultist's hood -- we're going incognito.

title: No Rest For The Wicked
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to slay Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
 Alumeth the Ascended Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: These fools have actually stumbled upon something that could pose a serious threat to our plans!$BThe leader of this particular sect, Alumeth, has ritualistically sacrificed himself and now his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$BIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$BCombine his heart, skull, scepter and robes from around their chamber and use his remains on the crystal there.$BHurry, <race>! Destroy him before he becomes any more powerful!

title: Not a Bug
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
 Dark Messenger summoned
desc_text: The cultists have discovered the last messenger you summoned, <race>.$BWhile it was quite informative, it's important that we continue to monitor the cult's every move.$BUse this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of enslaved minions at Aldur'thar. Then use their summoning crystal to bring another dark messenger into being.$BUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.

title: No Rest For The Wicked
obj_text:
Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to slay Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
 Alumeth the Ascended Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: It's Alumeth... He's growing in power again. I can sense it. Again his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$BIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$BReturn to his chamber in the north portion of Aldur'thar. Combine his heart, skull, scepter and robes, then use his remains on the crystal there.$BHurry, <race>! Destroy him while there's still time!

title: Fringe Science Benefits
obj_text:
Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (40)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender
$B

 Bombardment Infantry
$B
$B
 $BBombardment Captain slain (8)

 Stitched Brute
 Stitched Brute
$B

 Bombardment Captain
$B
$B
 $BGargoyle Ambusher slain (15)

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B

 Gargoyle Ambusher
desc_text: I installed our infra-green technology into commandeered bombers; it'll protect you on your first mission into enemy territory!  Speak with Rizzy Ratchwiggle to get a bomber, then fly into The Bombardment!$BYou'll have bombs and rockets and shields.  Keep the shields charged and use bombs on the ground Scourge at The Bombardment.  Come back after you hit your targets, and more work will await you.

title: Need More Info
obj_text: Koltira, aboard Orgrim's Hammer, wants you to collect the 3 pages of Cultists' Research from the Cult Researchers at Aldur'thar and use them to create the Cult of the Damned Thesis.
desc_text: The Cult of the Damned are notorious for concocting grandiose plans that in the end, rarely succeed. But something feels different this time....$BPerhaps it's the proximity to the Lich King that has their fervor heightened. Whatever it is, they appear to be more confident than ever. We must know what feeds this bravado and then find a way to strip them of it!$BI believe the key lies with their researchers. Find out what they're up to and report back to me with the details.

title: Chief Engineer Copperclaw
obj_text: Speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw.
desc_text: Speak with Chief Engineer Copperclaw.

title: Total Ohmage: The Valley of Lost Hope!
obj_text:
Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (50)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender
$B

 Bombardment Infantry
$B
$B
 $BGargoyle Ambusher slain (20)

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B
$B
 Scourge War Machine slain (12)
 $BFrostbrood Sentry slain (12)

 Frostbrood Sentry
$B

 Frostbrood Sentry
desc_text: <name>, the struggle continues.  Lucky for us, we're stocked up on bombs and rockets!  Time for another bombing mission  --  this one's a long one, through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope.  Head back out with an infra-green bomber and blow those Scourge into little scourge-lets!

title: Green Technology
obj_text: Speak with Fringe Engineer Tezzla.
desc_text: Tezzla is the one you want to meet, yes she is... she mastered a new wavelength, infra-green, and used it to hide herself near the Scourge!  Near enough to bomb them!$BI'll give you infra-green vision so you can find her hiding above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  Go, go... I know she has work for brave heroes eager to blow up!  I mean... eager to blow up the Scourge!$BAnd <name>, the Alliance has stolen our technology and has their own hidden airport nearby.  Avoid the dome with the Alliance banners!

title: Amped for Revolt!
obj_text:
Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill Bombardment Infantry, Gargoyle Ambushers, Frostbrood Sentries and Scourge War Machines.$B
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (40)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender

 Scourge War Machine slain (10)
 $BFrostbrood Sentry slain (10)

 Frostbrood Sentry
$B

 Frostbrood Sentry
desc_text: <name>, only our best pilots are given a mission like this, one deep, deep into enemy territory with only the power of infra-green technology to protect you!$BRequest another bomber from Rizzle, and this time fly it through the Valley of Lost Hope.  You have both air and ground targets on this mission, so keep your eyes open and your shields at full!$BGood luck!

title: Riding the Wavelength: The Bombardment
obj_text:
Fringe Engineer Tezzla wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (50)
