 Gargoyle Ambusher
desc_text: Ready to warm up with a short bombing mission?  You have your orders, and we have our bombers stocked and ready.

title: UNUSED - The Heroic Key to the Focusing Iris
obj_text: Deliver the Heroic Key to the Focusing Iris to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: A potent thrumming of magical nature can be heard and felt emanating from the eye-shaped jewel dropped from Sapphiron's clutches. To mortal ears it is nearly painful to be in the presence of the stone.$BSurely such a powerful item of import can only be taken to the queen of the dragons, Alexstrasza the Life-Binder. Seek her counsel atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.

title: UNUSED - Heroic Judgment at the Eye of Eternity
obj_text: Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight wants you to return with the Heart of Magic.$BThis quest is for the Heroic mode, 25-person version of The Eye of Eternity.
desc_text: Now that you have access to the focusing iris it's time to put that key to use.$BAs much as I would like to see Malygos brought back into the fold, that's just not going to happen at this point. With everything that's at stake, it is the judgment of the other Dragon Aspects that the Spell-Weaver needs to be put down.$B<Krasus says this last with a great deal of trepidation.>$B<name>, travel to the Eye of Eternity, confront Malygos and return with the Heart of Magic.

title: Aces High!
obj_text:
Corastrasza on the upper ring of the Nexus in Coldarra wants you to ride her drake and kill 5 Scalesworn Elites.
 Scalesworn Elites Slain (5)
desc_text: Again we meet, <race>. I confess, your presence is beginning to grow on me.$BAm I correct in assuming that you've come to hone your aerial combat skills?$BAs always, my pets stand ready to bring fiery destruction to the enemy.$BSpeak, and they shall be at your disposal.

title: Corastrasza
obj_text: Librarian Serrah wants you to speak to Corastrasza in Coldarra.
desc_text: Greetings, <class>. Might I impose on you for a favor?$BCorastrasza is the sister of Raelorasz - the red dragon in charge of our outpost here. Against his will, she has ascended to one of the upper rings of the Nexus to observe some frighteningly powerful blue drakes.$BThough he will never say it, he worries about her, and would welcome any news of her well-being.$BPlease seek her out. Ask her to put her pride aside and send word to her brother.

title: Aces High!
obj_text:
Corastrasza on the upper ring of the Nexus in Coldarra wants you to ride her drake and kill 5 Scalesworn Elites.
 Scalesworn Elites Killed (5)
desc_text: You possess the courage to draw so near to Malygos' lair, mortal? Or is it simply ignorance? Soon we shall know....$BI am a seasoned trainer of the graceful drakes of the red dragonflight. My business here is to study the enemy and teach my precious pets the tactics that will be most effective when we face the master of the blues.$BTo demonstrate your nerve and ability, I will allow you to ride one of my drakes against the enemy's minions.$BThe opportunity is yours for the asking...

title: The Brothers Bronzebeard
obj_text:
Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.
 $BAccompany Brann Bronzebeard to Frosthold.
desc_text: That does it! We finally have the keystone... It's beautiful! I've been around the world more than once, but this thing's got me all jittery with excitement again. I suppose now's not the time to stop and admire though, we need to get the heck out of here.$BHop on my flying machine and help keep us covered from those iron dwarves on the way out!

title: Defending Your Title
obj_text:
Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to defeat 6 Victorious Challengers.
 Victorious Challenger slain (6)
desc_text: Everyone's impressed by your performance, sister.  But do not let your guard down -- every new challenger with delusions of grandeur is going to come out swinging for your title of Hyldskvinnar.$BShow these upstarts what you're made of.

title: Preparations for War
obj_text: Speak to Sky-Reaver Klum to secure passage to Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown, and then report to Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar.
desc_text: You there!$BYou look like you have some wits about you. We could use some more able bodies in Icecrown.$BThe Alliance scum rushed into Icecrown ahead of us, unprepared, and got just what they deserved for their impatience. We took our time, we made ready, and soon we will mount a true assault from one of the most advanced pieces of engineering known to Azeroth - Orgrim's Hammer. The Alliance don't stand a chance, and neither does Arthas.$BSpeak to me when you're ready to depart and lend a hand.

title: The Aberrations Must Die
obj_text:
Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and obtain Vials of Frost Oil from the Valkyrion Aspirants.  Use the Vials of Frost Oil to destroy 30 Plagued Proto-Drake Eggs.
 Plagued Proto-Drake Egg (30)
desc_text: It is not enough to demonstrate your prowess among your peers.  You must also fight our enemies, dear sister.$BThe Valkyrion traitors continue to mock our noble drake-riding traditions by rearing plagued proto-drakes.$BSeize the frost oil they wield and use it to freeze their abominable plagued eggs.

title: The Library Console
obj_text: Take the Inventor's Disk to the Inventor's Library Console inside the Inventor's Library.
desc_text: Norgannon's shell is within our reach, <name>. Take the inventor's disk into the library's interior. There should be a console there that you can activate with the disk. I imagine Mimir stored more there than just Norgannon's shell. There are probably enough schematics stored there to keep Ironforge's engineers occupied for years!$BAnyway, bring the disk to the console. Hopefully, Mimir hasn't decided to put any more obstacles in our way.

title: Back to the Pit
obj_text:
Gretta the Arbiter, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.
 Hyldsmeet Warbear slain (6)
desc_text: To truly stay in your best riding shape you'll want to test yourself against the other Hyldnir every day.$BHead back into the Pit of the Fang and show them what you're capable of.  They'll appreciate suffering defeat to one as skilled as yourself.

title: Xarantaur, the Witness
obj_text: Speak with Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
desc_text: It seems we're not the only visitors to this area. A courier relayed a message from a tauren named Xarantaur, who said he was visiting a taunka village called Camp Tunka'lo. The note was somewhat cryptic, but it seems this Xarantaur has come to Storm Peaks to learn the history of a taunka legend.$BMeet up with him, <name>. See if what he knows can help us in any way. From his description, Camp Tunka'lo is far to the east, beyond the Terrace of the Makers and north of Dun Niffelem.

title: The Key to the Focusing Iris
obj_text: Deliver the Key to the Focusing Iris to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: A potent thrumming of magical nature can be heard and felt emanating from the eye-shaped jewel dropped from Sapphiron's clutches. To mortal ears it is nearly painful to be in the presence of the stone.$BSurely such a powerful item of import can only be taken to the queen of the dragons, Alexstrasza the Life-Binder. Seek her counsel atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.

title: Southern Sabotage
obj_text:
Destroy Shadowsight Tower, Flamewatch Tower or Winter's Edge Tower and return to Tactical Officer Ahbramis in Wintergrasp.
 Destroy one of the three southern towers
desc_text: The three towers south of the Wintergrasp river are draining power from the Fortress!$BDestroy Shadowsight Tower, Flamewatch Tower or Winter's Edge Tower, then return to me. Remember, only siege vehicles can damage a tower, so make sure to protect them from the Horde!

title: Let's Get Out of Here!
obj_text:
Escort Father Kamaros to safety and then report to Brother Keltan aboard Orgrim's Hammer.
 $BEscort Father Kamaros to safety
desc_text: The Light smiles upon me. I have not yet died in this living nightmare, but the Scourge will kill me and tear my body apart for use in their 'work' here if I cannot escape.$BI cannot make it on my own, <class>, but with your help, I may yet live to fight the Scourge again.$BWill you help me make my escape before the Scourge's butchers come to finish me off?

title: Toppling the Towers
obj_text:
Destroy Shadowsight Tower, Flamewatch Tower, or Winter's Edge Tower and return to Tactical Officer Kilrath in Wintergrasp.
 Destroy a southern tower in Wintergrasp
desc_text: While the Alliance may be pounding on our doors, a true tactician looks beyond the obvious.$B"Attack him where he is unprepared, appear where you are not expected."$B<name>, I need you to travel across the Wintergrasp River and destroy one of the three towers to the south. Our Warlocks report that the towers are draining power we could use to bolster our own troops.$BReturn to me once you've destroyed a tower.

title: Judgment at the Eye of Eternity
obj_text: Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight wants you to return with the Heart of Magic.
desc_text: Now that you have access to the focusing iris it's time to put that key to use.$BAs much as I would like to see Malygos brought back into the fold, that's just not going to happen at this point. With everything that's at stake, it is the judgment of the other Dragon Aspects that the Spell-Weaver needs to be put down.$B<Krasus says this last with a great deal of trepidation.>$B<name>, travel to the Eye of Eternity, confront Malygos and return with the Heart of Magic.

title: The Celestial Planetarium
obj_text:
Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to locate the entrance to the Celestial Planetarium.
 $BEntrance to Celestial Planetarium located
desc_text: Listen, <lad/lass>!  Azeroth's fate is at stake here.$BOur only chance is to get to the Celestial Planetarium in time to find this Algalon and stop him from beaming back any messages to his Titan masters.$BLocate the Celestial Planetarium and come back with any information you get.  We might still have some time to prepare for Algalon's arrival.

title: Freya's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Freya's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Freya's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark.  Should any of the elders be harmed, the Sigil's integrity will be compromised.$BSparing the elders, however, means that Freya will be more powerful when you face her.$BWhat can I say, <name>.  We're stuck between a rock and hard place.

title: Hodir's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!

title: The Argent Tournament
obj_text: Speak with Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament grounds to enroll in the tournament.
desc_text: We have invited you here to test your skill and valor against others who have bravely opposed the Scourge. Many have been our divisions, but the time has come for heroes fighting under all banners to test their blades against one another in preparation for facing our mutual enemy.$BMagister Edien Sunhollow is the Sunreaver representative to the tournament and he'll enter your name into the rolls and begin your training. Seek him out inside the large Horde tent in the southeastern part of the grounds.

title: Thorim's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Doren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Thorim's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Thorim's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Thorim's not himself, <name>.  He's come under a dark influence.$BAn evil presence under the guise of an illusion pretends to be his lost wife, Sif.$BYe can't let him be overcome by this impostor's spell.  If he does, the location of his sigil might forever be lost!$BYer going to have to beat some sense into him and yer going to have to do it quick.$BAs always, the Archivum Console will give ye all the gory details... even the ones ye don't like.

title: Archivum Data Disc
obj_text: ring the Archivum Data Disc to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
desc_text: This platinum disc is surprisingly symmetrical and devoid of any scratches or imperfections.  Engraved along its edge, bold runes spell out the word "ARCHIVUM."$BThere must be a device inside Ulduar capable of reading the disc.

title: Mimiron's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Doren at the Ulduar Archivum wants you to obtain Mimiron's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Mimiron's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Mimiron's a clever one.  His entire abode is rigged with some sort of self-destruction mechanism.$BUnfortunately yer gonna have to race against it if ye want to get his sigil.  Check the Archivum Console for more details if ye need them.

title: Algalon
obj_text: ring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
desc_text: You really did it, <name>.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$BYou best hurry, <lad/lass>.  Time is of the essence.

title: There's Something About the Squire
obj_text: Obtain a Large Femur from a Skeletal Woodcutter and use it to incapacitate Maloric. Search Maloric for evidence, then report back to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Every day, the Black Knight's squire, Maloric, makes a big show of heading to Crystalsong Forest with his axe over his shoulder. He wants us to believe he's chopping wood, but he never returns with more than a few twigs.$BHe usually goes toward the ruins southwest of the Mirror of Twilight. He spends a lot of time out there, even for a squire with responsibilities to his knight.$BFind a way to distract or incapacitate him and search him. If he's up to something, we'll know it.

title: Ancient History
obj_text: ring the Shattered Fragments of Val'anyr to the Archivum Console in the Archivum in Ulduar.
desc_text: The pieces fit together to form an elegant hammer.  Its construction appears to be at least partially Titan in nature.$BThe console inside the Archivum might have some information regarding this artifact.

title: The Black Knight's Fall
obj_text:
Defeat the Black Knight and then speak to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 The Black Knight slain
desc_text: We must put an end to the Black Knight's scheming, and show those who oppose us that we will not stand by and allow our champions to be murdered.$BBy now, he will suspect that someone is on his trail. Challenge him in the light of day, where he cannot refuse or murder in the dark, <name>.$BUse my argent charger for the battle. It's housed in the stables.$BSpeak to Squire Cavin at the Ring of Champions. The squire will call the Black Knight to battle, but you will make him answer for his crimes.

title: The Stories Dead Men Tell
obj_text:
Use the Seer's Crystal at the graves of Sir Wendell Balfour, Lorien Sunblaze, and Conall Irongrip to determine how they died, then return to Crusader Rhydalla.
 Sir Wendell Balfour's death investigated
 Lorien Sunblaze's death investigated
 Conall Irongrip's death investigated
desc_text: The crystal will reveal the truth about how three of the tournament's combatants died. Take it with you to the graveyard east of the Tournament Grounds and use it before the graves of Sir Wendell Balfour, Lorien Sunblaze, and Conall Irongrip.$BIf indeed these men were murdered, then we must find a way to tie it to the Black Knight before he strikes again. Look closely at what the crystal tells you, <name>, for we must be certain these deaths were not accidental.

title: The Black Knight of Silverpine?
obj_text: Investigate the Black Knight's claims and return to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds with your findings.
desc_text: No doubt you've heard the disturbing rumors about the contestant the others are calling the Black Knight. It's said that any rider who was scheduled to face him in combat has met an untimely end.$BOf course, we have no definitive proof of anything, but it wouldn't hurt to look into this knight's background.$BHe claims to hail from Valgan's Field in Silverpine Forest. It's a small farm on the western shore of Lordamere Lake. Would you visit the farm and let me know if there's any truth to his story?

title: Jack Me Some Lumber
obj_text: ring 12 Rough Hewn Planks to Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Come closer. No, not too close. Don't want any unnecessary suspicion now, do we?$BThis coliseum requires more lumber than we've stockpiled and there's no way I'm going to pay to have it shipped in from Grizzly Hills. At the western end of Crystalsong Forest, by the Great Tree, grow a number of young Crystalsong oaks. They'd provide just the kind of planking we need for building and scaffolding. Take this axe, use it to fell the trees and then hew them into planks, but don't let anyone see you!

title: The Seer's Crystal
obj_text: ring a Seer's Crystal to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Now that we know there's no truth to the Black Knight's stories, we must find a way to connect him to the murdered knights.$BI know a way to reveal the truth about how they died, but it requires a rare material. We must gain a seer's crystal, found only among the unbound seers who congregate near night elf ruins in the Forlorn Woods in the central part of Crystalsong Forest. Find one of these seers, <name>, and bring me the crystal it holds.

title: Val'anyr, Hammer of Ancient Kings
obj_text: Throw the Shattered Pieces of Val'anyr into Yogg-Saron's maw while he's casting Deafening Roar and defeat Yogg-Saron and recover the Reforged Hammer of Ancient Kings.$BThis can only be completed in Heroic mode and only if at least one Ulduar Watcher is not assisting you.
desc_text: The Archivum Console has hinted at a possible way to rebind the fragments of Val'anyr:  you must get the fragments inside the physical form of the being known as Yogg-Saron.$BIt sounds like a long shot, but for an artifact of such power you think the risk might just be worth it.

title: Learning The Reins
obj_text:
Strike a Melee Target with Thrust 5 times, use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, use Charge on 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, and then return to Galathia Brightdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or the Sunreaver Pavilion.
 Use Thrust on Melee Target (5)
 Use Shield-Breaker on vulnerable Ranged Target (2)
 Use Charge on vulnerable Charge Target (2)
desc_text: Most of the tournament's competitions require competitors to master the command of a mount in battle. In order to familiarize you with mounted combat, we've put up training dummies all over the northern part of the tournament grounds.$BVisit the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up on the Sunreaver hawkstrider. Familiarize yourself with the mount and use its abilities to defeat the three different kinds of training dummies.

title: Training In The Field
obj_text:
Amariel Sunsworn at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 8 Icecrown Scourge. You may kill Scourge in any part of Icecrown except the Bombardment.
 $BIcecrown Scourge slain (8)

desc_text: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you learn to master mounted combat, do not forget to practice the skills that have served you well all these years. Show us that you can face the Scourge with honor and bravery, and you will earn your right to compete in this tournament.$BTravel to Icecrown and slay any Scourge you see there, but stay clear of the Bombardment, where you would be overwhelmed.

title: A Worthy Weapon
obj_text: ring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Our champions have taken a liking to ancient weapons produced here in Northrend.$BI've heard the bards telling tales of travelers offering winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.

title: All Is Well That Ends Well
obj_text: Take the Reply-Code Alpha to Rhonin in Dalaran.
desc_text: We'd best hurry now, <name>.  We're going to have to transmit the reply-code from Dalaran.$BTake it to Rhonin, I will meet you there.

title: Up To The Challenge
obj_text: Present Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament with 15 Aspirant's Seals to signify you're ready to undergo the aspirant's challenge.
desc_text: When you have mastered the skills of the aspirant, you may choose to take the aspirant's challenge. The challenge will test your mounted combat skills and assess whether or not you're prepared to become a valiant. Should you pass, you will be able to join your capital city's delegation as a valiant.$BWhen you are ready to begin the challenge, return to me.

title: The Aspirant's Challenge
obj_text:
Speak with Squire David to summon your opponent. Once you have defeated the Argent Valiant, return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Argent Valiant defeated
desc_text: You have trained hard as an aspirant, <name>, and now the time has come to test your mounted combat skills against an experienced opponent.$BEquip your lance, then go to the stables outside the pavilion and mount the Sunreaver hawkstrider.$BAt the Aspirants' Ring on the northern side of the tournament grounds, you'll find a human child called Squire David. He'll ask if you're ready for the fight and call out your opponent.$BGood luck, <name>. May your mount be steady and your aim true.

title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
obj_text: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Some of the champions believe an ancient weapon born of Northrend will bring them luck in the tourney. I have agreed to help them search for these weapons.$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, <name>. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.

title: Horde Tournament Eligibility Marker
obj_text: This quest will be converted toAlliance Tournament Eligibility Markerif you transfer toAlliance.

title: A Valiant Of Orgrimmar
obj_text: Speak with Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Orgrimmar, <name>. Now, you should speak with Mokra the Skullcrusher, who leads Orgrimmar's competitors. As Orgrimmar's grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: A Valiant Of The Exodar
obj_text: Speak with Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of the Exodar.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of the Exodar, <name>. Now, you should introduce yourself to Colosos, who leads the Exodar delegation. As the draenei grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: The Black Knight's Orders
obj_text:
Use the Enchanted Bridle to gain control of the Black Knight's Gryphon and ride it to its destination. Once you have arrived, recover the Stolen Tournament Invitation and the Black Knight's Orders and bring them to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Black Knight's Gryphon taken
desc_text: We must discover who sent the Black Knight to the tournament and what his master hopes to gain by killing the competitors.$BThe Kirin Tor has offered to help in this matter and provided us with something to help our search.$BTake this enchanted bridle to the Black Knight's camp on the eastern edge of the tournament grounds and use it to gain control over the Black Knight's gryphon. The bridle's magic will force the gryphon to take you to his master's home. Search it and return with anything you find.

title: A Valiant Of Thunder Bluff
obj_text: Speak with Runok Wildmane at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of Thunder Bluff.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Thunder Bluff, <name>. Now, you should speak with Runok Wildmane, who leads Thunder Bluff's competitors. As Thunder Bluff's grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: A Valiant Of Sen'jin
obj_text: Speak with Zul'tore at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of Sen'jin.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Sen'jin, <name>. Now, you should speak with Zul'tore who leads Sen'jin's warriors. As the troll grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: The Sword and the Sea
obj_text: Old Man Barlo in Crystalsong Forest wants you to bring him the Sword of Knighthood.
desc_text: My sword was lost at sea.  Catch it and bring it back!

title: A Chip Off the Ulduar Block
obj_text: ring 15 Small Stone Blocks to Bozzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Getting stone for this job has been a nightmare, I tell ya! There are tons of stone available from ruins in safe places, but those holier-than-thou paladins won't go for it. Something about 'priceless artifacts.'$BAnyway, whining about that isn't going to get this place built. There are tons of crumbling titan ruins in the Foot Steppes and at the Inventor's Library in Storm Peaks. Take my, uh, 'chisel' with you and see if you can break those huge blocks into useful pieces.

title: The Edge Of Winter
obj_text: Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
desc_text: I heard an interesting story from one of the Ogrimmar valiants.$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, <name>.

title: A Valiant Of Silvermoon
obj_text: Speak with Eressea Dawnsinger at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of Silvermoon.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Silvermoon, <name>. Now, you should speak with Eressea Dawnsinger, who leads the Silvermoon delegation. As Silvermoon's grand champion, she will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: A Valiant Of Undercity
obj_text: Speak with Deathstalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of the Undercity.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of the Undercity, <name>. Now, you should speak with Deathstalker Visceri, who leads the Undercity delegation. As grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: Valiant Of Orgrimmar
obj_text: Speak with Mokra the Skullcrusher again if you wish to become a valiant of Orgrimmar.
desc_text: So, you have become a champion? Then, you have proven yourself a worthy combatant and I would proudly welcome you into Orgrimmar's delegation.$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Orgrimmar, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

title: The Valiant's Charge
obj_text: ring 25 Valiant's Seals to Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: In your training as a valiant, you'll have the chance to test your skills against valiants representing other cities. Although a valiant's battles are not a formal part of the competition, you will learn valuable lessons about the fighting styles and weaknesses of your opponents.$BThe valiants are a spirited lot, competing amongst themselves for honor and notoriety.$BTrain as a valiant until you are confident of your ability to best all who face you, then bring me the seals you have earned.

title: Valiant Of Sen'jin
obj_text: Speak with Zul'tore again if you wish to become a valiant of Sen'jin.
desc_text: Greetings, champion. If you are willing, I would welcome you into Sen'jin's tournament delegation.$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Sen'jin, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

title: Valiant Of Thunder Bluff
obj_text: Speak with Runok Wildmane again if you wish to become a valiant of Thunder Bluff.
desc_text: Welcome, champion. As grand champion of the Thunder Bluff delegation, I would be honored to welcome you into our ranks, if you are willing.$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Thunder Bluff, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

title: Valiant Of Undercity
obj_text: Speak with Deathstalker Visceri again if you wish to become a valiant of the Undercity.
desc_text: Welcome, champion. The Forsaken delegation could always use more <class>s like you. obj_text: Speak with Eressea Dawnsinger again if you wish to become a valiant of Silvermoon.
desc_text: So, you have become a champion? title: The Valiant's Charge
obj_text: ring 25 Valiant's Seals to Deathstalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: In your training as a valiant, you'll have the chance to test your skills against valiants representing other cities. obj_text:
Akinos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
 Converted Hero slain (10)
desc_text: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. obj_text: Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
desc_text: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. title: A Worthy Weapon
obj_text: ring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$BMy tournament blade has gone missing and I need it for a match this afternoon.$BOne of the bards tells me that travelers used to present winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to Drak'Mar lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near its border with Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills.

title: The Grand Melee
obj_text: ring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Morah Worgsister at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.

desc_text: While we all play at mock combat, it will do us good to remember that the real enemy surrounds us. The Argent Crusade wants to use competition to find the best fighters, but we can tell that by who returns from battle. Let's show the paladins that we are willing to take battle to the Cult of the Damned, even while making preparations for the tournament.$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any of the cultists you encounter. They have a strong presence around Aldur'thar and Deathspeaker's Watch.

title: Among the Champions
obj_text: ring 4 Marks of the Champion to Luuri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
desc_text: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, besting challengers of all levels. When the tournament begins, those you have defeated will have redoubled their efforts and will seek to avenge their losses.$BIt would be wise to continue honing your own skills and learning from your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions. Equip your lance, mount up on any mount you're entitled to use at the stables, and face the champions.

title: The Blastbolt Brothers
obj_text: Speak with Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: The highlord has tasked me with getting that coliseum completed as soon as possible. We've put our own masons to work on the project, but we found out very quickly that we were going to need help procuring materials. I've hired a couple of goblins, Bezzle Blastbolt and his brother, Bozzle.$BThey're supervising construction at the southeastern end of the tournament grounds. Speak with Bezzle and see if he and his brother could use any more help getting the building materials we need.

title: Among the Champions
obj_text: ring 4 Marks of the Champion to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
desc_text: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, overcoming challengers of all levels. You must make certain that you can defeat anyone you face when the tournament begins.$BYou should continue honing your own skills and learning more about the weaknesses of your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, pick any mount you can ride, then face the champions in practice bouts.

title: Taking Battle To The Enemy
obj_text:
Cellian Daybreak at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 members of the Cult of the Damned. You may kill cultists in any part of Icecrown.
 $BCult of the Damned member slain (15)

 Shadow Cultist
 Shadow Adept
 Wyrm Reanimator
 Cultist Corrupter
 Dark Subjugator
 Bitter Initiate
 Overseer Faedris
 Void Summoner
 Shadow Channeler
 Overseer Veraj
 Cult Taskmaster
 Cult Blackguard
 Vile Torturer
 Overseer Jhaeqon
$B

 Damned Apothecary
 Cult Alchemist
 Overseer Savryn
 Cult Researcher
 Alumeth the Ascended
 Cultist Shard Watcher
 Cult Conspirator
 Dark Zealot
 Dark Ritualist
 Deathspeaker Kharos
 Cult Assassin
 Shadow Cultist
 Dark Ritualist
 Icecrown Cultist Proxy
desc_text: The coliseum is perched in the most dangerous part of the world, <name>. The territory we've taken from the Scourge has been paid for in blood and misery, yet the enemy continues to strike back with a seemingly limitless army. To make matters worse, this undead army is supported and assisted by mortal sympathizers, the Cult of the Damned.$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any cultists you encounter.

title: Heroic: The Celestial Planetarium
obj_text:
Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to locate the entrance to the Celestial Planetarium.
 $BEntrance to Celestial Planetarium located
desc_text: Listen, <lad/lass>!  Azeroth's fate is at stake here.$BOur only chance is to get to the Celestial Planetarium in time to find this Algalon and stop him from beaming back any messages to his Titan masters.$BLocate the Celestial Planetarium and come back with any information you get.  We might still have some time to prepare for Algalon's arrival.

title: Heroic: Algalon
obj_text: ring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
desc_text: You really did it, <name>.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$BYou best hurry, <lad/lass>.  Time is of the essence.

title: Heroic: Freya's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Freya's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Freya's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark.  Should any of the elders be harmed, the Sigil's integrity will be compromised.$BSparing the elders, however, means that Freya will be more powerful when you face her.$BWhat can I say, <name>.  We're stuck between a rock and hard place.

title: Heroic: Hodir's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!

title: Heroic: Archivum Data Disc
obj_text: ring the Archivum Data Disc to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
desc_text: This platinum disc is surprisingly symmetrical and devoid of any scratches or imperfections.  Engraved along its edge, bold runes spell out the word "ARCHIVUM."$BThere must be a device inside Ulduar capable of reading the disc.

title: Heroic: Thorim's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Thorim's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Thorim's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Thorim's not himself, <name>.  He's come under a dark influence.$BAn evil presence under the guise of an illusion pretends to be his lost wife, Sif.$BYe can't let him be overcome by this impostor's spell.  If he does, the location of his sigil might forever be lost!$BYer going to have to beat some sense into him and yer going to have to do it quick.$BAs always, the Archivum Console will give ye all the gory details... even the ones ye don't like.

title: Mastery Of Melee
obj_text:
Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Jeran Lockwood's advice
 Use Thrust on Melee Target (5)
desc_text: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.

title: Heroic: All Is Well That Ends Well
obj_text: Take the Reply-Code Alpha to Rhonin in Dalaran.
desc_text: We'd best hurry now, <name>.  We're going to have to transmit the reply-code from Dalaran.$BTake it to Rhonin, I will meet you there.

title: Heroic: Mimiron's Sigil
obj_text: Prospector Loren at the Ulduar Archivum wants you to obtain Mimiron's Sigil.$BFor more information on obtaining Mimiron's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
desc_text: Mimiron's a clever one.  His entire abode is rigged with some sort of self-destruction mechanism.$BUnfortunately yer gonna have to race against it if ye want to get his sigil.  Check the Archivum Console for more details if ye need them.

title: The Scrapbot Construction Kit
obj_text: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
desc_text: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.

title: Mastery Of The Shield-Breaker
obj_text:
Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider. Speak to Valis Windchaser and use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, then return to Galathia Brightdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Valis Windchaser's advice
 Use Shield-Breaker on vulnerable Ranged Target (2)
desc_text: You'll need to learn how to break through an opponent's defenses to succeed in mounted combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Valis Windchaser. He'll be on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Valis will teach you the basics of using a ranged shield breaker attack to make a ranged target vulnerable.

title: Mastery Of The Charge
obj_text:
Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider outside the pavilion. Speak to Rugan Steelbelly and Charge 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, then return to Amariel Sunsworn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Rugan Steelbelly's advice
 Charge vulnerable Charge Target (2)
desc_text: Your strongest attack in mounted combat is undoubtedly the charge. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$BOnce you're mounted, speak with Rugan Steelbelly. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Rugan will tell you how to use this powerful ability and teach you some basic strategies.

title: Contributin' To The Cause
obj_text:
Speak with Squire Artie to contribute 10 gold to the Argent Crusade's cause.
 $BRequired money: 10
desc_text: The bestest of the champions come to the chapel to hear the argent confessor speak every day.$BYou should see how much she inspires them, <name>. Not only do they fight for the Argent Crusade, but they put a lot of money into the collection basket when I take it around.$BMaybe you'd like to contribute too?

title: At The Enemy's Gates
obj_text:
Morah Worgsister at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, and 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
 Boneguard Footman slain (15)
 Boneguard Scout slain (10)
 Boneguard Lieutenant slain (3)
desc_text: Even as we ready for the tournament, Argent Crusade forces prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's minions.$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, <name>, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.

obj_text:
Gahju at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
 Boneguard Footman slain (15)
