title: Battle Before The Citadel
obj_text:
Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 3 Boneguard Commanders.
 Boneguard Commander slain (3)
desc_text: Even as some of us labor on the tournament, our brothers prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled argent charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's commanders.$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, <name>, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.

title: The Black Knight's Curse
obj_text:
Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to investigate the Black Knight's Grave.
 $BInvestigate the Black Knight's Grave
desc_text: I wanted to remove the Black Knight's remains from the tournament grounds after your victory, but Confessor Paletress insisted that he receive a decent burial. Ever since, a dark presence has lingered in the cemetery and people are afraid to go there to visit the fallen.$BWould you visit the cemetery just past the eastern end of the tournament grounds and see if you can discover what's happening?

title: Battle Before The Citadel
obj_text:
Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 3 Boneguard Commanders.
 Boneguard Commander slain (3)
desc_text: As some crusaders prepare for the tournament, they have sent others to make an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's commanders.$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, <name>, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.

title: If You're Reading This While I'm In Combat...
obj_text:
ELM Daze Target wants you to kill 5 ELM Attackers for Dan and Great Justice!
 ELM Attacker slain (5)
desc_text: Dan is the most awesome programmer in the world... the World of Warcraft!$BIsn't it weird that you used to not be able to talk with me at all while I was fighting?  No longer, my friend, now that Dan has made significant improvements to one of my creature flags!$BCelebrate with me by snuffing out the lives of these awful creatures that perpetually have me in combat.

title: Sealed Vial of Poison
obj_text: ring the Seal Vial of Poison to Alchemist Cinesra in the Dalaran Sewers.
desc_text: This vial of poison looks particularly dangerous.  Perhaps someone in Dalaran might be interested in it.

title: Stop The Aggressors
obj_text:
Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Kvaldir.
 $BKvaldir slain (10)

 Kvaldir Mist Binder
$B

 Kvaldir Reaver
desc_text: The Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders, have disrupted our shipments and murdered the tuskarr inhabitants of an island to the north, renaming it Hrothgar's Landing. If they are allowed to get a foothold there, there is no doubt that we will be their next target.$BThe crusade's forces have their hands full dealing with the Scourge, and we must defend the tournament grounds. Fly north from the grounds until you reach the island and take on the Kvaldir before they can destroy anything else.

title: The Light's Mercy
obj_text:
Use the Confessor's Prayer Book to perform last rites for 8 Slain Tualiq Villagers and then return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Last Rites administered (8)
desc_text: I've been listening to Confessor Paletress speak, and I must tell you, her words have given me much to consider. It is not enough to fight beside the crusaders; we must take up their mission.$BOff the north coast is Hrothgar's Landing, where the seagoing Kvaldir have overrun an old tuskarr settlement and slain the villagers. Take this book and read the rites for the dead near the corpses of the villagers. It will allow their spirits to escape the mists engulfing the island and find peace.

title: The Black Knight's Fate
obj_text: Capture Doctor Kolher's Orders at Deathspeaker's Watch, then return to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: You said the body was taken by cultists? I can only think of one place they would have gone, Deathspeaker's Watch, the encampment on the rise west of the tournament grounds.$BWhatever the cultists are doing must be stopped. The rumors I've heard can only be true, then. The infamous Doctor Kohler must be among the cultists, practicing his arts. Look for a rise or an altar overlooking the cultist camp, slay the doctor, and look for proof of his plans. Slow down his work in any other way you can.

title: A Leg Up
obj_text: Recover 10 Stolen Tallstrider Legs for Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.$BThey've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.

title: You've Really Done It This Time, Kul
obj_text:
Rescue Kul the Reckless and 4 Captive Aspirants from Deathspeaker's Watch and return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Kul the Reckless rescued
 Captive Aspirant rescued (4)
desc_text: Crusader Kul has gone and gotten himself into trouble again, only this time he's not alone. When he saw the cultists making camp at Deathspeaker's Watch, west of the tournament grounds, Kul gathered the aspirants for an assault.$BWithout reinforcements, Kul and his followers were easily captured. I have no doubt that the cult will sacrifice the prisoners unless we can mount a rescue. Any of those cultists could carry keys to the black cages. Find the keys and free Kul and the captive aspirants.

title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
obj_text:
Use the Weighted Net to capture 8 Snowblind Followers and bring them to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Snowblind Follower captured (8)
desc_text: Two of my men have already been killed trying to confine the magnataur called Gormok the Impaler, yet the creature still rages. It howls for hours about being without its favorite snobold.$BIf the Argent Crusade didn't wish to use this monster in the coliseum, I'd slay it myself. Perhaps it's time to bring the beast its playthings. Take this net and travel to Garm's Bane in southeast Storm Peaks. It's just northeast of K3. Capture some of those snobolds and pray to the Light you've found the right one.

title: Breakfast Of Champions
obj_text: Acquire 4 Jormungar Egg Sacs and bring them to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Now that the coliseum is complete, the Argent Crusade has asked us to help look after the creatures that champions will be fighting.$BThe giant jormungar have perhaps the strangest diet; they grow strong by eating the eggs of their own kind and the best eggs come from deep jormungar.$BTake this drum to the Foot Steppes in central Storm Peaks and play them near the snow mounds you see there.  Rouse the deep jormungar, kill them, and gather their egg sacs.

title: Mistcaller Yngvar
obj_text:
High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill Mistcaller Yngvar.
 Mistcaller Yngvar slain
desc_text: The Kvaldir have returned to the coasts of Northrend and if left unchecked, they will prevent our supplies and reinforcements from arriving. One of them, known as Mistcaller Yngvar, has taken up residence in a cave on the western side of Hrothgar's Landing. There, he manipulates the mists to conceal the Kvaldir and  the sea beasts they command.$BTake this charm and travel across the strait north of the tournament grounds, to Hrothgar's Landing. Find the mistcaller's cave and use the charm to reveal him.

title: Drottinn Hrothgar
obj_text:
High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to defeat Drottinn Hrothgar.
 Drottinn Hrothgar slain
desc_text: The kvaldir, seafaring vrykul who raid ships and coastal settlements, have overrun a tuskarr  island across the strait to the north. Their leader is a veteran raider, Drottinn Hrothgar, who seeks to control these seas.$BWith him in power, our shipments and troop transports will never be safe. We will be stranded here at the Lich King's mercy.$BTake this captured kvaldir war horn to the circle of tuskarr statues on the northeastern part of Hrothgar's Landing and use it to challenge the kvaldir leader.

title: Deathspeaker Kharos
obj_text:
High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants to you kill Deathspeaker Kharos.
 Deathspeaker Kharos slain
desc_text: The Cult of the Damned has redoubled its efforts to see us destroyed. They have grown bold and are massing their strength at Deathspeaker's Watch on the ridge west of the tournament grounds.$BThe ruthless Deathspeaker Kharos has his men fortifying their positions, preparing to unleash all of the cult's weapons.$BMy men are preparing themselves and the valiants to defend the grounds, but I want champions like you, <name>, to lead our efforts to blunt the attack. Find Deathspeaker Kharos and slay him.

title: Breakfast Of Champions
obj_text: Acquire 4 Jormungar Egg Sacs and bring them to Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Now that the coliseum is complete, the Argent Crusade has asked us to help look after the creatures that champions will be fighting.$BThe giant jormungar have perhaps the strangest diet; they grow strong by eating the eggs of their own kind and the best eggs come from deep jormungar.$BTake this drum to the Foot Steppes in central Storm Peaks and play them near the snow mounds you see there. The sound will rouse the deep jormungar. Kill them, collect their egg sacs, and return to the tournament grounds.

title: Ornolf The Scarred
obj_text:
High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill Ornolf the Scarred.
 Ornolf the Scarred slain
desc_text: Ornolf the Scarred is a fearsome raider renowned among his Kvaldir brethren for raiding and capturing ships. From aboard Bor's Fury, he and his crew attack our ships and steal our goods.$BOrnolf and his men are among those who slaughtered the inhabitants of a tuskarr island to the north and renamed it Hrothgar's Landing. His ship sits at anchor at the eastern end of the island's harbor. Take this captured banner and display it on his ship to provoke him into facing you in battle.

title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
obj_text: Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring her 3 pieces of North Sea Shark Meat.
desc_text: The crusaders have captured a yeti that they're calling Icehowl. He's to be a participant in the coliseum battles and we've been asked to help with his training and upkeep.$BThe crusaders weren't fond of my suggestion that we feed the beast surplus Sunreavers. The creature has a predilection for shark meat, so I want you to fly down to the Silver Blade, floating in the strait to the north. Get some fresh chum from one of the buckets on the boat, then spread it in the water to attract sharks.

title: Stop The Aggressors
obj_text:
Giranan the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Kvaldir.
 $BKvaldir slain (10)

 Kvaldir Mist Binder
$B

 Kvaldir Reaver
desc_text: The Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders, have disrupted our shipments and murdered the tuskarr inhabitants of an island to the north, renaming it Hrothgar's Landing. If they are allowed to get a foothold there, there is no doubt that we will be their next target.$BThe crusade's forces have their hands full dealing with the Scourge, and we must defend the tournament grounds. Fly north from the grounds until you reach the island and take on the Kvaldir before they can destroy anything else.

title: Get Kraken!
obj_text:
Crusader Silverdawn wants you to mount an Argent Hippogryph, throw 6 Flaming Spears at the North Sea Kraken and take out 3 Vrykul Deepcallers.$BYou can find the Argent Hippogryphs right outside the Argent Crusade tent at the Tournament Grounds.
 Hurl Spears at North Sea Kraken (6)
 Kvaldir Deepcaller slain (3)
desc_text: The Sunreavers and Silver Covenant sent ships north to engage the Kvaldir at Hrothgar's Landing, but were intercepted and detained by a Kvaldir Raiding vessel.  To make matters worse, the Kvaldir have found a way to call forth the dreaded Kraken that lives beneath the North Sea.  If anyone on board is to get out alive, that Kraken must be driven away and the Kvaldir's summoning ritual ... disrupted.$BCrusader, take these spears and an Argent Hippogryph will take you to the battle.

title: Identifying the Remains
obj_text: Take the Kraken Tooth to Crusader Silverdawn as proof of your victory.
desc_text: A whole tooth from a dead Kraken is a rare find indeed.  Crusader Silverdawn will want to see this.

title: Rescue at Sea
obj_text:
Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds would like you to kill 8 Kvaldir Berserkers and 3 Kvaldir Harpooners aboard The Firehawk.
 Kvaldir Berserker slain (8)
 Kvaldir Harpooner slain (3)
desc_text: The Kvaldir have set up camp at Hrothgar's Landing, the small island to the North.  We sent Captain Aerthas Firehawk to the area, but they ran into a Kvaldir Raiding party heading to the Tournament Grounds!  The Firehawk is now under attack by the raiders and is vastly outnumbered. Get out there and show those Kvaldir why attacking the Sunreavers is a poor plan indeed.$BThe Firehawk is between Hrothgar's Landing to the north and the Tournament Grounds, on the western side of The Sea Reaver's Run.

title: The Fate Of The Fallen
obj_text:
Crusader Silverdawn wants you to bring peace to 6 Fallen Hero's Spirits.
 Fallen Hero's Spirit blessed (6)
desc_text: The Argent Crusade is hardly the first force to challenge the Lich King. Our enemy turns spirits of the fallen against us.$BTheir spirits wander the Valley of Fallen Heroes, southwest of the grounds and between Aldur'thar and the Ironwall Rampart. The area is littered with discarded soul crystals, used by the Scourge to control the spirits. Gather those soul crystals and use them with this Light-blessed relic to bestow the blessing of peace upon the spirits. They have more than earned their rest.

title: You've Really Done It This Time, Kul
obj_text:
Rescue Kul the Reckless and 4 Captive Aspirants from Deathspeaker's Watch and return to Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Kul the Reckless rescued
 Captive Aspirant rescued (4)
desc_text: Crusader Kul has gone and gotten himself into trouble again, only this time he's not alone. When he saw the cultists making camp at Deathspeaker's Watch, west of the tourney grounds, Kul gathered the aspirants for an attack.$BThey were easily captured, and now Kul languishes in a cage on the platform in the camp. I am sure that the cult will sacrifice the prisoners unless we can rescue them. Any of those cultists could carry keys to the black cages. Find the keys and free Kul and the captive aspirants.

title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
obj_text:
Use the Weighted Net to capture 8 Snowblind Followers and bring them to Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Snowblind Follower captured (8)
desc_text: Two of my men have already been killed trying to confine the magnataur called Gormok the Impaler, yet the creature still rages. It howls for hours about being without its favorite snobold.$BIf the Argent Crusade didn't wish to use this monster in the coliseum, I'd slay it myself. Perhaps it's time to bring the beast its playthings. Take this net and travel to Garm's Bane in southeast Storm Peaks. It's just northeast of K3. Capture some of those snobolds and pray to the Light you've found the right one.

title: Rescue at Sea
obj_text:
Head out to The North Sea and kill 8 Vrykul Berserkers and 3 Vrykul Harpooners attacking The Wavecrest.
 Kvaldir Berserker slain (8)
 Kvaldir Harpooner slain (3)
desc_text: Champion, Captain Wavecrest and her ship were sent north to disrupt the Kvaldir in Hrothgar's Landing when they were intercepted by a Kvaldir raiding party headed to the Tournament Grounds. Unfortunately, the Kvaldir far outnumber the crew on board and are slowly taking over the ship.$BWe need you to go north to The Wavecrest in The Sea Reaver's Run, between the Tournament Grounds and Hrothgar's Landing and help the crew fend off the attack.  You should see the ship on the east side of the pass.

title: The Light's Mercy
obj_text:
Use the Confessor's Prayer Book to perform last rites for 8 Slain Tualiq Villagers and then return to Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
 Last Rites administered (8)
desc_text: I've been listening to Confessor Paletress speak, and I must tell you, her words have made me think. We fight beside the crusaders, but we can learn from them, too.$BOff the north coast is Hrothgar's Landing, where the seagoing Kvaldir have overrun an old tuskarr settlement and slain the villagers. Take this book and read the rites for the dead near the corpses of the villagers. It will allow their spirits to escape the mists engulfing the island and find peace.

title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
obj_text: Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him 3 pieces of North Sea Shark Meat.
desc_text: The crusaders have captured a yeti that they're calling Icehowl. He's to be a participant in the coliseum battles and we've been asked to help with his training and upkeep.$BThe crusaders weren't fond of my suggestion that we feed some Silver Covenant members to the beast. The creature prefers shark meat, so I want you to fly down to the Crimson Dawn, floating in the strait to the north. Get some fresh chum from one of the buckets on the boat, then spread it in the water to attract sharks.

title: A Leg Up
obj_text: Recover 10 Stolen Tallstrider Legs for Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.$BThey've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.

title: Inside the Frozen Citadel
obj_text: Enter The Forge of Souls from the side of Icecrown Citadel and locate Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
desc_text: <class>! Come close quickly, I must have a word!$BMy queen, the Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, has uncovered a hole in the defenses of Icecrown Citadel into a place she referred to as "The Forge of Souls." She sent word before she left for me to find fierce fighters to send her way. I think you'll do.$BGo to her within the entrance to the forge, <class>.

title: Waterlogged Recipe
obj_text: ring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
desc_text: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....

title: Proof of Demise: The Black Knight
obj_text: This quest is marked as excluded, this either means it contains senstive information or that it cannot be obtained/completed.$BArchmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
desc_text: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.

title: You've Been Served
obj_text: Serve the Court Subpoena to Apothecary Hummel in Shadowfang Keep.
desc_text: You made it, huh? Good. I've been waiting for help. No time like the present to act, right?$BTake this kit and head deeper inside to serve papers to the leader of that scumbag chemical company, Hummel. The paper's inside. So's a little something to protect you from any chemical tricks they might pull. Use one of the neutralizers when the time comes, all right?

title: The Path to the Citadel
obj_text:
Free 15 Horde Slaves and kill Forgemaster Garfrost.
 Slaves freed (15)
 Forgemaster Garfrost slain
desc_text: They've put our captured soldiers to work in the quarry. Kill their captors and set them free, <class>, and do it quickly. We will need their aid when we confront Scourgelord Tyrannus.

title: An Audience With The Arcanist
obj_text: Retrieve the Ancient Dragonforged Blades tome from Arcanist Tybalin.
desc_text: I've placed an enchantment on the tabard that should allow you to slip past the Silver Enclave's defenses for a short period of time. You should have enough time to find your way up to the top level of the Silver Enclave and meet up with the Silver Covenant's man there, known as Arcanist Tybalin.$BWhile disguised, obtain the copy of Ancient Dragonforged Blades that his men borrowed from Wyrmrest, and return the book to me.

title: A Most Puzzling Circumstance
obj_text: Take the Head of Onyxia to Zardeth of the Black Claw in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind or to Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You have accomplished the truly impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Seize her head and deliver it to Zardeth of the Black Claw or Neeru Fireblade.

title: Shadowmourne...
obj_text:
Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to bring him Shadow's Edge.
Shadowmourne Quest Accept (Provided)

title: Echoes of Tortured Souls
obj_text:
Kill Bronjahm and the Devourer of Souls to secure access to the Pit of Saron.
 Bronjahm slain
 $BDevourer of Souls slain

 Devourer of Souls
 Devourer of Souls
$B

 Devourer of Souls
desc_text: I'm glad we have someone capable to aid us in this. Delving into the citadel with so few is risky at best, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the Citadel.$BBe quick about it, <name>. Time is short.

title: A Feast of Souls
obj_text:
Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to use Shadow's Edge to slay 1000 of the Lich King's minions in Icecrown Citadel. Souls can be obtained in 10 or 25 person difficulty.
 Souls fed to Shadow's Edge (1000)
desc_text: Shadow's Edge is among the greatest weapons a <class> could hope to obtain.$BIs your lust for power sated, <race>?$B<You feel Mograine's penetrating gaze.>$BI thought not. A final warning then...$BYou now embark on the most treacherous leg of your quest. Bridle your aspirations, for if your aims are impure then your life, your very soul, is forfeit.$BThe weapon you hold is but an empty husk, a mere shadow of what it may become. Only by devouring a thousand souls shall its true potential be unlocked.

title: Waterlogged Recipe
obj_text: ring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
desc_text: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....

title: What The Dragons Know
obj_text:
Speak to Krasus at the top of Wyrmrest Temple.
 Ask Krasus about the hilt's origins
desc_text: There's no mistaking it - this hilt comes from a powerful, ancient weapon, but which one? I do not recognize these particular markings, but we haven't hit a dead end yet.$BKorialstrasz, better known as Krasus, has long been a friend to the quel'dorei and the Kirin Tor. With his vast knowledge and resources, he's certain to know something. Travel to the top of Wyrmrest Temple and seek his counsel, then report to Magister Hathorel inside Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran.

title: Battle Plans Of The Kvaldir
obj_text: Recover the Heart of the Mists and bring it and the Kvaldir Attack Plans to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Looking over the captured attack plans, you find a map of the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor with major settlements marked. Reading over the orders, you learn that  Kvaldir captains have drafted plans for a series of devastating raids.$BAccording to the orders, the attacks are to begin after Mistcaller Yngvar "consults the Heart of the Mists." Perhaps you could delay the attacks by capturing the omen from the Mistcaller's Cave on the western side of Hrothgar's Landing and notify Justicar Mariel Trueheart.

title: A Most Puzzling Circumstance
obj_text: Take the Head of Onyxia to Zardeth of the Black Claw in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind or to Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You have accomplished the truly impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Seize her head and deliver it to Zardeth of the Black Claw or Neeru Fireblade.

title: The Splintered Throne
obj_text: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to collect 50 Shadowfrost Shards.$BShadowfrost Shards may only be obtained in the 25 person difficulty setting.
desc_text: The Lich King's throne once served as his prison. Kil'jaeden himself crafted the vessel of icy crystals from the twisting nether, its sole purpose to hold Ner'zhul's vengeful spirit.$BWhen Arthas struck the crystal with Frostmourne, he released Ner'zhul's soul, allowing it to merge with his own. Splinters from that impact are now scattered throughout the citadel.$BI shall require those shards, held only by the Lich King's most powerful servants, to seal the power contained in your blade.

title: Return To Myralion Sunblaze
obj_text: ring Ancient Dragonforged Blades to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.
desc_text: We must get this book to Myralion Sunblade. Would you bring it to him? I cannot rely on anyone else to transport the book and you have proven adept at evading the Silver Covenant's men.$BTake it with you to Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Myralion will be waiting for you. If he can identify that blade, we may be able to claim it in the name of Aethas Sunreaver and show Dalaran and the Alliance that we will lead the charge against the Lich King.

title: A Suitable Disguise
obj_text: Obtain a Borrowed Tabard from Shandy Glossgleam.
desc_text: Getting you inside the Silver Enclave will be tougher than it appears. Only those who possess Silver Covenant tabards are permitted entry to sanctuary. If we can get our hands on one, a simple enchantment will do the rest of the work.$BOn the balcony above Threads of Fate, you'll find Shandy Glossgleam. I've helped him a few times in the past, so he owes me a favor. He handles laundry for a wide variety of people in the city. Maybe he can find a way to 'lend' you a tabard for a while.

title: The Silver Covenant's Scheme
obj_text: Capture the Silver Covenant Orders.
desc_text: One of my contacts in the Underbelly caught sight of a Silver Covenant agent gathering information at the Cantrips and Crows Tavern. Silver Covenant members aren't normally found in the sewers, so they must be plotting something.$BGo into the Underbelly, find this Silver Covenant agent, and eliminate him. Search the body for any information that might give us a lead on the location of that tome from Wyrmrest. We can't let those simpering Silver Covenant weaklings get it back to Icecrown before we do.

title: Reforging The Sword
obj_text: Obtain 5 Infused Saronite Bars and the Forgemaster's Hammer, then combine them with the Remnants of Quel'Delar to create the Reforged Quel'Delar.
desc_text: We cannot allow Quel'Delar to remain broken and disgraced. Take the remnants of the sword, along with the battered hilt you discovered, and venture into the Pit of Saron within Icecrown Citadel.$BIn the pit, the Lich King uses slaves to mine, process, and transform saronite ore. This infused saronite is what we will use to rebuild Quel'Delar.$BYou must gather bars of infused saronite and capture the forgemaster's hammer, then bring them to the forgemaster's anvil and reforge the sword.

title: Sartharion Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Sartharion.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BSartharion slain

 Sartharion
 Sartharion (1)
 Sartharion (2)
 Sartharion (3)
$B

 Sartharion - Heroic
 Sartharion - Mythic
 Sartharion - Ascended
desc_text: Sartharion, the Onyx Guardian, watches over the eggs of the Twilight Dragonflight. He rests within the Obsidian Sanctum in the Chamber of the Aspects underneath Wyrmrest Temple.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Sartharion must die!

title: Journey To The Sunwell
obj_text: Speak with Halduron Brightwing at the entrance to the Sunwell Plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
desc_text: Take Quel'Delar to the Sunwell as quickly as possible, <name>. Trust in Uther's words when he says that you will not always be able to control the blade while it is subject to the evil of the Lich King's influence. You must travel to the Isle of Quel'Danas, and there, seek entry to the Sunwell itself, where you can cleanse the sword.$BThe guardians will try to stop you from entering the Sunwell Plateau, but make yourself known to Halduron Brightwing, who will be inspecting the guards there.

title: Anub'Rekhan Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Anub'Rekhan.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BAnub'Rekhan slain

 Anub'Rekhan
 Anub'Rekhan - Heroic
$B

 Anub'Rekhan - Mythic
 Anub'Rekhan - Ascended
desc_text: Anub'Rekhan, once-mighty Spider Lord of the nerubian empire, has been taken by the Lich King and corrupted into a state of undeath.$BNow a crypt lord, he sits in his parlor in the Arachnid Quarter of Naxxramas, spinning strategies for Kel'Thuzad.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Anub'Rekhan must die!

title: Noth the Plaguebringer Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Noth the Plaguebringer.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BNoth the Plaguebringer slain

 Noth the Plaguebringer
 Noth the Plaguebringer - Heroic
$B

 Noth the Plaguebringer - Mythic
 Noth the Plaguebringer - Ascended
desc_text: Noth the Plaguebringer, traitor and coward! Second only to the Lich King himself for the number of souls that have been Scourged!$BMake haste to Naxxramas. You will find him within the Plague Quarter hiding behind his undead minions.$BDestroy him! The Council of Six has decreed that Noth must die!

title: Thalorien Dawnseeker
obj_text:
Visit Thalorien Dawnseeker's Remains and obtain his blessing to wield Quel'Delar.
 Thalorien's Blessing obtained
desc_text: You are the one working with Myralion Sunblaze, arent you? I know of a way we can test the sword.$BIf you know the blade's history, you recall that it was borne by Thalorien Dawnseeker in defense of the Sunwell against the Scourge. He fell in what is now the Dead Scar, buying time for his men to make their own preparations. You will find his remains near the southern end of the Dead Scar on this isle. Visit them, and if his spirit gives you its blessing, I will allow you to enter the Sunwell.

title: Tempering The Blade
obj_text: Temper the Re-forged Quel'Delar in the Crucible of Souls.
desc_text: At last, the pieces of Quel'Delar are rejoined and the blade is whole, but it cannot see battle until you have tempered it. That jagged saronite edge is brittle and will shatter the moment it strikes anything.$BDeep in Icecrown Citadel's Forge of Souls is a place where the blade can safely be tempered. Take Quel'Delar with you to the abode of the Devourer of Souls and look for the crucible. Plunge the blade into the crucible to temper it and bring it back to me. I'll be waiting in The Frozen Halls.

title: The Battered Hilt
obj_text: ring the Battered Hilt to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: This battered old sword hilt has seen better days. Before the hilt was snapped from the blade, it must've been a magnificent example of the blacksmith's art.$BThe graceful symbols and exotic gemstones decorating the hilt suggest that the weapon may have belonged to a powerful person. Surely, the Sunreavers would be interested in hearing about the recovery of such an artifact. Seek out their representatives at Quel'Delar's Rest, to the south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.

title: Instructor Razuvious Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Instructor Razuvious.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BInstructor Razuvious slain

 Instructor Razuvious
 Instructor Razuvious - Heroic
$B

 Instructor Razuvious - Mythic
 Instructor Razuvious - Ascended
desc_text: Instructor Razuvious smugly struts about the Military Quarter of Naxxramas. It is said that only a death knight personally trained by him could possibly even withstand the prowess of his blade.$BYou and your group are going to prove everyone wrong.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Razuvious must die!

title: The Halls Of Reflection
obj_text:
ring Quel'Delar to Sword's Rest inside the Halls of Reflection.
 Bring Quel'Delar to Halls of Reflection
desc_text: You have re-forged and tempered the sword, yet it sits quietly in its sheath, little different from a mundane blade. You say the sword pulls you, as though it possesses a will?$BDare you bring it where it wishes to go? It is not right that the sword should be this silent and this insistent, yet I fear that if you do not take the sword to its destination, we will never learn why. Bear it with you to Icecrown Citadel's Halls of Reflection, but be on your guard. I will wait for you in The Frozen Halls.

title: Patchwerk Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Patchwerk.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BPatchwerk slain

 Patchwerk
 Patchwerk - Heroic
$B

 Patchwerk - Mythic
 Patchwerk - Ascended
desc_text: The so-called "avatar of war", Patchwerk is the ultimate abomination. It is also taking a heavy toll upon on our forces in the Dragonblight.$BI want you to assemble your companions and enter the Construct Quarter of Naxxramas. Disassemble the construct.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Patchwerk must die!

title: Malygos Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Malygos.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BMalygos the Spell-Weaver slain

 Malygos the Spell-Weaver
 Malygos Loot Dummy
 Malygos (2)
 Malygos (3)
 Malygos the Spell-Weaver - Heroic
$B

 Malygos Loot Dummy
 Malygos the Spell-Weaver - Mythic
 Malygos Loot Dummy
 Malygos the Spell-Weaver - Ascended
 Malygos Loot Dummy
desc_text: Our resources are strained. Malygos, the Spell-Weaver, is draining all of the magic out of the world, consolidating it in the Eye of Eternity. Without magic, we are doomed.$B<class>, the Nexus War must be brought to an end. The Council of Six has decreed that Malygos must die!

title: Flame Leviathan Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Flame Leviathan.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BFlame Leviathan slain

 Flame Leviathan
 Flame Leviathan - Heroic
$B

 Flame Leviathan - Mythic
 Flame Leviathan - Ascended
desc_text: Within the Formation Grounds sits Ulduar's first line of defense: Flame Leviathan.$BThe Kirin Tor have been provided with information suggesting that this Keeper-created machine is soon to be transported to an undisclosed location and let loose to wreak havoc upon the mortals of Azeroth.$BThis must not come to pass. The Council of Six has decreed that Flame Leviathan must die!

title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
obj_text: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
desc_text: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the restoration. Afterward, show the blade to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.

title: Ignis the Furnace Master Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Ignis the Furnace Master.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BIgnis the Furnace Master slain

 Ignis the Furnace Master
 Ignis the Furnace Master - Heroic
$B

 Ignis the Furnace Master - Mythic
 Ignis the Furnace Master - Ascended
desc_text: The great fire giant, Ignis the Furnace Master toils away inside of Ulduar's Colossal Forge. Under orders from Loken, Ignis creates weapons that are terrifying in their power.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Ignis must die!

title: Razorscale Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Razorscale.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BRazorscale slain

 Razorscale
 Razorscale - Heroic
$B

 Razorscale - Mythic
 Razorscale - Ascended
desc_text: Razorscale normally keeps to her aerie near the Colossal Forge in Ulduar. Of late, however, she has been spotted reigning fire down upon lands outside of the titan complex.$BThough the broodmother's is a sad tale, she poses an imminent threat to all of Northrend. The Council of Six has decreed that Razorscale must die!

title: Lord Jaraxxus Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Lord Jaraxxus.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 Lord Jaraxxus slain
desc_text: Archmage Timear has foreseen a horrible event, which is about to transpire. A foolish gnome warlock is about to accidentally summon an Eredar lord of the Burning Legion into the middle of the Trial of the Crusader.$BYou must be there when it happens, <class>. If Lord Jaraxxus escapes, he will open a portal and the Burning Legion will spill forth into our world once more.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Lord Jaraxxus must die!

title: Lord Marrowgar Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill Lord Marrowgar.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 Lord Marrowgar slain
desc_text: Lord Marrowgar is the guardian of the Frozen Throne within the Spire Chamber. Pieced together by the Lich King from the bones of a thousand vanquished adventurers, Marrowgar wields the power of the throne itself.$BWithout the destruction of this bone wraith, there is no hope of taking Icecrown Citadel.$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Lord Marrowgar must die!

title: The Sacred and the Corrupt
obj_text: Place Light's Vengeance, 25 Primordial Saronite, Rotface's Acidic Blood, and Festergut's Acidic Blood in Highlord Mograine's runeforge in Icecrown Citadel.$BRotface's Acidic Blood and Festergut's Acidic Blood may only be obtained in the 25 person difficulty setting of Icecrown Citadel.
desc_text: It is against my judgment that I present you this errand, <race>, as it will likely end in your undoing.$BIgnore my counsel and embark on the endeavor, and I shall provide you with the knowledge and resources to see it through.$BYou must return to Frostmourne Cavern and recover Light's Vengeance, Arthas' discarded hammer. Reforged with saronite and etched with the acidic blood of the Lich King's abominations, it will provide the foundation for our work.

title: The Pit of Saron
obj_text: Meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner inside the entrace to the Pit of Saron.
desc_text: Quickly, through the portal! I'll find you on the other side.

title: Deliverance from the Pit
obj_text:
Kill Scourgelord Tyrannus.
 Scourgelord Tyrannus slain
desc_text: We need to make our way up the main path and through the cave to Tyrannus' rise. There, he will be forced to confront us there lest we make our way into the citadel proper.$BGo now, <class>. My men and I will be there to stand by you when the confrontation with Tyrannus comes.

title: The Lich King's Last Stand
obj_text:
Highlord Darion Mograine in Icecrown Citadel wants you to kill the Lich King.
 Lich King Defeated
desc_text: Shadowmourne; a newly forged weapon already steeped in this world's history, reborn into an unrivaled destiny.$BWith this weapon you bear a solemn responsibility, and the time to carry out that charge is at hand.$BTake this weapon of myth and legend and march on the enemy. Avenge the countless heroes lost in his merciless campaign. Bring rest to their tortured souls.$BSteel yourself, <class>, and guide Shadowmourne to fulfill the purpose of its creation.

title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
obj_text: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
desc_text: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete its restoration, then show it to Myralio Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
obj_text: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
desc_text: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell to enter the Sunwell Plateau. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the restoration. Show the blade to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest once it is restored.

title: Frostmourne
obj_text: Meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner inside the entrance to the Halls of Reflection.
desc_text: Keep moving, the sword is close.$BI need a moment to send one of my Dark Rangers back to the airship. With all of our fodder gone, I will not be caught unprepared - we will need any help they can send.$BGo. I will meet you in the Halls of Reflection.

title: XT-002 Deconstructor Must Die!
obj_text:
Kill XT-002 Deconstructor.$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
 $BXT-002 Deconstructor slain

 XT-002 Deconstructor
 XT-002 Deconstructor - Heroic
$B

 XT-002 Deconstructor - Mythic
 XT-002 Deconstructor - Ascended
desc_text: Yet another strange construct of Mimiron, the XT-002 Deconstructor actually thinks that it is the keeper's son. Do not be fooled by its feigned innocence. It is a deadly machine!$BYou will find the Deconstructor within Ulduar's Scrapyard. The Council of Six has decreed that XT-002 Deconstructor must die!

title: Shadow's Edge
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
250 reputation with The Ashen Verdict

title: Blood Infusion
obj_text:
Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to infuse Shadow's Edge with blood and defeat Queen Lana'thel.$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
 $BInfuse Shadow's Edge with Blood then defeat Lana'thel.
desc_text: Your weapon is ready to be endowed with the power of blood.$BYou must face Queen Lana'thel in battle and subject yourself to her Blood Mirror. This will cause Shadow's Edge to drink the blood of the nearest living being. That being would be you, <race>.$BOnce the blade has been thus awakened, allow the Queen's Frenzied Bloodthirst to take hold of you, feed the blade thrice to sate it, and then give the queen an ignominious death.$BMay her screams pierce the ears of the Lich King as he awaits his fate.

title: Frost Infusion
obj_text:
Highlord Darion Mograine has instructed you to slay Sindragosa after subjecting yourself to 4 of her breath attacks while wielding Shadow's Edge.$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
 $BInfuse Shadow's Edge with Frost then slay Sindragosa.
desc_text: Shadow's Edge is prepared to receive its final infusion of power.$BSindragosa, the enemy's own mount, must fall. But before she is brought down, you must sustain four of her frozen breath attacks without tasting death.$BWithout his dragon, nothing shall stand between you and the Lich King.

title: Unholy Infusion
obj_text:
Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to infuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power and slay Professor Putricide.$BThis quest may only be completed in 25 person difficulty of Icecrown Citadel.
 $BInfuse Shadow's Edge with Unholy power then slay Putricide.
desc_text: efore your weapon can reach its full potential it must be endowed with its signature powers. First among them is unholiness.$BYou must seek out and defeat the one called Professor Putricide, but his death is not your only goal. You must use his resources against him.$BFind a way to absorb his mutated slime. Use the foul substance to infuse your weapon with the power of the unholy. Only when this has been done shall I reveal your next task.

title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
obj_text: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
desc_text: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, <name>.$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the its restoration, then speak with Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

title: REUSE
obj_text:
Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
500 reputation with The Silver Covenant

title: Wrath of the Lich King
obj_text:
Find Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and escape the Halls of Reflection
 Find Sylvanas Windrunner
 Escape the Lich King
desc_text: Uther knew a great deal about how Arthas might be defeated. It's hard to believe that there is much hope of defeating Arthas upon the steps of his own throne. And who will take up the crown of Lich King if it comes to that?$BMany questions remain, but the answers that you've uncovered may be critical to ensuring Arthas' defeat. You need to find Sylvanas and escape the Lich King while there's still time.

title: A Change of Heart
obj_text: Required money: 200

title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
obj_text: ring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers!$BAll the Horde will celebrate you as a hero, <name>.$BAs a <class>, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? I will not conceal my disappointment; I had hoped it would be a worthy sin'dorei. Let us seek the Argent Crusade's counsel. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Sunreavers.

title: A Victory For The Sunreavers
obj_text: ring the Restored Quel'Delar to Archmage Aethas Sunreaver at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
desc_text: At last, Quel'Delar is restored for the glory of the Sunreavers and the Horde! This is a blessing for our efforts against the Lich King.$BArchmage Aethas Sunreaver, the leader of the Sunreavers, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. title: Deprogramming
obj_text:
Defeat Lady Deathwhisper while ensuring that Darnavan survives.
 Rescue Darnavan
desc_text: We had hoped to place a man on the inside of the Cult of the Damned, to give us an inside angle on the Lich King's machinations, but we... underestimated the persuasive powers of Arthas and his dark minister, Lady Deathwhisper.$BOur man, Darnavan, is one of them now.$BIf you plan on fighting your way through the Oratory ahead, please keep your eyes peeled for Darnavan. If you can bring him back to us alive, we can attempt to reverse the Cult's brainwashing.

title: Securing the Ramparts
obj_text:
Slay the Rotting Frost Giant.
 Rotting Frost Giant slain
desc_text: As if this place weren't enough of a madhouse to begin with, we're fighting a war on two fronts up here, with the Scourge on one side and those blasted Alliance dogs on our other flank!$BWe are here to clear a safe landing for our vessels, but a behemoth of a giant on the other side of the Ramparts is hurling debris at anything that comes close and keeping our smaller ships at bay.$BI'll be honest -- he's a bit much for us to handle, but you and your companions look up to the task.

obj_text:
Return to Alchemist Adrianna while infected with Orange and Green Blight.
 $BReturn with two strains of Blight.
desc_text: Professor Putricide has been holed up in his foul laboratory, experimenting and refining increasingly lethal strains of blight to be used against us. If only we could obtain pure samples of the toxins, our researchers could concoct an antidote that would save countless lives.$BBut there's a catch -- a proper sample will need to mix two active strains within a living host. Should you have the... misfortune... of becoming such a host, please return here immediately so that we can harvest you for study.

title: Blood Quickening
obj_text:
Rescue Infiltrator Minchar before he is executed.
 Minchar Rescued
desc_text: These Scourge bloodsuckers -- San'layn they call themselves - give me the creeps. We've had one of our best men keeping an eye on them. But this morning he got sloppy and got himself taken prisoner. He's being interrogated by the Queen herself right now, and his cries echo through the Crimson Halls. Please, save him before it's too late!

obj_text:
Slay Arcane Serpents in Coldarra to prevent the unchecked arcane energies from destabilizing the ley lines and causing further harm to the magical balance of Azeroth.
 Arcane Serpent slain (15)
desc_text: Recently, the arcane energy within the Nexus has begun to spill over into the surrounding area, causing the very fabric of reality to shift and warp. This has given birth to a powerful and unstable entity known as Arcane Serpents, a magical serpent infused with raw arcane power.$BHero, the unchecked energies of these Serpents pose a grave threat to the stability of the ley lines and the magical balance of Azeroth. Travel to Coldarra and confront this volatile creature. By vanquishing Arcane Serpents, you will help restore the integrity of the ley lines and prevent further catastrophe.

Travel to Coldarra and defeat the Nexus Watchers to weaken Malygos's grip on the ley lines and aid in preserving the balance of magic that is vital to our world.

By defeating these guardians, you will weaken Malygos's control over the ley lines and aid in preserving the delicate balance of magic that sustains our world.

Your task is to confront and defeat the Magmoth Crushers, weakening their influence and halting their rampage.

title: Kaskala: Frogs in the Mist
obj_text: Collect 5 Steamed Frogs from Steam Frogs in the Flood Plains.
desc_text: In the mysterious Flood Plains, the amphibious creatures known as Steam Frogs have been affected by the strange energies in the area. Their unique biology has caused them to absorb the latent power, imbuing their bodies with an unusually potent essence. This essence could prove invaluable in crafting powerful potions and elixirs. Collect 5 Steamed Frogs from the Steam Frogs in the Flood Plains so that their essence can be harnessed for our cause.

title: Magmoth: Candles in the Darkness
obj_text: Collect 5 Extinguished Candles from Magmoth Shaman and Magmoth Foragers in Magmoth.
desc_text: The Magmoth Shaman and Magmoth Foragers have been using extinguished candles in their dark rituals, threatening the balance of power in Magmoth. By reclaiming these extinguished candles, we can disrupt their ceremonies and weaken their influence on the area. The task falls upon you to collect the extinguished candles from the clutches of the Magmoth Shaman and Magmoth Foragers.

title: Talramas: A Plague of Information
obj_text: Collect Scourge Meat from Scourged Mammoths and Scourge Blood Samples from Plagued Magnataurs near The Dens of Dying.
desc_text: Hero, our researchers have been studying the Scourge's devastating impact on the wildlife near "The Dens of Dying" in the Borean Tundra. We believe that by examining Scourged Mammoth meat and Plagued Magnataur blood samples, we can uncover crucial information about the Scourge's methods of infection and corruption. This knowledge will be invaluable in our fight against the undead and our efforts to heal the land.$BWe need you to venture into the dangerous territory near The Dens of Dying and collect Scourge Meat from the Scourged Mammoths and Scourge Blood Samples from the Plagued Magnataurs. Your bravery and dedication will be instrumental in our continued research and battle against the Scourge.

It is of utmost importance that we recover these lost supplies before they fall into enemy hands or are lost to the elements. Brave adventurer, seek out the lost supplies and return them to us.

We implore you to take up arms and venture into the heart of this danger. By defeating Chieftain Burblegobble and Heigarr the Horrible, you will safeguard the tranquility that defines this region and demonstrate your commitment to preserving the well-being of these lands.

title: Coldarra: Cold Seeker
obj_text: Find and loot the Nexus Dragon, Potent Crystalized Mana, Magic-bound Ancient Bark, and Geological Report in the Coldarra area to help us better understand the arcane forces at play and protect the balance of magic in Azeroth.
desc_text: The arcane energies of Coldarra hold great potential for both good and ill, depending on who controls them. To protect the balance of magic in Azeroth, it is crucial that we study and understand the forces that Malygos, the Spell-Weaver, seeks to manipulate.$BIn order to learn more about the magical energies of Coldarra, we need you to gather four specific items scattered across the island. Seek out and collect a Nexus Dragon, a Potent Crystalized Mana, a Magic-bound Ancient Bark, and a Geological Report. These items contain valuable information and potent energies that can help us devise a strategy to counteract Malygos's plans.$BHero, your mission is of great importance, as the future of Azeroth's magical balance hangs in the balance. Gather these items and help us unravel the mysteries of the ley lines and the arcane forces that lie within Coldarra.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Frigid Abominations in the Ruby Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Ruby Dragonshrine, once a place of serene beauty and home to the spirits of fallen red dragons, is now under siege. The tranquility of this sacred shrine has been shattered by the emergence of a sinister force known as the Frigid Abomination Attackers. These vile creatures, remnants of the Scourge's corruption, have risen from the icy depths to defile the hallowed grounds.

title: WotLK Daily Template

 Voidspawn slain

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Defeat Duke Vallenhal, Dahlia Suntouch, 7 Frigid Necromancers, and 7 Frigid Geists in the Ruby Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Ruby Dragonshrine, once a place of sacred tranquility, now faces a dire threat. Sinister forces have infiltrated this hallowed ground, led by the malevolent Duke Vallenhal and the enigmatic Dahlia Suntouch. Their dark presence has summoned Frigid Necromancers and Frigid Geists, casting a shadow of corruption upon the shrine.

title: Talramas: Chronicles of the Undead
obj_text: Collect the four necromantic tomes from Talramas and the Temple City of En'kilah.
desc_text: Hero, we have received word of four powerful necromantic tomes hidden within Talramas and the Temple City of En'kilah in the Borean Tundra. These books contain vital information about the Scourge's methods for raising the dead and controlling their undead armies.$BYour mission is to infiltrate these enemy strongholds, locate the four books - "Raising the Dead: A Necromancer's Guide to Commanding an Undead Army," "The Art of Corpse Crafting: Transforming the Dead into Powerful Servants," "The Necromancer's Apprentice: A Journey into the World of Undead Summoning," and "The Necrotic Tome: A Collection of Forbidden Spells and Incantations" - and return them to us. This knowledge will be invaluable in our fight against the Scourge and could provide us with the key to weakening their forces.

title: Magmoth: Elemental Harmony
obj_text: Collect Enraged Elemental Air, Boiling Elemental Water, and Raging Elemental Fire from the elementals in the Ruins of Eldra'nath, Boiling Pool, and Charred Rise.
desc_text: The elemental forces in the Ruins of Eldra'nath, Boiling Pool, and Charred Rise have become dangerously unstable. In order to restore balance, we must gather potent elemental essences from the most powerful elementals in the area: Enraged Tempests, Boiling Spirits, and Raging Boilers. By collecting Enraged Elemental Air, Boiling Elemental Water, and Raging Elemental Fire, you will help ensure the safety of this region and prevent further chaos from spreading. Your efforts are crucial in maintaining harmony amongst the elemental forces.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Dragonbone Condors and 1 Dreadtalon in the Ruby Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Ruby Dragonshrine faces a dire threat, and the balance between life and death hangs in jeopardy. Dark shadows loom over this sacred place as the vile Dragonbone Condors and the fearsome Dreadtalon pose a grave danger.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Gather 10 Petals of the Crimson Oak.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Ruby Dragonshrine faces a grave threat, and we call upon you to reinforce its defenses. Once a tranquil place where red dragons soared the skies, the shrine now stands under siege by malevolent forces. The ancient crimson oaks, a symbol of purity and connection to the red dragons, are in jeopardy.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Emerald Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Emerald Skytalons in the Emerald Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Emerald Dragonshrine, once a realm of serene beauty, is now under siege. The skies that were once graced by emerald dragons have been darkened by the malevolent presence of the Emerald Skytalons.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Ruby Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Collect 20 Frigid Bone Pieces from the creatures in the Ruby Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Ruby Dragonshrine, a place once revered for its sacred balance, now faces a dire threat. The malevolent forces that assail this hallowed ground have left behind Frigid Bone Pieces as a grim reminder of their dark presence.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Emerald Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Collect 10 Emerald Dragon Tears from the sacred grounds of the Emerald Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Emerald Dragonshrine, a place once bathed in the radiance of emerald dragons, now faces a dire threat. The tranquility of this sacred ground has been disrupted, and we call upon you to be our stalwart defender.

title: Kaskala: Culinary Components for Conjurers
obj_text: Collect the Kelp of the Deep Sea from Kvaldir Raiders, the "Other" Frog Meat from Gorloc Steam Belchers, and Caribou Horns from Marsh Caribou to assist in crafting a special stew for Dalaran's mages.
desc_text: The enchanting lands of the Flood Plains and the tuskarr settlement of Kaskala have long thrived due to their unity and cooperation. Today, we come to you, Hero, with a unique request that holds both tradition and magic in its essence. The mages of Dalaran, known for their arcane prowess, have developed a craving for a special stew that embodies the diverse harmony of the tuskarr, the Gorloc, and the creatures of the Flood Plains. To create this delectable dish, we need three vital ingredients: the Kelp of the Deep Sea harvested from the Kvaldir Raiders, the elusive "Other" Frog Meat from the Gorloc Steam Belchers, and the majestic Caribou Horns from the Marsh Caribou. Your role in collecting these items is pivotal, as you contribute to both the unity of these lands and the culinary delight of Dalaran's mages.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrine - Obsidian Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Disrupt 10 Necromantic Runes and defeat Rothin the Decaying in the Obsidian Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Obsidian Dragonshrine, a sacred place where the mighty dragons once roamed, is now defiled by the dark arts of necromancy. The vile forces of the Scourge seek to corrupt the shrine and unleash their malevolence upon the world.$BThe Necromantic Runes, etched with sinister power, channel dark energies that fuel the undead and threaten the balance of life and death. Their destruction is paramount to halt the Scourge's sinister plans.$BAs the chosen defender of Azeroth, you are summoned to answer the call to arms. The spirits of the fallen dragons yearn for liberation from this unholy menace, and it falls upon you to disrupt the foul runes and put an end to Rothin the Decaying, a harbinger of darkness.$BVenture into the heart of the Obsidian Dragonshrine, where the Necromantic Runes fester, and shatter their wicked power. Rothin the Decaying, a wretched servant of the Lich King, must be brought to justice.$BThe fate of the shrine and the balance of the world lie in your hands, Hero. You alone have the strength to push back the shadows and restore the sanctity of the Obsidian Dragonshrine.

title: Join the Frey - New Hearthglen
obj_text:
Collect 20 Onslaught's Armaments from the Onslaught Footmen, Onslaught Raven Priests, Commander Jordan, High General Abbendis, and Admiral Barean Westwind in the New Hearthglen.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, New Hearthglen, once a thriving settlement, now faces a dire threat from the malevolent Onslaught forces. These sinister enemies seek to conquer and subjugate, endangering the safety of all who reside here.$BThe Onslaught's Armaments, forged with malevolence and intent to conquer, are a symbol of the enemy's aggression. They must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.$BAs the chosen defender of Azeroth, you are summoned to answer the call to arms. The residents of New Hearthglen look to you for salvation, as the spirits of the fallen cry out for justice.$BVenture forth into the heart of the settlement, where the enemy lurks, and collect the Onslaught's Armaments. Your bravery will be the light that dispels the darkness and restores hope to New Hearthglen.

title: Join the Frey - Wrathgate
obj_text:
urn 10 Angrathar Aberrations using Smoldering Ichor in Angrathar the Wrathgate.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Wrathgate stands as a testament to the ongoing struggle for dominance in the frozen lands of Northrend. Amidst the chaos and conflict, a new threat has emerged - the Angrathar Aberrations. These twisted monstrosities, born from dark experiments, pose a dire menace to both the living and the undead.$BThe chilling winds that whip through the Wrathgate carry with them an eerie foreboding. The time has come for action, and you, Hero, have been chosen to answer the call. As the fate of Azeroth hangs in the balance, you must act decisively.$BIn your hands lies the Smoldering Ichor, a substance born from the essence of the Obsidian Dragonshrine. Its potent flames are the key to quelling the rising tides of darkness that threaten to engulf this sacred place.$BArmed with the Smoldering Ichor, venture forth into the heart of the Wrathgate. Seek out the Angrathar Aberrations and unleash the fiery wrath upon them. Your bravery and mastery over the arcane will be tested, but your resolve must remain unyielding.$BRemember, Hero, the safety of Azeroth is entrusted to you. In the face of these abominations, you stand as the last bastion of hope.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Emerald Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Collect 15 Emerald Feathers from the creatures in the Emerald Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Emerald Dragonshrine, once a sanctuary of emerald dragons, is now besieged by dark forces. The once-glorious skies are now filled with shadows, and the sacred feathers of the emerald dragons have become scattered amidst the chaos.$BThe spirits of the fallen dragons cry out for justice, and it falls upon you to answer their call to arms. The Emerald Feathers, imbued with the essence of the emerald dragons, hold great significance and power. They are a symbol of the shrine's sanctity and connection to the emerald flight.$BAs the chosen protector of Azeroth, you alone possess the strength and determination to gather these precious feathers. Embrace this crucial mission, for the fate of the Ruby Dragonshrine hinges on your valor.$BVenture forth into the heart of the shrine, where the sacred feathers await your touch. Let your bravery be the beacon of hope for the shrine's defenders, and safeguard the Emerald Feathers from those who would seek to desecrate them.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrine - Obsidian Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Collect 10 Smoldering Ichor from the Smoldering Skeletons, Smoldering Constructs, and Smoldering Geists in the Obsidian Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Obsidian Dragonshrine, once a place of reverence and power, now faces a dire threat. Dark forces have corrupted this sacred ground, and the smoldering remains of fallen warriors haunt its once hallowed halls.$BThe Smoldering Ichor, a substance tainted by malevolence, oozes from the tormented spirits that now roam the shrine. If left unchecked, this vile essence could unleash unspeakable horrors upon the world.$BAs the chosen defender of Azeroth, you are summoned to answer the call to arms. The spirits of the fallen dragons cry out for justice, and it falls upon you to put their souls to rest and secure the shrine's sanctity.$BVenture into the heart of the Obsidian Dragonshrine, where the smoldering apparitions lurk, and collect the Smoldering Ichor. Your bravery will be the light that pierces through the darkness and brings peace to the tormented souls.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrine - Bronze Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Infinite Timebreakers in the Bronze Dragonshrine and use the "Sample of Time-Magic Infused Sand" to aid you in your battle.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Bronze Dragonshrine is a sacred place where the very essence of time converges. The Bronze Dragonflight, entrusted with the duty of safeguarding the timeways, has sensed a disturbance in the fabric of reality. The Infinite Dragonflight, driven by a sinister purpose, seeks to disrupt the course of history.$BThe Infinite Timebreakers, agents of chaos and manipulation, have emerged from the nether to tamper with the very strands of time. They threaten to alter pivotal moments in Azeroth's history, creating darkened futures that should never come to pass.$BYou, Hero, have been chosen by the Bronze Dragonflight to stand against this malevolent force. Your courage and prowess are renowned, and the timeways themselves resonate with your arrival.$BIt is a daunting task that lies before you. The Infinite Timebreakers are formidable foes, cunningly protected by their "Battling through Time" aura. However, the Bronze Dragonflight has entrusted you with a potent weapon, the "Sample of Time-Magic Infused Sand." With this gift, you can temporarily weaken the Timebreakers, enabling you to confront them on even ground.$BYour mission is clear: seek out and defeat 8 Infinite Timebreakers, using the Sample of Time-Magic Infused Sand to nullify their defenses. The fate of Azeroth's past, present, and future rests upon your shoulders.

title: Join the Frey - Wrathgate
obj_text:
Slay 7 Frenzied Gargoyles and 3 Angrathar Necrolords in Angrathar the Wrathgate.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Wrathgate has become a battleground of darkness and despair. The forces of darkness have taken root, threatening to unleash chaos upon the sacred grounds. The time has come to answer the call to arms.$BAbove the scarred landscape, the Frenzied Gargoyles soar with malicious intent, their stone bodies animated by dark forces. They have become harbingers of terror, spreading fear among those who venture into their domain.$BNot far from the gargoyles, the sinister Angrathar Necrolords wield their necromantic powers with malevolent intent. Their presence corrupts the very essence of the Wrathgate, tainting its once-hallowed grounds.$BHero, you have been chosen to confront these vile threats head-on. Your courage and prowess in battle are needed now more than ever. Only through your relentless might can the tide of darkness be stemmed.$BVenture forth into the heart of Angrathar the Wrathgate, and let your name be whispered among the winds as the hero who stood firm against the encroaching night.

title: Join the Frey - Scarlet Point
obj_text:
Slay 10 Onslaught Masons, 10 Onslaught Infantry, and 5 Onslaught Death Knights at Scarlet Point.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the winds of war blow fiercely over Scarlet Point, a once peaceful land now besieged by the Onslaught. The sinister army, led by malevolent forces, threatens the safety of these lands and the innocent lives that reside within.

title: Join the Frey - Wrathgate
obj_text:
Slay the Colossal Abomination, a massive skeletal creature lurking in Angrathar the Wrathgate.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a fearsome threat looms over the sacred grounds of Angrathar the Wrathgate. Deep within the shadows, a Colossal Abomination stirs, its monstrous presence casting a sinister pall over the once-hallowed sanctuary.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrine - Bronze Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Collect 16 samples of Time-Magic Infused Sand in the Bronze Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Bronze Dragonshrine stands as a sanctuary where time converges, and the infinite possibilities of the past, present, and future are interwoven. The Bronze Dragonflight, the noble guardians of these timeways, seek your aid in preserving the delicate balance of time.$BIn recent days, the timeways have shown signs of turbulence. Temporal disturbances ripple through the fabric of reality, threatening to unravel the very essence of Azeroth's history. The Bronze Dragonflight suspects that malevolent forces seek to tamper with pivotal moments, paving the way for dire consequences.$BTo counter this dark influence, the Bronze Dragonflight requires a potent resource known as Time-Magic Infused Sand. This unique sand holds within it the essence of temporal power, and it can be utilized to mend the fraying threads of time.$BYour role, Hero, is to venture into the Bronze Dragonshrine and gather 16 samples of Time-Magic Infused Sand. This precious substance will bolster the efforts of the Bronze Dragonflight in their mission to maintain the integrity of Azeroth's past and future.$BBe wary, for the timeways are intricate and dangerous. While you may face challenges during your quest to collect the sand, know that your actions hold the potential to safeguard the very flow of history itself.

title: Join the Frey - War against Anub’ar
obj_text:
Slay 10 Anub'ar Slayers and 10 Anub'ar Blightbeasts in Icemist Village and Pit of Narjun.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the lands of Icemist Village and Pit of Narjun are under siege by a menacing threat, the Anub'ar. These vile creatures, born of darkness and decay, seek to spread their malevolence across this once tranquil region. The time has come to take up arms and join the Frey in the war against the Anub'ar.

title: Studying Northrend - Frostmourne Cavern
obj_text:
Collect 12 Deathbringer Essences from Ice Revenants in Frostmourne Cavern.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, within the chilling depths of Frostmourne Cavern lies an ancient and enigmatic power. This place holds the echoes of a past shrouded in both glory and darkness. As a champion of the living, your presence is requested to unravel the secrets hidden within these frozen halls.$BDeep within Frostmourne Cavern, the Ice Revenants dwell. These spectral entities are remnants of a time long past, guardians of the forgotten knowledge and arcane essences that permeate this place. The Deathbringer Essence, a rare and potent substance, is one such arcane essence they carry.$BThe Argent Crusade seeks to study these Deathbringer Essences, hoping to understand their nature and potential. As their most trusted Hero, you are tasked with venturing into Frostmourne Cavern to gather 12 of these elusive essences.$BBeware, Hero, for the Ice Revenants are not to be taken lightly. They draw upon the icy energies of Northrend, making them formidable adversaries. But it is your bravery, your skill, and your unwavering dedication to the cause of good that will see you through this task.$BIn the shadows of Frostmourne Cavern, the fate of these lands rests upon your shoulders. As you embark on this perilous journey, know that your actions may uncover truths long forgotten and aid the Argent Crusade in their noble pursuit.

title: Join the Frey - War against Anub’ar
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Anub'ar Underlords in the Pit of Narjun.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Pit of Narjun is infested with the malevolent Anub'ar, foul creatures loyal to the dark and insidious Old God, Yogg-Saron. Among these sinister beings are the dreaded Anub'ar Underlords, commanding the ranks of their vile brethren with ruthless efficiency.$BThe Frey calls upon you to take up arms and stand against the encroaching darkness in the Pit of Narjun. The Anub'ar Underlords are powerful adversaries, and their defeat is vital to weaken the forces of Yogg-Saron in this region.$BIn the shadows of the Pit of Narjun, the fate of Azeroth hangs in the balance. As you confront these malefic beings, remember that you are not alone in this endeavor. Other heroes, like you, have answered the call to battle, united in the cause to put an end to the threat that looms before us.$BBrave the depths of the Pit of Narjun, confront the Anub'ar Underlords, and show them the indomitable spirit of a true Hero. Your courage and determination will be an inspiration to all who fight in the war against Yogg-Saron and the malevolence of the Anub'ar.

title: Join the Frey - Disarming the army of Naxxramas
obj_text:
Defeat Kreug Oathbreaker, 5 Death Knights, and 1 Naxxramas Necrolord in The Carrion Fields.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Carrion Fields are a grim testament to the dark forces that seek to engulf our world. Within this desolate land lies the sinister fortress of Naxxramas, a malevolent necropolis ruled by the dread lich Kel'Thuzad. From its corrupted halls, an army of death and decay emerges, threatening all who dwell in Northrend.

title: Studying Northrend - The Mirror of Dawn
obj_text:
Gather 12 Frozen Steel Fragments from Ice Revenants in The Mirror of Dawn.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, amidst the ethereal beauty of The Mirror of Dawn, a wondrous yet perilous task awaits you. The serene landscape conceals an enigmatic secret that calls for your attention.

title: Victory over Nefarian
obj_text: Take the Head of Nefarian to your respective leader.
desc_text: You have done it. The Lord of Blackrock lies dead at your feet. Take his head and present it to Bolvar Fordragon, Thrall or Baron Revilgaz.

title: Deprecated: Lethality First
obj_text: The Facet of Keanna stored inside Keanna's Will wants you to gather 20 Arcane Residues from the Arcane Anomalies in Karazhan.
desc_text: Offensive magic was my area of expertise... that much I can remember.  I'll do my best to add my arcane channeling powers to yours.$BI'll need more raw power than I possess right now,however.  The arcane anomalies that roam the upper levels of the guardian's library would make excellent targets.  Gather their arcane residue,we'll need lots of it.

title: Adventurers Needed: Shadowfang Keep
obj_text:
Enter Shadowfang Keep and slay Archmage Arugal.
 $BArchmage Arugal slain

 Archmage Arugal
 Archmage Arugal - Heroic
$B

 Archmage Arugal - Mythic
 Archmage Arugal - Ascended
desc_text: I'm loath to send you on such a dangerous task without more training, but the threat has presented itself now. Gather a party of skilled adventureres before you take on this threat.$BFind a way to enter the inner courtyard of Shadowfang Keep. Fight your way through the army of ghosts and worgen and kill Archmage Argugal before his shadow extends past Silverpine Forest.$BThis quest must be turned in before level 29!

title: Victory over Onyxia
obj_text: Take the Head of Onyxia to your respective leader.
desc_text: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to Bolvar Fordragon, Thrall or Baron Revilgaz.

title: Strange Mojo
obj_text: Deliver the Strange Mojo to Hexxer Ubungo at The Argent Stand.
desc_text: This bottle of strange mojo may be the key to what is truly going on here.$BThe Zandalari troll Hexxer Ubungo, back at The Argent Stand, may want to take a look at it.

title: Population Control: Flamewaker Imp (High-Risk)
obj_text:
Travel to The Path of Anguish and cull 30 Flamewaker Imps.
 Flamewaker Imp (10)
desc_text: After the sundering of Draenor, most life was wiped out during collapse of the barrier between Draenor and the Twisting Nether and the resulting explosion. The wildlife that survived became sickly or corrupt, and many of Ner'zhul's portals were left permanently open, allowing all manner of dangerous beings to enter Outland and threaten our presence here.  The Flamewaker Imp population is becoming a real threat. Travel to The Path of Anguish and cull 30 of them.

title: ... Or Maybe We Don't
obj_text:
Charge your War Golem with the energy from 10 Lightning Sentries and return to Raegar Breakbrow at Prospector's Point.
 Charge Level (10)
desc_text: You'd think the guys making the power cells would've thought to power them up, but no, they've got to make it difficult for us.$BFine, we'll charge those cells the hard way. There's enough power in them to run the golem for a short time, but don't expect it to be any good in combat.$BYou see the lightning sentries that the irons have posted around the perimeter of Dun Argol? Bring the golem with you, take it close to them, and use the golem to absorb the power as the sentries die.

title: Locating the Mechanism
obj_text: Guard Captain Zorek at Valgarde in Howling Fjord wants you to bring him a Harpoon Control Mechanism.
desc_text: Don't worry, <name>; this is all going to lead to something big! HUGE! You're just going to have to trust me for now and do as I ask of you.$BWe need to get the mechanism mentioned in the manual for the next step of the plan.
