I have a strong suspicion that you'll find one on one of those vrykul that operate the harpoon guns in Wyrmskull Village. You'll find them on the east side of the village, on the docks by the longhouses.

title: The Pulse of the Poison
obj_text: Head to the depths of the sewers, eliminate the apothecaries, destroy the Blight charges, and obtain a water sample.
desc_text: <Cereza rifles through the papers on her table, her expression grim.>$BIf his plan was to weaponize blight charges... we don’t have time to waste.$B<name>, I need you to go deeper into the sewers. If you encounter any apothecaries—kill them. All of them. And destroy the blight canisters before they can be triggered.$B<Cereza hands you an empty vial with a steady hand.>$BEven if they haven’t gone off yet, the blight might already be seeping into the pipes. Take a water sample and bring it to Eldryn, the druid. If our fears are true... he’ll know what to do.$BI hope.

title: Wanted: Sathrivar the Corruptor
obj_text:
Slay Sathrivar the Corruptor
 Sethrivan the Corruptor slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Hero, the vile necromancer Sathrivar the Corruptor practices dark magic deep within Plaguewood, raising legions of undead. His foul powers spread sickness and decay, warping the environment. I beseech you, brave champion, to hunt down this villain. Journey into Plaguewood's rotted forests, find the necromancer's lair, and slay him so his evil spreads no further.

title: Who Called For Da Docta?
obj_text:
Kill the Kobold who bullied Lil Wa'zoo!
 Zipi slain
desc_text: Thank you so much friend! Some Kobold not nice, they hurt Lil Wa'zoo for bein' himself.$BLet me make clear: Kobold just want dig. We hit rock, make candle, explore world. My brethren, we no get why some hate us. We no mean to be nuisance. Am sorry.$BI thank my good friends who no hurt me... Thank your friend for me for looking out for me, and thank you for help too!$BOh...no, wait. Look behind you! He back!!!

title: The High Cultist
obj_text:
Warden Jodi Moonsong at Stars' Rest has asked you to slay High Cultist Zangus.
 High Cultist Zangus slain
desc_text: I have dreamed of Zangus before but without the context that you have discovered, I knew not what it meant. You have brought clarity to the vision that the goddess has bestowed upon me, and now I know that he can be found within the Pit of Narjun to the north.$BYou know your target, <name>. If there's to be an end to the suffering of the land, the high cultist must die!

title: A Bottle of Spirits
obj_text: Get a cannister of ectoplasm in Stonesplinter Valley.
desc_text: I mean…listen I can explain…it’s not what it sounds like, I mean it is but… oh this is bad. Efry you’re such an idiot, you should’ve just told the helpful adventurer! Gah! I…this isn’t helping, is it?$BI…look, there’s only so much our tech can do. People, like us, we’re smarter than any bot, but the question is, what makes us that way? What changes us? Well, it’s not like anyone’s got all the answers, but, ghosts, wraiths, those sorta things still retain their minds, so it’s not a body. So what if the difference is the spirits themselves? Well, the problem then is, how do you shove that into a bot?$BWell, some people have managed to gather something those spirits leave behind - ectoplasm they call it. So I thought, people have gathered ectoplasm anyway - what if I put that in the processor core of a bot, used ectoplasm combined with the basic intelligence systems we’ve been creating for a while, to create something more. Something like us!$BSo I…did that…with Nylrisa…$BLook, we can talk about this more later, the important thing is finding Nylrisa. If this troll exile has a plan… well, we don’t have a choice, do we? I don’t have any ectoplasm on me, but there was a cannister stolen by the troggs to the south. Doubt they know what to do with the stuff, so we can just hope they didn't break it.

title: In Service of Blood
obj_text: Koltira Deathweaver at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight wants you to use the Blood Gem on a Deranged Indu'le Villager and return to him with a Filled Blood Gem.
desc_text: The blood of innocents was once used to sate the thirst of the blade. Alas, such options are no longer available to me.$B<Koltira pauses to think.>$BWe must improvise. South of here, upon the high bluffs, is the tuskarr village of Indu'le. Having been recently overrun by the Blue Dragonflight's chaotic magic, the resident tuskarr of Indu'le have gone mad.$BTake this blood gem and use it on a deranged villager. If I cannot take the blood of innocents, I shall have the blood of the meek!

title: A Meeting With Fate
obj_text:
Orbaz Bloodbane has commanded you to deliver the Scarlet Courier's Message to High General Abbendis at King's Harbor.
Scarlet Crusade Disguise (Provided)
desc_text: This message must reach Abbendis. We do not want to draw their suspicion. They must continue under the assumption that everything is going as they planned.$BYou will don the Scarlet courier's clothes and with the help of some dark magic, take on the form of the courier.$BAbbendis is at King's Harbor, southeast of the Scarlet Overlook. Drop off the message and get as much information out of her as you can. She will tell us what we need to know about the "Crimson Dawn."

title: Cutting Off the Source
obj_text:
Overlord Razgor at Warsong Hold wants you to destroy 10 Nerub'ar Egg Sacs.
 Nerub'ar Egg Sac Destroyed (10)
desc_text: Aerial reconnaissance of the quarry reports that the Nerubians are storing their eggs on the scaffolding surrounding the base. Smart beasts these are... They're keeping the eggs high and dry, away from the epicenter of conflict.$BYou're going to have to go back out there and track down their eggs. Find 'em, smash 'em, and trash 'em.$BEach egg destroyed means twenty less Nerubians feeding on our corpses.

title: Life or Death
obj_text:
Rheanna at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to use the Renewing Bandage on 10 Wounded Westfall Infantry units.
 Westfall Infantry Healed (10)
desc_text: Oh, the carnage....$BI've been through many battles, <class>, and this one was more brutal than any I've seen. Our fight with the Horde has become more intense than ever. It's them or us here in Northrend - life or death.$BIf we are to survive here another day we'll need to mend our wounded. There are too many for me to rescue alone.$BI've prepared special bandages that will enable you to assist me. Take one and tend to those who have not yet succumbed to their wounds.

title: A Special Surprise
obj_text:
Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Antoine Brack, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
 Antoine Brack slain
desc_text: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, <name>. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty Forsaken in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

title: A Delicate Touch
obj_text:
Ricket at K3 wants you to use Improved Land Mines at Garm's Bane to fend off 12 attackers from Garm. Both Garm Invaders and Snowblind Followers will count towards this goal.
 $BGarm Attackers slain (12)

 Garm Invader
$B

 Snowblind Follower
desc_text: I've been waiting an eternity for these mines! Well, a few days at least. What took him so long?$BHere's the low down, compadre... there's this nasty bunch of magnataur--you know, big, hairy, and extremely ugly--and they seem pretty keen on taking K3 for themselves.$BNot going to happen.$BWe've got some defenses set up in their path, northeast of here. Sadly, our laser turrets have pretty limited power supplies... that's where these mines come in! Get over there and blow them up good!

title: Joining the Assault
obj_text: Report to Ground Commander Xutjja at the edge of the glacier north of Ymirheim.
desc_text: We need more men to join the main assault on Ymirheim.$BAny warrior with half a brain can tell you that vrykul are fierce fighters and should not be taken lightly. That goes two-fold for the Ymirjar. They have shown us no restraint in proving why the Lich King deemed them worthy.$BGround Commander Xutjja is overseeing the assault. The city itself is located in the center of Icecrown - Xutjja's troops are positioned near the edge of the glacier, north of the city.

title: Wanted: Magister Keldonus
obj_text:
Slay Magister Keldonus and return to Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.
 Magister Keldonus slain
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: y decree of Overlord Agmar:$BTarget: Magister Keldonus$BCrime: Treason$BStatus: Alive$BMagister Keldonus, once mage commander of Agmar's Hammer, is to be killed on sight in the name of the Horde.$BKeldonus was last seen traveling southwest towards Moonrest Gardens to join the Blue Dragonflight in their campaign against magic.$BApproach with caution as Keldonus is a powerful magus. Do not engage solo!$BAll bounties are paid out by Captain Gort at Agmar's Hammer.

title: Gal'darah Must Pay
obj_text:
Tol'mar at Dubra'Jin wants you to slay Gal'darah in Gundrak.
 $BGal'darah Slain

 Gal'darah
 Gal'darah - Heroic
$B

 Gal'darah - Mythic
 Gal'darah - Ascended
desc_text: Did ya see it, mon?$BIt musta been da most awful thing I ever seen. Da great Akali - slain right before my eyes. Horrible...$BI done took an oath not ta be gettin' involved here. My job be to observe only. But dis cannot stand! Gal'darah must pay!$BGo into Gundrak and seek him out. Come back to me when Akali's death been avenged, mon.

title: Join the Frey - New Hearthglen
obj_text:
Defeat 15 troops from the Onslaught group in New Hearthglen.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, New Hearthglen, a once peaceful settlement, now stands threatened by the malevolent Onslaught forces. These enemies seek to sow chaos and destruction, jeopardizing the safety and well-being of the innocent.$BAs the chosen defender of Azeroth, you are called upon to answer the call to arms. The residents of New Hearthglen look to you for deliverance from this menacing threat. The spirits of the fallen cry out for justice, and it falls upon you to bring swift retribution upon the Onslaught.$BVenture forth into the heart of the settlement, where the enemy forces have infiltrated, and show them the strength of the Hero. Let your battle cries be heard throughout New Hearthglen, inspiring hope and courage in the hearts of its defenders.

title: Join the Frey - War against Anub’ar
obj_text:
Gather 30 Anub'ar Venom from Anub'ar Slayer, Anub'ar Cultist, Anub'ar Blightbeast, and Anub'ar Underlord in Icemist Village and Pit of Narjun.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the call to arms echoes across the icy plains of Northrend as a war against the Anub'ar, the vile and insidious insectoid creatures, wages on. They crawl forth from the dark depths of the earth, threatening the peaceful denizens of Icemist Village and Pit of Narjun.

title: Join the Frey - War against Anub’ar
obj_text:
Collect 10 Black Blood of Yogg-Saron in the Pit of Narjun.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Pit of Narjun is shrouded in darkness and teeming with the malevolent Anub'ar, minions of the ancient and malefic Old God, Yogg-Saron. The vile creatures have been corrupted by the Black Blood of Yogg-Saron, a noxious substance that grants them unholy power and binds them to the will of the sinister Old God.$BThe Frey beseeches you to take up arms and delve into the treacherous depths of the Pit of Narjun. Your task is to gather the Black Blood of Yogg-Saron from these tainted creatures, severing their ties to their malevolent master.$BAs you venture into the heart of this shadowed realm, remember that you are not alone. Other champions of Azeroth stand with you, united in the fight against the encroaching darkness. The Frey believes in your valor and strength, knowing that only a Hero like you can face the horrors that dwell within the Pit of Narjun.$BDefeat the Anub'ar and carefully collect the Black Blood of Yogg-Saron in vials provided by the Frey. The malevolence of this substance is undeniable, but it is essential to disrupt Yogg-Saron's wicked schemes.

title: Studying Northrend - Eldricht Heights
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Bloodpaw Shaman and 10 Bloodpaw Warriors in Eldricht Heights.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, in the untamed wilderness of Eldricht Heights, a new threat looms on the horizon. The Bloodpaw tribe, known for their fierce savagery and allegiance to dark forces, has descended upon this tranquil land, leaving chaos and despair in their wake. Their brutal presence poses a dire threat to the fragile balance of Northrend's ecosystem.

title: Studying Northrend - Coldwind Pass
obj_text:
Collect 12 Ice Clusters from the Frozen Elementals in Coldwind Pass.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the frigid winds of Coldwind Pass whisper tales of ancient power and mysteries locked within the ice. The pass, nestled among the peaks of Northrend, is a land of eternal winter, where Frozen Elementals roam, their icy forms a testament to the primal forces that shape this unforgiving landscape.

title: Join the Frey - Disarming the army of Naxxramas
obj_text:
Implode 10 Plague Wagons in The Carrion Fields using the Siegesmith Wagon Disruptor.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Carrion Fields have become a grim battleground, tainted by the malevolent presence of Naxxramas and its vile Plague Wagons. These sinister contraptions spread pestilence and destruction, threatening all life in their wake.

title: Join the Frey - Disarming the army of Naxxramas
obj_text:
Collect 10 Siegesmith Wagon Disruptors from Scourge Siegesmiths in The Carrion Fields.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the dark forces of Naxxramas have spread their influence across The Carrion Fields, threatening to unleash untold destruction upon our lands. In their malevolent arsenal are the Siegesmith Wagons, powerful war machines capable of laying waste to our defenses.

title: Join the Frey - War against Anub’ar
obj_text:
reak 10 Eggs of Anub'ar in Icemist Village and Pit of Narjun.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the menace of the Anub'ar spreads its darkness across Icemist Village and Pit of Narjun. These vile creatures not only wage war with their living forces but also seek to multiply their ranks through the insidious hatching of Anub'ar Eggs.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Galakrond’s Rest
obj_text:
Collect 30 Wasted Bone of Galakrond from Giants in Galakrond's Rest.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the echoes of Galakrond's ancient might still resonate in these sacred grounds. However, the peace that once graced this place is now disrupted. The Giants that roam these lands have plundered the remains of the great dragon, Galakrond, and now, the Wasted Bone of Galakrond is scattered about, defiling this hallowed resting place.$BThe bones of Galakrond hold immense power, and in the wrong hands, they can be twisted into dark and nefarious purposes. The Giants, heedless of the consequences, have been amassing these bones, ignorant of the spiritual unrest they are causing.$BIt is imperative, Hero, that you gather these Wasted Bone of Galakrond before they can be exploited. Only you, with your unyielding valor and sense of duty, can prevent this malevolent energy from spreading.$BEmbark on this quest to protect the sanctity of Galakrond's Rest and restore balance to this sacred land. Face the Giants head-on, for they will not part with the bones willingly. Show them the strength and determination of a true hero.

title: Studying Northrend - Eldricht Heights
obj_text:
Collect 20 Bloodpaw Claws from the creatures in Eldricht Heights.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Eldricht Heights, once a realm of tranquility and natural beauty, is now under siege by the malevolent Bloodpaw tribe. These savage creatures, corrupted by dark forces, have brought chaos and terror to this once serene land. The Frey, a group dedicated to preserving the delicate balance of nature in Northrend, calls upon you to aid in their efforts to restore harmony to this beleaguered realm.

title: Studying Northrend - Lake Indu’le
obj_text:
Collect 12 Corrupted Water Samples from the Corrupted Ragers in Lake Indu’le.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Lake Indu’le, a place once teeming with natural beauty and serenity, now faces a dire threat. The tranquil waters of this sacred lake have been tainted by malevolent forces, giving rise to the Corrupted Ragers. These once peaceful creatures have been corrupted by dark energies, and their presence poses a grave danger to the delicate balance of this pristine environment.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Galakrond’s Rest
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Rotting Storm Giants in Galakrond's Rest.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient grounds of Galakrond's Rest hold a deep significance in the history of Azeroth. It is the final resting place of the mighty proto-dragon Galakrond, who once terrorized the world. Now, the peace of this sacred place is threatened, and the spirits that roam here are in peril.

title: Clipping their wings - Valkyrion
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Nascent Val'kyr in Valkyrion.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the skies of Valkyrion have become haunted by the presence of Nascent Val'kyr. These once-angelic beings, corrupted and twisted by dark forces, now roam the heavens with ill intent. The malevolence that emanates from them threatens the very essence of Valkyrion.

title: Clipping their wings - Valkyrion
obj_text:
Collect 10 Frostplume in Valkyrion.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the skies of Valkyrion are treacherous and unforgiving. Among the perilous winds and chilling storms, a unique and valuable resource known as Frostplume can be found. It is said to possess the essence of the very air that surrounds Valkyrion, infused with the power of ice and cold.

title: Studying Northrend - Crystal Vice
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Crystalline Ice Giants in Crystal Vice.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Crystal Vice, a treacherous and frozen land, holds many secrets waiting to be unraveled. Among its icy terrain, the formidable Crystalline Ice Giants roam freely, guardians of long-forgotten knowledge and ancient relics.

title: Clipping their wings - Valkyrion
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Frostfeather Screechers.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the once idyllic realm of Valkyrion, a troubling darkness now looms in the skies. The graceful Frostfeather Screechers, known for their enchanting melodies that once brought joy to the hearts of its denizens, have fallen victim to a malevolent curse. Transformed into aggressive and tormented creatures, their haunting screeches now echo through the valleys, striking fear into the hearts of all.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Galakrond’s Rest
obj_text:
Defeat 20 Wastes Scavengers in Galakrond's Rest.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient grounds of Galakrond's Rest have become troubled once more. The Wastes Scavengers, vile creatures that feed on the remnants of death and decay, have infested this sacred place. Their presence threatens the balance of the spirits that reside here, and their malevolent activities desecrate the sanctity of this hallowed ground.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Azure Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Defeat 20 Dragonblight Mage Hunters in Azure Dragonshrine.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Azure Dragonshrine, nestled amidst the breathtaking landscape of Dragonblight, has become a battleground where ancient forces clash in a struggle for dominance. The blue dragons, protectors of magic and guardians of Azeroth's arcane mysteries, face a grave threat in the form of the Dragonblight Mage Hunters.

title: Studying Northrend - The Cursed one in the Path of Titans
obj_text:
Defeat Jotun, The Curse Bearer in the Path of Titans.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Path of Titans, a sacred and enigmatic land, holds a tale of sorrow and a cursed being known as Jotun. Once a proud and noble titan, Jotun was burdened with a curse that forces him to walk this path for eternity. His heartrending story has touched the hearts of many across Azeroth.$BLong ago, Jotun was a formidable titan, devoted to protecting the very essence of creation. But fate dealt him a cruel hand, and he fell victim to an ancient curse, condemning him to wander the Path of Titans without respite or redemption.$BThroughout the ages, Jotun has become a symbol of suffering and sacrifice, a reminder of the enduring struggles faced by even the mightiest beings. Many have tried to break the curse, to grant him rest and salvation, but all efforts have been in vain.$BNow, Hero, it is your turn to face this solemn task. Engage Jotun in combat and show him that hope still shines in the hearts of mortals. Perhaps your valor and compassion can pierce through the darkness that binds him, even if only for a fleeting moment.$BYour battle with Jotun may not end the curse, but your presence and courage will not go unnoticed. You will stand as a testament to the indomitable spirit of mortals, and your actions may bring a glimmer of solace to the cursed titan.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Azure Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Gather 10 pieces of "Azure Dragonflight Plan evidence" from the Focus Wizard in Azure Dragonshrine to disrupt the magic in the Beacon Platforms of the blue dragonflight.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Azure Dragonshrine is a place of great significance to the blue dragonflight. For ages, they have safeguarded this sacred sanctuary, using it as a beacon of arcane wisdom and power. However, the tranquility of the shrine has been shattered by an insidious threat.$BWithin the Azure Dragonshrine, a group of sinister spellcasters known as the Focus Wizards has emerged. These once-respected members of the blue dragonflight have been corrupted by dark forces, seeking to disrupt the magic that flows through the Beacon Platforms.$BThe Beacon Platforms are not just a source of magic; they are a conduit for the blue dragonflight's ancient knowledge and power. Should the Focus Wizards succeed in their dark designs, the very essence of the shrine will be tainted, and the dragonflight's connection to their heritage will be severed.$BIt is with this dire warning that you are called upon, Hero. The blue dragonflight seeks your aid in disrupting the magic in the Beacon Platforms. Only by gathering 10 pieces of "Azure Dragonflight Plan evidence" from the Focus Wizards can you thwart their sinister plans.$BEmbrace this call to arms, for your courage and prowess in battle are renowned. You have faced mighty foes and overcome great challenges. Now, the future of the Azure Dragonshrine lies in your hands. The blue dragonflight believes in your ability to safeguard their legacy and preserve the sanctity of the shrine.

title: A Ballad of Fire and Ice - Dun Niffelem
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Seething Revenants in Dun Niffelem.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient titan city of Dun Niffelem stands at a precipice, threatened by a malevolent force that seeks to engulf this sacred realm in darkness. The once peaceful land now echoes with the restless spirits of the Seething Revenants, their rage and sorrow twisting the very fabric of this once harmonious place. As the brave Hero, you are called upon to confront this spectral menace and restore the delicate balance that has been disrupted.

title: A Ballad of Fire and Ice - Dun Niffelem
obj_text:
Collect 20 Seething Fire from Seething Revenants and Fjorn in Dun Niffelem.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient titan city of Dun Niffelem is facing a crisis that threatens the very essence of its existence. The eternal balance between fire and ice that once resonated harmoniously within these sacred halls is now under dire threat. The Seething Revenants, tormented spirits of the fallen, and the formidable Fjorn, who wields the power of frost and fire, have become sources of unbridled chaos, endangering the sanctity of this realm.

title: Reinforcements in the Shrines - Azure Dragonshrine
obj_text:
Gather 15 Blue Dragonflight scales in Azure Dragonshrine. Create a special container to hold them.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Azure Dragonshrine is a sacred place for the blue dragonflight, where they have safeguarded their ancient wisdom and magic for generations. However, the shrine now faces a dire threat, and the blue dragons require your assistance.

title: A Ballad of Fire and Ice - Dun Niffelem
obj_text:
Defeat Fjorn and 5 Stormforged Iron Giants in Dun Niffelem.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, we find ourselves in a time of dire need, with the ancient titan city of Dun Niffelem under threat. The once peaceful land is now besieged by the malevolent forces of the Frost Giants, led by the formidable Fjorn, known as the Ice-Lord. This dark presence seeks to plunge this sacred realm into eternal winter and disrupt the delicate balance that once existed.

title: A Ballad of Fire and Ice - Dun Niffelem
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Tundra Rams in Dun Niffelem.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient titan city of Dun Niffelem is facing an unexpected challenge that threatens the delicate balance of this sacred realm. The once peaceful Tundra Rams, known for their gentle nature, have inexplicably become aggressive and are causing turmoil in the region. Their sudden aggression is disrupting the harmonious ballad of fire and ice that resonates throughout this hallowed city.

title: Clipping their wings - Valkyrion
obj_text:
Defeat 5 Blighted Proto-Drakes and 10 Valkyrion Aspirants in Valkyrion.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Valkyrion, a place of chilling winds and desolate beauty, has fallen under the shadow of darkness. Once a bastion of hope and valor for the Vrykul, it is now plagued by corruption and malevolence. Blighted Proto-Drakes, once majestic creatures, now roam the skies with taint and sickness. The Valkyrion Aspirants, once noble and proud, have succumbed to darkness and serve as enforcers of doom.

title: Clipping their wings - Valkyrion
obj_text:
Collect 10 Stormcrest Eagle Eggs from Gob Eagle Eggs in Valkyrion.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the icy reaches of Valkyrion, an ancient nest of majestic Stormcrest Eagles has been discovered. These noble creatures are known for their fierce loyalty and have long served as symbols of strength and freedom to the denizens of Northrend. However, an ominous threat looms over these proud creatures – the vile Gob Eagles. These corrupted eagles, once majestic and free, now carry tainted eggs that endanger the survival of the Stormcrest Eagles. The Hero is called upon to venture into Valkyrion, locate the Gob Eagle Eggs, and gather the pristine Stormcrest Eagle Eggs. The fate of these magnificent creatures rests in the Hero's hands, for only through their actions can the curse on the Gob Eagles be broken, and the Stormcrest Eagles protected.

title: A Ballad of Fire and Ice - Dun Niffelem
obj_text:
Collect 10 Time Frozen Crystal Samples from the Thunderfall Epicenter in Dun Niffelem.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient titan city of Dun Niffelem is facing an unprecedented crisis that threatens the delicate balance of fire and ice within its sacred walls. The ethereal realm known as the Thunderfall Epicenter, a place where elemental forces collide, has experienced an unusual disturbance. The fabric of time has been tampered with, and the harmonious ballad of fire and ice is in peril.

title: Business request from the Goblins - K3
obj_text:
Defeat 7 Garm Invaders and 9 Snowblind Followers in K3.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the industrious goblins of K3 have found themselves in a precarious situation, beset by the relentless onslaught of Garm Invaders and Snowblind Followers. As the perilous snows of this unforgiving land blanket the outpost, the goblins urgently seek aid in defending their bustling trade hub. The invaders threaten to disrupt the vital commerce and trade routes that sustain K3, and they must be driven back.

title: Business request from the Goblins - K3
obj_text:
Defeat 7 Garm Watchers and 7 Snowblind Devotees in K3.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the industrious goblins of K3 have come to rely on your unwavering strength and prowess as a legendary adventurer. Once again, they seek your aid in a dire situation. The region is facing a new threat in the form of the Garm Watchers and Snowblind Devotees. These hostile forces, driven by unknown motivations, are determined to disrupt the smooth operation of K3 and threaten the goblins' lucrative trade routes.

title: Business request from the Goblins - K3
obj_text:
Collect 15 Garm Relics from the Garm Watchers and Snowblind Devotees in K3.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the goblins of K3 have an urgent business request that requires your extraordinary skills. In the frigid heart of the Storm Peaks, an ancient and mysterious artifact known as the Garm Relic has been discovered. Legends speak of its great power, and the goblins believe it could be the key to unlocking untold riches and technological advancements.

title: Polar bears are not enough - The Brunhildar Village
obj_text:
Defeat 20 Ravenous Jormungars in Hibernal Cave.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the once peaceful and tranquil Brunhildar Village, nestled within the icy embrace of Hibernal Cave, is facing a dire and unprecedented threat. The Ravenous Jormungars, fearsome and voracious serpent-like creatures, have surged in number and begun to encroach upon the village's territory. These relentless predators are known for their insatiable hunger and pose a significant danger not only to the village's inhabitants but also to the delicate balance of nature in the region.

title: Business request from the Goblins - K3
obj_text:
Gather 10 Impure Saronite Ore from the rich veins around K3.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the goblins of K3 have an urgent business request that requires your assistance. In the heart of the Storm Peaks, the land is infused with the mysterious and powerful element known as Saronite. This rare metal holds great potential for the goblins' ambitious ventures, and they seek to extract its valuable properties for their business endeavors.

title: Business request from the Goblins - K3
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Icetip Crawlers, 6 Crystalweb Spitters, and 6 Crystalweb Weavers in the vicinity of K3.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the goblins of K3 have a pressing business request that requires your immediate attention. In the frozen wilderness of the Storm Peaks, the goblins have established their outpost of K3. However, the area surrounding the outpost has become infested with dangerous and hostile creatures that threaten the safety of the goblin workers and their operations.

title: Polar bears are not enough - The Brunhildar Village
obj_text:
Gather 15 Hibernal Scales from the fierce creatures of Hibernal Cave.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Brunhildar Village is facing a daunting challenge, and they turn to you, the legendary champion of Azeroth, for aid. The tranquil harmony of Hibernal Cave has been disrupted, as the once-reclusive inhabitants of this frozen realm, the Hibernal Scales, have emerged from their hidden sanctuaries. These majestic creatures are renowned for their iridescent and resilient scales, which possess extraordinary properties and are highly sought after for their use in crafting and enchantments.

title: Polar bears are not enough - The Brunhildar Village
obj_text:
Gather 10 Icemaw Winter Fur from the majestic Icemaw bears within Hibernal Cave.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the chilling winds of Northrend have brought forth an unparalleled challenge to the Brunhildar Village. The once bountiful population of the Icemaw bears, a creature revered and cherished by the villagers for generations, has been dwindling at an alarming rate. These resplendent creatures are not only a symbol of strength and resilience but also a vital part of the village's ecosystem, helping to maintain the delicate balance within Hibernal Cave.

title: Polar bears are not enough - The Brunhildar Village
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Niffelem Frost Giants and 5 Frostworgs in the Valley of Ancient Winters.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Valley of Ancient Winters, once a serene and tranquil land, now faces a grave threat that imperils its very existence. The malevolent Niffelem Frost Giants and their sinister Frostworg allies have descended upon this sacred place, disrupting the delicate balance of nature and wreaking havoc upon its inhabitants. The peaceful denizens of the Brunhildar Village have sent out a desperate call for aid, seeking the prowess of a mighty champion to stand against these colossal foes.

title: Polar bears are not enough - The Brunhildar Village
obj_text:
Collect 5 Frostworg Skins from the formidable Frostworgs in the Valley of Ancient Winters.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the chilling winds of the Valley of Ancient Winters whisper tales of your valor and strength, making you a beacon of hope for the Brunhildar Village. As you step into this frigid wilderness, you witness a village struggling to survive amidst the relentless cold. The Frostworgs, fierce and cunning creatures, roam the valley, threatening the villagers and the polar bears alike. The Brunhildar Village looks up to you, knowing that only a hero of your caliber can face these beasts and bring back the Frostworg skins needed to protect their people.

title: Let it drift - Snowdrift plains
obj_text:
Gather 7 Stormrider Essences from Stormriders in Snowdrift Plains.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the heart of the Snowdrift Plains, a mystical phenomenon unfolds as the Stormriders roam freely. These enigmatic beings are ethereal entities born from the very essence of the tempestuous winds that sweep through the icy wilderness. The Stormriders' presence is no mere coincidence; their existence signifies a delicate balance between the elements, a harmony disrupted by unforeseen disturbances.$BHero, you are summoned to this realm of elemental power and frigid beauty. The Stormriders' essences hold the key to understanding the intricacies of the snow-laden winds. Only by collecting their essences can we discern the reason behind their presence and the impact they hold over this realm. As the guardian of the balance between earth and air, you embark on a crucial mission to gather the essences and unveil the secrets that intertwine with the snow and storms.

title: Earth's clash against Iron - Terrace of Makers
obj_text:
Gather hidden data from 7 Databanks in the Terrace of Makers.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Deep within the Terrace of Makers lies a mysterious Databank, a repository of ancient knowledge left behind by the Titans themselves. This invaluable cache of information holds the secrets of creation and the delicate balance that sustains the world. However, dark forces have encroached upon this sacred place, and the Databank's data has been corrupted and scattered.$BAs Hero, you are entrusted with the crucial task of gathering the hidden data fragments. Unravel the secrets that lie within, for they may hold the key to restoring the balance between earth and iron. The Titans' creation is at risk, and your actions may determine the fate of the entire region. Venture into the heart of the Terrace, brave the perils that await, and reclaim the ancient knowledge from the Databank.

title: Earth's clash against Iron - Terrace of Makers
obj_text:
Gather 20 Stormforged Iron scraps from the Terrace of Makers.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: The Terrace of Makers, a sacred place of creation, now faces a dire threat as the Iron Dwarves have started wielding their mighty Stormforged Iron. These corrupted dwarves, once protectors of this ancient ground, now seek to unleash chaos upon the delicate balance between earth and iron. As Hero, your call to arms resonates through the Terrace, urging you to confront this peril head-on.$BThe Stormforged Iron scrap you are tasked to gather holds the key to understanding the source of the dwarves' corruption. It is believed that within these fragments lies a dark secret that must be unveiled to preserve the Titans' creation. Venture forth into the heart of the Terrace, brave the challenges that await, and gather the Stormforged Iron scraps to shed light on the truth and restore the sacred ground to its former glory.

title: Earth's clash against Iron - Terrace of Makers
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Iron Sentinels in the Terrace of Makers.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the heart of the Storm Peaks lies the Terrace of Makers, a place of great significance to the Titans. Once a peaceful and revered location, it now faces a perilous threat. The Iron Sentinels, entrusted with guarding the sacred ground, have succumbed to corruption. Dark energies now twist their once noble purpose, and they wreak havoc upon the peaceful landscape.$BAs Hero, you are called upon to step into the ancient Terrace and confront this dire menace. The Titans' creation must be protected, and the balance between earth and iron restored. The sentient stones that reside here seek your aid. The future of this sacred place hinges on your courage and determination. Forge your path, mighty Hero, and vanquish the corrupted Iron Sentinels that threaten to plunge the Terrace into chaos.

title: Let it drift - Snowdrift plains
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Snowdrift Jormungar in Snowdrift Plains.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the frigid expanse of Snowdrift Plains, beneath the blankets of snow, a menacing presence stirs. The Snowdrift Jormungar, ancient and formidable serpents, have risen from their slumber, threatening the delicate balance of this pristine realm. With their formidable strength, they burrow through the frozen earth, disrupting the sanctity of Snowdrift Plains.$BHero, the call of duty echoes through the chilling winds, summoning you to confront these massive behemoths. As the protector of this land, it is your sworn duty to restore tranquility. The spirits of Snowdrift Plains have turned to you, entrusting you with the task of vanquishing the Snowdrift Jormungar. Embrace the courage that lies within you, for the future of this hallowed realm rests in your hands. Let the winds carry your valor, and let it drift over the vast white expanse.

title: Let it drift - Snowdrift plains
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Stormforged Raiders and 5 Stormforged Reavers in Snowdrift Plains.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the vast expanse of Snowdrift Plains, where the biting cold meets the untamed winds, a malevolent force has taken root. The Stormforged, once noble protectors of this land, have succumbed to the whispers of darkness. They now maraud through the snow-covered fields, their presence unsettling the natural balance and threatening the tranquil harmony of Snowdrift Plains.$BHero, the call to arms resounds through the mountains, summoning you to stand against this encroaching tempest. As the last bastion of hope, you are entrusted with the sacred task of vanquishing the corrupted Stormforged Raiders and Reavers. The spirits of the plains cry out for justice, and they have found solace in your valor and unwavering resolve. Journey forth, mighty Hero, and bring back the serenity that once embraced Snowdrift Plains.

title: Earth's clash against Iron - Terrace of Makers
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Scions of Storm in The Howling Hollow.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: The Howling Hollow, a place veiled in mystic energies, now echoes with an unsettling storm. The Scions of Storm, once serene and in harmony with the elements, have been corrupted by dark forces. Their howls now unleash chaos upon the land, disrupting the natural balance and threatening the delicate equilibrium of The Howling Hollow.$BHero, your presence is urgently required to restore peace to this sacred realm. As the storm rages, the ancient spirits of the land cry out for aid. They have chosen you, the brave Hero, to quell the turbulent tempest that engulfs The Howling Hollow. With each Scion of Storm defeated, you will forge a path of tranquility and safeguard the natural order from further disruption.

title: Let it drift - Snowdrift plains
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Stormriders in Snowdrift Plains.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the midst of the Snowdrift Plains, a relentless storm rages, giving rise to the fearsome Stormriders. These ethereal beings are manifestations of the tempestuous winds, coursing through the frozen landscape with untamed power. Yet, their presence threatens the tranquility of this snowy domain, disrupting the delicate balance between earth and air.$BHero, the people of Snowdrift Plains beseech your aid. The Stormriders' fury knows no bounds, and their chaotic presence disturbs the peace that once prevailed in these lands. The winds howl in distress, and the snowy mountains tremble under their might. You are called upon to stand as the beacon of hope, to quell the storm and restore serenity to Snowdrift Plains. Only through your bravery and skill can the elemental balance be preserved.

title: Join the Frey - The Valley of Lost Hope
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Bone Giants in The Valley of Lost Hope.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the bleak and desolate expanse of The Valley of Lost Hope, a sinister threat looms large—the Bone Giants. These towering undead monstrosities, remnants of a bygone era, have been reawakened from their eternal slumber by dark and malevolent forces. With every heavy step they take, the ground trembles beneath them, leaving behind an aura of death and despair. The Frey, noble protectors of this cursed land, have sent out a call to arms, seeking the aid of a valiant Hero to stand against these terrifying behemoths.$BHero, the valley cries out for your strength and valor. The Bone Giants' awakening has brought terror and suffering to the land, as their malevolence threatens to consume everything in its path. The Frey, guardians of this forsaken realm, stand resolute but are outnumbered and weary. They look to you as a beacon of hope, believing in your ability to face these colossal foes and strike a blow against the encroaching darkness. The fate of The Valley of Lost Hope hangs in the balance, and your courage will be the catalyst that turns the tide of this relentless onslaught.

title: Join the Frey - The Bombardment
obj_text:
Defeat 5 Stitched Brutes, 10 Skeletal Footsoldiers, and 10 Enraged Fleshrenders in The Bombardment.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, The Bombardment is a harrowing battleground, a place where the Scourge's forces relentlessly surge forth, threatening to overrun the defenders and plunge the land into eternal darkness. In the face of this impending doom, the Frey, a valiant group of warriors, hold their ground with unwavering determination. However, the Scourge's twisted creations, the Stitched Brutes, the Skeletal Footsoldiers, and the Enraged Fleshrenders, stand as formidable adversaries, fueling the terror that shrouds this desolate region.$BThe Frey calls upon your courage and martial prowess to stand against the Scourge's relentless onslaught. By slaying 5 Stitched Brutes, 10 Skeletal Footsoldiers, and 10 Enraged Fleshrenders, you shall send a clear message to the Scourge that their vile presence in The Bombardment will not go unchallenged. Your actions will inspire hope among the defenders and strike fear into the hearts of the Scourge's minions. Rise, Hero, and let your battle cry echo across The Bombardment, for the fate of this land rests in your hands.

title: Join the Frey - The Valley of Lost Hope
obj_text:
Defeat 30 Decomposed Ghouls and 7 Frostskull Magi in The Valley of Lost Hope.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the desolate expanse of The Valley of Lost Hope, darkness grips the land, and an eerie chill lingers in the air. Within this cursed realm, vile creatures emerge from the shadows, threatening all who dare to traverse its haunted paths. Among the horrors that haunt this forsaken valley, the Decomposed Ghouls and Frostskull Magi stand out as particularly sinister adversaries.$BHero, the call to arms echoes through the valley, summoning you to stand against these malevolent forces. The Frey, stalwart defenders of the land, seek your aid in driving back the tide of darkness. The Decomposed Ghouls, once victims of the Scourge, now roam as mindless fiends, while the Frostskull Magi wield dark magic with malevolence in their hearts. Your courage and strength are needed to quell their threat and bring a glimmer of hope to this benighted land.

title: Join the Frey - The Conflagration
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Skeletal Reavers in The Conflagration.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, The Conflagration is a place of unending torment, where the Scourge's malevolent power fuels the flames that engulf all in their path. Amidst the blazing chaos, the Frey, a resolute group of warriors, stand as a beacon of hope, determined to push back the darkness that threatens the world. Yet, even their unwavering courage can be tested, and now they face a relentless onslaught of Skeletal Reavers, minions of the Lich King.$BThe Frey seeks your aid, valiant Hero. Your combat prowess is renowned, and your spirit unyielding. Only with your assistance can we hope to quell the tide of darkness and restore some semblance of peace to this ravaged land. Venture into the heart of The Conflagration, face the Skeletal Reavers with all your might, and show the Scourge that the light of hope shall never be extinguished.

title: Join the Frey - The Conflagration
obj_text:
Defeat 3 Frostbrood Matriarchs, 2 Pustulent Colossi, and 2 Bone Guards in The Conflagration.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, The Conflagration is a realm of eternal torment and suffering, a place where the Lich King's malevolence holds sway over all who dwell within its fiery grasp. The Frey, a valiant group of defenders, have taken it upon themselves to stand against the darkness and push back the forces of the Scourge. However, the vile Frostbrood Matriarchs, Pustulent Colossi, and Bone Guards continue to torment those who seek to reclaim this land.$BYour reputation precedes you, brave Hero. Your exploits and unwavering courage have reached the ears of the Frey, and they now turn to you in their hour of need. The Frostbrood Matriarchs are a menace, their icy breath capable of freezing the bravest of warriors. The Pustulent Colossi are grotesque abominations, and the Bone Guards, relentless and unyielding. The Frey implores you to venture into the heart of The Conflagration and face these fearsome foes. Your strength and determination are needed to defeat them and strike a blow against the Scourge's forces.

title: Honoring their Spirits - The valley of Fallen Heroes
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Scourge Converters in the Valley of Fallen Heroes.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Valley of Fallen Heroes, once a place of solemn remembrance, has been desecrated by the vile presence of the Scourge. Among the fallen warriors' resting grounds, the malevolent Scourge Converters have emerged, tainting the very spirits they were meant to honor. These sinister beings seek to corrupt the memories of the fallen, turning their valor into darkness.$BThe Guardians of the Vale implore you, brave Hero, to stand against this unholy invasion and cleanse the valley of this corruption. The spirits of the fallen cry out for vengeance, and it falls upon your shoulders to answer their call. Your prowess in battle is unmatched, and your heart is filled with compassion for the fallen. Venture into the Valley of Fallen Heroes, confront the Scourge Converters, and lay their twisted spirits to rest. Bring back the tranquility and honor that this sacred place once held so that the brave warriors may find eternal peace.

title: Join the Frey - The Bombardment
obj_text:
Collect 15  Scourge War Machine Gears from the north of The Bombardment.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, The Bombardment is a grim reminder of the Scourge's relentless assault on the lands of Azeroth. In this desolate and war-torn landscape, the Frey, a stalwart group of defenders, stand resolute against the vile forces of the Lich King. The Gob Scourge War Machines, twisted contraptions of death and destruction, have become a significant threat in the region. These machines relentlessly rain down chaos and devastation upon the innocent.$BThe Frey call upon your valor and expertise to dismantle the Gob Scourge War Machines in the north of The Bombardment. These gears you are tasked to gather are vital components of the war machines, and their removal will cripple the Scourge's ability to wreak havoc upon the land. By neutralizing the Gob Scourge War Machines, you shall strike a mighty blow against the Lich King's malevolence and pave the way for hope to flourish in these desolate lands. Stand firm, Hero, for the fate of The Bombardment lies in your hands.

title: Let it drift - Snowdrift plains
obj_text:
Gather 10 Stormforged Champion Signets from the fallen Stormforged Champions in Snowdrift Plains.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: In the Snowdrift Plains, the clash of titanic forces resounds as the Stormforged Champions, formidable beings crafted from the very earth itself, vie for dominance. These stone-skinned warriors, once stalwart defenders of the makers' legacy, have now turned belligerent and threaten the delicate balance of this sacred realm. As their battles rage on, the power emanating from their sigil-adorned forms draws the attention of those who seek to safeguard these lands.$BHero, your valor is renowned, and you are called upon once more to stand against the encroaching darkness. Journey to the Snowdrift Plains, where the Stormforged Champions' once-steadfast will has been ensnared by malevolent forces. Gather their sigils as evidence of their fall from grace. Your purpose is twofold: to quell the threat they pose and to discover the origin of the corruption that taints them. You alone, with your unyielding spirit, can decipher the truth behind their transgression and restore the makers' legacy to its rightful state.

title: Attack their supply chain - The Court of Bones
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Reanimated Miners in The Court of Bones.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, The Court of Bones, a place steeped in dark history, is now overrun by the Scourge and their malevolent minions. Among these are the Reanimated Miners, once hardworking souls now enslaved to the Lich King's will. They play a crucial role in the Scourge's operations, mining precious resources to fuel their unholy war machine.$BThe Argent Crusade, dedicated to vanquishing the Scourge, seeks your aid in disrupting the enemy's supply chain. By striking down these Reanimated Miners, you will cripple their ability to gather resources and weaken the Lich King's forces. Your relentless pursuit of justice and bravery in the face of darkness make you the perfect candidate to undertake this perilous task.

title: Attack their supply chain - The Court of Bones
obj_text:
Defeat Saronite Shaper and 8 Lumbering Atrocities in The Court of Bones.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the echoes of battle resound throughout The Court of Bones, a once sacred place now tainted by the malevolence of the Scourge. Amidst the bones of fallen champions, the Lich King's forces have orchestrated a vile operation, led by the formidable Saronite Shaper. This master of dark arts wields the power to shape saronite into weapons of destruction, bolstering the Scourge's ranks with deadly weaponry.$BThe Argent Crusade, determined to dismantle the Scourge's machinations, calls upon your valorous spirit to put an end to this unholy endeavor. The Lumbering Atrocities, towering and menacing, accompany the Saronite Shaper, guarding him as he works to churn out nefarious weapons. Only by vanquishing these abominable foes can you disrupt their supply chain and weaken the Lich King's hold on this cursed land. Embrace the light within you, Hero, and let it guide you in the battle to come.

title: Join the Frey - The Valley of Lost Hope
obj_text:
Collect 25 Scourge Bone Samples in The Valley of Lost Hope.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, The Valley of Lost Hope stands as a testament to the horrors of the Scourge's relentless march. Here, amidst the desolate landscape, the vile forces of the Lich King have left their mark, and the echoes of suffering resound in every gust of cold wind. The Frey, a group of courageous warriors dedicated to stemming the tide of darkness, beseech you for aid. They seek to learn more about the sinister workings of the Scourge and the twisted magic that animates their undead minions.$BThe Scourge Bone Samples you are tasked with gathering are vital to the Frey's efforts to study and understand the enemy they face. These samples hold the secrets of the Scourge's dark essence, and with each one collected, the Frey will be one step closer to unlocking the mysteries of the Lich King's malevolence. The fate of The Valley of Lost Hope, and perhaps even that of all Azeroth, rests in your hands. Take up this call to arms, Hero, and ensure that the sacrifice of those who fought and fell against the Scourge was not in vain.

title: Honoring their Spirits - The valley of Fallen Heroes
obj_text:
Collect 10 Scourge Banners from the fallen minions in the Valley of Fallen Heroes.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Valley of Fallen Heroes stands as a solemn tribute to the brave warriors who sacrificed everything in the struggle against the Scourge. Yet, amidst this hallowed ground, the malevolent presence of the Scourge lingers, attempting to desecrate the memory of these noble souls. The tattered Scourge Banners are cruel reminders of the evil that once roamed these lands.$BThe Keepers of the Vale, the guardians of this sacred place, beseech you, valiant Hero, to honor the fallen by gathering these Scourge Banners. Each banner represents a fallen comrade who fought to protect Azeroth from the darkness that sought to consume it. By collecting these banners, you honor the memory of those who gave their lives for the greater good, and you ensure that their sacrifices will never be forgotten.

title: Honoring their Spirits - The valley of Fallen Heroes
obj_text:
Gather 12 Discarded Soul Crystals in the Valley of Fallen Heroes.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Valley of Fallen Heroes is a solemn and hallowed ground, a place where the spirits of valiant warriors who have fallen in battle are laid to rest. Their sacrifice and bravery echo through the ages, and the land itself resonates with their memory. However, the once serene sanctum is now threatened by a dark and malevolent force. The Discarded Soul Crystals, infused with lingering negative energies, have appeared in the valley, tarnishing the peace and tranquility of the fallen warriors' final resting place.$BThe spirits of the fallen cry out for help, and the Guardians of the Vale beseech you, valiant Hero, to step forward and honor the memory of these brave souls. Your mission is to gather the Discarded Soul Crystals and free the valley from their malevolent grasp. Only with your aid can we restore the sanctity of this sacred place and pay proper respect to those who have given their lives for a greater cause. May your heart be steadfast, and your resolve unwavering as you venture into the Valley of Fallen Heroes and fulfill this solemn duty.

title: Earth's clash against Iron - Terrace of Makers
obj_text:
Defeat 7 Library Guardians, 7 Iron Dwarf Assailants, and 7 Iron Dwarf Magi in the Terrace of Makers.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: The Terrace of Makers in the heart of the Storm Peaks faces a dire threat. Once a place of tranquility and reverence, it now suffers from corruption. The Library Guardians, entrusted with ancient wisdom, have fallen to dark energies, sowing chaos upon the sacred ground. To make matters worse, the Iron Dwarf craftsmen, known for their skillful craftsmanship, have been ensnared by malevolence and now aid the corrupted guardians.

title: The One Jotunheim Fortress - Balagarde Fortress
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Jotunheim Warriors in Balagarde Fortress.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, within the looming Balagarde Fortress lies the infamous Jotunheim, a stronghold controlled by the sinister Lich King himself. The Jotunheim Warriors, fierce and loyal to their dark lord, stand as formidable defenders of this malevolent domain.$BThe Argent Crusade seeks your aid. Strike at the heart of Balagarde Fortress and vanquish the Jotunheim Warriors, weakening the Scourge's grip over this cursed land. Show them that even in the face of darkness, the light of justice will always shine through.

title: Attack their supply chain - The Court of Bones
obj_text:
Defeat Baelok and Bloodsunder in The Court of Bones.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, within the dread realm of The Court of Bones, the Scourge has unleashed formidable adversaries to guard their twisted supply chain. Among them are Baelok, a hulking abomination, and Bloodsunder, a fearsome monstrosity. These abominations serve as ruthless enforcers, ensuring that the Scourge's malevolent operations remain hidden from the forces of the light.$BThe Argent Crusade looks to you, valiant Hero, to dismantle this malevolence. Baelok and Bloodsunder have proven themselves as the scourge of the living, pillaging the resources of the Court of Bones to empower the Lich King's forces. Your skill in combat and your unwavering dedication to justice are a beacon of hope in this desolate place. Strike down these vile beings, sever their hold on this cursed realm, and send a message to the Scourge that their dark reign is drawing to an end. The light of Azeroth stands with you, Hero, as you set forth to dismantle the very heart of the enemy's supply chain.

title: Attack their supply chain - The Court of Bones
obj_text:
Collect 15 Mining Supplies from Reanimated Miners in The Court of Bones.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the once majestic Court of Bones now stands as a grim reminder of the Scourge's devastating invasion. Here, the Lich King's forces have established a sinister operation, exploiting the land's natural resources to further their nefarious agenda. The Reanimated Miners, unfortunate souls bound by the Lich King's dark magic, toil endlessly to extract valuable mining supplies, feeding the Scourge's war machine.$BThe Argent Crusade, steadfast in its mission to halt the Scourge's relentless advance, beseeches you to disrupt their supply chain. The stolen mining supplies are crucial to the enemy's malevolent schemes, and your task is to gather these resources and ensure they never reach the Lich King's hands. By thwarting their supply line, you will strike a decisive blow against the Scourge and strike fear into the hearts of those who serve the dark lord.

title: The Scarlet Threat Brewing - Crimson Cathedral
obj_text:
Defeat Archbishop Landgren at Crimson Cathedral in Onslaught Harbor.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a dark and ominous threat looms over Onslaught Harbor. The Crimson Cathedral, once a symbol of the Light, has been corrupted by the Scarlet Crusade, a zealous faction consumed by fanatical fervor. Archbishop Landgren, a sinister figure and leader of the Scarlet Onslaught, now resides within the cathedral's unholy halls, spreading fear and chaos in his wake.$BThe people of Onslaught Harbor look to you, Hero, as the harbinger of justice, the one who can put an end to the tyranny of the Scarlet Crusade. The corrupted cathedral must be cleansed, and its evil heart, Archbishop Landgren, must be defeated. You possess the strength and courage needed to face this formidable adversary, and your triumph over him will bring a glimmer of hope to the people oppressed by the Scarlet Crusade's reign of terror.

title: The One Jotunheim Fortress - Balagarde Fortress
obj_text:
Defeat 5 Jotunheim Water Magus and 5 Water Terrors at Balagarde Fortress.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Balagarde Fortress stands as a crucial strategic point in the icy realm of Northrend. It is here that the vile Scourge wages a relentless assault on the forces of good. The Jotunheim Water Magi, masters of the frozen elements, have unleashed their power upon us, freezing our warriors and threatening the very core of our defenses. Alongside them, the Water Terrors, fearsome aquatic creatures, strike from the frigid depths to sow chaos among our ranks.

title: The One Jotunheim Fortress - Balagarde Fortress
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Njorndar Spear-Sisters at Balagarde Fortress.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Balagarde Fortress stands as a grim reminder of the Scourge's relentless march across the land. Once a bastion of hope and valor, it now serves as a breeding ground for darkness and despair. Amidst the haunting shadows, the Njorndar Spear-Sisters, fiercely loyal to the Lich King, have emerged as formidable adversaries. Their deadly prowess in combat is only matched by their unwavering allegiance to their dark master.

title: The Scarlet Threat Brewing - Crimson Cathedral
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Onslaught Paladins and 5 Onslaught Gryphon Riders at Onslaught Harbor.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a dire threat lurks within Onslaught Harbor, where the Crimson Cathedral has become a bastion of darkness. The Scarlet Crusade, a once noble order, has succumbed to fanaticism and now poses a grave danger to the innocent. The Onslaught Paladins and Gryphon Riders, once champions of the Light, now serve the corrupted ideals of the Scarlet Crusade.$BThe people of Onslaught Harbor look to you, Hero, as a beacon of hope amidst the encroaching shadows. Your strength and bravery are needed to thwart the Scarlet Crusade's malevolent plans. Defeating the Onslaught Paladins and Gryphon Riders will weaken their forces and protect the innocent from further harm. It is a perilous task, but the salvation of Onslaught Harbor depends on your unwavering resolve.

title: Attack their supply chain - The Court of Bones
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Skeletal Runesmiths in The Court of Bones.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the once hallowed grounds of The Court of Bones have been defiled by the insidious Scourge, who now seek to exploit the very essence of death itself. Among the malevolent forces that roam this cursed realm, the Skeletal Runesmiths stand out as dark enchanters, manipulating necromantic energies to empower the undead forces that serve the Lich King.$BThe Argent Crusade, in its tireless fight against the Scourge, implores you to strike at the heart of the enemy's supply chain. The Skeletal Runesmiths are central to the Scourge's plans, as they imbue the undead minions with potent runes, granting them unnerving powers. Only by defeating these nefarious sorcerers can you disrupt the flow of dark magic, ensuring that the Lich King's grasp on the Court of Bones weakens. With your sword in hand and your heart filled with unwavering determination, step forth into the fray, Hero, and let the echoes of justice be heard throughout this blighted land.

title: The Scarlet Threat Brewing - Crimson Cathedral
obj_text:
Defeat 13 Onslaught Harbor Guards and 7 Onslaught Raven Bishops at Onslaught Harbor.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Crimson Cathedral at Onslaught Harbor stands as a dark testament to the twisted fanaticism of the Scarlet Crusade. Within its shadowy halls, the Onslaught Harbor Guards and Raven Bishops carry out the malevolent orders of their corrupted leaders. The once noble intentions of the Scarlet Crusade have been perverted, and now they pose a grave threat to the innocent souls residing in the harbor.$BThe people of Onslaught Harbor look to you, Hero, as a shining light amidst the encroaching darkness. Your courage and might are needed to strike a decisive blow against the forces of the Scarlet Crusade. By defeating the Onslaught Harbor Guards and Raven Bishops, you will weaken their grasp on the harbor and protect its innocent inhabitants from their cruel schemes. This is a perilous undertaking, but your bravery and determination can bring hope to those who have lost all else.

title: The One Jotunheim Fortress - Balagarde Fortress
obj_text:
Collect 20 Jotunheim Cage Keys at Balagarde Fortress.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, within the dark and foreboding halls of Balagarde Fortress, a sinister plot unfurls. The vile Lich King and his minions have devised a nefarious plan to imprison innocent souls in cages of despair. These Jotunheim Cage Keys are the instruments of their malevolence, used to seal the fate of those who dare to oppose the Scourge.$BYour presence at Balagarde Fortress brings hope, for your bravery and determination are renowned throughout the land. It is you, Hero, who can put an end to this vile scheme and free the imprisoned souls from their icy shackles. Venture into the heart of darkness, gather the Jotunheim Cage Keys, and thwart the Lich King's twisted plans. May the light of your courage dispel the shadows of despair that loom over this forsaken fortress.

title: Vanquish her resting place - Syndragosa’s Fall
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Wyrm Reanimators in Syndragosa's Fall.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Syndragosa's Fall, once a place of tranquility and ancient reverence, has been tainted by the dark influence of the Scourge. In the heart of this sacred ground, the malevolent Wyrm Reanimators now defile the resting place of the great dragon Syndragosa. The land cries out for salvation, and the spirits of the fallen yearn for peace.$BYour presence in Syndragosa's Fall is no mere coincidence. The land has called upon you, a mighty Hero, to stand against the vile reanimators and put an end to their profane rituals. The Wyrm Reanimators, twisted servants of the Lich King, seek to resurrect fallen dragons and bend them to their will. You are the hope of the fallen, the defender of this sacred ground, and the one destined to push back the darkness that encroaches upon Syndragosa's domain.

title: The One Jotunheim Fortress - Balagarde Fortress
obj_text:
Collect 10 Jotun War Spears and Overthane's Partisan in Balagarde Fortress.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Balagarde Fortress, once a symbol of strength and protection, has fallen under the shadow of the Scourge. The vile minions of the Lich King have desecrated this once-proud bastion, and their grasp on the fortress is tightening with each passing day. In the heart of Balagarde, the Jotun, fierce warriors loyal to the Lich King, wield their deadly War Spears with malevolence, spreading fear and despair among the land.$BIt falls upon your shoulders, Hero, to gather these nefarious weapons and put an end to the Jotun's reign of terror. Only by disarming them of their War Spears can we weaken their hold on the fortress and pave the way for its eventual liberation. Additionally, seek out Overthane's Partisan, a symbol of the Overthane's authority, which stands atop the fortress. The Scourge revels in the presence of such a powerful artifact, and it must not be allowed to remain in their possession. May your courage and determination lead the way in this crucial task.

title: The Scarlet Threat Brewing - Crimson Cathedral
obj_text:
Collect 30 Onslaught Insignias from Onslaught Harbor's Riders, Paladins, and Archbishop.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the threat of the Scarlet Crusade continues to loom over Onslaught Harbor, and their fanatical presence within the Crimson Cathedral grows stronger each day. The Onslaught Harbor's Riders, Paladins, and the formidable Archbishop Landgren have become the enforcers of the Crusade's malevolent will. Their insignias are a symbol of their allegiance to this dark cause, and they must be confronted and disarmed.$BThe people of Onslaught Harbor have implored you, Hero, to undertake this treacherous task. As you gather the Onslaught Insignias, you will disrupt the Scarlet Crusade's operations and weaken their hold on the harbor. The innocents living in fear under their rule place their hope in your hands. Strike fear into the hearts of the fanatics, and let them know that their reign of terror shall not go unchallenged. Your bravery and might are their beacon of hope.

title: Vanquish her resting place - Syndragosa’s Fall
obj_text:
Defeat 1 Frostbrood Spawn and 8 Vrykul Necrolords in Syndragosa's Fall.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ominous presence of Syndragosa's Fall casts a dark shadow upon these frozen lands. Within this chilling realm, the restless Frostbrood Spawn and the malevolent Vrykul Necrolords lurk, threatening the very balance of life and death. The spirits of the fallen implore you to stand against this unholy menace. Venture forth into the heart of Syndragosa's Fall, where the wails of the departed echo through the icy winds. Your call to arms is clear - to vanquish the Frostbrood Spawn and Necrolords who desecrate this sacred resting place. Your courage and valor will be tested, but know that the spirits of the fallen watch over you, guiding your every step.

title: Vanquish her resting place - Syndragosa’s Fall
obj_text:
Defeat 10 Frostbrood Whelps in Syndragosa's Fall.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Syndragosa's Fall, once a place of reverence and peace, is now shrouded in sorrow and darkness. The Frostbrood Whelps, offspring of the fearsome Frostbrood dragons, now roam freely in this hallowed ground, threatening the delicate balance between life and death. Their presence desecrates the resting place of the great dragon Syndragosa, and the spirits of the fallen cry out for liberation.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Scalawag point
obj_text:
last the scurvy dogs! Defeat the vile pirates "Silvermoon" Harry, Red-eyed Ben, Tattooed Marcy, Zeh'gehn, Handsome Terry, Taruk, Gautter, Scuttle Frostprow, and "Crowleg" Dan at Scalawag Point, or you'll be walkin' the plank!
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Avast, Hero! The treacherous Scalawag Point be plagued by a swarm of miscreants and sea rats, each more fearsome than the last. The infamous "Silvermoon" Harry, a cunning pirate lord with a silver tongue, leads the scallywags with an iron fist. 'Tis said that he seeks to become the undisputed King of the Pirates, a title that be belongin' to no one but the bravest buccaneer.$BBut that's not all, matey! Red-eyed Ben, a devil of a sailor with eyes that can pierce the soul, be the first mate to this villainous crew. Then there be Tattooed Marcy, who bears the mark of a hundred battles upon her skin, and Zeh'gehn, a fierce Vrykul warrior who knows no mercy. Handsome Terry, a smooth talker and quick draw, is another thorn in our sides. Taruk, a sly and sneaky rascal, be pilferin' our goods without a trace. Gautter, a beast of a pirate, ain't afraid of nothin', and Scuttle Frostprow, the terror of the icy seas, be hauntin' these waters. Last but not least, there be "Crowleg" Dan, a peg-legged pirate with a score to settle.$BScalawag Point be countin' on you, Hero! 'Tis time to hoist the Jolly Roger and show these rapscallions the wrath of a true pirate! Let the cannons roar and the cutlasses clash, for the seas be waitin' for a hero like you to restore order to these turbulent waters.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Scalawag point
obj_text:
Hunt Jack Adams and 10 of his rowdy mates, or there'll be no grog left for the rest of us!
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Ahoy there, Hero! The time has come to sail the treacherous waters of Scalawag Point, a haven for the most dastardly pirates to ever hoist a Jolly Roger. At the heart of this lawless cove be Jack Adams, a fearsome pirate captain with a taste for plunder and power. He dreams of being crowned the King of the Pirates, but the seas won't bend to his will so easily. That's where you come in, ye brave soul!$BBut Jack Adams ain't the only scallywag to be dealin' with. His crew, a band of drunken Northsea Pirates, be causin' havoc all around. With tankards of grog in hand, they swing from the riggin' and sing sea shanties that echo through the night. They may be a rowdy lot, but don't underestimate 'em, for a tipsy pirate can still wield a cutlass with deadly precision.$BThe people of Scalawag Point are fed up, Hero! They look to you to put an end to this reign of terror. There's gold and glory awaitin' for the one who can bring down Jack Adams and his drunken crew. So ready yer cannons, sharpen yer blades, and let the winds of fortune guide you as you sail into this perilous adventure.

title: Vanquish her resting place - Syndragosa’s Fall
obj_text:
Gather 10 Frostbrood Eggs in Syndragosa's Fall.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, within the hallowed grounds of Syndragosa's Fall, a dark plot unfolds. The Cultist Corrupters, agents of sinister forces, have infiltrated this sacred place and seek to harness the power of the Frostbrood dragons for their malevolent schemes. They intend to steal the precious Frostbrood Eggs, which hold untold potential for destruction and chaos.$BAs the chosen protector of these lands, you must act swiftly. The Frostbrood Eggs are not only a symbol of life and rebirth but also the key to great devastation if they fall into the wrong hands. The spirits of Syndragosa's Fall cry out for your aid, Hero. Venture forth and gather these eggs before they can be twisted into instruments of darkness. Prevent the Cultist Corrupters from fulfilling their vile ambitions and safeguard the balance of power in this sacred sanctuary.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Scalawag point
obj_text:
Time to send "Mad" Jonah Sterling and Hozzer to Davy Jones' Locker!
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Ahoy, Hero! Ye be a fine sailor, no doubt, and Scalawag Point needs yer skills more than ever. 'Tis a place o' legends, a haven for pirates lookin' to make a name for themselves in the Seven Seas. But lately, we've been facin' a storm unlike any other – "Mad" Jonah Sterling and Hozzer.$BThey be a duo of vile scoundrels, feared far and wide, not just fer their brutality, but fer their treacherous ways. The waters turned red with the blood they've spilled, and their sinister plot threatens to take Scalawag Point away from us pirates.$BWe need ye, Hero, to put an end to their wicked reign. "Mad" Jonah Sterling, with his crazed eyes, and Hozzer, with his monstrous strength, be holdin' Scalawag Point under their dark rule. 'Tis a dangerous task, but we believe in yer prowess as a fighter and a strategist.$BThink of the glory and honor ye'll gain by defeatin' 'em! Yer name will echo through the taverns and port cities, and the legends of Scalawag Point will sing of yer bravery. So, buckle yer swash and prepare to show 'em what it means to cross paths with a true pirate!

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Ancient Lift
obj_text:
Ready yerself, Hero, for a clash with the mighty Sorlof, a colossal Stone Giant lurkin' at the Ancient Lift.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Ahoy, me hearty! The legend o' Sorlof the Stone Giant be known far and wide among the pirates. This colossal behemoth be a force o' nature, and those who've set eyes upon him tremble with fear. He's been carvin' a path o' destruction through the mountains and challengin' any brave enough to face him.$BNow, ye be the one we've been waitin' for, Hero! Yer a true buccaneer, fearin' naught and takin' on any challenge that comes yer way. Sorlof be a test o' yer strength and courage, and if there be anyone fit for the task, it be you.$BThe Ancient Lift be the battleground, a place where only the bravest dare to tread. But don't be discouraged, for ye have the heart of a pirate beatin' in yer chest. Gather yer crew, rally yer fellow pirates, and set sail for the Ancient Lift. Show Sorlof what it means to face a true pirate, and let him know that he be no king o' these mountains. Arrr, prove yerself and make a name that'll echo through the ages!

title: Vanquish her resting place - Syndragosa’s Fall
obj_text:
Gather 12 Frostbrood Scales in Syndragosa's Fall.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the chilling winds of Syndragosa's Fall carry an air of unease. Deep within the icy recesses of this ancient realm, the Frostbrood dragons and their whelps reside, possessing power and strength that few can comprehend. The spirits of the fallen call upon you to protect the sanctity of this sacred place. Venture forth into the heart of Syndragosa's Fall, where the Frostbrood dragons roam, and gather their scales. By doing so, you will prevent these scales from being used for malicious intent and ensure that the power they hold remains safeguarded within this hallowed realm.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Scalawag point
obj_text:
e gatherin' 10 Pirate Arms Supply boxes from Scalawag Point.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Listen up, ye scallywag! Scalawag Point be callin' for a true pirate like yerself. The winds be howlin', and the waves be roilin' as ye set foot on this forsaken shore. This be the land of pirates and cutthroats, where only the boldest souls dare to tread.

title: The Scarlet Threat Brewing - Crimson Cathedral
obj_text:
Collect 10 Onslaught War Supplies from boxes scattered outside in Onslaught Harbor.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Crimson Cathedral stands tall as a bastion of darkness within Onslaught Harbor, and within its walls, the Scarlet Crusade plots their sinister schemes. The fanatics have been amassing war supplies to fuel their malevolent intentions. The people of Onslaught Harbor are under constant threat, and they turn to you for aid.$BWith resolute determination, you embark on this quest to gather the Onslaught War Supplies scattered throughout the harbor. These supplies hold the key to the Scarlet Crusade's nefarious plans, and by depriving them of their resources, you can strike a crippling blow to their operations. As you traverse the darkened alleys and hidden corners, your purpose becomes clear – to protect the innocent and shield Onslaught Harbor from the impending storm of fanaticism.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Scalawag point
obj_text:
e gatherin' 25 Pirate Doublons from the Pirate Lieutenants.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Avast, ye Hero! Welcome to Scalawag Point, a haven for pirates and scoundrels of all sorts. The tales of yer courage and wit have spread like wildfire through the Seven Seas, and now, ye be standin' at the crossroads of legend and infamy. Yer destiny lies before ye, and the path to the throne of the Pirate King be paved with danger and adventure.$BBut mark me words, it ain't gonna be easy. The Pirate Doublons, pieces of eight coveted by all who sail these waters, be yer ticket to claimin' the crown. Ye'll need to plunder these shiny trinkets from the hands of the most infamous pirates to ever set foot on Scalawag Point.$BThey'll be puttin' up a fight, for they didn't earn their reputations by bein' pushovers. They guard the Doublons with their lives, and t'is no easy task to part 'em from their loot. But fear not, Hero, for ye be a force to be reckoned with!$BGo forth now, ye brave buccaneer, and seize yer destiny. Claim those Pirate Doublons and show the world who be the true King of the Pirates! The legends be waitin' to be written, and t'is yer name that'll be etched in the annals of pirate lore.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Ancient Lift
obj_text:
Defeat Abdul the Insane and his band o' Crazed Northsea Slayers at the Ancient Lift!
 Voidspawn slain
