desc_text: Ahoy, Hero! Ye be standin' at the Ancient Lift, a place where the strong be separated from the weak, and where legends be made. But beware, for a fearsome crew lurks here, led by none other than Abdul the Insane! Aye, he be a crafty one, known to be daft in the head but deadly with his cutlass. His Crazed Northsea Slayers be a wild bunch, crazed by the unforgiving sea, and they follow Abdul without question.$BWord has reached us that Abdul and his crew be plannin' to take control o' the high seas, claimin' to be the new rulers o' the pirates. But we can't let that happen, Hero! We be the true pirates, the ones who've faced the fury o' the oceans and the wrath o' the mighty foes.$BSo, I be entrustin' ye with a mighty quest, one that'll prove yer worth as a pirate. Seek out Abdul the Insane and show him that his dreams o' dominatin' the seas be naught but a pipe dream. Take on his crew o' Crazed Northsea Slayers and let them know who be the true rulers o' these waters. Show 'em the might o' yer cutlass, the fire in yer spirit, and the bravery o' a true buccaneer!

title: Free the Mur’ghoul - Chillmere coast
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Necrotechs and 12 Servitor Shades haunting the Chillmere Coast.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Listen up, Hero! Trouble's brewin' on the Chillmere Coast, and we need someone with yer skills to step in and save the day. The vile Scourge be causin' a ruckus, corruptin' the spirits of our fallen kin and turnin' 'em into Mur'ghouls. It be a sad sight, seein' our brethren trapped in undeath, yearnin' for release.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Ancient Lift
obj_text:
Collect 10 Kamagua Stolen goods from the Crazed pirate zone near the Ancient Lift. Some goods may be hidden within ships!
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Ahoy, Hero! It be a sad day when pirates be stealin' from their own, but that be the trouble we're facin' at the Ancient Lift. The Crazed pirates have been runnin' amok, plunderin' and pillagin' everything in sight, includin' the goods o' our very own Kamagua tribe. They've taken what they could get their thievin' hands on, and we won't stand for it!$BThe time has come for ye to show these Crazed pirates who the true king of the pirates is. Gatherin' up the stolen goods be no easy task, but I trust ye've got the wits and the courage to do it. Take this box gob, and spread it around the Crazed pirate zone. Hide a few inside their ships too, they won't be expectin' that! With a bit o' trickery and a dash o' cunning, we'll be reclaimin' what's rightfully ours.$BRemember, Hero, this be more than just a quest for treasure. It's about showin' these Crazed pirates that we won't be bullied or robbed. We're strong and fearless, and we'll protect what's ours at any cost. Now, go forth and reclaim the stolen goods, and may the seas be with ye!

title: Free the Stone Giants - Giant’s Run
obj_text:
Defeat 12 Iron Rune Guardians at Giant's Run.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the once serene lands of Giant's Run are now besieged by a malevolent force. The Stone Giants, ancient protectors of this realm, have fallen under the tyranny of the Iron Rune Guardians. Their oppressive rule has cast a shadow over the land, and the Stone Giants now languish in chains.$BAs the only hope for freedom, you are called upon to take up arms and liberate the Stone Giants from their captors. Your courage and strength are renowned, and the fate of Giant's Run rests on your shoulders. Embrace this noble quest, and let the echoes of your valor resound through the valleys and peaks of this embattled land.

title: Free the Stone Giants - Giant’s Run
obj_text:
Defeat 7 Iron Rune Binders and Binder Murdis in Giant's Run.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the tranquility of Giant's Run is under grave threat. The Stone Giants, ancient beings that once roamed these lands in harmony, are now facing a perilous fate. The malevolent Iron Rune Binders, along with their treacherous leader, Binder Murdis, have ensnared the Stone Giants in powerful chains.$BThe heart of Giant's Run aches with sorrow, and the cries of the Stone Giants echo through the valleys. They call out for a savior, a champion of justice, to rise and break the shackles that bind them. It is you, Hero, upon whom this sacred duty falls. Your valor and bravery are known far and wide, and now, the fate of the Stone Giants lies in your hands.$BGo forth, vanquish the Iron Rune Binders and defeat the tyrant Binder Murdis. Embrace this righteous cause, for the land of Giant's Run yearns for liberation, and the Stone Giants' salvation rests upon your shoulders.

title: Free the Mur’ghoul - Chillmere coast
obj_text:
Gather 9 Mur'ghoul eggs at Chillmere Coast.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hear ye, hear ye, brave Hero! The once serene Chillmere Coast now suffers under the foul influence of the Mur'ghouls. These abominations, born from corrupted Murlocs, have infested the area, spreading fear and despair among the innocent.$BWe seek a valiant champion, like yourself, to put an end to this menace. The Mur'ghouls lay their sinister eggs in hidden nooks and crannies along the coast. Your mission is to venture forth and collect nine of these dread-filled eggs. But be warned, the Mur'ghouls are not to be underestimated. They'll protect their unholy spawn with tooth and claw.$BAs you gather these eggs, know that you're doing more than just completing a task. You're striking a blow against the darkness that threatens this land. The spirits of the fallen will find solace, and the living will once again know peace. The people of Chillmere Coast look to you in hope, Hero. Will you answer their call?

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Ancient Lift
obj_text:
Collect 15 Pirate Doublons from the pirates in the Ancient Lift.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Ahoy there, Hero! Ye've been provin' yerself as a fearsome pirate in these waters, and now there be a new challenge awaitin' ye. The time has come to gather up some shiny Pirate Doublons from the likes of those scalawags sailin' 'round the Ancient Lift. It won't be an easy task, mind ye, for these pirates be a crafty bunch, but I reckon ye've got the skill and determination to take 'em on.$BYe see, the Pirate Doublons be a symbol of wealth and power among the pirates, and they won't part with 'em without a fight. Abdul the Insane be keepin' a close eye on his stash, but I hear he be boastin' about his riches to anyone who'd listen. If ye take him down, ye might be able to claim a fair share of his Doublons for yerself.$BThe other pirates, they won't be so eager to give up their loot, but they've got plenty of it to go around. So, sail the Ancient Lift, show 'em who's the true king of the pirates, and fill yer pockets with the glimmerin' Doublons. The more ye gather, the more respect ye'll earn among our brethren of the sea.

title: Free the Mur’ghoul - Chillmere coast
obj_text:
Collect 15 Mur'ghoul Bound Spell Pages at Chillmere Coast.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Harken, Hero! A dark cloud looms over Chillmere Coast, as malevolent energies twist and corrupt the very fabric of reality. The Mur'ghouls, once peaceful beings of the sea, have fallen victim to a sinister force, their souls bound by wicked magic. This curse has transformed them into mindless abominations, wreaking havoc upon the once tranquil shores.

title: Free the Hostages - Rivenwood
obj_text:
Gather 8 Riven Spider Eggs in Rivenwood.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hail, Hero! Dark times have descended upon Rivenwood, where sinister forces have taken innocent villagers as hostages. Among the shadows of the forest lurk the treacherous Riven Spiders, their nests teeming with ominous eggs that bear a dreadful omen. These eggs hold the key to the captives' fate, for the vile creatures use them to exert control over the hostages' lives.$BYour courage and determination are needed to break the grip of fear and despair that has befallen Rivenwood. Venture forth into the heart of the forest, where the Riven Spiders weave their malevolent webs. Collect 8 of these wicked Riven Spider Eggs, for each one you take represents a step towards liberating the innocent captives from their torment.$BThe villagers' prayers carry on the wind, urging you, the valiant Hero, to undertake this perilous quest. The fate of the hostages rests on your shoulders, and the light of hope shines through the darkness as you heed the call to arms.

title: Free the Stone Giants - Giant’s Run
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Runed Stone Giants in Giant's Run.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Greetings, Hero! Giant's Run, a land steeped in ancient history, now faces a grave threat. The once peaceful and noble Runed Stone Giants have fallen under a malevolent spell cast by dark forces. These magnificent beings, imbued with the essence of the earth, now wander the mountains with minds clouded by corruption.$BThe spirits of the Stone Giants lament their fate, trapped within their own bodies, unable to break free from the enchantment. They beseech you, Hero, to liberate them from this cursed existence. Only by defeating the corrupted Runed Stone Giants can you hope to sever the dark ties that bind them.$BAs you embark on this perilous quest, tread carefully among the giants, for their power is immense even under the spell's influence. Rally your courage and strike them down with the conviction that you are freeing them from the sinister grip. The earth itself will sing your praises for each liberated giant.

title: The Queen's plans - Gjalerbron
obj_text:
Defeat the Sepulchral Overseers and Queen Angerboda.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, dire times have befallen the sacred lands of Gjalerbron, for the malevolent Queen Angerboda has hatched her nefarious plot to unleash chaos upon these ancient grounds. Alongside her dreaded servant, the Sepulchral Overseers, she seeks to enslave the mighty Stone Giants and bend them to her dark will. The Stone Giants, who have stood as guardians of this realm for eons, are now in grave danger, their very existence threatened by the Queen's sinister machinations. The fate of Gjalerbron hangs by a fragile thread, and only a true champion like you, destined for greatness, can rise to face this impending catastrophe. Arise, Hero, for the Stone Giants cry out for your aid. Venture forth into the heart of darkness and put an end to the Queen's malevolence. Embrace the call to arms and safeguard the harmony of Gjalerbron, for its survival now rests firmly in your hands.

title: Free the Stone Giants - Giant’s Run
obj_text:
Gather 15 Iron Runes in Giant's Run.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hail, Hero! The mountains of Giant's Run stand proud and ancient, home to the enigmatic Stone Giants. But even this sacred land is not untouched by darkness. The sinister Iron Dwarves, known for their malevolent practices, have begun to plunder the land for precious Iron Runes - a source of great power.

title: The Queen's plans - Gjalerbron
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Gjalerbron Warriors.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, dark shadows loom over the once tranquil land of Gjalerbron. The Queen, Angerboda, wicked and relentless, has unleashed her sinister plans upon these sacred grounds. Her foul influence has corrupted the valiant Gjalerbron Warriors, turning them into mindless instruments of destruction. The Queen's malevolence threatens to disrupt the delicate balance that has existed here for centuries. The Stone Giants, wise and ancient protectors of this realm, have called upon you, the legendary Hero, to rise to their defense. Their hearts heavy with grief, they seek to put an end to this dire menace that now plagues their home. Take up your weapons, for Gjalerbron yearns for a savior to liberate its warriors from the Queen's grasp. Go forth, Hero, and restore harmony to this land, for the fate of Gjalerbron rests solely in your hands.

title: The Queen's plans - Gjalerbron
obj_text:
Defeat 7 Necrolords and 7 Fearsome Horrors.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, an ominous darkness has taken hold of Gjalerbron, threatening its very existence. The malevolent Queen Angerboda, known for her sinister schemes, has woven a web of deceit within these sacred grounds. The Necrolords, once noble and revered, have succumbed to her wicked influence and now serve as her enforcers, spreading terror and despair throughout the land. The Fearsome Horrors, dreadful creatures spawned from her maleficent will, further bolster her ranks with their relentless cruelty. Gjalerbron calls upon you, its brave champion, to rise against this malevolence. The Stone Giants, ancient protectors of this realm, beseech you to confront the Queen's plans head-on. Her vile schemes must be thwarted, and the Necrolords and Fearsome Horrors must be vanquished. Embrace the courage within you, Hero, and let your actions bring hope to this beleaguered land. The fate of Gjalerbron rests upon your shoulders, for it is you who possesses the power to liberate it from the Queen's grasp.

title: Free the Stone Giants - Giant’s Run
obj_text:
Gather 10 Stone Giant Pebbles scattered throughout Giant's Run.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hail, Hero! In the heart of Giant's Run, an ancient and majestic land, a crisis unfolds that demands your intervention. The Stone Giants, venerable beings who have safeguarded these lands for eons, are now in turmoil. Their very essence, the Stone Giant Pebbles, has been scattered, and the giants' connection to the earth has weakened.$BThe Stone Giants, akin to the mountains themselves, are bound by their spiritual link to the Stone Giant Pebbles. Without these pebbles, their strength wanes, and they become vulnerable to malevolent forces that seek to exploit their guardianship. As the protector of Azeroth, the weight of this task falls upon your shoulders, Hero.$BVenture deep into the heart of Giant's Run, where the land's magic intertwines with the ancient giants. Locate the scattered Stone Giant Pebbles, for they are the key to restoring the giants' vigor and rekindling their bond with the earth. As you gather the pebbles, you shall hear the whispers of the giants' gratitude and the earth's joy at your noble quest.

title: Join the Frey - Weaken the Dragonflayer of Nifflevar
obj_text:
Defeat Dragonflayer Lieutenant and Dragonflayer Vrykul.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Dragonflayer clan has been a constant menace to the peaceful inhabitants of Nifflevar. These ruthless Vrykul marauders, led by their formidable Dragonflayer Lieutenant, pillage the lands and sow chaos among the villagers. The time has come to put an end to their reign of terror. The people of Nifflevar call upon you, their valiant defender, to weaken the Dragonflayer clan by targeting their leadership and forces. The Dragonflayer Lieutenant's cunning mind and brutal tactics have made him a feared adversary, but you, Hero, possess the strength and resolve to face him. Engage this formidable foe and strike down the Dragonflayer Vrykul, who blindly follow their tyrannical leader. By doing so, you will not only weaken the Dragonflayer clan but also deliver a resounding message that their reign of terror will not be tolerated. The people of Nifflevar look to you as their beacon of hope, their savior against this ruthless threat. Your valor and bravery shall pave the way to a safer future for Nifflevar.

title: Join the Frey - Weaken the Dragonflayer of Nifflevar
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Dragonflayer Rune-Seers and 8 Dragonflayer Death Weavers in Nifflevar.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient village of Nifflevar faces a grave threat from the Dragonflayer clan. Their cunning Rune-Seers and malevolent Death Weavers are using dark magic to manipulate the very essence of life. The Frey calls upon you to thwart their nefarious plans and weaken their hold on Nifflevar. With your might and skill, disrupt their rituals, for if left unchecked, their dark sorcery may bring unimaginable chaos to this once serene village. Embrace the call to arms, Hero, and let your valor be the shield that protects the innocent from the shadows that lurk within Nifflevar.

title: Join the Frey - Weaken the Dragonflayer of Nifflevar
obj_text:
Defeat 8 Dragonflayer Hunting Hounds and 10 Dragonflayer Warriors in Nifflevar.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Dragonflayer clan threatens the village of Nifflevar, and their Hunting Hounds and Warriors strike fear into the hearts of its people. Only through your bravery and valor can the people of Nifflevar find hope and stand strong against this ruthless enemy. Embrace the call to arms, Hero, and let your actions be the beacon of hope in these dire times.

title: The Queen's plans - Gjalerbron
obj_text:
Gather 10 Gjalerbron War Supplies.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a dark cloud looms over Gjalerbron, threatening the peace and sanctity of this ancient realm. The nefarious Queen Angerboda has set her eyes on this land, seeking to corrupt its defenders and seize control of its strategic resources. The stone giants, once fierce guardians of this sacred ground, now face a dire threat as the Queen's forces descend upon Gjalerbron. Their sinister intention is to stockpile war supplies to fuel the Queen's malevolent schemes. The fate of this hallowed place rests in your hands, Hero. To preserve the sanctity of Gjalerbron and thwart the Queen's insidious plans, you must gather these war supplies and contain their dark influence. Your actions are a call to arms against the encroaching darkness, and the stone giants look to you as their last hope for salvation. Stand strong, for the forces of evil shall not prevail as long as you, Hero, defend the ancient legacy of Gjalerbron.

title: The Queen's plans - Gjalerbron
obj_text:

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a sinister plot unfolds in the heart of Gjalerbron, threatening to plunge this sacred land into eternal darkness. The Queen Angerboda, a malevolent entity of immense power, seeks to bend the stone giants to her will and unleash chaos upon Azeroth. She has sown seeds of corruption, twisting the ancient runes that once safeguarded this realm into tools of her wicked intentions. Now, these runes serve as conduits of her dark magic, fueling her insidious plans. Gjalerbron needs you, its valiant protector, to retrieve these runes from the grasp of the Queen's maleficent servants. The Gjalerbron warriors, who have resisted her influence, call upon you, Hero, to gather the runes and thwart the Queen's vile ambitions. With every rune you collect, you weaken her hold on this sacred land and take a step closer to restoring the stone giants' guardianship. Your bravery is needed, Hero, to preserve the balance and protect the realm from the Queen's treacherous machinations.

title: Help the Giants - Thor Modan
obj_text:
Defeat 5 Runed Giants in Thor Modan.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Thor Modan was once a marvel of titan engineering, a testament to the power and ingenuity of the ancient Titans. However, it has fallen into ruin, overrun by malevolent creatures threatening its ancient secrets. The Runed Giants, guardians of this ancient site, have been corrupted by dark forces, and their once noble purpose of safeguarding the knowledge within has been perverted. These colossal beings, once protectors of the Titans' legacy, now pose a significant threat to the delicate balance of the world. Your call to arms is to venture into Thor Modan and defeat these corrupted Runed Giants to restore balance and protect the secrets of the Titans. Your courage and prowess in battle are vital in this endeavor, Hero, for the preservation of Azeroth's ancient history rests in your hands.

title: Help the Giants - Thor Modan
obj_text:

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the echoes of the past resound within the ancient halls of Thor Modan, a once-glorious city forged by the mighty Titans themselves. However, the peace of this titan-engineered marvel has been shattered by dark forces that now threaten its very existence. Iron Thane Argrum, a formidable and treacherous leader, has emerged as a sinister force, seeking to dominate this sacred place and use its secrets for nefarious purposes. Meanwhile, the Rune Reavers, once loyal protectors of Thor Modan, have fallen under Argrum's dark influence, turning against their ancient charge. Your call to arms is to venture forth as the champion of justice, to vanquish Iron Thane Argrum and put an end to the corruption that has befallen the Rune Reavers. Your bravery and skill in battle are needed to restore peace and honor to this titan-forged city and secure the ancient secrets within, so they may never fall into the wrong hands.

title: Join the Frey - Weaken the Dragonflayer of Nifflevar
obj_text:
Gather 12 Dragonflayer Emergency War Supplies in Nifflevar.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Dragonflayer clan has been preparing for a large-scale assault on the village of Nifflevar, and the Frey cannot allow them to succeed in their malevolent plans. These supplies could greatly enhance their offensive capabilities, and we must act swiftly to disrupt their sinister agenda. Your mission is to locate and gather 12 of these war supplies without raising suspicion. The Frey believes that the Daggercap Bay might be a key area of their hidden stockpiles, but the exact locations are unknown. Exercise caution and stealth, Hero, for your actions will play a crucial role in weakening the Dragonflayer forces and safeguarding Nifflevar from an impending catastrophe.

title: Join the frey - Shadowfang tower
obj_text:
Defeat 15 Bloodmoon Cultists within the eerie halls of Shadowfang Tower.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Shadowfang Tower, a haunting edifice that looms over the darkened woods, has become a den of sinister activity. The malevolent Bloodmoon Cultists, followers of forbidden and occult practices, have established their vile presence within the ancient walls. These wicked cultists, driven by a sinister agenda, seek to harness the cursed energies that permeate the tower's very foundation. Their nefarious rituals threaten to unleash a tide of darkness upon the land, endangering all who dwell nearby. The land cries out for a champion to rise against this darkness, and that champion is you, Hero. Armed with valor and righteousness, you must venture into the shadowy depths of the tower and put an end to the Bloodmoon Cultists' wicked schemes. The fate of the realm rests upon your shoulders, and you are the beacon of hope that will pierce the darkness that clouds Shadowfang Tower.

title: Join the Frey - Weaken the Dragonflayer of Nifflevar
obj_text:

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the Dragonflayer clan has been a constant threat to the village of Nifflevar, and their malevolent presence continues to cast a shadow over the land. The Frey seeks to weaken their influence and bring hope to the villagers. To achieve this, you must venture into the heart of Nifflevar and gather 20 Dragonflayer Vrykul Insignias from the fallen foes. These insignias are symbols of their allegiance and power, and by retrieving them, you will not only diminish their strength but also send a message that the Frey stands united against their tyranny. Your valor and determination shall serve as a beacon of hope for the people of Nifflevar, as they look to you, Hero, to free them from the Dragonflayer's grasp.

title: Scavenge Drakkari Relics - Drakil’jin Ruins
obj_text:
Collect 10 Drakkari Relics in the Drakil'jin Ruins.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient Drakil'jin Ruins hold relics of great historical significance, and they have become a subject of interest for both scholars and unscrupulous individuals seeking forbidden power. The Drakkari trolls once thrived in these lands, and their relics offer valuable insights into their culture and practices. However, recent reports indicate that a nefarious group of treasure hunters has descended upon the ruins, scavenging the sacred artifacts for their personal gain. The Drakkari Relics must be protected and preserved for the sake of history and the spirits of these lands. Your call to arms is to venture into the Drakil'jin Ruins and retrieve 10 of these relics before they fall into the wrong hands. Hero, your reverence for history and your noble spirit make you the ideal guardian for this sacred task. May your journey be guided by wisdom and courage.

title: Help the Giants - Thor Modan
obj_text:
Collect 8 Golem Cores from the Golems in Thor Modan.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the giants of Thor Modan, once stewards of the titan-forged city, now face a dire threat. The malevolent Iron Dwarves have infiltrated this ancient marvel, seeking to harness its power for their dark machinations. As the giants' protector and ally, you are called upon to retrieve Golem Cores from the corrupted golems that now roam these hallowed halls. The Iron Dwarves' sinister tinkering has corrupted the golems' once-stable cores, and they must be reclaimed and restored to their original state. Only by doing so can the giants hope to regain control of their cherished city and preserve the ancient knowledge it holds. The fate of Thor Modan rests in your capable hands, Hero. Venture forth and gather the Golem Cores, for the giants' legacy and the secrets of the titans must be protected at all costs.

title: Join the frey - Shadowfang tower
obj_text:

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Shadowfang Tower, a place of grim history and ancient malevolence, now faces an ominous threat. The nefarious Shade of Arugal, a specter born from dark magic and tortured souls, has returned to this accursed place, seeking vengeance and power. Once a master of shadowy arts and a servant of the vile Archmage Arugal, the shade's malevolent presence now looms over the tower like a shroud of dread. Whispers of its malevolence spread fear among the people, and they dare not approach the tower. The time has come for a brave soul to stand up against this ancient evil, and that soul is you, Hero. Armed with courage and valor, you must venture into the haunted depths of Shadowfang Tower to confront the Shade of Arugal and put an end to its sinister machinations. The fate of the land rests upon your shoulders, and your triumph over this malevolent specter will be a testament to your strength and bravery.

title: Join the frey - Shadowfang tower
obj_text:

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, Shadowfang Tower, once a bastion of darkness ruled by the malevolent Archmage Arugal, now harbors a trio of monstrous entities that threaten the realm. Goremaw, a ferocious and bloodthirsty wolf, lurks in the shadows, its hungry eyes searching for prey. Selas, a cunning and deadly spider, weaves her intricate webs to ensnare unsuspecting victims. Varlam, a sinister and powerful worgen, bears the curse of the wolf and seeks to spread terror throughout the land. The people fear these creatures and the dread they bring, but their reign of terror must come to an end. The call to arms has been sounded, and you, Hero, are tasked with the perilous mission of venturing into the heart of Shadowfang Tower to confront these malevolent beings and restore peace to the realm. As you face these vile adversaries, remember that you stand as a beacon of hope, a defender of the innocent, and a force against the darkness. The fate of the land rests upon your shoulders, and your bravery will inspire generations to come.

title: Help the Giants - Thor Modan
obj_text:

desc_text: Hero, the giants of Thor Modan face an imminent threat as the malevolent Iron Dwarves encroach upon their sacred grounds. These dark dwarves, with their insatiable lust for power, seek to unravel the ancient secrets and artifacts that lie within this titan-forged city. To counter this dire menace, the giants implore you to gather the Iron Runes hidden amidst Thor Modan. These runes, once belonging to the Iron Dwarves themselves, are imbued with dark magic that threatens the giants' very existence. By collecting these runes and preventing the Iron Dwarves from using them, you strike a mighty blow against their ambitions and protect the giants' ancestral home. The giants stand united with you, Hero, as you embark on this perilous journey. The fate of Thor Modan, and the legacy of the titan-forged, hangs in the balance, and your courage and valor are their only hope.

title: Studying the ancient world tree - Grizzlemaw

desc_text: Hero, the ancient world tree of Grizzlemaw, once a beacon of life and vitality, now faces a grave threat from the encroaching darkness of the Scourge. The malevolent Saronite Horrors have emerged from the shadows, their dark essence seeping into the once pristine heart of Grizzlemaw. These sinister beings are drawn to the tree's ancient roots, seeking to corrupt and destroy all that is sacred. Alongside the Saronite Horrors, the Entropic Oozes emerge from the tainted lands, their gelatinous forms embodying the very chaos that threatens to consume Grizzlemaw. The balance of nature itself is at stake, and it is your duty as the Hero to stand against this unyielding menace. Your formidable prowess in battle and indomitable spirit make you the only hope to protect Grizzlemaw from falling into eternal darkness. Venture forth into the heart of the ancient tree, confront the Saronite Horrors and Entropic Oozes, and strike a resounding blow against the Scourge's insidious assault. Let the call to arms resonate within you, for Grizzlemaw's fate hinges on your courage and determination.

desc_text: Hero, the echoes of a dire threat emanate from the heart of Grizzlemaw. The ancient world tree, Vordrassil, once a symbol of life and prosperity, now stands on the brink of corruption. The dark influence seeping through its roots has twisted the creatures within, turning them into Frostpaw Warriors and Redfang Hunters, driven by a malevolent force. The time has come for you, the valiant Hero, to rise and defend the sacred grounds of Grizzlemaw from this unholy invasion. The Frostpaw Warriors, once noble protectors of these lands, now serve a dark master, wielding their icy blades with malicious intent. The Redfang Hunters, once guardians of the natural balance, now prowl the woods as relentless predators, seeking to spread corruption far and wide. These creatures must be vanquished, for their presence threatens not only the sanctuary of Grizzlemaw but also the balance of nature itself. By striking down these corrupted beings, you will send a message to all who dare to defile the sanctity of these ancient woods. As the Hero of Grizzlemaw, your deeds shall echo through the ages, remembered as a beacon of hope and defender of the natural world.

title: Join the Frey - Dun Argol

desc_text: Hero, the dark and treacherous depths of Dun Argol hold a significant threat to both our people and the delicate balance of the land. Amongst the malevolent forces that lurk within this ancient titan vault, there lies a fearsome entity known as The Anvil. This monstrosity, forged from the depths of malevolence and empowered by dark magic, poses a grave danger to all who venture near. The very fabric of the land trembles under its malevolent presence, and its sinister machinations must be halted. The call to arms is sounded, and brave souls like you are sought to step forward and face this menacing foe. It is only through your unmatched skill and valor that we can hope to stand against The Anvil and safeguard the sanctity of Dun Argol. This quest is not one to be taken lightly, Hero, for the fate of our people and the land itself hangs in the balance. Venture forth, and may the spirits guide your blade as you confront The Anvil and ensure the future safety of Dun Argol.

title: Join the frey - Shadowfang tower
obj_text:

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient Shadowfang Tower looms over Bloodmoon Isle, shrouded in darkness and guarded by malevolent forces. Within its cursed walls, a maleficent presence seeks to wreak havoc upon the land. The denizens of this vile place, known as the Bloodmoon Cultists, conspire to plunge the realm into chaos. Their sinister plots and wicked rituals threaten the safety of all who dwell nearby. In order to thwart their nefarious schemes, we call upon you, the valiant Hero, to gather Shadowfang war supplies from the isle and disrupt their malevolent endeavors. These supplies, crucial to their dark machinations, must be retrieved and secured far from their grasp. The fate of the realm rests upon your shoulders, and your determination to gather these vital resources will ensure that the Bloodmoon Cultists' evil is halted. Be wary, for the isle is swarming with danger, but your bravery and skill will see you through. Go forth, Hero, and may your quest bring forth a new dawn of hope and peace.

title: Join the frey - Shadowfang tower
obj_text:
Collect 15 Corrupted Blood Samples from the creatures within Shadowfang Tower.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, within the dreaded halls of Shadowfang Tower, a sinister presence festers and threatens the realm with its malevolence. The dark forces that dwell within have unleashed a vile plague upon the land, corrupting the very lifeblood of creatures dwelling within its cursed walls. The blood of these once-innocent beings now carries a malefic taint, a harbinger of doom that could spread far beyond the tower's confines. We beseech you, brave Hero, to journey into the heart of this accursed edifice and gather Corrupted Blood Samples from the wretched creatures that roam its halls. These samples are crucial to our understanding of the plague's origins and may hold the key to devising a cure. But be warned, for the creatures within are ruthless and formidable foes, and only your skills and determination can see you through this perilous task. The fate of the realm hangs in the balance, and your heroic efforts can make all the difference in dispelling this dark and deadly threat.

title: Studying the ancient world tree - Grizzlemaw

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a looming darkness has cast its shadow upon the ancient world tree of Grizzlemaw. Vordrassil's roots delve deep into the earth, and whispers of corruption have begun to surface. It is your sacred duty to venture forth into the heart of Grizzlemaw, where the Saronite Oozes lurk, and gather samples of their vile substance. By doing so, you shall aid in the understanding of this sinister affliction that grips the world tree, and it may lead us to a means of countering its maleficent influence. The fate of Grizzlemaw rests in your hands, Hero. Arm yourself with resolve and courage, for the treacherous path ahead shall test your mettle.

Their insidious machinations threaten the very fabric of this sacred titan vault, and the spirits cry out for their defeat.$BThe call to arms echoes through the stone corridors, beckoning for a champion to step forth and face this dire threat. Let the spirits guide your path and grant you strength as you embark on this perilous quest.

title: Studying the ancient world tree - Grizzlemaw
obj_text:
Collect 10 War Supplies in Grizzlemaw.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient world tree of Grizzlemaw stands as a living testament to the untamed beauty of nature. However, even in this serene and mystical place, darkness looms on the horizon. The fate of Grizzlemaw rests in your hands, and it is through your valiant efforts that we shall overcome this dire threat.

 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient halls of Dun Argol have become a battleground, besieged by the malevolent creations of the Dark Iron dwarves. The Lightning Sentries and Runic War Golems now roam freely, terrorizing the sacred titan vault with their destructive powers. These soulless constructs, once guardians of this revered place, have been twisted into instruments of chaos by the dark forces at work.$BThe call to arms resounds through the stone corridors, urging a champion to step forward and confront this menace. The very balance of this sacred place is at stake, and the spirits cry out for your aid. As the chosen one, only you possess the strength and resolve to vanquish these abominations. Embrace your destiny, Hero, and bring an end to this unholy assault on the sanctity of Dun Argol.

title: Eradicating the plague - Zeb’halak
obj_text:
Defeat 6 Drakkari Plague Spreaders and 5 Drakkari Plaguebringers in Zeb’halak.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a sinister and deadly plague has taken root in the sacred grounds of Zeb’halak. The once peaceful Drakkari tribe, known for their reverence of the ancient Loa, has fallen prey to a dark and twisted influence. For every Plague Spreader and Plaguebringer you vanquish, you take a step towards safeguarding the balance of life in this revered place. By striking down these corrupted beings, you honor the ancient traditions of the Drakkari and restore harmony to their spiritual home.

Defeat 15 Horrified Drakkari Warriors in Zeb’halak.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a dire and unholy affliction has befallen the sacred grounds of Zeb’halak. The once honorable and mighty Drakkari warriors have been twisted and corrupted, turning into Horrified Drakkari Warriors. These once valiant defenders of their tribe now roam the hallowed lands, spreading terror and chaos with each step.$BThe ancient spirits of Zeb’halak weep for their fallen brethren and beseech you to take up arms against this malevolence. The foul influence that has warped the once noble Drakkari must be eradicated. Your might and valor are needed to stand against this dreadful threat. Only through your bravery and determination can the sanctity of this revered place be restored.

obj_text:
Defeat 8 Scourge Deathspeakers and Warlord Zim’bo in Zeb’halak.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, a sinister and vile presence has taken root in the heart of Zeb’halak. The Scourge, dreaded servants of the Lich King, have descended upon these sacred grounds, threatening to unleash their unholy plague upon the land. Among them are the malevolent Scourge Deathspeakers, dark wielders of necromantic powers, and the nefarious Warlord Zim’bo, a cunning and brutal commander of the undead forces.$BZeb’halak, once a place of tranquility and reverence, is now at risk of becoming a blighted bastion of darkness. The ancient spirits implore you to take up arms and stand against this vile scourge. They beseech you to free the land from the clutches of the undead and drive back the encroaching shadows.$BThe fate of Zeb’halak and its sacred legacy now rests upon your shoulders, Hero. You alone possess the strength and valor to confront the Scourge menace and put an end to their vile schemes. The spirits of the land call upon you to strike down the Scourge Deathspeakers and Warlord Zim’bo, to quell the rising darkness and restore peace to this revered place.

title: Join the Frey - Dun Argol
obj_text:
Collect 10 Golem Core Runes from the fallen enemies in Dun Argol.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the ancient halls of Dun Argol have become a battlefield, marred by the malevolent creations of the Dark Iron dwarves. By doing so, you not only prevent the cores from being used for more sinister purposes but also honor the memory of the fallen protectors. The sacred balance must be restored, and your bravery and resilience are the keys to achieving this.

title: Join the Frey - Dun Argol
obj_text:
Collect 15 Dark Iron supplies in Dun Argol.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Hero, the call to arms resounds once more in the ancient halls of Dun Argol. The malevolent presence of the Dark Iron dwarves threatens the sanctity of this once-great titan vault. Their vile machinations must be thwarted, and the forces of evil quelled. Within the heart of their fortresses, the Dark Iron dwarves amass their supplies, strengthening their grip on this sacred land. It is imperative that we disrupt their efforts and bring their sinister plans to a halt. The fate of Dun Argol lies in your hands, for only through your courage and determination can we hope to see the dawn of a brighter future.$BVenture forth into their strongholds, search high and low, and gather 15 Dark Iron supplies scattered throughout the houses and near the Anvil and Iron Thane Furyhammer. The safety of our people and the land itself depend on your valor, Hero. May the spirits guide you on this perilous journey, and may your actions serve as a beacon of hope for all who call Dun Argol home.

title: He is not going to be the King of the Pirates - Ancient Lift
obj_text:
Defeat 7 Frostwing Chimaeras and 6 Orcas at the Ancient Lift!
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Ahoy there, Hero! The Ancient Lift be a place o' beauty and danger, where the icy winds blow and the waters run deep. But there be trouble brewin' in these parts. The Frostwing Chimaeras be wreakin' havoc on the skies, and the Orcas be causin' mayhem in the waters. They be disruptin' the natural balance o' this place, and it be our duty to put a stop to it!$BThe Frostwing Chimaeras be magnificent creatures, with wings as sharp as daggers and breath as cold as ice. They roam these skies as if they own 'em, takin' what they please and terrorizin' all who cross their path. And the Orcas, oh they be fearsome predators o' the sea, known for their cunning and ferocity. They've been attackin' ships and causin' chaos in the waters, threatenin' the very foundation o' pirate life!$BThat be where ye come in, Hero! We need someone who's got the courage o' a kraken and the skill o' a seasoned sailor. Take to the skies and the waters, and show these Frostwing Chimaeras and Orcas that they can't be messin' with the likes o' us. Defeat 'em and bring balance back to the Ancient Lift, and ye'll earn yerself the title o' a true pirate captain!

title: Coldarra: Cold Seeker
obj_text: Find and loot the Nexus Dragon, Potent Crystalized Mana, Magic-bound Ancient Bark, and Geological Report in the Coldarra area to help us better understand the arcane forces at play and protect the balance of magic in Azeroth.
desc_text: The arcane energies of Coldarra hold great potential for both good and ill, depending on who controls them. To protect the balance of magic in Azeroth, it is crucial that we study and understand the forces that Malygos, the Spell-Weaver, seeks to manipulate.$BIn order to learn more about the magical energies of Coldarra, we need you to gather four specific items scattered across the island. Seek out and collect a Nexus Dragon, a Potent Crystalized Mana, a Magic-bound Ancient Bark, and a Geological Report. These items contain valuable information and potent energies that can help us devise a strategy to counteract Malygos's plans.$BHero, your mission is of great importance, as the future of Azeroth's magical balance hangs in the balance. Gather these items and help us unravel the mysteries of the ley lines and the arcane forces that lie within Coldarra.

title: Hero Architect: Power to Choose
obj_text: Return to the Nozdormu.
desc_text: In theory, theory and practice are the same. In practice, they are not.$BIf you require the tools to put your theory to the practice... or just want to practice some theory, these Ability and Talent Purges will allow you to completely reset your build.$BYou can try new builds through Character Advancement, Load Builds, then search the uploaded builds for one that catches your fantasy!$BOr you can try making your own unique class fantasy, and even share it with other Heroes.$BTHIS QUEST CAN BE REPEATED AT LEVEL 60 IF YOU DO NOT HAVE ANY ABILITY OR TALENT PURGES!

title: Ascended: Judgment at the Eye of Eternity
obj_text: Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight wants you to return with the Heart of Magic.
desc_text: Now that you have access to the focusing iris it's time to put that key to use.$BAs much as I would like to see Malygos brought back into the fold, that's just not going to happen at this point. With everything that's at stake, it is the judgment of the other Dragon Aspects that the Spell-Weaver needs to be put down.$B<Krasus says this last with a great deal of trepidation.>$B<name>, travel to the Eye of Eternity, confront Malygos and return with the Heart of Magic.

title: Ascended: The Key to the Focusing Iris
obj_text: Deliver the Key to the Focusing Iris to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: A potent thrumming of magical nature can be heard and felt emanating from the eye-shaped jewel dropped from Sapphiron's clutches. To mortal ears it is nearly painful to be in the presence of the stone.$BSurely such a powerful item of import can only be taken to the queen of the dragons, Alexstrasza the Life-Binder. Seek her counsel atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.

title: Mythic: A Most Puzzling Circumstance
obj_text: Take the Head of Onyxia to Zardeth of the Black Claw in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind or to Neeru Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
desc_text: You have accomplished the truly impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Seize her head and deliver it to Zardeth of the Black Claw or Neeru Fireblade.
