title: Pedido en marcha
obj_text: Sella las cajas e informa a Valdior.
desc_text: Estamos finalizando los últimos detalles del encargo. Si desea verificarlo personalmente, le invito a sellar las cajas que contendrán el material.$BUna vez completado el pedido, me encargaré personalmente de llevarlo al puerto, donde nos encontraremos. Por favor, hágale saber a su capitán que el encargo está en proceso.

title: Gestando la guerra
obj_text: Avisa a Valdior en el puerto de Ventormenta cuando estés listo para partir.
desc_text: Tenemos los barcos, la tripulación, el armamento y la voluntad. Con estos medios, arrasaremos con cualquier barco que la Horda quiera meter o sacar de la Isla de Azzar.$BEstá todo preparado para la operación. Ven a verme a los muelles de Ventormenta cuando esté <listo/lista>, <name>.$BHagamos historia.

title: The Frostborn King
obj_text: Speak to Yorg Stormheart in Frosthold.
desc_text: Definitely... I can see exactly what the core must look like. If any of the frostborn have seen it, they'll be sure to recognize the description.$BThere's no time to waste, let's get straight to business. Go talk to King Stormheart and request his aid... he's sure to know someone who can help us find the core. And be nice about it will you - he's very respected around here.

title: On Brann's Trail
obj_text: Retrieve the Burlap-Wrapped Note from Brann's camp and return it to Archaeologist Andorin at Frosthold.
desc_text: After the discovery of Brann's journal in Grizzly Hills, we've only had one other communication from Brann. A mysterious note found its way to Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge, with no indication of where it came from. All it said was that we're to meet Brann at his camp and help him with his search.$BFrom what I can tell, the camp should be located northeast of here, across the Bor's Breath River and at the foot of some ruins from the Path of the Titans.

title: Fervor of the Frostborn
obj_text:
Yorg Stormheart at Frosthold has requested that you speak to Fjorlin Frostbrow to secure a ride and face your challenge.
 The Iron Watcher slain
desc_text: I be more than willing ta lend my shelter and home ta travelers in need, but I'm nae too keen ta force my people inte yer affairs.$BI'll tell ye what... my people are warriors, straight and true. On the day a frostborn becomes a man, he has ta prove himself in battle. He has ta show us that he'll not let size hold'm back.$BShow me yer as strong and fierce as one of my men, and I'll have them lend ye an ear or a blade. Speak ta Fjorlin over by the cliff to the south there and he'll put ye ta the test.

title: Sniffing Out the Perpetrator
obj_text:
Use the Frosthound Collar at the Abandoned Camp to track down whoever took Brann's possessions. When you recover them, use the communication device and speak to whoever you can contact.
 Track down thief
 Tracker Thulin slain
desc_text: The tone of Brann's note suggests he meant to bury something with the note, maybe a pack of some kind. You're sure this was all you found?$BOkay, I'm going to have you take one of these frosthounds with you. The frostborn use them for tracking. Bring it to the destroyed camp and let it get Brann's scent.$BIt should at least lead you to the location of those missing possessions, and if we're lucky, Brann himself.

title: Mythic: The Key to the Focusing Iris
obj_text: Deliver the Key to the Focusing Iris to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.
desc_text: A potent thrumming of magical nature can be heard and felt emanating from the eye-shaped jewel dropped from Sapphiron's clutches. To mortal ears it is nearly painful to be in the presence of the stone.$BSurely such a powerful item of import can only be taken to the queen of the dragons, Alexstrasza the Life-Binder. Seek her counsel atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight.

title: Pieces to the Puzzle
obj_text: Gather 6 Inventor's Disk Fragments and use them to assemble the Inventor's Disk.
desc_text: Thank the Light that someone got my message. Now that I'm safe from the iron dwarves, I need to ask your help with something. I've got a lead on Norgannon's keystone, which guards access to Ulduar's archives, but the Titans divided it into two pieces and secreted them away.$BOne of the pieces, the keystone's shell, is held within the Inventor's Library on the northern coast, south of Ulduar itself. The first thing you'll need to do is retrieve the fragments of an access disk from the library's guardians.

title: An Experienced Guide
obj_text: Locate Drom Frostgrip.
desc_text: I don't know where this core is hiding, but ye knew that. I said I'd help though, and that I shall.$BThere's a hermit by the name of Drom Frostgrip who lives in a cave north of here... down in tha valley. We've strayed away from the titans a bit ourselves being that there are so few about, but Drom's loyal to the old ways... he keeps an eye on their most precious places and speaks te the keeper Creteus often.$BYer sure to find him in the back of his cave... tell'm I sent ye and he'll help ye.

title: Data Mining
obj_text:
Use the Inventor's Disk to retrieve 7 pieces of Hidden Data from the Databanks.
 Hidden Data gathered (7)
desc_text: That disk you assembled... it's blank! That crafty Mimir must've hidden the information somewhere else. Look around the Inventor's Library; do you see any databanks there?$BThat might be what you need to do with the disk. Try using it near some of those databanks. Perhaps it's set to retrieve and store information from them. After you've tried your hand at that, contact me again and let me know what you've found. Meanwhile, I'll be trying to track down the other half of the archive key.

title: Aid from the Explorers' League
obj_text: Take Norgannon's Shell to Lagnus at Frosthold.
desc_text: Interesting. I don't see any locking mechanisms on the shell. That suggests to me that it may take more than just finding the other piece to combine the keystone.$BTake the shell back to the expedition leader, Lagnus, at Frosthold. Once he gets over his awe, he should be able to glean what the core looks like based on the shell, and maybe they can get the Frost Dwarves to help find it.$BI'm going to see if I can find out how to combine the two pieces. We'll catch up once we've both made some progress.

title: Unwelcome Guests
obj_text:
Fjorlin Frostbrow at Frosthold wants you to kill 10 Stormforged Invaders.
 $BStormforged Invaders slain (10)

 Stormforged Loreseeker
 Stormforged Monitor
$B

 Stormforged Pillager
desc_text: Our scouts have spotted iron dwarves in the valley north of here. I overheard King Stormheart sending you to visit Drom and I'm admittedly a bit worried about'm.$BIf you find any iron dwarves when you head down there, put'm down hard and fast for me, eh? I dun think they know exactly where we are or how to get here just yet, and I'd prefer to keep it that way.

title: The Hidden Relic
obj_text: Creteus in the Foot Steppes has provided you with the information to locate Norgannon's Core.
desc_text: During your absence, I was privileged enough to parley with the dwarf Brann Bronzebeard. This dwarf indicated his purpose for seeking the keystone, and I am satisfied that it is for satisfactory intent... I believe this dwarf may be the entity for which the keystone was created.$BNorgannon's Core is located in the Frigid Tomb to the southeast. Its guardians are ancient beings of ice, and they will not welcome your presence. Best these guardians and retrieve the keystone with my blessing, <race>.

title: The Exiles of Ulduar
obj_text: Speak with Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.
desc_text: The Storm Peaks are an intriguing place, but there's far more here than titan ruins. The peoples who live here face a dire threat in Loken and his minions.$BHe sent his favorite servants, the iron dwarves, on a brutal campaign against all the creatures of stone. He expelled the earthen from Ulduar, forcing them to take shelter at Bouldercrag's Refuge, on the face of a mountain west of the Inventor's Library. Bouldercrag and his brethren are beset by the iron dwarves there. Find and help them, <name>.

title: Norgannon's Shell
obj_text: Recover Norgannon's Shell from Archivist Mechaton.
desc_text: Charging inventor's disk.$BDisk charging completed.$BPreparing emergency protocol gamma.$BEmergency protocol loaded. Please use the charged disk to activate the guardian of Norgannon's shell, Archivist Mechaton. The archivist will release the shell once your identity has been verified.$BPlease have a pleasant millennium.

title: If He Cannot Be Turned
obj_text:
Defeat General Lightsbane and then report your success back to Thassarian aboard the gunship, The Skybreaker.
 General Lightsbane slain
desc_text: Death knights, such as General Lightsbane, are held on too tight of a leash to be able to be turned from the Lich King's will except under the most extraordinary circumstances.$BThe general keeps himself within the vault overseeing the creation of new weapons. Disturb one of his weapon racks at the northern forge and I assure you, he will come. I'll send Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper in to help you.$BIf we are to finally own The Shadow Vault, General Lightsbane must fall!

title: The Shadow Vault
obj_text: Report back to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
desc_text: It sounds like you did extremely well. And you secured three very important allies for the Knights of the Ebon Blade in the process.$B<Thassarian gazes out over the horizon.>$BYou should head back. By now, Baron Sliver and the other death knights will be fighting tooth and nail to hold The Shadow Vault against the might of the Scourge.$BI'm sure they'll need your help.

title: The Brothers Bronzebeard
obj_text:
Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.
 $BAccompany Brann Bronzebeard to Frosthold.
desc_text: That does it! We finally have the keystone... It's beautiful! I've been around the world more than once, but this thing's got me all jittery with excitement again. I suppose now's not the time to stop and admire though, we need to get the heck out of here.$BHop on my flying machine and help keep us covered from those iron dwarves on the way out!

title: Fury of the Frostborn King
obj_text: ring Norgannon's Core back to Creteus in the Foot Steppes.
desc_text: <As you retrieve the core from the chest, you hear the thumping of heavy footsteps rushing towards you from the corridor. There is the faint sound of battle in the distance.>

title: It's All Fun and Games
obj_text:
Destroy The Ocular and then report to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.
 The Ocular has been destroyed
desc_text: The Knights of the Ebon Blade want to take the Scourge base known as The Shadow Vault to the northwest. I have a contact in their group who has asked for help.$BThe first step is to blind the Lich King. He's using a device known as The Ocular to watch the area, which floats above the vault's spires.$BOur dwarves have created something for you to use against it. After the 'eye' has been destroyed, find Baron Sliver on the vault grounds. He's pretending to still be under the Lich King's will.

title: The Lonesome Watcher
obj_text: Recover Frostgrip's Signet Ring from an Iron Dwarf Monitor and then bring it to Creteus in the Foot Steppes.
desc_text: I never found the core... but I've often spoken to the keeper Creteus, and his omissions give him away. You'll find Creteus over the mountains to the east, in the Foot Steppes, keeping watch on the Engine of the Makers. The core might well be in there, but you'll need to win Creteus's favor.$BThe iron dwarves were here looking for something... it might well be the core. They took my ring. Find their leader, get the ring back, and show it to Creteus so that he knows I sent you.

title: No Mercy for the Merciless
obj_text:
Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp wants you to slay 10 members of the Horde.
 Horde members slain (10)
desc_text: Welcome to the Wintergrasp, <name>. Your mission is simple. Defeat ten of the Horde's finest. Now, go! Bring victory to the Alliance!

title: Mythic: Judgment at the Eye of Eternity
obj_text: Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight wants you to return with the Heart of Magic.
desc_text: Now that you have access to the focusing iris it's time to put that key to use.$BAs much as I would like to see Malygos brought back into the fold, that's just not going to happen at this point. With everything that's at stake, it is the judgment of the other Dragon Aspects that the Spell-Weaver needs to be put down.$B<Krasus says this last with a great deal of trepidation.>$B<name>, travel to the Eye of Eternity, confront Malygos and return with the Heart of Magic.

title: Victory in Wintergrasp
obj_text:
Win a Wintergrasp battleground match and return to Tactical Officer Abrahmis in Wintergrasp. You must have participated in the battle to be credited for the victory.
 $BVictory in Lake Wintergrasp
desc_text: Commander Zanneth might be satisfied with a pile of Horde corpses at his feet, but controlling Wintergrasp is of the utmost importance to the Valiance Expedition. Make sure it remains in our control.$BHowever, don't think we'll just let you stand around while your allies do your dirty work for you. If you're not at least a second level recruit by the end of the battle, don't come back.

title: Fate of the Titans
obj_text:
Creteus in the Foot Steppes has requested that you travel to the Temple of Invention, the Temple of Winter, the Temple of Life, and the Temple of Order and utilize the databank to examine each area.
 Temple of Invention Investigated
 Temple of Winter Investigated
 Temple of Life Investigated
 Temple of Order Investigated
desc_text: Norgannon's Core is not at this location. I am not sure why you seek it, <race>, and I am equally unsure if you truly know the purpose of that which you seek.$BI would like you to aid me before I consider extending my assistance.  I have recently encountered knowledge of the watcher, Thorim. His seat of power is contested, and his fate remains to be seen. This troubles me, for I do not know of the other watchers. Utilize this databank to examine their temples to the northeast and return the knowledge to me.

title: No Mercy for the Merciless
obj_text:
Commander Zanneth in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to slay 10 members of the Horde.
 Horde members slain (10)
desc_text: Welcome to the Wintergrasp Fortress, <name>. Your mission is simple. Defeat ten of the Horde's finest. Now, go! Bring victory to the Alliance!

title: Warding the Warriors
obj_text: Sorceress Kaylana at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 sets of Imbued Horde Armor from Horde players at the Glacial Falls.
desc_text: <name>, good to see you. While the battle has subsided for now, we must hurry and replenish our stocks. My research indicates that the armor of soldiers recently slain in the Glacial Falls becomes imbued with an incredible amount of energy. The Horde has been seen collecting armor in the area.$BHead to the Glacial Falls and slay any of the Horde you find there. Return their imbued armor to me.$BIf you cannot find any of the Horde, you might find the armor of an adventurer slain by the elementals.

title: Stop the Siege
obj_text:
Senior Demolitionist Legoso in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to destroy 3 Horde siege machines.
 Horde Siege Devices destroyed (3)
desc_text: It is only a matter of time before this castle is besieged by the forces of the Horde. Destroy three of their siege devices and return to me.

title: The Master Explorer
obj_text: ring Norgannon's Core to Brann Bronzebeard in the Engine of the Makers.
desc_text: Combining the keystone will require Norgannon's Binding - a device located in the Engine of the Makers, the large pit beside us. Brann should be down there with the other half of the keystone now. I have instructed him on the use of the device. He awaits your presence.$BI will do what I can to keep the iron dwarves occupied, but I do not have confidence that I will hold them for long. King Stormheart is returning to the defense of Frosthold with some of his men shortly. Please hurry, <race>.

title: A Rare Herb
obj_text: Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Horde Herb Pouches from Horde players in the Steppe of Life.
desc_text: My, it its quite chilly up here! Reminds me of the stormy peaks of Kaarinos on Argus. However, with all of this snow and ice, our soldiers can easily catch cold.$BHead to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp, and bring me back 10 of the Horde herb pouches you find. I will grind them into a medicine to help protect against the cold.$BThe Horde have been seen collecting them from the plant life in the area. Do not hesitate to slay them and retrieve the herbs!

title: I'm Not Dead Yet!
obj_text:
Escort Father Kamaros to safety and then report to Absalan the Pious aboard the Skybreaker.
 $BEscort Father Kamaros to safety
desc_text: The Light smiles upon me. I have not yet died in this living nightmare, but the Scourge will kill me and tear my body apart for use in their 'work' here if I cannot escape.$BI cannot make it on my own, my child, but with your help, I may yet live to fight the Scourge again.$BWill you help me make my escape before the Scourge's butchers come to finish me off?

title: Defend the Siege
obj_text:
Senior Demolitionist Legoso in Wintergrasp wants you to pilot or protect a siege device as it destroys three structures.$BPlayers of private rank or higher can build siege devices at Goblin Workshops.
 Siege Vehicles Defended (3)
desc_text: Front and center, <name>! We're beginning our assault on Wintergrasp Fortress. Those Horde animals think they can hide cowardly behind their walls? Well, I think not! We'll show them the power of Gnomish technology and smash their walls to bits!$BHowever, even the most powerful siege device is helpless without a crew. Pilot or protect one of our siege vehicles as it destroys three of the Horde structures.

title: Bones and Arrows
obj_text: owyer Randolph in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Horde players at the Forest of Shadows.
desc_text: Dragons are incredible! Well, their bones at least! I've been equipping our archers with arrowheads made of Dragonbone. Unfortunately, since the massacre at Angrathar, it has become almost impossible to get bone from Dragonblight.$BHowever, the Forest of Shadows on the western edge of Wintergrasp has enough bones to tide us over.$BHead to the Forest of Shadows and bring back any bone splinters you can find!$BThe Horde have been seen collecting bone splinters in the area. Slay them!

title: Finish Me!
obj_text:
A Dying Soldier in the Broken Front wants you to kill 5 Dying Soldiers and report to High Captain Justin Bartlett on the Skybreaker.
 Dying Soldiers Slain (5)
desc_text: They taunt us - even as they lie dying here...$BPlease, <brother/miss>... Don't allow their mocking to be the last sounds I hear...$BFinish me... deliver me from this torment... into... the Light.$BSeek out  my companions... offer them the same mercy.$BLeave nothing for the Scourge to raise!$BI beg you...

title: A Rare Herb
obj_text: Anchorite Tessa in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Horde Herb Pouches from Horde players in the Steppe of Life.
desc_text: My, it is quite chilly up here! Reminds me of the stormy peaks of Kaarinos on Argus. However, with all of this snow and ice, our soldiers can easily catch cold.$BHead to the Steppe of Life in southwestern Wintergrasp, and bring me back 10 Horde Herb Pouches. I will grind the herbs into a medicine to protect against the cold.$BThe Horde have been seen collecting them from the plant life in the area. Do not hesitate to slay them and retrieve the herbs!$BYou may also find one on a lasher in the area.

title: Assault by Ground
obj_text:
Escort the Skybreaker troops to the gates of Ymirheim. Return to Ground Commander Koup at the edge of the glacier east of Ymirheim for compensation after the task is complete.
 Alliance troops escorted to Ymirheim (4)
desc_text: Greetings <class>.$BOur troops have been attempting to storm Ymirheim for some time, but these vrykul are far more vicious than any we've faced before. They've been ambushing us repeatedly as we try to make it up the pass, and we've lost a lot of men.$BIf you want to lend yourself to the battle and help get my squad to the gates of Ymirheim safely, we will gladly reward you for your efforts. Once at the gates, we'll dig in and wait for reinforcements to catch up to us.

title: No Mercy!
obj_text:
High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker wants you to kill 15 Horde Players in Icecrown.
 $BPlayers slain (15)
desc_text: It is as I told you. They were not merely idle words spoken in a fit of anger.$BTime and again, the Horde have demonstrated their disdain for everything we hold dear and holy. They must pay with their lives for their transgressions against the light.$BAll of them.$BJust imagine a world free of their stain, <name>. Envision the joy our children will know. Think of the reverence your descendants will have for your memory, knowing they owe their happiness to you.$BNow go, and make that vision a reality!

title: King of the Mountain
obj_text:
Frazzle Geargrinder in Ymirheim wants you to use her Geargrinder's Jumpbot to plant the Alliance Battle Standard in the skulls at the top of the mountain.
 Alliance Battle Standard planted
desc_text: You've just got to get my jumpbot to the tippy top of the mountain to the northwest here at Ymirheim pronto, <name>!$BThat dastardly, no-good Blast Thunderbomb is working on his own bot, and I'm afraid he almost has it completed. We're in a race to see who's gonna be king of the mountain!$BOnce you jump up there, plant our battle standard in the pile of bones and show everyone that the Alliance, and my engineering skills, are the best!

title: Bones and Arrows
obj_text: owyer Randolph at Wintergrasp Fortress wants you to retrieve 10 Quivers of Dragonbone Arrows from Horde players at the Forest of Shadows.
desc_text: Dragons are incredible! Well, their bones at least! I've been equipping our archers with arrowheads made of Dragonbone. Unfortunately, since the massacre at Angrathar, it has become almost impossible to get bone from Dragonblight.$BHowever, the Forest of Shadows on the western edge of Wintergrasp has enough bones to tide us over.$BHead to the Forest of Shadows and bring back any bone splinters you can find!$BThe Horde have been seen collecting bone splinters in the area. Slay them!

title: Warding the Warriors
obj_text: Sorceress Kaylana in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 sets of Imbued Horde Armor at the Glacial Falls.
desc_text: <name>, good to see you. We must prepare for our next assault on the fortress. My research indicates that the armor of soldiers recently slain in the Glacial Falls becomes imbued with an incredible amount of energy. The Horde has been collecting armor in the area.$BHead to the Glacial Falls and slay any of the Horde you find there. Return their imbued armor to me.$BIf you cannot find any of the Horde, you might find the armor of an adventurer slain by the elementals.

title: ...All the Help We Can Get.
obj_text: High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker wants you to speak to Thassarian.
desc_text: Desperate times, <class>...$BAs uncomfortable as it makes me, I'm prepared to accept assistance from anyone - including our resident death knight.$BGo to Thassarian and see if he can help us develop tactics against the Scourge that will ensure victory once we are able to mount another offensive.$BWe have come so far... we must not fail here!

title: The Broken Front
obj_text:
High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker wants you to go to the Broken Front and question a Dying Soldier, then report back to him.
 Dying Soldier Questioned
desc_text: What?! Noooo!$BWe went to such great pains to keep this attack secret. How could the Horde have known? The resources... the men... all lost? Inconceivable!$BOur plans here in Icecrown hinged upon our taking that gate before the Horde could. We must recover quickly and prepare to mount another offensive.$BVisit the battlefield and search for any survivors. See if there's anything to be learned from this tragedy.$BAnd prepare yourself, <name>, for a war - on two fronts...

title: Poke and Prod
obj_text:
Thassarian on the Alliance gunship, Skybreaker, wants you to kill 5 Hulking Abominations, 5 Malefic Necromancers, and 5 Shadow Adepts at the Broken Front.
 Hulking Abominations killed (5)
 Malefic Necromancers killed (5)
 Shadow Adepts killed (5)
desc_text: As someone of your experience must surely know, there's no better way to familiarize one's self with their enemy than by confronting them in combat.$BWhile you no doubt lust for the glory of taking Icecrown Citadel, that cannot happen without taking each of the Lich King's gates first. For now, you must focus your efforts on the first of these...$BReturn to the Broken Front. Engage the enemy in battle. Search for a weakness we might exploit and return to me with a detailed report.

title: Fueling the Demolishers
obj_text: Siegesmith Stouthandle in Wintergrasp wants you to retrieve 10 Eternal Embers from Horde players at the Cauldron of Flames.
desc_text: <name>! About time you showed up. While we may have lost the last battle, we should prepare for the next! Travel to the Cauldron of Flames in southeastern Wintergrasp and retrieve several eternal embers.$BThe embers are mixed in with coal to fuel the Demolisher and Siege Engines.$BOh, and if you happen to see some of the Horde in the Cauldron, don't hesitate to slay them and take their embers. We must prevent them from holding the keep!

title: Your Attention, Please
obj_text: High Captain Bartlett wants you to speak with Chief Engineer Boltwrench in the Skybreaker.
desc_text: Chief Engineer Boltwrench has proven invaluable in his service aboard the Stormbreaker. Were it not for his ingenuity, we'd be sprinkled across half of the glacier several times over by now.$BThe thing is, he feels he must share his every miniscule invention or discovery - most of which I don't even understand.$BMy focus must be squarely on our enemies right now. I cannot afford any distractions.$BPlease visit him in my stead, <name>. And if you can, assist him. You'll find him belowdecks.

title: That's Abominable!
obj_text:
Thassarian on the Skybreaker wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
 Icy Ghouls Exploded (15)
 Vicious Geists Exploded (15)
 Risen Alliance Soldier Exploded (15)
desc_text: You know what to do, <class>.$BTake this kit and use the guts from their abominations to create one of your own, then command it to attack the enemy forces at the gate.$BYou would do well to refine this tactic for when we make another assault on the gate.

title: Get to Ymirheim!
obj_text: Speak with Frazzle Geargrinder in Ymriheim.
desc_text: I need you down in Ymirheim, that big frost vrykul town in the middle of Icecrown.$BFrazzle Geargrinder is down there on the south side of town representing the Valiance Expedition in a competition against the Horde scum. It's her jumpbot versus theirs in a king of the mountain contest!$BDon't let us down, <name>. Gnomish engineering pride is on the line! Besides, all the boys here in the hold are counting on you.$BThat and we've got money riding on it that you can kick those idiots in the pants!

title: Coprous the Defiled
obj_text:
Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to kill Coprous the Defiled at Mord'rethar.
 Coprous the Defiler Slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Reports of a powerful zombie at the death gate have reached my ears, <class>.$BWe cannot allow a potential threat such as this to go unchallenged. Any information you are able to glean from engaging it will be better than what we know now.$BGo to the western chamber of the gate and find this creature. Fight him, and find a weakness we might exploit.

title: Neutralizing the Plague
obj_text:
Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a plague cauldron at Mord'rethar.$BYou can create Pustulant Spinal Fluid by using a Giant Spine collected from a Pustulant Horror.
 Plague Cauldron Neutralized
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: You no longer need my assistance in neutralizing the enemy's plague cauldrons, <race>.$BHunt down the flesh giants at the death gate and use the fluid from their spines to render batches of the plague ineffective.$BYou are striking at the heart of the enemy's strategy. This is an important mission - vital to our cause, and should be carried out whenever time permits.$BRemember, the giants and the plague cauldrons can be found on Mord'rethar.

title: Borrowed Technology
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use the Smuggled Solution at the Broken Front.$BUsing the solution will require an Abandoned Helm, Abandoned Armor, and Pile of Bones, all found at the Broken Front.
 Field Tests Conducted (3)
desc_text: I get it, I get it. Cappy's too busy to see this for himself. His loss!$BSee, I've managed to 'acquire' a certain shipment of solution from the enemy. And as much as I hate tinkerin' with inferior goblin technology, I'm inclined to make an exception here.$BTake this sample. I'll need you to run a few field tests, just to prove its usefulness, while I try to do a little reverse engineering to duplicate the creation process.$BGo to the front and gather the materials to make a decoy, then use the oil.

title: The Solution Solution
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use the Smuggled Solution at the Broken Front.$BUsing the solution will require an Abandoned Helm, Abandoned Armor, and Pile of Bones, all found at the Broken Front.
 Frostbrood Skytalons Destroyed (3)
desc_text: Oh, yes, yes. Back again, are we? Never enough practice, I suppose.$BHere we are, the solution to that pesky frostwyrm problem.$BMake them scarce, <race>. The more you take out now, the less we face when we are again ready to attempt our march on the citadel.$BBest of luck, now. And do bring back whatever you don't use.

title: Slaves to Saronite
obj_text:
Absalan the Pious aboard the Skybreaker wants you to rescue 10 Saronite Mine Slaves.
 Saronite Mine Slave rescued (10)
desc_text: Our people are being captured and put to work as slaves in the saronite mines of Ymirheim, the vrykul stronghold in the middle of Icecrown. The Lich King has them mining that unholy ore day and night.$BI made a promise to Highlord Fordring that we would get those wretches out of there alive, and that's exactly what we will do.$BUnfortunately, I've been ordered to stay on this gunship and serve as an ambassador to the Valiance Expedition. Will you please rescue them in my stead, <name>?

title: Basic Chemistry
obj_text:
Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use Pustulant Spinal Fluid on a plague cauldron at Mord'rethar.
 Batch of Plague Neutralized
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: <Thassarian takes the pustulant spines and drains their fluid into a flask.>$BA little-known quality of the flesh giants...$BTheir spinal fluid interacts with the plague in a very interesting way, turning it into a corrosive acid.$BPoured from the towering ramparts, acid may not be a welcome sight to the troops below, but at least the victims won't rise up and add to the enemy's numbers.$BPour the contents of this flask into one of the plague cauldrons in the western chamber of the death gate.

title: Assault by Air
obj_text:
Ground Commander Koup at the edge of the glacier east of Ymirheim has ordered you to use the Skybreaker Suppression Turret to keep the Skybreaker Troop Transport alive long enough to make all of its drops.$B
 Skybreaker Infiltrators dropped (4)
desc_text: I've got some boys suited and ready for their drops inside of Ymirheim. I could use you to see them there safely.$BInside the walls, the vrykul have set up some kind of automated spear guns that have been tearing up our transports. We had our engineers install a Suppression Turret to shut down those spear guns - just fire a round near any gun and the smoke should block its sight and clog its gears.$BHop on the turret and see to it that all my boys make it to their drops in one piece.

title: Against the Giants
obj_text: Thassarian on the Skybreaker wants you to bring him 5 Pustulant Spines from the Pustulant Horrors on Mord'rethar.
desc_text: While it's going to be crucial to defeat the Scourge on the ground, we mustn't neglect the gate itself.$BThe flesh giants on the ramparts are capable of hurling massive boulders and chunks of ice, inflicting devastating damage to enemy infantry below.$BMuster a force and defeat these giants. We need to know just what we're up against in terms of their strength.$BOh... and bring me their spines. If memory serves, there's a little trick I can share with you.

title: Sneak Preview
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to fly down to the gate of desolation, visiting the south, central, north, and northwest regions of the gate.
 Aldur'thar South Visited
 Aldur'thar Central Visited
 Aldur'thar North Visited
 Aldur'thar Northwest Visited
desc_text: Progress is being made. We have a promising array of tactics that should gain us control of the death gate. There will doubtlessly be many casualties, but in the end,  we should be able to prevail - barring any interference from those Horde you insist on contending with...$BAt any rate, our next focus will be the gate of desolation. Fly down and become familiar with it and with the enemies posted there.$BWhen you return, I will have your missions prepared.

title: That's Abominable!
obj_text:
Thassarian on the Skybreaker wants you to use the Abomination Reanimation Kit to create a Reanimated Abomination, which you are to use to kill 15 Icy Ghouls, 15 Vicious Geists, and 15 Risen Alliance Soldiers.
 Icy Ghouls Exploded (15)
 Vicious Geists Exploded (15)
 Risen Alliance Soldiers Exploded (15)
desc_text: Abominations...$BThey can be a very capable enemy. I've seen them turn the tide of battle more than once. What few realize, is that they can also be very capable friends.$BThey are not deep thinkers. If you know the secrets of their creation, you can issue them basic orders that they will not question.$BFortunately for you, I know these secrets.$BThis kit will reanimate the remains of the abominations you defeat. Take it, and learn to use them against the Scourge on the death gate.

title: Drag and Drop
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
 Dark Subjugator dragged and dropped (3)
desc_text: The Cult of the Damned hold the gate of desolation, eh? No surprise there.$BTime to have a little fun. At the southern end of the gate, you mentioned there were new cultists being trained. They're almost certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$BThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$BKill the fools until you find one, <class>, then use it on a subjugator.

title: Get the Message
obj_text: Capture 6 Orgrim's Hammer Dispatches from Orgrim's Hammer Scouts and bring them to High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker.
desc_text: The Horde is up to something and I don't like it. After the stunt they pulled on the Broken Front, they're capable of anything, and it's up to us to stop it.$BThere's been a flurry of activity in the skies over the Icecrown Glacier, to the west of Aldur'thar and the Ironwall Rampart. Horde scouts and messengers streak in and out on dragonhawks, carrying reports and orders. Take this dart gun and use it to kill the Orgrim's Hammer Scouts. It'll probably work best if you're flying, too.

title: Chain of Command
obj_text:
Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to go to Aldur'thar and defeat Overseer Faedris, Overseer Savryn, Overseer Veraj, and Overseer Jhaeqon.
 Overseer Faedris Killed
 Overseer Jhaeqon Killed
 Overseer Veraj Killed
 Overseer Savryn Killed
desc_text: ased on your report, and my knowledge of the Cult, they have an overseer managing the operation of each encampment on the gate.$BWhile taking their leaders down will only be a temporary setback, it will at least slow them down and keep them off-balance. And that, <race>, is a worthy enough goal for now.$BSeek out these overseers and return to me when they have been dispatched.

title: Drag and Drop
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect Orbs of Illusion from Bitter Initiates at Aldur'thar and use them on 3 Dark Subjugators there.
 Dark Subjugators dragged and dropped (3)
desc_text: Looks like those initiates are increasing in number again. You know what to do...$BAt the southern portion of the gate, the new cultists are being trained. They're certain to be holding a special item given to all initiates - an Orb of Illusion.$BThese artifacts are used to disguise a cult member, allowing them to gain safe passage, infiltrate, or simply blend in with an enemy.$BSlay the fools until you find some, then use them on the subjugators there.

title: Bloodspattered Banners
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to kill 5 Scourge Banner-Bearers, 5 Scourge Converters, and 20 Converted Heroes.
 Scourge Banner-Bearer slain (5)
 Converted Hero slain (20)
 Scourge Converter slain (5)
desc_text: In the Valley of Fallen Heroes and Icecrown Glacier, to the west of Aldur'thar, the Scourge seeks to use the fallen against us. Scourge lieutenants have woken the valley's dead and imbued them with fearsome strength and fervor. The banners carried by the Scourge leaders in the glacier area are the source of these powers. Kill the banner-bearers, and you will weaken the converted heroes they lead.$BIt falls to you to rid us of this obstacle, and test the resistance before the main body can advance.

title: Cannot Reproduce
obj_text:
Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to use the Partitioned Flask at each of the 3 Cultists' Cauldrons at Aldur'thar, then bring it to Chief Engineer Boltwrench.
 Blue Sample Collected
 Green Sample Collected
 Dark Sample Collected
desc_text: I smell their cauldrons from here, but that's not plague they're cooking.$BPledges to the cult are forced to drink a concoction that steals their will and enslaves them forever to the Lich King.$BSome say the potion contains the twisted soul of a being who was tormented before being mercilessly slaughtered, but I've never been able to reproduce it...$BFill this flask with a sample from each of the three cauldrons in the northwest region of the gate and bring it to Chief Engineer Boltwrench.

title: Retest Now
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to throw a Writhing Mass into a cauldron at Aldur'thar.
 Writhing Mass Banished
desc_text: This should do the trick!$BThose twisted hooligans are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then I say we help 'em out a bit!$BTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... I'm almost positive that its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence once you've defeated them.$BWhen you've collected a bunch of them, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls into any of their cauldrons.$BLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!

title: Blood of the Chosen
obj_text:
Knight-Captain Drosche on the Skybreaker has sent you to kill 20 vrykul in Ymirheim.
 $BYmirheim Vrykul slain (20)

 Blight Falconer
 Ymirjar Element Shaper
 Foreman Thaldrin
$B

 Ymirheim Defender
 VEHICLE TEST - ANIM  BONE MANIPULATOR
 Ymirheim Chosen Warrior
desc_text: Those vrykul that have gained the favor of the Lich King call themselves the Ymirjar. They inhabit a city in the center of Icecrown. We have a lot of preparations to make before we assault Icecrown Citadel, and the one that stands before us now is routing these so-called "Chosen" of the Lich King.$BGo to their city, Ymirheim, and slaughter them in their home. Let there be no questions as to who the stronger combatants are here.

title: Retest Now
obj_text:
Chief Engineer Boltwrench aboard the Skybreaker wants you to drink the Diluted Cult Tonic, kill any Cultists at Aldur'thar and take their Tainted Essences. You are then to combine 10 of the essences into a Writhing Mass and throw it into any of their cauldrons.
 Writhing Mass Banished
desc_text: Those twisted cultists are looking for souls to put in their crazy-juice? Then let's help 'em out a bit!$BTake a swig of this - don't worry, I've diluted it plenty... I'm almost positive that its only effect will be to detect any cultist's essence.$BOnce you've collected a bunch of 'em, throw the writhing mass of twisted souls in one of their cauldrons.$BLet's see how they like a taste of their own medicine!

title: Raise the Barricades
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to construct 8 Barricades using your Barricade Construction Kit.
 Barricades constructed (8)
desc_text: When our forces begin to move beyond Aldur'thar, they will be vulnerable to attack from the Ironwall Rampart and the broad glacier below.$BWe have neither the time nor the materials to build fortifications, but we can put up some barricades to shield our men from fire and break up Scourge charges.$BTake this barricade kit to the Valley of Fallen Heroes, on the west side of Aldur'thar. Locate the markers I've placed there and use this kit to construct your barricades there.

title: The Guardians of Corp'rethar
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to kill 5 Harbingers of Horror and 5 Corp'rethar Guardians.
 Harbinger of Horror slain (5)
 Corp'rethar Guardian slain (5)
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: Corp'rethar, called the Horror Gate. It is the last barrier between us and the Icecrown Citadel. It waits to the south of the Ironwall Rampart, beyond the glacier and the Conflagration. By the time our troops reach it, they will be exhausted and worse.$BWe must weaken its defenses, or our army's strength will break upon its walls.$BIts battlements are manned by some of the Lich King's fiercest and most zealous servants. Do all you can to destroy these guardians and hope it is enough.

title: Joining the Assault
obj_text: Report to Ground Commander Koup at the edge of the glacier east of Ymirheim.
desc_text: We need more men to join the main assault on Ymirheim.$BAny warrior with half a brain can tell you that vrykul are fierce fighters and should not be taken lightly. That goes two-fold for the Ymirjar. They have shown no restraint in proving to us why the Lich King deemed them worthy.$BGround Commander Koup is overseeing the assault. The city itself is located in the center of Icecrown - Koup's troops are positioned near the edge of the glacier, east of the city.

title: Before the Gate of Horror
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to use the Volatile Acid to dissolve the corpses of 6 Skeletal Reavers.
 Skeletal Reaver bones dissolved (6)
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: The Conflagration, the ground before Corp'rethar, south of the Ironwall Rampart, is where the Lich King's elite soldiers have formed up to defend the citadel.$BLed by a contingent of death knights, a legion of skeletal reavers bars the way. I fear that even when these reavers fall, the Scourge will simply reconstitute them and send them back at us.$BI've come up with a plan to stop this, but I have no way of knowing if it will work. Take this solution and use it to dissolve the remains of the reavers.

title: The Ironwall Rampart
obj_text:
Defeat Grimkor the Wicked and return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
 Grimkor the Wicked slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: The Ironwall Rampart overlooks the Valley of Fallen Heroes, west of Aldur'thar. The rampart dominates the fields below on all sides. We will not be able to advance if the rampart cannot be taken, but it is held by Grimkor the Wicked and his Cult of the Damned disciples.$BIf you can weaken Grimkor, our forces will know what to expect as we advance. Take this rune of distortion. Unleashing its power near Grimkor's orb at the end of the rampart should be enough to get the necromancer's attention.

title: Leading the Charge
obj_text:
Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 40 Bombardment Infantry, 8 Bombardment Captains and 15 Gargoyle Ambushers.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (40)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender
$B

 Bombardment Infantry
$B
$B
 $BBombardment Captain slain (8)

 Stitched Brute
 Stitched Brute
$B

 Bombardment Captain
$B
$B
 $BGargoyle Ambusher slain (15)

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B

 Gargoyle Ambusher
desc_text: Infra-green technology allows us to stay hidden here, right over the Scourge's nose!  What's more, we installed infra-green in specially constructed bombers... but not to hide them, no!  We use infra-green tech to shield them!$BSpeak with Karen No and request a bomber.  Fly it over the Bombardment... use its shields and turret to protect yourself, and use the bomb launcher to hit Scourge targets.  Practice well, then return to me and I'll have an even more vital mission for you!

title: No Rest For The Wicked
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to defeat Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
 Alumeth the Ascended Defeated
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: These fools have actually stumbled upon something that could pose a serious threat to our plans!$BThe leader of this particular sect, Alumeth, has ritualistically sacrificed himself and now his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$BIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$BCombine his heart, skull, scepter and robes from around their chamber and use his remains on the crystal there.$BHurry, <race>! Destroy him before he becomes any more powerful!

title: Killohertz
obj_text: Chief Engineer Boltwrench wants you to find Kibli Killohertz at the hidden Alliance airport above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.
desc_text: The goblins got lucky and found a new energy.  They call it infra-green, and I'll be a one-eyed ogre if those psychos didn't strike green gold.$BGo find Kibli Killohertz.  He's leading the reverse engineering efforts of infra-green, at a small, hidden Alliance airport above Aldur'thar, the Desolation Gate.  I'll give you infra-green vision to help you find it.  Go to the dome with our Alliance banners -- if you fly near the Horde airport then you'll be in a load of green trouble.

title: Watts My Target
obj_text:
Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill Bombardment Infantry, Gargoyle Ambushers, Frostbrood Sentries and Scourge War Machines.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (40)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender
$B

 Bombardment Infantry
$B
$B
 $BGargoyle Ambusher slain (20)

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B
$B
 Scourge War Machine slain (10)
 $BFrostbrood Sentry slain (10)

 Frostbrood Sentry
$B

 Frostbrood Sentry
desc_text: Put on your lucky socks, <name>, and say your favorite prayers.  This next mission will test your wit and fortitude like a visit from the in-laws!$BRequest another bomber from Karen No.  Take it beyond The Bombardment and over the Valley of Lost Hope.  You have more targets this time, both on the land an in the air.  Keep your shields charged and your ammo loaded, <name>!  I'll see you when it's over.

title: No Rest For The Wicked
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to defeat Alumeth the Ascended at Aldur'thar.
 Alumeth the Ascended Slain
 $BSuggested players: 5
desc_text: It's Alumeth... He's growing in power again. I can sense it. Again his underlings are channeling power to his soul.$BIf he's allowed to rest, their efforts will soon transform him into a mighty adversary.$BReturn to his chamber in the north portion of Aldur'thar. Combine his heart, skull, scepter and robes, then use his remains on the crystal there.$BHurry, <race>! Destroy him before he becomes any more powerful!

title: Putting the Hertz: The Valley of Lost Hope
obj_text:
Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 20 Gargoyle Ambushers, 12 Frostbrood Sentries and 12 Scourge War Machines.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (50)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender
$B

 Bombardment Infantry
$B
$B
 $BGargoyle Ambusher slain (20)

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B

 Gargoyle Ambusher
$B
$B
 Scourge War Machine slain (12)
 $BFrostbrood Sentry slain (12)

 Frostbrood Sentry
$B

 Frostbrood Sentry
desc_text: The fight goes on!  Your new orders arrived for a long-range bombing mission through the Bombardment and into the Valley of Lost Hope -- when you're ready, ask Karen for a bomber and pour those bombs and rockets onto the Scourge!

title: Exploiting an Opening
obj_text: Speak to Captain Kendall below Icecrown Citadel.
desc_text: I've got an interesting assignment for you, <name>.  If you're up for a challenge, that is.$BWe've been tipped off about an opening below Icecrown Citadel.  Our engineers have studied the layout and have decided it's a structural weakness.$BWe've sent some men there along with some "borrowed" saronite bombs.  They're under Captain Kendall's command.$BWith a little help we could deal a huge blow to the forces of the Scourge.  What do you say, <name>?

title: Not a Bug
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
 Dark Messenger summoned
desc_text: Alright, <friend/missy>, time to plant a bug.$BRelax, it's not a bug exactly, but it'll serve our purposes.$BIn the northern portion of Aldur'thar the cult's void summoners enslave demonic minions. Use this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of these enslaved minions, and then use their summoning crystal to bring our little spy into being.$BUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.

title: Capture More Dispatches
obj_text: Capture 6 Orgrim's Hammer Dispatches from Orgrim's Hammer Scouts and bring them to High Captain Justin Bartlett aboard the Skybreaker.
desc_text: Despite our efforts, the Horde continues to send scouts to the area of the Icecrown Glacier, to the west of the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.$BWe can't afford to let the Horde gain the upper hand with this scouting operation. Take the dart gun with you again and show the Orgrim's Hammer scouts no mercy! Bring the captured dispatches to me.$BThe Horde's wasted efforts will be our gain.

title: Set it Off!
obj_text: Captain Kendall, below Icecrown Citadel, wants you to go to the nearby Saronite Bomb Stack to light the fuse.
desc_text: Things are looking good.  Let's do this.$BThe stack of bombs is right near the pit.  I'll start to evacuate the men.

title: Securing the Perimeter
obj_text:
Captain Kendall at Icecrown Citadel wants you to slay 10 Hulking Horrors.
 Hulking Horror slain (10)
desc_text: The saronite bombs are in place, <name>.  We're only going to get one shot at this, however.  Let's make it count.$BWe need temporary control of the area for a safe detonation.  Let's try to put a dent in the Scourge's numbers.

title: Not a Bug
obj_text:
Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect 5 Dark Matters and summon a Dark Messenger at Aldur'thar.
 Dark Messenger summoned
desc_text: The cultists have discovered the last messenger you summoned, <race>.$BWhile it was quite informative, it's important that we continue to monitor their every move.$BUse this rod to siphon the dark matter from the corpses of enslaved minions at Aldur'thar. Then use their summoning crystal to bring another dark messenger into being.$BUntil it is discovered, the messenger will serve as our eyes and ears, discreetly observing the actions of our enemy.

title: A Short Fuse
obj_text: Look for clues wherever the fall takes you.
desc_text: As you light the fuse, you notice that it is consumed by fire far quicker than you would expect.$BThe bombs are about to go off and your best chance at surviving is to lean towards the pit and hope the fall doesn't kill you.

title: Army of the Damned
obj_text:
Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp wants you to raise an army of 100 Ghoulish Minions.
 Ghoulish Minion Raised (100)
desc_text: You probably think you're quite strong -- fighting these undead and crushing their bones beneath your war machines.$BThat is nothing compared to the strength it took to create them.$BI saw the prince do it himself.  I can show you how it happened... if you'd like.

title: Return to the Surface
obj_text: Return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
desc_text: You should leave now.  You'll find a portal behind me.  It'll take you to the surface.$BWe'll meet again.  He'll be looking for you.$BIt's only a matter of time until he finds you.

title: A Voice in the Dark
obj_text: Investigate the nearby voice in Naz'anak, the Forgotten Depths.
desc_text: The object is not a crystal at all, but some form of organ, encased in ice.$BAs you touch it, your hand reels in horrible pain.  You feel as if your hand has been cut, yet there is no visible wound.$BAs you collect your thoughts, you hear a young boy's voice nearby.$B"You really shouldn't have done that."

title: Need More Info
obj_text: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect the 3 pages of Cultists' Research from the Cult Researchers at Aldur'thar and use them to create the Cult of the Damned Thesis.
desc_text: The Cult of the Damned are notorious for concocting grandiose plans that in the end, rarely succeed. But something feels different this time....$BPerhaps it's the proximity to the Lich King that has their fervor heightened. Whatever it is, they appear to be more confident than ever. We must know what feeds this bravado and then find a way to strip them of it!$BI believe the key lies with their researchers. Find out what they're up to and report back to me with the details.

title: Do Your Worst
obj_text:
Use the Refurbished Demolisher to destroy 150 Decomposed Ghouls, 20 Frostskull Mages and 2 Bone Giants in the Valley of Lost Hope.  Speak to Matthias Lehner at the First Legion Forward Camp when you've completed this task.
 Decomposed Ghoul slain (150)
 Frostskull Magus slain (20)
 Bone Giant slain (2)
desc_text: You're going to use this machine against the Scourge?  You're not going to win against them like that.$BYou can destroy hundreds... even thousands of them.  But you won't win.  Not out here.$BWhen you're done playing with your machine, meet me to the north.  There is an old army encampment.  What I will show you will teach you a little bit about who you're up against.

title: Futility
obj_text: Return to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
desc_text: Do you see now?  Sending your men against the prince's armies just swells their numbers.$BI don't expect you to understand... you'll probably just end up like the others.  You'd best return to whoever sent you.  They might be worried.

title: Sindragosa's Fall
obj_text:
Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker wants you to slay 5 Wyrm Reanimators, 8 Cultist Corrupters and 3 Vrykul Necrolords at Sindragosa's Fall.
 Wyrm Reanimator slain (5)
 Cultist Corrupter slain (8)
 Vrykul Necrolord slain (3)
desc_text: You're a real star, <name>.  See, when I give one of these other soldiers an assignment, the odds of them getting it done are about fifty-fifty.  The odds of them coming back... well, slightly worse.$BBut with you, it's always a guaranteed thing.  Like gnomish clockwork!$BAnyway, I have another one for you.  Sindragosa's Fall, east of the valley.  There is some serious cultist activity, including and not limited to, the raising of frost wyrms.  I need you to go kick their teeth in.$BI hate cultists.

title: Time to Hide
obj_text: Matthias Lehner wants you to obtain 3 Faceless One's Blood.
desc_text: You shouldn't have touched it.  But now that you did, he's going to come looking for you.$BAnd he'll find you.  Unless you hide yourself from him.$BBring me blood from the faceless ones if you want to live!

title: Knowledge is a Terrible Burden
obj_text: Report back to Thassarian aboard the Skybreaker.
desc_text: Now you know what you're up against, <name>.  An opponent who no longer knows pain... remorse... or humanity.  An opponent who will do anything to get what he wants.$BThe heart was his weakness and now he knows you've found it.$BIf you're going to go back for it, you'd best bring help.  He will not leave it unguarded again.

title: Field Repairs
obj_text: Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker, wants you to collect 5 Demolisher Parts from the Scavenging Geists and take them to the Wrecked Demolisher in the Valley of Lost Hope.
desc_text: All right.  Let's not celebrate just yet.  We need to capitalize on the momentum we've gathered with our little bombing mission.$BWe've spotted a workable Horde demolisher-class catapult in the field below.  The geist seem to be taking it apart.$BIf you can put it back together, we'll be able to do some serious damage to the Scourge's armies in the Valley.$BSure, you'll be a little outnumbered, but I've a lot of faith in you!

title: The Hunter and the Prince
obj_text:
Matthias Lehner in the Court of Bones wants you to look for a Bloodstained Stone and complete the Prince's Destiny.
 The Prince's Destiny
desc_text: efore the prince became a king, he fought many battles... but only one where he came close to dying.$BIt was fought right here.  After you let me show you what happened, you'll understand everything.$BFind a bloodstained stone and pick it up from the floor.  You'll see what happened.

title: Time for Answers
obj_text: Speak to Matthias Lehner at the Court of Bones.
desc_text: You have a lot of questions, <name>.  You're the only one who can see me because you touched something that once belonged to him... don't you remember?$BYou don't know what it is?  Well I can't just tell you... that would make him really mad.  He's not just a prince anymore... he's the king!$BMeet me at the Court of Bones, north of Icecrown Citadel and you can see for yourself.

title: Static Shock Troops: the Bombardment
obj_text:
Kibli Killohertz wants you to kill 50 Bombardment Infantry, 10 Bombardment Captains and 20 Gargoyle Ambushers.
 $BBombardment Infantry slain (50)

 Enraged Fleshrender
 Enraged Fleshrender

 Bombardment Infantry

 Bombardment Captain

 Gargoyle Ambusher

 Gargoyle Ambusher
desc_text: This is a short-ranged mission, over The Bombardment.  A good warm up.  Ready?

title: Tirion's Help
obj_text: Speak to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Crusader's Pinnacle.
desc_text: It's not the first time I've heard that story about Arthas and his heart... always thought it was some made-up tale to impress the rank and file.$BWe must act on this information immediately.  Unfortunately, we must do so in secret.$BArthas's agents are everywhere and if he finds out, our plan is dead in the water.$BWe need to take this to the Argent Crusade.  Every single paladin in that order was hand-picked by Tirion himself.  If there's anyone free of cultist infiltration, it's those guys.

title: Shatter the Shards
obj_text: ring the Broken Shard of Horror, the Broken Shard of Despair, and the Broken Shard of Suffering to Thassarian, aboard the Skybreaker.
desc_text: Atop the battlements of Corp'rethar, the Lich King's minions have erected three crystals, the shards of horror, despair, and suffering. Should our men reach the walls of Corp'rethar, he will unleash these weapons on our army.$BIn full effect, the crystals will afflict the minds of our men with paralyzing pain and fear. Then, the Scourge will be able to slaughter them at will.$BFind these shards, destroy them, and bring me their broken remains. We cannot allow the Lich King to deploy these weapons!

title: Tirion's Gambit
obj_text:
Tirion Fordring, at the Crusader's Pinnacle, wants you to obtain and wear a Cultist Acolyte's Hood and meet him at the entrance of the Cathedral of Darkness, northwest of Icecrown Citadel.
 Tirion's Gambit
desc_text: Just this morning, my scouts informed me of a Cult of the Damned procession leaving from Icecrown Citadel to the Cathedral of Darkness, bearing an artifact.$BAnd now I learn that it might be Arthas's own heart... a thing containing the last bit of his remaining humanity.$BThis is a sign of the Light.  As long as such an artifact exists, there is a chance that Arthas Menethil can become a man again!$BMeet me at the cathedral's entrance.  Be sure to bring a cultist's hood -- we're going incognito.

title: Let's Get Out of Here
obj_text:
Escort Father Kamaros to safety and then report to Absalan the Pious aboard the Skybreaker.
 $BEscort Father Kamaros to safety
desc_text: The Light smiles upon me. I have not yet died in this living nightmare, but the Scourge will kill me and tear my body apart for use in their 'work' here if I cannot escape.$BI cannot make it on my own, my child, but with your help, I may yet live to fight the Scourge again.$BWill you help me make my escape before the Scourge's butchers come to finish me off?

title: Preparations for War
obj_text: Speak to Officer Van Rossem to secure passage to the Skybreaker in Icecrown, and then report to High Captain Justin Bartlett.
desc_text: You there!$BYou look like you have some wits about you. We could use some more able bodies in Icecrown.$BYou may have heard rumors of our failure in assaulting the glacier from the ground, but let me set those concerns to rest. We're now mounting our assault from one of the most advanced pieces of engineering known to Azeroth, the Skybreaker. The Horde don't stand a chance, and neither does Arthas.$BSpeak to me when you're ready to depart.

title: Where Dragons Fell
obj_text: Matthias Lehner at Sindragosa's Fall wants you to obtain 6 Whelp Bone Dusts.
desc_text: A whole brood of blue dragons fell here.  And now, one by one, they're being raised by his servants.$BHe raised the biggest of them all himself.  Bring me some bone dust from the whelps and I'll show you exactly how he did it.

title: A Valiant's Field Training
obj_text:
Sir Marcus Barlowe at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
 Converted Hero slain (10)
desc_text: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.

title: Valiant Of Stormwind
obj_text: Speak with Marshal Jacob Alerius again if you wish to become a valiant of Stormwind.
desc_text: Welcome, champion. Word of your combat prowess has already reached my ears. Do you seek to join Stormwind's tournament delegation?$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Stormwind, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

title: The Library Console
obj_text: Take the Inventor's Disk to the Inventor's Library Console inside the Inventor's Library.
desc_text: Norgannon's shell is within our reach, <name>. Take the inventor's disk into the library's interior. There should be a console there that you can activate with the disk. I imagine Mimir stored more there than just Norgannon's shell. There are probably enough schematics stored there to keep Ironforge's engineers occupied for years!$BAnyway, use the disk to recover the shell. Hopefully, Mimir hasn't decided to put any more obstacles in our way.

title: Learning The Reins
obj_text:
Strike a Melee Target with Thrust 5 times, use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, use Charge on 2 vulnerable Charge Targets and then return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
 Use Thrust on Melee Target (5)
 Use Shield-Breaker on vulnerable Ranged Target (2)
 Use Charge on vulnerable Charge Target (2)
desc_text: Most of the tournament's competitions require competitors to master the command of a mount in battle. In order to familiarize you with mounted combat, we've put up training dummies all over the northern part of the tournament grounds.$BVisit the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up on the Quel'dorei steed. Familiarize yourself with the tactics available to you and use them to defeat the three different kinds of training dummies.

title: The Edge Of Winter
obj_text: Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
desc_text: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, <name>.

title: The Argent Tournament
obj_text: Speak with Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament grounds to enroll in the tournament.
desc_text: We have invited you here to test your skill and valor against others who have bravely opposed the Scourge. Many have been our divisions, but the time has come for heroes fighting under all banners to test their blades against one another in preparation for facing our mutual enemy.$BArcanist Taelis is the Silver Covenant's representative to the tournament and he'll enter your name into the rolls and begin your training. Seek him out inside the large Alliance tent in the northeastern part of the grounds.

title: A Worthy Weapon
obj_text: ring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$BMy tournament blade has gone missing and I need it for a match this afternoon.$BOne of the bards tells me that travelers used to present winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to Drak'Mar lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near its border with Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills.

title: The Grand Melee
obj_text: ring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Captain Joseph Holley at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
desc_text: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. The people of Stormwind adore their knights and are looking forward to seeing us win the melee. To that end, they've been honing their skills against the other valiants.$BI suggest you do the same.$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Elwynn steed, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Alliance Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.

title: The Aspirant's Challenge
obj_text:
Speak with Squire David to summon your opponent. Once you have defeated the Argent Valiant, return to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
 Argent Valiant defeated
desc_text: You have trained hard as an aspirant, <name>, and now the time has come to test your mounted combat skills against a skilled opponent.$BEquip your lance, then go to the stables outside the pavilion and mount up on the stabled Quel'dorei steed.$BAt the Aspirants' Ring on the northern side of the tournament grounds, you'll find Squire David. He'll make certain that you're ready for the fight and call out your opponent.$BGood luck, <name>. May your horse be steady and your aim true.

title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
obj_text: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Good, honest, honed steel may not carry the day. The other combatants are using enchanted blades and I find myself at a disadvantage, but all is not lost.$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, <name>. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.

title: Threat From Above
obj_text:
Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
 Chillmaw slain
 Cultist Bombardier slain (3)
 $BSuggested players: 3
desc_text: Highlord Tirion Fordring has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. He doesn't believe that they will stop just because their Black Knight has been defeated.$BOur skytalon scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party. If we don't intercept them, the tournament will come under attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.

title: The Black Knight of Westfall?
obj_text: Investigate the Black Knight's claims and return to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds with your findings.
desc_text: No doubt you've heard the disturbing rumors about the contestant the others are calling the Black Knight. It's said that any rider who was scheduled to face him in combat has met an untimely end.$BOf course, we have no definitive proof of anything, but it wouldn't hurt to look into this knight's background.$BHe claims to be descended from the Cooper family of Westfall. Would you visit their residence in the western part of Moonbrook in Westfall? See if you can find any proof of his story.

title: The Edge Of Winter
obj_text: Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
desc_text: The Ironforge grand champion's squire told me an intriguing story.$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, <name>.

obj_text: Speak with Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of Stormwind.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Stormwind, <name>. Now, you should introduce yourself to Marshal Jacob Alerius, who leads the Stormwind delegation. As Stormwind's grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: Alliance Tournament Eligibility Marker
obj_text: This quest will be converted toHorde Tournament Eligibility Markerif you transfer toHorde.

title: A Worthy Weapon
obj_text: ring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Our champions have taken a liking to ancient weapons produced here in Northrend.$BI've heard the bards telling tales of travelers offering winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.

title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
obj_text: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Some of the champions believe an ancient weapon born of Northrend will bring them luck in the tourney. I have agreed to help them search for these weapons.$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, <name>. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.

title: Up To The Challenge
obj_text: Present Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament with 15 Aspirant's Seals to signify you're ready to undergo the aspirant's challenge.
desc_text: When you have mastered the skills of the aspirant, you may choose to take the aspirant's challenge. The challenge will test your mounted combat skills and assess whether or not you're prepared to become a valiant. Should you pass, you will be able to join your capital city's delegation as a valiant.$BWhen you are ready to begin the challenge, return to me.

title: A Valiant Of Ironforge
obj_text: Speak with Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds  to become a valiant of Ironforge.
desc_text: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Ironforge, <name>. Now, you should introduce yourself to Lana Stouthammer, who leads the Ironforge delegation. As Ironforge's grand champion, she will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

obj_text:
Speak with Squire Danny to summon your opponent. Once you have defeated the Argent Champion, return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
 Argent Champion defeated
desc_text: You are nearly ready to compete on behalf of Stormwind in the grand melee. To prove yourself worthy to enter the lists on behalf of our city, you must defeat a champion of the Argent Crusade.$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up. Speak to Squire Danny at the Argent Valiants' Ring on the western edge of the grounds. The squire will call out your opponent when you're ready.$BAfter the battle is concluded, we will speak of the outcome.

As the gnomish grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$BIt has been an honor working with you, <name>, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.

title: A Champion Rises
obj_text: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: Congratulations, <name>. You have mastered many kinds of combat and overcome all the challenges you've faced. There can be no doubt that you are ready to compete with the best warriors who have gathered at the tournament, against the champions of the capital cities.$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, <name>, and to formally enter you in the champions' grand melee.

desc_text: Welcome, champion. I have heard of your accomplishments and we would be honored if you would join the delegation from Darnassus.$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Darnassus, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

obj_text: Speak with Ambrose Boltspark again if you wish to become a valiant of Gnomeregan.
desc_text: Welcome, champion. Word of your combat prowess has already reached my ears. Gnomeregan's delegation could really benefit from a <class> like you.$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Gnomeregan, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.

obj_text: ring 25 Valiant's Seals to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: In your training as a valiant, you'll have the chance to test your skills against valiants representing other cities. Although a valiant's battles are not a formal part of the competition, you will learn valuable lessons about the fighting styles and weaknesses of your opponents.$BThe valiants are a spirited lot, competing amongst themselves for honor and notoriety.$BTrain as a valiant until you are confident of your ability to best all who face you, then bring me the seals you have earned.

obj_text:

desc_text: There's no mistaking it - this hilt comes from a powerful, ancient weapon, but which one? I do not recall seeing or hearing of a sword with these markings, but that doesn't mean that all is lost.$BKorialstrasz, better known as Krasus, has long been a friend to the quel'dorei and the Kirin Tor. With his vast knowledge and resources, he's certain to know something. Travel to the top of Wyrmrest Temple and seek his counsel, then report to Arcanist Tybalin inside the Silver Enclave in Dalaran.

title: A Meeting With The Magister
obj_text: Retrieve the Ancient Dragonforged Blades tome from Magister Hathorel.
desc_text: I've placed an enchantment on the tabard that should allow you to slip past the Sunreaver Sanctuary's defenses for a short period of time. You should have enough time to find your way into The Filthy Animal and meet up with the Sunreaver contact there, one Magister Hathorel.$BObtain the copy of Ancient Dragonforged Blades that his men borrowed from Wyrmrest while your disguise holds, and return it to me.

 Bronjahm slain
 $BDevourer of Souls slain

 Devourer of Souls
 Devourer of Souls
