 Devourer of Souls
desc_text: I cannot thank you enough for coming. We're severely undermanned to be risking a venture into the citadel, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the citadel.$BPlease hurry, <name>. We're counting on you.

title: Inside the Frozen Citadel
obj_text: Enter The Forge of Souls from the side of Icecrown Citadel and find Lady Jaina Proudmoore.
desc_text: <class>! Come close quickly, I must have a word!$BMy patron, the Lady Jaina Proudmoore, has uncovered a hole in the defenses of Icecrown Citadel into a place she referred to as "The Forge of Souls." She sent word before she left for me to find any help that I could... and, well, I was hoping that might be you.$BPlease, find her there as soon as you can.

title: The Sunreaver Plan
obj_text: Obtain the Sunreaver Orders.
desc_text: One of my contacts in the Underbelly caught sight of a Sunreaver agent buying reagents from a dealer in the Black Market area. The Sunreavers normally aren't known for their interest in what goes on down in the sewers, so that's a big indication that they're planning something.$BHead into the Underbelly, find this Sunreaver agent, and take care of him. Search the body for any information that might give us a lead on the location of that tome from Wyrmrest. We can't let them get it back to Icecrown first.

title: A Suitable Disguise
obj_text: Obtain a Borrowed Tabard from Shandy Glossgleam.
desc_text: Getting you inside the Sunreaver's Sanctuary will be tougher than it appears. Only those who possess Sunreaver tabards are permitted entry to sanctuary. If we can get our hands on one, a simple enchantment will do the rest of the work.$BOn the balcony above Threads of Fate, you'll find Shandy Glossgleam. I've helped him a few times in the past, so he owes me a favor. He handles laundry for a wide variety of people in the city. Maybe he can find a way to 'lend' you a tabard for a while.

desc_text: They've put our captured soldiers to work in the quarry! Kill their captors and set them free, hero, and do it quickly. We will need their aid when we confront Scourgelord Tyrannus.

title: Return To Caladis Brightspear
obj_text: ring Ancient Dragonforged Blades to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.
desc_text: We must get this book to Caladis Brightspear immediately. Would you bring it to him? I cannot rely on anyone else to transport the book and you have proven adept at keeping the Sunreavers at bay.$BTake it with you to Quel'Delar's rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Caladis and the sword will be waiting. The sooner we can identify the blade, the sooner we can claim it.

title: Wrath of the Lich King
obj_text:
Find Lady Jaina Proudmoore and escape the Halls of Reflection
 Find Jaina Proudmoore
 Escape the Lich King
desc_text: Uther knew a great deal about how Arthas might be defeated. It's hard to believe that there is much hope of defeating Arthas upon the steps of his own throne. And who will take up the crown of Lich King if it comes to that?$BMany questions remain, but the answers that you've uncovered may be critical to ensuring Arthas' defeat. You need to find Jaina and escape the Lich King while there's still time.

title: The Pit of Saron
obj_text: Meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore just inside the Pit of Saron.
desc_text: Quickly, through the portal! I'll meet you on the other side.

title: Deliverance from the Pit
obj_text:
Kill Scourgelord Tyrannus.
 Scourgelord Tyrannus slain
desc_text: We need to make our way up the main path and through the cave to Tyrannus' rise. There, he will be forced to confront us there lest we make our way into the citadel proper.$BGo now, <class>. My men and I will be there to stand by you when the confrontation with Tyrannus comes.

title: Frostmourne
obj_text: Meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the entrance to the Halls of Reflection.
desc_text: We must press on, hero. We've come so far... we're so close to our goal. I must delay a moment to send Elandra back to the airship. I'm uncertain how we're going to escape with so many men lost and so few to keep our path in secure - we will need any help they can send.$BContinue on. I will meet you in the Halls of Reflection.

title: Journey To The Sunwell
obj_text: Speak with Halduron Brightwing at the entrance to the Sunwell Plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
desc_text: Take Quel'Delar to the Sunwell as quickly as possible, <name>. Trust in Uther's words when he says that you will not always be able to control the blade while it is subject to the evil of the Lich King's influence. You must travel to the Isle of Quel'Danas, and there, seek entry to the Sunwell itself, where you can cleanse the sword.$BThe guardians of the Sunwell will not simply allow you to walk in, so you must find Halduron Brightwing, who will be inspecting the guards there.

title: Thalorien Dawnseeker
obj_text:
Visit Thalorien Dawnseeker's Remains and obtain his blessing to wield Quel'Delar.
 Thalorien's Blessing obtained
desc_text: If you truly bear Quel'Delar, <name>, I might be able to admit you to the Sunwell. If you know the blade's history, you recall that it was borne by Thalorien Dawnseeker in defense of the Sunwell against the Scourge. He fell in what is now the Dead Scar, buying time for his men to make their own preparations. You will find his remains near the southern end of the Dead Scar on this isle. Visit them, and if his spirit gives you its blessing, I will allow you to enter the Sunwell.

title: Tempering The Blade
obj_text: Temper the Reforged Quel'Delar in the Crucible of Souls.
desc_text: At last, the pieces of Quel'Delar are rejoined and the blade is whole, but it cannot see battle until you have tempered it. That jagged saronite edge is brittle and will shatter the moment it strikes anything.$BDeep in Icecrown Citadel's Forge of Souls is a place where the blade can safely be tempered. Take Quel'Delar with you to the abode of the Devourer of Souls and look for the crucible. Plunge the blade into the crucible to temper it and bring it back to me in The Frozen Halls.

title: The Battered Hilt
obj_text: ring the Battered Hilt to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: This battered old sword hilt has seen better days. Before the hilt was snapped from the blade, it must've been a magnificent example of the blacksmith's art.$BThe graceful symbols and exotic gemstones decorating the hilt suggest that the weapon may have belonged to a powerful person. Surely, the Silver Covenant members would be interested in hearing about the recovery of such an artifact. Seek out their representative at Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.

title: The Halls Of Reflection
obj_text:
ring your Tempered Quel'Delar to Sword's Rest inside the Halls of Reflection.
 Bring Quel'Delar to Halls of Reflection
desc_text: You have reforged and tempered the sword, yet it sits quietly in its sheath, showing no signs of the power it should possess. You say the sword pulls you, as though it possesses a will?$BDare you bring it where it wishes to go? It's not right that the sword should be this silent and this insistent, yet I fear that if you do not take the sword to its destination, we will never learn why. Take it into Icecrown Citadel's Halls of Reflection, but be on your guard! I'll be waiting for you in The Frozen Halls.

title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
obj_text: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
desc_text: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to me and to the rest of my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. The blade will bond to you. When that happens, carry it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

title: The Twilight Destroyer
obj_text:
Defeat Halion and repel the invasion of the Ruby Sanctum.
 Halion slain
desc_text: This was no reckless attack, but rather a carefully orchestrated strike against the heart of the Red Dragonflight.$BZarithrian, on the bluff over there, is overseeing the assault, but the true leader of this force is a brash and powerful Twilight dragon named Halion. Not since Dargonax has a full-grown spawn of Sinestra's twisted experiments been seen.$BSlay him, <name>, and then when the invasion has been fully repelled, report to Krasus regarding all you have seen here.

title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
obj_text: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
desc_text: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. Once the blade is restored, return with it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
obj_text: ring the Restored Quel'Delar to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
desc_text: In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, <name>. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.$BThe Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.$BAs a <class>, the sword seems to know you lack the training to wield it and hasn't bonded to you. Where, then, will its next master come from? Perhaps the Argent Crusade can find one. Go north to the Argent Tournament Grounds and present the sword to Justicar Mariel Trueheart on behalf of the Silver Covenant.

title: A Victory For The Silver Covenant
obj_text: ring the Restored Quel'Delar to Vereesa Windrunner at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
desc_text: In spite of Queen Lana'thel's boasting, you have restored Quel'Delar, <name>. Long have we dreamt of reclaiming Quel'Delar.$BThe Silver Covenant, and indeed all quel'dorei owe you a debt of gratitude.$BVereesa Windrunner, the leader of the Silver Covenant, asked to see you after you returned from the Sunwell. Take Quel'Delar with you and go to Dalaran's Violet Citadel where she waits, <name>.

title: Thirsting For Power
obj_text: Retrieve a Potent Voidwalker Essence from the Vengeful Voidwalkers and return to Taleris Dawngazer at Falcon Watch.
desc_text: Falcon Watch serves as a stop for pilgrims on their long journey into Outland. Although we are an early stop on the way,many of the pilgrims reach us exhausted and wracked by their addictions.$BIn a world such as this,many find it necessary to relearn mastery of their magical addiction. Food and drink help,<class>,but magical energy is their greatest need. The remains of Outland's voidwalkers provide a potent source of energy,but they grow rare and can only be found in the Warp Fields to the southwest.

title: Coren Direbrew
obj_text:
Slay Coren Direbrew!$BYou recall all the talk about Coren Direbrew in Blackrock Depths. Perhaps you should search there?
 $BCoren Direbrew slain

 Coren Direbrew
 Coren Direbrew
$B

 Coren Direbrew
desc_text: The infamous Coren Direbrew resides inside of the Blackrock Depths.  He is seeking to ruin our wonderful festival.$B<Takes a drink from flask>$BOh boy that's the stuff, Coren Direbrew seems to be causing quite a bit of trouble. We need that loaf of a dwarf terminated so that our supplies can continue to flow!$BHead into the depths and end his plot to ruin our fun!

title: Trouble at Wyrmrest
obj_text: Speak with Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
desc_text: My old friend Krasus sends word of dire happenings at Wyrmrest, in Dragonblight. His missive was brief, but it seems that there has been some sort of attack on the Ruby Sanctum beneath the Temple.$BPressing business here in Dalaran keeps me from attending to the matter personally, but I have heard word of your exploits in the Lich King's Citadel and you are doubtless up to the task -- perhaps you could assist Krasus in my stead?

title: Assault on the Sanctum
obj_text: Investigate the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.
desc_text: <race>, something terrible has transpired within the Ruby Sanctum beneath the Temple.$BThe entry to the Sanctum is in ruins, and its guardians violently slain. We sent scouts to investigate, but they have not returned. I cannot help but fear the worst.$BEnter the Ruby Sanctum and discover what has befallen the home of my flight. Once we have more information, we can plan our next steps accordingly.

title: Artifacts from Tuurem
obj_text: Gather 6 Tuurem Artifacts from Tuurem Scavengers and Tuurem Hunters and bring them to Rakoria at Stonebreaker Hold.
desc_text: Have you ever noticed the behavior of the Lost Ones in Tuurem? They wander the ruins,searching for surviving scraps of anything made by the draenei.$BTheir Broken masters know better. They've left their former lives and identities behind and become something completely different.$BI believe we can use the Lost Ones' compulsion to our benefit and gather old draenei relics from them. Why risk life and limb battling the Broken,when we can profit from picking our targets wisely?

title: <NYI>Harnessing the Light
obj_text:
Take the Glowing Sanctified Crystal to Rumatu at the Temple of Sha'naar,who will invoke the Light to smite the demon within.
 Assist in Voidwalker's Destruction
desc_text: Now,the time has come to destroy this demon. I counsel caution in this,<name>,for there is much you do not yet know about the voidwalkers of Outland.$BTake this vessel to Rumatu,who will see to its destruction. Observe the process carefully and report to me when it is finished.

title: Reforging The Sword
obj_text: Obtain 5 Infused Saronite Bars and the Forgemaster's Hammer and use them to make the Reforged Quel'Delar.
desc_text: We cannot allow Quel'Delar to remain broken and disgraced. Take the remnants of the sword, along with the battered hilt you discovered, and venture into the Pit of Saron within Icecrown Citadel.$BIn the pit, the Lich King uses slaves to mine, process, and transform saronite ore. This infused saronite is what we will use to rebuild Quel'Delar.$BYou must gather bars of infused saronite and capture the forgemaster's hammer, then bring them to the forgemaster's anvil and reforge the sword.

title: Free the Hostages - Rivenwood
obj_text:
last open 10 Riven Widow Cocoons in Rivenwood.
 Voidspawn slain
desc_text: Greetings, Hero! Dark days have befallen Rivenwood, a once vibrant and serene forest now marred by a sinister presence. The vile Riven Widows, dreaded creatures born of shadow and malevolence, have ensnared innocent villagers in their wicked cocoons. These poor souls, now hostages to the foul creatures, cry out for salvation.$BYou, the brave Hero, are the last hope for these hapless captives. Your mission is clear - venture into the heart of Rivenwood and destroy 10 of those ominous Riven Widow Cocoons. Each cocoon holds an innocent life in its dreadful grasp, and your valor and skill are needed to free them from this torment.$BThe forest mourns the loss of its tranquility, and the captives' families yearn for their safe return. Embrace the call to arms, Hero, and let courage be your guide. Remember, the fate of these lives rests upon your shoulders, and your actions can bring light back to the shadowed groves.
